103410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
103410.value: The project focuses on the study of spectral Galerkin/collocation methods for solving the Helmholtz type equations with certain hypersingular nonlocal boundary conditions and large wave numbers. Applications can be found in many areas and the emphasis in this project is on electromagnetic scattering from large cavities. The aim of this project will be twofold. First we will study the stability estimate with explicit dependency on wave numbers for the Helmholtz boundary value problems. The second is to develop some efficient spectral Galerkin/collocation methods and to present error estimates of these spectral methods. 該項目將著重研究Galerkin/collocation 型譜方法及關於帶著超奇異非局部邊界條件和大波數Helmholtz型方程的數值解。該研究項目具有廣泛的應用背景，特別是關於大腔體電磁散射。該項目的研究主要分兩個部份。第一部份是研究波數相關的穩定性估計。第二部份是發展有效的數值方法及方法的誤差估計。

103410.label: Realisation of objectives
103410.value: All the project objectives have been achieved. Particularly, 1. we present a stability estimate with the explicit dependency of wavenumber for the Helmholtz type problem, 2. an effective Legendre spectral Galerkin method and a high-order FEM have been proposed and the corresponding error estimate of the spectral method has been given, and 3. a systematic numerical simulation has been done for many physical models.

103410.label: Major findings and research outcome
103410.value: We have studied the electromagnetic scattering from a large cavity embedded in an infinite ground plane. We present a stability estimate with the explicit dependency of wavenumber for the Helmholtz type problem. A Legendre spectral Galerkin method is proposed, in which a Legendre-Gauss interpolatory approximation is devised for the hypersingular integral and a Legendre-Galerkin scheme is used for the approximation to Helmholtz equation. Based on our stability estimate, the existence and the uniqueness of the approximation solution are established for large wavenumbers. The stability and the spectral convergence of the numerical method are then proved. In addition, we have developed a class of tensor product high-order finite element methods for solving the Helmholtz type problem with large wavenumbers. By the fast Fourier transform and the Toeplitz-type structure of the approximation to the nonlocal operator in the nonlocal boundary condition, a fast algorithm is designed for solving the linear system arising from the cavity problem with (vertically) layered media, which requires $O(N^2logN)$ operations on an $N imes N$ uniform partition. Numerical results fori model problems illustrate the efficiency of the fast algorithm and exhibit the expected optimal global convergence rates of the finite element methods.

103410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
103410.value: We are working on the electromagnetic scattering from a large cavity embedded in an infinite ground plane with some different ground materials.

103410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
103410.value: Numerical solution of the Helmholtz type equations is one of most challenging problems in scientific computing. Applications can be found in many areas, such as electromagnetic scattering, optics and acoustics. A variety of numerical methods including finite difference, finite element, boundary element methods, and hybrid methods have been developed for solving the Helmholtz type equations with different applications in engineering community. However, most people only focus on the problems with relative small wave numbers or most of existing numerical methods are efficient only for small wave number problems. This project focuses on the study of spectral and other high-order methods for solving the Helmholtz type equations with certain hypersingular nonlocal boundary conditions and large wave numbers.

104310.value: Boltzmann方程的流體動力學極限：含接觸間斷的情形

104310.label: Project Objectives

104310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
104310.value: 在氣體和流體動力學中，當在不同的物理尺度下關注氣體和流體的不同側面時可以導出許多著名的運動方程。在宏觀尺度下氣體和流體可以看作是連續的，它們的運動可以由宏觀量來描述。Euler方程和Navier-Stokes方程是流體動力學中到目前為止最著名的方程。 另一個極端是微觀尺度，此時氣體和流體被看成由微觀粒子（原子或分子）組成的多體系統。因此這一系統的運動由耦合的Newton方程來描述。 雖然Newton方程是經典力學的第一原理，但是當方程組的數量充分大時，它幾乎沒有什麼實用價值（阿伏加德羅常數約為6×1023）。另一方面，宏觀量和一些依賴於微觀狀態的量的統計平均密切相關。因此給出了氣體和流體運動介觀描述的動力學理論是連接宏觀尺度和微觀尺度的一個關鍵理論。最經典和基本的動力學方程是1872年由Boltzmann導出的Boltzmann方程。 從動力學方程推導出流體動力學方程組的最早工作可以追溯到Maxwell和Boltzmann的工作。他們的工作是基於如何平衡動力學方程中的各項。這種平衡的技巧在某種程度上似乎是任意的。因此，Hibert在1912年提出了一個系統的展開，Enskog和Chapman在1916/1917年各自獨立的提出了另一個展開。 Hilbert展開或Chapman-Enskog展開的主項是可壓縮Euler方程，其他的相應階為可壓縮Navier-Stokes方程組、Burnett方程等。從數學上嚴格證實這些形式逼近，即考慮Boltzmann方程的流體動力學極限，是非常困難的，部分是因為這些流體動力學方程組的基本的適定性和正則性問題等都還是懸而未決的。 由於Euler方程有三類基本波：激波、稀疏波和接觸間斷，在本專案中，我們將研究含接觸間斷的Boltzmann方程的流體動力學極限。具體內容將在下文給出。

104310.label: Realisation of objectives
104310.value: The objectives of the project have been achieved. Five research papers have been published or accepted by some leading journals in applied mathematics, such as Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis, SIAM Journal on Mathematical Analysis. Note that the convergence of the Boltzmann equation to the compressible Euler equations when the Knudsen number tends to zero has been a long-standing open problem in the kinetic theory. Among the results obtained in this project, in particular, in the setting of Riemann solution we succeed in justifying this limit by introducing hyperbolic waves with different solution backgrounds to capture the extra masses carried by the hyperbolic approximation of the rarefaction wave and the diffusion approximation of contact discontinuity. This is the first result on this topic in the general setting, that is, when the Riemann solution consists of the generic superposition of shock, rarefaction wave and contact discontinuity to the Euler equations. Hence, we expect the approach and the analytic techniques have potential for the future study in this area.

104310.label: Major findings and research outcome
104310.value: The research results were written in five research papers that have been published or accepted. In the first paper, we study the vanishing viscosity limit of the compressible Navier-Stokes equations to the Riemann solution of the Euler equations that consists of the superposition of a shock wave and a rarefaction wave. Precisely, it is shown that there exists a family of smooth solutions to the compressible Navier-Stokes equations that converges to the Riemann solution away from the initial and shock layers at a rate in terms of the viscosity and the heat conductivity coefficients. Fluid dynamic limit to compressible Euler equations from the Boltzmann equation is an important topic with limited success so far. In the second paper, we consider the case when the solution of the Euler equations is a Riemann solution consisting two rarefaction waves and a contact discontinuity and prove this limit for both Navier-Stokes equations and the Boltzmann equation when the viscosity, heat conductivity coefficients and the Knudsen number tend to zero respectively. In addition, the uniform convergence rates in terms of the above physical parameters are also obtained. In the third paper, we consider the Boltzmann equation with soft potentials and prove the stability of a class of non-trivial profiles, that include the rarefaction wave, defined as some given local Maxwellians. In particular, one of the key observations is a detailed analysis of the Burnett functions so that the energy estimates can be obtained in a clear way. In the fourth paper, we study the vanishing viscosity limit of strictly hyperbolic systems, extending the earlier result by Bressan-Yang to systems where each characteristic field can be either genuinely non-linear or linearly degenerate. For a given initial data with small total variation, we obtain a bound on the L1 distance between the exact solution and a viscous approximation. Under the additional assumptions that the integral curves of all linearly degenerate fields are straight lines, we obtain a sharper estimate. The convergence of the Boltzmann equation to the compressible Euler equations when the Knudsen number tends to zero has been a long standing open problem in the kinetic theory. In the fifth paper, in the setting of Riemann solution that contains the generic superposition of shock, rarefaction wave and contact discontinuity to the Euler equations, we succeed in justifying this limit by introducing hyperbolic waves with different solution backgrounds.

104310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
104310.value: The justification of the fluid dynamic limit of the Boltzmann equation to the compressible Euler equations is still far from being solved. We hope the results obtained in this proposal can be useful for the future study on this challenging problem. One of the doable problems is to study the limit when wave interaction occurs. And this is possible because it involves the structure of the Riemann solution and the construction of suitable approximate wave patterns that are extensively studied in this project.

104310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
104310.value: In the gas and fluid dynamics, many famous equations of motion have been derived by focusing on different aspects of gas and fluid in different physical scales. In the macroscopic scales, the Euler equations and Navier-Stokes equations are the most famous equations proposed so far. In the microscopic scale, the gas and fluid are treated as a many-body system of microscopic particles. Thus, the motion of the system is governed by the coupled Newton equations. Although the Newton equation is the first principle of the classical mechanics, it is not of practical use when the number of the equations is enormous. The kinetic theory that gives the mesoscopic description of the gas and fluid is a key theory that links the microscopic and macroscopic scales. The most classical kinetic equation is the Boltzmann equation. The first derivation of fluid dynamics from the kinetic equations can be traced back to Maxwell and Boltzmann based on arguments as how the various terms balance each other. Later, Hilbert, Chapman-Enskog proposed two systematic expansions that give the compressible Euler equations in the leading order. The objective of the project is to investigate the limit in the setting of Riemann solutions.

104410.label: Project Objectives
104410.value: to quantify the blocking events over Siberia specifically in terms of location, intensity, duration, extension and frequency for present climate conditions and the linkage with the regional climate in South China, to assess the frequency of occurrence of extreme cold weather over South China as influenced by the blocking events under future climate conditions making use of GCM simulations, and to investigate the physical and dynamical processes involved in the occurrence and duration of blocking events by analyzing the role of large-scale teleconnections, snow cover and sea surface temperature anomalies.

104410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
104410.value: An unexpected severe and prolonged snowstorm attacked South China in January 2008, caused a direct economic loss exceeding 53 billion RMB. The extensive damage brought by this extreme event is unambiguous comparing to that caused by tropical cyclones. For example, Typhoon Dujuan hitting the coast of Guangdong in 2003 caused only some 2.3 billions RMB. At the same time, the snowstorm is unexpected actually highlighting the need to improve our understanding and thereof predict. While warmer winters along with global warming have drawn much attention from the public perceptually, this unusual and sudden chilling weather apparently highlights the potential threats brought by events of extreme weather and marks the importance to understand the reasons leading to their occurrences. For better disasters preparedness, it is therefore crucial to evaluate whether the occurrence of extreme cold weather events such as snowstorms and freezing rain would increase under global warming scenario. Prolonged cold spells or extreme snowstorms in South China are mainly attributed to the occurrence of blocking events in the vicinity of Siberia. Thus, a better understanding of the characteristics of the blocking would be a key to the wintertime regional climate variability in South China. In the meantime, understanding of the development mechanisms and predictability of Siberian blocking, as well as its influences to the winter conditions in South China remain limited. How the blocking characteristics vary in future is undoubtedly need to be addressed by scientists as well as policy makers, for preparedness and risk assessment. In this study, we will first characterize the blocking activities over Siberia in terms of intensity, duration and spatial structure. Then the influence of blocking activities to the winter climate in South China in a changing climate will be evaluated. By examining the Asian monsoon circulation anomalies as well as their connection with other climatic signals such as El Niño and Southern Oscillation and Arctic oscillation etc, the causes of extreme blocking events and consequently the extreme weather in South China, will be uncovered. This integrated study of Siberian blocking for present and future condition will enable us to not only advance the state-of-the-art of East Asian winter monsoon research, but also produce many results and findings of great importance for sustainable social-economical development of South China including Hong Kong.

104410.label: Realisation of objectives
104410.value: We analyzed the characteristics of wintertime atmospheric blocking over Ural-Siberia, the possible relationship between Ural-Siberian blocking and the East Asian winter monsoon in relation to the Arctic oscillation, the El Niño-Southern Oscillation and snowcover, and project the future condition with CMIP5 models. With the support of GRF, we have achieved the objectives and published 4 blocking-related papers in SCI journals. In addition, 2 more papers are conditionally accepted, 1 paper under review and 1 paper in preparation.

104410.label: Major findings and research outcome
104410.value: 1. Characteristics of wintertime atmospheric blocking over Ural-Siberia The evolution of a Ural-Siberian blocking (USB) event forms a dynamic linkage with the Siberian high, in which the decay stage of the USB event is accompanied by a southeastward migration of the Siberian high and a subsequent cold air outbreak in East Asia. These results advance our understanding of USB and its relationship with East Asian winter monsoon activities. 2.Present and Future Climate Conditions of Ural Blocking in CMIP5 Models and Its Implication on the East Asian Winter Climate In this study, we make use of the state-of-the-arts CMIP5 general circulation models (GCMs) for assessing Ural blocking and the East Asian winter climate in the historical scenario and the two representative concentration pathways (RCP 4.5 and RCP 8.5). Biases of the blocking frequency over the Euro-Atlantic and Ural sectors are likely caused by the mean circulation bias over the North Atlantic, which is associated with the displacement of the Atlantic jet stream. There is a strong and consistent linkage between the UBI and the East Asian winter monsoon (EAWM) in most GCMs. Altogether, our results suggest that the long-term mean (variance) bias in the UBI and the EAWM forms a weak (strong) link across the GCMs. 3. Relationship between Ural-Siberian blocking and the East Asian winter monsoon in relation to the Arctic oscillation and the El Niño-Southern Oscillation During the boreal winter, the dominance of blocking thermally enhances cold advection downstream. The frequent occurrence of Ural–Siberian blocking potentially promotes a cold EAWM and vice versa. The seasonal blocking activity can be regarded as the combined effect of the Arctic Oscillation (AO) and the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO). Weakened (strengthened) meridional flow in the positive (negative) phase of the AO is unfavorable (favorable) for the formation of blocking highs. If both AO and ENSO attain the positive (negative) phase, the Siberian high tends to be weaker (stronger) and the temperature tends to be higher (lower) in East Asia, with less (more) Ural–Siberian blocking.

104410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
104410.value: Note that an increasing number of sudden stratospheric warming incidents occur when the heat flux from the North Atlantic into the atmosphere is increased. After a sudden stratospheric warming, the pressure difference between the Icelandic Low and the Azores High is reduced. This pressure difference determines the prevailing wind direction for Northern Hemisphere and thus determines whether the Eurasian winter and/or USA winter will be cold or warm. The anomalously cold period in South China during early 2008, the severe snowy 2009/2010 winter in European countries and 2014 USA freezing cold are a good example. We will identify the different dynamic structures of polar vortex associated with two types of stratospheric sudden warming (vortex displacement and vortex splitting) and how they couple with tropospheric blocking activities. This integrated study will advance our understanding of extreme weather and climate under a changing climate background. It will improve our ability to take adaptive measures to minimize the negative effects of climate change, thus helping ensure the sustainability of socioeconomic development in South China, including Hong Kong.

104410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
104410.value: Atmospheric blocking describes a quasi-stationary high pressure system over the extratropical region, which often triggers extreme weather across the world, such as the 2003 European heat wave, the 2008 Chinese snowstorm and the 2010 Russian heat wave and Pakistan flood. In boreal winter, the occurrence of blocking in the vicinity of the Ural Mountains persistently strengthens the cold advection toward western Siberia and reinforces the Siberian high. This highlights the role of Ural blocking in the East Asian winter climate. This also highlights the need of analyzing blocking in general circulation models in order to evaluate the regional climate of East Asia in future.

104710.label: Project Objectives
104710.value: Error bounds for some learning schemes with unbounded sampling processes and \ell^1 regularizer. We shall conduct error analysis in the least square regression setting by means of concentration techniques. For the least square RKHS regularization scheme with unbounded sampling processes, we shall estimate the sample error and get confidence-based error bounds. For the regularized regression algorithm with \ell^1 penalty and a general (non-symmetric) kernel, we shall improve the error bounds by methods from approximation theory including local polynomial reproduction and norming set condition. Some approximation theory problems arising from learning with RKHS. Approximation theory properties of minimizing functions of the generalization error associated with ranking loss functions will be investigated and error analysis for related ranking algorithms will be conducted. High order approximation schemes for one-class support vector machines will be analyzed, and error bounds for the learning algorithm will be provided. For a general regularization scheme and the related online algorithm, the approximation in the RKHS will be investigated. The restricted isometry property in compressed sensing will be considered by methods from learning theory.

104710.label: Major findings and research outcome
104710.value: In [1] the PI studied the grouping effect of the elastic net. By means of a concept of empirical approximation error when the model fits the data well we improved the existing quantitative estimates for coefficient differences corresponding to correlated predictors in a linear regression setting. An approximation theory problem concerning empirical approximation errors appears naturally from our investigation of the elastic net and was analyzed in our study. By methods from approximation theory, we also showed the role of the l^1-regularizer in coefficient-based regularization schemes for learning. In [2] the PI considered the density problem and approximation error of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces for the purpose of learning theory. For a Mercer kernel K on a compact metric space (X, d), a characterization for the generated reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) to be dense in C(X) was given. As a corollary, we showed that the density is always true for convolution type kernels. Some estimates for the rate of convergence of interpolation schemes were presented for general Mercer kernels. These were then used to establish for convolution type kernels quantitative analysis for the approximation error in learning theory. By the example of Gaussian kernels with varying variances, we showed that the approximation error can be improved when we adaptively change the value of the parameter for the used kernel. This confirms the method of choosing varying parameters which is used often in many applications of learning theory. In [3] the PI considered the problem of function approximation by Bernstein type positive linear operators on a variable Lp space associated with a general exponent function p from the domain to the interval [1, infty). The problem was motivated by support vector machines stated in learning theory as regularization schemes in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. Under an assumption of log-Holder continuity of the exponent function p, we provided quantitative estimates for the approximation when the approximated function lies in a variable Sobolev space. The uniform boundedness of the Kantorovich operators and the Durrmeyer operators on the variable spaces is proved when the exponent function p is Lipschitz alpha with 0< alpha leq 1, which yields rates of approximation. The technical difficulty arising from the uniform boundedness is overcome by the Lipschiz continuity of the exponent function and localization of Bernstein type positive linear operators. In [4] the PI and his former PhD students, Ting Hu, Jun Fan, and Qiang Wu, introduced a learning algorithm for regression and potentially for ranking generated by a minimum error entropy (MEE) principle and regularization schemes in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. This empirical MEE algorithm is highly related to a scaling parameter arising from Parzen windowing. We carried out consistency analysis when the scaling parameter is large. Explicit learning rates were provided. Novel approaches were proposed to overcome the difficulties in bounding the output function uniformly and in the special MEE feature that the regression function may not be a minimizer of the error entropy. This idea can be used for studying ranking problems by methods from approximation theory and Fourier analysis. Approximation theory properties of the minimizer of the corresponding generalization error were discussed. In [5] the PI and his collaborators studied simultaneous approximation in Holder spaces by Bernstein operators. The results and methods can be applied to learning algorithms generated by polynomial kernels.

104710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
104710.value: The goal of this project is to provide error bounds for some kernel-based learning schemes and to deal with some approximation theory problems arising from learning theory. We study the grouping effect of the elastic net and get satisfactory estimates for coefficient differences corresponding to correlated predictors by means of a concept of empirical approximation error. It shows the role of the 1-norm regularizer in coefficient-based regularization schemes for learning. A learning algorithm for regression and ranking generated by a minimum error entropy principle and regularization schemes in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces is introduced. Consistency analysis and explicit learning rates are provided for this algorithm by novel approaches from approximation theory and Fourier analysis, which can be used for dealing with unbounded sampling processes. The density problem and approximation error of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces are considered for the purpose of learning theory. A characterization for the denseness in the space of continuous functions is given. The problem of function approximation by Bernstein type positive linear operators on variable Lp spaces is investigated, motivated by support vector machines stated in learning theory as regularization schemes in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. Simultaneous approximation by Bernstein operators in Holder spaces is also studied.

110210.value: 貝葉斯方法作可靠性分析

110210.label: Project Objectives
110210.value: To develop a Bayesian approach for reliability estimation of complex engineering systems. This involves designing an efficient algorithm for generating samples to explore rare failure events and formulating a Bayesian framework to obtain the posterior probability distribution of reliability estimates using the simulated samples. To investigate various theoretical and computational issues in the proposed framework, focusing on histogram models. To apply the proposed approach to reliability analysis of engineering systems.

110210.label: Realisation of objectives
110210.value: All three objectives have been achieved successfully. A Bayesian approach has been developed for reliability estimation of complex engineering systems, including development of an efficient algorithm for generating samples to explore rare failure events and formulation of a Bayesian framework to obtain the posterior probability distribution of reliability estimates using the simulated samples. The effects of various parameters used in the Subset Simulation algorithm have been investigated, including the level conditional probability and the spread of the proposal PDF. The uncertainty of the failure probability estimates has been investigated from a Bayesian perspective. This leads to a ‘Bayesian post-processor’, where the uncertain failure probability (due to limited sample information) is modeled as a stochastic variable whose possible values belong to the unit interval. The generated samples are then viewed as informative data relevant to the reliability of the system. Instead of a single real number as an estimate, this produces the posterior PDF of the failure probability that takes into account both prior information and the information in the sampled data. This PDF quantifies the uncertainty in the value of the failure probability and it may be further used in risk analyses to incorporate this uncertainty. A theory that connects the posterior uncertainty in Bayesian system identification and the estimation variance in classical frequentist statistics has also been developed. The theory is based on the fundamental property of the likelihood function which always integrates to unity with respect to the data for a given value of the model parameters. To make the theory tractable a second order approximation of the negative log-likelihood function is used, which turns out to give an intuitive relationship. Numerical studies are carried to investigation the theory, which show a good approximation when there is little or no modeling error. The proposed approach have been applied to two complex engineering systems, namely, 1) reliability analysis of building structures (including both static and dynamic problems); and 2) site characterization problems in geotechnical engineering systems. The proposed approach has been shown to effectively tackle the difficulty in generating meaningful statistics from the usually limited amount of soil/rock property data obtained during geotechnical site investigation.

110210.label: Major findings and research outcome
110210.value: Major findings and research outcome are listed below: 1. The Modified Metropolis algorithm (MMA), a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) technique which is used in Subset Simulation (SS), has been analyzed. The efficiency and accuracy of SS directly depends on the ergodic properties of the Markov chains generated by MMA. The optimal scaling of MMA for efficient exploration was studied, and an optimal scaling strategy for this algorithm was developed. A theoretical basis was provided for the optimal value of the conditional failure probability p0, an important parameter to be chosen in SS. It was found that choosing any p0 within [0.1, 0.3] as the optimal value gives similar efficiency. (see Paper No. 1 in section 8) 2. A Bayesian post-processor SS+ for the original SS method has been developed where the uncertain failure probability is modeled as a stochastic variable. Simulated samples from SS are viewed as informative data relevant to the system’s reliability. Instead of a single real number as an estimate, SS+ produces the posterior PDF of the failure probability. This PDF quantifies the uncertainty in the value of the failure probability and it may be further used in risk analyses to incorporate this uncertainty. The Bayesian post-processor SS+ has been demonstrated and applied to reliability analysis of an elasto-plastic structure subjected to strong seismic ground motion. (see Paper No. 1 in section 8) 3. A theory that connects the posterior uncertainty in Bayesian system identification and the estimation variance in classical frequentist statistics has also been developed. In Bayesian system identification, results are often described in terms of the ‘most probable value’ (MPV) of the model parameters and their posterior uncertainty in terms of the ‘posterior covariance matrix’. In a ‘frequentist’ perspective, parameter uncertainty is often described in terms of the ensemble covariance matrix of the MPVs among statistically identical experiment trials. The relationship between these two quantifications of parameter uncertainty in system identification has been investigated. A second order theory was presented, which shows that in a weighted sense the ensemble average of the posterior covariance matrix is equal to the ensemble covariance matrix of MPV. (see Paper No. 2 in section 8) 4. The Bayesian approach have been successfully applied to reliability analysis of building structures (see paper in section 9) and site characterization problems in geotechnical engineering systems (See Paper No. 3-6 in section 8).

110210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
110210.value: The proposed approach can be further implemented and developed as user friendly computer software for distribution to industry and potentially broad application of the proposed approach in engineering practice.

110210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
110210.value: The advent of modern computing technology has allowed engineering systems to be analyzed with much greater detail than ever before. Along side are increasing expectation of high performance reliability and robustness in functionality, calling for a rational assessment of the effects of uncertainties and their mitigation in the design decision making process. Quantitative risk analysis of engineering systems often requires the estimation of reliability, or equivalently the failure probability, of satisfactory performance under uncertainties modeled in a given scenario. Monte Carlo methods have shown great promise for applications in complex systems but its direct version is computationally prohibitive for rare failure scenarios, which are often the main interest in reliability analysis. A novel approach is proposed in this project that formulates the Monte Carlo reliability problem as a Bayesian inference problem using the simulated samples as ‘data’. This approach allows greater flexibility in the design of samples for exploring rare failure events. The proposed approach have been applied to complex engineering systems and shown to effectively tackle the difficulty in generating meaningful statistics from a limited number of data points.

110410.label: Project Objectives
110410.value: To investigate the effects of typeface, font size, text direction, and copy placement on human performance and subjective preferences in a Chinese proofreading task. To investigate the effects of line length, line spacing, and number of lines displayed in the window view presentation of a Chinese proofreading task. To formulate and provide useful design recommendations for the settings of the selected display factors and screen design parameters that will improve Chinese proofreading performance and proofreader preferences.

To formulate and provide useful design recommendations for the settings of the selected display factors and screen design parameters that will improve Chinese proofreading performance and proofreader preferences.

110410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
110410.value: Proofreading is an essential task that must be performed to reduce printing errors and ensure accuracy in the production of electronic texts. Due to the rapid growth of large-scale digitization of Chinese texts to disseminate knowledge and the use of distributed proofreading, texts are now usually read on screens and not on printouts. Therefore, there is an urgent need to examine the possibility of improving on-screen proofreading performance and proofreaders’ subjective evaluations through better use of display factors and screen design parameters. Two experiments will be conducted in this research. The first will investigate the influence of four display factors viz. typeface (Ming Liu and Jheng Hei), font size (10-point and 14-point), text direction (horizontal and vertical) and copy placement (left-right and above-below) on Chinese proofreading performance and subjective preferences. The second will examine different screen design methods for presenting large amounts of text for proofreading. Proofreading performance will be measured in terms of time and accuracy, and subjective preferences will be examined in terms of comfort, ease, and fatigue evaluations. The results are expected to provide useful design recommendations to assist in determining the display factor and screen design settings that will improve Chinese proofreading performance and subjective evaluations. Practical Application of the Proposed Research: The findings of this experiment will provide human factors information and recommendations that are useful for the design of proofreading interfaces to improve proofreading time and accuracy, and proofreaders’ subjective evaluations. 校對是一項必須執行的重要任務，以減少印刷錯誤和確保電子文本的生產的準確性。由於中文文本的數碼化正快速增長，以傳播知識和利用分佈式校對，現在的文本閱讀通常都在屏幕上，而不是在列印本上。因此，目前迫切需要研究的是通過更好地利用顯示因素和屏幕設計參數，對提高屏幕上校對表現和校對者的主觀評價的可能性。本研究將進行兩個實驗。第一個實驗將研究四個顯示因素對中文校對表現和主觀偏好的影響，四個顯示因素分別為字體(細明體和 正黑體)、字體大小(10點和14點)、文字方向(橫向和縱向)以及副本放置(左右和上下)。第二個實驗將研究不同的屏幕設計方法以呈現大量的文字供校對。校對的表現將以時間和準確性來衡量，而主觀偏好則以舒適、方便和疲勞評估作為準則。結果可望提供有用的設計建議以幫助確認顯示設計因素和屏幕的設置來提高中文校對表現和主觀評價。 本研究的實際應用： 這個實驗的研究結果為校對界面的設計提供了有用的人為因素信息和建議，以改善校對的時間、準確性以及校對人員的主觀評價。 關鍵詞：人為因素，人類工效學，校對，顯示因素，屏幕設計

110410.label: Realisation of objectives
110410.value: Two specific experiments were successfully conducted in this project, and were published in top-tier journals Ergonomics, and Human Factors. This experiment investigated the influence of four display factors, viz. typeface (Ming Liu and Jheng Hei), font size (10-point and 14-point), text direction (horizontal and vertical) and copy placement (left-right and top-bottom) on Chinese proofreading performance and subjective preferences. This experiment thus examined four display factors on Chinese proofreading performance and subjective preferences. The findings of this experiment provide information and recommendations that should prove useful for the design of proofreading interfaces to improve proofreading time and accuracy, and to satisfy proofreaders’ preference. The main purpose of the second experiment was to investigate the effects and interactions of line length, line number and line spacing on Chinese screen based proofreading performance and amount of scrolling. The conclusion is that for balancing time and detection rate and improving performance for on-screen Chinese proofreading, the display setting of medium line length (36 characters per line), with 4 lines and 1.5 line spacing should be used. The findings of this experiment provide useful and important information and recommendations for display factors and the screen design that should prove useful for improving proofreading time and accuracy.

110410.label: Major findings and research outcome
110410.value: Major findings of the first experiment: i. To improve proofreading speed, Ming Liu and Jheng Hei are recommended for use in proofreading interfaces for small and large fonts, respectively. The presentation of information in a horizontal rather than a vertical direction is advantageous for both top-bottom and left-right copy placement arrangements. ii. To increase the accuracy of proofreading, top-bottom copy placement setting is recommended for use in proofreading interfaces. Task time is also an important factor and sufficient time should be given for the task. iii. To improve proofreaders’ experience, it is recommended that a 14-point character size and horizontal text used in Chinese proofreading tasks. Major findings of the second experiment: i. Proofreading time and typo detection rate increased with increasing line spacing, probably as a result of an increase in travel distance between the two copies. ii. 2 lines and single spacing resulted in the fastest proofreading time, while 4 lines and double spacing resulted in the highest typo detection rate. iii. Scrolling amount decreased with increasing line number and line length but remained unchanged by varying line spacing. iv. A display setting of medium line length (36 characters per line), with 4 lines and 1.5 line spacing is recommended for Chinese on screen proofreading.

110410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
110410.value: With the advancement of computer technology and prevalence of its application in human work, there is an increasing trend of using different varieties of technology such as a dual-monitor configuration, a large display, a touch screen and/or tablet in a work environment nowadays. The findings of the three display factors viz. line length, line number and line spacing on proofreading tasks here might be changed under these situations. For example, the increase of display size may result in larger font size and larger window size, but inevitably increases line of sight travel distances between live and dead copies which may not result in better proofreading performance. Future studies on proofreading tasks should thus consider the impact of technology on study design and the levels to be tested.

110610.label: Project Objectives
110610.value: Improvement of the counting framework - the current counting system will be improved by researching new computer vision and machine learning algorithms, including: 1) a new unified segmentation model capable of perspective-invariant motion segmentation and background subtraction; 2) the integration of multiple camera views to improve the count accuracy; 3) efficiently training new systems at novel viewpoints using knowledge transfer from previously learned scenes; 4) features for scaling the system to very large crowds (>100 people); 5) static line counters for counting people passing through specific lines-of-interest. Real-time system implementation and deployment - a real-time implementation of the counting system will be developed, and the system will be deployed at City University of Hong Kong for long-term data collection and evaluation. Long-term data collection and quantitative evaluation - data from the deployed system will be collected over a two-year time frame, and the counting performance will be quantitatively evaluated. The system will be further improved by analyzing any discovered failure modes.

110610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
110610.value: Hong Kong is one of the most densely populated cities in the world. The core urban areas of Hong Kong Island and Kowloon have a population of over 3 million, or a population density of 35,700 per square km. Everyday, large crowds form and flow through public spaces, such as open-air markets, plazas, sidewalks, and subway stations, as the city’s inhabitants go about their daily lives. Understanding where, when, and how large crowds flow in the urban landscape has important applications in resource management (e.g. the allocation of funds and personnel), urban planning (e.g. improving the efficiency of crowd flow), advertising (e.g. targeting ads to larger crowds), security (e.g. the deployment of security personnel), and surveillance (e.g. monitoring maximum occupancy and detecting anomalous events). In this project, we propose to research, develop, and implement a real-time video surveillance system for counting people as they move through a crowded environment. The system will count the total number of people occupying the environment, and will distinguish between crowds moving in different directions. The system will also count the number of people crossing a line-of-interest in the video (e.g. entering a specific area in the scene). Finally, using multiple camera views, the system will produce a crowd occupancy map, which details the density of the crowd throughout the environment. We propose to deploy the system overlooking the main pedestrian entrance of City University of Hong Kong, which connects the university to the Festival Walk shopping mall. The performance of the surveillance system will be evaluated over a 2-year timeframe. This long-term experiment will provide key insights on the reliability of the system in various environmental conditions, and seed future research on modeling the dynamics of crowd flow over long periods of time. The development and deployment of a reliable crowd counting system will improve the understanding of crowd flow within large urban environments, which will have a broad long-term impact on the management and planning of the city’s resources. 香港是世界上人口最密集的城市之一。香港岛和九龙的核心城区拥有超过三百万人口，相当于每平方千米35700人的人口密度。城市居民每天忙碌于生活，造成大量行人流动于诸如露天街市，广场，人行道，地铁站等公共场所。因此，掌握城市中大规模人群活动的地点，时间以及方式成为了资源管理（例如，资金和人事资源的分配），城市规划（例如，改善人口流动的效率），投放广告（例如，把广告投向大规模人群），安全（例如，安保人员的部署），监视（例如，最大容量的监测和异常事故的检测）中的重要应用。本项目中，我们计划研发并实现一套实时的视频监测系统，该系统通过人群密集环境中人群的流动情况计算行人数量。此系统将能够计算出所监测环境中行人的总数，并将能分辨流向不同方向的行人的数目。此系统也能够计算我们感兴趣的区域中行人的数量（例如，输入检测场景中的一块指定区域）。最后，利用多重视角的摄像头，此系统会生成一个人群分布的地图，并会标出所检测环境中人群的密度。我们计划将此系统部署于香港城市大学的入口处连接又一城购物广场和城市大学的主干道上。此监测系统的性能评测将基于超过两年的监测录像的预测效果。此项长期的实验将会对在不同环境中系统的可靠性提供重要的分析视角，并且为未来的基于长期的动态人群流动建模提供研究基础。人群计数系统的开发与部署将会改进大规模城市环境中人口流动情况的掌握，并且将会对城市资源的管理和计划产生深远的影响。

110610.value: Objective 1 - improving counting framework 1a. derived a better counting regression framework, which directly regresses to counting numbers. 1b. studied a hierarchical clustering algorithm for motion annotation in video. 1c. developed fast algorithm for creating dynamic-texture based motion codewords for motion classification. 1d. developed algorithm for counting over a line-of-interest. 1e. developed local block-based features for improving counting accuracy. 1f. developed unified segmentation & background subtraction algorithm. 1g. developed foreground segmentation algorithm. 1h. developed small-instance detection method for locating people in the crowd. Objective 2 - real-time system 2a. implementation of all components of the real-time system, including feature extraction, motion segmentation using dynamic textures, count prediction, and storage management. Objective 3 - data collection 3a. evaluation of counting system on different viewpoints. 3b. collection of several hours of data for further validation. 3c. further long-term data collection is hindered by the privacy policy for recording video at the university. Because recorded video must be deleted after 1 week, we can only test on the video for a limited time. We are still developing ways to work around this limitation.

111210.label: Project Objectives
111210.value: To experimentally demonstrate random number generation using optically injected semiconductor lasers. The quality of randomness will be quantified using standardized tests. Due to the bandwidth enhancement effect of optical injection, high-speed generation on the order of gigabits per second will be investigated. Optimization of the injection parameters will be conducted for high-quality random number generation. To investigate random number and signal generation using different schemes of injection. These schemes include modulated optical injection, injection with two master lasers, cascaded injection, and injection with distributed feedback from fiber gratings. The nonlinear dynamics of these schemes can be manipulated to increase the chaotic bandwidth for improved random number generation. 111210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
111210.value: Random number sequence generation has long been an important research problem in science and engineering. Random numbers are required in applications such as numerical simulation and encryption. While true random number generation has to rely on physical non-deterministic entropy sources, pseudo-random number generation is founded on well-designed algorithms using true random numbers as seeds. Over the years, chaotic systems have been suggested as an attractive candidate for random number generation. Owning to their well-known sensitivity to initial conditions, chaotic systems can amplify very small ever-present fluctuations in producing random numbers. Such approach has been undertaken using different chaotic circuits, both analogue and digital, for low-speed applications. For high-speed applications, chaotic dynamics of wide bandwidth deemed necessary. Recently, semiconductor lasers in chaotic dynamics were investigated for high-speed random number generation. Due to the short photon and electron lifetimes of semiconductor lasers, random numbers were generated at rates on the order of gigabits per second. In order to obtain optical chaos, proper perturbations to the lasers are always required. While all related works employed optical feedback for perturbation, the possibility of using different kinds of perturbations remains unexplored. In this proposed work, we intend to investigate the dynamics of optically injected semiconductor lasers for random number generation. Optical injection is known for its effect of bandwidth enhancement, lack of time-delay signature, and flexibility in design, which are advantageous properties for random number generation. Enhancement of bandwidth allows increase of data rate. The absence of time-delay signature relaxes the stringent requirement on the sampling rate. The flexibility in varying the injection parameters enables convenient optimization for randomness. As a result, the quality of the random sequences generated from optically injected semiconductor lasers has to be investigated. Possibilities of fully utilizing the chaotic bandwidth and alleviation on high-speed electronics will be explored. Moreover, in order to tailor the chaotic signals, variations on the optical injection will be employed. Configurations with modulated injection, cascaded injection, and injection with distributed feedback will be considered. In addition, feasibility of synchronizing chaotic oscillations for secure distribution of random number sequences will be explored. Success of the system will enable simultaneous secure chaos communication together with random number distribution. The results will lead to an extra level of security in chaos communication. The overall outcome of the proposed work is expected to generate novel and interesting applications using optically injected semiconductor lasers. 隨機數的產生長久以來為科學和工程學中的一個重要命題。隨機數字應用於模拟和加密。儘管真隨機數產生依賴物理熵源，可是偽隨機數須用演算法和真隨機數為種子。混沌提供隨機數產生的可能性。 由於對初始條件的敏感，混沌系統可以放大很小的初始差異以產生隨機數。雖然低速的應用可使用不同的混沌電路，高速的應用必需利用寬頻混沌。近來，半導體激光器的混沌動力學被應用於產生快速隨機數。光子和電子的快速衰減容許了產生每秒千兆的隨機二元數。光學混沌總是需要對激光器適當的微擾。儘管有相關的實驗曾使用光回饋為微擾，但不同的微擾方法迄今仍未被研究。 在這項工作，我們使用光注入為微擾使半導體激光器產生隨機數。光注入有利增強頻寬和省免時間延遲。 增強的頻寬允許速率的提高。注入參數的靈活性將方便優化。初步調查顯示了光注入激光器於隨機數研究的潛力。這工作將探討充分利用混沌頻寬和減輕使用高速電子的可行性。 此外，這研究將會考慮注入調製、注入級聯及分佈回饋。這工作另將探討同步混沌隨機數分佈的可行性，使隨機數分佈應用於混沌通信。 總體結果預料將會成為光注入半導體激光器的新應用。

111210.label: Realisation of objectives
111210.value: The project focused on the applications of the electrical signals converted from optical chaos for random number generation. The optical chaos is obtained from the nonlinear dynamics of single-mode semiconductor lasers. Due to the sensitivity to initial conditions, the inherent noise in the lasers can lead to random number generation at high bit rates, which rely also on the fast electronics for processing. The objectives listed above have been progressively achieved during the project as follows. Objective 1 was concerned with utilizing chaos generated from optically injected lasers for random number generation. The objective was completed by an experimental demonstration. The chaotic waveforms inherently possess no undesirable autocorrelation due to the absence of feedback, which allowed passing the standard test suite of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Also, an oversampling technique was developed to alleviate the bandwidth requirements on the electronics. An output bit rate of 30 Gbps was achieved using only a fractional bandwidth of 1.5 GHz of the optical chaos. Further bandwidth broadening with fiber nonlinearity at relatively high power levels were tested also. Objective 2 was concerned with variation of the perturbation schemes for chaos generation. Distributed feedbacks from fiber Bragg gratings were found as an effective solution for eliminating the undesirable time-delay signatures in feedback systems. The approach was further consolidated by simulating the lasers with gratings, which led to optimization of the time-delay signatures and the chaotic bandwidth for random number generation. The perturbation scheme with modulated optical injection was investigated for data format conversion between amplitude- and frequency-keying. Also, stabilization of the oscillatory signal fluctuations was demonstrated through a combination of the optical injection and feedback schemes. Objective 3 was about generating different channels of random bits simultaneously. Security can be assured based on the principle of limited observability when the synchronization with sufficient robustness becomes impractical. Such a limited observability requires a sufficiently high random bit generation rates. As a result, the optical chaos from the injected lasers was investigated in which both the amplitude and phase fluctuations are utilized. Through optical as well as electrical mixings, different portions of the chaos bandwidth are effectively utilized which allowed parallel generation of random bit streams. With the oversampling technique, four simultaneous channels were demonstrated with a high aggregated output bit rate reaching 200 Gbps.

111210.label: Major findings and research outcome
111210.value: The research outcome contributed to 6 journal publications, 2 invited conference papers, and 4 other conference or symposium papers. The work also led to training a M.Phil. student who is continuing with his Ph.D. study and contributed to forming to a collaboration with the University of Glasgow. The major findings are summarized as follows. Random number generation was experimentally demonstrated using a semiconductor laser driven into chaos by optical injection. It was achieved at a sampling rate of 10 GHz even when digitizing only a fractional bandwidth of 1.5 GHz within a much broader chaotic bandwidth. Only the 3 least significant bits were retained per sample in producing an output bit rate of 30 Gbps. The approach requires no complicated postprocessing and has no stringent requirement on the electronics bandwidth. Besides, broadband chaos generated in the optically injected semiconductor laser was applied for power-over-fiber transmission, where optical power of 27 dBm was obtained after 20 km transmission over a fiber. The approaches required no modulation electronics or microwave signal sources. Details were documented in journal publications [1-2] and conference publications [1-2,5-6] in Part C. Modifications of the perturbations schemes were also considered. Lasers were put under distributed feedbacks for concealing the feedback time in chaos generation. Detailed simulations revealed the link between the associated chromatic dispersion and the time-delay signature. Moreover, lasers under modulated optical injection were also studied for modulation format conversion through dynamical tuning of the oscillation frequency. Furthermore, frequency fluctuation reduction was demonstrated with a combination of optical injection and optical feedback. Using a laser with a relaxation resonance frequency of only 7 GHz, photonic generation reaching 45 GHz was demonstrated with a linewidth below 50 kHz. Details were documented in journal publications [3-5] in Part C. The principle of limited observability requires a sufficiently high output bit rate for the random number generation for ensuring security. Parallel random bit streams were demonstrated by extracting portions of the chaotic emission, where mixings in both the optical and electrical domains were realized. Each channel was required to digitize only 2.5 GHz of a much broader chaos bandwidth. At a sampling rate of 10 GHz with a maximal of 5 least significant bits selected from every 8-bit sample, the total output bit rate reaches 200 Gb/s from four simultaneous channels, where their randomness were verified using the NIST tests. Details were documented in journal publication [6] and conference publications [3-4] in Part C.

111210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
111210.value: The project developed a new approach of random bit generation by simply using lasers under continuous-wave injection. It would be interesting to extend the research to address the following questions. 1. Can optical down-conversion be utilized to circumvent the electronic bottleneck? The approach in the project still relied on some electronics, which would better be eliminated for developing an all-optical system. Research is in progress through another project on this issue. 2. Can the fast random bits generated be directly applied in digital systems? This requires sufficient parallelization for feeding into digital circuits of a large number of channels and relatively low bandwidths. 3. Can the bistability in photonic devices be utilized for digitizing the analog chaotic signals? Instead of the costly electronic analog-to-digital converters, both active and passive photonic devices with bistabilities are candidates for digitization of optical chaos.

111210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
111210.value: Random numbers are crucial for engineering in numerical simulation and encryption. True random number generation has to rely on physical non-deterministic entropy sources, while pseudo-random numbers rely on well-designed algorithms. Yet, even pseudo-random numbers require true random numbers as seeds. Chaotic systems have been suggested as an attractive candidate for providing physical entropies. They allowed random number generation based on their high sensitivity to initial conditions. For high bit rates, utilizing optical chaos for random number generation appeared an excellent candidate. This project successfully demonstrated an approach of chaotic random bit generation using laser light. It is mainly based on chaos generation through optically injecting a semiconductor laser using a continuous-wave optical wave. The approach inherently eliminated the undesirable residual time-delay information, which was commonly found in other optical chaos systems. Variations on the perturbation, in addition to the optical injection alone, were also explored to improve the chaotic properties. The possibility of parallelized generation was also verified and developed through experiments, which led to generation at high bit rates with excellent randomness quality as scrutinized by the standardized randomness tests. The approach developed in this project can potentially enable optical chaos communication and encryption with much improved security.

111410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
111410.value: Building software using service-oriented architecture and web services is increasingly popular. In this kind of software, web services use XML as the common message format to exchange information among one another in a loosely coupled manner. Developers may specify the required message types using XML Schema, which is also in XML format. XPath is an indispensable means to manipulate these documents, such as extracting the required contents from an XML message returned by a web service, or keeping the extracted contents in a variable under the right variable definition. Any mismatch among components, such as extracting the wrong contents, failing to extract any content from a correct XML message, or different interpretations of the same XML message by two collaborating web services may cause the software to function incorrectly. This project aims to develop a comprehensive testing framework to assure web services and the software applications that are built on top of web services and service-oriented architecture. We address the problems of whether developers have conducted adequate testing to assure web service-oriented software, how to generate or select useful test inputs, how to detect anomalies from test executions, and how to re-run test cases when the software has been evolved or adapted. The project builds on top of our previous research on representing XPath and XML as a kind of graphs known as XRG. We propose to develop a form of parallel composition of XRGs so that different web services can be linked together, and through the input or output ports of web services, each XRG can associate with program codes in individual services. We will analyze how program statements in one web service may indirectly associate with the program statement in another web service, and develop test adequacy criteria accordingly. We will also investigate how to generate effective test inputs based on the developed model and schedule them to test such software with a view to exposing concurrent faults in service-oriented software. 目前，使用面向服務的體系結構和Web服務來構建的軟件變得越來越為流行。在此類軟件中，不同的Web服務都使用XML作為公共的消息格式，並以松耦合的方式來進行彼此間的信息交換。同時，開發者往往會使用XML Schema來規定所需消息的類型，而XML Schema本身也遵循XML格式。XPath是操作這類文檔所必不可少的工具，相關操作包括：從Web服務返回的XML消息中抽取需要的內容，或者依照恰當的變量定義將抽取的內容存入變量中等。在這些過程中，任何部分之間的不匹配（例如不正確的內容抽取、從正確XML消息中抽取內容失敗、以及兩個協作的Web服務對同一XML消息的不同解釋等）都可能導致軟件功能的不正確。 因此，本項目的目標在於建立一個全面的測試平台，用以保證這些Web服務以及構建於Web服務和面向服務體系結構之上的軟件質量。我們解決的問題包括：如何確定開發者是否已經進行過充分的測試來保證面向Web服務的軟件質量、如何生成或選擇有用的測試輸入，如何在測試的執行中檢測到異常、以及如何在軟件已經被改進或者被調整後重新執行現有的測試用例等。此項目基於我們之前的一項研究，該研究將XPath和XML建糢為一類圖，稱為XRG。我們提出將XRG進行一種並行組合，以便將不同的Web服務連接在一起。同時，通過Web服務的輸入端和輸齣端口，我們可以將每個XRG和每個服務的程序代碼關聯起來。我們將會分析如何將一個Web服務中的程序語句與另一個Web服務中的程序語句間接地關聯起來，以及如何生成相應的測試充分性標準。另外，我們還會研究如何基於已開發的模型來生成有效的測試輸入，以及如何調度他們的執行以便在測試過程中暴露在面向服務的軟件中的並行錯誤。

111410.label: Realisation of objectives
111410.value: We are happy to report that we have successfully achieved all objectives of this project. We have achieved the Objective 1 through three major aspects: metric, comprehensiveness, and technique design. Among the achievements for this objective, in particular, we have developed HMFD as a new testing metric, a subsumption hierarchy of techniques for comprehensive testing, and adaptive testing and fault localization strategies for the three aspects respectively. We have validated their effectiveness through controlled experiments in each case. We have achieved the Objective 2 by studying the efficiency aspects in different layers of the technological stack for web-based services in both design time and run time. At the test suite level, we have developed new technique to cost-effectively and adaptively generate prioritized test case sequences. At the test case level, we have developed efficient approach to profiling test executions online and offline and reveal corner scenarios. At the code level, we have developed new and efficient fault localization strategies to pinpoint faults. At the instruction level, we have designed the influence of compiler options to efficiently detect concurrent faults. In the execution aspect, we have studied the tradeoff of energy against output quality-of-service and slowdown factors. We have conducted critical literature review, empirical studies and controlled experiments to validate our achievements with respect to this objective. We have achieved the Objective 3 by developing new re-testing techniques and conducting empirical studies to examine critical design factors in existing and our newly proposed re-testing techniques. We have studied the test case prioritization aspect of re-testing and study the effective use of the coverage data obtained from the previous executions of the test cases. We have studied their integration with test comprehensiveness and the fault localization aspects in test-driven continuous integration. We have conducted extensive validation on them and analyzed billions of test scenarios in the corresponding data analyses. We have achieved the Objective 4 by successfully applying different test correctness criteria, including regression test oracle, expected results of test cases, and concurrency test correctness criteria, to reveal failures or anomalies from service or software-based implementation applicable to implement web services in the controlled experiments. We have achieved the Objective 5 by implementing our techniques as automated tools. Our tools included the automation of test management and benchmark management, execution of our techniques, test execution, and test analysis. We have applied these tools in our case studies and controlled experiments.

111410.label: Major findings and research outcome
111410.value: In this project, we have made significant original and new research discovery in ensuring the quality assure of different types of services (aka service-oriented software) through dynamic testing. We have developed the first subsumption hierarchy based on proven relations among existing and new effective testing techniques and shown that the rates of fault detection of these testing techniques on comprehensive test suites follow the order in this hierarchy [J12]. To handle services whose implementations are unavailable for testing, we have shown that using more precise user contexts can lead to more specific service outputs [J1] and developed a novel metric HMFD to measure the degree of randomness in the inputs and the expected outputs of test cases [J11]. Moreover, as the services under test need to communicate with other services executing concurrently, we have developed the first adaptive approach to generating or selecting unplanned test cases to handle the evolution nature of services composition while testing [J13,C7]. We have also developed the first technique that uses semi-structural nature of XML documents involved in the test executions to discover corner scenarios hidden in the generated test suites and rerun the corresponding test cases cost-effectively [J6,C11]. The underlying of each software-based service is a program. To comprehensive test these services, we need to profile their test executions [C6, C8] cost-effectively [C9,C14,C15] and if there are failures [C12], we further need to assist developers to pinpoint the program faults or anomalies leading to the observed failures in test executions. We have developed novel techniques to reduce the profiled execution traces online [J7,C3] and offline [C5], produced execution contexts [C10], and applied them to profile backend service programs such as (Apache httpd) [J7,C13]. We have explored the use of both failure and non-failure test executions [J2,J9,C2,C4] and the use of failure test executions only [J5] to pinpoint program faults, and summarize the science in such fault pinpointing techniques [J10]. We have also shown that the use of stronger test comprehensiveness criteria can make such techniques more effective [J8, C1]. We have extensively studied how to schedule cost-effective re-testing [J6,J11,J12,J13] by both conducting controlled experiments and proposing new testing techniques. The use of XRG and/or XML technologies are fully integrated in our developed technologies [J3,J6,J11,J12,J13] as well. We have used medium-scale and/or large-scale industrial projects, including proprietary and open-source ones, in our case studies [J2,J3,J5,J8,J9,J10,J11,J12,C2,C8] to demonstrate the applicability of our discovery to the industry.

111410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
111410.value: The project outcome is fruitful, and we have also found that there are still plenty of research challenges to be addressed. In this project, we found that some test cases are surprisingly obsolete soon. The underlying reason is due to dynamic service compositions, and yet individual web services may require fulfilling different interface contracts so that they can be usable. Although the universal interface of services make these obsolete test cases executable by the evolved service composition, yet the intended functionality to be tested may not be tested. It raises the false positive issue in failure identification and require an adaptive and agile approach to re-construct test cases, which new techniques should be developed. We have also found that the standard of web services is moved toward using more lightweight artifacts such as JSON instead of XML recently. Although the techniques developed in this project are still applicable, yet further optimization on the new artifacts should be studied. Besides, future research should address is to run testing in a computing cloud cost effectively. It is an emerging area that more research efforts should be devoted to. The results also enable the PI to obtain new funded GRF projects.

111410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
111410.value: In the past, software applications were installed on personal computers and mobile devices before the users can use them. In recent years, software applications are offered as Internet-based services. Instead of purchasing copies of software applications, users send their job descriptions to these Internet-based services for executions and these services will return the results of the jobs that each matches such a job description. This new model of delivery of computation to users makes the instant availability of the upgraded and changed functionality of such a software application possible. Furthermore, this type of instant availability of functionality makes such an application responsive to the market needs, thereby increasing the competitiveness of the company offering such an application, which is possible only if such a change in functionality is of high quality. The significance of this project to enable Hong Kong to be the first mover and a major player in supporting this emerging kind of scenario. We have successfully discovered a number of new and novel techniques that have been validated to be effective in this scenario through controlled experiments and case studies. 111510.label: Project Title(Chinese)
111510.value: 用於無綫設備的可重構多功能組件

111510.label: Project Objectives
111510.value: Multi-function patch elements: A new class of patch topologies integrated with multiple functions will be proposed and verified. Multiple functions including out of phase power dividing, bandpass filtering and transition between different interfaces, will be combined within a simple rectangular patch. The equivalent circuit to describe the operating principle and subsequent parametric analysis will be presented. Based on the theoretical analysis, the detailed design procedure will be summarized for generality. Reconfigurable multi-function patch elements: Based on the previous proposed multi-function patch element, the patterned ground plane using varactor diodes are investigated to provide tunable capacitance between the center conductor and ground plane. This is subsequently used to achieve the frequency reconfigurability of the multi-function patch in order to fulfill the requirement of multi-standard operation. Wideband active quasi-circulator: A wideband active quasi-circulator will be formed by connecting several distributed amplifiers together with a certain phase shift element. Its efficiency, linearity and noise will be studied to see how reconfigurability can be best done for each of these three parameters. Reconfigurable wideband active quasi-circulator: Investigation on reconfigurability will be studied by adjusting the bias of transistors and an alternative method based on signal cancellation. The previous proposed reconfigurable patch balanced filter and reconfigurable broadband active circulator will be combined with antennas to form reconfigurable full duplex balanced front ends. This will be investigated to verify the proposal and to investigate the effects of interaction between them. A wideband quasi yagi antenna is used as the test antenna because of its unique characteristics, to study the effects of mutual coupling on the reconfigurability.

111510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
111510.value: Future wireless communication devices will be even more complex, supporting both multi-band and multi-mode operation, capable of operating with global cellular standards (like GSM, 3G and emerging 4G technologies), incorporating existing services such as BlueTooth, Global Positioning System (GPS) and Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN or WiFi). Other emerging applications include Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN), WiMax for mobile internet access, and proximity radio for wireless headsets or wireless printing. Conventional multiband mobile radios employ separate narrow band front-ends, one for each band, with 2 bands requiring 2 front-ends, 3 bands requiring 3 front-ends and so on. This problem is further compounded with multiple antennas mobile radios, where this number would correspondingly be multiplied by the number of antennas. This results in a large cumbersome solution that is not adaptable to changes and locale with differing standards. Compact broadband solutions for multiband use are not practical due to their much poorer performance and severe interference mitigation problems. In this research proposal a reconfigurable radio front end is proposed which combines the advantages of multiple front-end performance with broadband operation by allowing a broadband front end to be re-configured. When reconfigured under software control, to switch between different frequency bands, a more optimal performance can be achieved which approaches or even betters the narrow band performance. This result in a one size fits all solution or one that comes close to it. Realizing reconfigurable front-ends, that include components such as power amplifiers, low noise amplifiers, filters, duplexers/diplexers, baluns and couplers, is problematic due to the number of components and frequency bands involved. Innovative integrated multiple functionalities within a passive and an active element is therefore proposed. This solves these problems and reduces the overall complexity, which allows for such diverse reconfigurability. Reconfigurability over such a large bandwidth is no mean feat but the proposed research work overcomes these obstacles be separating and combining multiple functions into two separate blocks. The resulting work will work for both Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) and Frequency Division Multiple Access (FDMA) methods. 未來無綫通訊設備將會變得更加複雜來支持多頻段和多模式工作,能夠工作于各種流動通訊標準(譬如全球行動通訊系統(GSM),第三代流動通訊(3G)和新興的第四代流動通訊(4G)),囊括現存的服務比如藍芽,全球定位系統(GPS),無綫局域網(WLAN 或者 WiFi), 還有其他新興應用包括無綫體域網(WBAN),用於流動互聯網接入的無綫城域網(WiMax), 和用於無綫耳機或者無綫打印的近距離無綫通信. 傳統多頻段無綫流動通訊系統採用獨立的窄帶前端,一個頻段使用一個前端,兩個頻段使用兩個前端,三個頻段使用三個前端等等.這個問題在多天綫系統中進一步惡化,因爲前端數目要根據天綫的數目相應增加.這樣的結構最後只能提供一個體積龐大而不能適應變化和用於不同標準的解決方案.小型寬帶解決方案同樣不實用因爲更差的性能和嚴重的干擾問題.在這個研究提案中,一個可重構無綫通訊前端通過實現一個寬帶前端的可重構功能來合併多個組件的優越性.實現的前端可以通過程式控制來轉換不同工作頻率,提供接近或者優於窄帶解決方案的性能,同時小型尺寸使它可適用于各種不同用途. 由於組件和工作頻段的數目衆多,實現可重構的包含功率放大器,低噪聲放大器,濾波器,雙工器,不平衡變壓器和耦合器的前端存在很多問題.因此創新的集成多個功能的無源器件和有源器件被提出.這個結構解決了這些問題,減少整體複雜度,為可重構概念的實現提供基礎. 在寬帶範圍實現可重構非常困難,提議的研究工作通過把所有難點集成為兩大部分來分開解決.最後實現的結構將可以同時支持時分多址聯接方式(TDMA)和頻分多址聯接方式(FDMA).

111510.label: Realisation of objectives
111510.value: Patch type circuits have previously been hindered by narrow bandwidth and large size which was why the objectives of multi-functionality and re-configurability were proposed. The projects objectives have all been met, namely the multi-functionality [1, 2, 3, 4] and re-configurability [5]. There were some slight deviations from the patch topology [3, 4] due to constraints and its feasibility in realising the multi-functionality [3, 4]. A frequency range of 1-6GHz was chosen for the circuits built as it aligns with most commonly used applications such as public mobile radio and WiFi. In addition simple PCB fabrication methods could be used. This enabled a faster and even lower cost path in realising the objectives with the main task concentrating on the technique and methodology. Thus with more precise fabrication technologies, the research work could be applied to other higher frequency bands such as in the millimetre waves. Objective 1 has been exceeded with several works on dividing [1, 3, 4, 5], interfacing [1, 2, 3], equivalent circuit [2, 5] and filtering [3]. Objective 2 has been met with work done based on varactor diodes that were tuned to realise re-configurability [2]. Work on this was performed before the official start of the research project hence the early submission date for this research paper. Progress on re-configurability was quick at first but when we looked at improving the performance, there was difficulty in sourcing better varactor diodes. Some of the multi-functionality was performed separately to easier differentiate their characteristics but there is no reason why they cannot be integrated together.

111510.label: Major findings and research outcome
111510.value: It has been shown that patch type circuits have great potential for broad bandwidth [1] as well as frequency agility [5]. The circuits have been demonstrated to be very versatile with the ability to integrate multi-functionality [1, 3], which reduces overall circuit size. However its size can also be used to its advantage, because of its larger size it is thus well suited to higher frequencies of operation. These have been achieved with topologies that enable the use of low cost PCB manufacturing techniques. All these qualities have been proven to be possible which will make their use more prevalent. There has previously been very limited work on improving the performance of patch type circuits, which is why it was possible to publish a number of long research papers in high ranking journals. So far 4 papers have been published and 1 accepted for publication in journals with a very high impact factor. Apologies for papers [1, 2 and 3] which have mistakenly acknowledged City University's internal research number (9041555) rather than the RGC research grant number. Later papers [4 and 5] have correctly acknowledged RGC research grant number (CityU 111510). From the work done, it has been observed that there is much more potential in continuing with research work in several areas. For example, with more innovative patch filter topologies using multiple layers, lower patch hybrid insertion loss and even broader band operation. Each one of these is a potential area for research.

111510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
111510.value: There is tremendous potential for patch type circuits now that it has been shown that they do not have to be limited to narrow band applications. Due to their inherently large size they are well suited for millimetre wave applications where large size makes them easier to fabricate or manufacture. Smaller patches are possible but would require high dielectric constant substrates resulting in narrow lines or line spacing. High dielectric constant substrates enable the size reduction of the patch type circuits but are more expensive and require tighter tolerances to manufacture. Size reduction is possible using patterned ground structures but in extreme cases will result in either narrow lines or line spacing. Other major potential areas of research for future development would be to apply the techniques to substrate integrated circuits which have found popular use at millimetre wave frequencies. The reason for their popularity is their ease of manufacture which is shared with patch type circuits. Patch type circuits have not found much use in substrate integrated circuits so this would be a great potential for development and would allow a more variety of circuits.

111510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
111510.value: Research work performed here allows the use of low cost circuits in high performance applications found in mobile radio, existing wifi and future wifi networks that will operate at much higher frequencies. The existing radio frequency spectrum is very crowded and the only way to go is higher. Unfortunately at higher frequencies the cost of hardware goes up exponentially, which will inhibit the growth in the use of the higher frequency spectrum. This will result in an ever increased crowding in the use of the existing radio frequency spectrum. Crowding results in slow network speed resulting in annoyingly slow hearing/viewing of mobile audio/video entertainment that many people have experienced. Consumers now demand premium performance for a dazzling multimedia experience and at a low cost. Use of the higher frequency spectrum such as that found in millimetre waves where hundreds of MegaHertz of band width is available is the only way that will satisfy this demand. The research work performed will hopefully enable this to happen.

111710.label: Project Title(Chinese)
111710.value: 二进神经网络和细胞非线性网络的算法设计与分析

111710.label: Project Objectives
111710.value: Identify the relation between the extended one-dimensional Cellular Automata (CA) and the bi-infinite symbolic sequences, perform rigorous mathematical analysis for a class of Elementary Cellular Automata (ECA) rules from the viewpoint of symbolic dynamics, and reveal the rich and complex dynamical behaviors hidden in various ECA rules such as topological transitive and mixing properties, positive topological entropy, glider, collision, and even chaos. Characterize the behaviors of the perceptron of Binary Neural Networks (BNN), and based on biological concepts and methods, design several new algorithms for efficiently performing a huge number of Boolean functions. Apply the obtained theoretical results and computational algorithms for Cellular Nonlinear Networks (CNN), which is a combination of both CA and Hopfield Neural Networks, to create a piece of PC software that can be easily programmed into hardware realization of the CNN templates.
