147210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
147210.value: The efficient allocation of tasks and responsibilities across levels of government in a country is a perennial problem. In China, ambiguous and overlapping responsibilities between the national and local governments have for long been said to account for many ills of government administration. However, only recently has this issue grabbed the attention of Government leaders as a reform priority. In the meantime, we have seen a stream of adjustments, experiments and ‘coping strategies’ at both sub-national and national levels. But now that reform is on the agenda, it is timely to review the experience of these changes and to see what we can learn from them in order to inform future directions. As well, we should see how the reform discourse has evolved, whether it has taken note of this experience and to what extent it has also been informed by international reform ideas. This study thus has a dual focus: first, on how changes to allocation of tasks and responsibilities have come about ‘on the ground’ and what effects they have; and second, on the development of recent national reform strategies and the reform discourse. Thus, it looks both at local case studies where national initiatives and local events have led to some reallocation of responsibilities in a specified arena (education) and also at the national level reform discourse to see what sorts of problems and solutions, in more general terms, are being identified. In exploring these different aspects of the process of administrative development, the study not only seeks to contribute to the policy debates about directions of reform in inter-governmental arrangements in China but also aims to contribute new insights to wider theories on institutional change and administrative reform. 摘要： 有效配置政府间事权一直以来都困扰着各国政府。在中国，中央和地方政府间事权划分不清、职责重叠的问题长期以来被认为是导致一系列管治混乱的根本原因。然而，这一问题直到最近才引起中央领导人的注意而被列为优先改革领域。于此同时，就理顺政府事权划分，在中央和地方层面也出现了一连串的调整、试验和“应对策略”。在改革已经纳入议事日程的当下，我们有必要回顾这些改革变迁的经验，并从中发掘值得在今后改革中借鉴的地方。同时也应该观察有关的改革话语是如何演进的，话语与变迁经验的关系，以及有否及在多大程度上受国际经验的影响。 本研究主要侧重于两个方面：其一，事权划分调整的变化在现实中是如何发生的，并产生了什么效果；其二，中央最近的改革战略和改革话语的发展过程。为此，本研究将检视一些地方个案，看中央倡议和地方行动如何促使一些地方在一些领域（如教育）重新配置政府间的事权；另外，也要审视改革话语中展示的问题意识和改革目标模式。 在探讨这些发展过程的不同方面时，本研究不仅寻求对中国政府间职能分工的政策讨论作出贡献，而且着眼于在更宽泛的制度变迁和行政改革理论上提出新的见解。

147210.label: Realisation of objectives
147210.value: All the project objectives have been adequately met. This is largely due to the extensive field research through which, notwithstanding access bottlenecks and complications in interpretations of data, an enriched understanding of actors and processes was obtained; and we have also made use of panel data information to assist evaluation of the reform. There are doubtless limitations of the panel and ethnographic data – which are generic to their nature and in many cases a reflection of practical constraints of the research environment – and they enable insights as well as pose challenge on the subject. This work has led to new and ongoing research in the areas of fiscal policy, equity education, and inter-governmental relations. For this reason, I would not claim 100% objective completion – all research is part of a continuum and an open-end process.

147210.label: Major findings and research outcome
147210.value: Major findings of this research, many of them as reported in the research outputs listed in Part C below, may be conceptualized to consist of five major areas: (1) Analysis of the Jurisdiction Demarcation Reform measures and their embeddedness in the larger policy reform and political context of China: the ‘What’, and ‘Why/Significance’ questions. [Output#1, 10,12] (2) Analysis of the process of the Education jurisdiction demarcation reform, including actors and their interaction: the ‘How’ question [Output#4,5,9]. (3) Evaluation of reform outcomes against its objectives, using panel data available and ethnographic data from case studies: the ‘So What’ question [Output#2,3,4,5,9,13,14]. (4) Analysis of a major part of the education reform – impact for equity in education. The objective to develop ‘equitable education’ is in part a development of the education financing and demarcation reforms, and allows us an angle to understand and evaluate the meaning and significance of the latter. [Output#7,8,11] (5) Broader understanding of the bigger government reform processes and inter-governmental reforms, arising from, but not limited to, the education reforms. [Output#1,6,9,12]

147210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
147210.value: This research has potential for further development in a few directions for follow up: (1) A projection of possible institutional reforms on jurisdiction demarcation in education and other areas, leveraging on insights on inter-governmental dimensions and actors’ incentives gained here. Action taken: 2 new projects started by a team member in China. PI will participate as CI in one of these. (2) Study of the fiscal mechanisms and system design and possible institutional reform designs. Action taken: initial discussions commenced with prospective new collaborators and team members. (3) Administrative reform and role of law and reform: PI will continue ongoing work in Guangdong and explore new collaboration opportunities, especially in Shunde and Nansha, where PI was invited to take part in the reform design and execution governance processes by respective governments. (4) Equity education and reform processes and design: follow up on a deepening and evolving reform process and intellectual discourse.

147210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
147210.value: Education is amongst the top policy priorities in most governments including China and but the state of education provision as a public good has been highly uneven in the country and conditions in the rural education sector are, in many cases, disturbing. Addressing these conditions was the objective of a major reform initiative in the mid-2000s by the national government and this research seeks to understand its effectiveness and difficulties. It does so using in-depth case studies through which we identified actors and their ideas, incentives and roles, and aggregate panel data through which we gauged the impact of actions taken. We find that the massive injection of central state resources into a previously highly decentralized rural education sector has no doubt changed the behaviours of education actors, but the wide disparities of education standards and provision between the more and less well-off regions have largely remained. Local government leaders had complex incentives and it may not be fair or true to ascribe implementation difficulties of national policy objectives to local non-compliance. Enhancing the quality and equity of education requires more equitable distribution of fiscal resources in different education sectors and localities; but more importantly, it requires efforts and reflection beyond the adjustments to the education budget.

147610.label: Project Objectives
147610.value: Investigate the relationship between operational performance, particularly cost, and carbon footprint and the tradeoff associated with decisions that impact operational performance and carbon footprint. Develop models that support the design, planning and control of supply chains with both cost and carbon footprint in mind. Investigate the benefit of collaboration and coordination among firms within the same supply chain when there are constraints on carbon emissions and identify incentive schemes under which such collaboration is beneficial to all firms. Study the impact of mechanisms such as carbon tax, carbon offsetting and carbon trading on the carbon cost-carbon footprint tradeoff for individual firms and the supply chain as a whole. Particularly, facing a volatile carbon trading market, what kind of policy firms should adopt to manage their carbon asset. Develop several industry cases studies that illustrate the impact of operational decisions and supply chain coordination on carbon footprint. Provide insights and guidelines for government and regulatory agencies on carbon emission reduction policies. An objective is to support the design of policies that achieve desired emission targets while minimizing the cost to the entire supply chain.

147610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
147610.value: 二氧化碳排放日益被公认为是全球暖化的一个主因。很多公司，或基于自身的考虑或迫于公众与政府的压力，开始致力于碳减排。各国政府，包括欧洲、日本、美、中、印等等，已经完成或者正在着手相关的立法工作。在香港和中国大陆，对于环境的关注也要求制造商和物流业者大力减排。 在多数工业中，当前的减排主要集中在直接减排，也就是通过设备的更新换代或者采用新能源来减排。这些工作当然是重要和显著的，但却忽略了一个同样重要的、由于不当的商业实践和运营策略导致的排放。只关注于直接排放同样忽略了由于企业间缺乏合作导致的过量的不必要的排放。 在本项目中，我们提出通过高效运营和供应链协作来减排。我们主张（1）改变当前运营现状的有效率的运营可以显著减排；（2） 供应链协作可以一个较低的成本达致整个供应链的减排；（3） 设定供应链范围的碳排放限额有利于鼓励企业间的合作，达到低成本减排的目的。 本项目获得了METRO Group和格力电子两家公司的支持。他们将帮助我们采集数据，验证我们的理论模型的正确性。在本项目中，我们计划开发一系列综合考虑成本和碳排放的决策模型。这些模型可以被用来帮助单个公司以较低的成本减少自己的碳排放，也可以用来帮助供应链上的多个公司协作减排。我们将会考虑各种碳规则对于公司的影响。项目的另一个目的是找出一种协作的机制；在这种机制下面，企业会自发的参与碳减排，自发的去寻求供应链的协调。我们相信，本研究除了可以向企业决策者提供管理的洞见，对于碳规则制定者制定有效的规则也会有很大的裨益。

147610.label: Realisation of objectives
147610.value: The project objectives have been achieved as planned. These are mainly delivered through three research projects. In the first research project, we used simple, classical lot sizing models to study the impact of carbon regulations and the tradeoff between cost and carbon reduction. To certain extent, our models are pioneering, and many research works have followed us to use similar models to address the similar concerns under different backgrounds like transportation and logistics and some specific production environments. So far, the research paper published by IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering has received 124 citations (according to Google Scholar) over the short period of time. In the second research project, we look at a more concrete production planning setting, i.e., a power plant's power generation planning, and we use that to examine how a firm would operationally respond to the forthcoming carbon regulations. The complexity of decision making is greatly improved. Nevertheless, we have been able to characterize the structure of the optimal policy and examine the impacts of carbon regulations on firm's decisions and profits. This more concrete example also demonstrates consistent insights as in our first project. In our third project, motivated by the empirical findings so far in those countries or regions with carbon regulations in place, we study the impacts of carbon policies on an economy's cost and social welfare. We find that surprising, carbon reduction may not lead to cost increment to an economy, and the social welfare excluding environmental benefits may increase due to carbon regulations. The intuition is that carbon regulation will twist firms' cost structure and thus they will compete less intensively. As a result, the firms' profits may increase. In the meanwhile, consumers may also benefit since the government will reduce their other tax burdens such as income tax. Such a finding is very helpful for policy makers who typically face huge political pressure when proposing carbon regulations--economy may be hurt due to carbon efforts, which is not necessarily true according to our study. Through these research projects, we have been able to achieve basically all the project objectives.

147610.label: Major findings and research outcome
147610.value: The first major research finding is that operational adjustment can mitigate carbon emissions effectively. With a very small cost increment, firms can reduce up to 15% carbon emissions. Further, carbon constraints may encourage supply chain members to collaborate, and as a result, surprising, the firms' total profits may increase. In particular, we propose that an emission regulation is imposed on a supply chain instead of a single firm; in other words, a larger scope, which allows firms more flexibility to effectively reduce carbon emissions. The second major outcome is we have successfully developed simple production policies for power plants in the presence of new carbon constraints, either carbon cap, tax, or cap-and-trade. The problem tends to be very complex. Nevertheless, we showed that the power plant's optimal policy follows a generalized (s,S,p) policy. The third major finding is that using a competitive model, we showed that carbon regulation may actually cost nothing to the economy in the meanwhile bringing environmental benefits. This is consistent with the empirical findings in those countries or regions where carbon tax have been implemented, including Germany, Norway, Sweden, British Columbia of Canada. Our explanation is that in the presence of carbon tax, the firms' competition becomes less intensive, as a result, less is produced and a higher price is commanded. As a result, firms' profits may actually increase. In the meanwhile, the revenue neutrality of carbon tax requires governments to reduce other burdens of citizens, such as income tax reduction. Social welfare may actually be improved. The finding that carbon regulation may not hurt the economy is very insightful and important to policy markers, who typically face political pressure since it is widely believed that carbon reduction means cost increment. Our study shows that if carbon regulation is properly designed, it might be beneficial to the society even if we only consider direct economic outcomes, not to mention the environmental benefits.

147610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
147610.value: Besides the three research projects we have discussed, we are now actively looking at other aspects related to carbon reduction. For example, an ongoing project is to study the impacts of a downstream firm's voluntary carbon compliance initiative on its suppliers. Wal-Mart, for example, compiled a sustainability index to assess its suppliers environmental footprint. What will be the impact on the firms' profits, optimal decisions, and the social welfare? We are building models to explore such issues.

147610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
147610.value: Global warming is a central reality of our age and carbon mitigation is an urgent must for the sustainability of human beings. In this project, we examine how firms can change their way of doing things so as to reduce their carbon emissions. We have found that to achieve around 15% carbon emissions may actually incur very little cost if firms improve their operational efficiency and collaborate with their supply chain partners. Moreover, contrary to the widely held belief, carbon reduction may not hurt the economy. In fact, when carbon policy is in place, people's behavior will change and as a result, not only will carbon emissions be reduced, but the firms will tend to be more efficient and seek for more collaboration, and ultimately, all benefit. In other words, carbon regulation is like a driver of change that will ultimately lead the society to a better state.

147710.label: Project Title(Chinese)
147710.value: 超越服務品質：從社會資本的角度理解資訊系統用戶的滿意度

147710.label: Co - Investigator(s)
147710.value: Prof Fang, Yulin Prof Straub, Detmar

147710.label: Project Objectives
147710.value: To theorize the possible role of social capital on user satisfaction in the context of IS services. To examine empirically the extent to which social capital has a main and/or moderating effect on user satisfaction.
rows: To theorize the possible role of social capital on user satisfaction in the context of IS services.
To examine empirically the extent to which social capital has a main and/or moderating effect on user satisfaction.

147710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
147710.value: Information systems (IS) departments have long been viewed as service providers to business functions, and service quality is seen as a key performance indicator for predicting user satisfaction. Yet, in today’s organizations, the changing nature of IS services has increasingly positioned the IS department as a strategic collaboration partner who serves business users by joining their value creation activities. This value co-creation process, however, requires significant time and effort from not only IS professionals but also from business users, which could, in turn, compromise user satisfaction. Drawing from the equity theory and social capital literature, we propose that social capital, as a resource embedded in the relationship between the IS department and business users, can play an important role in improving user satisfaction by (1) alleviating time and efforts required of business users during the IS service delivery process, and (2) strengthening the effect of service quality. We specify three dimensions of social capital (structural capital, cognitive capital, and relational capital) and examine their respective impacts on user satisfaction. To test the proposed research model, we plan to conduct a field survey across several hundred business users receiving IS services in several financial institutions in China. 資訊系統（IS）部門一直以來被視作業務部門的服務提供者，因此服務品質被當做預測用戶滿意度的重要變數。不過，在當今的組織中，IS服務迅速變化的本質正急速地將IS部門推到一個與業務部門用戶共同創造價值的戰略協作夥伴的位置上來。這種價值共創過程需要IS員工與業務部門員工共同的努力以實現IS用戶的滿意。從公平理論與社會資本理論的文獻出發，我們提出社會資本作為一種內嵌於IS部門與業務部門關係中的資源，在提升用戶滿意度方面具有舉足輕重的地位。這種作用可以通過兩種方式來實現：（1）社會資本可以減少業務部門用戶在IS服務傳遞過程中所需付出的時間和精力；（2）社會資本可以增強服務品質對用戶滿意度的影響強度。我們指出了社會資本的三個維度（結構型社會資本，認知型社會資本和關聯式社會資本），並且分析了他們對用戶滿意度的不同影響。我們計畫對中國金融機構中接受IS服務的幾百個業務部門用戶進行實地問卷調查以檢驗我們提出的研究模型。

147710.label: Realisation of objectives
147710.value: The objectives of the project, as stated above, have been fully achieved. In relation to the first objective, existing research has long considered service quality as a primary determinant of user satisfaction with IT service delivery. In response to the knowledge-intensive and collaborative nature of IT service delivery in the contemporary business context, we advance the theoretical understanding of user satisfaction by re-conceptualizing IT service delivery as a bi-lateral, relational process between the IT staff and users. Based on this re-conceptualization, we draw on social capital theory and develop a novel research model to examine the antecedents of user satisfaction with IT service delivery. In relation to the second objective, a field study of 159 users in four financial companies provides general empirical support for our hypotheses. The results generated interesting insights and useful guidelines for practitioners on how firms can better achieve higher level of user satisfaction with IT service delivery.

147710.label: Major findings and research outcome
147710.value: This project yields three major findings which are new to the literature of IT services. First, our results suggest that social capital between users and IT units, particularly the cognitive and relational dimensions, are strong predictors of user satisfaction with IT services. Second, our results indicated two positive moderating effects of social capital (cognitive and relational) on the well-known relationship between service quality and user satisfaction. Finally, our results indicated that the effect of structural capital on user satisfaction was fully mediated through cognitive capital and relational capital, suggesting that frequent communication between IT units and users may not necessarily lead to user satisfaction unless cognitive capital and relational capital are well developed. This research offers several important research outcomes. First, it offers a new theoretical understanding by re-conceptualizing IT service delivery in the contemporary business environment. Prior research on IT service quality has only considered the role of IT units in the delivery process and has focused on service quality as the dominant antecedent to user satisfaction. However, today’s knowledge-intensive IT services often demand a much closer working relationships between users and IT units, thus calling for a fundamental rethinking of the nature of IT service delivery. By drawing on recent work in IT service and marketing, we advance the current understanding of IT services delivery as a relational process through which specialized domain knowledge in IT and business units is exchanged and integrated. This conceptualization shifts the focus of IT service from the original service provider-driven process, a perspective long taken in the service quality literature, to a more relational, collaborative process taking place between users and IT units, thereby building a conceptual foundation upon which alternative theories can be introduced to explain user satisfaction with IT services. Second, our research contributes to the IT services literature by introducing social capital theory as an important alternative theoretical lens through which to gain an understanding of user satisfaction with IT services. In doing so, our project theorizes and empirically validates the crucial role of social capital in formulating user satisfaction, over and beyond the already better understood relationship between service quality and user satisfaction. Specifically, the results advance the scholarly understanding of cognitive capital and relational capital as key antecedents to user satisfaction in the context of IT services that necessitate distinctive interactions and collaboration, thus highlighting the crucial role of social capital.

147710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
147710.value: As with any study, this study has several limitations that need to be take into consideration when interpreting the results. With that, there are also several opportunities for further development of this research. First, as the empirical context of our study, China’s industrial features and cultural factors may limit the general applicability of our conclusions. Future research could extend this study across different industrial and cultural settings to enhance its generalizability. Second, the structural capital measure used in this study could be enhanced by adopting an alternative social network approach, which would assess the structural relationship between the two actors in both directions, thus making the measure immune to common method bias. Finally, given the limited number of departments in our dataset, our analytical approach appropriates social capital at the level of individual user perception. While this approach is consistent with similar studies in the literature, future research should consider applying a multi-level analytical approach.

147710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
147710.value: Our findings suggest that relationship and sharing understanding matter. While IT units should remain committed to improving service quality, they should also focus on developing a strong social capital with business units. Specifically, IT units should enhance communication with users, conduct proper training in related business domains, and help their business counterparts learn more about IT . IT units should also build and maintain good interpersonal relationships with users; for example, by developing various formal as well as informal contacts and by establishing a cooperative culture within the organization. While some of these appear intuitive, practicing managers may not fully realize their importance. When we recommended these suggestions to the companies involved in our studies, the senior managements were rather surprised and commented that they did not think these were so important. Most importantly, these recommendations helped them to improve their overall user satisfaction.

147810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
147810.value: Corporate political connection becomes a widespread phenomenon in the business world. For instance, Faccio (2006) finds corporate political connections in 35 out of the 47 countries in her sample. Fan et al. (2007) report that 27% of the CEOs in China’s listed firms are former or current government officials. Goldman et al. (2009) find politically connected boards in more than 30% of the S&P 500 firms. According to recent literature, political connections are believed to be a valuable resource for firms in both developing (e.g. Fisman, 2001, Classens et al. 2008) and developed countries (e.g. Cooper et al., 2009; Goldman et al., 2009). An important question left under-researched by prior studies relates to the specific channels and mechanisms through which political connections lead to higher shareholder value. Existing studies find that political connections increase the likelihood of government bailouts of firms in financial distress (Faccio et al. 2006) and help firms get preferential access to bank finance (Khwaja and Mian, 2005; Classens et al., 2008). To our best knowledge, no study examines the impacts of political connections on cost of financing. The objective of this project is to use a hand-collected international panel dataset to determine whether and to what extent a borrower’s political connection affects the costs of bank financing. For each firm in the connection dataset, we will also collect detailed (contract-level) information from their private credit agreements. These matched data allow us to quantify the effects of political connection on external financing costs and covenant restrictions. Specifically, our first question will examine whether loans provided to politically connected firms tend to contain more favorable terms than those provided to non-connected borrowers. We will investigate the preferential treatment by using multi-dimensional measurements of the costs of debt, which includes loan spread (direct cost) and loan maturity, collateral requirements and covenant restrictions (indirect cost). Our second question will assess whether political connection affects the syndicate structure of bank loans. In addition, we will examine whether firms with “stronger” politicians obtain even greater preferential access to bank loans. We also plan to assess how the undergoing financial crisis influences political connected firms compared to non-connected companies in their bank loan financing. The findings of the study will contribute to both political connection and loan contracting literature. The study should also be of interest to financial regulators who wish to enhance the soundness and efficiency of financial regulation. 该研究计划研讨公司高层管理以及董事会成员的政治关联对公司债务融资的影响.公司政治关联有可能通过影响公司的财务困境风险以及资产回收率来影响公司的融资成本. 本研究计划用全世界的微观公司数据以及具体的银团贷款合约来测试该潜在影响. 该研究还会结合全世界不同市场的债权人保护机制来研究政治关联对公司债务融资在不同的法律环境中的影响.

147810.label: Realisation of objectives
147810.value: The project conducted a comprehensive exploration of the impact of political connections on loan contract terms using a unique hand collect database and the political power shift in the mid term election in U.S. as a identification setting. The project achieves all the research objectives. Specifically, using a hand-collected data set of the political connections of S&P 500 companies over the 2003-2008 time period, we find that the cost of bank loans is significantly lower for companies that have board members with political ties. This negative link between political connections and the costs of bank loans is more profound for firms with more government procurement dependence, less relationship lending, lower credit ratings, for firms facing stronger foreign competition and for firms during the recent financial crisis period. Moreover, focusing on the sample period from 2005 to 2007 and the firms that borrowed from banks both before and after the Democratic victories in the mid-term election of 2006, we find that firms connected to the Democratic Party experience a decrease in cost of borrowing after the election while firms connected to the Republican Party experience an increase in the loan spread after the election. We also find that political connection reduces the likelihood of a capital expenditure restriction or liquidity requirement commanded by banks at the origination of the loan. Taken together, our results suggest that political connections increase the value of U.S. companies and reduce monitoring costs and credit risks faced by banks and, in turn, reduce the borrower’s cost of debt.

147810.label: Major findings and research outcome
147810.value: The project conducted a comprehensive exploration of the impact of political connections on loan contract terms using a unique hand collect database and the political power shift in the mid term election in U.S. as a identification setting. Specifically, this paper analyzes whether the political connections of listed firms in the United States affect the cost and terms of loan contracts. Using a hand-collected data set of the political connections of S&P 500 companies over the 2003-2008 time period, we find that the cost of bank loans is significantly lower for companies that have board members with political ties. We consider two possible explanations for these findings: a Borrower Channel in which lenders charge lower rates because they recognize that connections enhance the borrower’s credit worthiness and a Bank Channel in which banks assign greater value to connected loans in order to enhance their own relationships with key politicians. After employing a series of tests to distinguish between these two channels, we find strong support for the Borrower Channel and no direct evidence to support the Bank Channel. Finally, we demonstrate that political connection reduces the likelihood of a capital expenditure restriction or liquidity requirement commanded by banks at the origination of the loan. We also find that the impact of political connection on loan contract temrs is more profound in financial crisis. Taken together, our results suggest that political connections increase the value of U.S. companies and reduce monitoring costs and credit risks faced by banks, which in turn, reduces the borrower’s cost of debt. The paper is now under Revise and Resubmit (2nd round) at top accounding journal Journal of Accounting Research.

148610.label: Project Objectives
148610.value: provide a general theory of indexicals, which can properly explain (a) sloppily bound 'I' under 'only'; (b) first-person 'de se' belief reports; (c) shifted indexicals; and (d) the phenomenon of deferred reference; explore how indexicals and attitude verbs/modal operators/quantifiers interact with each other, and how to drive the abnormal meanings of indexicals involved in such an interaction; offer evidences to show that Chinese reflexive pronoun 'ziji' is different from Chinese first person pronoun 'wo', and then provide a semantic theory for them; give a unified treatment of indexicals, anaphors and bound variables in DRT, where our theory on indexicals as well as Chinese 'ziji' can be incorporated; and produce research papers to be presented at conferences and published in journals or as a collection.

148610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
148610.value: Indexicals are linguistic expressions (such as I, here, now, today, he, she, and that) which have their reference shifting from context to context. For instance, when you use the word 'I', it designates you; when I use the same word, it designates me. As we have seen, indexicals reflect the economy and flexibility of human language, and consequently require one’s higher cognitive capability to grasp their meaning. In this project, we will pursue the meaning of indexicals. In his classic paper on Demonstratives, Kaplan claims that indexicals are directly referential: when an indexical is used in a context, it picks out its referent directly, without the mediation of any propositional component as in the Fregean sense. Kaplan takes this to imply that the referent of an indexical is fixed by the actual context of use, and cannot be affected by logical operators. However, this view is challenged by four kinds of cases: (a) sloppily bound 'I' under 'only'; (b) first-person 'de se' belief reports; (c) shifted indexicals; and (d) the phenomenon of deferred reference. After examining these problematic cases, this project argues that indexicals are indeed directly referential, but their interactions with attitude verbs, modal operators as well as quantifiers are far more complicated than that suggested by Kaplan’s analysis. After an intensive study of these interactions, we will extend our analysis to the study of Chinese reflexive pronoun 'ziji'. 'Ziji' behaves in a distinct way from other pronouns. It can be used as an indexical, an anaphor and/or a bound variable. Given the fact that there is no appealing interpretation of it yet, we will conduct a comprehensive study from the semantic perspective based on the comparison between 'ziji' and first person indexical 'wo' (I) in Chinese. Finally, we will unify indexicals, anaphors and bound variables in the framework of Discourse Representation Theory (DRT) to achieve the interpretation of pronominal expressions in a single framework. The present research contributes to the general theory of meaning. It will further benefit the relevant theoretical research such as the nature of belief, self-knowledge, first-person perspective and consciousness. The outcomes generated will improve people's understanding of expressions containing indexicals, and consequently help explain how the communication between groups of people comes true and what the cognitive process and mechanism are like when people learn and use language. 语言中的索引词（Indexicals）如“我”, “这里”,“现在”, “今天”, “他”, “她”及“那个”等在不同的语境下会有不同的所指（reference），即其所指会随着语境的变化而变化。例如，当你用“我”指自己时，“我”的所指是你，当我用同样的词时，其所指却是我。由此可以看出索引词所反映的是语言的经济性和灵活性，因此，理解这些词涉及到人们更高的认知能力。本项目致力于理解并探索索引词的意义。Kaplan在其非常经典的有关“指示词”的论文中主张，索引词直接指向其所指，即在一个语境中，一个索引词的意义就是其所指，而没有任何其它的东西，如弗雷格所说的义项（sense）。Kaplan 认为，一个索引词的指称（referent）是由其出现的语境所决定的，并不会受到逻辑算子的影响。然而，这种观点在下面四种情况下受到了质疑：(a)在“only”算子的辖域内取宽解的受约变量“我”;(b) 有关第一人称代词的涉己信念报告; (c) 随语境变化的索引词; 以及(d) 涉及延指（deferred reference）的现象。本项目在研究了上述四种情况之后，认为一个索引词的意义确实就是其所指，尽管索引词和信念动词、模态算子以及量化短语的相互作用远比Kaplan讨论的要复杂得多。在详细得研究了上述相互影响之后，我们会把相关的分析推广到汉语反身代词“自己”的研究。汉语的“自己”与其它的人称代词非常不一样，它可以用作索引词、回溯词以及受约变量。由于目前还没有一个非常令人信服的解释，本项目会对“自己”进行一个非常全面的语义研究，同时比较它和第一人称代词“我”的异同。最后，我们试图在篇章表述理论的框架下对索引词、回溯词以及受约变量进行统一的分析和解释，以便取得在一个单一框架下对所有的代词进行解释。本研究项目会对有关意义理论的研究作出一定的贡献，并会促进相关的理论研究如信念的本质、有关自己的知识、第一人称视角及自我意识等。本项目的研究成果会增进我们对索引词的理解，最终会帮助我们解释不同人之间的交际是如何发生的以及人们学习和使用语言的认知过程和机制是什么。

148610.label: Realisation of objectives
148610.value: 1. To overcome the problems of the traditional directly referential theory of indexicals, we partly adopt Wechsler’s de se theory of person indexicals, as it can better solve the problem of the essential indexical, explaining the associative semantics of the first and second person plurals, etc. But despite of its correct application to the person indexicals used in single-clause sentences, we find that it still encounters problems if extended to the person indexicals used in the embedded clauses of attitude reports. To solve this problem, we propose to distinguish the internal speaker and the external speaker and use Kuno et al.’s theory of linguistic empathy to account for the non-de se readings of the embedded person indexicals in attitude reports. 2. To reveal the interaction between indexicals and attitude verbs, we begin with the investigation of the logophors in West African languages and the long-distance anaphors in Asian languages, as these items exhibit similar properties as indexicals when they occur in attitude reports. According to our observation, the two notions - logophoricity and empathy - play important roles in binding in attitude reporting contexts. Schlenker’s (2003, 2010) shifted indexical analysis of logophoricity and Oshima’s (2006, 2007) theory of empathy have been applied to the explanation of the interaction between indexicals (as well as the Chinese long-distance anaphor ziji) and attitude verbs. 3. Relevant data on Chinese reflexive pronoun ziji are collected and studied. We have shown that the previous description of the properties of Chinese long-distance anaphor ziji is inaccurate, especially, the obligatory de se reading is not really required. We also point out the problems with the previous theories of Chinese long-distance anaphor ziji, and provide a new analysis for it based on Oshima’s (2006, 2007) research on the logophoric and empathic binding in Japanese. 4. We adopt Wechsler’s (2010) implementation of the de se theory of indexicals in the typical DRT framework by specially adding the self-notion, i.e., a mental representation of self-ascription via which person indexicals can refer to the speech-act participants in discourse. In order to account for their non-de se readings in the embedded clause of attitude reports, we further improve the de se theory by adding the empathy relation to indicate the speaker’s empathy focus. 5. Several journal articles and conference papers have been published or under review resulting from this project.

148610.label: Major findings and research outcome
148610.value: 1. We argue that Wechsler’s de se theory of person indexicals has the problem with the person pronouns used in the embedded clauses of attitude reports, as these pronouns may be knowingly used to refer to the internal speaker, but not the external speaker, and moreover, they may be interpreted as non-de se in certain circumstances; and it also has the problem with the Chinese reflexive pronoun ziji of sentence-free use, as it may be knowingly used to refer to the speech-act participants not via grammatically specified self-ascription, but via the speaker’s empathy (Wang & Pan, 2012). 2. We find that some elements usually deemed as obligatory de se anaphors may be interpreted non-de se in certain contexts. We argue that these non-de se readings cannot be subsumed under the category of de re readings and suggest extending Kuno et al.’s (Kuno & Kaburaki 1977; Kuno 1987) theory of empathy to account for them. We think that the non-de se reading can be extended to other anaphoric expressions like person pronouns and thus propose that, besides the traditional de se and de re distinction, an attitude report may have another reading, i.e., the indirect de se reading, which requires that the speaker empathize with the attitude holder, helping the latter to do the self-reference. 3. In Wang & Pan (to appear), we show that the interpretative similarity between temporal anchoring and anaphoric binding suggested by Giorgi (2006, 2007) cannot be maintained, especially for Chinese. With the recognition of the fact that Chinese long distance reflexive ziji also has an empathic use based on Kuno and Kaburaki’s (1977) notion of empathy, we argue that a minimal revision to Giorgi’s theory, namely replacing the speaker’s coordinate with the empathy locus which encodes the information of the speaker’s empathy in the embedded clause, will help account for all the difficulties that Giorgi’s theory faces concerning Chinese LDA ziji. 4. At to the interpretation of the Chinese reflexive ziji, we propose that the Chinese long-distance ziji is empathic in extensional contexts, and it is often both logophoric and empathic in intensional contexts, though it may still have the pure empathic use in some particular cases, e.g., in some indirect speech. The different distributions of the long-distance anaphors in Chinese and Japanese are mainly due to the obligatory empathy requirement in Chinese, but not in Japanese.

148610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
148610.value: 1. The long-distance binding phenomenon has variations among different languages. Specifically, the European languages like Dutch, German and Icelandic seem to be nicely treated by the syntactic apparatus (see Reuland 2011), while the Asian languages like Chinese, Japanese and Korean obviously needs the discourse-based analysis, though they may be constrained by the different discourse factors. The reasons for these variations are calling for further exploration. 2. Most discourse-based accounts of binding like Sells (1987) and Kuno (1987) are sort of informal in the sense that they do not tie themselves with a general theory of semantics and of the syntax-semantic interface. We think that it is necessary to clarify the relationship between these discourse-based notions, and then provide a more elegant formal analysis for them. 3. Our theories on the first person pronoun and reflexives may need to be further tested by some psychological experiments such as using equipments like ERP or designing questionnaires for children and adults.

148610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
148610.value: Indexicals and reflexives are frequently used in everyday life to express first-person thoughts. It is generally held that these expressions are always interpreted de se (i.e., by self-ascription), which leads to the so-called Irreducibility Thesis (Lewis 1979; Perry 1979) that cannot be explained away or replaced by a co-referring term without destroying the cognitive impact the relevant use conveys. In our study, we examine indexicals and reflexives used in various contexts and different languages, and find that they in effect do not always have de se readings as what is generally claimed, e.g., in situations when the first/second person indexicals occur in embedded clauses of attitude reports, or the Chinese long-distance anaphor ziji uses in extensional contexts, and even in some intensional contexts like indirect speech. These observations lead us into thinking why this is the case. According to our investigation, we find that the theory of empathy originally due to Kuno et al. can account for the non-de se anaphoric binding in question. This is to say, the speaker’s point of view also plays an important role when s/he reports other person’s speech or thought, in addition to the latter’s own position.

149810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
149810.value: 如何在庞大的手机用户网络中进行有针对性的商业讯息 （比如：折扣券）传播来撬动较好商业产出（比如：赞许的回应）？ 本研究从一定的商业目的出发（比如，发放折扣券），专注于移动社会网络应用部署的提议，设计以及实证评估来回答该问题。从传统意义上来说，MSNA是一种支持移动电话使用者在构建公开或半公开的简介，以及与共享同一个网络的其他用户建立关系并交流的移动商务应用模式(Beer 2008; Boyd and Ellison 2007)。虽然近年来出现了一些专门针对MSNA技术细节(Miluzzo et al. 2008; Tsai et al. 2009) 以及用户行为 (Humphreys 2008, Sadeh et al. 2009) 的研究，但是，关于MSNA的商业影响这一研究领域的具体研究仍然比较缺乏。事实上，近来的一期Nature(Kwok2009)已经开始呼唤我们需要更多的致力于潜在移动商务应用的应用型研究。 本研究旨在提出一个整合模型将移动商务文献中出现的有关于MSNA系统的三个主要特征，即基于轮廓，基于空间以及基于时间的特征进行整合，并将其作为有效商业讯息传播赢得消费者赞同的回应的决定要素。本项目是以社会网络范例(Valente 2006)为中心来建构一种核心宗旨，那就是，通过对相当亲密的人们的抚养和桥接关系，通过使用MSNA来产生更加深远的商品信息的目标传送，比如折扣券。我们的研究将包括两大部分。第一部分会注重于：1）MSNA的理论模型的开发以及它在商业信息传播有效性；2）在香港开展一个实证研究，专注于理解是否不同的MSNA的特征对商业信息的传播和接受会有影响。第二部分将会用到第一部分的结果来作一个大范围的实验，以此来进一步理解MSNA特征的影响以及在商业信息的传播和消费者回复（在中国大陆）问题上这些特征之间的联系。最后，通过我们对MSNA的研究，我们可以从中获得一定的管理启示。

149810.label: Major findings and research outcome
149810.value: (1) Mobile Social Networking Application Viability: A Research Framework (accepted at International Journal of Accounting and Information Management). This research examines consumers’ behavior together with the business aspects of MSNAs, and proposes the technological design considerations to fulfill the needs and interests of both the users and developers/investors. We propose three classes of features, namely profile-, spatial-, and temporal-based features, that need to be investigated for MSNAs. We also explore the question of how these features may effectively reach the right customers (profile-based) with the right products/services at the right place (spatial-based) and right time (temporal-based). To aid in understanding how individuals’ social networks can be leveraged on, we have provided a comprehensive explanation of the different social network perspectives that may inform future research. (2) Addressing the Personalization-Privacy Paradox: An Empirical Assessment from a Field Experiment on Smartphone Users (published at MIS Quarterly 2013) This article proposes and prototypes an IT solution - referred to as a personalized, privacy-safe application - that retains users’ information locally on their smartphones while still providing them with personalized product messages. We conducted a field experiment by benchmarking it against two more conventional MSNA applications. Follow-up surveys corroborated these nuanced findings and further revealed the users’ psychological states that explained our field experiment results. We found that the saving of adverts for content gratification led to a perceived intrusion of information boundary that made the users reluctant to do so. (3) Using Personal Communication Technologies for Commercial Communications: A Cross-Country Investigation of Email and SMS (paper conditionally accepted for publication at Information Systems Research) This research began with focus groups’ assessments of two commonly utilized PCTs - Email and SMS (a primitive form of mobile social-networking application) - which revealed their comparative symbolic meanings in terms of intimacy or formality of communication – to be in line with extant literature. Then, in a commercial setting where retailers leverage PCTs to disseminate product discount coupons, we examined the difference between two distinct environments which differed in their context-cultural dimensions (their cultural milieus of social interaction and communication) - i.e., China (an environment of high context-cultural dimension) and Switzerland (an environment of low context-cultural dimension). Follow-up surveys provided deeper insights into how both PCTs’ general meanings and pertinent values in the cultural milieus led to consumer responses. (4) An Informs ISS Design Award 2013 was received in recognition of outstanding design science project on mobile application.

149810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
149810.value: As reported in the last progress report, the PI is extending this research with the development of two mobile applications in relation to MSNA. Data on the user testing and the preliminary field investigations were currently analyzed. Design refinements are currently on-going as well. A design science approach of doing incremental design improvements is adopted. Looking ahead, the PI is optimistic that the developed technologies can be of commercial and social values. Without this funding, this entire reseach cannot be commenced and progressed. Thank you!

149810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
149810.value: This research takes a design perspective of looking at how mobile applications can be created to support commercial and social networking. Several field studies and follow-up investigations involving several mobile implementations are conducted. Mobile applications that aid in the dissemination of commercial messages (and the spread through the social network of consumers), reduce information privacy violation concern, and enhance the joy of using mobile application in engaging consumers are developed and tested.

150310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
150310.value: Organizations increasingly provide online product recommendation agents (RA) to advise consumers on what products to buy and to promote their own products. An effective presentation of a product advice has been considered one of the most significant factors in determining the success or failure of persuasion. However, as cases of Internet fraud rise, consumers have become increasingly suspicious about online recommendation services. Marketing research has suggested that the effectiveness of an advice presentation (strong versus weak advising strength) is affected by consumers’ levels of suspicion on the advising attempt. A strong presentation is more persuasive than a weak one when consumers are not suspicious, whereas the opposite is observed when consumers are suspicious. In this light, this project intends to examine the persuasive effects of RA advising strength by considering the moderating role of users’ suspicion on an RA. In terms of persuasive outcomes, the existing literature primarily examines the beneficial outcomes of recommendation services (e.g., user trust), whereas user distrust in these services has been largely ignored. The persuasion literature has suggested that distrust and trust are distinct constructs. Given the rising consumer suspicion on recommendation services, distrust has emerged as a critical factor in influencing the effectiveness of these services. Consequently, this project will investigate the differential effects of advising strengths on both trust and distrust in RAs, as well as the asymmetric and distinctive effects of trust and distrust on users’ behavioral intentions. Two experiments will be conducted to manipulate users’ levels of suspicion on an RA. In experiment (1), the source credibility of an RA will be manipulated as a means to investigate how it will moderate the effects of advising strengths on users’ trust and distrust in the RA. In experiment (2), users’ suspicions will be manipulated through their familiarity with the product recommendations provided by the RA. To my knowledge, this will be the first research that investigates the role of user suspicion on an RA in the effectiveness of a presentation it uses to deliver product advice. Moreover, this research will fill the theoretical gap in mitigating user distrust in an emerging domain of online recommendation technologies. The results of this study will provide practitioners with guidelines for designing trustworthy and distrust-free RAs for online consumers. With the provision of effective recommendation services, companies can build stronger relationships with consumers via such services, leading to more successful e-businesses. 越來越多的企業為消費者提供產品的在線推薦代理服務，建議他們購買什麼，並同時推銷自己的產品。一個產品推薦的有效描述已經成為影響這種推薦服務成功與否的最顯著的因素。然而，隨著網絡欺詐的日漸興起，消費者漸漸對在線推薦代理服務持懷疑態度。市場營銷學的研究表明，消費者試用推薦代理時的懷疑程度將會影響到推薦描述（推薦語氣的強或弱）的有效性。當消費者沒有懷疑時，一個強烈的推薦比一個弱的推薦具有更好的說服作用，反之亦然。因此，本研究試圖檢驗在線推薦代理推薦強弱的不同的說服作用，並同時考慮用戶對在線推薦代理的懷疑的調節作用。 針對勸說效果的研究，現有的文獻主要集中在推薦服務的益處方面（如用戶信任），卻忽略了用戶對其的不信任。已有的勸說文獻表明信任與不信任是兩個獨立的有區別的變量。在消費者對在線推薦服務日漸懷疑的情境下，不信任逐漸成為影響這些服務有效性的關鍵因素。因此，本項目主要是探索推薦的強烈程度對在線推薦代理的信任與不信任的不同影響，同時研究信任與不信任對用戶的行為意圖影響的不對稱性與區別性。 為了控制用戶對在線推薦代理的懷疑程度，本研究將採用兩項實驗。其中，實驗(1)將通過控制在線推薦代理來源的可靠性，来探索其是如何調節推薦強弱程度與用戶信任與不信任關係的；實驗(2)將通過用戶對在線推薦代理產品推薦的熟悉程度來調控用戶的懷疑程度。 依據現有的知識，本研究將是檢驗在線推薦代理用戶懷疑對產品推薦的描述有效性影響的研究先河。本擬議的研究將針對在線推薦技術這類新興領域，填補削減用戶不信任的理論空白。本研究的結論將提示實踐者如何為在線消費者設計值得信任的推薦技術。隨著有效的推薦服務的提供，企業可以通過此類服務與在線消費者建立更加緊密的關係，從而成長為成功的電子商務企業。

150310.label: Realisation of objectives
150310.value: All the four research objectives have been fully achieved. First, based on prior literature on the impacts of consumer suspicion on consumers' judgement of advice from others, I have theorized the moderating role of consumer suspicion on a recommendation agent (RA) in the effects of advising strengths on users’ trust and distrust in the RA (i.e., the Objective 1). Second, I conducted a laboratory experiment to empirically test the differential effects of advising strengths on users’ trust and distrust in an RA by taking into account the role of consumer suspicion on the RA. The results largely confirm that when consumers are highly suspicious, stronger advising strengths lead to higher distrust and lower trust. Third, related to the Objective 3, in the experimental setting, I successfully manipulated two cues that can trigger users’ suspicion on the RA, namely, the source credibility of an RA and users’ familiarity with the product recommendations provided by the RA. Fourth, in a laboratory experiment, I tested and confirmed the asymmetric and distinctive effects of trust and distrust in an RA on users’ behavioral intentions towards the RA. In sum, all the four research objectives in the proposal have been fully achieved.

150310.label: Major findings and research outcome
150310.value: The major findings of the project are summarized as follows. (1) The effects of advising strength of a recommendation agent (RA) on users’ credibility and discredibility beliefs in the RA are moderated by users’ familiarity with the brand of the recommended product. In particular, when users are familiar with the brand of the recommended product, the strong advising strength leads to higher users’ credibility beliefs (lower discredibility beliefs) than the weak one. Conversely, when users are not familiar with the product brand, the weak strength, compared with the strong one, results in higher users’ credibility beliefs (lower discredibility beliefs). (2) However, users’ brand familiarity doesn’t moderate the effects of the advising strength on their benevolence or malevolence beliefs. (3) The influence of users’ trust beliefs on their cooperative behaviors (i.e., intention to reuse and positive WoM) is stronger than on their punishment behaviors (i.e., negative WoM), and the influence of distrust beliefs on punishment behaviors is stronger than on the cooperative behaviors. A manuscript has been drafted to report the aforementioned findings. Weiquan WANG and Yanli JIA, "The Persuasive Effects of Advising Strength of Online Recommendation Agents: The Contingency Role of Brand Familiarity," Working Paper, City University of Hong Kong, 2013.

150310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
150310.value: A few areas were identified for future research: (1) Regarding factors that may trigger users’ suspicion towards an RA, I only focused on the brand familiarity. There are other factors that can generate users’ suspicion. Future research could look into these factors and investigate whether or not the moderating role of these factors might differ from this research. (2) I only focused on the interaction relationships between brand familiarity and advising strength. In particular, advising strength is considered as the solid evidence violating or supporting users’ suspicions triggered by the brand unfamiliarity. However, the persuasion literature suggests that some other factors may play the same role as advising strength. For example, source credibility of an RA also determines whether users’ suspicion could be confirmed or not. Future research could further explore role of source credibility to extend this project. (3) Regarding the trust and distrust-related behaviors, I mainly focus on limited cooperative and punishment behaviors and thus can’t sufficiently generalize the differential effects of trust and distrust beliefs to other types of cooperative and punishment behaviors.

An effective presentation of product advice has been considered the key to the success of persuasion. However, as cases of Internet fraud rise, consumers have become increasingly suspicious about online recommendation services. In this light, this research examines the persuasive effects of RA advising strength by considering the role of users’ suspicion about an RA. Data were collected in a laboratory experiment. I found that when users are familiar with the brand of the recommended product, the stronger advising strength leads to higher credibility beliefs of users (lower discredibility beliefs). Conversely, when users are not familiar with the product brand, the weaker strength results in higher credibility beliefs (lower discredibility beliefs). Furthermore, the results confirm (1) the stronger influence of users’ trust beliefs on their cooperative behaviors (i.e., positive WoM) than on punishment behaviors (i.e., negative WoM) and (2) the stronger influence of distrust beliefs on punishment behaviors than on cooperative behaviors.

150510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
150510.value: Understanding the antecedents and consequence of Internet-enabled Supply Chain Integration (IeSCI) is an important concern to supply chain management researchers and practitioners. Although the existing research has identified economic and legitimacy-oriented motives that lead organizations to adopt IeSCI, there is a lack of research investigating how these motives are interrelated. On the other hand, the findings of previous studies on the consequence of IeSCI adoption have been mixed and even controversial. As such, little is known about the confluence of economic and institutional factors on IeSCI adoption and the true value of IeSCI adoption remains unclear. Practitioners are left with little guidance on whether they should focus more on economic or legitimacy-oriented factors in promoting IeSCI adoption and whether the purported benefits of IeSCI can be materialized. To address these pending research questions, our proposed study aims to reveal (1) how the economic and legitimacy-oriented motives are interrelated to influence IeSCI adoption, (2) how the effects of these antecedents vary across different dimensions of IeSCI (3) how the different dimensions of IeSCI influence different aspects of performance. Drawing upon transactional cost economics (TCE) and institutional theory, we develop a research model. Specifically, we argue that economic and legitimacy-oriented motives are not independent of each other, as is implicitly assumed by previous studies; rather, they are interrelated. In addition, we propose that different motives have differential impact on the adoption of the escalating dimensions of IeSCI, which subsequently affect substantive and symbolic performance. To examine the proposed relationships among motives, adoption of IeSCI dimensions, and organizational performance, we will conduct case studies with at least 10 companies in China and then a longitudinal survey study over a 16-month period using a sample frame of approximately 500 companies in China. The results obtained will have significant theoretical and practical implications. It will contribute to the innovation adoption literature by offering a more complete picture of how economic and legitimacy-oriented motives co-influence the adoption of IeSCI, the core of current supply chain management. It will extend our understanding of the differential effects of economic and legitimacy-oriented motives on the adoption of innovative practices. Furthermore, this study may be among the first to investigate how the adoption of different IeSCI dimensions differentially affect an organization’s substantive and symbolic performance. The findings of this proposed research will contribute to the practice by offering guidelines regarding tactics for promoting IeSCI and adopting the right IeSCI dimensions. 互联网驱动的供应链整合的前因与结果的探索 了解互联网驱动的供应链整合(Internet-enabled Supply Chain Integration：IeSCI)的前因与后果对于供应链管理的学者和实业界人士来说是非常重要的。虽然现有研究已经确定效益驱动(economic-oriented)和制度驱动(legitimacy-oriented)因素是企业参与IeSCI的主要动机，但对这些动机间相互关系的探索则较为贫乏。另外，现有对IeSCI和企业绩效之间关系的研究也存在诸多争议。这导致我们对IeSCI的效益驱动和制度驱动因素的相互作用机制缺乏认知，同时对IeSCI的价值创造机制也未达成共识。这使得实业界人士在决定是强化效益因素还是制度因素来促进IeSCI时缺乏理论指导。同时他们也无法确定理论上提出的IeSCI价值能否且如何在实践中得以实现。 面对这些研究问题，我们将尝试从以下几个方面进行探索：(1) 在影响IeSCI参与时，效益驱动和制度驱动动机如何相互关联；(2) 影响IeSCI参与的前因将如何差异化影响IeSCI参与的不同维度；(3) IeSCI参与的不同维度将如何差异化影响企业绩效。基于交易成本理论(transactional cost economics)和制度理论(institutional theory)，我们提出了以下研究模型：我们认为效益驱动动机和制度驱动动机是相互关联的，而不是以前研究所认为的是相互独立的。另外，我们指出，以上动机对IeSCI不同维度的影响可能存在差异。而这些渐进维度会分别影响到企业的实际绩效 (substantive performance)和象征绩效(symbolic performance)。为了检验我们所提出的动机、IeSCI参与维度和企业绩效的关系，本研究将分别通过案例分析和纵向问卷调研的方式展开。我们会先在中国选择约10个企业进行案例分析，然后在约500个企业进行为期16个月的纵向问卷调研。 该研究的结果将具有显著的理论和现实意义。IeSCI是当前供应链管理的一个重要创新，因此通过对IeSCI中效益导向和制度导向动机的共同影响的研究，我们的研究成果将丰富创新采纳的相关研究。它能扩展我们对企业采纳创新中效益驱动和制度驱动动机不同作用的认知。此外，该研究开创性地探索了IeSCI不同维度对企业实际绩效和象征绩效可能存在的不同影响。该研究将有助于实业界人士选择有效的IeSCI促进策略并采纳更为适用的IeSCI维度。

150810.label: Project Title(Chinese)
150810.value: 長期痛症患者之恐懼逃避模式：痛症認知與恐懼的前瞻性及追蹤研究

150810.label: Co - Investigator(s)
150810.value: Dr Chen, P. P. Prof Fielding, Richard Prof Jensen, Mark P.

150810.label: Project Objectives
150810.value: To examine the dispositional role of neuroticism and negative affectivity in explaining differences in pain catastrophic cognition; To assess the mediating role of pain hypervigilance in the relationship between anxiety sensitivity and pain-related fear; To evaluate the trajectories of FAM components; and To investigate the concurrent interrelationships of the FAM components.

150810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
150810.value: Existing research testing the Fear Avoidance Model (FAM) of chronic pain generally supports pain catastrophic thinking and pain-related fear as two crucial antecedents of pain avoidance behaviors that contribute to disability. Yet, a number of key questions regarding individual differences in pain catastrophizing and pain-related fear remain unanswered. Previous studies suggest neuroticism and negative affectivity are two primary personality traits that influence pain catastrophizing. However, the distinctiveness of these two constructs, and how they relate to each other and to pain catastrophic thinking have not been clearly articulated. Anxiety sensitivity has been proposed to be the more fundamental fear which is manifested by pain-related fear, and pain hypervigilance has been suggested to be a mediator regulating the effects of anxiety sensitivity on pain-related fear. However, the hypothesized mediational relationship between anxiety sensitivity, pain hypervigilance, and pain-related fear awaits empirical testing. Critically, most of the existing evidence for the FAM is derived from cross-sectional studies in Western populations on selected FAM components, severely limiting the conclusions that can be drawn from existing research. A prospective, longitudinal design is a much stronger method for testing hypothesized associations in FAM components over time. This prospective, longitudinal study is proposed to address the existing gaps in the research literature regarding the determinants of individual variability in pain catastrophic cognitions and pain-related fear, and the trajectories of chronic pain within the FAM framework. The study will also allow us to obtain empirical evidence of the FAM among Chinese patients. A sample of 400 Chinese patients with chronic musculoskeletal pain will be recruited at two multidisciplinary pain clinics in Hong Kong. Measures of the FAM components will be taken at baseline, and at 3-, 6-, and 12-months following baseline. Linear mixed effect modeling will be used to assess the role of personality traits in pain catastrophic cognitions and the underlying mechanisms of pain-related fear. Hierarchical linear modeling and path analyses will be used to evaluate changes of the FAM components over time and the cross-sectional interrelationships between FAM components respectively. The proposed project will be the first systematic study on pain behavior and adjustment among Chinese patients with chronic pain. The findings will shed light on the trajectories of chronic pain and the design of non-pharmacological strategies to decrease morbidity and control chronicity in a local as well as an international context.

150810.label: Major findings and research outcome
150810.value: Results of this project confirmed the hypothesized model that (1) negative affect mediated the relationship between neuroticism and pain catastrophic thought, and (2) pain hypervigilance mediated the relationship of two dispositional factors, pain catastrophic cognition and anxiety sensitivity, with fear of pain. On the one hand, these data differentiated the effects of neuroticism and negative affect, and the dispositional factors influencing individual differences in pain catastrophic cognition. This offered empirical evidence for the theoretical postulation that neuroticism and negative affect are distinct traits that can be conceptually related using a hierarchical model, wherein the former is the primary and the latter a secondary trait as hypothesized in the proposal. Clinically, this hypothesized model offered practical value by suggesting how personal determinants associate with pain catastrophizing. These data established a preliminary evidence base for screening programs to identify patients at risk for developing pain avoidance behaviours and subsequent disability. Matching education and intervention programs may also be designed to accommodate patient characteristics, such as higher neuroticism and negative affect. Further research is needed that tests the revised FAM under different clinical and cultural conditions to further clarify causal pathways in predicting pain adjustment outcomes. One the other hand, the current findings indicated pain hypervigilance mediated the relationship of two dispositional factors, anxiety sensitivity and pain catastrophic cognition with pain-related fear. These findings not only substantiated the existing data that anxiety sensitivity, pain hypervigilance, and pain catastrophizing were precursors of pain-related fear, they also lent further support to the existing literature regarding the mediating role of pain hypervigilance, which suggested that considerable variation in pain-related fear measure could be due to changes in pain hypervigilance. These findings have shed light on the underlying mechanism of pain-related fear that detrimental impacts of anxiety sensitivity and catastrophic pain cognition on fear of pain are partially carried through selective attention to pain-related stimuli. While reducing patients’ catastrophic thoughts has been one of major components in interventions using cognitive-behavioral approach, our data suggest that interventions that are designed to help patients reduce more basic fear, and appraise and process aversive anxiety-related bodily sensations would yield positive outcomes. Most importantly, results of this study added to the existing pain literature on the multivariate FAM which is primarily obtained from Western populations. Using a sample of Chinese patients with chronic musculoskeletal pain, our data is consistent with the view that the basic premises of the FAM appear to generalize across cultures. These findings provided an important theoretical and empirical base for future research to clarify cultural similarities and differences among patients with chronic pain.

150810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
150810.value: The current data could be extended by (1) advancing the current practice of screening patients at risk for engaging in maladaptive pain behaviors, and (2) building evidence-based, less expensive, non-pharmacological interventions that address dispositional factors in the development and maintenance of chronic pain among Chinese. In particular, matching interventions can be designed for patients with specific personality dispositions. These further development would contribute to reducing overall healthcare costs and improving the quality of care delivered to these patient groups.

150810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
150810.value: This prospective, longitudinal study examined individual variability in pain catastrophic cognitions and pain-related fear within the Fear-Avoidance Model of chronic pain (FAM) framework in a sample of Chinese chronic pain patients. Results of the study confirmed the dispositional role of neuroticism and negative affectivity in pain catastrophizing, and the role of pain hypervigilance in mediating the effect of anxiety sensitivity on pain-related fear. These findings fill the research gap in the pain literature regarding individual differences in the primary cognitive appraisal of pain and in the emotional response in pain, contributing to the development of more effective interventions that can address the factors underlying catastrophizing and pain-related disability. This study has also provided the first systematic data in the field for understanding cognition, emotional response, and behavior associated with chronic pain among Chinese.

151610.label: Project Title(Chinese)
151610.value: 在名義利率近乎零的情況下，過多外匯儲備對貨幣政策穩定性的影響

151610.label: Project Objectives
151610.value: To develop a general equilibrium model to understand the sustainability of various monetary regimes (domestic inflation targeting, CPI inflation targeting and exchange rate targeting) when a country experiences large government surpluses and accelerating foreign exchange reserve accumulation. The main differences between regimes consist of the degree of commitment of the central bank to let the money supply expand, or of the degree of commitment against letting the exchange rate appreciate, in order to defend the target of monetary policy. The reserve gains are fastest, and the collapse therefore happens earliest, under monetary regimes that imply the strongest commitment to intervene in foreign exchange markets by issuing money against foreign exchange, and therefore the strongest commitment against letting the nominal exchange rate appreciate. The intervention is expected to be weakest under domestic inflation targeting, intermediate under CPI inflation targeting, and strongest under exchange rate targeting. To examine the dynamics of major economic variables (like output, consumption, exchange rate appreciation rate and inflation) when the government intends to discontinue its accumulation of reserves in the near future and the nominal interest rates are approaching their zero lower bound in accelerating fashion.

151610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
151610.value: This project aims to study the impact of explosive foreign exchange reserve accumulation on the sustainability of monetary policy targets. Several emerging economies, including China and Colombia, have experienced large current account surpluses and accelerating foreign exchange reserve accumulation in recent years. This has been accompanied by economic booms, exchange rate appreciations and in some cases increases in domestic inflation. The current account surpluses have led to explosive central bank foreign exchange accumulation, to the point that reserves now exceed what is required for liquidity purposes by a wide margin. The upward impact of foreign exchange accumulation on the domestic money growth makes the central bank very difficult to control the interbank nominal interest rate, which starts to significantly undershoot the target policy interest rate. In order to maintain the monetary policy target, the central bank will have to sterilize the impact of foreign exchange accumulation on the domestic interest rate by selling domestic currency treasury bills. (For example, if a central bank buys foreign exchange to counteract appreciation of the exchange rate under an exchange rate targeting regime, base money will increase. To sterilize the increase, the central bank must also sell government debt to counteract the monetary base by an equal amount.) However, the sterilization soon becomes unsustainable when the central bank runs out of domestic currency treasury bills required for sterilization, and the central bank’s net creditor position vis-a-vis the financial sector soon turns into a net debtor position. As a result, exchange rate appreciation and interest rate decline continues unchecked, which ultimately leads to a collapse of the existing monetary regime when the nominal interest rate reaches its lower bound. While there have been much research in the balance-of-payments crises literature on the effects of having too little foreign exchange, few studies have investigated the effects of accumulating too much foreign exchange on the sustainability of the existing policy targets. This project develops a general equilibrium model to investigate the sustainability of the central bank monetary targets when there is rapid foreign exchange accumulation and the nominal interest rate is bounded at zero. In particular, three monetary policy regimes are examined: the inflation targeting regime, the exchange rate targeting regime and the domestic price level targeting regime. The dynamic paths of the major economic variables at the end-phase of the collapse of the existing monetary regime are also analyzed. 是次研究集中研究過多外匯儲備對貨幣政策目標穩定性的影響。發展中國家如中國及哥倫比亞在近年來都有龐大的貿易盈餘和快速的外匯儲備增長，它們還同時出現高速經濟發展，匯率升值和國內加速通脹的現象。 過快的外匯儲備增長使中央銀行在控制銀行同業拆息上出現困難。為了要維持貨幣政策目標，中央銀行需要出售政府債券以減輕外匯儲備增長對本地利率構成的下跌壓力。（舉一個例子，如果中央銀行利用購買外幣以減輕匯率上升的壓力，中央銀行需要出售同量的政府債券。）但是，這個對衡方法並不能長期維持，因為中央銀行不能長時期發債，而持續的匯率上升及利率下跌最終亦令貨幣政策目標不能維持。 目前的文獻主要集中研究過少外匯儲備的影響，而很少研究外匯儲備過多時的影響。這個研究室希望發展一個全面均衡模型(General Equilibrium Model) 去研究過快外匯儲備增長怎樣對貨幣政策的穩定性構成影響，尤其當名義利率已接近零的下限時，本文特別研究以通脹，匯率及本地價格作為目標的貨幣政策。

151610.label: Realisation of objectives
151610.value: The objectives have been achieved. The details are as follows: 1. We have completed and polished the DSGE model to investigate the effects of accelerating foreign reserve accumulation under several monetary regimes (domestic inflation targeting, CPI inflation targeting and exchange rate targeting). We use the model to analyze the dynamics of real exchange rate appreciation, domestic inflation, economic growth and other key economic variables when the foreign exchange reserve approaches its upper limit. 2. The solution of the DSGE model has been solved using numerical simulation. Using simulation, we have solved the dynamic paths of the major economic variables in the model (which include output, consumption, exchange rate appreciation rate and inflation) when the government intends to discontinue its accumulation of reserves in the near future and the nominal interest rates are approaching their zero lower bound in accelerating fashion.

151610.label: Major findings and research outcome
151610.value: This paper addresses a relatively new phenomenon for many emerging markets, a concern either by the government or by financial markets with excessive rather than insufficient government foreign exchange reserves, often accompanied by exchange rate appreciation and higher domestic inflation. The paper explores the nature of the underlying fiscal problem and its dependence on the monetary regime. We show that one way to understand these episodes is by looking at them through the lens of the literature on first-generation balance-of-payments crises. The major difference is that the crises, or rather the anti-crises, that concern us feature an upper rather than a lower limit on foreign exchange reserves. Moreover, this upper limit is not arbitrary but rather depends on the ability of seigniorage adjustments to stabilize asset dynamics. That ability encounters its natural limit in the desire of the monetary authority to stay away from the zero lower bound on nominal interest rates. We have shown that the end-phase of such anti-crises is characterized by an economic boom accompanied by a further acceleration in the accumulation of foreign exchange reserves, and by nominal interest rates approaching their zero lower bound. While exchange rate depreciation drops sharply at that time, domestic inflation can rise sharply if the government targets CPI inflation. Monetary regimes that imply the strongest commitment to intervene in the foreign exchange market to prevent exchange rate appreciation, such as exchange rate targeting and to a lesser extent CPI inflation targeting, experience the most rapid reserve accumulation and therefore the quickest onset of the anti-crisis.

151610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
151610.value: In view of the rapid growth of international reserves since 2000 and concerns expressed by the IMF about the potential implications for the stability of the international monetary system, this project provides theoretical underpinnings for the Fund’s concerns and advice. It also sheds light on future studies that examine how reserve adequacy (or excessiveness) affects countries’ internal and external stability.

151610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
151610.value: The recent debate about the desirability of a new world monetary system has been motivated in large part by the perception that the existing system has contributed to the development of large current account imbalances that are ultimately unsustainable. For example, calls for changes have been made by, among others, Russia (BBC, 2009) and China (Bloomberg, 2009). On March 20, 2007 China's central bank governor was quoted in Reuters (2007) as stating "foreign exchange reserves in China are large enough. We do not intend to go further and accumulate reserves". Similarly, during 2007 Colombia experienced a period of large central bank foreign exchange purchases to stem the appreciation of its real exchange rate due to capital inflows. This project examines the theoretical implications of policy responses to excessive reserve accumulation when the nominal interest rates are bounded at zero. This lower bound on the nominal interest rate implies an upper limit on the reserve accumulation which ultimately ends in the collapse of the previous monetary regime and a rebalancing of demand towards domestic sources. The issue analyzed in this project has direct policy implications on a number of major emerging countries, including China and Colombia.
