151810.label: Project Title(Chinese)
151810.value: 與現有企業結盟：創新企業在中國聯盟戰略的研究

151810.label: Project Objectives
151810.value: This research has three major objectives: First, we build upon the co-opetition framework and differentiate two types of important alliances (exploration vs. exploitation alliances). Exploration alliances are formed with the motivation of organizational learning to seek and generate new knowledge and technology, while exploitation alliances are formed with the motivation of leveraging complementary assets among the alliance partners to take advantage of existing technology (Rothaermel, 2001; Rothaermel & Deeds, 2004). Both exploration and exploitation alliances with large firms may improve the financial gains of entrepreneurial firms. However, the relative benefits of each for entrepreneurial firms have seldom been examined in the literature. We address which alliance strategy (exploration vs. exploitation) may give entrepreneurial firms the best possible returns. Second, to capture the complex nature of alliance strategy, we move beyond the direct effect between entrepreneurial firms’ alliance strategy and performance by considering critical contingencies. Specifically, we argue that alliance governance (equity vs. nonequity alliance), and bargaining power in resources and partner substitutability may strengthen or weaken the respective effect of either exploration or exploitation alliances. Third, our study attempts to contribute to our understanding of entrepreneurial firms in a transition economy like China, the context of which is important in two ways: First, it complements and extends the limited research in the Western setting (e.g., Kalaignanam, Shankar, and Varadarajan, 2007; Katila, Rosenberger, and Eisenhardt, 2008). Most of the existing research were conducted in the United States and also relied on archival data, which are often short of revealing the nuisances in partner interactions. Second, entrepreneurial firms in China face severe difficulties in accessing financial and technological resources due to underdeveloped market mechanisms and institutional environment. It is expected that entrepreneurial firms in China would exhibit a large variance and uniqueness in their entrepreneurial activities. In addition to the above theoretical contributions, the project also has practical implications for entrepreneurial firms in Hong Kong and the mainland China. Entrepreneurial ventures explain a lion share of the net employment and economic growth in recent years. The findings of this study can provide practical guidance for managers to strategically design their alliance strategies and help them to cooperate and compete with incumbent firms in alliances. For instance, our study would suggest that if an entrepreneurial firm is forming an exploitation alliance with large firms, non-equity alliance governance might be better than an equity alliance governance.

Second, to capture the complex nature of alliance strategy, we move beyond the direct effect between entrepreneurial firms’ alliance strategy and performance by considering critical contingencies. Specifically, we argue that alliance governance (equity vs. nonequity alliance), and bargaining power in resources and partner substitutability may strengthen or weaken the respective effect of either exploration or exploitation alliances.

Third, our study attempts to contribute to our understanding of entrepreneurial firms in a transition economy like China, the context of which is important in two ways: First, it complements and extends the limited research in the Western setting (e.g., Kalaignanam, Shankar, and Varadarajan, 2007; Katila, Rosenberger, and Eisenhardt, 2008). Most of the existing research were conducted in the United States and also relied on archival data, which are often short of revealing the nuisances in partner interactions. Second, entrepreneurial firms in China face severe difficulties in accessing financial and technological resources due to underdeveloped market mechanisms and institutional environment. It is expected that entrepreneurial firms in China would exhibit a large variance and uniqueness in their entrepreneurial activities.

In addition to the above theoretical contributions, the project also has practical implications for entrepreneurial firms in Hong Kong and the mainland China. Entrepreneurial ventures explain a lion share of the net employment and economic growth in recent years. The findings of this study can provide practical guidance for managers to strategically design their alliance strategies and help them to cooperate and compete with incumbent firms in alliances. For instance, our study would suggest that if an entrepreneurial firm is forming an exploitation alliance with large firms, non-equity alliance governance might be better than an equity alliance governance.

151810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
151810.value: How can entrepreneurial firms benefit from strategic alliances with incumbent firms? Most of the prior research on strategic alliances has taken the perspective of large established firms, while paying scant attention to the alliances in entrepreneurial settings (Alvarez, Ireland, and Reuer, 2006). Research has suggested that alliances can significantly enhance the survival rate of entrepreneurial firms in early years and contribute to their long-term viability (Baum, Calabrese, and Silverman, 2000). In the mean time, however, entrepreneurial firms may suffer from alliances with large firms because large firms tend to outlearn entrepreneurial firms and take away a lion’s share of the value created in alliances (Alvarez and Barney, 2001). Thus, entrepreneurial firms are often at a dilemma in their decisions for forming alliances with large firms. This study attempts to investigate how entrepreneurial firms can effectively address this dilemma in a transition economy like China. It builds upon the co-opetition framework where firms cooperate and compete simultaneously in alliances. Specifically, we investigate two forms of alliance activities that entrepreneurial firms can form with incumbent firms: exploration vs. exploitation alliances. We contend that these two types of alliances exhibit different adaptation attributes (current vs. future viability) and have different demands for entrepreneurial firms in alliance governance, resource commitment and knowledge protection. It is likely that entrepreneurial firms will have varying returns from these different alliance strategies. We argue that in general entrepreneurial firms may have larger financial gains from exploitation alliances with incumbent firms than from exploration alliances. We further investigate the contingency factors such as alliance governance and bargaining power that may strengthen or weaken the financial gains from these alliance strategies. The research is thus of great importance to understand how entrepreneurial firms can successfully grow by allying with incumbent firms. 創新企業如何從與現有企業結盟中獲利？當前關于企業聯盟的研究大多關注于大型企業，卻很少關注于創新企業。研究表明聯盟戰略能極大地提高創新企業的生存率與長期發展。同時，創新企業在與現有大型企業的結盟中也會付出代價，因爲大型企業通常具有更強的學習能力並能從聯盟中分得更大的利益。于是，創新企業在與大型企業結盟時通常遇到一個進退兩難的情況。 該項目試圖研究在中國這樣的轉型經濟中創新企業如何有效地與大型企業結盟。理論基礎來自于企業合作競爭的框架：企業在聯盟中合作與競爭並存。特別是，我們調研兩種類型的聯盟類型（探索與開發聯盟）。我們認爲這兩種不同的聯盟類型給創新企業帶來不同的環境適應特性(當前與將來的生存能力)，並且，對創新企業在聯盟治理、資源投入和知識保護等方面提出了挑戰。很明顯，這些不同的聯盟戰略會帶來不同的績效。我們認爲總體而言，創新企業會從開發聯盟中得益更多，而現有大型企業會從探索聯盟中獲益更多。我們進一步研究了聯盟公司治理和談判力量的相關影響因素。該項研究有助于我們理解創新企業如何與現有大型企業結盟以發展壯大。

151810.label: Major findings and research outcome
151810.value: 1. Our findings suggest that alliance strategies with large firms in terms of exploration or exploitation exert differential impacts on small firms’ valuations. Due to the high risks of appropriation in exploration alliances with large firms and the general incapability of small firms to govern these complex and uncertain activities, small firms reap less returns from exploration than exploitation alliances with large firms. 2. Our findings further suggest that if small firms are equipped with proper alliance governance they are able to capture greater benefits from their alliances with large firms. We found that small firms are better off governing exploration alliances with equity structure, while governing exploitation alliances with non-equity structure. Our analyses suggest that small firms reap the highest benefits from their non-equity-based exploitation alliances with large firms, followed by equity-based exploration alliances. 3. This study contributes to both the entrepreneurship and strategic alliances literatures. While most prior research on strategic alliances has primarily focused on large firms, we examined alliances from the perspective of small firms. In particular, we suggest that in general small firms can derive greater benefits from exploitation alliances than from exploration alliances with large firms. However, if small firms manage their alliances with large firms via proper alliance governance, they will enhance their evaluations from exploration alliances with large firms. Our findings extend prior studies that adopt the perspective of large firms in allying with small biotech firms (Rothaermel, 2001) by highlighting the contingencies that help small firms configure their alliances with large firms. 4. The study offers important insights for managers of small firms to better understand how to benefit from alliances with large partners. Managers need to proactively design their strategic alliances with large firms and consider the ramifications of each new partnership choice. For example, managers should recognize that while both exploration and exploitation alliances with large firms may be beneficial, small firms will generally benefit more from exploitation than from exploration alliances. Exploration alliances with large firms are more risky for small firms due to potential value appropriation by their large partners. However, small firms protected by formal governance such as equity structure are likely to have greater returns from the variance-seeking activities in exploration alliances.

151810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
151810.value: This stream of research can be further developed in the following ways: 1. our data come from a single industry. This sampling creates a well-defined context for examining our theoretical hypotheses, but limits the generalizability of the findings to other contexts. Although we believe that the general pattern may hold for small firms’ alliances with large firms in other contexts, further empirical validation is required in other industries such as computers and telecommunications industries. 2. given that firm performance is commonly considered as a multi-dimensional construct, it will be interesting to explore whether a small firm’s high valuation will lead to its long-term economic returns (Kale, Dyer, and Singh, 2002). Future research may probe into the unique context of private equity valuations to gain additional insights. 3. future research may consider directly measuring the relational governance between small firms and large firms in alliances. Our research implies that a small firm’s embeddedness in an alliance network may not win trust for them from large firms. Probably it is easier for a small firm to develop trust with a few rather than many large alliance partners.

151810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
151810.value: Small firms often face a challenge of configuring their alliance portfolio with large firms: they should address not only the tension between the need for resources and the risk of appropriation, but also the balance between exploration and exploitation alliances with large firms. This project investigates the relative impacts of exploration and exploitation alliances with large firms on small firms’ valuations by drawing on the exploration/exploitation framework as well as the alliance governance literature. We find that in general small firms benefit more by forming exploitation alliances with large firms. However, if small firms are protected by proper alliance governance such as equity structure they are likely to increase their returns from their exploration alliances with large firms. This study conveys an important message that small firms should adjust their alliance strategies with large firms by considering appropriate alliance governance.

152010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
152010.value: 中国企业必须得到监管机构的批准方可以进行公开发行股票并上市。中国证监会下设一个有25个委员的证券发行审核委员会（发审委）来筛选公开发行的申请者。平均起来，大概25%的申请企业被否决。会计师事务所的合伙人在发审委里面占有重要的地位。 这个项目主要研究审计师在股票发行审核中扮演的角色。第一，我们将检验那些有合伙人在发审委任职的会计师事务所的客户是否更容易通过发行审核。第二，我们将检验那些忧合伙人在发审委任职的会计师事务所是否收取了更高的审计费用。第三，我们将比较那些又合伙人在发审委任职的会计师事务所和其他会计师事务所的审计质量。这些检验将证明那些合伙人在发审委任职的会计师事务所是否利用他们的影响力帮助一些不符合要求的客户通过发行审核。我们将通过比较股票发行抑价和盈余管理来确定审计质量的高低，并通过比较上市后被谴责的概率来比较通过发行审核的上市公司的质量。 这个项目的重要性如下。第一，我们将提供新的证据来证明审计师在面临利益冲突时是否保持独立性。第二，我们也将检验超额审计收费代表高质量审计的传统理论。第三，我们的工作也跟股票发行分配的腐败文献相关。第四，我们的工作也有助于判断政府审核股票发行是否能够提高资本配置效率，所以有相当的政策启示。

152010.label: Realisation of objectives
152010.value: All of the project objectives have been achieved desirably. Details are as follows. Objective #1: I summarize the evoluation of IPO administration in China and the role of auditors in IPO administration through a comprehensive search and review of relevant regulations. A summary of IPO administration is contained in the publication Yang (2013, CAR). Objective #2: I download all IPO applications, available on the CSRC website, and run a logistic model, and find that prospective IPO firms audited by auditing firms whose partners are on the CSRC Committee have a greater chance to pass the IPO screening process. The results are reported in Yang (2013, CAR). Objective #3: I examine the audit fees charged to IPO firms, and show that auditing firms charge higher IPO audit fees after their partners are appointed to the Committee. Results are reported in Yang (2013, CAR). Objective #4: I compare IPO auditing (and abnormal accruals) between IPO firms audited by auditing firms whose partners are on the Committee and those audited by other auditing firms, and find no significant difference. These results suggest that auditing firms with partners on the Committee charge higher IPO audit fees not because they provide higher quality audits. Untabulated results are discussed in Yang (2013, CAR). Objective #5: I compare the incidences of being rebuked by regulators after the IPO between firms audited by auditing firms with partners on the Committee and those audited by other auditing firms, and find no significant difference. The possibled reason is that the incidences of being rebuked are rare and therefore, the test lacks power. This result is not reported in the paper for brevity. Objective #6: I examine audit fees charged to seasoned clients, and find that there is no significant difference between those audited by auditing firms with partners on the Committee and those audited by other auditing firms. This finding does not support the argument that auditing firms with partners on the Committee have higher quality audits. Untabulated results are discussed in Yang (2013, CAR). Objective #7: I show that IPO firms audited by auditing firms with partners on the Committee are more likely to report an immediate earnings decline after the IPO, suggesting that these IPO firms are of lower quality than other IPO firms. Collectively, these findings suggest that higher audit fees are rents extracted by auditing firms with partners on the Committee who can help their IPO clients receive favorable regulatory decisions.

152010.label: Major findings and research outcome
152010.value: The research output was published in Contemporary Accounting Research (CAR) in September 2013. Contemporary Accounting Research is among top five accounting journals and among Financial Times top business journal list. The major findings of this project are summarized as following. First, I show that audit firms significantly increase their IPO market share after their partners are appointed to the CSRC Committee that performs the screening of IPO applicants. Second, I show that these audit firms also signficantly increase their charges to IPO audit services. Third, these audit firms deliver benefits to their IPO clients by helping reduce the IPO regulatory rejection rate for their clients. Fourth, IPO firms audited by these audit firms are more likely to report an immediate earnings decline after the IPO, suggesting that they are of lower quality than other IPO firms. Fifth, I do not find any evidence supporting the notion that these audit firms provide higher quality audit services. I measure IPO audit quality using discretionary accruals and IPO underpricing, both measures commonly used in the literature. Collectively, these findings suggest that audit firms' connections with the regulatory authority can bring regulatory benefits to their clients by helping reduce IPO rejection rate. Consequently, these audit firms can attract more clients and charge higher fees to their services. The connections with the regulatory authority enable audit firms to obtain useful insights into the regulatory process, such insights very useful to clients in a highly regulated market. Moreover, the connecitons with the regulatory authority may also help audit firms lobby favorable regulatory decisions on behalf of their clients.

152010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
152010.value: As the paper (Yang, 2013) suggests, the findings fromt this project can be applied to other market intermediaries such as investment banks and law firms which also provide professional services to IPO firms. One possible development is to examine whether other intermediaries can also obtain benefits through their connections with the government, and if yes, in which form. I plan to apply the same research design to law firms which also have partners sitting on the CSRC IPO regulatory Committee.

152010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
152010.value: This project examines whether the connections with regulatory authority bring benefits to connected audit firms and their clients, and if yes, in which form. The IPO regulatory arrangement in China provides an ideal setting to test this issue. The government sets up a Committee to perform the screening of IPO applicants and audit firm parnters are the largest group of professionals on the Committee. I find that audit firms obtain greater IPO market shares and charge higher IPO audit fees after their partners are appointed to the Committee. These audit firms do not provide higher audit quality but help their clients reduce IPO rejection rate. Hence, connections with regulatory authority help bring regulaory benefits to their clients which in turn bring economic benefits to these audit firms. These findings contribute to the literatures in several imporant ways. First, it provides direct evidence that political connections bring benefits to connected firms, whereas previous studies mostly provide indirect evidence. Second, it is the first paper to examine the role of political connections to market intermediaries, and its findings can be generalized to other intermediaries such as investment banks. The paper is therefore published in CAR, one of the top five accounting journals.

152110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
152110.value: Doing business in China has often proven to be a formidable challenge not only for foreigners but for locally-based businesspeople as well. The first advice a businessperson typically receives in China is to build an effective Guanxi network, predicated on personal, well-embedded ties at the individual level as defined in this research. Yet, very little effort has been devoted to address the essential issue: How do businesspeople become embedded? Embedded ties, or the interpersonal relationships between firm boundary agents, have gained significant attention from organizational scholars, because they represent an additional governance form that carries strong expectations of trust and deflects opportunism (Granovetter 1985; McEvily and Marcus 2005; Uzzi 1996, 1997). Researchers argue that it is rather simplistic to assume that persons are either innately self-interested or cooperative. That is, businesspeople can be selfish and cooperative simultaneously; whether they behave selfishly or cooperatively depend on the structure of the organization and the market in which they are embedded (Uzzi 1997). Building on previous studies, we contend that embedded ties result from not only social forces but also economic and institutional factors. These forces combine to form embedded relationships in interfirm relational exchanges. We develop an integrative, testable model of embedded ties formation, drawing on resource dependency theory, institutional theory, and social exchange perspectives. This parsimonious model extends current research on relational exchanges and enables us to assess simultaneously the various potential antecedents and consequences of embedded ties. Through an empirical examination of matched samples from sales firms and distributors, we intend to (1) examine the direct and indirect effects of the key components of these three perspectives on each element of embedded ties and their relative importance, (2) highlight the partial mediating role of interpersonal interactions in forming embedded ties, and (3) uncover the asymmetric effect of each antecedent force for both manufacturers and distributors. The proposed theory moves beyond mere economic approaches (e.g., resource dependence theory) and more recent institutional theories pertaining to relational governance at the organizational level. The findings in turn will offer managers a broader and deeper understanding of the driving forces behind embedded ties in interfirm relationships. 在中国做生意是个艰巨的挑战，对外国人尤甚。 商人得到的忠告通常是建立个人关系网的重要性。然而，学者对商人如何成为嵌入关系（朋友）这一重要问题却研究甚少。作为一种治理机制，嵌入关系或公司间边际人员之间的私人关系能使公司间产生强烈的信任感并抑制投机行为，因而受到组织行为学者的极大关注。研究者认为不能简单地认为人是天生的自私或合作倾向。商人可以是两者兼而有之， 何时自私或合作取决于公司及市场的结构 在前人研究的基础上，我们认为嵌入关系的形成不仅仅是社会的力量，也是受经济及制度的影响。 三种力量交汇形成公司间的交往关系。建立在资源依赖理论，制度理论，和社会交往理论的基础上，我们开发了一个整合的可检验的嵌入关系形成模型. 该简约模型同时探讨嵌入关系的前因后果，是对现有的关系交往研究的延伸。 通过对销售公司和分销商配对样本的实证研究，我们将会（1）检验上述三种力量中的关键因素对嵌入关系的三个组成因素的各自作用及其重要性；（2）突出人际互动的中介作用；及（3）检验每个影响因素在生产商与销售商角度出发会否对嵌入关系的起不对称的作用。我们所提出的理论超出了目前建立在公司层面上的与关系治理有关的经济方法及制度理论。我们的实证结果将会让管理人员更清楚地了解嵌入关系是如何形成的及其对公司治理的作用。

152110.label: Major findings and research outcome
152110.value: 1. Our study establishes a model of embedded ties development that integrates economic, institutional, and social perspectives. Through an empirical examination of 348 matched samples from sales firms and distributors, the authors (1) examine the direct and indirect effects of the key components of these three perspectives on each element of embedded ties and their relative importance, (2) highlight the partial mediating role of interpersonal interactions in forming embedded ties, and (3) uncover the asymmetric effect of each antecedent force for both manufacturers and distributors. The proposed theory moves beyond mere economic approaches (e.g., resource dependence theory) and more recent institutional theories pertaining to relational governance at the organizational level. The findings in turn offer managers a broader and deeper understanding of the driving forces behind embedded ties in interfirm relationships. 2. Firms doing business in foreign institutional environments face pressures to gain social acceptance (commonly referred to as legitimacy) and difficulty in evaluating market information, both of which undercut firm performance. In our study, we argue that firms can design governance strategies to deal with foreign institutions to secure both social acceptance and firm performance. Using a Chinese sample of manufacturers that export products to various foreign markets through local distributors, the authors develop and test a model that bridges the effects of institutional environments and governance strategy on channel performance. Specifically, they find that firms can use two governance strategies, contract customization and relational governance, to deal with both legitimacy and efficiency issues and to safeguard channel performance. Thus, international channel managers are advised to maintain an integrated management of legitimacy and efficiency in foreign marketing channels. Please refer our JM paper. 3. Our study explores the effects of the guanxi institution on interfirm relational ties, information sharing, and the acquisition of skills across firms. According to social network theory, the marginal benefit of interfirm relational ties on information sharing should decrease with the strength of ties; according to information overload theory, information sharing should have an inverted U-shaped effect on the acquisition of skills. Institutional theory further suggests that the links across these three constructs are subject to the influence of the guanxi institution. With data collected from 338 manufacturing companies, this study shows that the links differ across environments that have strong versus weak guanxi institutions. A strong guanxi institution generally promotes information sharing and skill acquisition, but it also has a dark side.

152110.value: The database we collected has the potential for further publications in top tier journals. We intend to write up two more papers. Also, based upon current project, we have further explored the influence of the three principles rooted in Chinese culture: (1) sentiment (qing, 情in Chinese); (2) reason (li, 理in Chinese); and (3) law (fa, 法 in Chinese) on governance strategy in marketing channels in China and developed more research ideas for future study.

152510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
152510.value: Viet Nam is developing fast and its connection with Hong Kong is very close. It is also the country with which China is often compared in the study of the transitional economies. This project aims to advance our understanding of Viet Nam, particularly at the micro-level, by examining the impacts of the socio-economic change at the residential neighbourhood, the arena in which structure intersects with agency. The neighbourhood arouses renewed interest among academics and policy makers in the West on its impact as a key domain for the transmission of shared values and norms and as building block of social cohesion. Yet, the importance of the neighbourhood has been undermined in Viet Nam in the past owing to strong kinship tie. However, they have a long history of taking the neighbourhood as arena of social control and political mobilization in the pre-reform era. The economic reform, Doi Moi, and the associated rapid industralisation and urbanization have brought profound transformation to the neighbourhood. First, it weakens both the capacity of kinship network and the state in providing necessary services and crucial support to residents. Hence, the recreation of neighbourhood social and service networks can be a solution. Second, the neighbourhood is also where entrepreneurial activities started. This often marks the beginning of the institutionalisation of the informal economy. Third, old apparatus of social control at the neighbourhood has been eroded by the economic reform, the neigbhourhood has instead transformed into a venue of negotiation between the state and local residents. This hinges on to the changing state-society relation and connects closely to the development of the civil society. This project will employ multiple methodologies, survey, indepth interview, observation, focus group etc, to collect information on various aspects of the neighbourhood, which include, social and kinship networks, formal and informal provision of services, the informal economy, the role of the ward offices and their interaction with local residents. Such information enables us to explore the changing faces of the neighbourhood in social, economic and political aspects as well as to offer empirically based and culturally specific information on social change in transitional economies. This project can also allow the research team to produce synergy with what they find in this project with their research on the neighbourhood in China and elsewhere in enriching our understanding of the transitional economies as well as on the study of the neigbhourhood. 毗鄰香港的越南，目前正處於迅速發展的階段，而它的經驗常常在學術界視與中國相比較的轉型經濟個案。本研究旨在分析社會經濟變遷對社區，作為結構與行動者相互作用的領域的影響，從而可以從微觀層次加深對越南的理解。近年來，社區研究再次成為西方學術研究的熱點問題，一方面是由於社區在傳播共同價值和規範方面所扮演的重要角色，另一方面也是因為社區是社會整合的重要基石。然而在越南，由於親屬關係的重要作用，社區的角色在過去一直被低估。實際上，在改革之前，社區在越南一直是社會控制和政治動員的重要領域。而越南的經濟改革政策（Doi Moi）以及與之相伴的快速工業化和城市化，給社區帶來徹底的改變。首先，親屬紐帶關係弱化，國家在為居民提供必要服務和支援方面的角色也有所減弱。由此，社區的社會和服務網路重建成為解決相關問題的對策。其次，由於社區也是企業經營的地域所在，因此經濟改革也推進了非正式經濟的產業化。再者，當社區中原有的社會控制機制逐漸被經濟改革削弱時，這一領域目前已經成為國家與地方居民溝通協商的空間。這都與國家-社會關係的轉型、市民社會的發展密切相關。本研究將會採用包括問卷調查、深度訪談、觀察、焦點小組等多種方法，收集社區各個方面的資料資訊，例如社會和親屬網路、正式和非正式服務供給部門、非正式經濟、基層政府的角色以及他們與當地居民的互動。這些資訊將有助於我們瞭解社區對越南社會、經濟和政治方面的變遷所起的作用，以及提供轉型經濟在社會變遷方面的實證研究和其文化特性。本研究的成果還將與研究團隊完從的中國社區研究的成果進行比較分析，從而推進對轉型經濟以及社區問題的研究。

152510.label: Realisation of objectives
152510.value: Extensive face to face questionnaire survey had been carried out in the urban areas of Hanoi between July to December 2012. A total of 1000 questionnaires have been completed and analysis. This is accompanied with 24 indepth interviews in 6 wards with residents that have been contacted in the survey with a balance in age, gender and length of residence. Such activities were able to map the changing social and kinship relations in the neighbourhood and the impacts of the built form, tenure and population mobility on such relations. In the 6 wards we has done the indepth interviews, detailed records on street vending and informal building structure extension were made. Indepth interviews (24 interviews mentioned in the preceding section) were conducted in tapping residents’ view on the benefits and nuisance that may associate with street vending as well as their perspective on the impacts of their own and others informal construction and extension on building safety and other potential risks. In addition, 32 indepth interviews with street vendors in four wards were made. Such activities were able to trace the informal economic activities in the neighbourhood and the benefits and conflicts they bring to the neighbourhood. The survey and the indepth interviews with residents and street vendors also touched on how they engaged in negotiation with the local ward officials. Interviews with 2 ward directors and 2 municipal official on housing and buildings were also conducted. Data collected enable us to locate changing state-society interaction in the neighbourhood and the process of negotiation and mediation within the neighbourhood. Through interviews with government official, relevant professional and the meetings with the external collaborator and relevant Vietnamese academics and professionals, the contrast in social, economic and political changes in the neighbourhood amongst different social, tenure and income groups as well as types of neighbourhoods and between north and south of the country have been touched on. Yet since the original budget was being reduced and it is not possible to collect empirical data from the south of the country (originally targeted at HCM City) could not be done. With extensive literature review and data collected from the PI in his previous projects, some comparison has been done China to extend the understanding of the reform process and impact on the neighbourhood in transitional economies

152510.label: Major findings and research outcome
152510.value: Unique Gentrification Gentrification (which can be understood as the migration of new users of a high socio-economic status with an associated change in the built environment through a reinvestment in fixed capital) in Hanoi presents unique. The foreign -aid induced, state-led, capital led and piece-meal tourist oriented gentrification offer contrasting examples in our understanding of the process. The Neighbourhood The neighbourhoods in Hanoi appeared to the residents as highly stable, cohesive and with high level of reciprocity. Crime rates are low and residents felt very safe in their neighbourhood. More important is the high level of sense of community and trust compared with other transitional economies. Informal Economy at the Grassroots Street vending is still extensive though it may have been contracted a bit compared with a few years ago. For the residents, street vending created little nuisance and instead offered much benefit to their daily necessities. For the street vendors, most of them found little interference from the local states and they felt symbiotic relations with the residents. Informal extension of building structure The informal extension can be understood more critically from the concept of “informality” in which categories of legal-illegal is misleading but should be understood as a result of shifting of boundary in definition and outcomes of the deferential involvement of the state. State-society interaction High level of social control in the neighbourhood may be one reason which explains the high level of social cohesion. The ward office and the resident groups have a bonding function that contributes to create and maintain the sense of community. The neighbourhoods in Hanoi also reveal the fluid, self-organising characters of neighbourhood governance that is based on the traditional Vietnamese philosophy that places neighbourly relationship higher than government law. Comparison with China Compared with China, Hanoi has a tighter social control at the neighbourhood. Whilst verbally criticizing the state and local government openly in neighbourhoods in China is common-place, questions in this respect in Vietnam that were raised to the respondents were still being received with strong reservation. As the urban development of Hanoi is still trailing behind China and state capacity at the grassroots is weaker, residents are less dependent to the local state than in China and the self-organisation instinct is instead higher.

152510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
152510.value: As Vietnam progresses in a rapid trajectory of economic and social development, the neighbourhood continues to be an interesting arena in observing social change of the country at the grassroots. More recently, gentrification of its older neighbourhoods has been speeding up and old public housing neighbourhoods are undergoing transformation, this intensifies the internal differentiation of old urban areas. Yet more importantly, large scale up-market neighbourhoods begin to emerge in the fringe of big cities for the new middle class. Such “New Urban Areas” (NUA) creates new division of segregation but also brings new urbanism to the country. Hence how such NUA impacts on the social fabric of the society as well as the contradiction brought along by the increased segregation would be an important concern. Research on the changing segregation of big cities in Vietnam and the impacts brought by the NUA are worth pursuing.

152510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
152510.value: As the capital city in a rapidly growing transitional economy, Hanoi exhibits an interesting case in the study of social transformation. The old quarters of the city has begun to redeveloped but it is done in a way that unique features of the city can be preserved. It is in sharp contrary to countries like China in which demolition and replacement are the norm. Residents in the neighbourhoods have also indicated a high degree of identity and cohesion which is partly owing to the tight control government at the grassroots but also embedded in the traditional values of the Vietnamese which treasure neighbourliness and personal connection. Yet despite the appearance of strong social control at the neighbourhood, administrative governing capacity has been weak in Hanoi. Hence social space for negotiation has been created at the grassroots in which the informal economy is more developed. Street vending and informal building structure extension are wide-spread. Compared with China, the intention of the government to control at the neighbourhood is stronger. Yet residents in Hanoi is less dependent on the local state compared with their counterparts in China and hence show a high instinct of self-organising.

152910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
152910.value: Abstract We propose to investigate firm-level relations between debt enforcement, political connections, and operational efficiency. Extant literature has shown that stronger investor protections promote both financial development and subsequent economic growth. In this proposed study, we focus on the role of law enforcement and how political connections affect enforcement. We will base our study on all public listed firms in China that incur defaulted loans over a period of 1999 to 2007. We will examine how the legal system deals with firms that are in default, whether political connections affects this process, and how the enforcement process affects the investment policy and operational efficiency of the firm after default. 摘要： 我们将分析在公司层面上债务追偿，政治关系以及经营效率的关系。现有的文献已经发现投资者保护可以促进资本市场的发展进而推动经济增长。在这个研究中，我们将关注法律执行效率以及政治关系如何影响法律执行效率。我们的研究将基于1999年至2007年间有到期未偿还的银行贷款。我将检验法律如何处置借款不换的公司，这个过程中公司的政治关系起了什么样的作用，以及不同的执行程序如何影响公司事后的投资策略和经营效率。

More importantly, we document significant evidence that the defaulted bank loans are less likely to be enforced through court. 153510.value: 企业捐赠的动因及影响：基于一个自然事件的实证证据

153510.label: Project Objectives

Does corporate governance affect corporate donation decisions?  What is investors’ reaction to the announcements of earthquake donations?  Does investor’s reaction differ according to the type of corporate ownership and other firm characteristics?  Do donations affect ex-post firm performance?  Does the effect of donations on firm performance in private firms differ from that in state-owned firms?
rows:  Are private firms or state-owned firms more willing to make donations holding other factors constant? Does corporate governance affect corporate donation decisions?
 What is investors’ reaction to the announcements of earthquake donations?
 Does investor’s reaction differ according to the type of corporate ownership and other firm characteristics?
 Do donations affect ex-post firm performance?
 Does the effect of donations on firm performance in private firms differ from that in state-owned firms?

153510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
153510.value: An unprecedented earthquake devastated Wenchuan county of Sichuan on May 12, 2008 and caught the attention of the world. Flurries of donations were made from home and abroad to fund the emergency relief and reconstruction work after the quake. I exploit this as a natural experiment to study the causes and effects of corporate donations by focusing on Chinese listed companies. In doing so, I appeal to three important strands of the literature. First, the causes and effects of corporate donations have long been of interest to researchers with a growing literature focusing on whether donations improve or hurt corporate performance in the U.S. However, this line of research has produced mixed results and has been seriously hampered by the identification problem due to the reverse causality between donations and performance as well as data issues related to sample selection bias that emanates from voluntary disclosure of donation data. Exploiting the earthquake donations as a natural experiment, my study contributes new insights to this literature. The donation data used in my study are clean, homogenous (for the same emergency relief purpose and unlike in the U.S. that has different state laws, corporate donation in China is subject to homogenous tax treatment), and do not have significant sample selection bias. The unanticipated earthquake represents an exogenous event to all companies and this feature minimizes the reverse causality issue that plagues prior studies on the motives of donation and its effect on firm performance. Second, taking advantage of the unique ownership structure (co-existence of state-owned and privately-owned companies) in the Chinese corporate sector, my study is the first to examine the different motives and effects of corporate donations between stated-owned and privately-owned firms. This helps to address the dearth of evidence regarding the role of corporate governance in corporate social responsibility decisions (Starks, 2009, p.465). It also helps uncover a new moderating mechanism of the donation-performance relation. Third, the study extends the literature regarding the incentives of government ownership and its effects on corporate decisions by focusing a new angle – corporate donations. Evidence from this study is clearly of strong local relevance and has important implications for investors. Starks, L.T., 2009. EFA keynote speech: “Corporate governance and corporate social responsibility: What do investors care about? What should investors care about?” Financial Review 44, 461-468. 2008年5月12日,中国四川汶川发生了强烈的地震, 生命财产损失惨重。灾后灾区收到国内外大量的企业捐助。本研究以此次地震及震后捐助为自然实验环境，研究中国上市公司赈灾捐助的影响因素及捐赠对企业造成的影响。本研究涉及三大理论。 第一，企业捐赠的动因及捐赠对公司业绩的影响一直为学术界所关注。然而，这一系列的研究得出了不同的结论，在很大程度上也存在着由于捐赠和业界的内生性所带来的识别问题以及自愿性披露所带来的关于样本选取偏差的数据问题。本研究通过地震震后捐赠这一自然事件为已有文献提供了新的见解。本研究运用的捐赠数据是纯净且同质的(均为紧急救援目的，且不同于美国诸多相异的地方法律，中国的企业捐赠适用相同的税收政策)，同时不存在明显的样本选取偏差。此次地震对于所有公司都是一个外生事件，这一特征大大降低了存在于现有关于捐赠动机及捐赠对公司业绩影响的研究中颠倒因果关系的问题。第二，利用中国企业独有的股权结构(国有企业与私营企业并存)，本文是第一个考察国有企业与私营企业之间不同的捐赠动机与影响的研究。本研究弥补了关于公司治理在公司社会责任决策的角色方面证据的缺乏 (Starks, 2009, p.465), 同时有助于发现新的对捐赠-业绩关系有影响的因素。第三，本文运用一个全新的角度 -- 企业捐赠，丰富了政府持股对公司决策影响方面的文献。本研究有助于了解中国经济及企业，对投资者有着重要寓意。

153510.label: Realisation of objectives
153510.value: To examine Objective 1, I run a Logit analysis to examine the effect of ownership identity on the incidence of earthquake donations, and a Tobit analysis to examine the effect of ownership identity on the extent of donation. In addition to including a variable denoting the ownership identity of a firm (both a binary dummy on whether a firm’s ultimate ownership is state-controlled or not and a continuous state ownership variable), I also include a number of secondary internal corporate governance variables (e.g., board independence, institutional ownership, managerial ownership) in the model. I also conduct a split-sample Logit and Tobit analysis for state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and private firms separately to see whether the same corporate governance mechanisms function differently in the donation decisions of SOEs and private firms. To examine Objective 2, I conduct a market event study to examine whether the market reacts significantly to donation announcements, I also run second-stage cross-sectional regressions to test the relation between firm- and donation-characteristics and the market reaction to donation announcement. To examine Objective 3, I regress cumulative abnormal return on the ownership identity variable, and interact it with donation amount to see whether the relation between market reaction and donation amount varies between SOEs and private firms. To examine Objective 4, I examine the effect of donations on the long-run stock performance of the donating firm (up to 3 years following the donation). Specifically, I regress 1-year, 2-year or 3-year buy-and-hold stock return net of the market return subsequent to donation on the donation made in 2008, controlling for other factors affecting the stock performance. I interact donation (measured in several ways) with the ownership identity variable in the stock performance model to investigate whether the effect of donation on firm performance in private firms differs from that in SOEs. Viewing firm ownership identity as the first-order governance mechanism, I hypothesize that private firms that are better governed than state-owned enterprises (SOEs) are more likely to donate for value maximization. I find evidence broadly consistent with my hypothesis and I conclude that all the research objectives have been fully achieved.

153510.label: Major findings and research outcome
153510.value: I find that private firms are more likely to donate to the 2008 Sichuan earthquake and donate more than SOEs. The effects of secondary governance variables in the donation determinant models (e.g., board independence, managerial ownership) are more consistent with the value maximization argument. While short-term market reaction to donation announcement is not significant for private firms, it is lower when SOEs make a large donation or when firms that have a CEO or chairman with a political background. Also supporting my hypothesis that donation by private firms is for value maximization, I find that over the 24-36 months following the donation, private donors realize a higher abnormal stock return; in contrast, there is not a statistically significant relation between the donation amount in 2008 and the subsequent long-run stock performance in SOEs. Robustness checks suggest that the positive effect of donation on stock performance is unlikely an artifact of the endogeneity of donation in 2008 that may arise from the existence of correlated omitted variables.

153510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
153510.value: A possible future extension of the study is to search for channels through which firm performance is enhanced by donation. The value maximization view posits that corporate donations and other philanthropic activities improve the public image of the firm and signal that the firm’s aversion to sacrificing quality or stakeholders’ interest for profit. As a result, the firm’s relationships with various stakeholders (e.g., customers, suppliers, employees, creditors) are improved; in turn, the firm may be able to increase its sales, transact at more favorable business terms, or access key resources controlled by stakeholders when needed. This extension, of course, needs the collection of extra data.

153510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
153510.value: Researchers have long been interested in understanding why firms make generous donations and whether giving improves or hurts firm performance. The mixed results from recent studies and the general lack of evidence on the role of corporate governance in donation decisions underpin the further need to test the value maximization and the shareholder expense hypotheses. Taking advantage of the 2008 Sichuan Great Earthquake as a natural experiment, our study contributes to the literature by providing fresh evidence regarding both the motives and effects of corporate donations. I view firm ownership identity as the first-order governance mechanism. I hypothesize that private firms that are better governed than SOEs are more likely to donate for value maximization and less likely to pursue managerial perquisite consumption or altruism. The results from the determinants and effects of donation provide support for the hypothesis. Overall, I conclude that ownership identity and the associated governance has a first-order effect on corporate donations. Overall, using a cleaner donation dataset, my study contributes to the ongoing debate over the merits/costs of corporate donations and helps better understand how SOEs and private firms (particularly family-owned firms) differ in their governance and financial decision making.

160110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
160110.value: 心臟各組件和電流元件的協調機械及收縮是由心臟精確傳導控制。該心臟傳導系統（CCS）依賴於正確離子通道的排列, 其表現是受到心臟轉錄因子（TF）的控制。不正確排列或離子通道基因突變會導致重大的心臟問題。心臟轉錄因子如何相互合作，控制離子通道基因在心臟不同位置和時間的表達，是所知甚少。 斑馬魚提供了幾個獨特的優勢作為一種模式生物為研究脊椎動物心血管發展和疾病。透明的胚胎，連同轉基因技術，可讓我們在光學和熒光顯微鏡下直接觀察活胚胎的心跳和血液循環。由於斑馬魚的遺傳基因易於調節改動，使在相對短的時間內可研究出心臟的協調機制。成年斑馬魚的心臟可以在損傷的21天後完全無疤痕再生。此外, 斑馬魚能夠強勁再生。 我的實驗室最近從基因irx1a的研究上取得了一些令人興奮的數據。在早期胚胎中, 缺乏基因irx1a可導致心臟異常發展。在缺乏irx1a的胚胎中，電壓門控的鈉離子基因scn5Laa不能表達式，而心臟基因 tbx5.1的表達也下調。此外，我們發現基因irx1a的表達在成年斑馬魚心臟的組織損傷後再生的位置上3天後上調，暗示該基因可能在早期事件心臟再生發揮作用。從我們的初步數據表明，基因irx1a在斑馬魚心臟發育和再生擔富當關鍵角色 在這個項目中，我們將確認基因 irx1a在胚胎心臟發育和成人再生心臟上確實控制離子通道基因的表達。我們的研究也將解構基因irx1a在監管心臟離子通道的表達的作用位置，這是建立一個發展中的胚胎心臟功能傳導系統和成人心臟再生必要的。此外, 我們將劃定基因irx1a在心臟形態和生理的恢復過程再生的角色。我們建議的研究將有助於了解如何從疤痕形成的分子途徑轉動而組織損傷後的再生，因此這是與人類疾病高度相關。該系統還可以應用於篩選具有心臟損傷治療潛力的藥物或小分子。

160110.label: Realisation of objectives
160110.value: We have managed to to achieve the proposed objectives, resulting in the submission of 2 manuscripts. The major achievement is that we have reported the same cascade of irx1a and irx2a regulating cardiogeneis, just like what we have delineated in the retina. Importantly, in irx morphants, the expression of the voltage-gated sodium ion gene scn5Laa was significantly abolished while the expression of the cardiac TF tbx5.1 appeared to be down-regulated. Moreover, using bioinformatics tools, we found IBS upstream of the start codon of the scn5Laa gene. Our report here supported the hypothesis that irxa and irx2a genes are potential regulators of scn5Laa gene in the zebrafish. Hence, we have clearly achieve the first objective on defining the roles of the irx1a gene in cardiac development. Potential interactions between the irx1a gene and the tbx5.1 gene can also occur during heart regeneration. Organ-wide up-regulations of the irx1a, irx5a and tbx5.1 gene were observed during the early stages of heart regeneration. Furthermore, we found that irx5a expression was up-regulated in the leading edge of the amputated adult heart as early as 3 days post amputation (dpa), suggesting a potential role of this gene in the early events of heart regeneration. Collectively, our data suggest a critical role for irx in zebrafish heart development and regeneration and we have achieved the second objective in assessing the roles of irx1a in heart regeneration. In this study, the voltage-gated potassium channel kcnh2 displayed an organ-wide activation during heart regeneration. It is interesting that voltage-gated ion channels were involved in both the embryonic and regenerating processes in the zebrafish. We have obtained very exciting data from the breakdance mutant. However, we took the advice from the panel member on our progress report, and dropped the investigation on the breakdance being a surrogate of the knockout mutant. We turned our attention into generating the mutant zebrafish with targeted deletion of the irx1a gene. However, we went into technical difficulties as we could not generate F1 generations from our founders. This has taken a long time for us to complete the generation of the knockout mutant. At the end, it has delayed our submission of the manuscripts and hence they are still under review, 9 months after the completion of this 3 year project. We will provide updates on the acceptance of these two manuscripts in due course.

160110.label: Major findings and research outcome
160110.value: The iroquois (irx) homeodomain transcription factors are highly conserved in both structurally and functionally from invertebrates to vertebrates. They are involved in patterning and regionalization of organs differentiation in Drosophila, chick, mouse and zebrafish. We report here the major findings that the zebrafish iroquois homolog irx1a and irx2a actively participate in the development and electrophysiology of the cardiac system in zebrafish embryos. Anatomical and functional defects were observed in irx1a and irx2a knockdown morphants at 48 hour-post-fertilization (hpf). Morphant embryos showed dilated heart chambers, pericardial edema and regurgitation of blood. Irregular heart beat rates and long QT syndrome were observed in morphant embryos in the electrocardiogram (ECG) analysis, suggesting that irx1a and irx2a may control the ion channel expression in the heart developmental process. More interestingly, the expression of the voltage-gated ion channel gene scn5Laa was down-regulated in irx1a and irx2a morphants. A cascade of irx1a regulating irx2a was also observed during cardiogenesis, as irx2a mRNA can rescue the phenotypes of the irx1a morphatns, similar to that reported by our group on retinogenesis. Most notably, the down-regulation of scn5Laa was restored in the mRNA rescued morphants, suggesting a potential regulatory control of the ion channel gene by the irx1a gene. The transcriptional regulation is also possible because two Iro-binding sites were identified at around 4,500 bp upstream of the scn5Laa start codon, suggesting a potential interaction between the Irx1a protein and the scn5Laa gene. The irx genes might also play a role during heart regeneration. Expressions of both irx1a and irx5a were observed near the wound as well as in other parts of the regenerating heart. The irx5a was up-regulated as early as 3 hours post amputation (hpa), suggesting an early role of this cardiac transcription factor. Interestingly, during heart regeneration, the voltage-gated potassium ion channel gene, kcnh2, was also up-regulated. This report suggests, for the first time, potential interactions of the patterning genes irx with the ion channel gene scn5Laa during embryonic development. In addition, up-regulation of the irx and the kcnh2 genes during vertebrate heart regeneration suggests a similar mechanism of this family of transcription factors being involved in the patterning of ion channel genes both during embryonic heart development and adult heart regeneration.

160110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160110.value: From the exciting data we have obtained on the breakdance mutant, we have submitted a second proposal. In our hands, we have discovered novel and additional phenotypes of the bre mutants. Adult bre mutants display a delay in heart regeneration and higher mortality rate in the cryoinjury model of adult heart regeneration. 80% of bre mutants survived by 14 dpci and the survival rate in bre mutants kept at 31oC was only 55%. In this cryoinjured model of heart regeneration, the epicardium envelops the damaged site, and replaces the scar from the subepicardial to lumen direction, thereby maintaining the crucial physiological function of the heart in this unique regenerative phase. The delay of heart regeneration in the bre mutant shares similar features with the mammalian cardiac infarct, and hence offers an excellent opportunity to investigate how to improve the replacement of this persistent scar by newly formed and vascularized myocardium. In this project, we will focus on two potentially interlinked processes, namely, the scar degradation and the epicardial EMT. We will test the hypothesis that scar degradation and epicardial EMT are perturbed in the bre mutant, and that the acceleration of one process will affect the other. Therefore, we are extending on the current project and move to investigate in details the delay in heart regeneration in the breakdance mutant.

More interestingly, the expression of the voltage-gated ion channel gene scn5Laa was down-regulated in irx1a and irx2a morphants. A cascade of irx1a regulating irx2a was also observed during cardiogenesis, as irx2a mRNA can rescue the phenotypes of the irx1a morphatns, similar to that reported by our group on retinogenesis. The irx genes might also play a role during heart regeneration. Expressions of both irx1a and irx5a were observed near the wound as well as in other parts of the regenerating heart. 160110.value: This project grant on the zebrafish heart regeneration focuses on the roles of irx1a gene in heart development and regeneration. Apart from the research output listed and postgraduate students trained, the other rewarding aspect is the international and interdisciplinary collaborations spun out of this work. The topic of zebrafish heart regeneration is fascinating as a biological issue and despite the keen competitions there remain many areas yet to be explored. The experiments conducted on the zebrafish regeneration experiments in this project have enabled the initiation of the following collaborations with overseas scientists. Firstly, we have initiated a collaboration in late 2012 with the Waters Corporation and the Imperial International Phenome Training Center. We have now presented the first work on the multi-Omics approach on the plasma samples of the regenerating heart in August 2014 (see Part C). Based on our previously developed way to extract plasma samples from the entire zebrafish, we have collected samples from different stages of the regeneration. With the pooled plasma samples, Dr Leanne Nye, with the input from Waters, Manchester UK and Waters, Milford USA, has conducted proteomic analyses. She is currently working on the metabonomics and lipidomics analyses on the same samples. This study will be the first in the world to analyse the circulating proteins, metabolites and lipids in the zebrafish at different stages of organ regeneration. Secondly, we used the data on the extracellular matrix of the regenerating heart to calculate the porosity of the scar tissue surrounding the wound area. With these morphometric dimensions, Professor Tony McNally and Dr. Chaoying Wan of the Warwick Manufacturing Group (WMG) have produced porous membranes electrospun from polycaprolactone (PCL) nanofibers in the summer of 2014. These membranes will used in cell migration assays to investigate the interactions amongst cardiomyoctyes, cardiac fibroblasts and the immune cells. Thirdly, we have performed microarray studies to profile the gene expression of wild type and a mutant zebrafish during heart regeneration. Apart from using the standard software on bioinformatics, we have initiated a collaboration in March 2014 with Dr Xin Wang at Center for Biomedical Informatics at Harvard Medical School. Together we have conducted data mining of the microarray data and searched for sub-networks enriched for differentiation expression. Two types of functional analyses were conducted, namely, gene set overrepresentation and gene set enrichment analyses (GSEA) and Enrichment maps, which show relationships (shared genes between gene sets) between gene sets that are significant. It appears that gene sets related to cell cycle and DNA replication are enriched. More interestingly, gene sets on “tissue development”, “fin development” and “fin morphogenesis” have also been enriched, suggesting overlapping pathways for these developmental and morphogenic processes with heart regeneration in the adults. Besides postgraduate student training, this project was also allocated for undergraduate student training. The student named Lee Wing Tong was well trained with zebrafish dissection and heart cryoinjury techniques in our group. In the project, she was responsible for preparing the heart injured zebrafish and harvesting the regenerated hearts at particular days post injury. The harvested hearts were used in gene expression and immunostaining study, which the student also participated in.

160510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
160510.value: Polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) are commonly used brominated flame retardant additives in polymers and textiles and are present in many household appliances and furnishings. Because of their wide application, these compounds are entering our global ecosystem, and humans, at an alarmingly rapid rate, leading them to be formally recognized as persistent organic pollutants (POPs) by the Stockholm Convention. Monitoring human exposure to this class of pollutant is, therefore, very important to the assessment of their risk to society. Although numerous studies have been carried out to trace and assess population exposure to PBDEs in different parts of the world, it can be argued that the reliability of some of these results is limited, mainly due to the difficulty in the acquisition of adequate human tissue samples for measurement, and the bias inherent in limited sample sizes and sampling schemes. Blood and breast milk are the most frequently used human tissues for exposure quantification. Nevertheless, sampling of blood is an intrusive operation and large-scale sampling is usually difficult to achieve. Although breast milk sampling can be regarded as a non-intrusive process, samples are restricted to lactating women within a relatively narrow age distribution, and therefore these results may not reflect population-level exposure. Sampling human urine, on the other hand, is a truly non-intrusive process and it is much easier to obtain a large number of urine samples from voluntary donors for a large-scale population survey. Thus, it would be desirable if metabolites of PBDEs in human urines can be used as exposure markers. Our research team has already obtained preliminary data showing that relatively high concentration of glucuronide and sulfate conjugates of bromophenol (BP) are present in human urine samples. These water-soluble conjugates are known PBDE metabolites and are potential candidate urinary exposure markers for PBDEs. In this project, we will investigate the correlation between the concentrations of these urinary BP metabolites and PBDEs in human blood, as well as measuring concentrations of known PBDE metabolites and selected naturally-occurring bromophenols. Our work will contribute to the development of a more reliable assessment methodology for human PBDE exposure and public health risk assessment. 多溴聯苯醚（Polybrominated diphenyl ethers，PBDEs）作為溴化阻燃劑被廣泛添加於高分子聚合物和紡織品中，並廣泛存在于家居產品和傢俱中。由於這種廣泛使用，多溴聯苯醚正快速進入到全球生態系統甚至人體中，並被斯德哥爾摩公約正式認定為持久性有機污染物。因此，檢測人類對這類污染物的暴露情況對於它們的社會和人體健康風險評價有很大作用。儘管世界各地已經有大量的研究跟蹤並估計PBDE的人口暴露情況，但是由於無法獲得足夠用於檢測的人體組織樣品，並且有限的樣本量和抽樣方案會產生偏差，這些結果的可靠性還有待商榷。 血液和母乳是目前最常用於暴露風險量化的人體組織。然而，血液的取樣是一種侵入性操作，並且很難做到大規模取樣。儘管母乳的取樣是非侵入性的，但是樣品來源僅局限於比較小年齡範圍內的哺乳期婦女，並不能反映全部人口的暴露情況。而尿液不但其取樣是一個非侵入性過程，並且容易從大範圍被調查人口中獲得志願者提供的大量樣品。因此，從尿液中檢測多溴聯苯代謝物作為暴露標記物具有很重要的實際意義和應用價值。 我們的研究團隊已經獲得的主要資料表明，人體尿液樣品中存在高濃度的葡糖苷酸和硫酸結合形態的溴酚。這些水溶性結合物是多溴聯苯醚代謝物，可以作為尿樣中潛在的多溴聯苯醚的暴露標記物。在本課題中，我們會研究尿液中溴酚代謝物和血液中多溴聯苯醚濃度的相關性，並檢測已知多溴聯苯醚代謝物和一些自然產生的溴酚的濃度。我們的工作將對多溴聯苯醚暴露風險更有效評估方法論的發展和公共健康風險評估作出重要貢獻。

160510.label: Realisation of objectives
160510.value: All the objectives of the project have been successfully achieved. First, glucuronide and sulfate conjugates of 2,4-dibromophenol and 2,4,6-tribromophenol have been successfully synthesized, purified by HPLC – UV, and characterized by 1H-NMR, 2D-NMR, high resolution mass spectrometry and elemental analysis. This was followed by the development of a new analytical method of their determination in human urine by liquid-liquid / solid phase extraction and ion paired – HPLC / MS – MS. This analytical method was validated and showed outstanding analyte recovery, repeatability and sensitivity for the quantification of the trace amount of bromophenol (BP) glucuronide and sulfate conjugates in human urine. Limit of detections for all the conjugates in the urine matrix were below 13 pg mL-1, with 73 – 101 % analyte recovery and 7.2 – 8.6 % repeatability. One hundred parallel human urine and blood samples were recruited randomly in Hong Kong. Levels of 17 BDE congeners, 22 OH-BDE and 13 MeO-BDE metabolites, and 3 BPs species in the plasma samples were measured by GC-NCI-MS. Levels of 4 BP glucuronide and sulfate conjugates in the matching urine samples were determined by LC-MS. PBDEs were detected in all the 100 human plasma samples with ΣPBDE ranging from 0.01 – 23.48 ng/g-lipid. OH-BDEs and BPs were also detected in human blood samples. All the four types BP glucuronide and sulfate conjugates were detected in human urine samples, ranged from 0.08 to 106.49 μg/g-creatinine. Multivariant statistical analyses have revealed good correlations between ΣPBDEs in the blood plasma and ΣBP glucuronide and sulfate conjugates with the same number of bromine substituents in the corresponding urine samples. These suggest that the BP conjugates in human urine are mainly originated from the metabolism of PBDEs in human body, and they can be adopted as exposure markers for PBDE, especially those of Penta- and Octa-BDEs, in human.

160510.label: Major findings and research outcome
160510.value: We have successfully synthesized, purified and characterized a series of bromophenol (BP) glucuronide and sulfate conjugates as authentic standards for analytical purposes. These conjugates are highly water-soluble and rather difficult to synthesis. To the best of our knowledge, we were the first research group to report the synthesis of these conjugates. Using these bromophenol conjugates as authentic standards, an analytical protocol using solid-phase extraction and ion-paired LC–ESI-MS/MS quantification was developed for their direct and simultaneous determination in human urine samples. Limit of detections for all analytes were below 13 pg mL-1, with 73 – 101 % analyte recovery and 7.2 – 8.6 % repeatability. That was the first time an analytical method for the determination of these conjugates in human urine was reported. We then applied this analytical method to analyze 20 human urine samples collected randomly from voluntary donors in Hong Kong. All the samples were found to contain one or more of the bromophenol conjugates, with concentration ranging from 0.13 – 2.45 μg/g-creatinine. That was the first time that the occurrence of bromophenol glucuronide and sulfate conjugates in human urine was proven. Our findings was published in the ACS journal Analytical Chemistry (2012, Vol. 84, pp. 2881 - 2888) (impact factor: 5.695, ranked 3 out of 75 (top 4%) in the acalytical chemistry discipline). To evaluate whether urinary bromophenol glucuronide and sulfate conjugates can be population exposure markers for polybromodiphenyl ethers (PBDEs), we recruited 100 parallel human plasma and urine samples from voluntary donors in Hong Kong. Levels of 17 BDE congeners, 22 OH-BDE and 13 MeO-BDE metabolites, and 3 BPs species in plasma samples, the 4 BP glucuronide and sulfate conjugates in their matching urine samples were determined. We have detected PBDEs in all the 100 human plasma samples at 0.01 – 23.48 ng/g-lipid. All the four BP glucuronide and sulfate conjugates were also detected in human urine samples, ranged from 0.08 to 106.49 μg/g-creatinine. Multivariant statistical analyses revealed good correlations between ΣPBDEs in the blood plasma and ΣBP conjugates with the same number of bromine substituents in the corresponding urine samples. This was the first time correlation between PBDEs in human blood and BP conjugates in human urine was revealed. This also suggest that the BP conjugates in human urine can be adopted as exposure markers for PBDE in human. A research paper reporting all these findings is in preparation.

160510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160510.value: With the establishment of bromophenol glucuronide and sulfate conjugates in human urine as potential population exposure molecular markers for PBDEs, reliable assessment on the exposure level of population in the Hong Kong and Southern China region can be carried out. Similar PBDEs in human blood vs BP conjugates in human urine correlation studies can be carried out in other parts of China, Southeast Asia and Pacific region and beyond to explore the applicability of BP conjugates as PBDE exposure markers for regional and global populations. If the latter can be established, a global-scale survey to assess human exposure to PBDEs will become possible.

160510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
160510.value: Polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) are commonly used brominated flame retardant additives in polymers and textiles and are present in many household appliances and furnishings. Because of their wide application, these compounds are entering our global ecosystem, and humans, at an alarmingly rapid rate, leading them to be formally recognized as persistent organic pollutants (POPs) by the Stockholm Convention. Monitoring human exposure to this class of pollutant is, therefore, very important to the assessment of their risk to society. In this project, we find that a group of bromophenol glucuronide and sulfate conjugates are present human urine and their concentrations bear close correlation with the levels of PBDEs in human blood. This finding means that we can reliably estimate the level of PBDE contaminants in a person by analyzing the content of bromophenol conjugates in his/her urine sample. In the past, this could only be achieved by the analysis of blood or other tissue samples. Our finding has greatly simplified the process for the evaluation of population exposure of PBDEs and enables more rapid and reliable assessment of the public health risk posed by PBDEs to the local Hong Kong and Southern China population, and beyond.

160610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
160610.value: Halogenated flame retardants (HFRs) containing chlorine and bromine have been widely used in product manufacturing to reduce the likelihood of combustion. Certain flame retardants, e.g. polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs), can separate from products and be released into the environment. Reports of increasing PBDE levels in both abiotic and biotic environmental samples around the world, in addition to the publication of studies demonstrating the toxicity of these chemicals, prompted regulation of PBDE use in countries including the US and EU. This phase-out of PBDEs reduces the world market demand for these compounds, but requires the use of other HFRs in their place in product manufacturing. The Pearl River Delta (PRD) in south China is among the most heavily industrialized and developed areas in Southeast Asia. Its rapid pace of development, along with the large number of manufacturing industries and the extensive e-waste processing occurring there make the PRD a potentially significant source of emerging toxic chemicals such as HFRs. Although PBDEs have been measured in Hong Kong and China, there is a lack of comparable data for other HFRs such as hexabromocyclododecanes (HBCDs), prompting our group to start surveillance of these compounds in south China. The results indicated relatively high concentrations of HBCDs in local cetaceans, and also revealed the presence of two new HFRs in Hong Kong cetaceans, 2-ethylhexyl 2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate (TBB) and bis-(2-ethylhexyl)-tetrabromophthalate (TBPH), at levels comparable to those of HBCDs; these HFRs had not previously been reported in high trophic level organisms. The presence of these new HFRs in Hong Kong cetaceans indicates that these compounds are being released into the environment, and raises the possibility that other HFRs are also present in local top predators. Thus, it is instructive to investigate the occurrence of novel HFRs in the local environment. In this study, the species of interest are marine cetaceans (dolphins and porpoises) and waterbirds (herons and egrets), both of which are of great conservation value in Hong Kong. The objectives of this proposed study are therefore to (1) identify novel bioaccumulative and persistent HFRs in local cetaceans and waterbirds; (2) quantify these HFRs in cetacean and waterbird tissue samples using previously established methods; and (3) provide baseline information on the newly identified HFRs in the Hong Kong and south China marine environment with the aim of using these results as a basis for further research on the environmental distributions and toxicities of the identified compounds.

160610.label: Realisation of objectives
160610.value: Using the techniques developed in this research project, concentrations of organohalogenated contaminants including polychlorinated dibenzo-p-dioxins (PCDDs), polychlorinated dibenzofurans (PCDFs), coplanar polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) and polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) were measured in 56 egg samples collected from waterbirds of different species (Great Egret, Little Egret, Night Heron and Chinese Pond Heron) from different regions of Hong Kong. Analytical techniques developed were also applied for analyses of brominated flame retardants [e.g. PBDEs and hexabromocyclododecanes (HBCDs)] with local marine mammal samples (Objective 2) Based on these preliminary results, further work was undertaken focusing on novel brominated flame retardants including Decabromodiphenylethane (DBDPE), 1,2-dibromo-4-(1,2-dibromoethyl)cyclohexane (TBECH), Dechlorane Plus (DP), bis-(2-ethylhexyl)-tetrabromophthalate (BEHTBP), 2-ethylhexyl 2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate (EHTBB), hexabromocyclododencanes (HBCDs) and 1,2-bis(2,4,6-tribromophenoxy)ethane (BTBPE) in marine mammals from the South China Sea (Objective 1). Despite the fact that PBDEs were the most predominant brominated flame retardants in the samples analysed, a wide range of novel halogenated flame retardants (HFRs) were detected in both porpoise and dolphin samples. These patterns were attributed to the replacement of PBDEs by alternative HFRs and the increasing usage of these alternatives following the restriction/voluntary withdrawal of the production and use of PBDE commercial mixtures. Our findings provided baseline information on a wide range of newly identified HFRs in the Hong Kong and south China marine environment. The toxicities of HFRs were also investigated using zebrafish larvae as a model (Objective 3).

160610.label: Major findings and research outcome
160610.value: In the first phase, we developed and validated the analytical (instrumental) methods required for the project (Chemosphere, 82:18-24; Atmospheric Environment, 45:3750-3757 and Publication No. 1) Using these techniques, concentrations of organohalogenated contaminants including polychlorinated dibenzo-p-dioxins (PCDDs), polychlorinated dibenzofurans (PCDFs), coplanar polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) and polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) were measured in 56 egg samples collected from waterbirds of different species (Great Egret, Little Egret, Night Heron and Chinese Pond Heron) from different regions of Hong Kong. Although no significant variations were observed within- and between-site in the levels of PCDD/Fs, coplanar PCBs and PBDEs, the concentrations of coplanar PCBs were much higher than PCDD/Fs. Similarity in composition profiles of PCDD/F and coplanar PCBs from different egretries is possibly associated with non-point sources of these contaminants to Hong Kong. Predominant accumulation of BDE-47, BDE-99 and BDE-100 suggested the penta-BDE technical mixtures usage in Hong Kong and its vicinity. Toxic equivalency and Monte Carlo simulation technique did show potential risks on waterbirds due to their exposure to PCDD/Fs (Publication No. 2). Analytical techniques developed were also applied for analyses of brominated flame retardants [e.g. PBDEs and hexabromocyclododecanes (HBCDs)] with marine mammal samples (Publication No. 3). Based on these preliminary results, further work was undertaken focusing on “new” brominated flame retardants including Decabromodiphenylethane (DBDPE), 1,2-dibromo-4-(1,2-dibromoethyl)cyclohexane (TBECH), Dechlorane Plus (DP), bis-(2-ethylhexyl)-tetrabromophthalate (BEHTBP), 2-ethylhexyl 2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate (EHTBB), hexabromocyclododencanes (HBCDs) and 1,2-bis(2,4,6-tribromophenoxy)ethane (BTBPE) in marine mammals from the South China Sea. Despite the fact that PBDEs were the most predominant brominated flame retardants in the samples analyzed, DBDPE, BTBPE, bis- (2-ethylhexyl) -tetrabromophthalate (TBPH), 2-ethylhexyl 2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate (TBB) and DP were all detected in both porpoise and dolphin samples. In addition, significantly increasing temporal shifting trends of Deca-BDE to DBDPE, Octa-BDE to BTBPE, and Deca-BDE to DP were observed in porpoise samples between 2003 and 2012 and dolphin samples between 2003 and 2011 (Publication No. 4). Our toxicological studies on BFRs indicated that prenatal transfer of PBDEs could result in developmental neurotoxicity in zebrafish larvae. This highlights the potential risks associated with these contaminants (Publication No. 5). Recently, we have further detected commercial fluorosurfactants in the Hong Kong marine environment suggesting potential threats to waterbirds and marine mammals due to these compounds (Publication No. 6).

160610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160610.value: Results from this project suggest that the changing patterns and profiles of HFRs in the Hong Kong (and south China) environment were attributed to the replacement of traditional brominated flame retardants (e.g. PBDEs) by alternative halogenated flame retardants (HFRs) and the increasing usage of these alternatives following the restriction/voluntary withdrawal of the production and use of PBDE commercial mixtures. Our findings suggest that the study region may be a source of contamination by a wide range of PBDE alternative flame retardants due to the high detection frequencies and levels of these compounds in local wildlife species. Further investigations should be conducted to identify the sources of these compounds and implement management measures to control and mitigate potential negative impacts on the ecological systems and human health due to these emerging chemicals of concern.

160610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
160610.value: Halogenated flame retardants (HFRs) have been widely used in industrial products since the 1970s to reduce the likelihood of fire. One group of HFRs, polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs), has been detected at high concentrations in environmental samples around the world. Their ubiquitous occurrence and toxicity prompted regulation of PBDE use worldwide. With the phase-out of PBDEs, other HFRs must consequently take their place in product manufacturing. Our earlier surveillance work revealed the presence of two new HFRs, namely 2-ethylhexyl 2,3,4,5-tetrabromobenzoate and bis-(2-ethylhexyl)-tetrabromophthalate, in Hong Kong cetaceans. This project identified a wide range of novel (not previously reported) HFRs in waterbirds and marine cetaceans in Hong Kong. Our findings indicate that there are clear trends for the replacement of traditional HFRs (e.g. PBDEs) by alternative HFRs and the increasing usage of these alternatives following the restriction/voluntary withdrawal of the production and use of PBDEs. Our results further suggest that Hong Kong and its nearby region is an important contamination source of a wide range of new HFRs. Further investigations should be conducted to identify these sources so that appropriate management measures can be implemented to control and mitigate potential negative impacts due to these emerging chemicals of concern.
