244610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
244610.value: The significance of traffic congestion and air pollution in Chinese cities was highlighted during the 2008 Beijing Olympics. The average speed of motor vehicles in the city center during rush hour is now around 12-18 km per hour compared with 15km per hour by bicycle; Transport-related air pollutions account for about 23% of total air pollution in Beijing. Many attribute the problems to the rocket soaring car ownership and the increasing dependence on car for urban Chinese in their daily travel. More fundamental issues, however, have not yet received sufficient attention: apart from increased income, what other factors contribute to the growing demand for car? Apart from increased accessibility to car, what other factors contribute to the increased urban traffic? Based on our recent research on urban transportation in China, we hypothesize that urban form remaking, or spatial restructuring in Chinese cities, resulted from Danwei (or work unit), land, and housing reforms, has largely, if not fundamentally, changed the ways that urban Chinese use time and space and consequently their travel behavior. This research is thus proposed to investigate the interrelations between urban form remaking, car-dependence and traffic congestion in Beijing. Specifically, we will collect first-hand data on individuals’ preference towards living environment and travel behavior, actual activity-travel behavior and socio-economic variables at two time points. Secondary data will be collected to characterize the built environment in which individuals live. Econometric models especially longitudinal modeling tools such as the two-wave structural equation models will be used to establish associations as well as cause-effect relations between built environment and activity-travel behavior in terms of car ownership, the use of time and space, travel frequencies and duration and shares of motorized and non-motorized transport modes. This proposed research has both great academic significance and policy relevance. It will enrich the current literature on the connections between built environment and activity-travel behavior with empirical findings from a case outside North America and Europe. It will also greatly contribute to the understanding of congestion and air pollution problems related to urban traffic in Chinese cities and based on which appropriate remedy policies may be proposed. 中国城市的交通堵塞及空气污染情况的严重性在２００８年北京奥运时受到特别的关注。在北京，于繁忙时间在市中心行驶的机动车辆平均车速为每小时１２－１８公里，而自行车则是每小时１５公里。与交通相关的空气污染贡献率占全北京市大气污染百分之二十三。 许多人认为造成此污染问题的原因主要是机动车保有量的迅猛增长和城市人口日渐依赖机动车的出行习惯。可是人们往往忽略了一个最基本的问题是：除了收入的增长外, 其他导致汽车需求上升的重要原因是什么? 除了大多数人比以前可以更方便地使用汽车出行外, 还有什么原因造成城市的交通堵塞? 根据我们近期对于中国城市交通的研究，我们认为由单位,土地和住房改革引发的城市结构调整如果不是根本上至少在很大程度上改变了城市居民的时间和空间运用方式，从而改变了他们的日常出行行为。因此本研究旨在探讨中国城市空间结构的变化如何影响居民的日常活动与出行行为，从而更好地理解造成北京的交通挤塞情况的原因。具体来说，我们先将设定两个时间点，以收集有关对居住环境和出行行为的个人偏好，以及实际出行行为和社会经济变量的第一手资料。我们亦会收集有关居民生活居住环境的第二手资料。我们会用计量经济模型 (econometric models)，尤其是纵向的建模工具(longitudinal modeling tools)，如两阶段结构方程模型(two-wave structural equation models)来建立环境和出行行为的因果关系，当中包括汽车所有权，使用时间和空间的活动与出行情况等。本拟议的研究有重要的学术意义和政策参考性。这一北美与欧洲之外的案例将充实现有关于居住环境与交通行为关系的文献研究。它也将大大有助了解中国城市中的交通堵塞和空气污染问题，从而设计出适当而有效的政策来缓解这些问题。

244610.label: Realisation of objectives
244610.value: If not more, we have fully addressed all research objectives of this project: We have collected two-wave activity-travel diary and related data, one of the very few of this type in travel behavior research. This allow us to conduct a number of longitudinal investigations into changes in activity-travel behavior in terms of trip making, time use, activity engagement, car usage, car ownership, etc. and other phenonomenon, which have also been accomplished. A series papers have been produced, which have been either published or under review. In addition to that, we have also extended the scope of the research to include topics on residnetial satisfaction, subjective wellbeing, travel satisfaction and life satisfaction, etc.

244610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
244610.value: This research project studies the impacts of home change on individuals' engagement in daily activities and travel and to infer how important the built environment of home in infleuncing people's daily travel. We found that access to public transit such as railway stations reduces total tarvel time; travel-related attitude such as preference for walking/bicycling induces the choice of slow modes for travel. We have also studied the impacts of residential move on residential, travel and life satisfaction and find that home change leads to at least short-term increases in satisfaction with residence, daily travel and life as a whole.

245310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
245310.value: This is a survey of China’s regional film industry between 1900 and 1950. As the birthplace of cinema in China, Shanghai (the so-called Hollywood of the East) was the centre where most historical documents have been collected, studied and written about. The concentration on Shanghai is inevitable, but as the field grows there is a need to look beyond Shanghai in order to come to a comprehensive, in-depth knowledge of the film industry as a whole, before it was nationalized under the People’s Republic of China in 1950. This project is premised on a recurring issue in Chinese early film historiography--Hollywood domination and the counter-hegemonic response from local industry--and asks how this relationship played out in the regional markets. In addressing this question, the project aims to collect and analyze four sets of primary materials from regional archives and libraries: 1) distribution companies and their circuits; 2) movie theatres; 3) film advertisements; and 4) film reviews. These materials will provide a deeper understanding of the regional industry practices (distribution, marketing, exhibition) and film reception (film reviews), that are currently missing in the standard literature. To what extent does the shape of early film industry reflect the priorities of Hollywood? What kind of response did this generate from the local establishments? With respect to geographical scope, this project will conduct field research in five cities: Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Tianjin, Chongqing and Hong Kong, which represent five major regions, including Eastern China, Southern China, Northern China, Western China and the Chinese diaspora. Three research teams led by the principal investigator and three co-investigators will be organized to discover materials from major newspapers, trade publications, municipal records, memoirs and interviews. We extend the search beyond Shanghai, tracing the centrifugal connections from the capital to the regional cities of China. We plan to share our findings with the larger scholarly communities by scanning and preserving the collected film advertisements and reviews in electronic files, as the first step leading to a large electronic database of the Chinese film industry for future research. 這是一項對中國1900到1950年間地方性電影工業的調查。上海，作為中國的電影誕生地，不僅藏有眾多的歷史材料，也是研究和書寫的核心地帶，因此研究中國早期電影工業聚焦於上海是不可避免的。但隨著這一領域研究的逐步深入，為了對未國有化的1950年之前的整個電影工業有一個更全面和深入的了解，我們有必要將視野擴展到上海之外的地方。本計畫的初衷是重新探討中國早期電影歷史編撰中的一個重要議題——好萊塢的統治和來自地方電影工業對霸權的反抗回應，並考察這種關係是如何在地方性市場上進行博弈的。為了探討這一問題，本項調查致力於蒐集和分析來自地方檔案館和圖書館的四種類型的資料：1）發行公司和它們的院線；2）電影院；3）電影廣告和4）電影評論。這些資料將有助於更好地理解中國的地方性電影工業實踐（發行、營銷和放映）和電影接受，而這些研究在目前的權威文獻中仍是缺失的。 我們試圖解答中國早期電影工業的狀態在何種程度上反映了好萊塢的優勢？地方的電影公司面對強大的好萊塢又做出了怎樣的回應？ 出於地理維度方面的考慮，這一項目將在5個城市展開田野調查：杭州、廣州、天津、重慶和香港，因為它們代表著中國的5個主要地區：華東、華南、華北、西北和海外中國人聚居區。由研究團隊領導的3支調查團隊將有計劃地從主要報紙、行業刊物、地方志文獻、回憶錄和訪談中挖掘資料。這項調查擴展到上海之外，追踪影業首都與中國地方城市之間的離心張力。我們計劃通過掃描等數字化方式保存蒐集來的電影廣告和評論，在未來建設一個中國電影工業數據庫，與學術界共享研究成果。

245310.label: Realisation of objectives
245310.value: (1) To arrive at a preliminary depiction and explanation of the regional film culture and market between 1900 and 1950: The research team collected and analyzed film advertisements, news items and articles from Chinese newspapers during 1900 to 1950 in Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Tianjin, and Hong Kong, which represent four major regions, including Eastern China, Southern China, Northern China and the Chinese diaspora. The team read through eight Chinese newspapers in the four cities and collected over twenty-two thousand film-related primary materials. These findings are essential in reconstructing early film scenes in China, beyond our existing knowledge of the Shanghai-centric filmography and historiography. Furthermore, these findings help us advance our understanding of the economical patterns of the regional markets and of the differences of film reception from region to region. (2) To conduct a systematic survey on film distribution, marketing, promotion, exhibition and reception in four major regional cities: The research team employed archival research and collected all relevant items related to movie business, film events, activities and personnel as they appeared in the selected newspapers. The items collected were categorized, transcribed, summarized and compiled into an on-line database. (3) To uncover new primary materials on Chinese cinema history: Through employing an archival research, the research team collected a massive amount of primary materials and as a result, discovered a number of errors in the standard history of Chinese and Hong Kong film industry. Materials currently missing in the standard literature were also uncovered which provide a deeper knowledge of early film industry practices (distribution, marketing and exhibition) and reception. (4) To make the primary materials available for scholars, students and researchers in print and electronic format: An open-access online database which provides an index to and synopsis of all collected materials was launched in March 2015 (http://digital.lib.hkbu.edu.hk/chinesefilms/). In this database, collected primary materials were catalogued by the following indices: date of publication, press, tagline, synopsis, company, exhibition venue, personnel and film title. The database is open to general public and will serve as an essential reference for future research on Chinese regional film history. Based on the findings, the research team also edited an anthology with 6 articles, completed with a compilation of selected primary materials. The anthology will be published by the Peking University Press in November 2015.

245310.label: Major findings and research outcome
245310.value: The major outcomes of the project: 1) An Online Database: The database provides an index to film-related materials in eight Chinese newspapers from late Qing to the Republican era in four cities: Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Hangzhou and Tianjin. The first of its kind, this database has a rich collection of over 22,000 entries which covers a period of 50 years. This database made available a keyword index which allows easy data search that goes beyond geographical limitations, and will serve as an essential reference for future research on China regional film history. 2) Two journal articles by PI 3) One edited book by PI: 《華語電影工業：方法與歷史的新探索》(Rethinking Chinese Film Industry: New Methods, New Histories) Peking: Peking University Press (2011); 4) One edited book by PI and Co-Is: 《走出上海：早期電影的另類景觀與史料建置》 (Beyond Shanghai: Reconstructing the Early Scenes of Chinese Film Industry) Peking: Peking University Press (forthcoming in 2015): With six articles by PI, Co-Is, Research Associate and Research Assistants, and a compilation of selected primary materials Other outcomes: 1) One International Conference: “Rethinking Chinese Film Industry: New Methods, New Histories” organized by the PI in Oct 2010. 2) One Conference Panel: A panel reporting the research findings at the international conference “Chinese-language Cinema: Text, Context and History”, organized by the PI in Jun 2013. 3) Six conference papers by - Prof. Emilie Yeh (PI): Hong Kong (Jun 2013), Russia (Oct 2013), Taiwan (Apr 2014), Milan (Jun 2014) - Prof. Feng Xiaocai (Co-I): Hong Kong (Jun 2013) - Dr. Liu Hui (Co-I): Hong Kong (Jun 2013) 4) One Special Issue on Republican Cinema published in JOURNAL OF CHINESE CINEMAS Further details of the above will be provided in Part C.

245310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
245310.value: The principal investigator was awarded a GRF in the 2014/2015 exercise for the project “Early Hong Kong Cinema in English-language Documents: 1897-1925” (project no.: 12408414). The application was developed based on major findings of the current project. In the current project, while verifying some ambiguous information collected from the Chinese newspaper in Hong Kong, several gaps in the standard historiography became evident. To address this, the team turned to local English-language newspapers for cross-reference and found that these newspapers as a whole offer more detailed information on early Hong Kong film with respect to exhibition, reception and the people involved in the trade. For instance, in 1909, between January and March, the English-language press China Mail ran a total of 146 film advertisements and 16 news items while The Chinese Mail printed 40 film ads and only 3 news items. Not only did the English press surpass its Chinese counterparts in covering film in quantity, its film coverage was considerably more substantial in content. Enough evidence shows that English newspapers will reveal further and more precise information on early Hong Kong film history.

245310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
245310.value: The project was a survey of China’s regional film industry between 1900 and 1950. It addressed two problems in current Chinese film historiography. First, Shanghai as the metonymy of pre-socialist cinema, and second, the lack of a systematic industry study grounded on a supply of primary historical sources. As the birthplace of cinema in China, Shanghai is the centre where most historical documents have been collected and written about. There is a need to look beyond Shanghai in order to come to a comprehensive, in-depth knowledge of the film industry as a whole. The project conducted field research in four cities: Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Hangzhou and Tianjin which represent four major regions, including the Chinese diaspora, Southern China, Eastern China and Northern China. The primary materials collected are essential in reconstructing the early China regional film industry. The project’s outcomes include 1) two journal articles: “Translating Yingxi: Chinese film genealogy and early cinema in Hong Kong” (Journal of Chinese Cinemas 9.1 (March 2015): 76-109) and "New Takes on Film Historiography: Republican Cinema Redux" (Journal for Chinese Cinemas 9.1 (March 2015): 1-7); 2) two edited books: Rethinking Chinese Film Industry: New Methods, New Histories (Peking University Press, December 2011) and 走出上海：早期電影的另類景觀與史料建置 (Beyond Shanghai: Reconstructing the Early Scenes of Chinese Film Industry) (Peking University Press, forthcoming in 2015); 3) an open-access database: launched on March 18, 2015 in collaboration with the Digital Humanities project of the Hong Kong Baptist University Library. The database offers a collection of over 22,000 entries which cover a period of 50 years, from 1903-1949. Many of these entries are new discoveries in the history of Chinese cinemas. This database provides a keyword index which allows easy data search that go beyond geographical limitations, and will serve as an essential reference for future research on China regional film history.

260010.label: Project Objectives
260010.value: To test whether neonatal maternal separation (NMS) could evoke enteric nervous system (ENS) plasticity in the structural, neurochemical and functional aspects. These experiments will be critical in providing direct evidence whether or not NMS can evoke the ENS plasticity. To determine whether blocking NGF/Trk signaling with a non-specific Trk antagonist k252a during postnatal day before daily NMS affects the development of ENS plasticity and visceral hyperalgesia in adulthood. The results will help us to understand whether the NMS-evoked neuronal plasticity of the ENS is NGF/Trk signaling mediated. To test whether exogenous NGF treatment will result in visceral hyperalgesia and ENS plasticity in adulthood. The information will provide direct evidence how NGF evokes the ENS plasticity and visceral hyperalgesia. To test the difference of ENS plasticity among male and female NMS rats. The information will help us to understand the gender difference under early life stress.

260010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
260010.value: 早前的研究表明：大鼠幼年時期的母子分離可以改變大鼠的胃腸功能及對內髒刺激的感應性；神經生長因子可以直接或間接影響胃腸道功能。神經生長因子不但對於中樞神經系統的發育有重要作用，對於腸神經系統的表型調節亦有重要作用。我們先前的研究表明：神經生長因子參與母子分離大鼠所致的內髒痛覺超敏，而這種痛覺超敏與由神經生長因子介導的中樞神經可塑變化密切相關。但是母子分離大鼠是否存在腸神經系統可塑變化以及這種變化是否由神經生長因子介導，仍未可知。本研究的主要目的就是探討母子分離大鼠的胃腸運動異常是否與腸神經系統的可塑變化相關，以及這種可塑變化與神經生長因子的相關關系。試驗中，雄性Wister幼鼠從出生後第二天開始至第14天接受每天三小時與母鼠分離。在此過程中，一組母子分離大鼠接受抗－NGF抗體，另一組不接受母子分離但是接受外源性神經生長因子，目的在於探討神經生長因子是否參與腸神經叢的可塑變化及其與胃腸功能變化的關系。所有模型大鼠將接受胃腸動力測試以確定是否存在胃腸動力異常，Western-blot 及半定量PCR將用於測量神經生長因子及其受體在大鼠結腸中的表達，腸神經叢的結構、功能變化亦將采用常規方法檢查。通過這一研究，旨在探討母子分離大鼠胃腸功能變化的原因，為尋求治療腸易激綜合征治療藥物提供可能的途徑。

260010.label: Realisation of objectives
260010.value: In the proposed study,aims including: i)To test whether neonatal maternal separation (NMS) could evoke enteric nervous system (ENS) plasticity in the structural, neurochemical and functional aspects; ii) To determine whether blocking NGF/Trk signaling with a non-specific Trk antagonist k252a during postnatal day before daily NMS affects the development of ENS plasticity and visceral hyperalgesia in adulthood; iii)To test whether exogenous NGF treatment will result in visceral hyperalgesia and ENS plasticity in adulthood; and iv) To test the difference of ENS plasticity among male and female NMS rats. Our research results showed that NMS can induce the visceral hyperalgesia and motility disorder in adult rats. Also, we found that NMS induced visceral hyperalgesia and motility disorder accompanying with the enteric nerve system plasticity, which including enteric nerve system structural changes in enteric ganglia,such as neuronal hypertrophy and hyperplasia and glial hyperplasia. For the neurochemical coding of enteric neurons, our results also showed that NMS can cause a significant increase in the P75 and TrkA immunoreactive neurons of the submucosal plexus and myenteric plexus in both proximal and distal colon,with an increase of ChAT immunoreactive neurons in the myenteric plexus and a decrease of VIP immunoreactive neurons in the proximal submucosal plexus. Furthermore, NMS still induces a significant increase in the nNOS immunoreactive neurons in the proximal myenteric plexus and Cabindin immunoreactive neurons in the distal submucosal plexus.These data support that maternal separation promotes long term alterations in enteric neuronal plasticity in rat colon, from the proximal colon to the distal colon.Further we also found that exogenous NGF can not only trigger the increase of serotonin in the gut, but also results in a visceral hyperalgesia and ENS plasticity in adult rats. Furthermore, the non specific TrkA antagonist K252a can not only affect the NMS-induced visceral hyperalgesia and motility disorder in adult NMS rats, but also it can affect the ENS plasticity in adult rats. We did not find the difference of ENS plasticity among male and female rats, although there are some difference about the degree of visceral hyperalgesia. In addition, we are investigating the neurostem cells changes in the hippocampus under the neonatal maternal separation, which may be related with the development of psychological disorder in NMS-induced visceral hyperalgesia rats.

260010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
260010.value: Based on our previous studies and the current project, we found that NMS can cause significant neuroplasticity in ENS and spinal cord. But we donot know whether there is similar changes in the central nerve system. Currently, with the support of our research funding and other grants, we are focusing the neurostem cells changes in the hippocampus under the neonatal maternal separation, which may be related with the development of psychological disorder in NMS-induced visceral hyperalgesia rats. The results may explain why NMS can induce the psychological disorder behavior in NMS rats, which maybe applied to the clinical irritable bowel syndrome patients with psychological disorder, especially for depression.

260010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
260010.value: Early life stress is a risk factor for the development of irritable bowel syndrome. The reason why the early life stress can cause the onset of visceral hyperalgesia and gastrointestinal motility disorder still under investigation. Current study, in combination with our previous study, explains, at least partially, that neonatal maternal separation, one form of early life stress, can cause the neuroplasticity in enteric nerve system, spinal cord level, thus to make the adult rats predispose to develop the clinical symptoms of IBS. And the mechanism of such action is mediated through nerve growth factor (NGF)/ TrkA pathway. Further studies are needed to elucidate any other hormones are involved in the visceral hyperalgesia development process, and whether there is a potential to develop a new drug targeting this pathway to treat irritable bowel syndrome.

261210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
261210.value: Matrix population models are often used in conservation to measure the relative contribution of different demographic parameters to population growth and then to explore various conservation strategies. This study aims to examine the use of such models for the management of the sea urchin Anthocidaris crassispina, a commercially important harvested species inhabiting the coasts of Japan, Korea and China. In Hong Kong, commercial harvesting of this species began in the mid-1970s with an annual production of cleaned gonads (i.e. roe) reaching a peak of 60-80 tonnes in 1978-1980, but since 1984 the landings have declined to less than 10 tonnes a year. Despite the strong evidence of over-exploitation, no quantitative assessment of the effects of fishing on survival, growth and mortality has been conducted and there is no management plan for this species. This study will compare the demography of four A. crassispina populations, two in no-take areas and two in areas open to fishing, to examine the effects of establishing marine park and marine reserve on the sea urchin population. Based on the empirical data we will use a matrix modeling approach to analyze the contribution of different demographic rates to population variability, examine the consequences of various levels of fishing and conservation on population growth through numerical simulation. The results will provide essential information for the development of a management plan for this sea urchin for the first time. 261310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
261310.value: Anti-mitotic drugs, such as paclitaxel, are among the most commonly used chemotherapeutics in the clinic, in particular for treating solid tumors. Most anti-mitotic drugs are known to induce prolonged mitotic arrest and trigger apoptosis by the intrinsic pathway, but the mechanism of apoptosis activation and its relationship to mitotic arrest and cell cycle progression are poorly understood. This grant application proposes to use a live cell fluorescent reporter of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), the committed step of intrinsic apoptosis, to measure the kinetics of apoptosis induction under paclitaxel and investigate how this kinetics is altered by perturbation of the intrinsic apoptotic pathway, in particular the Bcl-2 network. The goal is to identify potential molecular trigger for cell death induced by anti-mitotic drugs and unravel the role of apoptosis regulators in activating apoptosis in both cancer and normal mammalian cell lines. This would be an important step forward for understanding how intrinsic apoptotic pathway that governs responses to anti-mitotic drugs is differentially regulated, and how these differences alter drug responses in different cell types. The proposed project combines real-time live-cell imaging at the single cell level with quantitative modeling of cellular network dynamics. Real-time microscopy based on phase-contrast and/or fluorescent imaging allows in situ monitoring of drug-induced cellular alterations leading to MOMP and apoptosis. Their dependence on Bcl-2 family proteins will be investigated by RNAi knock-down. With the kinetic data acquired from live-cell imaging, computational analysis will be employed to integrate different data sets and construct a model of Bcl-2 network dynamics in response to paclitaxel. Such detailed and quantitative understanding is likely to reveal molecular components in the intrinsic apoptotic pathway that governs cell death triggered by anti-mitotics, and are potential drug targets that could synergize with anti-mitotics in anticancer regimen. 抗分裂藥物，例如紫杉醇，是臨床上最常用的化療藥物之一，特別是用於治療固態腫瘤。大多數抗分裂的藥物都會使細胞長時間處於分裂態，進而引發細胞凋亡，但關於其激活細胞凋亡的機制，以及細胞凋亡與抑制細胞分裂進程之間的相互關係則還未有清晰的研究結果。本研究計劃通過利用熒光標記線粒體外膜通透性（MOMP）以及活體細胞瞬態成像，從動力學的角度量化紫杉醇誘發細胞凋亡的過程，並研究這一動態過程如何受到內在細胞凋亡通路的調控，特別是Bcl - 2網絡的調控。我們的目標是找出潛在的觸發細胞凋亡的調控分子，從而找到抗分裂藥物激活細胞凋亡進程的分子機制，以及其在癌變和正常細胞上作用的特異性。這一研究項目的成果將會使我們了解抗分裂藥物對細胞凋亡通路的影響和作用，以及其對不同類型細胞作用的特異性。 本研究計劃結合在單細胞水平上的活體細胞瞬態成像以及定量的網絡動態模擬。活體細胞瞬態成像利用phase-contrast及熒光成像的方法，實時監測藥物引發 momp和細胞凋亡的動態過程。而這一過程如何受 Bcl – 2網絡的調控將通過RNAi的方法進行研究。根據實驗得到的動力學數據，一個量化的Bcl-2網路模型將會被建立，並通過模擬模型對紫杉醇的動態響應以整合不同的實驗數據。通過模型的構建，我們將會對抗分裂藥物在細胞凋亡通路的作用靶點有定性及定量的認識，並且找到能與抗分裂藥物起協同作用的新的藥物靶點。

261310.label: Realisation of objectives
261310.value: Objective 1: This objective is fully realized. Specifically, the kinetics of MOMP and apoptosis triggered by anti-mitotic drugs, e.g. paclitaxel and K5I, had been measured and quantified in details for four representative mammalian cell lines, including HeLa, U2OS, OVCAR-5 and A549. Our results showed distinct kinetic features not only between different cell lines but also between death in mitosis and death after mitotic slippage (Shi et al, Cancer research 2011). Objective 2: This objective is fully realized in three steps. (1) We first determined that apoptosis induced by anti-mitotics during mitotic arrest is independent of checkpoint proteins and proteins involved in the mitotic slippage pathway, and confirmed that MOMP kinetics is likely the result of mainly variation in Bcl-2 network proteins that are direct regulators of the apoptosis machinery (Huang et al, Plos One 2010). (2) Then by systematically knocking down individual Bcl-2 proteins, we determined that Mcl-1 and Bcl-xL (both are anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins) are the primary negative regulators of apoptosis during prolonged mitotic arrest (Shi et al, Cancer Rsearch 2011). (3) To identify MOMP regulators responsible for apoptosis after mitotic slippage, we perturbed post-slippage cell death by either knocking down Kinesin-5 or reducing the duration of mitotic arrest. Our results showed that post-slippage MOMP is triggered by multinucleation-induced DNA damage and regulated by the p53-dependent DNA damage response pathway (Zhu et al, Cell Cycle 2014). Objective 3: This objective is fully realized. Based on the experimental data, a simplified Bcl-2 network model has been constructed to quantitatively evaluate MOMP kinetics and cell-line variations in a unified framework. Simulation of the Bcl-2 network model showed that given a variable, slowly accumulating pro-apoptotic signal, e.g. depletion of Mcl-1 during mitotic arrest, generation of a switch-like MOMP response requires the formation of pro-apoptotic Bax/Bak complexes containing at least hundreds of subunits, indicating crucial role of very high-order cooperativity in controlling the switch-like apoptotic responses. The modeling results also revealed that cell-to-cell variation in their sensitivity and kinetics to apoptosis arises primarily as a result of differential basal expression of Mcl-1 and Bcl-xL relative to Bax/Bak, providing potentially quantitative molecular diagnostics for predicting drug response to anti-mitotics in patients with distinct cancer types. We are currently generating figures of the modeling data and drafting the manuscript. We plan to submit the manuscript within the coming 3-5 months.

261310.label: Major findings and research outcome
261310.value: Our study uncovered and determined key molecular and cellular mechanisms that govern Bcl-2 network dynamics and the resulting cell-type variation in apoptotic response to anti-mitotic chemotherapeutics. By identifying the distinct MOMP regulators for anti-mitotics induced cell death both during mitotic arrest and after mitotic slippage, our findings provide not only novel, quantitative biomarkers for predicting anti-mitotics drug response in patients with different cancer types but also point to new combinatorial strategies, e.g. combining anti-mitotics with Navitoclax (Bcl-xL inhibitor), that may be more effective for cancer treatment. Our findings have resulted in 3 publications in peer-review journals and a 4th manuscript currently under preparation, which is expected to be submitted within the coming 3-5 months (please refer to Part C for details of the publications).

261310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
261310.value: Our study has elucidated the cytotoxic mechanisms of anti-mitotic chemotherapeutics using cell culture model. In order to apply our findings to the clinical setting, we have to first test the biomarkers and cellular mechanisms that we uncovered using appropriate mouse tumor models. We thus have established collaboration with Prof. Timothy Mitchison at Harvard Medical School to pursue this further study, as his laboratory has developed several mouse tumor models to investigate dynamics of anti-mitotic drug response in vivo, e.g. by intravital imaging.

261310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
261310.value: Anti-mitotic drugs, such as paclitaxel, are among the most commonly used chemotherapeutics in the clinic, in particular for treating solid tumors. However, the mechanism of their cytotoxicity and its relationship to mitotic arrest and cell cycle progression are poorly understood. Through this study, we have elucidated the cellular and molecular mechanisms that govern cytotoxic activity of anti-mitotics both during mitotic arrest and after mitotic slippage. Our results suggested: (1) that to predict tumor cell response to anti-mitotic drugs, two distinct sets of biomarkers may need to be considered, one involving genes that regulate cell death during prolonged mitotic arrest (e.g. Mcl-1 and Bcl-xL) and the other involving genes that control DNA damage-dependent post-slippage death (e.g. p53 and Puma); and (2) that combinatorial treatment of anti-mitotics with Navitoclax is more effective than anti-mitotics alone across different tumor types.

261510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
261510.value: Agricultural soil contaminated by heavy metals has become a global environmental issue for years. Compared to other heavy metals, cadmium (Cd) has a relatively higher mobility in soil and higher rates of soil to plant transference, and thus has attracted more public attention. Consumption of Cd-contaminated rice has resulted in thousands of people suffering from a serious kidney and bone disorder called “Itai-Itai” disease. Similar to other plant species, such as rice, maize and tobacco, some vegetables are able to avidly take up Cd and accumulate a high level of Cd in their edible parts, thus posing a potential health risk to human. Cadmium enrichment or contamination in agricultural soils is prevalent in the Pearl River Delta (PRD) region, Guangdong Province, due to rapid urban and industrial development and increasing reliance on fertilizers and agrochemicals during the past several decades. Over 90% of the vegetable products consumed in Hong Kong are directly imported from neighboring mainland China. At present, there are a total of 767 registered vegetable farms exclusively supplying vegetables for Hong Kong, most of which are located in Guangdong, Yunnan and Hainan Provinces. A preliminary survey showed that 26.8% of the vegetables from Guangdong Province exceeded the Chinese safety standard for Cd (0.05 mg/kg) contained in vegetables. Therefore, there is an urgent need to investigate the status of Cd in vegetables and soils from registered vegetable farms in the PRD region, and to develop feasible mitigation measures to reduce Cd accumulation in vegetables. Based on the results of intensive field surveys, the following options will be developed to cope with the issue of Cd contamination in registered vegetable farms in the PRD region: (1) screening and breeding the vegetable genotypes with low Cd accumulation in their edible parts; (2) using the intercropping system consisting of vegetables and Cd-hyperaccumulators or fast-growing Cd-accumulators to produce vegetables containing an acceptable level of Cd; and (3) utilizing the intercropping system consisting of Cd hyperaccumulators and fast-growing Cd-accumulators combined with metal chelating agents or beneficial soil microorganisms (including arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungi and plant growth promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR)) to remediate Cd-contaminated agricultural soils. The results to be generated would be very valuable in developing practical mitigation measures for Cd accumulation in vegetables. The phytoextraction technique for slightly to moderately Cd-contaminated agricultural soils will be significantly improved to become practically feasible. 近年來農田的重金屬污染已經成為全球的熱點環境問題之一。其中鎘由於在土壤 中有比其他重金屬有更高遷移性和易被植物吸收的特質而備受關注。食用鎘污染 的稻米會引發嚴重的腎衰竭以及骨畸形的所謂痛痛病。某些蔬菜也與稻米、玉米 和煙草等作物相類似，對鎘有較強的吸收和體內累積能力。一旦這些鎘在可食部 分富集，則對人類健康會造成潛在的威脅。目前，由於城鎮化和工業化的高速發 展以及含鎘農用化學品（主要是化肥）的大量使用，珠江三角洲地區農田土壤的 鎘污染狀況日益嚴峻。香港市民消費的蔬菜超過90％需要從內地進口。在廣東、 海南和雲南，就有767 個註冊農場，專門為香港市場提供蔬菜。但是，根據初步 研究結果，廣東省出產的26.8％蔬菜中的鎘含量超過0.05ppm 國家食品安全標 準。因此，對在珠三角地區供港蔬菜基地的土壤污染狀況進行系統研究並找出相 應的對策已迫在眉睫。 我們將根據土壤壤調查結果，進行如下後續研究： 1. 遴選可食部位中低鎘累積的蔬菜品種； 2. 利用“鎘超積累植物－蔬菜＂間作技術降低鎘在蔬菜中的累積，實現蔬菜的 安全生產； 3. 結合土壤有益微生物（如菌根真菌和促植物生長細菌）和易降解化學螯合劑， 配合“鎘超積累植物－快速生長積累植物＂間種技術，將土壤中的鎘濃度降 低到安全生長所要求的閾值之下。 我們期望通過這個項目的研究，找出切實可行的對策以治理鎘污染土壤，提高 供港蔬菜的安全性。

261510.label: Realisation of objectives
261510.value: Triplicate samples each of 60 species/varieties of edible vegetables within nine groups commonly consumed in Hong Kong were randomly acquired. Subsamples of dried and ground vegetable were digested by conc. nitric acid followed to measure heavy metal (HM) concentrations. From each vegetable group, three random samples were selected to HM bioaccessibility. In order to evaluate once or long - term potential hazardous exposure to HMs via consumption of vegetables by the population of Hong Kong, the estimated daily intake (EDI), total Hazard Quotient (THQ) of HMs were calculated. Both surface soil samples (five random replicates per farm) and edible vegetable samples (triplicate samples each of five random vegetable species per farm) were collected from five farms around the PRD region, Southern China. The air-dried soil samples were sieved for analyzing soil pH, and total and DTPA-extractable HM concentrations. Subsamples of dried and ground vegetable were digested by conc. nitric acid followed to measure HM concentrations. The bioaccumulation factors (BFs) of toxic metals from contaminated soil to different types of vegetables were calculated by the ratios of the concentration of one metal in plant tissue to the total or DTPA-extractable concentration of that metal in soil from where the plant was grown. A greenhouse pot experiment was conducted to compare the phytoextraction efficiencies of Cd by hyper-accumulating Alfred stonecrop (Sedum alfredii Hance) and fast-growing perennial ryegrass (Lolium perenne L.) from a Cd-contaminated (1.6 mg kg-1) acidic soil, and their responses to the inoculations of two arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungal strains, Glomus caledonium (Gc) and Glomus mosseae (Gm). Ryegrass and stonecrop were harvested after growing for 9 and 27 wk, respectively. Five aspects of Cd and P uptake efficiencies by plants were assessed: total Cd and P absorption, Cd and P translocation efficiency, shoot and root P/Cd concentration ratio, weekly Cd extraction, and P consumption index for extracting Cd. An 8-week pot trial was then conducted to study Cd and P acquisition of upland kangkong (Ipomoea aquatica Forsk.) intercropped with stonecrop in the Cd-contaminated soil inoculated with Gc or G. versiforme (Gv), followed to assess the sustainability of mycorrhization effect and the post-harvest outcomes. Finally, a 10-week pot trial was conducted to investigate growth and Cd accumulation of kangkong intercropped with stonecrop in the Cd-contaminated soil inoculated with Gc and/or applied with biochar. Biochar and Gc-inoculated stonecrop decreased Cd availability and accessibility to kangkong, and resulted in relatively low-Cd vegetables.

261510.label: Major findings and research outcome
261510.value: This study aimed to (1) evaluate the contamination status and potential health risks of Cd and other major heavy metals (HMs) in market vegetables available in Hong Kong, (2) investigate the transfer pattern of Cd from soil to edible vegetables in farms around the Pearl River Delta (PRD), China, (3) compare the role of arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungi in Cd and P accumulation by remedial plants, i.e. hyper- accumulating and fast-growing plants, as well as by neighboring vegetables in intercropping systems, and (4) apply biochar and mycorrhizal intercrops on vegetable production in Cd-contaminated soils. A systematic survey of HM concentrations and bioaccessibilities in market vegetables in Hong Kong were carried out. The total bioaccessible target hazard quotient of Cd, Pb, Cr, Ni, Cu, and Zn via consumption of vegetables was 0.18 and 0.64 for average and high consumers, respectively, with Cd and leafy vegetable being the major risk contributors. In five random vegetable farms around the PRD, only soil total Cd concentrations were higher than the threshold of China. Soil DTPA-extractable Cd concentration, which negatively correlated to soil pH, was the key factor in influencing Cd bioaccumulation, notably stem/leaf vegetables. The weekly Cd extraction by Alfred stonecrop was substantially higher than perennial ryegrass. Glomus caledonium (Gc) and G. mosseae (Gm) increased Cd acquisitions of stonecrop and ryegrass, while only Gc-inoculated stonecrop significantly accelerated Cd extraction efficiency. Intercropping of stonecrop tended to decrease Cd uptake by upland kangkong via rhizosphere competition. Gc increased Cd acquisition of the host (stonecrop), and hence further lowered Cd concentration and acquisition of kangkong. Glomus versiforme (Gv) increased shoot biomass of the neighboring kangkong, causing a dilution effect on kangkong Cd concentration. Both Gc and Gv decreased DTPA-extractable Cd by elevating soil pH, and lowered kangkong Cd concentrations in a post-harvest experiment. Biochar significantly increased kangkong yield via elevating available P, and decreased soil Cd phytoavailability and kangkong Cd concentration via increasing soil pH. Compared with the monocultural control, there was a significantly higher kangkong yield with a substantially lower Cd concentration under the intercropping treatment applied with biochar and AM fungi. In summary, human health risk assessment should be modified by taking bioaccessibility into account. Cd was the primary metal of risk in vegetable farms around the PRD, and stem/leaf vegetables posed higher risks. The hyper-accumulating stonecrop associated with AM fungi (notably Gc) showed a potential application for treatment of Cd-contaminated soil. In addition, AM fungi and biochar played additive roles in the intercropping systems for the dual purposes of vegetable production and remediation of Cd-contaminated soils.

261510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
261510.value: Due to the limitations on risk assessment in the present study, it is urgent to determine HM concentrations and bioaccessibilities in other food categories (such as cereals) available in Hong Kong markets to form a complete picture on the total food consumption related to HM intakes. Meanwhile, since meals and meal time may affect the uptake of HMs from the human gastrointestinal tract, there is a need to conduct more extraction tests by simulating popular combined meals, and further modifications of the estimated HM absorptions via contrasting the difference of HM bioaccessibility with single vegetables. Due to the limitations about the present mycorrhizal remediation experiments more screenings of combinations involving remedial plant and AM fungus are needed to search for high phytoextraction efficiencies of Cd, and further research on biochar effects is necessary to quantify the benefits concerning safety and yield of vegetables. Moreover, application of both mycorrhizal stonecrop and biochar amendment with the dual purposes of Cd phytoextraction and vegetable production in Cd-contaminated deserve more detailed field investigation.

261510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
261510.value: The present study consisted of market survey, field investigation, and pot trials. The main aim of the present study was to investigate the public risk, transfer pattern, and remediation and revitalization of Cd-contaminated vegetable farm soils around the PRD, south China. This project will enhance our understanding of the health aspects associated with vegetables produced around the PRD, South China. The results generated from the present project will be very valuable in revealing the environmental influences on Cd uptake by vegetables, and will provide valuable information for the development of feasible mitigation measures to reduce Cd accumulation in vegetables, with emphasis on AM fungus, intercropping system, and biochar. It is envisaged that this project will be of great importance in coping with slightly to moderately Cd-contaminated farm soils around the PRD, China.

261610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
261610.value: Calcium is vital for most cellular and physiological processes. In mammals, body Ca2+ homeostasis is achieved by a balance among intestinal Ca2+ absorption, renal reabsorption and bone resorption and the process is tightly regulated by hormones. Disruption of the intracellular Ca2+ dynamic can impair many cellular functions, including cell division and cell growth. The disturbance of extracellular Ca2+ levels can lead to a diverse group of pathological consequences, such as osteoporosis, ricket and kidney stone disease. In the last decade, the characterization of the mammalian cell surface calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) and epithelial Ca2+-channels (ECaC/TRPV5 and TRPV6) has given insight to a new molecular concept of Ca2+ regulation and these have subsequently been identified as the prime therapeutic targets for diseases such as hypercalcemia and other metabolic bone diseases. Although valuable information has been deduced from the structural models of CaSR and ECaC/TRPV6, very little is known about how the mechanism of their activity is regulated. In fish, CaSR and ECaC have been cloned and were found to be expressed in gill epithelia, the major Ca2+-transporting tissue which is known to be crucial in the maintenance of Ca2+ homeostasis. The capability of fish gills to regulate different rate of Ca2+ absorption at varying water Ca2+ contents makes it as an excellent model to decipher the fundamental mechanism of epithelial Ca2+-transport. Yet surprisingly, information on the cellular mechanism of gill Ca2+-transport is very limited. In addition, the mechanistic action of the major fish calcium-regulating hormone, stanniocalcin-1 (STC1) to gill epithelia is also not known. Our success in isolating gill pavement and chloride cells as well as the establishment of primary gill cells culture provide an excellent opportunity to decipher the Ca2+-transport mechanism and to identify STC1-target cells. The studies described here aim to decipher the involvement of in situ Ca2+-sensing in the regulation of ECaC and CaSR expression/activity in gill epithelial cells. The results generated in this study will open up a new approach to investigate fish Ca2+ homeostasis mechanism and to reveal how the function of STC1 evolves in animals. This knowledge will ultimately provide profound benefits in the improvement of aquaculture practices, biomedical research and human health. 鈣在細胞及生物體內有不可或缺的重要功能。哺乳類動物通過激素來緊密調控腸道、腎臟和骨骼等器官對鈣的輸送以維持體內的鈣離子平衡。干擾細胞內鈣離子濃度會影響眾多細胞功能，包括細胞分裂和生長等。而當細胞外的鈣濃度受擾，更會導致骨質疏鬆症、佝僂病及腎石等疾病。經過過往十年的研究，對位於哺乳類動物細胞表面的鈣質敏感受體 (CaSR) 與及表皮性鈣離子通道 (ECaC) 等蛋白的認知,讓我們可以更深入地了解分子層面上的鈣質調控機制。這些新的知識更有助研發更有效的方法來治療高血鈣及其他代謝性骨病。雖然科研人員已對CaSR 及ECaC 等蛋白的結構上有一定的認知，但我們對規範這些蛋白活動的調控機制仍未有足夠充分的了解。 魚鰓對維持魚類體內鈣離子平衡有著重要的功能。CaSR 與ECaC 被發現表達於魚鰓表皮組織並且已經成功被克隆。基於魚鰓能有效地調節吸收鈣離子的速度以應付含有不同濃度鈣離子的水源的特性，魚鰓非常適合用作于研究表皮性鈣離子運輸的調控機制。但我們對主要魚類鈣調節激素—斯鈣素—對魚鰓內外的鈣離子運送的知識至今依然非常有限。 我們對提取並分離富含粒線體細胞與其他魚鰓表面細胞以及建立原代魚鰓細胞培養有相當豐富的經驗。該技術為我們提供一個非常優越的機會用作研究鈣離子的輸送調控機制和辨認斯鈣素的目標細胞。本研究致力於解釋魚鰓表皮組織的原位鈣離子感應對調控CaSR 與ECaC等蛋白的表達及活性的參與作用。其結果將為我們對研究魚類維持體內的鈣離子平衡的能力開拓新的方向，並有助揭示斯鈣素在動物體內的功用。最終，這些知識可以協助我們改善水產養殖方法、推動生物醫學上的研究和促進人類的健康

261610.label: Realisation of objectives
261610.value: We have completely achieved the two proposed objectives. In addition to the previous three publications submitted in the mid-term progress report. There is one additional paper accepted for publication in the "Journal of Molecular Endocrinology" in 2014. This paper addressed the activity of calcium-sensing receptor and its regulation in the expression levels of calcium channels in gills cells (Objective 1). For objective 2, a second manuscript is under preparation to demonstrate stanniocalin-1 (STC-1) mediated signaling and ligand binding in gill cells. A third manuscript includes RNAseq data of the STC-1 producing endocrine gland, Corpuscle of Stannius. These two manuscripts will be submitted to Journals in this September. Nevertheless all the data are included in the thesis of my PhD student Gu Jie. His PhD examination is scheduled on 27 August 2014.

261610.label: Major findings and research outcome
261610.value: Expression of Ca2+-sensing receptor (CaSR) in the endocrine gland, Corpuscle of Stannius (CS) is known to regulate the secretion of hypocalcemic hormone, stanniocalcin-1 (STC-1) to inhibit gill Ca2+-uptake. Although numerous reports have revealed the branchial expression of CaSR and STC-1, their de novo branchial functions have not yet been elucidated. In this study, we hypothesized that branchial CaSR plays a de novo “sensing” function in the maintenance of local Ca2+-homeostasis via the induction of STC-1 expression in gill cells. We identified a de novo CaSR-STC-1/COX-2 mediated protective pathway in gill tissues. The data sheds light on a possible cellular protective mechanism that is associated with transcellular Ca2+-transport. This findings provide an evolutionary link to demonstrate similar functional role of STC-1 in the regulation of cytosolic Ca2+ levels in both fish and mammals. To fill the major gap in our understanding on how STC-1 inhibits gill calcium uptake, we adopted various preparations of STC-1 receptor ligands (CS extracts, recombinant STC-1 proteins) and bioassays (cAMP, immunohistochemical (IHC) staining, receptor binding), to identify the action and illustrate the possible ligand-receptor interactions in fish gills. The results of our study support the notion of the presence of functional STC-1 receptor in gill cells. It is a G-protein coupled receptor that stimulates production of cAMP in response to STC-1 binding and subsequently acts on at least two downstream targets, epithelial Ca2+ channel (ECACL) and cyclo-oxygenase-2 (COX-2) to reduce Ca2+ entry and cytosolic Ca2+ levels. Collectively our study provide solid evidences to reveal both the target cells and mechanistic actions of STC-1 in gill tissues.

261610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
261610.value: With the solid evidence of STC-1 specific binding sites identified in gill cells, there will be a great opportunity for the cloning of STC-1 receptor from gill tissues. It would be an important study to provide a clue to clone the receptor in the mammalian system. Since mammalian STC-1 has been involved in diverse physiological and pathological functions, the identification of STC-1 receptor would help to delineate the mechanistic actions of the hormone.

261610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
261610.value: Calcium ion has diverse beneficial roles in living organisms, from invertebrates to vertebrates. Its function is pleiotropic, ranging from the regulation of signaling cascade in a single cell to a wide variety of physiological functions at an organ level. Failure in Ca2+ homeostasis affects a variety of molecular and cellular processes, ultimately leading to many pathological consequences. Life has evolved from an aqueous environment, however our information on the fish gill Ca2+-transport mechanism is surprisingly limited. The studies described here provide a fundamental understanding on the importance of in situ Ca2+-sensing and the regulatory mechanism in Ca2+-transport undertaken in fish gill epithelia. The delineation of these molecular mechanisms will provide fundamental and novel perspective to reveal the current model of epithelial Ca2+-transport in mammalian system, hence to facilitate the development of therapeutic strategies for a number of pathophysiological disorders.

261810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
261810.value: The recent discovery of a novel class of endogenous, small, non-coding RNAs, known as microRNAs (miRNAs) which can affect gene expression by inhibition of translation and/or degradation of their target genes has become the focus of recent research. These microRNAs by virtue of their gene regulation ability are important effectors of biological processes, such as cell proliferation, differentiation and growth. Besides, specific microRNAs are found to relate to disease development, such as cancer. However, information about the role of microRNAs in endothelial cell function, especially angiogenesis is very limited. We have been working on the effect of ginsenosides, active components of ginseng, on angiogenesis for more than 10 years. We have demonstrated that ginsenoside-Rg1 possesses angiogenic property through enhanced production of nitric oxide and increased expression of vascular endothelial growth factor; both are key activators of angiogenesis. In our recent study, we had successfully confirmed that the angiogenic effect of Rg1 is related to the enhanced expression of endothelial nitric oxide synthase through down-regulation of mir-214 by Rg1. In the present study, we want to focus on the role of mir-15b in angiogenesis and its gene targets. The result of this study will provide insight about the role of microRNAs in regulating angiogenesis and would create a new research direction about the physiological effects of natural compounds through modulation of microRNA expression. 最近發現一種新型的內源性, 細小的及非編碼的RNA, 被稱為微小RNA（miRNA）, 它可以通過抑制翻譯和/或降解靶基因而影響基因的表達, 它已成為近期的研究重點。這些小分子RNA憑藉其基因調控能力是重要的生物效應器，如細胞增殖，分化和生長。此外, 特定的microRNA被發現涉及到疾病的發展, 如癌症。但是, microRNA作用在血管內皮細胞的功能, 尤其是血管生成方面是非常有限的。我們對人參有效成分 - 人參皂甙, 對血管生成的效果研究已超過 10年。我們已經證明人參皂甙Rg1具有促進血管生成的屬性, 通過提高一氧化氮生產和增加血管內皮生長因子的表達，因二者都是激活血管生成的關鍵。在最近的研究中, 我們已經成功地證實了皂甙Rg1對血管生成的作用是關係到下調miR-214。在本研究中, 我們將著眼於miR-15b在血管生成的角色及其靶基因。這項研究結果將洞察microRNA在調節血管生成的角色, 並會創建一個新的研究方向, 就是天然化合物如何通過調節microRNA的表達而產生有關的生理作用。

261810.label: Realisation of objectives
261810.value: 1) Identification of the gene targets for mir-15b using proteomic and bioinformatics approach, Proteomic approach using 2-D PAGE and MS was applied to identify possible targets of microRNAs 15b. However, this approach was not successful; we were not able to identify candidate proteins that are related to angiogenesis except for protein of the major metabolic pathways. The possible reason may be the sensitivity of the method in identifying differentially expressed proteins. As a result, we decided to focus our effort on the previously identified target, VEGFR2 which is related to angiogenesis. 2) Verification of the gene targets for mir-15b by cloning of the target gene 3’-UTR and luciferase detection assay, To confirm the relationship between microRNAs 15b and VEGFR2, a reporter vector construction using the 3’-UTR of VEGFR2 cloned behind the LUC reporter gene was obtained from a commercial vendor. The construction indeed confirmed that microRNAs 15b targets VEGFR2. According to the proposal, mutations will be performed around the seed sequence in order to confirm the binding complementarity relationship. However, we felt quite confident in the reporter gene assay that we decided not to proceed further in that direction. 3) Functional analysis of miR-15b using mimics and antisense RNAs, MicroRNA 15b anti-sense inhibitor and precursor form were obtained to see their effect on VEGFR2 expression as well as on tube formation assay (one of the assays for angiogenesis). Finally, functional assay was performed using zebrafish as our model by microinjection of microRNA-15b inhibitor or precursor in order to investigate their effect on blood vessel formation, especially the sub-intestinal vessel. Our result clearly showed that increased level of miR-15b can inhibit blood vessel formation in zebrafish. 4) Study on the regulation of mir-15b expression by Rg1 and VEGF. Our previous study have identified through microarray analysis that some microRNA candidates were found to be differentially expressed in HUVECs after treatment with ginsenoside Rg1 and one of the candidate microRNAs is miR-15b. To confirm the above data, HUVECs were treated with Rg1 and VEGF respectively to monitor the expression level of miR-15b by qRT-PCR. The result showed that both Rg1 and VEGF can reduce the expression and the effect can last for at least 24 hrs. Preliminary work on the biogenesis of miR-15b due to Rg1 also demonstrated that the conversion of primary miR-15b to precursor miR-15b is reduced upon Rg1 treatment while further maturing steps of miR-15b is not affected.

261810.label: Major findings and research outcome
261810.value: The aim of the project is to understand the role of microRNA-15b in angiogenesis. We have fulfilled all the research objectives that we put forward in our proposal. First of all, we confirmed again that the previous microarray data were correct that Rg1 is able to decrease the expression of miR-15b. And that one of the predicted targets of miR-15b was confirmed as VEGFR2 by using western blot for protein expression and reporter gene system to study the direct interaction of miR-15b with the 3’-UTR of VEGFR2. Furthermore, miR-15b anti-sense inhibitor and mimics precursor were transfected into HUVECs to study the effects on the expression of VEGFR2. All these provided us with a clear linkage between miR-15b and VEGFR2. On the other hand, Rg1 was able to increase the expression of VEGFR2 in HUVECs. Since then, we are convinced that Rg1 can decrease the level of miR-15b leading to the increased translation of VEGFR2. The functional aspects of increased level of VEGFR2 leading to angiogenesis was further investigated by transfection of miR-15b anti-sense inhibitor and mimics precursor into HUVECs to study the angiogenic properties, such as tube formation and cell migration. It was found that reduction of endogenous miR-15b could increase tubulogenesis and cell migration while over-expression of miR-15b will have the reverse effect. The same set of experiment was performed in zebrafish by microinjection of the respective oligonucleotides into the developing embryos to look for changes in angiogenesis. The result indicated that increased level of miR-15b can suppress the subintestinal vessels formation. All these point to the involvement of miR-15 in angiogenesis. This work has been accepted for publication and is now in press in Biochemical Pharmacology 2013 titled “MicroRNA-15b contributes to ginsenoside-Rg1-induced angiogenesis through increased expression of VEGFR2.”

261810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
261810.value: With the methodology that we have developed on the study of microRNAs, we also applied that to other systems, such as control of collagen expression by miR-25 in Human dermal fibroblasts and the control of adipogenesis by miR-27b. Also, miR-15b was found to affect IP-10 expression in virus infected system. This work has confirmed our thinking that ginsenosides or simple natural compounds can indeed affect the expression of microRNAs leading some physiological changes. Please refer to Part C for the related references. The present project has provided solid evidence to support this thesis. The next step will be to study how natural compounds, such as ginsenosides can affect the biogenesis of microRNAs. Also, what are the possible targets of ginsenosides that can mediate these differential expressions of microRNAs?

261810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
261810.value: In this project, we demonstrated that a simple natural compound, such as ginsenoside-Rg1, which is one of the active components of the famous herbal medicine – ginseng can mediate angiogenesis.(formation of new blood vessels) through affecting some small RNAs, known as microRNAs. The process of angiogenesis is in fact related to a lot of physiological and pathological processes, such as cancer. In this study, we did confirm the relationship between Rg1 and microRNA, miR-15b. Rg1 can decrease the level of miR-15b, which will in turn enhance the synthesis of a protein, vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-2 (VEGFR2). This protein (VEGFR2) which acts as a major receptor present at the cell membrane will receive signal from vascular endothelial growth factor, an important angiogenic factor. The whole result is the increased of blood vessel formation. The relationship between natural compounds and microRNA is still emerging. The number of publication is still rather limited. This project has provided another supporting evidence that some physiological process and be mediated through microRNAs as affected by natural compounds. This will open a new direction in the study of natural compounds.

261910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
261910.value: Biotic and abiotic stresses often trigger generation of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (ROS/RNS) that have the potential to cause cellular damage. On the other hand, ROS/RNS, such as hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) and nitric oxide (NO), act as key signaling molecules that transduce environmental and developmental cues into appropriate physiological responses. Their signaling function is largely mediated through oxidoreduction of redox-sensitive proteins. Like other post-translational protein modifications such as phosphorylation/dephosphorylation, protein oxidation/reduction has increasingly been recognized as an important molecular switch that controls a wide variety of biological processes. We have recently identified an Anamorsin family protein in Arabidopsis (AtAnamorsin1) as one of redox-sensitive proteins whose reactive cysteine thiols undergo oxidative modifications under oxidative stress. Anamorsin, also termed Cytokine-Induced Apoptosis Inhibitor 1 (CIAPIN 1), was initially identified in mammals as an anti-apoptotic protein, and several members of this family have been implicated in regulating apoptosis, cell proliferation, carcinogenesis, and oxidative stress tolerance. However, the molecular basis for the roles of Anamorsin family proteins in these biological processes remains elusive. The AtAnamorsin1 gene is induced by various biotic and abiotic stress treatments and its loss-of-function mutation causes embryonic lethality. Our preliminary findings suggest that AtAnamorsin1 mediates biological processes by sensing cellular redox states through its oxidoreduction. The overall goal of this proposal is to define the molecular and biological function of AtAnamorsin1 through a multidisciplinary approach. We will determine the redox states of AtAnamorsin1 under various physiological stress conditions and reveal whether its redox states dictate its subcellular localization and action. We will test the working hypothesis that AtAnamorsin1 could be an AdoMet methyltransferase implicated in modification of nucleic acids or proteins, leading to transcriptional reprogramming of effector genes. Besides, molecular genetics approaches and microscopic techniques will be employed to unravel the AtAnamorsin1’s role in embryogenesis and the stress responses. The proposed study will lead to understanding of the mode of action by AtAnamorsin1 in the physiological and developmental processes. Arabidopsis, a model plant for molecular biology and genetics research, offers many advantages for carrying out these experiments. The study should also provide important insights into the molecular function of other Anamorsin family proteins. 生物和非生物脅迫常常誘導產生活性氧分子和活性氮分子。這些分子一方面造成細胞損傷，另一方面可以作為關鍵的信號分子（例如過氧化氫和一氧化氮）使植物對環境信號和發育信號作出合適的生理應答。這種信號傳導功能一般依賴於氧化還原敏感蛋白質的氧化還原狀態的變化。蛋白質的氧化和還原就像其他的蛋白質修飾方式例如磷酸化和去磷酸化一樣，越來越多地在多種多樣的生物學過程中被發現起著重要的分子開關作用。 最近我們在擬南芥中發現了一個Anamorsin家族的蛋白質並命名為AtAnamorsin1。氧化脅迫會造成一些氧化還原敏感蛋白質的活性巰基的氧化修飾，AtAnamorsin1就是其中之一。Anamorsin（CIAPIN1）最初在哺乳動物中作為一種抑制細胞凋亡的蛋白質被發現。這一蛋白質家族中的某些成員已被發現參與調控了細胞凋亡，細胞增殖，癌症的發生和氧化脅迫的應答。然而，人們對Anamorsin蛋白質家族參與這些生物學過程的分子機制仍然所知甚少。Anamorsin1基因的表達會受到很多生物和非生物脅迫的誘導。它的敲除會造成植物在胚胎期死亡。我們的初步實驗結果表明，AtAnamorsin1可能通過自身的氧化還原變化感應細胞內的氧化還原狀態，從而調控下游的效應分子。 這項研究計劃的主要目的是通過應用多學科技術手段研究AtAnamorsin1的細胞學和生理學功能。我們將研究AtAnamorsin1在各種生理條件下的氧化還原狀態，並揭示其氧化還原狀態是否決定了它的亞細胞定位和功能。我們還將檢驗是否AtAnamorsin1是一個AdoMet甲基轉移酶，通過對核酸或蛋白質底物的修飾，調控效應基因的轉錄。除此以外，我們將應用分子遺傳學手段和顯微鏡技術揭示AtAnamorsin1在胚胎發育和脅迫應答中所起的作用。這項研究不僅將闡明AtAnamorsin1發揮功能的機制，還將為研究Anamorsin蛋白質家族其他成員的功能提供新思路和新視角。

261910.label: Realisation of objectives
261910.value: AtANA1 was identified as one of redox-sensitive proteins that underwent oxidative modification in Arabidopsis cells subjected to the treatment of hydrogen peroxide. The proposed study aimed to achieve six objectives to further understand the function of AtANA1. All these objectives have been completely or nearly completely addressed. 1. Redox states of AtANA1 under variety of redox-perturbation physiological treatments will be determined. Using transgenic plants expressing AtANA1 fusion with FLAG, the redox states of AtANA1-FLAG was studied in the transgenic lines subjected to redox-perturbation treatments through immune-precipitation and protein gel mobility shift assay. AtANA1 was found to become oxidized under salicylate and flg22 treatments. 2. Subcellular localization of AtANA1 will be investigated and the relationship between AtANA1 redox states and its localization and functioning under stressed physiological conditions will be revealed. To determine AtANA1 subcellular localization, transgenic Arabidopsis plants were generated that express AtANA1 fused with GFP. AtANA1-GFP localization was examined in the transgenic plants under normal and oxidatively-stressed conditions. The fusion protein was found to be localized in the cytosol and in particles which could be polyribosomes. 3. Zinc-binding assay will be carried out to determine whether AtANA1 is zinc-binding protein. AtANA1 was expressed in and purified from E. coli. The purified protein was used for its zinc-binding assay. No zinc binding has been detected. 4. Yeast two hybrid screen and the co-immunoprecipitation method will be used to identify AtANA1-interating protein(s) or components of any AtANA1-containing protein complex. Whether the zinc-ribbon domain is involved in protein-protein interaction will be examined. Transgenic plants expressing AtANA1-FLAG were used in the co-IP assay to identify interacting proteins. Several pulled-down proteins are under further analysis. The yeast two-hybrid screen has so far failed in identifying promising candidates. 5. Enzymatic assays will be performed to determine whether AtANA1 possesses an AdoMet methyltransferase activity and, if so, what is its possible physiological substrate. AtANA1 expressed in and purified from E. coli was used to determine whether it possesses an AdoMet methyltransferase activity. 6. Phenotypes resulted from loss-of- and gain-of-function mutations of AtANA1 will be characterized in details to unravel the role of AtANA1 in physiological responses and developmental processes. Two T-DNA insertion lines of AtANA1 were obtained. In addition, transgenic plants carrying an AtANA1 overexpression construct were generated. These lines were observed for any discernible phenotype. AtANA1 was also subjected to site-directed mutagenesis. The mutagenized versions were transformed into the Atana1 mutant in the aim of finding a weak mutant allele of AtANA1.

261910.label: Major findings and research outcome
261910.value: 1. Through a protein gel mobility shift assay which separates reduced and oxidized proteins, it was found that multiple cysteine residues in AtANA1 underwent oxidative modifications in Arabidopsis plants subjected to salicylate and flg22 treatments, two plant defense inducers that are known to cause perturbation of redox homeostasis. The results suggest that AtANA1 plays a role in the plant immune response likely through altering its redox states which is expected to alter its activity. 2. AtANA1 contains a putative zinc-binding domain and shares a limited sequence similarity to some AdoMed methyltransferases. AtANA1 was expressed in and purified from E. coli. However, the purified AtaANA1 did not exhibit an AdoMet methyltransferase activity. Neither did it show zinc binding. However, the negative results could be because the E. coli-expressed protein is inactive due to improper folding or other heterologous expression-related issues. Transgenic plants expressing AtANA1-FLAG has been used to purify the fusion proteins from plants which could be used for the enzymatic and zinc-binding assays. 3. Through a co-IP assay, several ribosomal proteins were pulled-down together with AtANA1. In addition, AtANA1-GFP was found to be associated with some cellular structures which could be polyribosomes. These results raise a possibility that AtANA1 could be involved in regulating protein synthesis in response to oxidative stress. 4. Two atana1 mutant alleles have been obtained (ana1-1 and ana1-2). Both mutations are caused by T-DNA insertion. The ana1 mutation causes embryonic lethality, demonstrating that ANA1 is essential for embryogenesis. The lethality, however, makes it difficult to obtain a homozygous mutant line for analyzing the function of AtANA1 in physiological responses. It appears that the ana1 mutant embryo development was arrested after the first division of the zygotes. The apical cell was found to be enlarged but did continue cell division. Further analysis is under way to determine whether the apical cell undergoes nuclear division but not cytokinesis. 5. The ana1 mutation also causes abortion of some male and female gametophytes. Interestingly, it was found that ANA1-carrying male gametophytes from ANA1/ana1 plants (which produce both ana1 and ANA1 male gametophytes in the same pollen sac) also underwent abortion. The result suggests that the aborting ana1 gametophytes might release a ‘death promoting factor’ which can also trigger wildtype pollen to undergo programmed cell death.

261910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
261910.value: Thiols of multiple cysteines in AtANA1 are sensitive to oxidation under oxidative stresses, including to the inducers of plant immunity, indicating its role in the stress responses. Its role in embryogenesis and gametogenesis further reveals that it is also important in various developmental processes. Its loss of function mutation apparently causes gametophytes and developing embryos to undergo programmed cell death. Despite the importance of AtANA1 in the biological and physiological processes, its precise molecular, biochemical, and biological functions remain to be further defined. AtANA1 purified from plants could be a good source of the protein for characterization of its biochemical and molecular function. For unraveling its biological function, one approach that will be taken in future is to generate weak alleles that do not lead to lethality but show some levels of defects, which will allow us to obtain a homozygous mutant of such an allele for functional characterization. Our previous attempt to generate mutant alleles through site-directed mutagenesis was not found to be an effective approach for this purpose. We are going to use some newly developed techniques, such as the Cas9-based genome editing method, to generate various ana1 mutant alleles for further characterization.

262210.label: Project Objectives
262210.value: The first objective is to investigate the enhancement effects of NR2B specific siRNAs on the key effectors of the Akt and Ras-ERK-CREB pro-survival pathways using Western blot analyses. In addition, the inhibitory effects of NR2B siRNAs on pro-apoptotic pathways will also be confirmed. The second objective is to investigate the effects of NR2B siRNA on Ca2+ ion influx through the NMDA receptors into the neurons. Patch-clamp analysis of the Ca2+ currents through the NMDA will be performed to provide the change in Ca2+ ion influx. In addition, Ca2+ imaging in live neurons will also be performed. The third objective is to investigate the changes in subcellular localization of the NR2B subunit after the siRNA treatments within the context of synaptic versus extra-synaptic sites by pre-embedding and post-embedding immuno-electron microscopy. Since extra-synaptic NMDA receptors mediate cell death mechanisms mainly composed of NR2B subunits, our siRNA treatments could functionally reduce the detrimental extra-synaptic NMDA receptors. The immuno-EM analyses will fully prove this point.

262210.value: The enhancement effects of NR2B specific siRNAs on the key effectors of the Akt and Ras-ERK-CREB pro-survival pathways using Western blot analyses have been accomplished. In addition, the inhibitory effects of NR2B siRNAs on pro-apoptotic pathways has been confirmed. The effects of NR2B siRNA on Ca2+ ion influx through the NMDA receptors into the neurons has been demonstrated. Patch-clamp analysis of the Ca2+ currents through the NMDA has been performed to provide the change in Ca2+ ion influx. In addition, Ca2+ imaging in live neurons has been performed. Despite we have found significant changes in cell death and cell signaling pathways after applications of Nr2B specific siRNA. However, there was lss change in the subcellular localization of the NR2B subunit after the siRNA treatments within the context of synaptic versus extra-synaptic sites as observed by pre-embedding and post-embedding immuno-electron microscopy. Since extra-synaptic NMDA receptors mediate cell death mechanisms mainly composed of NR2B subunits, our siRNA treatments should be functionally related to the reduction of the extra-synaptic NMDA receptors. Lack of changes of NR2B subunits at the subcellular levels may be due to he dynamic nature, and turn over and short half-life of the siRNA. These remain as major drawbacks in applications of siRNA in therapy. Because of these reasons, we have further developed an combination of nanoscience with molecular biology in enhancement of the gene silencing effects. We have developed a gold nanoparticle-conjugated NR2B siRNA specific complexes in application of gene silencing effects. We have confirmed the application of gold nanoparticle-siRNA conjugated complex has significantly increases the gene silencing effects up to about two-fold in cells. These findings have proven the application of nanoscience in neuroscience.

262210.label: Major findings and research outcome
262210.value: In the present study, N-methyl-D-aspartate Receptor Two B (NR2B) specific siRNA was applied in the parkinsonian models. Our previous results showed that reduction in expression of N-methyl-D-aspartate Receptor One (NR1) by antisense oligos, the key subunit of NMDARs, ameliorated the motor symptoms in 6-hydroxydopamine-lesioned rat, an animal model of Parkinson’s disease (PD) . In order to further investigate the efficacy of gene silencing, siRNA specific for NR2B subunit, was designed and administrated in the striatum of 6-hydroxydopamine (6-OHDA)-lesioned rats. The present results showed that administration of NR2B specific siRNA decreased the number of apomorphine-induced rotation in the lesioned rats. Moreover, there was significant reduction in NR2B proteins levels after NR2B specific siRNA administration. Furthermore, attenuation in loss of dopaminergic neurons was found in both striatal and substantia nigra region of the 6-OHDA-lesioned rats that had been continuous infused siRNA for seven days. On the other hand, a significant up-regulation of p-p44/42 MAPK (ERK1/2) (Thr202/Tyr204) and p-CREB (Ser133) in striatal neurons was found. These results form a basis for applying gene silencing targeting NR2B as a potential treatment of PD, also revealed the possibility of the NR2B specific siRNA to be involved in pro-survival pathway. In order to enhance the RNA interference effects which has a great potential in biomedical therapeutic applications and is suggested to be a valuable tool for gene therapy. Due to the instable nature of the RNA molecules and the absence of on-target effective delivery vehicle, we have then developed a specific, biocompatible and non-viral vector raise a pressing need to achieve a promising efficacy and clinical importance in therapeutic approach. We have demonstrated a NR2B specific siRNA delivery with a newly designed nanocarrier. A specific size of the gold nanoparticle with polyethylene glycols coating showed a significant reduced expression of the NR2B protein, which is well-known to mediate the excitotoxicity and cell deaths in the aforementioned neurodegenerative diseases. The potency of this new nanoparticle-based delivery in down-regulating the gene has exhibited a great improvement for future application of the RNAi technology.

262210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
262210.value: Findings in the present project has opened up a new insight in applying gene silencing strategies in reaching therapeutic effects on neurodegeneration. We have first demonstrated the efficacy of NR2B specific siRNA in prevention of dopamine neuronal cell death in rat model of Parkinson's disease. Mechanistic data have been obtained and we have confirmed that the functions of the cell death prevention of NR2B siRNA is mediated through MAPK pathways. We then further develop a gold nanoparticle-NR2B-siRNA nanocarrier in enhancement of the NR2B siRNA gene silencing effects. The conclusions are with the application of nanocarriers, we have confidence that the gene silencing effects can be further proven in animal models in the near future. Further research using nanocarrier will be carried out.

262210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
262210.value: Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases affect both young and elderly patients and these diseases have created a great burden to patients and families, and to the society. There are no ultimate cure at present. In the present research, we have developed a potential drug therapy using molecular medicine and gene therapy. We have confirmed the efficacy of the gene silencing agents can reduce the cell death of dopamine neurons in the brain. This is a good indication it can prevent and potentially treat Parkinson's disease. In addition, we have then developed a nanocarrier to further enhance the efficiency of the gene silencing effects. The efficiency has been found to increase at least two-fold. These approaches are proven by our work to have potential in future drug delivery.

340010.label: Project Objectives
340010.value: To complete, by December 2013, a six-chapter single-authored study or five scholarly articles (to be submitted to top-ranking peer-reviewed journals)on contemporary collaborative painting and drawing, focussing on works by the three above-mentioned artist-groups. To theorise the relationships between the works in question and relevant historical, socio-political, cultural and artistic contexts. These contexts include: the histories of individual and collective production of art and craft objects, and changing definitions of the artist/craftsperson, within the relevant cultural traditions; a late-modern Western tendency to demystify art and problematise “lone genius” notions of the artist; the rise of the ‘networked society’ and globally-networked social movements; the recent prevalence of diasporic and/or culturally-hybrid forms and styles of art; the values and practices that govern international art exhibitions, institutions and markets. To identify the range of work processes employed by the collaborating artists in question, their stated motivations for working in that way, and to assess the aesthetic and semantic contribution that any visual evidence of these collaborative processes makes to the paintings and drawings thus produced.

340010.label: Realisation of objectives
340010.value: The second and third objectives have been met, and the research for the book is complete. However, the completion of the manuscript will take a further 5-6 months. One solo-authored has been accepted for publication by the International Journal of Art and Design Education and a jointly- authored article has been published in Pedagogy, Society and Culture (see Part C). The first objective listed above - to publish either 5 articles or a book - has therefore not yet been fully met. One reason for this under-achievement is that I was unable to work at normal capacity for a large part of the period of teaching relief because I suffered a severe illness which led to major surgery and a period of recuperation. In recognition of this difficulty, Lingnan University approved the revised project completion date of 30/6/14. However, I have not yet completed the manuscript. The ‘other outputs’ that I refer to in Part C – exhibitions, two pedagogy/ creative publications and two related videos -- were informed by, and have informed, my theoretical research on collaborative painting, drawing and pedagogy. They have facilitated knowledge transfer between the ‘academy’, students, artists, and the broader community. Valuable as these activities have been, they were not slated as its objectives. They have entailed a considerable time commitment -- more than I had foreseen -- and this is time that could otherwise have been spent on the manuscript completion. In the present context then they must be viewed as factors that contributed to the delay of the manuscript. A single-minded focus is the best way to proceed at the present juncture.
