444210.label: Major findings and research outcome
444210.value: Study 1 revealed that, after controlling for actual affect, Hong Kong Chinese valued low arousal positive states (LAP; e.g. calm, relaxation) more than high arousal positive states (HAP; e.g. excitement, enthusiasm) across the three age groups. Older adults valued both HAP and LAP less, and reported a smaller discrepancy between ideal and actual affect, than did the middle-aged adults and younger adults. In addition, after controlling for the demographics and physical health, the ideal-actual discrepancy accounted for subjective well-being but not depression among older adults; subjective well-being and interpersonal depression among middle-aged adults; and emotional depression but not subjective well-being among younger adults (Outputs #1, 2, 6). Regarding conceptions of mental health, younger adults considered HAP to be significantly better than did middle aged and older adults. Moreover, middle-aged adults considered high arousal negative states (HAN; e.g. anger) unhealthier than did younger and older adults. For low arousal negative states (LAN), younger adults considered them to be unhealthier than did middle aged and older adults (Outputs #1, 2). . In Study 2, we found that Time 1 (T1) ideal HAP significantly predicted Time 2 (T2) actual HAP, and the magnitude of this correlation was greater in older adults than in younger adults. T1 ideal LAP significantly predicted T2 actual LAP, and T1 actual LAP also predicted T2 ideal LAP. The magnitude of these correlations slightly decreased among participants older than the age of 40. Furthermore, we examined the sequential effects of actual affect on ideal affect. Our results only showed that actual HAN at T1 predicted ideal LAP at T2. We did not find age differences in the effects of actual HAN on ideal LAP (Output #3). In Study 3, we manipulated future time perspective (FTP) and then examined the effects of FTP and age on individuals’ preferences of LAP or HAP health-related choices. Results suggested that expanded future time made people more likely to choose HAP options, regardless of age. Conversely, limited future time led to a higher preference for LAP options, regardless of age (Output #6). Data obtained from the above three studies were compared with data obtained from European-Americans and Chinese-Americans. Results revealed that age and cultural differences in mixed emotions (the correlation between positive and negative actual affect; Output #3), views of aging, life satisfaction (Output #4) and leadership styles (Output#5) were all at least partially accounted for by ideal affect.

444210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
444210.value: The major contribution of this line of research lies in showing that it is the emotion that people ideally want to feel (i.e. ideal affect), rather than more structural socio-psychological factors, that explains age differences in emotional experience, health-related choices, life satisfaction and views of aging across cultures. Future studies should follow this up by examining whether some mental health problems (such as depression) and some intergenerational or inter-cultural conflicts, can be reduced by changing ideal affect. In addition, findings from Study 3 suggested that future time perspective predicted individuals’ preferences on LAP or HAP health-related choices. Future studies should further examine the role of future time perspective in other age-related meaningful life outcomes such as risk-taking in various life domains.

444210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
444210.value: The research project used survey, multiple phone-callings in a week and quasi-experiment method to examine whether ideal affect varied by age across cultures, and the potential causes and outcomes of age differences in ideal affect. The study recruited younger, middle-aged and older Hong Kong Chinese, and compared their data with comparable data from European Americans and Chinese Americans. Our results revealed that there were age differences in individuals’ value on positive affect, discrepancy between their ideal and actual affect, and their conceptions on mental health. These results suggested that older European Americans were less satisfied and held more negative views of old age than did older Chinese Americans and Hong Kong Chinese, in part because they valued high arousal positive affect (such as excitement) more. Furthermore, future time perspective (the perception of time in future) might be a potential cause of age differences in ideal affect, and it predicted preferences for some health-related options. Findings from the studies advance our scientific understanding of emotion across the adulthood. Since ideal affect can be construed as the ultimate emotional goal, our findings of age differnces in ideal affect across cultures can help to differentiate the universal from the culturally specific aspects of socioemotional aging.

444410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
444410.value: This research aims to analyze the narratives of thirty Mississippi World War II veterans of Chinese ancestry in order to understand their military participation and how their service affected them as “new” citizens in the American South. With origins in Southern China’s Pearl River Delta (i.e., Taishan, Hoi Ping, Xinhui, Guangzhou) and Hong Kong, these men of the Chinese diaspora eventually settled in the Mississippi Delta. For until the 1980s, Mississippi was the Southern state with the largest Chinese population. As new immigrants, they volunteered or were drafted by the U.S. government to serve alongside other military personnel, the majority of whom were Caucasians (African-American soldiers were often segregated into their own units). In the analysis of the narratives, the researchers will trace the draft/induction, service, and discharge experiences of the veterans. The most in-depth examination of the stories will focus on analyzing major themes and topic areas that surface in the storytellers’ words: coming to America and working in Chinese grocery stores in the Delta; draft, induction, and basic training experiences; shipping out; military ranks and duties; war stories/key military events (i.e., the European and Asian theatres, major invasions, close calls, down time, injuries, prisoner of war life, weather/storms, fear, duty/patriotism, liberation); interactions with generals and celebrities (i.e., George Patton, Douglas McArthur, Bob Hope, and Irving Berlin); ethnicity (co-existence of Chinese and other military personnel, prejudice, camaraderie, being Chinese Americans vs. being Japanese Americans; being Chinese American servicemen in the Asian theatre where other Asians were either friend or foe); family (parent and sibling incidents during the war, marriage and immigration after the war, silence about their service to children and local community members); homecoming; post-war significance of military service (i.e., education and the GI Bill, citizenship, missed opportunities and unfulfilled dreams); and the importance of faith. By examining these themes and topics, the researchers will explore the Mississippi Chinese veterans’ wartime contributions as well as the tangible and abstract effects their service had on them and their families. As a consequence of this analytical study of this specific cultural group, the researchers will also attempt to look beyond the Mississippi Chinese community, contextualizing their experiences in a broader perspective (e.g., to consider how their educational and social background compares to Mississippi African-Americans, to examine how storytelling and recall may differ among same and different groups within the state and different regions of the U.S.). 本研究旨在分析美國南部密西西比州三十位華裔二戰老兵的故事，藉以了解他們服役的經歷，並探討他們身為「新公民」因此而受到什麼影響。 老兵們祖籍南中國珠江三角洲（即台山、開平、新會、廣州等）及香港等地，漂洋過海，輾轉流徙至美國南部密西西比三角洲一帶。上世紀八十年代以前，密西西比是美國南部最多華人聚居的州份。二戰期間，這些華裔老兵有的志願參軍，有的被美國政府徵召入伍。他們以新移民的身份與其他軍事人員同為美國政府效命。軍中的同袍大部分是白種人，非洲裔士兵都被編入獨立的師團。 是次研究將深入探討這些老兵的故事，勾勒他們被徵召入伍的過程、其軍旅生活，及退役歸家等經歷。研究的重點，是仔細分析從老兵自述所歸納得來的共同經歷，主題包括：留美到中式雜貨店打工；被徵召入伍、接受基本軍事訓練和被派往海外執勤的遭遇；軍階及職務；戰時經歷及軍中重要事件（如：歐亞戰區的戰事、主要攻防戰、生死關頭、值勤以外的時間、傷患困擾、戰俘生涯、天氣/風暴、恐懼、責任感/愛國心、戰事結束和平解放）；與軍中將領及名人交往（如：巴頓將軍、麥克阿瑟將軍、著名笑匠卜合和著名作曲家Irving Berlin等）；種族問題（華裔士兵與其他軍事人員共同工作的情況、對華裔士兵的偏見、士兵之間的兄弟情誼、美籍華裔士兵與美籍日裔士兵、美籍華裔士兵於亞洲戰場上敵友難分的困局）；家庭（戰時父母及子女的遭遇、戰後婚姻及遷移、對戰時經歷三緘其口）；歸國；戰後協助退役軍人重投社會的服務（即：教育及退役軍人權利法案、公民權、錯失機會和理想落空的無奈）；及信仰的重要。 通過研究這些華裔二戰老兵的故事，有助了解他們戰時的貢獻，探究他們和家人的生活如何因服役而有所改變。此外，以特定社群為對象的研究，可由此延伸至密西西比州華裔群體以外，把華裔老兵的經歷放置於更廣闊的層面和背景討論（如：比較美籍華裔與美籍非洲裔人士的教育和社會背景；研究在美國相同/不同州份的相同/不同群體，對昔日二戰的回憶和描述有何不同之處）。

444410.label: Major findings and research outcome
444410.value: Researching archives and related military records, I have identified 157 Mississippi Chinese World War II veterans. Of these, I have been able to locate and interview 24. The interviews have been analyzed and prepared for use as primary research data. Transcriptions and sub-titled recordings have been completed, enabling researchers and interested others to see and hear the voices of a group of veterans from this cohort of the greatest generation. The primary materials have been prepared as a book, and a publisher is now being sought.

Second, a documentary is planned, using the extensive material in the first book as well as from the sub-titled film.

444410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
444410.value: Voices of the Diaspora: Mississippi Chinese World War II Veterans Tell Their Stories fills a gap in the extant research on the specific World War II “cohort generation” of the Chinese diaspora in the Mississippi Delta. To achieve this purpose, my team and I researched archives and data bases, brainstormed with friends and families in the Mississippi Chinese community, as well as wrote and phoned local, state, and federal agencies to develop as comprehensive a list of Mississippi Chinese World War II veterans as possible. We eventually verified 157 names and interviewed 24 of them. The research data has resulted in the book, divided into three major parts. Part I focuses on the search for Mississippi Chinese who served in the military in the Second World War. Part II showcases 24 veterans’ profiles and their wartime stories. To conclude, Part III presents a roll call of the 157 Mississippi Chinese veterans identified in military records and online sources. This research sheds light on these particular veterans of Chinese ancestry who served in the American military in the Second World War; in addition, the data reveals much about the social, cultural, and political context at that time in the American South.

444510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
444510.value: This proposed project builds on an existing GRF project, Everyday Aesthetics in Hong Kong Camera Phone Use that is due to end in December 2010. The original project is well underway, having substantially expanded the database of the original Pilot Project and having developed a more interactive database, linking images from a Project website, a Facebook group, and blogsites with questionnaire responses and analysis. Detailed interviews and image analysis is being undertaken to establish intricate micro-level patterns of usage and aesthetic innovation in camera phone usage. However, the focus on camera phone images alone has revealed two further areas in need of research; firstly, the necessity consider more widely digital photography and the history of vernacular photography, snapshots and family photographs in Hong Kong and Asia within the expansion of User-Created Content – an area quite neglected in the global attention to UCC - and secondly, the necessity to take into consideration more recent technological developments and especially the rapid increase of 3G and 3.5G mobile phone use in Hong Kong (less than 25% of total use at the beginning of this study, now approaching 40%) and the impact of these developments on the status of the image itself. The new 3G camera phones, as converged digital data devices continuously connected to the Internet, not only resemble and rival consumer digital cameras but they also increasingly deploy what we might call ‘machinic aesthetics’, actively directing users’ compositional choices, marketed in highly affective ways (“smile tracking’ and ‘smile capture”, ‘face optimization’, ‘skin beautification’ etc). The increasingly blurred lines between amateur and professional practices underlines a major historical development so far not widely investigated in current repurposing of industrial spaces in Hong Kong as part of creative industries expansion – the shift in photography device production to Asia, initially to Japan in the pre-war period, then to Hong Kong in the post-war period, (production of cheap plastic cameras - the Diana, the Holga – as precursors to now ubiquitous low resolution camera phone pictures) and to the mainland since the 1970s. This research builds on the ethnographic methods of the earlier study, combined with a technocultural research approach incorporating visual research and art historical methodologies, and aspects of political economy, to map the emergence of ubiquitous image production in the city since the 1970s and 1980s and to consider self-fashioning and self-image production within developments of democracy and modernity in Hong Kong and China.. 444610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
444610.value: The aim of this project is to investigate and document architectural design in Hong Kong from the 1950s to 1970s. Living and working in Hong Kong, we can easily see a big difference between buildings built in the middle of the last century and those built in recent years. From a professional point of view, we appreciate old buildings more than new ones for the simple reason that they usually have a better design. It seems that these old buildings were designed with a very different set of sensibilities, attitudes, principles and know-how, which can hardly been seen in today’s buildings. This phenomenon has evoked enough curiosity to conduct formal research. The period from the 1950s to 1970s was an important phase in Hong Kong’s modern history. It was a period of economic boom and fast development in building construction and urban expansion. Most of the old buildings we see today are from this period. In that period, the architects’ professional body consisted mainly of two parts, foreign architects as the majority and the growth of Chinese architects due to the participation of a large number of migrant Chinese architects from the Mainland. Therefore, the study will look into a special group of architects and their works. We are interested to find out, through this project, who these architects were, what their educational backgrounds were, in what professional and social contexts they worked, what their design attitudes were, what buildings they designed, and most importantly why this great design tradition has been lost today. These questions can be answered through case studies of selected single building events and topical studies of selected building types. It combines design analysis with historical and theoretical study. The research aims at four monographs following the previous two completed studies, plus exhibitions, papers, articles, and a web database as by-products. By recording an important period in Hong Kong’s architectural history, this study will provide a special perspective to the design achievements of Hong Kong’s modern architecture, bridge a research gap in the study of Hong Kong’s architecture by providing rigorously documented visual evidence and meet the urgent need for documentation of superficially unremarkable buildings before they are demolished. 此項計劃的目的是調查和紀錄香港1950至1970年代的建築設計。在香港居住和工作的人大概很容易發現香港上個世紀中的建築和現在的建築很不一樣。從專業角度來說，我們欣賞老建築更甚於新建築，原因就是老建築的設計更加優秀。這些老建築中所體現出的設計的感覺、態度、原則和技巧已經很難在現在的建築中看到。這個現象促使我們對那個時期的建築作深入的研究。1950 至1970年代在香港的歷史上是一個很重要的時期。蓬勃的經濟帶動了建築和城市的飛速發展。今天我們所見的老建築基本上都是那個時期所建。其時香港的建築師主要由兩部份所組成，為主的是西方建築師，同時華人建築師的力量也因大陸移民建築師的加入而急速擴大。所以此項研究將重點了解特定的建築師人群，以及他們的作品。他們究竟是誰？他們具有甚麼樣的教育背景？他們在甚麼樣的專業和社會環境中工作？他們的設計態度是甚麼？他們設計了哪些建築？最重要的是，為甚麼這些建築所體現的建築設計傳統中斷了？這些問題可以通過對單一的建築事件以及單一的建築類型的深入研究得到答案。這是一個涉及歷史、理論和設計分析的研究。在前面已經完成的兩個案例研究的基礎上，本研究的目的是再完成四項專題或案例研究，以及相關的展覽、文章及網頁。本項研究通過案例研究的方法為了解香港的現代建築成就提供一個的特殊視角，通過對圖紙資料的重繪和整理填補香港建築歷史研究的空白，以及為那些將要被拆除的、不知名的優秀建築留下一份珍貴的文獻資料。

444610.label: Realisation of objectives
444610.value: The main objectives of this project are to obtain in-depth knowledge about Hong Kong's modern architecture through a case study approach, to provide accurate and detailed records on selected buildings in drawings, pictures and words, to promote the design achievements of Hong Kong's modern architecture via publications, exhibitions and other means of dissemination, and to use the research findings as a reference for a critical reflection on current architectural design in Hong Kong. These objectives have been mostly realised in different forms of production. We have conducted more than 20 case studies of different building types from public building to public housing and scales from single small building to large building complex. The selection is made based on a broad survey of buildings from the 1940s to the 1980s. About 800 buildings are collected and organised into a database. These buildings are selected based on their significance in the history of Hong Kong modern architecture or their unique design qualities. For each case study, we adopted a method of literature study, site visit, drawing production, and documentation. Buildings were recorded in precise CAD drawings, in some cases, also in 3D models, as well as in photographs. Basic data are collected from archives and publications. We use documentation as a primary means to organise research materials and to reveal the design quality of the selected building. These research findings are further reported and disseminated through various means such as exhibition, journal paper, and lectures. We also use these research findings as a reference for critical reflections on contemporary architectural practice in Hong Kong mainly in relation to the debate on the conservation of several significant historical buildings such as Central Market, the formal Central Government Offices, and formal Hollywood Road Police Married Quarters. Our research has provided crucial professional and academic knowledge for both the general pubic and the government to understand the design value of these buildings. We are not successful in further developing some of the documentations into books. We have started to work on two books, one about Police Housing Program in the 1950s and 1960s, and the other about modern buildings in Central area based on the exhibition booklet “The Greatest Form has no Shape” in 2011. But, these two books are still underdevelopment, partly due to the difficulty to find a publisher and partly due to time management.

444610.label: Major findings and research outcome
444610.value: When this project was originally proposed, we had an essential question in mind: how to judge the design quality of Hong Kong’s modern architecture around 1960s? We couldn’t give a clear answer that time as we didn't have enough materials to make a statement. However, with about 800 buildings recorded and more than 20 selected for documentation and analysis, we could say firmly that the design quality of Hong Kong’s modern architecture is at a very high level and comparable to any key buildings in the world from the same period. Hong Kong architects developed design solutions for Hong Kong’s particular social, economic and geographic conditions so to hold an unique position within a large picture of world modern architecture. The main research outcome from this study is a collection of “Documentation of Hong Kong Modern Architecture”. With this report, we submit 8 documentations. Except the one on Central Market, six are public housing estates (refer to the list in Part C). One is a collection of 5 single buildings. The unfinished book on Central will cover formal 7 buildings (Central Government Offices, City Hall, Start Ferry, Queen’s Pier, Car Park next to City Hall, Bridges Street Market, and Bishop Hoare memorial Building), which are not included in documentation. We also submit a documentation on the current state of the database. These documentations can be further developed into several products. One is book publication. We planned to produce two books. One is a book on old police housing project which we have been working on for about 10 years and always under development. And the other one is on modern architecture in Central area, which is based on the exhibition in 2011. Chinese University Press showed a great interest about 2 books but no financial support. We also contacted the Joint Publisher but their interest is more on social aspect, not pure architecture. Other forms of dissemination include exhibition, journal paper and lectures. We made an exhibition on three exemplary buildings in Central—Central Market, the former Central Government Offices, and Hollywood Road Police Married Quarters—under the title “the Greatest Forms has no Shape”. One journal paper on public housing published in core academic journal “Time+Architecture”. Besides, five M.Phil students were trained through this project. We also delivered quite number of lectures on various occasions and our studies were reported in local magazines and newspapers.

444610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
444610.value: The project in its nature can be seen as a basic study on Hong Kong modern architecture — to obtain first hand materials about selected key buildings from that period. There is no this type of basic research on modern buildings done before. These research findings can be further developed for several possibilities. 1, Future grant applications The PI has already submitted a GRF proposal for a comprehensive study on Hong Kong public housing design. The proposed research will focus on issues such as site, outdoor space, circulation, unit, and facade, based up on materials from case studies. Another funding possibility is a comprehensive study on the design characteristics of Hong Kong modern architecture, which will be largely based on the database we have developed. 2, Publication possibilities and other means of dissemination We are still working on the two books mentioned before, even though we failed to deliver them for this final report deadline. We also look for opportunities to convert other documentations into book publication. One recent development is the discussion with Hulu Culture on a joint project to publish a book on So Uk Estate. There are other possibilities for exhibitions, journal papers and lectures.

444610.value: The aim of this project is to investigate and document architectural design in Hong Kong from the 1950s to 1970s, which has never been studies before. Its objective are to obtain in-depth knowledge about Hong Kong's modern architecture through a case study approach, to provide accurate and detailed records on selected buildings in drawings, pictures and words, to promote the design achievements of Hong Kong's modern architecture via publications, exhibitions and other means of dissemination, and to use the research findings as a reference for a critical reflection on current architectural design in Hong Kong. The research findings from this project provide solid graphic evidences to support an argument that Hong Kong’s modern architecture showed a very high level compared to other regions in the world that time. More than that, Hong Kong architects developed design solutions for Hong Kong’s particular social, economic and geographic conditions so as to hold an unique position within a large picture of world modern architecture.

444810.label: Project Title(Chinese)
444810.value: 文學與哲學中的現代自我

444810.label: Project Objectives
444810.value: explore in close detail a number of major representations of the self in Romantic and post-Romantic poetry and philosophy argue that collectively these representations fall into two groups or models of which one has been more influential but possibly also more damaging for us than the other explore the kinds of value that the study of poetry and philosophy, the key humanities disciplines, still have for us today, including in Hong Kong consider the question and possible characteristics of a "modern self"
rows: explore in close detail a number of major representations of the self in Romantic and post-Romantic poetry and philosophy
argue that collectively these representations fall into two groups or models of which one has been more influential but possibly also more damaging for us than the other
explore the kinds of value that the study of poetry and philosophy, the key humanities disciplines, still have for us today, including in Hong Kong
consider the question and possible characteristics of a "modern self"

444810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
444810.value: In summary, this research will --set out and critically assess two models of the modern Western self as represented in poetry* and philosophy since the Romantic era (1780s) --argue that the more influential of these models has, contrary to appearances, been inimical to our well-being, and not just in the "West", while the less influential one has been restorative of it --undertake this assessment by means of a careful engagement with a limited number of key texts and passages from major authors so that the non-specialist reader can see how the argument is derived from the examples --argue that, seen in this way, poetry and philosophy remain the core Humanities disciplines, and the key evaluative practices of Western thought-in-language (which is also important for the Humanities in Hong Kong) [*Note: “poetry” here includes novel, drama, etc., ie what we nowadays call “literature”, since philosophy too is a kind of “literature”.] This research will complete the project begun by the author with his earlier book on models of the pre-modern self. Tentative conclusions remaining to be tested in the new research are that we tend to think of ourselves EITHER as autonomous self-generating centres of will, decision, reason, choice, and ideology, surrounded by messy, distracting emotions, memories, desires, the competing demands of others, and the claims of our own traditions: OR as actually constituted by those desires, memories and traditions, and by others, so that it doesn't make sense to talk of a truly autonomous self at all. In the post-Romantic and post-Christian West we have spent two hundred years eroding the key constituent of the first model: but have we filled the empty space with a conceptual quasi-God? These are issues often addressed by social scientists, who analyse their material empirically, “from the outside”. But light can also be shed on such questions by studying the work of philosophers and poets, especially in conjunction with each other. These are the two oldest and richest forms of language thought in the West, and their practitioners reveal more about how we think about the self than anyone else, because they are relying on and developing models of it “from the inside” in their work: conceptual models in the case of philosophers, metaphorical ones in the case of poets. They actually enact the models of the self they work with. We in turn experience those models in reading them. 1(d)項目摘要 概而言之，該項目將完成下述各項研究任務：  確立自浪漫主義時期（1780年代）以來，文學∗與哲學中所表現的兩種西方現代“自我”範型，並予以詳盡評論；  論證與表面現象相反：有較大影響力的範型不利於人類的健全發展，而較小影響力的範型則有助於恢復這一發展；  在評述過程中細繹經典作者的少量代表性文本和章節，從而使一般讀者能夠領會如何從例證中得出論據。 作者早先一部專著討論的是前現代“自我”範型，該項目是這一研究的繼續。嘗試性得出的結論，在新的研究項目中有待進一步檢驗，即我們對“自我”往往持有兩種傾向：我們或者將“自我”當作一種意志、行動、判斷、選擇和思想的自在自為的中心，四周充斥了混亂不安的情感、記憶、欲望，以及他者的生存壓力和傳統的籲求；或者把它當作事實上是由這些欲望、記憶、傳統和他者所共同建構的東西，因而討論一個真實的、自在的“自我”其實毫無意義。在後浪漫主義和後基督教西方世界，我們花了兩百年的時間來削弱前一個範型的主要構成因素，然而，我們是否已建立起一個觀念上的“類神”來填補這個真空尚有待討論。 社會科學家經常討論這些問題，他們以經驗主義的方式分析他們的材料，從而常常“從外部”處理這些問題。但是，通過研究哲學家和文學家的著作、尤其是通過將二者結合起來考查，同樣可以為這些問題找出答案。他們的著作包含了西方世界兩種最古老和最豐富的語言形式，對於如何思考“自我”這個問題，任何人都沒有他們揭示得更多。因為他們的著作“從內部”即倚賴並力圖發掘“自我”的範型：哲學家從觀念范式上著手，文學家從隱喻的角度出發。實際上，他們自己就扮演了他們探索的“自我”的角色，而反過來我們在閱讀時也在體驗那些範型。

444810.label: Realisation of objectives
444810.value: Objective 1. The number of writers had to be reduced from the original conception as explained above. This is not an under-achievement but a necessary reduction in scope given reduced funding. An 85,000-word monograph study of representations of the self in Wordsworth and Kant was almost entirely completed (except for publishers’ proof-reading processes etc) during the grant period, well under budget, and has since been published (August 2013). This represents a further 50,000 words since the last Annual Report. The depth of analysis required made the work on these two authors more time consuming than originally thought, which is why only two and not four authors have been considered at length (although many others and especially Burke and Rousseau have been considered more briefly). Early reviews are already appearing and the book has been nominated for a prize. In addition to the paper mentioned in the last Annual Report, a second conference paper, now an article, on the closely related theme of recognition in Hegel and Shakespeare, was delivered in December 2012 to the Australia New Zealand Shakespeare Association conference on “Shakespeare and Emotion”, University of Western Australia, and is being submitted for publication. This points toward a second monograph. The reason for the 90% figure rather than 100% is only that the original objective mentioned many more authors; this simply turned out to be impossible given the necessary rigour in investigating these two and the reduced funding. This was addressed however in the last Annual Report. Objective 2. The two authors mentioned above represent the romantic model of the self referred to in the Revised Objective, in one particular “redemptive” aspect. The monograph does indeed address, especially but not only in its Preface and Introduction, both the influential nature and the damaging effects for modernity of this model. Objective 3. Brief references were indeed made to this objective throughout the book, but especially on pages 1-35. Hong Kong is not explicitly mentioned but the clear implication is that the study of these writers and in particular of the redemptive aspect of their thought is essential not just in English-speaking or European-language but in any community. Objective 4: The monograph is sub-titled “the making of the post-Christian imagination”, and the book is full of references to the self. The index lists several page references to the modern self. The underlying theme of “redemption” is linked to an aspect of the modern self.

444810.label: Major findings and research outcome
444810.value: The project set out to explore major representations of the self in the Romantic period as the source of our modern picture. In its exploration of two hugely influential writers of the later 18th and earlier 19th centuries, Kant and Wordsworth, the principal research outcome of the project was an 85,000-word monograph. The major finding of the monograph/research was that a hidden notion or reflex of redemption, deriving originally from the Christian model but now secularized into various equivalents such as saving, cleansing, absolving and restoring, exerts a powerful continuing pressure on the way we think about ourselves. The two writers mentioned are themselves enormously influential in modern poetry and philosophy, and the way this hidden notion or set of notions operates in them can be taken as representative of the way it operates in many modern people. This model of redemption, according to the research/monograph, has several sub-divisions or modes: aesthetic, political, spontaneous. Each turns out to have a deep effect on the way we think of ourselves. At the same time an important part of the modern attitude to secular redemption is that it is mainly the preserve of writers themselves: ie, that we look to writers to redeem us from ourselves, where once we looked to God. The research has uncovered some major problems with this claim; in effect it turns out to be self-defeating. Poetry and philosophy do better if they don't try to replace religion. So the research has found that the modern self, at least in the West, has at its core a wish to redeem itself, especially through art and philosophy; but that the wish is self-defeating. As the book concludes, we have to find our “redemption” not in some solitary epiphany, but “in the messy, noisy richness, the obstinate community, of other lives”. The “nightmare of modernity” has been that “each of us faces the eternal silence alone”, whereas in fact “each of us, after all, lives, and lives now, and is survived by others who also live.” So these major Romantic writers got some important things wrong, and have left us with in some ways a damaged sense of self.

444810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
444810.value: As indicated in the original proposal, this is part of a much larger ongoing project, whose ultimate goal is to present a picture of the modern self in poetry and philosophy, and argue that this is the self most people in the West and also in many places elsewhere still live with in ordinary life. The research has been useful in setting the stage for this by reading the single most important modern philosopher and the major Romantic poet in English. I have already started another project under the same broad umbrella, by comparing Kant’s chief successor Hegel with the greatest of English language poets and dramatists, Shakespeare, so as to highlight what the modern self looks like by contrast with its predecessor. This will be a short monograph focusing on the important concept of recognition. Another development will be a similar work on T S Eliot and Wittgenstein. I hope to make progress with both over the next 2-3 years. I am currently planning to submit a grant proposal to help to make all this possible, with a slightly longer time-frame but a smaller budget, given my experience this time.

444810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
444810.value: This research grant has enabled me to write a substantial monograph. The book is about an important feature of how modern human beings think of themselves and their lives, not just in a broadly Western framework but more generally. The book uses as its material the work of two of the most influential of all modern writers, the English poet William Wordsworth and the German philosopher Immanuel Kant. It argues that they both (and by extension many others) feel that their lives need to be redeemed in some way, cleansed or restored. Once upon a time people who felt this would turn to religion; some still do. But these writers look to poetry and philosophy as the main tools to carry out this redemptive task. And yet in both cases they succeed inadvertently in showing that this is wrong: poetry and philosophy should not be thought of like this. This is of great significance for the ways many people still think of art and philosophy. Its value lies in suggesting that poetry and philosophy, and the sense many of us have that we need to be better, should be approached differently.

445710.label: Project Title(Chinese)
445710.value: 跨国公司基于全球税后利润优化目标的供应链决策

445710.label: Project Objectives
445710.value: Investigate the economic benefits of a tax-effective supply chain strategy which integrates international tax planning and global supply chain decisions. Develop analytical models for a global firm with subsidiaries operating in low and high tax countries, respectively, and characterize the firm’s optimal supply chain decisions under various centralized and decentralized performance measures. Quantify and compare different managerial control mechanisms based on various before-tax and after-tax, local and global objectives. Design incentive schemes which enable the global firm to coordinate local supply chain decisions so as to obtain maximum global after-tax profits.
rows: Investigate the economic benefits of a tax-effective supply chain strategy which integrates international tax planning and global supply chain decisions.

Develop analytical models for a global firm with subsidiaries operating in low and high tax countries, respectively, and characterize the firm’s optimal supply chain decisions under various centralized and decentralized performance measures.
Quantify and compare different managerial control mechanisms based on various before-tax and after-tax, local and global objectives.
Design incentive schemes which enable the global firm to coordinate local supply chain decisions so as to obtain maximum global after-tax profits.

445710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
445710.value: The globalization of the world's economy allows multinational companies to expand their global businesses rapidly beyond their home countries. Many of these global firms increasingly recognize the strategic value of aligning international tax planning with their supply chain decisions. However, they often face challenges in coordinating various supply chain entities in different countries to achieve higher global after-tax profitability. In this study, we will develop analytical models to evaluate a multinational firm's global supply chain decision structures under a so-called worldwide tax system. Most countries in the world employ some forms of the worldwide tax system in which a multinational firm's global incomes are subject to its home country's tax. To avoid double taxation, some countries such as U.S. and Japan permit the use of foreign tax credits (the portion of foreign tax payments that exceed the home country tax liabilities) generated from a subsidiary (located in a high-tax regime) to offset the tax liability from another subsidiary (located in a low-tax regime). Clearly, such tax averaging provision offers a global firm with two (or more) subsidiaries operating in low and high tax countries, respectively, an opportunity to potentially reduce its home-country tax liability. Our proposed models will characterize the interdependencies between the global firm's two subsidiaries at both international tax level (when tax averaging occurs) and supply chain operations level (when they share inventory). We will derive optimal global supply chain decisions based on various centralized and decentralized after-tax profit-maximizing performance measures. We will also explore various decentralized and centralized control structures which allow the global firm to coordinate supply chain decisions at subsidiaries located in different low and high tax countries to maximize its global after-tax profits. The outcomes of this project will contribute significantly to the supply chain literature as few existing supply chain models have focused on global after-tax profitability objectives. Our study will also have significant practical value in offering a number of managerial insights, such as how to design incentive schemes that will induce local managers at the subsidiaries to collectively make globally optimal supply chain decisions. 经济全球化使跨国公司在全球范围内得以迅速扩张其业务。很多跨国公司开始逐渐意识到通过供应链决策来进行国际税收筹划所产生的战略价值。但他们经常面对的挑战是如何协调处于不同国家的供应链单位，以获取更高的全球税后利润。 在本研究中，我们通过建立分析模型来评价全球税收体系下的跨国公司全球供应链决策体系。目前，世界上大多数国家均按跨国公司所在国税率对其全球收入征税。为避免双重课税，一些国家例如美国、日本允许使用其子公司（高税制）的国外税收抵免 （国外已纳税额超过本国应纳税额的部分）来抵偿其他子公司（低税制）的应交税额。显然，这类平衡税收的条款为在高税率和低税率国家均设立子公司的跨国公司提供了减少其所在国应交税额的机会。 我们提出的模型将描述处于不同国际税收水平（当平衡税收行为发生时）和供应链运作水平（当共享库存时）下的两家子公司之间的依存关系。通过多种集中和分布式税后利润最大化绩效指标得出最优全球供应链决策。此外，我们也会探究各种集中和分布式的控制结构，通过协调母公司和其位于高税收或低税收的子公司之间的供应链决策，最大化其全球税后利润。 由于目前鲜有供应链模型以全球税后利润为优化目标，本项目的研究成果将对现有的供应链文献做出显著贡献。此外，我们的研究还会提供一系列的管理启示，具有重大的实践价值， 例如如何设计激励方案，促使各子公司经理共同做出最优的全球供应链决策。

445710.label: Realisation of objectives
445710.value: The PI have achieved all 4 objectives of the proposal. The PI have produced two papers based on the proposed study. Both papers characterized the economic benefits of the integration of tax planning and supply chain management (objective. 1); developed quantitative models for multiple subsidiaries of a global firm and analyzed the operational behaviors of the firms under tax consideration (objectives 2 &3); and investigated the effectiveness of a number of incentive schemes to achieve better coordination of the subsidiaries (objective 4). The two papers are in various stages of review/revision. One paper is under second round revision and resubmission (R&R) for Manufacturing & Service Operations Management (MSOM). Another paper was submitted to Management Science and was subsequently rejected. It is under revision currently and will be submitted to another journal soon.

445710.label: Major findings and research outcome
445710.value: Among the main managerial insights derived from the two papers, the one that is the most interesting and surprising insight--which was demonstrated through theoretical and numerical analysis in the two papers--is that the tax factors will affect operations decisions such as sourcing and inventory quantities in non-trivial and sometimes non-intuitive ways. For example, the papers found that a more preferential tax rate may even discourage a operation manager to produce more quantity--a behavior that is not observed in the absence of tax consideration.

445710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
445710.value: The integration of tax planning and supply chain management is a research area that has not attracted much efforts within the Operations Management research community. The two papers the PI produced have been focused in the impact of foreign tax credits on the global supply chain decisions. There is high potential for further investigation of other tax related factors, such as transfer pricing, tariffs, etc. on operational decisions.

445710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
445710.value: Many global companies do not effectively integrate tax planning with their operations decisions, perhaps due to their complexity or the firm's lack of understanding on how to achieve integration. The proposed research aims to gain better understanding of such integration. This is an important area that has not attract much attention in the literature. Thus, the proposed study and its outcomes have the potential to have significant impact both academically as well as in practice.

445810.label: Project Title(Chinese)
445810.value: 簡潔的區域集聚的數理模型：應用Eaton-Kortum的新框架

445810.label: Co - Investigator(s)
445810.value: Prof Holmes, Thomas Joseph Prof Lee , Sanghoon

445810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
445810.value: Since Krugman’s (1991) seminal work, research on the economics of agglomeration has flourished and constitutes a new field named New Economic Geography (NEG). The insights of this line of literature are important for understanding why cities are formed, why firms agglomerate, and how both influence people’s lives. Another important work by Ottaviano, Tabuchi, and Thisse (2002) employs a linear demand model that makes for a more tractable NEG model than Krugman’s. At the core of any NEG theory is a consideration of how people/firms in different regions specialize and trade with one another. In both of the aforementioned canonical NEG models, trade is modeled with increasing returns, due to the fixed cost of production. This is an appealing formulation, but it may not represent the entire picture of regional trade. In particular, trade may emerge from differences in productivities across goods, i.e., comparative advantages, and the differential of gains from trade within-the-region over those across regions may actually form an agglomeration force. Nonetheless, such an agglomeration force is largely overlooked in the NEG literature. The models of trade and geography developed by Eaton and Kortum (2002) and in the companion paper published by Bernard, Eaton, Jenson, and Kortum (2003), hereafter BEJK, have been extremely influential in the field of international trade. They are trade models that incorporate comparative advantages, a.k.a, Ricardian models, and the structures are highly flexible, making them tractable for quantitative analysis. Krugman (1991) applies the trade model of monopolistic competition and increasing returns to a regional context, and we do the same to the Eaton-Kortum model. More specifically, we allow production factors, labor in particular, to be mobile. Such a model can endogenously generate not only the size distribution of cities, but also the spatial distribution of population and firms. Using our extension to the Eaton-Kortum model, we propose to revisit the standard issues examined in the NEG literature. Due to the tractability of our model, we are able to simulate the spatial distribution of population on a large plane with fine grids. We plan to examine how the spatial distribution of population implied by our model resembles real world patterns, and how it can help to explain the regularity of city size distribution. 自從Krugman (1991)，關於都市形成與經濟地理的理論模型如雨後春筍，形成了一個新的領域，被稱為「新經濟地理」。這一套理論關注集聚形成的原因以及集聚如何影響人們的生活。除了Krugman (1991)，另一個重要的新經濟地理模型是Ottaviano, Tabuchi, and Thisse (2002)。這篇文章使用了線性需求函數，使得模型較Krugman (1991)更為簡潔，於是也能夠被更廣泛的應用在其他議題上。 在新經濟地理學的核心其實是人與人之間如何交易的理論。特別是跨區域的貿易。在前述的兩種重要的新經濟地理的框架中，跨區域貿易由生產的報酬遞增而產生。這種觀點雖然吸引人也在某種程度上符合實際，但是這並非跨區域貿易的全貌。簡單的說，跨區域貿易也可以基於是更傳統的比較優勢。當人們有基於比較利益而交易的好處時，自然就會產生集聚的動機，因為聚集在一起交易可以節省許多運輸成本及其他的跨區域交易的不便。不論是生產的報酬遞增或者是比較優勢，都有在總體層次（aggregate level)上的「報酬遞增」。也就是說，當集聚產生時，市場的規模就愈大，而分工交易的好處就愈大。然而，基於比較優勢的解釋在新經濟地理的文獻中基本上是被漠視的。 Eaton and Kortum (2002)新的貿易模型以及之後的Bernard, Eaton, Jenson, and Kortum (2003，從此簡稱為BEJK）在國際貿易領域產生的極大的迴響。他們的模型是基於傳統的比較優勢理論，而他們的模型結構非常的彈性與簡潔。我們計畫使用他們的模型框架，應用來分析去區域間的集聚。我們將以此模型來重新探討一些傳統的集聚課題。由於我們的模型，有如BEJK，將會是相當簡潔，我們應該能有模擬空間上多個區域的人口與廠商分佈。如此一來，我們也能夠分析都市的大小分配。

445910.label: Project Title(Chinese)
445910.value: 清代古典戲曲中的明史再現

445910.label: Project Objectives
445910.value: To investigate the creative contexts and processes, aesthetic and philosophical characteristics of historical drama in the Qing era; To explore the interrelations of literature, history, and historiography; To grasp the social, cultural, political, and historical significance of dramatic representations of Ming history at different periods of the Qing dynasty; To illuminate an overlooked but important stage of development in the history of Chinese literature as well as classical Chinese drama. To shed new light on the "emotional" history of people in the Qing.
rows: To investigate the creative contexts and processes, aesthetic and philosophical characteristics of historical drama in the Qing era;
To explore the interrelations of literature, history, and historiography;
To grasp the social, cultural, political, and historical significance of dramatic representations of Ming history at different periods of the Qing dynasty;
To illuminate an overlooked but important stage of development in the history of Chinese literature as well as classical Chinese drama.
To shed new light on the "emotional" history of people in the Qing.

445910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
445910.value: The Qing dynasty (1644-1911) saw a tremendous burst of intellectual energy and creativity that led to a marked growth in historical drama as well as historiography. Among more than 3000 recorded plays composed in the Qing, approximately one third are history plays, and over 200 deal with Ming (1368-1644) history, which include great works of art. Under what circumstances were the events and figures of the preceding dynasty or their literary representations recalled and reshaped? To what extent was historical drama created during the Qing different from that of previous dynasties? Is it true that re-enacting events of the past helps a group “commemorate collectively” and the shared experience creates “a feeling of identity, binding the participants together and excluding outsiders”? (Grant and Ravelhofer 2008, 5) What factors came into play in the dramatic representations of Ming history in Qing China? To what extent were the writing and use of Ming history in drama different from the official history, and also different from early Qing to mid-Qing and to late Qing? What impact did these history plays have on people’s perception of the Ming and its relation to their present time? By examining the entire corpus of the 170 or so extant play-texts within their social, cultural, and historical contexts, I wish to portray the diversity and inter-textuality of the Qing world of historical drama, in order to shed new light on the creative processes, aesthetic and philosophical characteristics, as well as the socio-political relevance of classical drama in late imperial China. Besides furthering drama research, another aim of my proposed investigation is to broaden the scope of traditional historical study by exploring the "emotional" history of the Qing people, for in drama, social energy, collective beliefs and experiences are often encoded. The fact that quite a number of excerpts from Qing historical plays still grace the Kun opera stage bears witness to their artistic value and emotional appeal. Last but not least, when the project is completed, contemporary playwrights may gain insights from my theoretical reflections on the evocative force and emotional structure of the best kind of drama ever written on human history. 有清一代，文人編撰歷史劇蔚然成風。現有著錄之三千多種劇作中，約有三分之一 為歷史劇，其中演述明史者超過二百種；其中不少為優秀的藝術作品。在何種情況 下，前朝人事或有關他們的文學作品被回憶與再現？清代戲曲家再現明史時如何發 明？他們編撰的歷史劇與前朝有何不同？是否重現過去有助於某一群體「集體紀 念」，而此共享的經驗會造成「一種認同的感情，令參與者團結，同時排除他 者」？是哪些因素影響了清代中國劇壇上的明史再現？戲曲中的明史書寫及其用途 在多大程度上與正史不同？這在清初、清中葉、晚清是否也有變化？清代歷史劇對 當時人們認知明史，感受其與當代的關係有何作用？ 本計畫擬深入探討現有的全部170種左右有關明史的清代古典戲曲，考察這些作品產 生的社會、文化、歷史脈絡，描繪它們的多元性與互文性，以洞悉其創造過程、思 想、藝術特點，及其與清代社會、政治之間的各種關連。 本計畫的目的除了促進戲曲研究，還希望探索清人的情感歷史，藉此拓寬傳統歷史 研究的範圍－－因為在戲劇中，經常隱含負載著社會能量、集體信仰以及經驗。有 為數不少來自清代歷史劇的折子仍活在當下的崑劇舞台上的這一事實，正見證著這批 作品的藝術價值與情感力量。最後，此計畫完成之後，其中的理論性反思，亦可為 當代從事創作的戲劇家提供歷史先例而有所裨益。

445910.label: Realisation of objectives
445910.value: 由於計劃所涉及的劇目近兩百種，筆者從歷史劇所涉及的史事、人物以及藝術風格出發，分別選擇了最有代表性的具體案例，如在史事上選擇「明亡」，人物撰擇「女性角色」與歷史記憶的關係，相對於嚴肅史劇之「通俗史劇」，選擇了與明武宗相關的十幾種劇目進行專題研究。前二者分別撰成了幾篇學術論文，並與筆者近年的學術著作，結集為《明清戲曲中的女性聲音與歷史記憶》一書出版。關於明武宗的通俗史劇論文則正在撰寫之中。以上這些學術論文所思考的議題，都與上述計畫目標密切相關，換言之，我考索了清代歷史劇之美學與哲學特色；文學、歷史以及史學之關聯；有清不同時期對明史之戲劇再現的社會、文化、政治及歷史意義，以及清人的「情感歷史」。 在寫作論文之外，筆者亦將所有清代與明史相關的歷史劇作了仔細的考察，於原計劃所列之167種劇目，進行查證，又加以增刪，定為187種，後考其作者、版本，撰成劇目提要共十三萬餘字，此項工作業已全部完成。

445910.label: Major findings and research outcome
445910.value: （一）確認清代戲曲中與明史相關劇作達187種，其中清前期57種，中期43種，後期38種，無名氏49種。由清前期至後期，呈現篇幅減少，由傳奇至雜劇的轉變，且多一折短劇。綜觀此187種劇目，對於明史最大的關懷在於對明代衰亡的反思，集中於明亡與宦官之禍；涉及倭亂之劇作亦不少，但少見嚴肅的政治反思，反多通俗的娛樂傾向。 （二）肯定以戲曲再現或重塑歷史，清初成就最高，清中後期則集中於蔣士銓、黃燮清等少數大家。但不論是哪個時期，都可見「以古喻今」或「借古諷今」，並帶有創作者的個人生平背景及當代歷史脈絡，此為歷史劇作研究中最值得探索之處。比如說清代書寫崇禎之死的文人劇，從《鐵冠圖》到《帝女花》，展現著由「悼明」到至少是表面上包含「頌清」的轉變；而同樣是表彰節義、意在教化的作品，若審視作者背景，往往可見地域意識、地方官紳脈絡等因素。 （三）發現前人著錄的錯誤，如《氾黃濤》作者「思齊主人」一向誤為「思齋主人」。傳奇《義忠恩》與《挾忠烈》實為同劇異名等等。

445910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
445910.value: 筆者在研究清代宮廷演出鈔本《鐵冠圖》時，注意到清廷對民間歷史記憶刻意編排操弄的痕跡。因此想逆向思考，在文人向清廷所獻的迎鑾戲曲中，如何書寫地方歷史記憶，以及藉地域文化的認同來抵制官方大一統的意識型態。此或可發展為「儀式、表演與政治：清代迎鑾戲曲研究」，以探討迎鑾戲與地方社會、民間信仰、物質文化與文人創作的互動關係，以彰顯康、乾二帝南巡北返過程中，戲曲於「政治」上的運用，此將有助於具體展現清代戲曲之特殊重要面向。

445910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
445910.value: 清代古典戲曲作品已知超過四千種，為歷代之最，又以歷史劇的創作在中國戲曲史上成就卓著。本計畫以「清歷史劇中的明史再現」作為考察範圍，首先確認了現存相關劇作共187種，為各劇撰寫提要外，並擇重要史事如明亡，人物類型如女性角色，戲曲風格如通俗史劇來考察其美學、哲學特色，進一步比較在清代不同時期，以戲曲再現明史的社會、文化、政治乃至歷史意義，嘗試從戲劇文類，一窺清人的情感歷史。計畫期間，本人參與國際學術研討會四次並發表論文，且於學術期刊上刊登論文四篇，並出版了一本論文集。

446110.label: Project Title(Chinese)
446110.value: 揭示多种注意力范式之后的构造

446110.label: Project Objectives
446110.value: Extracting the constructs of visual attention I plan to test 18 paradigms: Conjunction search, Configuration search, Counting, Tracking, Feature access, Spatial pattern, Response selection, Visual Short-term memory, Spatial short-term memory, Change blindness, Intelligence, Visual marking, Attentional capture, Consonance-driven orienting, Inhibition of return, Attentional blink, Task switching, Mental rotation and Stroop task. All 18 will be tested on each participant and I will use principal component analysis to extract the constructs(s) behind their performances (i.e., the individual differences) on these paradigms. The pilot data suggest that there is only one single construct behind all these variables. And this general attentional limit seems to be uncorrelated with phenomena such as Inhibition of return, Attentional blink and Attentional capture. Separability of certain mechanisms I will use structural equation modeling to test whether some of the mechanisms are separable. For example, is there a search mechanism that is separable from the general attentional limit? Is there a short-term memory mechanism that is separable from the general attentional limit? Role of inhibition of return in visual search Some researchers have proposed that inhibition of return functionally marks locations that have been visited by visual attention and therefore ensures that visual attention is paid to new locations, so that a scene can be scanned more efficiently (e.g., Klein, 1988). If inhibition of return does contribute significantly to the efficiency of visual search, those observers with greater inhibition of return should perform better in visual search tasks. I will test this prediction. The nature of Attentional blink A recent important debate on the nature of attentional blink is whether it occurs because the first target depletes the resource (e.g., Dux, Asplund, & Marois, 2008) or because of a strategy of “turning off the selection” (e.g., Nieuwenstein et al., 2005). If the resource-depletion account is correct, then we would expect attentional blink to correlate significantly with the general attentional limit (i.e., those with less attention resource would be more completely depleted). On the other hand, if the turning-off account is correct, then attentional blink is somehow an optional strategy that an observer may or may not use and there would be no reason for it to correlate with the general attentional limit. I will test this prediction.

I will test this prediction.

The nature of Attentional blink A recent important debate on the nature of attentional blink is whether it occurs because the first target depletes the resource (e.g., Dux, Asplund, & Marois, 2008) or because of a strategy of “turning off the selection” (e.g., Nieuwenstein et al., 2005). If the resource-depletion account is correct, then we would expect attentional blink to correlate significantly with the general attentional limit (i.e., those with less attention resource would be more completely depleted). On the other hand, if the turning-off account is correct, then attentional blink is somehow an optional strategy that an observer may or may not use and there would be no reason for it to correlate with the general attentional limit. I will test this prediction.

446110.value: In recent decades, visual attention has been among the most rapidly growing fields in cognitive psychology and neuroscience. A large part of the empirical research in this field has focused on concrete paradigms. Both visual search and tracking, for example, are claimed to reflect attention. However, there is no clear demonstration that they are indeed measuring the same underlying construct. The central idea of the concept of attention is a limit of information processing. Visual search, for example, is considered to reflect attention because observers try to find goal-relevant information (i.e., targets) and exclude goal-irrelevant information (i.e., distractors), presumably because it is impossible to process all of the information efficiently due to the limit of information processing. As another example, attentional blink is considered to reflect attention because observers cannot detect two targets that are presented within a short period, again presumably because it is impossible to process all of the information efficiently due to the limit of information processing. All these classic paradigms are reasonably related to the general concept of attention, but it is also easily conceivable that they could reflect limits in different stages of information processing, and, if so, they would be dissociated from each other. The present study will try to reveal the construct(s) behind these paradigms in order to shed light on the nature of the underlying limit(s). I propose to collect a large individual-differences data set to address this question. I plan to test 18 paradigms: Conjunction search, Configuration search, Counting, Tracking, Feature access, Spatial pattern, Response selection, Visual Short-term memory, Spatial short-term memory, Change blindness, Intelligence (Raven’s test), Visual marking, Task switching, Mental rotation, Stroop task, Attentional capture, Consonance-driven orienting, Inhibition of return, Attentional blink. All 18 will be tested on each participant and I will use principal component analysis to extract the constructs(s) behind their performances (i.e., the individual differences) on these paradigms. The pilot data so far seems to suggest that there is only one single construct behind all these variables. And this general attentional limit seems to be uncorrelated with paradigms such as inhibition or return, attentional blink and attentional capture. Furthermore, I will use structural equation modeling to test whether some of the mechanisms are separate. 446110.label: Major findings and research outcome
446110.value: A large part of the empirical research in the field of visual attention has focused on various concrete paradigms. However, as yet, there has been no clear demonstration of whether or not these paradigms are indeed measuring the same underlying construct. We collected a very large data set to address this question. We tested more than 200 participants on various paradigms. A fairly general attention factor was identified. This single factor explained 35% of the total variance. A more important result of the present study is the lack of semi-general factors. In other words, it is impossible to identify a small number (e.g., two) of dissociable mechanisms behind these paradigms. If there is any semi-general mechanism that contributes selectively to a few paradigms (e.g., a search mechanism that contributes to conjunction and configuration search, but not to the other paradigms), then there will be an identifiable secondary factor. In other words, the present study not only shows that disparate paradigms are related to one general attention factor, but also that this general attention factor is the only shared mechanism in these paradigms. Another important result of the present study is that the portions of paradigm-specific mechanisms seem to be rather large. As mentioned earlier, 35% of the variance of the nine primary paradigms can be explained by the general attention factor. On the other hand, the reliability of these nine paradigms is generally high, so only very small portions of the variance in the data are caused by random errors in measurements. On average, about 63% of the reliable variance of the primary paradigms is attributed to paradigm-specific mechanisms. In some sense, for each paradigm, most of its mechanism is unique rather than shared with other paradigms. Some of the participants were also tested on some other paradigms. This general attention factor was found to be correlated with intelligence, visual marking, task switching, mental rotation, and Stroop task. On the other hand, a few paradigms that are very important in the attention literature (attentional capture, consonance-driven orienting, and inhibition of return) were found to be dissociated from this general attention factor.

446110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
446110.value: An important future direction following this project is to see how the general attention factor can be affected by training of the individual attention tasks. A series of studies have suggested that video game players are generally better than others on a wide range of attention tasks (e.g., Green & Bavelier, 2003), thus it is likely that the general attention factor can be affected significantly by training. If the results of the present project can be applied to training effect, then we would expect to see that training on any attention task will have a moderate, but broad, effect on all other attention tasks, and will have a large task-specific effect. It will be interesting to see whether this is the case, and generally explore the relevant questions. I will try to conduct a number of pilot experiments along this direction in the near future.

446110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
446110.value: When we inspect a complex scene with great detail, only a small subset of the information, as the “focus of the mind,” is subject to in-depth analysis and explicit report. This focus of the mind, namely attention, has been studied extensively by experimental psychologists in the last decades, with a wide variety of paradigms and tasks. For example, in visual search tasks, an observer will search for a pre-specified target among many items; in tracking tasks, an observer will keep track of 3-4 items while they move around along with other items. However, as yet, there has been no clear demonstration of whether or not these paradigms are indeed measuring the same underlying mechanism. In the present study, a fairly general attention factor was identified, suggesting that there is indeed a general attention mechanism which is involved in all of these tasks. More importantly, the present study also suggests that this general attention factor is the only shared mechanism in these paradigms. Another important result of the present study is that the portions of paradigm-specific mechanisms seem to be rather large. In some sense, for each paradigm, most of its mechanism is unique rather than shared with other paradigms.

446210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
446210.value: The aim of this project is to conduct research into shoppers’ dynamic in-store decision-making processes, with regard to unplanned purchases, so as to increase shopper satisfaction and store profitability. In-store decision making has drawn increasing attention from manufacturers and retailers in recent years because shoppers make a large part of their decisions inside the store. Efforts have been made to make in-store marketing more effective in order to trigger consumers’ impulse or unplanned purchases. Given the importance of in-store marketing and a shortage of relevant research on this topic, the purpose of the current project is to improve our understanding of consumers’ dynamic in-store decision-making processes. We specifically present a comprehensive framework examining factors influencing consumers’ likelihood to engage in unplanned purchases in the store. In our ongoing field study, we have grocery shoppers wear eye-cams and RFID tags to record their real-time activities and shopping paths during their entire shopping trips. In our proposed data coding and analyses plans and several future experiments, we examine how in-store shopping path characteristics, external characteristics such as store and product category factors, and shopper characteristics impact shoppers’ in-store unplanned purchases. Our most primary focus is on the relationship between consumers’ in-store movement (i.e., shopping path) and their unplanned purchases. Several aspects of shopping path are examined including the distance shoppers have traveled by when they reach a specific decision, the number of their prior unplanned considerations before the current decision, and the proximity or distance between their current decision and the next or previous one. In addition to path characteristics, we also look at external characteristics such as store display and product category that can either encourage or discourage unplanned purchases, and examine how these external factors interact with shopping path to influence unplanned purchases. Finally, in terms of the shopper characteristics, we focus on the role of both demographic (e.g., gender and age) and psychographic information (shopper internal impulsivity) on in-store decision making. Taken together, in this project, we investigate several important but relatively unexplored issues along with their relationship in shopper marketing, including dynamic in-store decision making, shopping paths, unplanned purchases, and store and shopper characteristics. We aim to reach managerial implications to help marketers improve in-store marketing effectiveness and to help consumers enhance their shopping planning performance. N/A

446610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
446610.value: Service plans (also known as service contracts, protection plans, or retailer extended warranties) are a type of warranty contract under which retailers promise to repair or replace products for consumers. Separate from manufacturers' warranty policies, which typically come bundled with the products, retailers' service plans are optional and usually offer broader and more prolonged coverage than those offered by manufacturers' base warranties. Today, these plans have become a common practice among retailers. For instance, consumers have the option of purchasing a two-year “Best Buy Geek Squad Black Tie Protection” policy for a Canon SD 1100 digital camera at Best Buy at a price of US$34.99, which takes effect from the date of purchase and offers coverage for setup, performance, and ongoing support, which is beyond the scope of Canon's one-year base warranty. Note that in this typical example, the service plan takes effect on the same date as the manufacturer's warranty and has an extended scope of coverage. Hence, from the consumer's point of view, the retailer's service plan complements and can even substitute for the manufacturer's base warranty. Given that the retailer has already offered a more extended warranty, it seems obvious that the manufacturer should offer a minimal warranty so as to avoid free-riding on the part of the retailer. So why does Canon still offer a base warranty? More generally, what motivates manufacturers to offer a base warranty when service plans are available to consumers? What are the strategic interactions between the retail service plan and the manufacturer base warranty? How do these service plans affect the role of manufacturers' warranties and channel performance? There is a rich literature in economics, marketing, and operation management on product warranties. Many of these studies cover the motivations behind such warranties, and there are two well-documented roles of warranties: the insurance role (e.g., Heal 1977) and the signaling role (e.g., Spence 1977). Regardless of service plans’ prevalence and nontrivial implications in distribution channels, research on service plans is scarce. In the present research, our goal is to understand the impacts of a retailer's service plan on a manufacturer's base warranty policy and on channel performance. In particular, we examine the effect of a retailer service plan on the manufacturer warranty’s signaling role. Our work will be among the first to address this issue. 服务计划（也称为服务合同，保护计划，或零售商延长保修）是保修合同的一种，零售商承诺为消费者修理或更换产品。和制造商与产品捆绑在一起的基本保修政策不同，零售商的服务计划是可选的，其通常会提供比制造商的保修更广和更长的覆盖范围。如今，这些服务计划已成为零售商一种非常普遍的做法。例如，消费者在Best Buy购买佳能公司的SD 1100数码相机时可以选择是否同时购买一个售价34.99美元为期两年的“Best Buy黑领带保护”计划。该计划从购买之日起生效，覆盖范围包括基本设置，性能，和持续的支持，这超出了佳能的为期一年的基本保修政策。 注意，在这个典型的例子中，服务计划和制造商的保修政策同日生效并具有更大的覆盖范围。因此，从消费者的角度来看，零售商的服务计划是制造商的保修政策的补充，甚至可以取代制造商的保修政策。鉴于零售商已经提供了更广的保修，生产商似乎应提供最低限度的保修，以避免零售商利用自己搭便车。那么，为什么佳能还会提供基本保修？更普遍存在的问题是，是什么促使制造商依然提供基本的保修政策当零售商已经提供服务计划给消费者？零售服务计划和制造商保修政策之间有什么互动影响？这些服务计划如何影响到制造商保修政策和整个销售渠道的表现？ 经济学，市场营销学，和产品运行管理学等学科在产品保修方面的文献很丰富。其中许多研究是关于提供这些保修背后的动机，有两个被大家所接受的动机：保险作用（例如，Heal 1977）和信号传递作用（例如，Spence 1977）。尽管零售商服务计划是如此的盛行，以及它对于分销渠道的意义重大，目前对服务计划的研究很少。在本研究中，我们的目标是要了解零售商的服务计划对制造商的基本保修政策的影响。我们会重点讨论零售商服务计划对制造商保修政策的信号传递作用的影响。我们的研究是第一个讨论这个问题的。

446610.label: Major findings and research outcome
446610.value: We show that offering a service plan is the dominant strategy for the retailer. When the manufacturer's warranty plays an insurance role alone, its coverage must be reduced in the presence of a service plan. The service plan is optional and thus more efficient from the channel's point of view. As a result, it is in the manufacturer's interest not to offer a base warranty if its cost in providing warranty is the same as that of the retailer. Nevertheless, it may be optimal for the manufacturer to offer a limited warranty, if its cost to do so is sufficiently low. In this case, although offering a warranty aggravates the double-marginalization problem, it reduces the total warranty cost in the channel and provokes the retailer into enlarging the service plan coverage to a level that is optimal for the manufacturer. When a manufacturer's warranty plays both insurance and signaling roles, surprisingly, the presence of a service plan may increase the sustainability of the signaling equilibrium; it boosts product demand and thus increases the benefit of revealing the manufacturer's a high-quality nature. However, given that manufacturers are generally more efficient than retailers in providing warranties, in reality, the presence of service plans is likely to negate the signaling role played by manufacturers' warranties. We also find our major results are robust in an enviroment where both the manufacture warranty and the retail price serve as the signals for product qualities to consumers. This constitutes the first signaling model in which the signals come from different and independent firms.

446610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
446610.value: This paper leaves several issues open for future research. First, the manufacturer warranty is a bundled base warranty in our model. In reality, some manufacturers offer optional extended warranties in addition to a base warranty. In such cases, the competition between the extended warranties provided by both channel members can be head on. As the retailer has greater incentives to promote its own warranty, the distribution arrangement for manufacturers' extended warranties may become critical decision for the manufacturers. A research that extends Desai and Padmanabhan (2004) and allows for a base warranty and both channel members' extended warranties is desirable. A second promising direction for future analytical research would be to extend our model to allow for multiple retailers (and perhaps even for multiple manufacturers). Studies along this line could provide a more complete picture of the strategic interactions among channel members. We leave these interesting issues for future research.

446610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
446610.value: Service plan (service contract, protection plan, and extended warranty) has become a common practice among retailers. It is a contract offered to purchasers of products for an additional fee, under which the provider offers to repair or replace the product over a specified time period. There is a large literature in economics, management, marketing, and operation management on product warranties. Among them, many works aim to offer the motivations of such warranties. There are two well documented roles of warranties. That is, insurance role and signaling role. More recently, there has been increasing research interest in service contracts (extended warranties) due to its financial significance for retailers and importance in practice, but many questions remain unanswered. Our research is the first attempt to examine the impact of a retail service plan in a distribution channel in which the manufacturer also offers a warranty. We find that a service plan can negate the potential for a manufacturer base warranty to operate as a signal: the signal becomes incredible if the manufacturer is relatively cost efficient. Our results also help to explain the mixed empirical findings on the relationship between the warranty and the product quality.

446710.label: Project Title(Chinese)
446710.value: 當今中國的健康不平等：對於相對地位假說的新評估

446710.label: Project Objectives
446710.value: Evaluate the relative importance of the health effects of the subjective relative social status and absolute level of socioeconomic position, including an assessment of direct, indirect, or spurious components of the effects of subjective and objective standing. Decompose the apparent health effects of the subjective relative social status into the effects of (a) current subjective relative status and (b) subjective status mobility, either realized or anticipatory. Compare the effects of subjective relative social status on the positive and negative aspects of health. Provide a comprehensive description of social inequality in an extensive array of positive and negative health outcomes, which will offer a basis for comparison in future studies.

446710.label: Realisation of objectives
446710.value: We have achieved all the project objectives. We carried out data collection by attaching a total of 40 questions to two rounds of nationally representative surveys conducted in 2010 and 2011. We received the raw data at the end of 2011 and 2012 respectively. Below we explain how each objective is achieved. For the first two objectives, we wrote a paper using the 2010 survey data to analyze the relationships between physical and mental health outcomes and subjective and objective indicators of social positions. In this paper, we also assess the health effects of perceived intra- and inter-generational mobility, and decompose the apparent effects of subjective status into the effects of current subjective status and those of perceived mobility. Different versions of the paper have been presented at three international conferences. It is now under review at Social Science & Medicine. In terms of the third objective, we are now preparing a manuscript using the 2011 data. It examines how subjective status in different dimensions of social stratification, such as wealth, cultural capital and power, influences the positive and negative aspects of individuals’ psychological state. We also seek to ascertain the effects of inconsistencies among the subjective status in the three hierarchies. We explicitly assess whether subjective status in the three hierarchies and status inconsistencies among the hierarchies have different effects on the positive and negative aspects of health. The manuscript has been submitted for presentation to an international conference. We plan to submit the manuscript to a journal within next two months. Three papers have been developed to address the last objective. The first investigates the relationship between non-cognitive skills, which is influenced by socioeconomic status, and physical and mental health outcomes, and has been published in Chinese Sociological Review. The second used the 2011 data to construct a cross-sectional panel dataset so as to study the temporal trends in the relationship between socioeconomic status and the positive and negative aspects of health, and has been accepted for publication by Social Indicator Research. The third paper examines the effects of personality skills on subjective well-being, and has been presented at an international conference. It is now under preparation for submission to an academic journal. Finally, a PhD student of the PI is using the 2010 survey data to examine the effects of higher education on health in one of the chapters of his thesis.
