501210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
501210.value: The study of boundary value problems (BVP) is an important area of applied mathematics, with many applications: including waves, fluid mechanics, mathematical biology, and superconductivity, just to mention a few. Physical systems are usually modeled as systems of differential equations. When an object with finite extent is involved, physical conditions at its boundary represent constraints to be satisfied by the solution, thereby constituting a BVP. Large objects are often approximated as having infinite extent and boundary conditions can be prescribed as asymptotic behavior of the solution "near" infinity. A fundamental question in the study of BVP's is the existence of solutions. Knowing that an empirical "solution" (the observed state of the system) exists is not sufficient proof that the mathematical BVP has a solution, because the BVP is only an idealized representation of the physical system. A logically vigorous existence proof serves as an assurance that the model is not flawed. The next natural question is how many solutions are there? Uniqueness of the solution plays an important role in the further investigation of many systems. Yet this property is elusive and difficult to establish. The PI has previously obtained results in this area that became widely cited and have been further developed by other researchers. On the other hand, many nonlinear systems possess multiple solutions. It is important to know under what conditions the BVP will guarantee multiple solutions, and if so, how many solutions are there? Further properties of the solutions, such as smoothness, monotonicity, bifurcation, asymptotic behavior, etc. are essential to the understanding of the physical system represented by the equations. New applications in recent years lead to new models involving complex nonlinearity, delayed effects, and unconventional boundary conditions, etc., thus giving rise to difficult new problems often not treatable by traditional techniques. Last year, the PI started to investigate several such new models: an electro-diffusion model, a population biology model, multipoint BVP's, the asymptotic spikes of a class of reaction diffusion equations and the scalar field equation. By introducing novel approaches, the PI obtained promising results, which have been or are in the process of being written up for publication. In this proposed project, the PI will continue to further exploit the new methods he has introduced to obtain improvements of the preliminary results and to research into other physical models in order to expand the range of applications. 非線性邊值問題在應用數學中是重要的一個課題。很多物理系統可用微分方程系來模擬。假如模擬的物體是包含在有限空間裡，其在邊界的物理條件就是方程解必須遵從的條件。求這樣的解就是邊值問題。大的物體可以看成在無窮遠處適合給定的漸近條件。 邊值問題的基本研究目標是解的存在和唯一/多解性。其它問題包括光滑性，單調性，分歧，漸近性質等。當方程系是非線性的時候，這些問題都是不容易回答的。 新的應用包括電子擴散，生物種群分布，反應擴散方程等，導出新的方程系，和新的非古典的邊界條件。已知的數學技巧對很多這些新問題不再適用。這一研究計劃針對此等新系統，尋找新的方法來解決新的問題。

501210.label: Realisation of objectives
501210.value: The proposed objectives have been successfully accomplished in our project. New methods have been introduced in solving several non-conventional boundary-value problems of differential equations that arise in several new applications in physics. Some open questions have been settled and some classical results have been extended. The use of computer software, especially the symbolic manipulation program MAPLE and matrix numerical packages MATLAB have been successfully applied in our study and we have demonstrated that even non-rigorous and non-exact numerical methods can be exploited to assist rigorous study of mathematical problems. The results have been published as eight research articles in well-known and world class journals and have been well received by other researchers. At the moment, the use of interval arithmetic, however, has not been entirely satisfactory. The main reason is that the technique is rather time-consuming and computationally extensive (requiring excessive computer execution time) and often the results are applicable only to a few concrete cases and are not general enough to be incorporated in a useful rigorous result. We found that often, an alternative approach using MAPLE can achieve similar goals. In fact, symbolic manipulation software plays quite an important role in many parts of our investigation. We intend to return to the subject of interval arithmetic in some future study.

501210.label: Major findings and research outcome
501210.value: In paper #1, we made use of a known method in the study of eigenvalues of Sturm-Liouville problems to study the invariance of the inertia of products of matrices via the study of a pencil of matrices. We were able to extend classical results of Sylvester and Johnson to non-Hermitian matrices. In paper #2, we investigated the mean-square exponential synchronization of stochastic complex net- works with Markovian switching and time-varying delays by using the pinning control method and other techniques in differential equations. In papers #3 and 4, we studied non-conventional Neumann boundary value problems arising from two-ion electrodiffusion problems (with balanced and unequal valence, respectively). A novel transform needed to be applied to convert the problem before we could apply topological degree theory of the resulting 2-dimensional shooting problems. We were able to complete previous known studies on the equations. In paper #5, we presented new results on a nonlinear Sturm-Liouville-type eigenvalue problem for a multi-point boundary value problem. The boundary conditions involves more than two points and requires much additional effort in the study than conventional two-point problems. Paper 6 is concerned with a problem related to those of #3 and 4, but the boundary conditions are of the radiation type. The methods and skills used are completely different from those of the previous papers. In paper 7, we discovered new subadditive properties of the error function which was involved in the study of the heat and related partial differential equations. We expect that the properties will become useful in future study of these equations. Paper 8 presented some new inequalities of trigonometric polynomials. These polynomials are partial sums of Fourier series which are one of the basic tools used in solving boundary value problems of partial differential equations. They are used in the study of the properties of the solutions of the equations.

501210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
501210.value: All the new methods and techniques we have proposed and studied have potential applications to other types of boundary value problems and we believe will find further applications in other mathematical systems modeling a wide variety of physical phenomena. We also are convinced that computer assistance in the form of symbolic manipulation has high potential of applications in pure mathematics where rigorous proofs are the norm and we will continue to apply the technique in future projects.

501210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
501210.value: The project have been successfully carried out, with the collaboration of several experts in the field. New methods for solving new types of boundary value problems have been presented and applications to various fields have been investigated. Approaches used in the study of differential equations were found to be used in other areas of mathematics, including matrix theory and stochastic processes. Old results have been generalized or complemented. New properties of some the error function have been discovered and will be useful for future study of other related problems in solving differential equations. Athough the use of interval arithmetic has not been very successful, we still were able to obtain our desired results using alternative computer-aided approaches.

501410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
501410.value: 催化交叉偶聯反應是其中一個最簡單實用的連鍵方法，應用於製造大量的藥學上有用的化合物。事實上，高可調性催化劑具有重要的意義在藥物發現過程，由於不同的分子，通常需要特定的微調催化劑的優化。 當前方法的改進和探索新技術具有很高的基本重要性。這個項目的目的是：（1）發展一個淺顯的模塊化合成了一類新的簡單高效的膦配體（及其手性的變種）具有高潛力的可調性，（2）探討在新的配體範圍解決具有挑戰性的問題基板，高立體擁擠耦合夥伴，特別是對 2 -雜環基及相關未開發;（3）探索一種新型的環境友好的親電反應的耦合;（4）研究基本觀點上的動力學行為的organonucleophile產生和發展一個靈活和可靠的協議在原位製備親核夥伴;及（5）研究的不對稱 CC和第一Csp2 - N鍵的形成及其潛在的應用價值軸向合成手性分子的天然圖案。 這一新的領域將為我們提供一個極好的機會，進一步作出了重大進步，在催化研究前沿，在香港並會為我們建立一個通用的科學基礎精細化工行業。

501410.label: Realisation of objectives
501410.value: This is the completion report of the funding PolyU5014/10P. In this project, we have thoroughly accomplished in developing a new class of simple phosphine ligands via a facile and modular synthesis. With the newly invented ligands, we attempted in exploring challenging cross coupling reactions. The establishment of environmentally benign electrophile, i.e. from naturally abundant phenolic derivatives, has been achieved. The kinetic behavior of the coupling partners (nucleophiles) has been studied using NMR tracing approaches. The chiral version of the phosphine ligands were obtained via chiral HPLC resolution. These optically active ligands were applied in enantioselective cross-coupling catalysis.

501410.label: Major findings and research outcome
501410.value: This is the completion report of the funding PolyU5014/10P In this proposed study, we have made important achievement in developing a new class of phosphine ligands via a simple assembling approach, from easily and readily available starting materials. The invented ligands have been applied in various challenging or under-developed catalysis. We have successfully shown the first Suzuki-Miyaura coupling of alkenyl mesylates. These findings have been published in Chemical Communications, 2011, 47, 8328-8330. Moreover, by using the new ligands, we have achieved the lowest catalyst loading employed so far for sterically hindered couplings (the tri-ortho-substituted biaryl synthesis). These findings have been published in Chemical Communications, 2011, 47, 5079-5081. Having the similar ligand structure, we also achieved the first carbon-boron bond cross-coupling of aryl chlorides, simply using -PPh2 containing ligands. These findings have been published in The Journal of Organic Chemistry, 2012, 77, 3543-3548. By altering the indole scaffold with benzimidazolyl ring, another series of ligands were developed. In this context, the first Suzuki-Miyaura coupling of aryl mesylates/tosylates using P,N-type ligands was reported. These findings opened up another ligand direction for coupling of phenolic derivatives. These achievements have been published in Chemical Communications 2012, 48, 1967-1969. We have also developed a new nucleophile (coupling partner) for cross-coupling reactions. The arylsulfonyl hydrazides were found to be effective coupling partners for direct C-H arylation of benzoxazoles. These developments have been published in Synlett, 2012, 23, 2714-2718. Recently, our ligand achievement was recognized by RSC publisher. We were invited to contribute a review article concerning the recent advancement of transition metal-catalyzed borylation of aryl halides and sulfonates (RSC Advances, 2013, 3, 12518-12539). With the previous successful results in hand, we also explored the first Pd-phosphine-catalyzed reductive cleavage of phenolic C-O bond from tosylated arene using isopropanol as the mild reducing agent. These findings have been published in Organic Chemistry Frontiers, 2014, 1, 464-467. Moreover, our research contribution was highlighted by the publisher as the Insider Cover Page. Further evaluation of this type of ligand was made, a general direct arylation of polyfluoroarenes catalyzed by palladium-indolylphosphine complexes was developed. These findings have been published in Chemistry An Asian Journal, 2015, 10, 857-861. The chiral version of these ligands were obtained through HPLC resolution. The optically active ligands were applied in asymmetric cross-coupling reactions. These research output were reported in Chiral China Symposium 2012, in Lanzhou.

501410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
501410.value: The invented phosphine ligands have high potential in dealing with challenging and problematic coupling reactions. With the easily modified ligand skeleton, the tackling of specific window of unexplored reactions would be realized.

501410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
501410.value: The proposed research study of funding PolyU5014/10P concerns the development of easily accessible catalyst for joining two or more organic fragments together. The catalysts being made were from simple approach (i.e. highly step-efficient), and from readily available and inexpensive starting materials (i.e. highly cost-effective). With this catalyst tool box in hand, challenging and problematic coupling reactions can be conveniently tackled.

502510.label: Project Objectives

502510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
502510.value: In the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) research area, an intrinsic property of the diffusivity profile is positive semi-definiteness. Recently, the PI and his collaborators proposed a comprehensive model to approximate the apparent diffusion coefficient profile by a positive semi-definite diffusion tensor of either second or higher order. The new model is called PSDT (positive semi-definite diffusion tensor). On the other hand, one of major developments in convex optimization for the last two decades was focusing on conic linear programming (CLP). It turned out that the PSDT model can be converted to a new CLP problem. The PI and his collaborator investigated this new CLP problem and called it the space tensor conic programming problem. So far, no practical numerical methods have been proposed for solving the PSDT model and the space tensor conic programming problem. It was noted that the maxima of ADC profile do not correspond to true fibre orientation. The Q-balling imaging approach is to reconstruct the diffusion orientation distribution function (ODF) of the underlying fiber population of a biological tissue. As the water molecules in normal tissues tend to diffuse along fibers when contained in fiber bundles, the principal directions (maxima) of the ODF agree with the true synthetic fiber directions. The ODF, as a probability distribution function, should be nonnegative. Until now, no ODF models have addressed this satisfactorily. In this project, we plan to construct efficient algorithms for solving the PSDT model and the space tensor conic programming problem, and to apply the PSDT idea to the ODF approach to construct a completely nonnegative ODF model. The algorithms considered include conventional convex programming methods, semi-definite programming methods, cutting plane algorithms and special interior point algorithms for solving CLP problems. It is very important that the ADC profile is positive semi-definite and the ODF is nonnegative. The success of this project will result in not only important applications in the MRI research area in biomedical engineering, but also a sound understanding to the the new CLP problem - the space tensor conic programming problem. The success of this project will also make significant contributions to the development of numerical multi-linear algebra - a new branch of applied and computational mathematics. The success of this project will have a high impact in both the MRI and CLP areas.

502510.label: Realisation of objectives
502510.value: We considered the positive semi-definite space tensor cone constrained convex program, its structure and algorithms. We established convergence of three polyhedral outer approximation algorithms for solving this problem. We then studied some other approaches for solving this structured convex program. Space tensors appear in physics and mechanics. In the research area of diffusion magnetic resonance imaging, convex optimization problems are formed where higher order positive semi-definite space tensors are involved. We investigated these problems from the viewpoint of conic linear programming (CLP). We characterized the dual cone of the positive semi-definite space tensor cone, and studied the CLP formulation and the duality of positive semi-definite space tensor conic programming. We examined the maximum eigenvalue function of an even order real symmetric tensor. As an application, we proposed a generalized Newton method to solve the space tensor conic linear programming problem which arises in medical imaging area. Local convergence rate of this method was established by using the semismooth property of the maximum eigenvalue function. We introduced the tensor conic linear programming (TCLP), which is a generalization of the space TCLP. Then an approximation method, by using a sequence of semidefinite programming problems, was proposed to solve the TCLP. In particular, we reformulated the extreme Z-eigenvalue problem as a special TCLP. It gave a numerical algorithm to compute the extreme Z-eigenvalue of an even order tensor with dimension larger than three, which improves the literature. Numerical experiments showed the efficiency of the proposed method. High angular resolution diffusion imaging (HARDI) and Q-Ball Imaging (QBI) are used to estimate the probability density function (PDF) of the average spin displacement of water molecules. In particular, QBI is used to obtain the diffusion orientation distribution function (ODF) of these multiple fiber crossing. As a probability distribution function, the orientation distribution function should be nonnegative which is not guaranteed in the existing methods. We proposed a novel technique to guarantee the nonnegative property of ODF by solving a convex optimization problem, which has a convex quadratic objective function and a constraint involving the nonnegativity requirement on the smallest Z-eigenvalue of the diffusivity tensor. We proposed a gradient descent algorithm to solve this problem. We also present formulas for determining the principal directions (maxima) of the ODF. Numerical examples on synthetic data as well as MRI data are displayed to demonstrate the significance of our approach.

502510.label: Major findings and research outcome
502510.value: In [1], the l^k-eigenvalues/vectors of a real symmetric square tensor, and some properties on the related l^k-spectral radius of a real nonnegative symmetric square tensor, were studied. In [2], two high-order search directions for tensor decomposition: geometric search direction and algebraic search direction, were proposed. In [3], an explicit linear convergence rate of the Liu-Zhou-Ibrahim (LZI) algorithm for finding the largest eigenvalue of an irreducible nonnegative tensor, was established for weakly positive tensors. In [4], the maximum eigenvalue function of an even order real symmetric tensor was examined. As an application, a generalized Newton method to solve the space tensor conic linear programming problem which arises in medical imaging area, was proposed. Local convergence rate of this method was established by using the semismooth property of the maximum eigenvalue function. In [5], the Q-linear convergence of a power type algorithm for computing the largest eigenvalue of a nonnegative tensors, was established under a weak irreducibility condition. In [6], a novel technique to guarantee the nonnegative property of the diffusion orientatuion distribution function (ODF) in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was proposed by solving a convex optimization problem. Formulas for determining the principal directions (maxima) of the ODF were presented. Numerical examples on synthetic data as well as MRI data were displayed to demonstrate the significance of this approach. In [7], the positive semi-definite space tensor cone constrained convex program, its structure and algorithms, are considered. Convergence of three polyhedral outer approximation algorithms for solving this problem, are established. Some other approaches for solving this structured convex program, are studied. In [8], it was established that finding the maximum eigenvalue of an essentially nonnegative symmetric tensor is equivalent to solving a sum of squares of polynomials (SOS) optimization problem, which, in its turn, can be equivalently rewritten as a semi-definite programming problem. In [9], M-tensors and nonsingular M-tensors were studied. In [10], the tensor conic linear programming (TCLP) was introduced. Then an approximation method, by using a sequence of semidefinite programming problems, was proposed to solve the TCLP. In [11], the space tensor conic programming problem was investigated. The dual cone of the positive semi-definite space tensor cone was characterized, and the duality of positive semi-definite space tensor conic programming was studied. In [12], symmetric tensor spaces and cones arising from polynomial optimization and physical sciences were studied.

502810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
502810.value: Manipulating cells and micro-particles is an important scientific achievement, for example, trapping dielectric spheres, viruses, bacteria, living cells, organelles, small metal particles, and even strands of DNA. Applications of this technique include confinement and organization (cell sorting), tracking of movement of bacteria, application and measurement of small forces, and altering of larger structures (such as cell membranes). Only recently, researchers are able to probe motor properties and address questions such as: Does the motor take individual steps? What is the step size? How much force can the motor produce? Such ability also allows scientists to measure the elasticity of the DNA, as well as the forces under which the DNA breaks or undergoes a phase transition. Optical tweezers has made significant contributions in micro-particle and cell manipulations. It uses a focused laser beam to displace microscopic objects as small as a single atom. Many biological and medical studies were accomplished by this instrument. Acoustic tweezers are motivated by the optical tweezers, however, using sound wave. Similar wave properties and vibration characteristics are shared between sound wave and laser light, which belongs to electromagnetic wave. It is highly likely that the same phenomenon occurs in optical tweezers may happen in an acoustic field. The advantages of acoustic tweezers may include larger cells and particles handling, larger force exertion, operation in light opaque media, less photodamage, cost-effectiveness and small size. A series of recent theoretical studies have shown that under appropriate conditions acoustic trapping of a small particle is possible. In this proposal, we intend to develop an experimental system to validate these theoretical results and to demonstrate the feasibility of acoustic tweezers in manipulating micro-particles in three dimensions. Many potential biomedical applications including moving single cells, measuring intercellular forces, such as those between erythrocytes and sperm motility, are envisioned. 控制细胞和微小粒子是一项重要的科学成就，例如，捕捉介电粒子，病毒，细菌，细胞，細胞器，微小金属粒子，甚至是DNA。这项技术的应用还包括限制和排列细胞，跟踪细菌的运动，施加和测量微小应力，改变细胞膜的结构等。仅仅在最近，科研人员才可以探测运动细胞的特性，并且回答这样的问题：细胞运动是否是步进的？步进的步伐有多大？可以产生多大的力？控制细胞和微小粒子的能力也可以帮助科学家测量DNA的弹性有多大，在多大的力的作用下会断裂或产生突变。镭射光鉗在微小粒子和细胞的控制上有很大贡献。光鉗利用聚焦的镭射光来推动微小物体（单个原子）运动。许多生物和医学的研究也在使用这种仪器。 声钳的提出是基于光鉗的启发。声波和光波有着类似的波动性能和震动特征。在光学领域出现的光鉗现象很有可能在声学领域出现。声钳可以有控制更大的粒子和细胞，产生更大的力，在不透明的介质工作，没有光损伤，造价低廉和小巧的优势。 近期一系列的理论研究显示：在适当的声学条件下捕捉粒子是可行的。在本研究中，我们尝试开发一套实验系统来证实用声钳可以在三维空间中控制微小粒子的可行性。大量的潜在的生物医学上的应用包括移动单个细胞，测量细胞间的作用力，特别是红细胞之间的作用力，研究精子的活性等等。

502910.label: Project Title(Chinese)
502910.value: 量子計算中的數學問題

502910.label: Project Objectives
502910.value: Develop mathematical results, techniques and computer algorithms in quantum computing research There are many mathematical challenges in quantum computing research. For example, quantum systems always interact with the external environment leading to decoherence. As a result, data in a quantum computer and its transmission can be easily corrupted. Hence, to construct useful quantum computers and communicating devices, one has to overcome such problems. This leads to study of quantum error correction (to protect the integrity of the data), quantum tomography (to extract information about a quantum channel), quantum control (to set up initial quantum states for computations, and to manipulate the environment for the evolution of the quantum system), and quantum measurement (to set the mathematical framework in designing the apparatus to extract useful measurement for the quantum algorithm). We will study problems related to these issues. Some sample problems will be mentioned in research plan and methodology. To make sure that we will focus on important and useful problems, we will collaborate with practitioners. We will continue to absorb new ideas from collaborators, and work on new problems. In addition to solving open problems, we will focus on developing new techniques with wide applicability. Moreover, we will develop computer algorithms which will help provide numerical solutions for open problems and provide examples to test conjectures. Building connections between quantum computing researchers from different backgrounds and training young researchers Since quantum computing is a highly inter-disciplinary research area, it is important for researchers from different areas to work together. However, it is well known (as experienced by the two investigators and also witnessed by them in meetings on quantum computing), researchers from different backgrounds (computer science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, etc.) often have problems in their communication. For example, different researchers use different notations and descriptions of problems and results in quantum computing. As a result, it is not easy for them to understand each other, and communicate their problems and results. Further, researchers without the mathematical background may not be able to use mathematical results and formulate mathematical problems properly and effectively. In the last few years, we have overcome the notation and “language” barriers so that we can work with quantum computing researchers from different areas. We will continue to work with different researchers so that we can communicate mathematical results (ours or existing ones) to them. Moreover, we will formulate mathematical problems in quantum computing properly and bring in other mathematicians with different expertise to study the problems. A long term goal of our project is to build up a network between mathematicians and quantum information scientists so that more mathematicians can be involved in the development of quantum information theory. Also, we will involve junior researchers and students in our project so as to build up the work force in quantum computing research.

502910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
502910.value: Quantum information and quantum computing is a rapidly growing research area. It concerns the use of quantum effects in constructing fast computing devices and designing secure and efficient communicating schemes. The quantum computing device (quantum computer) will store and handle data in quantum bits (qubits) and run quantum algorithms, which can solve problems much more efficiently than the digital computers (using binary bits) used nowadays. For instance, Shor has designed a computationally efficient quantum algorithm for factoring large integers. Using this algorithm, one could readily decrypt commonly used cryptosystems (such as the RSA public key cryptography scheme) if a quantum computer is built. This will have a significant impact on security issues in communications and commercial activities. On the other hand, one can use quantum effects such as superposition and entanglement to construct efficient and secure communication schemes (protocols), which help to distribute public key and improve cryptography systems. In fact, quantum cryptography has already been used in financial transactions and computer network protection. The research on quantum computing and quantum information science relies on many branches of sciences including mathematics, physics, chemistry, computer science, information theory, engineering, etc. In particular, mathematics is central to the development of the subject. In this project, we will focus on the mathematical aspect of quantum computing research, and study mathematical problems central to the development. For example, we will consider problems related to completely positive (CP) maps, which describe all quantum operations and channels. We also consider generalized numerical ranges, which are useful in the study of quantum error correction and quantum tomography. Computer algorithms will be developed to provide numerical solutions to some open problems. Numerical results will also help test conjectures on the topic. Furthermore, we will collaborate with experimentalists so that we can focus on important and useful problems. We will also collaborate with other mathematicians so that other mathematical techniques can be brought into the study. This project will lead to important new results, novel proof techniques, computer software, and solutions of open problems, in quantum computing research. The findings will be put in accessible forms and communicated to non-mathematical researchers in the quantum computing community. Additionally, working with practitioners, we will formulate the mathematical problems in quantum computing properly and bring in other mathematicians to study the problems. We also plan to work with young researchers and students so as to build up the workforce for quantum computing research. 量子信息與量子計算為現今一個迅速發展的科學研究課題。此領域乃以量子力學理論為基礎，設計及構建快速計算設備及安全通信方案。量子計算（量子電腦）以量子位元為單位，存儲、處理及運算數據，與現時電腦科技（使用二進制位）相比，量子電腦能更有效地解決複雜問題。例如，由肖爾（Shor）設計，以量子計算為基礎的整數分解法，理論上可以輕易地破解常用的密碼系統（如RSA公鑰加密算法）。量子電腦的面世將在通信和商業安全方面產生深遠影響。另一方面，從量子本身的特性，如疊加性和糾纏性，研究人員能構建有效及安全的通信方案，有助改進現時的加密技術。事實上，量子密碼技術已應用於金融交易及網絡保護等層面上。 量子計算和量子信息建基於多門學科上，包括數學、物理、化學、計算機科學、信息理論、工程學等，尤其以數學為中心。在這個研究項目，我們將集中研究量子計算領域上一些重要數學問題。例如，我們會考慮有關完全正映射的問題，這問題對量子操作和量子渠道的描述有重要幫助。我們還從研究矩陣的數值域以了解有關量子糾錯碼和量子斷層攝影問題。此外對一些未解問題，我們將編寫電腦程式以提供參考數據。電腦程式亦有助求證及測試其他不同猜想。我們還將與實驗人員合作，使我們的研究方向能更專注於領域中的重點問題。我們亦將與其他數學研究人員保持緊密溝通，令其他數學技術能納入本研究之中。 此研究項目冀望能取得新的研究成果、新的證明技術及電腦軟件以解決量子計算科學中未解的問題。研究結果將以最有效的方式分享予領域中其他範疇的研究人員。此外，希望藉此研究項目，吸引更多優秀數學工作者參與研究量子計算的課題。我們還計劃引入青年學者和學生參與研究，從而培養更多量子計算的研究人員。

502910.label: Realisation of objectives
502910.value: The first object of this project is to develop mathematical results, techniques and computer algorithms in quantum computing research. In this project, the PI and Co-I successfully achieved this goal and obtained many mathematical results in several areas in quantum computing research, namely, quantum error correction [Papers 2, 3 and 6 in Pact C], quantum channel [Papers 8 and 9], entanglement criteria [Paper 1], and other areas [Papers 4, 5, 7]. These results have been published in international peer-viewed journals and have been cited by other researchers in mathematics and quantum information science communities. These results have also been presented in various meetings, workshops and conferences. The second object of this project is to build connections between quantum computing researchers from different backgrounds and training young researchers. The PI and Co-I has achieved this goal through organizing workshops in Hong Kong, attending international conferences and workshops, and visit other institutions. During this project period, a workshop on quantum information science was held and more than twenty scholars from Canada, China, Japan, and USA joined the event and shared their works. In particular, the investigators have built up a strong collaboration with Professors Mikio Nakahara and Hiroyuki Tomita, physics professors of Kinki University, Japan. They shared a common interest in the topic of quantum error correction and their collaborative work has been published in [Papers 2, 3 and 6]. The investigators also worked with another physicist, Professor Hoi-Fung of The University Hong Kong. They together worked in the topic of entanglement transformation [Paper 9] and symmetric metric in quantum system [Paper 4]. For training young researchers, a postdoctoral fellow, Dr. Zejun Huang, was recruited in this project. Huang has contributed in various parts of this project and is one of the co-authors of three published papers [Papers 5, 7 and 8] in this project. Some other young researchers also participated in this project, they are Dr. Chi-Hung Fred Fung of The University of Hong Kong [Paper 9] and Dr. Edward Poon of Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University [Papers 8 and 9].

502910.label: Major findings and research outcome
502910.value: In this project, the investigators obtained a sequence of results in the area of quantum error correction. First, they developed a theatrical framework for the quantum error correction using operator approach. They showed that implementation for recovery process in quantum error correction can always be done by unitary gates followed by a trace operation and no syndrome measurement is needed in the process [Paper 6]. Then the investigators have applied this theatrical framework to study collective noises. An efficient implementation scheme for a special case of collective noise, namely, correlated noise, was proposed in [Paper 2] and a recursive scheme for the general case was developed in [Paper 3]. The investigators also studied the problem of quantum entanglement transformation with given initial and final states. They provided a necessary and sufficient condition on the existence of such transformation in [Paper 9]. The investigators also provided some theatrical necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of a quantum transformation (without entanglement restriction) in [Paper 8]. Entanglement criterion has also been studied in this project. Realignment criterion is one of comment criteria used for testing separability. The investigators obtained bounds for elementary symmetric functions of singular values of realignment matrices and this answered a conjecture proposed by Lupo, Aniello, and Scardicchio in [J. Phys. A: Math. Theor. 41 415301 (2008)]. Detail results are presented in [Paper 1]. The investigators also studied other mathematical problem related to quantum information science. In [Paper 4], they extended a result of Chau [Quant. Inform. & Comp. 11, 721–740 (2011)] and showed that any symmetric norm induces a metric on the group of all n by n unitary matrices and proved an inequality concerning the eigenvalues of a product of two unitary matrices which generalized a few inequalities obtained earlier by Chau. Finally in [Paper 7], the investigators considered linear preserver problem related quantum information science. In particular, they considered linear operators on mn by mn Hermitian matrices such that the tensor product of A and B and its image have the same spectrum for any m by m Hermitian A and n by n Hermitian B. The structure of linear maps leaving invariant the spectral radius of matrices in tensor form is also obtained. The results are connected to bipartite (quantum) systems and are extended to multipartite systems.

502910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
502910.value: With the successful collaboration built during this project, the investigators will continue to work with physicists and quantum information scientists in various research areas in quantum information science. In particular, based on the theatrical framework proposed in this project, one of the future investigation directions is to explore all possible applications of this operator quantum error correction. The investigators will continue to explore new quantum error correcting schemes as well as improve and generalize some of those existing schemes. Also they will explore the possibility of experimental realization for the schemes investigated with experientialists in the future.

502910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
502910.value: Quantum information and quantum computing is a rapidly growing research area. It concerns the use of quantum effects in constructing fast computing devices and designing secure and efficient communicating schemes. The research on quantum computing and quantum information science relies on many branches of sciences including mathematics, physics, chemistry, computer science, information theory, engineering, etc. In particular, mathematics is central to the development of the subject. In this project, the investigators focused on the mathematical aspect of quantum computing research, and study mathematical problems central to the development. For example, the investigators proposed a theatrical framework for the study of quantum error correction. The idea of quantum error correction is to protect quantum information from errors due to decoherence and other quantum noise during the transmission of information in quantum channels. This framework has been applied to study various quantum error patterns. The investigators have also obtained other results in the areas of quantum channel, entanglement criterion, and linear preserver problem related to quantum information science. In short, the project has lead to important new results, novel proof techniques, and solutions of open problems, in quantum computing research.

503510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
503510.value: 镧系絡合物爲內生定位細胞周期調節影像技術 幹細胞自我複制機制的失調可能會導致細胞的惡性轉化。迄今爲止，人類對幹細胞自我複制的功能性和分子性的了解還不是很詳盡。近期研究顯示，細胞周期對這個過程有著重大的影響。而當中直最接分析幹細胞周期調節的方法就是把它影像化。傳統的熒光標記法局限于定影和透化作用。因爲利用熒光蛋白的遺傳標記時會涉及到異位蛋白的表達，所以直到目前爲止還沒有一種顯像技術可以實現連續地觀察活細胞的內生細胞周期調節。 我們團隊早前結合了多光子誘導的發光過程、金屬配位化學和特定的镧系絡合物等研究並提出它們在體外生物學上應用。跟常用的有機熒光團相比，镧系離子是一個很好的試驗品。镧系金屬元有長的發光壽命和尖銳的發射峰。更特別是，由于幹細胞是在飼養層的上面生長，所以較適用于厚樣品的镧系生物探針便更能顯出其優勢。多年來對雙光子誘導的發光敏感的镧系探針標記多肽或蛋白的研究幾乎沒有進展。在本研究中，我們把創新的發色基序引入到镧系絡合物，使得整個量子産率都有明顯的提高。 在初步的研究中，我們做了兩個概念驗證的測試：首先我們合成並修飾了細胞周期調節蛋白A 核心片段, 而且證明此多肽與镧系絡合物偶合以後使得熒光信號顯著的增強。其次，我們亦發現以人類血清蛋白標記镧系絡合物後發光信號亦會顯著增強。由此可說明發色團、蛋白和镧系離子之間的能量轉移路徑發生了改變。所以，我們提出透過調查研究能量轉移機理以達到它們在體外成像應用方面最好的分辨效果。初步活細胞成像研究顯示，铕絡合物結合的組蛋白H3的細胞核定位，在子宮頸癌HeLa 細胞中能夠穩定的表達綠色熒光蛋白標記的組蛋白H2B。基于镧系元素特定的性質和初步的研究發現，我們想制定一套以自然化學連接和合成技術去結合多光子可激發的镧系絡合物和一系列去靶向細胞周期調節蛋白的重組基因文庫的常規方法並應用到活細胞成像技術中，希望以此檢測出幹細胞分裂過程中內生定位和細胞周期調節蛋白的結構變化。

503510.label: Major findings and research outcome
503510.value: Major finding Fifteen water-soluble lanthanide complexes/nanomaterials have been synthesized, with linear and two-photon/upconversion-induced photophysical properties of these complexes/nanomaterials being measured and their potential application as dual in vitro imaging and anticancer agents (by inhibition of key cell cycle regulator) evaluated. Most of these complexes/nanomaterials with high luminescence and tumor inhibition effects have been selected for further studies in terms of cellular uptake, subcellular localization, cyto- and photocytotoxicity (under linear and two-photon excitation) using various cancer and normal cells. Some highlights of our project 1. Three types of polymer-coated upconversion nanoparticles (UCNPs) were prepared through a hydrothermal reaction and then a ligand exchange process. They have similar TEM results and DLS size, excellent water solubility, and similar upconversion luminescence efficiency, only differing in their zeta-potential values. In addition, we have demonstrated that UCNP-PEI entered HeLa cells mainly through clarthin-mediated endocytosis. This study is the first report on the cellular uptake mechanism of positively charged UCNPs. (ACS Nano, 2011, 7838) 2. A new water soluble triazine-based europium complex has been synthesized, and it demonstrated a strong two-photon absorption cross-section (320 GM). This particular europium complex has demonstrated low cytotoxicity, cell permeability, and fast cellular uptake, and therefore it has the potential to become a new time-resolved imaging probe that is excitable at a wavelength within the “biological window”—in which light penetration through biological tissue is maximal. (Inorg Chem, 2011, 5309) 3. Two series of dimeric DO3A (1,4,7,10-tetraazacyclodecane-1,4,7-triacetate) lanthanide complexes (LnL1, LnL2, Ln = Eu, Gd, and Tb) have been synthesized with two different bridging chromophores. Photophysical measurements indicated that the bridged antenna in LnL2 gives a higher efficiency than that of LnL1 and was responsive to the protein human serum albumin (HSA), enhancing the f-f luminescence signal with a binding constant log K = 4.84. In vitro imaging of EuL1 and EuL2 in HeLa cells has been recorded, and EuL2 demonstrated a higher rate of cellular uptake and low cytotoxicity (IC50 = 3 mM). (Inorg Chem, 2011, 5517)

503510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
503510.value: This proposal have produced numerous interesting bioprobes for biological application. This is a big step forward in developing a new generation of lanthanide complexes conjugated with responsive chromophore and cyclin-specific peptides as dual probes – imaging and anti-tumors. It is hoped that success in research could also translate to success in practical usage. One question, still unanswered in the cancer field, is the origin of cancer stem cells. Recent evidence suggests that the cell cycle has tremendous influence on this process. Purification of important cell cycle regulators in stem cells (Bmi-1, p21, Cyclin A, Cyclin B1) and tagging these proteins with lanthanide complexes will allow endogenous visualization of proteins mediating the unexpected state of stem cell renewal and cancer stem cell transformation. This could shed new light on interventions that specifically target the cancer stem cell populations based on the studies and results from this proposal.

503510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
503510.value: There are lots of studies on the development of target-specific anti-cancer agents, and one of the vectors is cell cycle regulator, such as cyclin(s) family. The level of this cell cycle regulator in cancer cells is much higher than the normal cells since most of the normal cells in our body are not available for cell division. The inhibition of this cell regulator can be the solution of the development of new anti-cancer drugs hence there is a high demand on the development monitoring and inhibition agents for this cell cycle regulator proteins. The typical imaging agents have some drawbacks however, such as low signal to noise ratio, making it easy to be confused with autofluorescence. Therefore, by using the unique photophysical properties of lanthanide ion as the new generation of imaging agent that can improve the major problems of traditional organic-based imaging probe in cells. In this project, we have tailored-made lanthanide materials which are able to demonstrate significant signal increase after conjugating the peptides with the lanthanide materials with cell cycle regulators (such as Cyclin D). Their photophysical properties were studied and results showed high selectivity on the toxicity in cancer cells, but not in normal cells.

503610.label: Project Objectives
503610.value: To identify the major physiochemical factors and examine their effects on the morphological characteristics of mycelia (filamentous or pellet form; pellet formation and properties) in Cs-HK1 liquid cultures. The initial selection of factors will be based on literature and our preliminary experiments, and the significant factors will be screened out for further investigation. To investigate the physiological and thermodynamic mechanisms of morphological regulation by the physiochemical factors, i.e. their effects on the surface properties of fungal mycelia which are fundamental to mycelial aggregation and pellet formation, and the possible connections to the changes in culture physiology (cell growth kinetics and metabolism). To characterize the mycelial pellet properties (structure, size and density) with respect to the physiochemical and fluid mechanical conditions in an agitated bioreactor; to establish the criteria or design equations for predicting the morphological form (filamentous or pellet) and the pellet size from given sets of physiochemical parameters (e.g. mycelia hydrophobicity and zeta potential) and fluid mechanical parameters (e.g. agitation power, and shear force). To investigate the relationships between mycelial morphology, EPS formation and broth rheology and to derive the optimal fermentation conditions and favorable pellet morphology for efficient bioreactor operation, high EPS yields and effective mycelia-liquid separation, respectively.

503610.label: Major findings and research outcome
503610.value: 1. Three major factors, (1) type and concentration of major carbon and nitrogen sources, (2) medium pH and (3) addition of surfactants to the liquid medium, had significant influence on mycelial morphology and aggregation (pellet formation and size) of a medicinal fungus Cs-HK1 in liquid culture. With decrease of the glucose concentration from 40 g/L to 20 g/L and elimination of yeast extract, and use peptone as the sole nitrogen source in the culture medium, the mycelial morphology was changed from filamentous form to aggregated pellet form, and meanwhile the biomass growth and EPS production were significantly decreased. Addition of surfactants inhibited the pellet formation and aggregation. No direct relationship found between mycelial morphology and EPS productivity. 2. Surfactant Tween 80 added to the culture medium could significant enhanced the EPS production, though the effective concentration of 1.5% (w/v) was quite high and not desirable for large-scale application. Two possible mechanisms for Tween 80 enhancement of EPS production: stimulation of EPS biosynthesis activity in the fungal cells and stimulation of the cell membrane permeability (facilitating release EPS and nutrient uptake). 3. The variation of culture nutrients such as the carbon sources could also influence the properties of EPS such as monosaccharide composition and molecular weight. 4. The Cs-HK1 mycelial fermentation was successfully scaled up to industrial fermenters in large volumes (2000-5000 L). The mycelial growth and EPS yields attained in the large industrial fermenters were event higher than in small shake-flasks due probably to more effective oxygen transfer and mixing conditions. 5. The mycelial fermentation broth exhibited pseudoplastic rheology following the power-law, with the flow behavior index n decreasing from 0.5-0.3 and the flow consistency K, and the apparent viscosity a increasing with time and biomass concentration.

503610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
503610.value: Cs-HK1 mycelial fermentation has been carried out in small laboratory culture vessels and large industrial fermenters. Both the mycelia biomass and polysaccharides produced have great potential for commercial application in functional foods, health care products and biomaterials because of their notable bioactivities and/or special molecular properties. We are still looking for industrial partners to further develop the technology and to commercialize in the near future. Research is undergoing in the P-I’s lab to evaluate the properties of EPS produced by Cs-HK1 for potential functional foods (e,g. prebiotics and dietary fibers) and to use the EPS for green synthesis of Ag nanoparticles.

503610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
503610.value: Polysaccharides from medicinal fungi provide an attractive source of nutraceutical and therapeutic products because of their anticancer and immunomodulation activities, and other medicinal properties. Liquid fermentation has been widely explored for the production of mushroom mycelia and PS, especially the exopolysaccharides (EPS). Mycelial morphology is a determining factor on the flow properties of fermentation broth, imposing strong influence on the performance and productivity of fermentation. Cordyceps (Dong-chong-xia-cao) is a highly valued medicinal fungus in China. In this project, we investigated the factors affecting the mycelial morphology, and the biomass growth, and EPS production of a Cordyceps fungus Cs-HK1 in liquid fermentation systems. Through our project, we have found the suitable conditions and effective measures for efficient production of biomass and EPS. The products from the Cs-HK1 mycelial fermentation have shown notable health effects (antitumor, antioxidant, and antifatigue), and promising potential for commercial application in functional foods, health care products and biomaterials. Several high quality papers have been published in internal scientific journals from the research results, attracting word wide interest.

504010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
504010.value: 從歷史上看，天然產物是新藥結構的重要來源。進化過程中物競天擇的自然規律，使得生物產生了大量的、具有生物活性的天然產物。這些天然產物作為先導結構經過化學家的優化，產生出更多的具有特殊作用的藥物分子。天然產物及其類似物的化學合成一直是藥物研發的重要手段。當天然產物不能從自然資源中大量獲得以滿足生物活性測試和相關研究的需要時，化學合成天然產物則可以解決這一問題。同時化學合成還可以提供對天然產物結構修飾的類似物庫，為提高先導化合物的活性、改善物化和生化指標提供可能。化學合成同時對構效關係分析也非常重要，因為構效關係研究本身需要獲得大量先導化合物的結構類似物。 本項目的研究重點是新分離的抗癌天然產物分子rhizopodin，它具有強大的、在低納摩爾濃度抑制腫瘤細胞生長的活性。其抑制效果源於rhizopodin能與肌動蛋白相互作用，並通過與G-肌動蛋白關鍵位點的絡合來干擾肌動蛋白組成的細胞骨架結構。 Rhizopodin是38元環大環內酯，其獨特結構包括兩個共軛二烯結構、兩個雙取代的噁唑以及兩個含有enamide的側鏈。重要的生物學活性及其生物來源的限制，再加上其獨特的分子結構，使rhizopodin成為全合成研究和進一步抗癌藥物開發的目標分子之一。到目前為止，還沒有關於rhizopodin全合成的報導發表。 本研究的長遠目標是以rhizopodin為基礎，通過分子設計、化學合成和生物測試來開發具有抗癌活性的、結構簡化的藥物先導化合物。針對rhizopodin的合成，本研究設計合理的策略和方法，使之可以方便的用於結構修飾和改進研究。我們也將合成rhizopodin的結構類似物庫，並確定其生物活性的關鍵結構位點。這一研究項目對rhizopodin全合成和類似物的合成，以及相應的藥物研發等領域，都會有特殊的貢獻。

504010.label: Realisation of objectives
504010.value: We have developed three strategies toward the total synthesis of rhizopodin. One of the approached has led to the formal-synthesis of this natural product. During the research period, we have published 11 papers, and also disclosed some important information to the synthetic medicinal community. Since the final product only obtained in very small quantity, and therefore, the biological testing work has been limited to a number of analogues.

504010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
504010.value: The studies focus on a newly isolated anticancer natural product called rhizopodin. Biological studies of this natural product indicated that it possesses potent cytostatic activity against a range of tumor cell lines in the low nanomolar range. The long-term goal of this research is to develop highly effective anticancer agents from rhizopodin, and to carry out the molecular design, chemical synthesis and biological testing of simpler biological mimics of this molecule. We have prepared a number of analogues of rhizopodin by organic synthesis, this also led to the formal total synthesis of rhizopodin. The investigation towards the total synthesis of rhizopodin and its analogues set up the basis for further development of anti-cancer drugs based on this natural product.

510410.label: Project Title(Chinese)
510410.value: 多工廠生產環境下的協調機器維護及分佈排程

510410.label: Project Objectives
510410.value: To investigate the role of machine maintenance and availability in Distributed Scheduling (DS). To study production capability of factories subject to machine failures and maintenance as well as to investigate various coordination mechanisms such as the optimal maintenance and production rerouting strategies. To establish mathematical models for integrating machine maintenance and DS into a joint decision making framework to fully realize the benefits of DS in industrial organizations. To develop a new optimization methodology for this complex decision making process.

510410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
510410.value: The demand for Distributed Scheduling (DS) is increasing as single factory production is gradually giving way to multi-factory production. Multi-factory production allows manufacturers to perform production in different locations. This provides the manufacturers with the ability to make factories closer to customers, take advantage of favorable legal jurisdictions, focus on specific product types, produce more effectively, and respond to market changes more rapidly. By implementing DS, system reliability and resource utilization can be maximized through the collaboration of different supply chain activities. However, DS problems face more challenges than traditional scheduling problems. In DS, local-level scheduling problems for each factory must be addressed in conjunction with the global considerations of job allocation and factory capacity and resources. The factory capacity is based on the number of machines and their availabilities. The latter is dependent on machine reliability and its maintenance. Maintenance as a critical element in different forms (perfect, imperfect, corrective, preventive, and condition-based) directly influences machine availability, production rates, product quality, and utilization ratios. If machine maintenance is not appropriately incorporated in DS, the production schedules and system reliability will be negatively impacted. Although DS-related mathematical models and solution algorithms have been extensively studied, machine maintenance has not been investigated for such multi-factory production environments. This is the first research that intends to incorporate machine availability in such environment. This project aims at investigating the role of machine maintenance (availability) in DS and integrating the two into a joint decision making framework to fully realize the benefits of DS in industrial organizations. Our main research focus will be on the study of production capability of factories subject to machine failures and maintenance as well as the investigation of various coordination mechanisms such as the optimal maintenance and production rerouting strategies. The joint decision making framework requires the development of mathematical models for maintenance and production scheduling under various realistic constraints in multi-factory production environments. To facilitate the complex decision making process, a new optimization methodology will be developed in the course of the project computationally efficient for relatively large systems with several factories and machines.. The expected research results will provide a new research paradigm for the future study of DS. 由於單一工廠生產逐漸被多工廠生產替代，以致對分佈排程(DS)的需求亦相對增加。多工廠生產允許製造者在不同的地點生產，使製造商能夠把工廠設置在較近顧客的地方、佔有利法律管轄權的優勢、專注特定產品類型、更有效地生產，并且更加迅速地對市場改變作出反應。 通過實施DS，系統可靠性和資源運用可以透過協調不同供應鏈活動而獲得最優化。然而， DS問題比傳統的排程問題面對更多的挑戰。在DS，每一所工廠局部性的排程問題必須與整體工廠的工作分配、工廠產能和資源一起考慮及處理。工廠的生產能力是根據機器的數量及其可用性而評估的。而後者則十分依賴機器可靠性和它的維護。維護是其中一個重要元素並以不同的形式(完美，不完美，矯正，預防和基於狀況)直接地影響機器可用性、生產率、產品質素和運用比率。如果機器維護沒有適當地與DS協調，會對生產排程和系統可靠性產生不良的影響。 雖然與DS相關的數學模型和解答算法已廣泛地被研究，但是這些研究項目並沒有涉及多工廠生產環境下的機器維護。因此，這是首份研究將機器的可用性協調於這種生產環境。 這個項目主要研究機器維護(可用性)在DS的角色及結合兩者於一個聯合決策架構下使之能充分地實現DS的好處。我們的焦點是研究工廠在機器故障和維護下的生產能力以及不同的協調機制例如最優化的維護和重選生產路徑的策略。建立一個聯合決策架構需要發展機器維護和生產排程的數學模型並且能夠適用於多種現實限制及多工廠生產環境。為了在複雜決策過程中容易作出決定，這個項目將會開發新的優化方法學適合於相對大型的系統並有多個工廠和機器用作高效率計算。這個項目的研究結果期望為未來提供一個新的DS研究範例。

510410.label: Realisation of objectives
510410.value: Objective 1 (100% achieved) A distance-based fuzzy Multi-Criterion Decision-Making (MCDM) approach was developed for the proper maintenance policy selection in production scheduling. Maintenance process enhances customer satisfaction and reliability of products meanwhile it can increase the profitability of manufacturers. The developed MCDM approach is efficient in incorporating data, in the form of linguistic variables, triangular fuzzy numbers, and crisp numbers, into the evaluation process of maintenance policy alternatives. The proposed method provides the means for integrating the economic figure of merit with the strategic performance variables and avoids the induction of extra direct cost due to inefficient maintenance policy. Objective 2 (100% achieved) A set of machine failure rate diagrams was developed for the modelling of machine failure probability along with the cumulative machine operating time. More importantly, these diagrams were able to indicate the estimated maintenance lead time required at different periods along with the cumulative operating time. Based on these diagrams, production capability of factories was being able to estimate more efficiently and precisely. In addition, with the support of these diagrams, we were being able to optimise the maintenance policy/strategy being adopted and the optimal time to schedule necessary preventive maintenance to be taken place. Objective 3 (100% achieved) A number of mathematical models were developed for the integration of preventive machine maintenance with Distributed Scheduling (DS) in order to make a joint decision making framework. The preventive maintenance operations were modelled as one of the production operations built inside a production schedule. The operations lead times used by the maintenance operations were defined by the machine failure rate diagrams as mentioned before. Objective 4 (100% achieved) Genetic Algorithms (GA) were developed to solve the mathematical models developed above. In order to make the GA be more specialised in searching for an optimal preventive maintenance operation, a multi-dimensional chromosome was designed to represent job, operation, machine, and maintenance. To further enhance the genetic searching ability, dominated genes modelling approach was being proposed to control the genetic crossover operations. In addition, various novel mutation approaches were designed and developed in order to balance the work load between factories, meanwhile increasing the diversity of the solution pool to avoid local trapped.

510410.label: Major findings and research outcome
510410.value: (1) For the development of the maintenance policy selection decision support tool, a lot of decision support factors have to be considered simultaneously, e.g. product quality, system reliability, maintenance cost, etc. Some of these factors were linguistics. Thus traditional approaches such as Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) may not be appropriate. Accordingly, fuzzy logic was applied and a distance-based fuzzy Multi-Criterion Decision-Making (MCDM) approach was developed. The fuzzy MCDM approach evaluated the alternatives on the basis of the proximity ratio, not on the basis of the distance from the Fuzzy Positive Ideal Solution (FPIS) and Fuzzy Negative Ideal Solution (FNIS) solutions. The results of the proposed decision-making algorithm were compared with other traditional decision making algorithms. The comparison results indicated that the proposed algorithm outperformed the others, leading to higher-quality products, better economy, and higher profitability [Part C(8)-item1]. (2) To study the integrated machine maintenance with Distributed Scheduling (DS) joint decision frameworks, DS problems have been studied first of all. In order to maximise the benefits of distributed scheduling, various types of manufacturing collaborations have been studied. In general, manufacturing networks can be classified into vertical, horizontal, and lateral one. Based on the research findings, we observed that lateral collaboration outperforms the others in terms of total operating cost reduction [Part C(8)-item2]. (3) Genetic algorithms (GA) were developed to solve the integrated model [Part C(8)-item3]. Various preventive maintenance schemes and machine failure diagrams were developed and investigated. The situations of with and without considering integrating maintenance into production schedule were being analysed. With reference to the experimental results, although the integrated model is much more complicated and required a slightly longer computational time than that under the without integrated situation, the production capacity of the factories can then be fully utilized [Part C(8)-item3 & Part C(9)-items1-2]. Accordingly, the penalty cost induced by order delay can be reduced significantly. More importantly, the developed algorithms were able to assign preventive maintenance operations and make the best use of the machine idle time for maintenance [Part C(8)-item4 & Part C(9)-items3-4]. Moreover, benefited from the integrated decision, the number of maintenance operations carried out can be reduced. In other words, the total cost spending on maintenance was reduced.

510410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
510410.value: In fact, although the developed integrated machine maintenance with distribution scheduling model and the developed genetic algorithms have been applied and testified in a case company and the results are very promising, it is believed that the model can be even more robust if the following suggestions can be achieved: 1. The current model was optimised under a deterministic environment. However, uncertainties are inevitable in reality, which may exist in production lead time, and machine maintenance lead time. It is known that deviation from the expected lead time may lead to delay of the consequent operations. In this connection, uncertainties at different stages of production should be analysed and considered. Stochastic modeling can be one of the possible approaches to model them. 2. In the existing machine failure modeling, linear and piecewise linear modeling approaches were being used to approximate the machine failure rate. To further increase the accuracy, continuous curvy should be used. This can be done by modeling the scenarios using various distribution functions.

510410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
510410.value: To summarise, this project successfully studied the impact of machine maintenance on production schedule. Machine maintenance is inevitable. After certain operating time, the product quality and the production reliability most likely may go down. Meanwhile the machine failure rate may increase. When machine failure happens, the whole production system will be interrupted (stopped) and the planned operation(s) may not be able to start, resulting in job delay. Moreover, we understand that the longer the machine operated, the longer the maintenance lead time will be. In order to minimise the production interruptions due to the unexpected machine failure, preventive machine maintenance has been scheduled with production scheduling simultaneously. Based on the analytical results obtained from simulation experiments and industrial case studies, integrated scheduling of preventive machine maintenance, in general, will benefit the production schedule. First of all, the reliability of the production schedule can be improved due to the minimisation of machine failure rate. Moreover, the machine utilisation can also be increased by avoiding the long maintenance lead time induced. Lastly, job delay can also be minimised due to the adequate allocation of machine maintenance operations into the machine idling time. As a conclusion, all the objectives listed in the proposal are completed.

510610.label: Project Objectives
510610.value: To identify and study the new requirements and issues of developing pervasive computing middleware systems based on UIOs, considering the technology advances in cyber-physical objects. To design the system model, architecture, and major functional mechanisms and algorithms for achieving UIO-based middleware functions, including UIO interactions, discovery and maintenance of contextual relationships between UIO, service management, and context management. To evaluate the effectiveness and performance of the proposed mechanisms and algorithms through theoretical analysis and simulations. To build test-bed and prototype to implement the proposed middleware framework with mechanisms and algorithms, and develop example applications using the prototype to experiment and demonstrate the research results.

510610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
510610.value: Most existing middleware systems for pervasive computing are based on a top-down, centralized model where a central controlling entity facilitates and coordinates the functional operations of component devices deployed in the system. As technology advances in nano-scale semiconductor, wireless communications and microelectro-mechanical system (MEMS), devices will be made smaller and smaller, and more and more intelligent in terms of sensing, computing and communication capabilities. In the foreseeable future, a pervasive computing environment will be embedded with large number of devices augmented with such intelligent capabilities. The current middleware models need to be improved because they are designed with the view that the component devices are passive objects and need to be centrally managed. Given the increasing number of embedded devices, centralized middleware architecture compromises the scalability of the middleware. More importantly, the increasing capability of the component devices can be used to alleviate the role and load of the central controlling entity and facilitate the design of distributed and localized algorithms for achieving middleware functions. In this project, we propose an alternative bottom-up, decentralized approach to designing and programming pervasive computing middleware functions based on ubiquitous interacting objects (UIOs), which are smart devices augmented with various processing capabilities. Many middleware functions, such as service discovery, service composition, context derivation and inconsistency checking, can be performed through the decentralized interaction and collaboration of the UIOs. Building these functions into individual UIOs will facilitate the deployment of pervasive computing applications because the UIOs can autonomously discover and coordinate with each other to carry out the middleware and application-specific functions, with the minimum support from the central controller. Also, without relying heavily on central controllers, the proposed approach makes the middleware system more scalable and flexible. Designing UIO-based middleware functions using a bottom-up, decentralized approach faces many challenging problems. We will identify and address the fundamental issues, and seek for effective and efficient solutions. We believe that pervasive computing systems based on UIOs is the trend in the near future. The results and findings of this project will facilitate the development of high-performance pervasive computing middleware and applications, such as smart space, social networking, logistics, transportation, pervasive-care, and intelligent construction and building management. As the Hong Kong SAR government has been greatly promoting the development of innovative technologies, the contribution of this project is highly relevant and has special significance to Hong Kong scientific and industrial community and society. 现有的大多数普适计算中间件系统都基于一种自顶向下，集中式的模型，它们需要一个集中控制实体来帮助和协调部署在系统当中的各个部件的运作。随着 诸如纳米半导体器件，无线通信和微机电系统（MEMS）等技术进步，设备将会变得越来越小，而且会被嵌入感知，计算和通信能力，从而越来越智能 化。在可预见的未来，大量的这类智能设备会被嵌入到普适计算环境当中。目前的中间件设计中，组成系统的设备被视为是被动的对象，需要集中化的管 理，因此这种中间件模型需要被改进。在嵌入设备数量不断增大的情况下，集中式的中间件体系结构会制约其可扩展性。更加重要的是，各个部件不断增强 的计算能力可以用来减轻集中控制实体的负载和作用，并且可以帮助实现分布式，局部化的算法和机制。 在本项目中，我们提出了一种自底向上，非集中化的方法来设计和实现基于普适交互对象（UIO）的普适计算中间件。其中的UIO是指嵌入了各种计算 和信息处理能力的智能设备。很多中间件功能，例如服务发现，服务组合，情景推理和一致性检查等，可以通过多个UIO之间的分布式交互和协作来完 成。把这些功能内置到单个UIO中可以方便普适计算应用的部署，这是因为这些UIO可以自主地发现对方并且互相合作，只需要中央控制实体最少的支 持就可以完成某些中间件和应用特定的功能。此外，由于对中央控制实体的依赖性很小，因此我们提出的方法能够让中间件系统更具有可扩展性和灵活性。 用自底向上，非集中化的方法设计基于UIO的中间件功能面临很多挑战。需要确定和研究其中的基本问题，寻找有效和高效的解决方法。我们相信基于 UIO的普适计算系统是将来的发展趋势。本项目研究的结果和发现将会帮助开发高性能普适计算中间件和应用系统，例如智能空间，社会网络，后勤管 理，智能交通，医疗保健，以及智能建筑和房屋管理。香港特区政府历来非常支持创新技术的开发，而这个项目的贡献与之紧密相关，并且对于香港科学和 工业界及社会都有重要意义。

510610.label: Realisation of objectives
510610.value: To study the requirements and identify research issues of developing pervasive computing middleware, we have conducted extensive review on the existing literature and projects. We found a clear trend that the cyber world is being integrated with the physical world rapidly. The physical devices in our surrounding environments become increasingly interconnected and embedded with sensing and computing capabilities. They are able to collaborate to build a smart environment that can understand various contextual situations and proactively provide desired services to users. However, realizing such device collaboration and pervasive service provisioning is not easy, and we have identified grand research challenges, including device heterogeneity, interaction and coordination, service composition and scalability. We proposed a UIO-based model for developing pervasive computing systems, which provides a high level abstraction of various kinds of devices and allows us to address the above issues. UIO stands for Ubiquitous Interacting Objects, which are devices, in addition to their original physical functions, augmented with sensing, computing and communication capabilities. Essentially, the UIO model is a unified abstraction for smart objects. Each UIO is composed of four interfaces, namely inter-UIO interaction interface, intra-UIO adapter interface, local environment interface and maintenance interface, and several functional components including plug-and-play (PnP), context management, service management, and so on. UIO modeling enables a localized, bottom-up approach to developing pervasive computing middleware functions, which will become more scalable, efficient, and reliable. By utilizing the UIO model, we developed a pervasive computing system architecture and identified many crucial middleware functions, including context modeling and derivation, service discovery, service composition, UIO contextual relationship detection and maintenance, etc. In the middleware layer, the research challenge lies in how to enable UIOs to collaboratively achieve these functions efficiently. So far, we have realized the following key middleware functions. First, we utilized the set theory and developed a novel method to model and manipulate contexts. Each context is defined as a set of context entries and operators are introduced to specify how to manipulate contexts according to the needs of different applications. Second, we designed a localized algorithm, called LASEC, for efficient service composition. This algorithm allows UIOs to collaborate with each other in a bottom-up, localized manner to compose required services without requiring global knowledge. Third, we developed a distributed mechanism to detect contextual relationship between UIOs in the highly dynamic pervasive computing environment. Contextual relationships are formulated as predicates, and this mechanism relies on distributed predicate detection algorithms to achieve significant communication overhead reduction. We have built a prototype of the middleware system over wireless sensor nodes (Telosb and Micaz motes) and PCs. We have mainly focus on the support for the development of pervasive services in a bottom-up decentralized way. Different types of UIOs using the middleware functions can discover each other and work together for various functions and services. As demonstration, two application scenarios have been developed using those UIO prototypes. One is a smart office where chair UIO, table UIO, computer UIO, light UIO, and projector UIO can interact with each other to assist people in doing their office work. The other is a smart wheelchair for elderly healthcare at home, which can perform auto-navigation by communicating and collaborating with nearby UIO devices. Through these UIO prototypes and applications, we illustrate that i) UIO is a feasible and powerful vehicle to enable large-scale pervasive computing systems, and ii) the UIO-based middleware can greatly ease the development of pervasive computing applications.

510610.label: Major findings and research outcome
510610.value: Our research outcome generated from this project is fruitful, mainly including 7 journal papers, 10 conference/workshop papers, and several demonstration systems. Meanwhile, several MPhil/PhD students have been trained owing to the funding support of this project. The students were all supported to attend the conferences, and our publications have received international recognition from the pervasive computing community. The first notable result generated from this project is a survey paper on pervasive computing middleware systems [J2013a]. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first survey in this area. It categorizes and compares the existing middleware systems, points out their strengths/weaknesses, and discusses some potential research directions. Researchers can benefit from this survey by gaining a global view about the recent development in this area. Also through the extensive literature study, the importance and necessity of this project become clearer to us. The UIO-based approach proposed in our project will bring a fundamental change to this area. Future pervasive computing systems, like Smart Cities and Smart Internet-of-Things, are all large-scale systems intrinsically involving device heterogeneity and great system dynamicity. Our approach is especially suitable for tackling these issues, and will serve as a competitive solution to building these systems. Having understood the importance of UIO concept, we further developed a middleware architecture based on UIO, and lots of underlying algorithms/mechanisms to enable efficient middleware systems. Some of our important results are summarized as follows. First, in [J2012a], we proposed a scalable and efficient algorithm for service composition, which is a key function in the middleware. With this algorithm, advanced services can be provided to users by composing multiple simple services together. Second, we developed a novel mechanism for context modeling and reasoning based on set theory [J2011a]. This method makes manipulation of contexts possible without losing mathematical rigor. Third, localization is a driving function for a lot of popular location-based pervasive computing applications. In [C2012e] [J2014a], we leveraged RFID readers/tags to achieve localization. Also, we studied accurate localization by using wireless sensor networks [C2012b]. Fourth, leader election has a wide range of applications in pervasive computing. We developed an efficient top-K leader election algorithm in the distributed and mobile environment [J2014b]. Fifth, we investigated how to build a map of contextual links among different UIOs. A communication-efficient distributed algorithm has been proposed in [C2012f] to detect dynamic contextual links. Aside from the above theoretical output, we have also conducted experimental studies and acquired rich experiences and results from real-world evaluation. To build UIO prototypes, we developed a method to transform the daily physical objects to UIOs, and validated its feasibility in [C2012a]. So far, many UIO prototypes have been implemented in our lab, such as UIO chair, UIO lamp, UIO table, etc. We further built a middleware system running over diverse UIO devices and network protocols. The middleware serves as a proof-of-concept for this project and supports many interesting pervasive computing applications. The first application we implemented is a smart wheelchair, which is capable of understanding user’s sitting posture and performing auto-navigation by cooperating with other nearby UIO devices [C2012a]. The second is a video surveillance application by utilizing the pub/sub function in the middleware [C2011d]. After the evaluation studies, we found that the development of pervasive computing applications can be greatly simplified by utilizing a UIO-based middleware, which can automatically provide desired services for the application layer by autonomous UIO collaboration.

510610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
510610.value: Now that the project is completed, we believe there also exist many aspects for further research and development. In the following, we will mainly introduce two promising directions. First, the UIO-based approach proposed in this project is especially suitable for large-scale and dynamic pervasive computing systems. To make full of the results in this project, it will be interesting to apply them in some societally crucial systems, like Smart Cities. On one hand, we can further evaluate the performance of our proposed approaches. On the other hand, it will allow us to further explore the potential of adopting the UIO concept in system development. To achieve this goal, a feasible initial step is that we can start by focusing on some crucial elements in Smart Cities, such as Civil Infrastructure, and Transportation Systems, and make them smart by applying our UIO-based approaches. In fact, currently we have been discussing with the civil engineering department in our university for collaborative research. Second, since most of the algorithms developed in this project do not consider faults, there exists a big room for enhancing these algorithms to make them robust. In real world, faults are common, e.g., a traffic light UIO’s hardware can fail. Apparently, fault-tolerance adds another dimension of challenge to this research. However, fault-tolerant algorithms will make pervasive computing systems more practical and more sustainable.

510610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
510610.value: In the foreseeable future, our living and working environments will be embedded with large number of devices augmented with sensing, communication and computing capabilities. They can collaborate together to build large-scale pervasive computing systems, which can provide various desired services to users. To enable such large-scale systems, in this project we proposed a novel paradigm, that is, a bottom-up, decentralized approach, to build middleware functions for pervasive computing systems. This approach relies on a key concept called UIO (Ubiquitous Interacting Object), which essentially is a unified model for the diverse smart objects. By UIO modeling, we can gain a lot of benefits, such as autonomous device interaction and collaboration, resolution of device heterogeneity and scalability issues, etc. The feasibility and advantages of our approaches have been validated by many prototype systems. As a pioneering research, the outcome generated from this project will pave the way for building future pervasive computing systems involving the participation of large number of devices. Many societally important areas, such as transportation and healthcare, can benefit from the outcome. In addition, it will also have great impacts on a wide range of other areas, including mobile and wireless networking, autonomic computing, etc.
