510910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
510910.value: Over the years, combustion science has progressed tremendously to become a coherent discipline that is supported by both mathematical analysis and empirical data. In many industrial or domestic burners ranging from power turbines to gas heaters, turbulence in combustion processes plays a key role. Generally, the primary objective is to achieve stable combustion under lean burning conditions because the leaner the flame, the lower the amount of NOx produced, thereby introducing less pollutant into the environment. Therefore, research into the physical and chemical processes in turbulent combustion remains vital for improved energy efficiency and environmental protection. It is commonly known that major parameters affecting turbulent combustion are fuel-air mixture, flame configuration and turbulence intensity. These factors influence the overall burning rate of combustion conditions. While burning velocity for premixed flame propagation in laminar flow depends only on the diffusive-reactive property of the mixture, turbulent burning velocity is more complex and depends on turbulence characteristics as well as interaction with the ongoing combustion process. The relationship between turbulent burning velocity and its laminar counterpart has been the subject of much research in the past few years. Experimental and numerical work have been widely adopted on several types of flames, namely the Bunsen flame, the rod-stabilized flame, the stagnation flame and the expanding spherical flame. Recently, attention has been paid to the weakly swirl-stabilized freely propagating flame. The swirl-stabilized flame is of particular interest as it allows much leaner combustion, thereby producing a lesser amount of NOx. In recent years, “large eddy simulation” has also received much attention in computational fluid dynamics and is recognized as a powerful tool for numerical simulations of reacting flows. Although considerable work is still needed to improve its robustness, the rapid development of computer technology and computational techniques has made LES the main CFD tool for engineering design. In this project, a swirl-stabilized turbulent flame based on finite step reaction will be studied numerically. LES will be used to study the flow field, with emphasis on the SGS model used. Flow and flame configurations will include different turbulence intensities and fuel-air mixtures. Results of the numerical simulation will be compared with experimental data from LBNL, USA. It is expected that with the development of robust computational methods, the techniques can be applied to more practical combustion situations, allowing designers of premixed burners to predict quantities such as turbulent burning speed and perhaps regions of local extinction. 多年來，燃燒科學在數學分析與實證資料支持下已進展到成為一個連貫的學科。湍流燃燒對輪機到氣體熱水爐等許多工業或家用燃燒器起著關鍵的作用。湍流燃燒主要為實現精益燃燒條件下的穩定燃燒提供精簡火焰及低NOx的產生，從而減少環境污染，因此，在湍流燃燒中的物理和化學過程的研究仍然非常重要。 由於影響湍流燃燒的主要參數是燃料-空氣混合物、火焰配置和湍流強度，這些因素影響整體燃燒率的燃燒條件。雖然在層流燃燒速度的預混火焰傳播只取決於這種混合物的擴散，但湍流燃燒速度更為複雜，並取決於湍流特性，以及與正在進行的燃燒過程的雙互關係。 湍流燃燒速度和對應的層流燃燒速度的關係已在過去的幾年中受到很多研究，實驗與模擬數值計算的工作已被廣泛採用在幾種類型的火焰包括接合火焰、杆穩定火焰、停滯火焰和擴大的球形火焰。最近，弱旋流對穩定自由傳播火焰的研究開始被重視，主要原因在於它允許更精簡的燃燒從而產生較低的氮氧化物。 近年來「大渦模擬法」在計算流體動力學中備受重視，並被公認為反應流數值模擬的有效工具。雖然其全面性仍然需要大量的工作，計算技術與電腦技術的快速發展已使「大渦模擬法」成為工程設計的主要CFD工具。我們將利用數值方法在單相反應基礎下研究湍流火焰的穩定性，並側重于研究使用「大渦模擬法」的SGS模型。流和火焰配置將包括不同湍流強度和燃料-空氣混合物。數值模擬結果將與美國LBNL實驗資料進行比較。預計隨著計算方法的發展，技術可以應用於預混燃燒器的設計及局部火焰熄滅的預測。

510910.label: Realisation of objectives
510910.value: Numerical model of a swirl-stablized flame has been studied using large eddy simulation. By means of the open source code OpenFOAM, flame configurations in conventional combustion, high temperature combustion and flameless combustion modes with finite rate chemiostry have been investigated. The effect of confinement on the freely propagating swirl-stabilized flame was examined under a wide range of flame conditions. In addition, LES of incompressible heat and fluid flows past a cylinder at different Reynolds numbers were carried out to provide more understanding to the complex reactive flow configuration. The mechanism of flame and flow interaction were specially studied with different Reynolds numbers and wall temperature effect. Analysis of different fuel-air mixture and different reaction rates have been done to have a fuller understanding of the combustion and flow characteristics. Three research personnel, one Research Fellow and two Research Assistants, were employed in the course of the project to assist with the development fof the numerical work, implementating the computer codes and the ananlysis of numerical results. One paper has been puiblished by one of the top refereed journals. Another paper is under final review after some minor revision and a third paper has also been submitted for publication and is under review. Overall, the project objectives have been achieved during the course of the project.

510910.label: Major findings and research outcome
510910.value: Based on experience gained from previous projects when the numerical techniques involved discreter vortex method and contour advectiuon with surgery, approach of the current project had mainly been using large eddy simulation, which is most convenient as it is less demanding in computer power, but able to treat flow geometry and boundary conditions accurately than the previously used conventional Reynolds-Averaged technique. Within LES, a open source code OpenFOAM has been used. The code is specially suitable for simulating reactive flows with different reaction mecahnisms. It also allows the implementation of parallel computing which is essential for simulating the complex flame/flow interections. Therefore, numerical part of the project was focused on using LES. As turbulence/flame interaction is particularly important in premixed combustion, LES was used to study the flow field, with emphasis on the sub-grid scale model used. Numerical simulations were used to compare with experiemtnal data under the same flow and flame conditions obtained at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, USA previously. Specifically, flame and flow structure of a freely propagating swirl-stabilized flame were invetsigated in the conventional mode, high temperature combustion mode (HiTC) and flameless mode with finite rate chemstry and one-step combustion mechanism. As reported in our paper submitted for publication, moving from conventional combustion mode towards HiTC mode solely by increasing the preheating level results in several phenomena. Firstly, the combustor is more prone to formation of thermal NOx due to higher temperature of product. Secondly, the risk of flash back increases due to lower value of Karlovitz stretch rate. Thirdly, the flame becomes shorter and thinner due to modification of laminar flame speed. Lastly, turbulent kinetic energy of incoming flow grows. On the other hand, approaching the flameless mode, by leaning the highly preheated mixture, leads to an almost thermal-NOx free combustion with lower risk of flashback as well as thicker and longer flames without any significant modification of turbulence level upstream. This finding indicates that designing a combustion system inside or close to flameless mode could be an optimized solution for exploiting the mixture preheating method in lean premixed combustion. Qualitative agreement between simulated results and experiments also shows the capability of LES PaSR model and one step tuned mechanism for capturing main features of the turbulent flame in a wide range of mixture temperatures and equivalence ratios.

510910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
510910.value: While the present project has demonstrated that numerical simulation of turbulent premixed combustion, in particular large eddy simulation, is suitable for predicting freely propagating swirl-stabilized combustion, a few areas have been identified for futher development. With the advancement of computer power, more detailed chemistry associated with reaction mechanisms could be studied, allowing analysis of the important research of polutant transport. In addition, with the availability of high performance computing, researchers of computational fluid dynamics and computational combustion are able to use direct numerical simuation (DNS) to study combustion phenomenon of reasonable sized domains without relying on turbulence and combustion modeling.

510910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
510910.value: Turbulent flames are of great importance as they occur in the operation of almost all combustion systems such as gas turbines and industrial or domestic burners. Although many researches have been carried out over the years, many aspects associated with flame/turbulence interaction are still not fully undersstood, due to the range of length scales and time scales involved and comlexity of the physical phemomenon. A freely propagating swirl-stabilized turbulent premixed flame in a reduced-size combustor has been modeled by advaning the large eddy simulation algorithm with OpenFOAM code. Flow statistics under different combustioon modes; namely the conventional mode, high temperature combustion mode and the flame combustion mode; were simulated and compared with available experimental data. As one of the objectives in combustion science is to achieve stable combustion under the leanest burning condition. Flamability limit or lean blow-out has been studied. Fuels with different fuel/air mixtures were simulated to study the dynamic behavour of turbulent proemixed combustion. The significance and value of the project is in providing a better understanding of the complex combustion phenomena so as to enable designers of premixed flame burners to predict combustion characteristics and stabilities for different reactant turbulence intensities.

511510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
511510.value: Over the past decades, bulk metallic glass (BMG) has attracted tremendous research interest due to its unique mechanical, chemical and functional properties. Many efforts have been spent on developing new systems with enhanced properties, understanding their microstructures and properties, and exploring engineering applications. Although some novel commercial BMG products have been developed, the poor ductility at room temperature is still one of the main issues limiting their applications. BMGs are known to fail due to the formation of localized shear bands. Many attempts have been made to improve the ductility of BMGs by introducing heterogeneous structures, second phases or metal into the amorphous material. Nonetheless, the improvement is still criticized to be either limited to compressive ductility, or resulted in a degradation of the basic properties of BMGs due to the embedment of second phases. The improvement of tensile ductility remains one of the most challenging issues in the field of BMGs. There is a need to develop new approaches to address this issue. The proposed study is a challenging and timely attempt to design and fabricate a new type of BMG structure with enhanced tensile ductility. Without using crystalline or second phase particles which may degrade the properties of BMGs, the laminate structure consists of multilayers of two types of monolithic glassy film or sheet. The layers will be thermoplastic bonded at a stationary pressure in the supercooled liquid region of one of the glassy alloys with low glass transition temperature. This structure design will provide flexibility in introducing (a) a compressive residual stress on the surface of the BMG structure, (b) soft and hard glassy layers into the structure; (c) glassy layers of different thicknesses to limit the shear band extension, suppress the shear band opening, and avoid crack development. Mechanical testing will be conducted to systematically study the dependence of ductility and deformation behaviour on various laminate structures. A number of advanced analytical techniques will be used to characterise the amorphous structure of the glassy layers, and the interface structure. It is envisaged that by understanding the mechanisms of nucleation and propogation of shear bands in laminate structures, and the correlation between ductility and the laminate structure, large size BMGs with enhanced tensile ductility can be achieved by proper design of the laminate structure. The findings will not only clarify the deformation mechanisms of BMGs, but will also result in opening up new potential applications of BMGs. 塊體金屬玻璃材料因為其獨特的力學、化學和功能性特點，在過去幾十年中引起了巨大的研究興趣。 研究者們付出了很多努力在開發新的金屬玻璃體系，探索其微結構與性能的關係，並試圖找出新的應用。 儘管已經有一些商業化的金屬玻璃產品被開發出來，但是其脆弱的室溫塑性依然是限制其應用的主要難題。金屬玻璃的斷裂主要是因為形成局域化的剪切帶。為了提高金屬玻璃的塑性，很多嘗試包括引入不均勻的結構、第二相或者金屬來增強金屬玻璃。雖然如此， 這些改進被認為只能提高壓縮塑性，或者因為植入的第二相而導致金屬玻璃原始性能的降低。因此，改善金屬玻璃的拉伸塑性依然是金屬玻璃領域的一個重要挑戰。 我們需要發展新的方法來解決這一問題。 設計和合成具有新結構特徵並塑性增強的金屬玻璃是一個富有挑戰性、及時的研究項目。層壓材料包含多層兩相金屬玻璃薄帶或薄片，因為其沒有使用晶態材料，所以不會降低金屬玻璃的固有性能。層與層之間的連接是通過熱塑性壓縮，溫度控制在兩相金屬玻璃中具有低玻璃轉變溫度的過冷液相區範圍內。這種結構設計將提供柔韌性通過引入：（a）層狀金屬玻璃表面的殘餘壓縮應力；(b) 軟硬相間的金屬玻璃層；(c) 不同厚度的金屬玻璃層會限制剪切帶的擴展，抑制剪切帶的打開，並避免裂紋的發展。將採用力學測試來系統研究各種層壓金屬玻璃材料塑性與結構的關係。許多先進分析技術將被用來表徵金屬玻璃層的非晶態結構以及介面特徵。可以預見本研究通過揭示剪切帶在層壓材料中的形成和擴展以及塑性與層狀結構的關係，將設計出合適的具有大尺寸並增強拉伸塑性的層壓金屬玻璃材料。該研究發現不光可以進一步澄清金屬玻璃的變形機理，並打開新的應用潛能。

511510.label: Realisation of objectives
511510.value: Objective 1 (100% achieved) In this project, a number of dual phase metallic glass laminates were fabricated. By using a Gleeble 3500 thermal-mechanical testing system, multi-layer Pd and Zr-based bulk metallic glass (BMG) laminates were successfully synthesized by diffusion (thermoplastic) bonding. Various temperatures, pressures and times for diffusion bonding were attempted, and their interrelationship were analysed. The structural relaxation was minimized by using a low bonding temperature and a short holding time. The multi-layer BMG laminates have demonstrated larger plasticity than two-layer BMG laminates or the as-cast BMGs. In addition to diffusion bonding, a number of BMG/metal laminates were also obtained by electrodeposition or arc melting. The results showed that the macroscopic plasticity of the laminates was better than that of as-cast BMGs. Objective 2 (100% achieved) The structure of the as-cast BMGs and the laminates was examined by x-ray diffraction with Cu Kα radiation and differential scanning calorimetry . The mechanical performance and the serration flow of the as-cast BMGs and the laminates were measured on an electromechanical MTS 810 equipment. In addition to compressive and tensile tests, three-point bending tests at room temperature were also conducted on an Instron testing system with support span of 8 mm and the displacement control of 0.1 mm/min. The bonding quality between the mutli-layer BMGs and their fracture morphologies were also investigated by scanning electron microscope (SEM) observation. Objective 3 (100% achieved) As compared to the as-cast BMGs and two-layer BMG laminates, the multi-layer BMG samples have demonstrated larger plasticity. By examining the fracture morphologies of the different BMG samples, the enhancement is shown to be due to the blocking effect of the bonding interface(s) for the propagation of shear bands. During the diffusion bonding process, diffusion makes the nano-voids shrink to form metallurgical bonding at the interface and it caused structural relaxation leading to the embrittlement inside bulk. The performance of the bonded samples is dependent on not only the coalescence of the contacting surface but also the rearrangement of atoms inside bulk. For BMG/metal laminates, by examining the fracture morphologies and the serration flow, the results have demonstrated that the high confining compressive stress exerted by the outer layer on the BMG samples impedes the rapid propagation the shear bands, resulting in enhanced ductility. Objective 4 (100 achieved) The ductility of diffusion bonded BMG laminates is shown to relate to (1) the bonding quality of the interfaces and (2) the structural relaxation of BMGs. The effect of temperature, pressure and time of the diffusion bonding process on the bonding quality and the structural relaxation was studied. The results shows that diffusion promotes the metallurgical bonding, but one the other hand, it causes structural relaxation which changes the properties of the parent materials. A balance between the two aspects needs to be realized. The results of the BMG/metal laminates further show that a soft metal layer can act as a buffer zone for absorbing the elastic energy upon loading and can induce activation of multiple shear band in the interface, resulting in a higher ductility than those laminates with an amorphous layer.

511510.label: Major findings and research outcome
511510.value: (1) Based on the analyses of the influences of temperature and pressure on diffusion behaviour with time, a Zr-based bulk metallic glass was successfully bonded in its supercooled liquid region. Three-point bending tests show that the flexural performance of the samples bonded with various parameters is significantly different. The parameters in favour of diffusion bonding do not automatically benefit the performance of the bonded materials. Diffusion makes the nano-voids shrink to form metallurgical bonding at the interface and it caused structural relaxation leading to the embrittlement inside bulk. Balance between the two aspects is the key to the bonding success. Based on these findings, a paper was published in Intermetallics. (2) Our work also demonstrated for the first time that the plasticity of multi-layer Pd-based bulk metallic glasses synthesized can be enhanced by thermoplastic bonding. The structural relaxation was minimized by using a low bonding temperature and a very short holding time. As compared to the as-cast and the two-layer BMG samples, the three-layer samples achieved larger plasticity. The fracture morphology of the multi-layer samples reveal that the enhanced plasticity is due to the blocking effect of the bonding interface for the propagation of shear bands. Based on these findings, a paper was published in Materials Science and Engineering A. (3) The tensile plastic deformation behaviour of a Ti-based metallic glass composite confined by commercially pure titanium was investigated. The results show that the laminate sustains a true tensile strain exceeding 10%. The uniform plastic deformation of the laminate originates from a deformation mechanism of the dislocation pile-ups, inducing activation of the multiple shear bands in the interface. Based on these results, a paper was published in Philosophical Magazine Letters. (4) An amorphous Fe-Ni-W/Ni bilayer was successfully electroplated on a Zr-based bulk metallic glass and the deformation behaviour of the laminate was investigated. Its enhanced plasticity is mainly attributed to the enhanced confinement caused by introducing the amorphous Ni-W layer. The plasticity enhancement of a Zr-based bulk metallic glass was also achieved by an electroplated Cu/Ni bilayered coating. The enhanced plasticity is attributed to the thin soft Cu layer acting as a buffer zone for absorbing the elastic energy, and the strong outer Ni coating exerting a high confining stress upon loading. Based on these findings, a paper was accepted for publication in Materials and Technology. Another paper was published in Materials Science and Engineering A.

511510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
511510.value: Although the findings of the present project reveal that the plasticity of BMGs can be enhanced by introducing the laminate structures through diffusion bonding, a more in-depth study is needed to fully understand the effect of the process parameters on the free volume and the structures of the laminates so as to better control its structure relaxation during diffusion bonding, which is known to be critical to the plasticity of BMGs. In the project, work has also been done to synthesize laminates using other techniques. Although some improvements have been achieved, it is still most worthwhile to explore a more novel technique for synthesizing bulk metallic glass laminates for industrial applications. A new laser freeform manufacturing machine is going to be installed in the department of the Principal Investigator. Preliminary work will be done to use the machine to synthesize BMG laminates,and to examine their mechanical properties. Based on the findings of the preliminary work, it is expected that a new research proposal will be formulated.

511510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
511510.value: Bulk metallic glasses are known to exhibit unique properties include high strength, high elastic strain and good corrosion resistance. Although some novel commercial BMG products have been developed, their poor ductility at room temperature and limited sample size are still the main issues limiting their applications. With the aim to address these issues, various types of metallic glass laminates were successfully synthesized by diffusion bonding. The results show that the laminates have achieved enhanced ductility as compared to monolithic bulk metallic glasses. The enhancement is shown to be due to the blocking effect of the bonding interface. Other types of laminates were also synthesized by electrodeposition or a melting process. The results also demonstrate that the bulk metallic glass/metal laminates have enhanced ductility at room temperature. The Ti-based metallic glass composite laminate is shown to achieve a true tensile strain exceeding 10% before fracture. The results of the present project do not only lead to a better understanding of diffusion bonding of bulk metallic glass laminates and the deformation mechanisms of bulk metallic glass laminates, but also lay down a good foundation to further develop commercial bulk metallic glass laminates.

511910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
511910.value: Tower cranes are widely as loads lifting structures in construction sites, but they collapse quite frequently in different parts of the world, including those countries where site safety standard is generally considered high. From the statistics of Occupational Safety Health Administration, there were 137 crane-related fatalities from 1992 to 2001 in USA alone. Globally, there were also 516 accidents with 277 fatalities reported from 2000 to 2002. Falseworks, scaffolding and tower cranes are generally considered as structures of high risks and they have a certain degree of similarity such as under repeated loads causing ever increasing member and frame imperfections, instability and greater difficulty in control of quality. From the experience of a couple of investigation projects by the proposer, the causes of collapse can be due to unclear understanding of structural behavior of the cranes leading to over-looking of some important structural aspects of this type of structures. Fairly speaking, tower cranes have been tested for their normal uses during manufacturing. However, there are many operations that this condition cannot be fulfilled and a detailed analysis is needed to determine the safety of the structure under various processes such as installing and dismantling and under strong wind, of which the studies by tower manufacturers may be relatively few. A linear elastic analysis cannot fulfill this objective of checking as its buckling check is based on undeformed geometry without yielding. The findings can also be used as a simulation-based design tool for checking against various scenarios and for education to engineers and technicians about the load transfer during various proceses. Previous research findings and development by the proposer has, to a certain extent, generated an impact to the practice of structural engineers. The second-order and advanced analysis has been used in the latest design steel code 2005 published by the Hong Kong SAR government (see web http://www.bd.gov.hk/english/documents/index_crlist.html), in which the applicant is the first principal consultant. However, the method of nonlinear analysis is very board and its application to design of tower cranes requires a careful study on the modeling of suddenly applied loads and of fabrication and dismantling processes, as well as refinement in modeling towers under repeated uses which are not covered in code. This project is to develop a new and advanced method for analysis of tower cranes under various scenarios with an aim of saving lives and reducing losses due to collapse. 塔吊（俗称天秤）作为起重机器已广泛地应用于施工场地。然而，在世界各地却常有塔吊倒塌的事故发生，这些地区甚至包括那些场地安全标准较高的国家。根据美国职业安全和健康署的统计，从1992年至2001年间，单美国就有137起塔吊相关的恶性事故发生。从2000年至2002年的大致统计是，有516起事故发生，其中277是严重事故。脚手架、棚架和塔吊被普遍认为是高风险的结构，它们具有某种程度上的相似性，比如都是需要重复使用，这就造成单独构件及框架整体的缺陷不断增加，失稳情况严重，质量控制难度加大等。从申请人参与的一些现场事故调查的经验而言，倒塌多是因为不了解塔吊的结构行为和忽略了这类结构的一些重要的结构方面。公平地讲，塔吊在制造的时候对其在正常使用的条件下是做了测试的。然而，在工地现场的很多实际操作是超出了加工工厂的测试条件的。因此，更为精细的分析来确定结构在各种流程下的安全性是必须的，比如安装、拆卸、强风作用等，这些研究在塔吊制造商方面是相对少进行的。传统的线弹性分析方法实现不了上述的目的，因为这类方法在进行稳定性设计时是基于未变形的结构上的，而且不考虑材料的屈服。本项目的成果可提供一种基于电脑模拟的设计工具，用于检查结构在各种情况下的安全性，同时可在各种流程下荷载传递的情况方面给工程师和技术人员提供指引。 申请人以前的研究成果已在很大方面给结构工程师造成影响。申请人所研究和推动的二阶及高等分析方法已在香港政府部门发布的最新的钢结构设计规范(2005年版)中采用，其中申请人作为该规范的第一主要咨询人，详情见http://www.bd.gov.hk/english/documents/index_crlist.html。然而， 非线性分析是非常之广的，它在塔吊设计方面的应用还需进行细致的研究，如模拟突加荷载、制作和拆卸过程，以及模拟塔吊的重复使用（这方面还没有覆盖在规范里面）。本项目旨在发展一种新的高级分析方法，用于分析塔吊在各种工况下的结构行为，从而防止塔吊事故发生，达到保护生命和减少损失的目的。

513010.label: Project Title(Chinese)
513010.value: 閃電定位系統探測效率計算之新統計模型的建立及其應用

513010.label: Project Objectives
513010.value: For a DF network, a lightning stroke is located only when it is detected by at least 2 stations in the network. Whilst for a TOA network at least 3 stations are needed to locate a lightning stroke. Lightning location data given by a LLN usually include the information of sensors that detected the lightning stroke. With these in mind, the possible relationship between lightning strokes reported and those occurred will be analyzed and discussed. On the basis of the above analysis and discussion, general equations that describe the relationship between the DE of individual sensors in a LLN, the lightning strokes reported by the LLN, and those occurred within the network coverage area will be developed. With the theory and equation developed in the above, specific algorithm/procedures for estimation of the DE of a LLN from a set of historical lightning data reported by the LLN will be established. Applying the proposed algorithm to a practical LLN in China, estimate the spatial distribution of the DE of each sensor in the LLN. There may be several DE values estimated from different subsets of data for the same sensor in the same area. The extent of consistency of these DE values for the same sensor in the same area may be used to validate the adequacy and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. It is anticipated that the estimated lightning DE of a sensor will be a function of distance and azimuth and will be different for sensors at different sites. Analysis and interpretation of these results will be done and therefore suggestions for possible improvement of DE of the LLN concerned will be provided.

513010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
513010.value: Lightning location networks (LLN) have been used world-wide to minimize lightning hazards by provide early warnings and to produce lightning data that are important in both the research and the design of lightning protection systems. In China, LLNs have covered more than half of the nation and it is still extending. One important performance characteristic of the LLN is its detection efficiency (DE) (the percentage of lightning strokes detected to those occurring), which is essential for the use of lightning data especially in drawing lightning density map. The vendor usually provides the DE maps for their products. However, the DE maps provided by the vendor are generally based on the hardware characteristics and the locating principles of their sensors. The installation environment and the geographical condition that affect the lightning signal and its propagation are not taken into account. Most existing approaches for DE estimation of a LLN are based on comparisons between the lightning data detected by the LLN and those recorded by such as video systems, which can only give roughly the average DE of the LLN within limited area for limited time period. Several models that use the lightning data reported by the LLN to compute its relative DE are also developed. In fact, most of LLNs are utilizing either the gated wideband magnetic direction-finding (DF) or long-baseline time-of-arrival (TOA) technologies. Such a LLN usually has a lightning DE of about 65 to 90 percent, which apparently depends on the polarity, seasons, storm type as well as the position of the storm to the network. DE may also vary significantly with the type and topography of the network. Obviously none of the existing approaches can provide good solutions to this reality. This study aims to develop a new statistical approach for estimation of the absolute DE of a LLN by using the large amount of the lightning data reported by the LLN itself. Especially, this new approach can provide the spatial distribution of the DE of individual sensor in a LLN and therefore the DE profile of the whole LLN. The new approach may be implemented and repeated any times for various sets of historical data when necessary. The DE estimated from a set of data, in turn, can be used to correct that set of data for drawing more accurate maps of lightning density for lightning protection purpose. 為了減少閃電帶來的災害，閃電定位網已經被廣泛的採用。它不光提供先前預警，而且獲取的閃電資料在閃電研究和閃電防護系統的設計中都有著重要的應用。在中國，定位網已經覆蓋了一半以上的國土並且仍然在擴大中。 閃電定位網的一個重要特徵參量就是探測效率（探測到的閃電回擊數量和實際發生的比率）。在利用定位網的資料過程中必須知道探測效率，尤其是在描繪閃電密度圖的時候。定位網的架設者一般會給出探測效率的分佈圖。這裡需要強調的是，他們給出的探測效率分佈圖通常只基於感測器的硬體特性和定位原理。並沒有考慮到設備的安裝環境、影響閃電信號發生和傳播的地理條件。目前對探測效率評估的方法主要還是把定位網的資料和其他探測系統作比對，比如參考視頻資料。這樣的方法只能得出有限區域、有限時間範圍內的粗略的探測效率的平均值。此外，人們也發展出了一些模型，利用定位網自身的資料來計算它的相對探測效率。 絕大多數閃電定位網利用的技術要麼是門控磁定向法，要麼是長基線時差法。這類系統的探測效率明顯依賴於閃電極性、季節、風暴類型、和風暴相對於定位網的位置等因素，一般從65%到90%。同時探測效率也會隨著地形而顯著變化。很明顯，當考慮到實際情況時，目前已有的方法不能很好的給出結果。我們此項研究的目的是發展一種新的統計學方法，利用定位網自身記錄的海量資料來估算它的絕對探測效率。該方法的特別之處在於它能給出定位系統中單個感測器的探測效率的空間分佈並由此確定網路整體的探測效率。在必要的時候，不同系列的歷史資料都可以用新方法進行操作。反過來，為了防護，從資料得出的探測效率又可以對定位網的資料作修正從而畫出更準確的閃電密度分佈圖。

513010.label: Realisation of objectives
513010.value: This project aims to develop a more effective method for evaluating the detection efficiency (DE) of a lightning location network (LLN) in comparison with existing ones. There are 5 specific project objectives. To achieve these objectives, we have had following staffing actions and efforts. Staffing: (1) Miss DING Xueyun, Master of Philosophy, 03-Jan-2011 to 24-May-2013; (2) Mr XU Yazhong, Research Assistant, 19-Sep-2012 to 18-sep-2013; (3)Mr WANG Huaibin, Research Associate, 11-Mar-2013 to 10-Jun-2013; (4) Dr MA Ming, Research Associate, 02-Jul-2013 to 01-Jan-2014. During the first project year, based on thorough reviewing of the pros and cons of existing methods in literature we proposed a statistical method that can provide the spatial profile of DE for individual sensors in a LLN. By these efforts, the Objectives 1 & 2 had been fully achieved. During the second project year, with the historical lightning data from a 25-station DF/TOA type regional LLN in south-west China, the method we proposed was practiced and validated. The results showed that our method did well as it was expected. By these efforts, the Objective 3 had been fully and Objective 4 had been partially achieved. During the third project year, based on the preliminary results the proposed method was further refined and more accurate DE results were obtained. With the accurate DE values the feature of the DE as a function of distance and azimuth was discussed and possible interpretations to the feature were explored. Meanwhile, with the DE feature found, possible measures for improving the DE of a DF/TOA type LLN were suggested. These efforts led to the full achievements of the Objectives 4 & 5.

513010.label: Major findings and research outcome
513010.value: A statistical method for evaluating the detection efficiency (DE) of a lightning location network (LLN) has been proposed and examined. In the method, a LLN with a great number of sensors was grouped into sub-networks each with 3 sensors. The LLN covered area was divided into grids each with a small size. The DE for a sensor in a sub-network at a grid was then estimated based on a comparison of the number of lightning detected by all 3 sensors and that by any 2 sensors in the sub-network and grid concerned. The method was applied to a LLN in China, which consists of 25 sensors covering an area of 1350 km x 1030 km. it was fund that the DE varied significantly with individual sensors at different distance and azimuth, which might reflect the influence of the terrain and sensor parameters’ setting on the DE. The DE of a sensor usually has a low value of 20-50% within 20 km of the sensor, and then gradually increases to a maximum value of 60-80% at 60-120 km, and then gets down to 20-30% at 220-240 km away. The overall network DE ranged from 60-90% for most of the inner area of the LLN. The preliminary results were presented at the APEMC, 2011 [1] and the final results were published on Atmospheric Research, 2013 [2]. In addition, we proposed a statistical approach for identifying the effect of earth path on the lightning electromagnetic pulse (LEMP) amplitude. Based on the same LLN data, a coefficient reflecting the effect of propagation path on the LEMP was defined and estimated. The results showed that the path effect coefficient varied significantly at different distances and directions to a given sensor. Theoretical explanations for such a variation were also explored. The results were presented at the ICLP, 2012 [3]. [1] Mingli Chen, Yaping Du, Dong Zheng and Yijun Zhang, Detection Efficiency of A Regional Lightning Location Network in China, Asia-pacific EMC Symposium (APEMC), May 16-19, 2011, Jeju, Korea. [2] Mingli Chen, Dong Zheng, Yaping Du, Yijun Zhang, A statistical method for evaluating detection efficiency of lightning location network and its application, Atmospheric Research, 128 (2013), 13–23. [3] Xueyun Ding, Mingli Chen and Yaping Du, Study of the Effect of Propagation Path on Lightning-produced Electromagnetic Pulses based on LLN Data, International Conference on Lightning Protection (ICLP), Sep 2-7, 2012, Vienna, Austria.

513010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
513010.value: By applying our method to a LLN in China, it was found that the DE for individual sensors in the LLN varied significantly with the lightning source direction and distance to a sensor. The DE for individual sensors usually has a low value at close distance, a large value at moderate distance and again a low value at remote distance. Such a property of the DE might be due to the influence of terrains and sensor parameters’ setting on the lightning detection. With this finding, we may further analyze how the terrain and sensor setting affect the lightning detection, hence the measures to improve the DE of a LLN might be figured out. Besides, by comparing the signals measured at different sensors for the same lightning stroke among the huge data from a LLN in China, the effect of earth path on the propagation of lightning electromagnetic pulse was examined. It was found that the path effect coefficient varied significantly with the lightning source distance and direction to a sensor. In conjunction with suitable modeling, theoretical explanations for how the earth surface affects the propagation of lightning pulses might be explored.

513010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
513010.value: Lightning location network (LLN) has been used world-wide to provide lightning warnings. An important indicator of LLN is its detection efficiency (DE) (percentage of lightning strokes detected to those occurred). Most existing methods for DE estimation are based on comparison of LLN data with ground-truths, which only provides the average DE within limited area and time. In fact, DE varies with not only the type and topography of a LLN, but also the lightning types and terrain conditions. In this study, a new method for DE estimation was proposed. In the method, sensors in a LLN are grouped into sub-networks each with 3 sensors. The LLN coverage regions are divided into small grids. DE for each sensor in each sub-network at each grid is then be estimated based on comparison of the lightning strokes detected by all 3 sensors and those by any 2 sensors in the sub-network and grid concerned. As such, it can provide the spatial distribution of DE for each sensor in a LLN. Besides, DE estimated from various sets of data could be used to study how the terrain and lightning type affect the DE, hence measures to improve DE could be found.

513110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
513110.value: 本项目试图通过对低纬度电离层闪烁的研究以提高卫星导航系统的安全性能。由电离层分布不均匀性引起的电离层闪烁会对无线电信号产生严重干扰，对导航安全和通讯形成巨大威胁。本项目首先利用10年香港GPS观测数据分析电离层闪烁对GPS接收机的影响，并建立在不同闪烁条件下接收机测量误差统计分布以完善在低纬度地区的GNSS完好性监测。此外，我们将通过软件接收机平台研究在电离层闪烁条件下的接收机新算法，以减少电离层闪烁对GNSS的影响。

513110.label: Realisation of objectives
513110.value: Objective 1: To develop reliable GNSS receiver measurement error models and ionospheric threat models to support safety of navigation for GNSS in low latitude regions; We have analyzed GNSS data from a 11 year solar cycle, developed a new method to estimate the plasma bubble drift speed, quantified the main characteristics of plasma bubbles, and developed error and threat models for GNSS scintillation periods, which in turn, will improve GNSS positioning accuracy and reliability Objective 2: To improve GNSS receiver performance during ionospheric scintillation periods We have analyzed the effects of ionosphere scintillation on GNSS receiver tracking loop. Based on the analysis, we have proposed a new receive tracking configuration to reduce the effects of ionosphere scintillation. Both theoretical analysis and experiment tests demonstrated that our new method can significantly improve the tracking performance, compared with conventional GNSS receivers.

513110.label: Major findings and research outcome
513110.value: In this project, we have developed new method to estimate plasma bubbles using a regional GNSS network and analyzed the main characteristics of the bubbles in Hong Kong using more than 11 year GNSS observation (references 1, and 2). We have developed a new ionosphere model for the low latitude area and analyzed the effects of high order ionosphere effects on GNSS positioning accuracy (references 3, 4, 8, and 9). We have developed new algorithms to mitigate ionosphere scintillation effects through modelling and improving receiver configurations and proposed new algorithms for error modelling, cycle slip correction and receiver tracking (references 5, 6, 7, and 10).

513110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
513110.value: In this project, we are mainly concentrating on various mitigation methods (including data processing and receiver improvement) to reduce the effects of ionosphere on GNSS positioning, particularly during ionosphere scintillation period. On the other hand, plasma bubbles are import phenomena of space weather. GNSS provides a very effective tool to study such events. We should work together with geophysical researcher to further understand the formation of the bubbles and the prediction models.

513110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
513110.value: GNSS have been widely used for many different applications. However, due to the disturbances of ionosphere, GNSS signals are frequently affected by such disturbances. This will cause the discontinuity of GNSS positioning and also, reduce the positioning accuracy. In this project, we have develop a series of methods to mitigating the effects of ionosphere disturbances on GNSS positioning, from analyzing the characteristics of the ionosphere disturbances, developing algorithms to model the effects of the disturbances, and designing new GNSS receivers to improve the performance of the receiver during the disturbances.

513310.label: Project Objectives
513310.value: The proposed work is to develop a practical AC distribution system for the future power distribution system. The proposed system aims to consider high frequency AC distribution of 20kHz or above. It will firstly examine for enclosed areas such as aircraft or aerospace applications and other lower voltage distribution such as home and building. In summary, the main objectives are:Investigate the system design of the high frequency AC distribution for enclosed system. Each subsystem will be examined. Examine the high frequency magnetics for high frequency AC distribution and isolated power conversion. This includes the source, distribution, and receiving end magnetics. Investigate the high frequency AC circuit breakers or switching method especially the zero-voltage-switching and zero-current-switching electronic switches. Modeling of the high frequency AC distribution system in terms of the lines, the power electroncis devcies and sub-circuits. Effective design of bus structure in regard to the induced system noise, different bus waveforms, transmission line structure for low losses in high frequency and PCB layouts. Investigate the EMI of the high frequency AC distribution and its associated high EM screening and leakage problem. Develop the overall system design and stability for the AC distribution system. The above objectives will only be limited to 3kW in order to define the research content for not being too ambitious.

513310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
513310.value: The AC distribution using low frequency 50-60Hz has been used extensively worldwide. The aerospace uses 400Hz in order to reduce the passive components side because of weight requirement. The recent development in power electronics enables the generation of high frequency AC and higher dynamic control of AC power. The proposal is to describe a new method of power conversion based on high frequency AC distribution. The investigation includes the development of power conversion techniques in high frequency AC. The aims of the study includes the new topology of power supplies, the control dynamics of the voltage and current control, the high power factor correction, electromagnetic interference, system modeling, bus structure and the high frequency magnetics design. The advantage of the development will reduce the overall system design as compared with the DC distribution and conventional AC distribution design. This will significantly reduce the cost of materials and the overall size. The new method of distribution is a new era of power control and has potential to reduce all power conversion units and machines. The research will identify the system topology. The investigation of the system voltage and frequency are examined. The range of the study between 24V and 300V for voltage and 20kHz to 100kHz for frequency are examined. The consideration includes the operational rating of power devices, safety, dynamic performance and requirement of the loads. Then each of the sub-system is examined. This includes the high frequency waveforms, high frequency rectifier, and power factor correction design for high frequency AC bus, high frequency magnetic design, high frequency distribution cable design, electromagnetic modeling, filtering, screening and system stability. The proposed application is the enclosed system including the home, factory and office and can be extended to buildings, aircraft and navy distribution systems. The research work will concentrate on the use of the power electronics to solve the above problems. The outcome of the problem will benefit users and industry. This AC distribution issue is now a possible research topic using power electronics. The successful development of the new technology will change the existing distribution network and will benefit to both materials cost and energy saving. 在交流配電使用低頻率50-60Hz ，並一直被全世界廣泛使用，航空航天使用400Hz以減少無源元件的體積以配合重量的要求。最近的發展，使新一代電力電子可有效控制高頻交流和提升動態能力。本提案是描述一種基於高頻交流配電的功率轉換新方法，研發包括發展在高頻率的交流電力轉換技術。這項研究的目的包括新的電源拓撲結構、控制動態的電壓和電流控制、高功率因數校正、電磁干擾、系統建模、總線結構和高頻磁性元件的設計。其優勢的發展將降低整個系統的設計，並可匹配傳統的交流和直流配電配電設計，這將大大降低材料成本和整體規模。新的配電方式是一種新時代的電源控制，並可減少所有電源轉換裝置和機器。 這項研究將研發高頻交流系統的拓撲結構，調查系統的適當電壓和頻率，首先以24V和300V和20kHz至100kHz的頻率進行檢查。考慮因素包括功率器件的工作範圍、安全分柝、動態性能和負載的要求。然後，並對每個子系統進行審查，這包括高頻率的波形、高頻整流器、功率因數校正的設計和高頻率的交流總線、高頻磁設計、高頻率分佈電纜設計、電磁模擬、過濾、綱濾和系統的穩定性。 建議的應用以封閉的系統為主，包括家庭和辦公室，並可以擴展到建築物、飛機和海軍配電系統。這項研究工作將集中於使用電力電子解決上述問題，其結果將有利於大眾市民及工業。採用電力電子技術，這個交流分配問題現在已是一個可行的研究課題，成功開發這新技術將有效改變現有的配電網絡，將有利於材料的成本和節省能源。

513310.label: Realisation of objectives
513310.value: The objectives of this exercise are to study High frequency AC power distribution system in tens of kHz operation. The study includes the converter and inverter and the overall control and high frequency power signal examination and a number of associated studies in high frequency. The success of high frequency power distribution are determined by control, magnetics, moderation, topology, subsystem design, modular design and soft-switching to reduce the noise, The entire system can be divided into power source, load side conversion, and distribution track. From the distribution architecture viewpoint, the power source feeds high frequency voltage and current to the AC transmission track, and load side converts the bus voltage to a specific low DC voltage or low frequency operational voltage. The objectives of HFAC project have already been accomplished from power source side and load side as well. The studies of power source has successful developed the suitable circuitry topology, modulation strategy, advance control algorithm, and system integration. The achievements are solved the examination of high power capacity, parallel connection, and better control performance. The load side conversion mainly focuses on various configurations which are adaptable to high frequency AC distribution system. The conventional power factor correction is not feasible due to too high frequency. The new study in AC-AC power conversion family without transformers and DC Link, cascaded module based AC/DC resonant converter and simple switched capacitor based multilevel rectifier. The investigation and experiment results prove that the proposed topologies are suitable for high frequency AC distribution system. Various designs using low inductance and without transformer has been done. In addition to the circuit topology and control scheme, the other associated study on high frequency has been examined. The topology of the bus structure has been studied. New subcircuit structure and topology has been developed to meet this high frequency requirement. The high frequency magnetic design is also accomplished for the proposed topologies. The optimized design is considered for high frequency magnetic components. Meanwhile, some considerations of high frequency AC circuit breakers or switching method are studied with the zero-voltage-switching and zero-current-switching feature. The stability and robustness of enclosed system are testified by the simulation and experimental results.

513310.label: Major findings and research outcome
513310.value: 1.A novel based cascaded multilevel inverter developed provides high frequency voltage output with lower harmonics and less switching devices [Journal 3]. A unified phase-shifted modulation is done to integrate the regulations of magnitude and phase. A controlled phase integrated with magnitude control can eliminate circulation current [Journal 2]. A modified input-parallel output-series topology with power sharing resolves synchronization issue with wide operation range [Journal 4]. The load side conversion studies include: topology of resonant step up switched-capacitor-based ac-ac converter developed for AC-AC [Journal 5], AC-DC various level using resonant switched-capacitor topology [Journal 6], and using cascaded module AC-DC [Journal 7]. They all provide flexible voltage control. 2. The high frequency magnetic design is accomplished for the proposed topologies, including power inductor and transformer. The optimized design is considered for low harmonics requirement through u-control and power sharing control [Journal 1, 4]. Resonant method for high frequency AC(HFAC) is modulated so that HF transformer can be used [2]. Reduction of the transformer needs has been examined using switched-capacitor method [Journal 5,6,7] and the integrated magnetics has been studied [Journal 8]. 3. Special consideration of HFAC breakers or switching method has been examined with the zero-voltage-switching and zero-current-switching feature. The arcing study has been conducted [Journal 8]. Leakage protection for HFAC system has been thoroughly based on soft-resonant switching [Journal 6,7]. 4. The modeling of HFAC distribution is accomplished from power and load sides. This includes u-based robust control model, phase-shift modulation model, multi-level inverter model and power sharing model [Journal 1,2,3,4]. The modular approach for AC devices and subcircuit design simplify the subsystem modelling [Journal 7]. Stability and robustness have been achieved. 5. The ideal bus frequency and voltage of high frequency power distribution are determined by various distribution and power structures. The multilevel design provides a method to reduce PWM requirement and the voltage rating. A solution of interleaving and active-clamp structure at 20-30kHz has been examined. [Journal 4, Conf 1] 6. The high frequency effect has been examined under the operation of inverter and the converter study. THD for high frequency can be reduced to less than 6% using the power sharing scheme and using the u-control can reduce to less than 3%. [Journal 1,4]. 7. System design and stability are verified from source side and load side. The circuit topology, interfacing-topology and control to the PWM are key factors. A stable switched-capacitor structure is also examined. [Journal 1,3,6]

513310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
513310.value: Further investigations are required to propel its application and merge the gap between the lab prototypes with industry products: 1. System level experimental test 2. Application research to building and renewable energy Mircrogrid and its system interfacing 3. Thermal analysis for various distribution and bus is interesting for study. The high frequency AC induces high eddy current or AC loss and its thermal management in the power unit and the distribution is especially important during application research. The understanding of its thermal signature to enclosed system especially in mobility system should be studied. Examination and modelling using thermal field will be used for the study. 4. The digital control and intelligent management needs further study for high frequency power distribution. 5. Application research for the application to electric vehicles or electric boat. The proposed method can reduce the size of the power conversion components and it is expected to reduce the weight for the mobility apparatus; A large funding has been applied with a number of public and private organizations jointed together to build the Electric Vehicle application development based on Innovation and Technology Fund of Hong Kong.

513310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
513310.value: The continual increasing capacity and performance of power distribution system presents severe challenges in modern energy industry. The traditional power distribution contains DC and AC. The existing DC power distribution confronts low efficiency and poor transient response, while low frequency AC power distribution suffers from lower power density, and slow dynamic performance. Hence, the conventional power distribution is far from enough in many power applications, such as aerospace, telecommunication, and computer system. The high frequency system is simpler with a lower stage count. And also, the components’ size is much smaller when the frequency gets higher. Its advantages are low costs in maintenance and initial investment, high efficiency and high reliability. High frequency AC power distribution system is to deliver the power with tens-of-kHz, which has attracted the attentions from both industry and academia. The project has already been examined from high frequency power source side and load side with research in power sharing, as well as new control method, topology and structure. The aim is to provide feasible solutions to propel high frequency system into the applications with short-to medium distance distribution and high power capacity, such as electric mobility and renewable energy microgrid.

514210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
514210.value: The aim of this research is to find out how existing residential buildings can be repaired and maintained with alternative mixes of technologies and procedures so that (i) employment opportunities can be maximized, (ii) life-cycle costs can be minimized, or (iii) carbon emissions can be reduced to the minimum. Since its peak in 1997, the annual gross value of the total construction market in Hong Kong had shrunk for nine consecutive years. In 2006, it was 69% of the value in 1997 in real terms. Consequently, the construction industry had the highest unemployment rate among all industry groups in the last quarter of 2008. However, different sectors performed differently during 1997 and 2006. Whilst the value of new building and civil engineering works fell by 53% and 70% respectively, that of repair and maintenance jumped by 59%. The prospects for the repair and maintenance sector are being further enhanced by the government. Legislation is being drafted on a mandatory building inspection scheme (MBIS) and a mandatory window inspection scheme (MWIS). The schemes, scheduled for introduction into the Legislative Council by end 2009, will require private building owners to regularly inspect their buildings and windows, and make good the defects. Whilst there are sizeable implications for resources and carbon emissions, these schemes also present an opportunity to retrofit existing buildings to make them more environmentally friendly. This need for retrofitting is poised to grow as the building stock continues to grow and to age. Buildings in Hong Kong make up more than 53% of total greenhouse gas emissions. The problem is that, whilst we expect to reap the benefits of employment generation and a better living environment from an expanding repair and maintenance sector, we shall also incur sizeable construction costs as well as the externalities of carbon emissions. What is the best trade-off between the benefits and the costs? An optimization model will be developed to demonstrate that, with different mixes of building technologies and processes, we can maximize employment opportunities, minimize life-cycle costs or reduce carbon emissions to the minimum. In addition, any imbalance between the supply and demand of labour and materials, and the probability of failure to achieve targeted carbon reductions, will be identified. Finally, building codes, strategies and policies will be recommended to the authorities and industry which will facilitate the adoption of green technologies, and address imbalance and shortfall problems. 本研究的目的, 在於找出合適的技術和程序, 對現有住宅樓宇進行檢修, 從而: (1) 創造最高就業機會；使 (2) 生命週期成本或 (3) 碳排放減至最低。自1997年的高峰以來，香港總體建築市場的年度合約價值連續9年呈萎縮態勢。 以實質計算, 2006年的合約價值為1997年的69%，建築行業因此成為2008年第4季度中失業率最高的行業。儘管如此，於1997年和2006年期間, 不同組別的表現迥異。在新建樓宇和土木工程合約價值分別下降53%和70%的同時，樓宇修理和保養合約價值卻躍升59%。強制驗樓計劃 (MBIS) 和強制驗窗計劃 (MWIS) 的立法草案即將提交立法會討論，樓宇檢修的前景將會在政府立法支持下得到進一步提升。預計於2009年底提交立法會的計劃，將要求私人戶主定期檢查其樓宇及窗戶，並修繕缺失。除了對諸多有關資源和碳排放的影響外，這些計劃亦提供了一個機會, 從翻新現有樓宇使之更為環保。隨著樓宇存量的持續增長和老化，樓宇翻新的需求亦相應上升。香港的樓宇製造了超過53%的溫室氣體排放，問題在於，從創造就業機會, 和擴張檢修工程以創造更好居住環境的同時，我們也承担著相當可觀的建築成本及碳排放的外部性效應。試問成本和效益的最佳平衡點何在？ 我們將建立一個最優化模型，通過樓宇技術和程序的不同替代組合，可以實現就業機會最大化，生命週期成本或碳排放最小化。另外，我們將對任何勞動力和原料方面需求與供給的可能失衡，以及無法實現碳減排目標的可能性進行鑑定。最後，我們將向當局和業界提出有關建築規範、策略和政策方面的建議，以期促進綠色技術的使用和解決供求失衡及不足的問題。

514210.label: Realisation of objectives
514210.value: The objectives are generally achieved. Two optimization models have been devised and published in three papers to find the optimal solution for balancing carbon, cost and labour (the three goals) in the case of building maintenance in Hong Kong. The first model is reported in Paper No.2 (Section C). Based on a private residential property, the life-cycle carbon emission, cost, and labor requirements of a maintenance project were evaluated first. Afterwards, an optimization model was developed to identify the optimal portfolios of materials that would minimize carbon emission, cost, or labor deployment, in their respective turns one at a time. Later, in two papers (with the cases of the private and public sectors in Papers No. 4 and 5 respectively), we presented an optimization model based on Data Development Analysis (DEA) to do the same, but this time, instead of achieving any one objective at any one time, our DEA model suggests that a portfolio of materials can be constructed to achieve two goals (out of the three of minimizing cost, carbon and labour) at any given time, with the third one acting as a constraint. The imbalance issue was addressed in our case studies. The alternative materials we used to substitute the baseline materials are the ones readily available in Hong Kong. Recommendations were made for the industry to consider using these alternative materials to lower cost, reduce carbon and set the right labour intensity. The versatility of our models is perhaps best illustrated by the labour issue. The proposal was conceived when the local construction industry was yet to revive, and when construction unemployment had become a serious problems. Generating employment opportunities was considered one major objective of the proposal. However, ever since the launch of the public works programme, the situation had changed from acute unemployment to critical shortage of labour. Our papers demonstrated that the model could be employed to identify materials so that maintenance works could be less labour intensive. As regards the final objective, policy implications and recommendations are discussed in all the five papers reported, and for the case of China Mainland as well in Paper No.3. Lastly, though not envisaged in the original proposal, we have also developed a prototype for measuring the carbon emissions arising from the utilization of electrical appliances in a typical Hong Kong Family, and published it in Paper No.1.

514210.label: Major findings and research outcome
514210.value: Paper No.2 in Part C: With the case of a private property and a simple “Solver” add-in of Excel, the paper demonstrates how to optimize one of the three variables (cost, carbon and labour) while keeping the other two at targeted levels. When decision makers are not clear about their priorities, they can run the optimization model to achieve the objectives one by one and then decide on the objective they want to achieve. Therefore, they can improve any of the carbon, cost, and labor performance without making the remaining criteria worsen off. Papers Nos.4 and 5: Using Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA), we found that it is possible to achieve two objectives at any one time under the constraint of the third. Papers No.4 and No.5 are based on private and public properties respectively. Very different sets of baseline materials were used in the private and public residences. The former was luxurious housing and the latter one subsidized mass housing. Nevertheless, our findings demonstrate that common and readily available alternative materials can be found so that the collective performance of carbon, cost and employment is always better than the baseline materials. In Paper No.4, we also computed the average efficiency scores of baseline and alternative options for all three constraints (carbon, cost and labour), and concluded that the proposed alternative options are always more efficient than the baseline options actually used in the case building in terms of reducing total carbon emissions, life-cycle costs, and aggregate working hours. In Paper No.5, we summarized our work, commenting that our study contributes to the sustainability performance of the global building construction sector in overcoming the universal barriers to implementing energy-efficient buildings, namely, high initial cost, weak enforcement of government policies, and uncertainty of returns. Papers Nos. 1 and 3: In Paper No.1, we expanded our scope of study to carbon emissions from electrical appliances. We found that, by adopting the energy-saving guidelines for space coolers, refrigerators, water heaters and washing machines, carbon emissions in Hong Kong’s residential building sector can be reduced by 155,443 metric tons, or by 8.6 per cent of the current emission. In Paper No.3, we also expanded our scope to study China Mainland. We reported the barriers which impede the promotion of Energy Efficient Building (EEB), and to propose solutions to alleviate these barriers by capturing the benefits from Clean Development Mechanism (CDM),

514210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514210.value: There is good potential for the research to be further developed into the following areas. First, this optimization methodology can be applied easily to other economies, and other decision criteria could be adopted to serve the requirements of different stakeholders (such as project completion time or indoor air quality). This methodology could also be readily applied to new construction and commercial developments, and replicated in projects of a much larger scale. Second, aside from the embodied energy of materials, the research boundary could be extended to include operational energy savings from retrofitting of existing buildings to improve their energy efficiency, and from new developments. The study can also include building services installations, in addition to builders’ work that was focused in this project. Third, consideration can also be given to the construction process itself including, for example, the use of construction plants. Fourth, more advanced multicriteria methods could be adopted in the quantitative analysis. Last but not least, further research can be conducted to examine the setting up of databases of life-cycle costs (similar to the RICS BCIS in the UK), labour constants and carbon emission (the Hong Kong version of the Inventory Carbon and Energy (ICE) of Bath University).

514210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
514210.value: This research concludes that we can identify appropriate maintenance materials and technologies so that existing residential buildings can be repaired and maintained with minimum carbon emissions and minimum life-cycle costs, whilst employing the most appropriate amount of labour available. Given these three goals of minimizing costs, reducing carbon emission, and employing the right mix and amount of labour, our simpler optimization model enables us to identify building materials to achieve one goal under the constraints that the remaining two goals do not worsen off. Our Data Envelopment Development model enables us to identify building materials to achieve two goals at any one time without scarifying the third one. The construction cost in Hong Kong has been found to be the most expensive in the world. Hong Kong is also facing an acute problem of aging and shortage of construction labour. Furthermore, given the increasing housing stock in Hong Kong and the Governments’ pledge to reduce carbon emission, the issues that our study addressed cannot be more significant and pressing. We have tackled these problems directly, suggested solutions and given policy recommendations. We believe that our study has made significance contributions to knowledge in sustainable construction and environment.

514610.label: Project Title(Chinese)
514610.value: 高頻超聲結合紫外輻射產生的自由基降解水中難降解污染物

514610.label: Project Objectives
514610.value: Previous research has shown that many EDCs can not be easily removed by conventional wastewater treatment processes, while advanced oxidation technologies (AOTs) can assure a satisfactory result through the generation of strong oxidant - hydroxyl radicals in the water. In this study, a new AOT using high-frequency ultrasound and UV-irradiation (HFUS/UV) for EDC removal is proposed and will be examined at laboratory scale. The broad aim will be to assemble a prototype HFUS/UV unit which can be evaluated using model and real wastewater samples to establish the process performance and figures of merit. An extensive programme of tests will be undertaken to examine the importance of various process parameters including US frequency, power density (W m-3) and power intensity (W m-2), UV dose, and solution conditions (pH) on the generation of hydrogen peroxide and hydroxyl radicals. Optimal conditions will be confirmed in reactivity tests with atrazine as a reference probe compound The potential treatment performance of the HFUS/UV process will be investigated using model EDC compounds, namely, nonylphenol and the recalcitrant di-methyl phthalate and di-butyl phthalate, under controlled aqueous- and optimal process- conditions to quantify the reaction kinetics and degradation mechanisms and products under a range of solution conditions (pH, DOC, etc). The potential general treatment benefits of the HFUS/UV process for upgrading secondary wastewater effluents will be investigated in experiments using real wastewater samples, with and without spiked reference compounds. The assessment will be based on quantifying changes in general physico-chemical parameters (eg. DOC, colour), toxicity and estrogenic activity. The performance of the HFUS/UV process will be bench-marked by comparison with parallel tests using UV alone, and ozone, in order to confirm the relative superiority of the AOT. Based on the information gained from the laboratory studies, referred to above, the likely cost-effectiveness of the HFUS/UV process at a practical scale will be evaluated in comparison to alternative technologies. This evaluation will include measures of sustainability such as a life-cycle analysis.

514610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
514610.value: In recent years, many natural and synthetic organic pollutants, such as endocrine disruptor compounds (EDCs), have been identified in wastewaters and in the aqueous environment. These are of increasing concern because of potential adverse effects on the environment and to humans via drinking water and fish farming. Herbicides and industrial chemicals are important groups of such pollutants, since they are poorly degraded during conventional water and wastewater treatment. Although such chemicals are present in final effluents at low concentrations, there is growing concern that such levels are toxicologically significant, and in some countries (eg. UK) full-scale trials of conventional tertiary treatment methods are being conducted to evaluate the feasibility of their deployment; these include ozone, activated carbon and chlorine dioxide. While these treatment methods are able to achieve modest degrees of pollutant removal, they are unlikely to be cost-effective for some of the more recalcitrant compounds, and may present substantial practical and operational burdens on water utilities. Within the research community various advanced oxidation technologies (AOTs) have been evaluated for the treatment of specific organic pollutants, and many of these involve the dosing of chemicals (eg. ozone, hydrogen peroxide) and/or catalytic materials in order to generate free radicals as the primary oxidizing chemical. However, there is a growing interest among water utilities to move away from processes requiring the dosing of chemicals towards ‘chemical-free’ treatment, since the latter can bring many operational and economic benefits. This project will evaluate a new treatment technology for the degradation of refractory pollutants in water, based mainly on the formation of highly reactive species, hydroxyl radicals, without the dosing of additional chemicals. The treatment is based on applying externally a combination of high-frequency ultrasound and UV-irradiation (HFUS/UV) in order to bring about highly reactive conditions, which include the processes of pyrolysis, photolysis, and the generation of hydrogen peroxide and hydroxyl radicals. In addition, ultrasound has the capability of disrupting and disaggregating particulate contaminants which may contain and protect adsorbed organic micropollutants. Internationally, UV-irradiation is being used increasingly as a disinfection technology for wastewater plants and the possible addition of an ultrasound unit would be, in principle, a practically-convenient development. In this study, we propose to investigate in detail a novel laboratory-scale HFUS/UV system in terms of the overall process performance, reaction kinetics and pathways, and impact on solution toxicity under various aqueous conditions for selected reference EDC compounds. 近年來，在廢水和水環境中檢測出許多天然和人工合成有機污染物，如內分泌干擾物。因為他們可能經由飲水和魚類養殖而對環境和人體產生潛在的副作用，所以這些污染物引起了越來越多的關注。除草劑和工業化學品是這類污染物的重要群體，因為他們在常規水和廢水處理過程中很難被降解。雖然在最終出水中這種化學物質濃度比較低，但是人們越來越擔心，這類污染物即使在這種濃度水平在毒理學上也不能被忽視，某些國家（如英國）採用全面規模的傳統三級水處理方法進行評估其去除這類污染物的可行性，其中包括臭氧，活性炭和二氧化氯。儘管這些處理方法能夠實現中等程度的污染物去除，但是對於一些比較頑固的化合物而言，這些傳統的三級處理方法從成本效益上來看行不通，會給自來水公司增加實際的和運行上的負擔。在研究團體內，各種高級氧化技術（AOTs）被評估去除某種特定有機污染物的可行性，而它們中的很多都是通過添加化學品（如臭氧，過氧化氫）和/或催化材料來產生自由基作為主要的氧化劑。然而，自來水公司的興趣已從依賴化學試劑的添加的處理方法越來越轉向了無化學品的添加的處理技術上了，因為後者可以帶來許多業務和經濟效益。 該項目將評估一個新的處理技術降解水中難治性污染物的可行性，這項技術主要基於在無化學品的添加的條件下高活性自由基--羥基自由基的形成。這項技術是基於高頻超聲及紫外線照射（HFUS /紫外線）的組合應用，以產生高活性的條件，其中包括熱解、光解以及過氧化氫和羥自由基的產生。此外，超聲波有能力破壞和分解顆粒狀污染物，顆粒狀污染物可能含有和保護被吸附的微污染物。在國際上，紫外線照射日益被用來作為污水處理廠的一個消毒技術，而在紫外照射的基礎上增加超聲設施原則上是利於實際應用的發展。在這項研究中，我們建議詳細調查和評估一種新的實驗室規模的HFUS /紫外線系統在整體過程中的表現，評估此選擇的內分泌干擾物降解的反應動力學和降解途徑，以及就選擇的內分泌干擾物在各種水環境條件下降解後對溶液毒性的影響。

514610.label: Realisation of objectives
514610.value: All the objectives proposed in the original application have been achieved. A laboratory scale high-frequency ultrasound and UV irradiation (HFUS/UV) unit consisting of a 400 kHz ultrasound and a photolytic system at 253.7 nm was set up. The whole study was carried out progressively in terms of investigating the degradation of different target compounds. Initially, effect of several important parameters on the degradation of dimethyl phthalate were evaluated, including ultrasonic frequency, ultrasonic power, UV light wavelength and intensity, initial concentration of probe compound, initial solution pH, effect of H2O2, etc.. The process performance were established by understanding the role of different parameters. The optimal condition involving 400 kHz ultrasound and 253.7 nm UV light was established to conduct subsequent investigation. The potential treatment performance of the established HFUS/UV process was further examined using other model compounds, namely atrazine, di-butyl phthalate, and nonylphenol. Furthermore, the degradation kinetics of different compounds in individual HFUS, UV processes, and in combined HFUS/UV process was quantified and compared, where synergistic effect was found in HFUS/UV process. The synergistic mechanism was investigated by applying sequential tests and examining the role of ultrasonically generated H2O2. As a result, the generation and photo-decomposition of hydrogen peroxide were found to be the principal reason for the process synergy. A novel inverted S-curve model was developed based on the synergistic mechanism, which was able to successfully describe the sonophotolytic process and the degradation of different compounds. In addition, the degradation products of the investigated compounds and mineralization efficiencies in the HFUS, UV, and HFUS/UV processes were identified and quantified using HPLC-MS2, and the combined HFUS/UV process demonstrated the best mineralization performance. The performance of the HFUS/UV process was also bench-marked by comparison with parallel tests using conventional Fenton, sono-Fenton, and sono-photo-Fenton processes. Moreover, in order to study the potential of HFUS/UV process for upgrading secondary wastewater effluents, the influence of some background species (e.g. Cl−, Fe2+, NO− 3, radical scavengers, TOC) was first evaluated. After figuring out the role of the main background species in secondary wastewater effluents, real wastewater effluent was applied as the water matrix with spiked reference compounds. Finally, based on the information gained from the laboratory studies, the cost-effectiveness of the HFUS/UV process at a practical scale was evaluated in comparison to conventional oxidation treatments (i.e. ozone, ozone/H2O2 and H2O2/UV) for degrading atrazine in water treatment. The above analysis was conducted by using life cycle assessment.

Based on the information gained from the laboratory studies, referred to above, the likely cost-effectiveness of the HFUS/UV process at a practical scale will be evaluated in comparison to alternative technologies. This evaluation will include measures of sustainability such as a life-cycle analysis.

514610.label: Major findings and research outcome
514610.value: In this study, results showed that the HFUS/UV process could efficiently degrade different types of organic compounds. In the HFUS process, the optimal performance was obtained from a frequency of 400 kHz, and the degradation rate increased directly with the power density. In the UV-related process, higher light intensity was beneficial for both the photolytic and sonophotolytic degradation performance. Meanwhile, significant synergistic effect was observed in the HFUS/UV process. The ultrasonically generated H2O2 was verified to be the principal mechanism for the system synergy. The sonolytic and photolytic degradation of the investigated compounds all followed pseudo first-order kinetics, while their sonophotolysis exhibited variable kinetics. A novel inverted S-curve model clearly illustrating both the “individual effect” and the “synergistic effect” was developed and found to successfully describe the sonophotolytic process and the degradation of different probe compounds. Furthermore, the heterogeneous feature of sonochemical process was investigated from different aspects. Atrazine degradation was found very different in the 400 and 20 kHz ultrasound systems. The better heterogeneous distribution of solutes in the former allowed a faster decay of hydrophobic compounds than that in the latter. The physicochemical properties of phthalic acid esters (PAEs) played an important role on their sonolytic degradation. The more hydrophobic PAEs demonstrated stronger competitiveness. However, stronger hydrophobicity was adverse for PAEs to obtain remarkable synergistic effect in the sonophotolytic process. Besides, the more hydrophobic PAEs also experienced less inhibition by dissolved TOC in real wastewater in the sonophotolytic degradation. The mechanism of sonolysis of these compounds was mainly by radical oxidation rather than pyrolysis. The degradation region of relevant compounds was predominately surrounding the bubble-liquid interfaces and much less happening in the bulk solution. Moreover, it was noted that the incorporation of UV into HFUS process could promote the degradation of probe compounds and those hydrophilic intermediates by either direct photolysis or producing additional •OH radicals. The combined HFUS/UV process was found to be most efficient in preventing the accumulation of degradation intermediates. The results of TOC variation demonstrated that the best mineralization performance was obtained from the HFUS/UV process. Finally, results of life cycle analysis revealed that the HFUS/UV process contributes lower environmental loads in comparison to other alternatives (i.e. ozone, ozone/H2O2 and H2O2/UV). It can be confirmed that HFUS/UV process is a sustainable oxidation alternative to conventional methods.

514610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514610.value: In future work, experiments in pilot-scale are needed to amend the results obtained under idealized conditions. In addition, from a practical point of view, the continuous flow reactors should be used in full-scale treatment, therefore reactor design including both the configuration of ultrasound and the layout of UV lamps will be a critical factor determining the performance of the HFUS/UV process. Furthermore, more experiments based on real wastewater are recommended for future work, which will facilitate the estimation of practical operation performance.

514610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
514610.value: This project has proposed and investigated a novel, green, and sustainable advanced treatment method, i.e. the combination of high-frequency ultrasound and UV irradiation (HFUS/UV) for the removal of different EDCs in wastewater effluents. The novelty of this HFUS/UV technology is that it avoids the application of chemical dosing, taking an effective step toward the environmentally friendly strategies. It contributed to regional and international studies being carried out at present to identify practical and cost-effective treatment methods for the removal of recalcitrant pollutants. This research has provided important information about the performance and practical utility of the HFUS/UV process, which is supposed to be of interest to the research community in terms of information about the fundamental process mechanisms and figures of merit, and to the water utilities and environmental organizations regarding its practical and economic suitability. The findings of this study is also meaningful in stimulating new ideas and leading to abundant positive outcomes in other fields.
