518710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
518710.value: While many researchers of operations and supply chain management have offered ideas on managing and mitigating supply chain risk, their ideas in general focus on mitigating risks relating to material disruptions. Yet, many recent risk incidents such as melamine-tainted milk, lead-tainted toys, toxic toothpaste, defective tires, and fake medicine reveal that there is a category of risk that is not related to material disruptions. We define this category of risk as supply ethical risk, which refers to the possibility that suppliers simply focus on fulfilling the technical requirements of the direct customers and fail to address the concerns of stakeholders such as product end-users, employees, the general public, regulators, politicians, and non-government organizations (NGOs). Indeed, supply ethical risk could lead to broad and long-term damage to not only organizational performance, but also the reputation of an industry or a nation. In the literature, much has been suggested on the use of supplier development to improve supplier capabilities and on the use of corporate social responsibility (CSR) to improve organizational ethical behaviours. Yet, given the increasing importance and number of incidents involving supply ethical risk in recent years, suggestions on employing supplier development to develop CSR in suppliers in order to reduce supply ethical risk have been lacking in the literature. In this study we propose to examine whether or not socially responsible supplier development (SRSD) in the buyer affects the CSR adoption in the supplier, and CSR adoption in the supplier in turn reduces the level of perceived supply ethical risk for the buyer. To offer more precise insights, we draw on learning organization theories and the literature on supply chain risk management to identify and test moderators including CSR in the buyer, the supplier’s learning processes regarding absorptive capacity, SRSD in the supplier, and environmental uncertainty, for such associations. We will collect longitudinal data from dyadic buyers and suppliers from the food and beverage industry of China to examine the posited associations. By using sophisticated statistical techniques such as structural equation modeling and hierarchical multiple regression to analyze the empirical data, we expect the study results will offer useful suggestions to practitioners to manage their supply ethical risk and provide new insights to extend the literature on supply chain risk management, supply management, CSR, organizational learning, and strategic alignment. 如何管理和降低供应风险已经引起运营管理和供应链管理学者的广泛关注，大家将目光都集中在了如何降低与材料供应中断相关的风险上。然而，近期出现的许多风险事件，例如三聚氰胺奶粉，含铅玩具，毒牙刷，缺陷轮胎和假药，不约而同地将问题矛头指向了另一类风险。此类风险可能来源于供应商只顾满足一些直接客户对其技术方面的要求而没有考虑到其他利益相关方，例如产品使用者，员工，公众，监管者及非营利机构的利益。事实上，此类与道德相关的供应风险不仅仅会对企业本身造成重创，还会影响一个行业甚至一个国家的声誉。目前很多学者都建议采用供应商发展计划来提升供应商的能力，同時有文献建议通过发展企业社会责任提升公司的道德表现。然而，面对近几年日益严重且增多的供应道德风险事故，鲜有文献涉及如何采用供应商发展计划去提升供应商的企业社会责任并借此降低供应道德风险。 此次研究旨在探讨由生产商发起的供应商社会责任发展计划是否会影响供应商的企业社会责任采纳程度，并最终降低生产商自身所认知的供应道德风险。通过回顾学习型企业理论和供应链风险管理文献，我们将深入探究可能影响供应商社会责任发展计划结果的各项调节变量，包括生产商企业社会责任，供应商与吸收能力相关的学习过程，供应商社会责任发展计划及环境不确定性，并收集中国食品及饮品行业的生产商及供应商双方的纵向数据检测假设关联。通过使用多种统计技术，例如结构方程模型和分层回归分析所得的实验数据，我们希望检验结果能够帮助从业者更好的管理供应道德风险，并为供应链风险管理，供应管理，企业社会责任，组织型学习及战略管理文献的发展作出贡献。

518710.label: Realisation of objectives
518710.value: SRSD refers to the concerted supplier development efforts made by a buying firm to improve its important suppliers’ capabilities to CSR implementation. Our objectives suggest that by implementing SRSD, important suppliers will be induced to implement CSR and the ethical performance of both suppliers and the buying firms will be improved. To achieve this objective, we first developed and tested the measurement scales for SRSD. Using qualitative methods including literature review, expert panel discussion involving six professionals, and a pilot test involving managers of 20 manufacturers, we identify three dimensions and the corresponding scale items of SRSD. Next, we used this survey instrument to collect data from 160 paired buyer-supplier manufacturers in China. With the survey data, we validated the scales and tested the posited hypotheses concerning our objectives. The final hypothesis test results indicate that all three objectives of this project were met. The major findings led to the publications of two journal articles.

518710.label: Major findings and research outcome
518710.value: The data of this project are concerned with the management of operational employees in both service and manufacturing operations. Based on such data, we developed two papers. The first paper (i.e., Lee, To, and Yu, 2013) investigates operational service employees’ behavioral attribute patterns and their associated performance levels by using a configuration approach. The result is an empirical taxonomy comprises attributes including team use, organizational support, clear goals, collaborative climate, coercive influence and adaptation difficulty. The taxonomy indicated that there were three attribute patterns among the samples. The analyzed results indicated that the different attribute patterns are associated with different levels of performance. The second paper (i.e., Lee, Lau, and Cheng, 2013) investigates manufacturers’ socially responsible practices with respect to the management of their labor. In this paper, we conceptualize employee rights protection as a management initiative concerning an organization’s efforts in managing operational employees responsibly. We argue that organizations should adopt employee rights protection to improve their corporate reputation and financial performance, and that it is important for buyers to involve suppliers to implement such an initiative in order to improve the financial performance of both parties in the buyer-supplier relationship. Our analysis shows that all the posited hypotheses of this research are supported. References Lee, Peter KC, WM To, and Billy TW Yu. "Team attributes and performance of operational service teams: An empirical taxonomy development." International Journal of Production Economics 142.1 (2013): 51-60. Lee, Peter KC, Antonio KW Lau, and TCE Cheng. "Employee rights protection and financial performance." Journal of Business Research 66.10 (2013): 1861-1869.

518710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
518710.value: By integrating the findings of the separate papers resulted by this projects, I am working on a proposal which employs social capital and stakeholder theories to argue that when the companies involved in a supply chain implement corporate social responsibility practices consistently, the companies can adapt and/or respond to external changes more efficiently. I plan to submit this proposal to one external funding body to compete for a future grant.

518710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
518710.value: In the paper concerning service operational employees’ behavior patterns (i.e., Lee, To, and Yu, 2013), the findings contribute to the literature by providing empirical evidence to indicate that employee attributes and their combined patterns are determinants of the performance of service operations. They also contribute to practitioners by reporting the current status of operational service team management and offering guidelines on enhancement of team performance. In the paper concerning the social practices in manufacturing buyers and suppliers (i.e., Lee, Lau, and Cheng, 2013), the findings contribute to practice by offering empirical evidence on the strategic importance of employee rights protection and showing the critical role of suppliers in implementing this initiative. They also provide new research insights that extend the literature on labor rights, business ethics, CSR, and supply chain management.

519110.value: To investigate the optimized processing conditions by FEM simulation for generating high strain rates, validation of the simulation using a high speed camera for checking the balls’ speed and by TEM for checking the nano-twins’ density in high strength nano-twinned TWIP steel; To produce appropriate treatment conditions for achieving an optimized combination to obtain a steel with the dual properties of ultrahigh yield strength (2 GPa) and high ductility with an elongation higher than 20%, the fracture mechanisms will be studied using multiscale experimentation tools for the mechanical characterization of nano-twinned steel in order to understand the mechanical and the failure behaviors; To develop a simulation model scheme for predicting the mechanical behavior of nano-twinned steel with a variation of nanosize twins and nanosize grains and to investigate the effects of twin spacing and twin density.

To produce appropriate treatment conditions for achieving an optimized combination to obtain a steel with the dual properties of ultrahigh yield strength (2 GPa) and high ductility with an elongation higher than 20%, the fracture mechanisms will be studied using multiscale experimentation tools for the mechanical characterization of nano-twinned steel in order to understand the mechanical and the failure behaviors;

519110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
519110.value: Synthesizing high-strength and high-ductility materials is always the driving force for materialists to explore the strengthening and toughening mechanism of materials and to modify the compositions and microstructures for extreme performance. Among the various means to reach the ideal properties, the nanostructured material has long been recognized as an effective solution. However, nanocrystalline (NC) materials suffer from low ductility which hinders their applications because the strengthening mechanisms used basically increase grain boundary volume fraction by reducing the grain size down to the nanometer size. The experimental results reported recently in SCIENCE [1, 7-8] on NT copper seem to suggest that denser twins could render higher strength as well as higher ductility. These results demonstrated that materials with nanometer twins are materials with high potential to reach the dual properties of high ductility and high strength. The goal of the present project is to develop a new route for producing high density nano-twin steels with ultrahigh strength (Yield stress > 2 GPa) by maintaining very good ductility (> 20% elongation in tension). Based on our preliminary study, different high C (from 0.45-1%) and Mn contents (from 17% to 23%), which exhibits exceptional twin induced plasticity capacities with very good combination of strength and ductility, will be selected as a family of case study materials. We will investigate the fundamental mechanisms of such exceptional performances. The proposed project includes three scientific tasks as follows: Task 1: To investigate the optimized processing conditions by simulation to obtain the high nano-twin density in high strength steel Task 2: To produce a steel with the dual properties of ultrahigh yield strength (2 GPa) and high ductility with an elongation higher than 20% Task 3: To develop the physical models for describing the strength and ductility of nano-twinned materials and metals with dual phases of nano-grain and nano-twins

519110.label: Realisation of objectives
519110.value: The three targeted objectives are all achieved. The first objective is to investigate the optimized the materials to provide general criteria for the materials [1, 7, 11]. We have successfully studied the role of the different types of nanotwin and their effect on the mechanical properties nanotwinned materials. We have provided a quantitative continuum plasticity model capable of describing the variations in strength, ductility and work hardening rate of nanotwinned metals with the twin spacing. The critical twin spacing is found to be linearly proportional to the grain size, which is consistent with recent molecular dynamics simulations. The second objective of the project is to produce appropriate treatment conditions for achieving an optimized combination to obtain a steel with the dual properties of ultrahigh yield strength and high ductility. Thanks to the new concept of hierarchical twins, it’s possible to further promote the mechanical properties. In contrast to the microscopic multilayered hierarchical structure, this HNT structure is a completely twinning system in different scales. As theoretically demonstrated by the dislocation-based model in pure copper[4], the HNTs are much more effective than monolithic nanotwins for strengthening and can reach a maximum value by optimizing the twin spacing (of two-order nanotwins) and grain size in each order. Very recently, we have successfully produced three-order HNTs in bulk NS TWIP (twinning induced plasticity) steels, achieving an unprecedented property that breaks the conventional milestone of yield strength for metallic materials over 2 GPa while still preserving a considerable uniform elongation for suffi cient engineering formability[10]. For the third objective, we develop a simulation model scheme for predicting the mechanical behavior of nanostructured materials with different configuration of nanostructure which included nano-twinned materials [3,5,9,11, 13,14, 16]. The general concept of strain non localization was developed and achieved for different type of materials such as nanotwinned materials [10] and metallic glasses [8].

519310.label: Project Title(Chinese)
519310.value: 關於固態照明系統的研發與優化

519310.label: Project Objectives
519310.value: To investigate the lifetime performance of LEDs for guiding a proper thermal design. To develop new methods for improving the overall performance of LED driver technology and enhance their competitiveness for adoption in solid-state lighting. To develop a controller IC for bi-level current driving for use in general purpose LED drivers. To benefit the local and Mainland manufacturing industries through the technological transfer.
rows: To investigate the lifetime performance of LEDs for guiding a proper thermal design.
To develop new methods for improving the overall performance of LED driver technology and enhance their competitiveness for adoption in solid-state lighting.
To develop a controller IC for bi-level current driving for use in general purpose LED drivers.
To benefit the local and Mainland manufacturing industries through the technological transfer.

519310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
519310.value: Abstract Recent advances in high-brightness light-emitting diodes (LEDs) technology for the last two decades have completely revolutionized the world of artificial lighting previously dominated by incandescent and fluorescent lamps, as evidenced by the inclusion of solid-state lighting in the agendas of national or international energy or environmental policies, business switching or expansion by global lighting companies, emergence of industry standards, and increased number of research publications and technical conferences on solid-state lighting. Presently the luminous performance of white LEDs has already exceeded the incandescent lamps and is approaching that of fluorescent lamps, but it remains far below the theoretically limiting value. Thus research efforts on bringing the LED performance towards the ultimate goal are continuing actively all over the world. Solid-state lighting must be available at reasonably low initial cost and be able to bring about long-term energy saving for successful adoption in the lighting market. Therefore, low-cost and efficient LED drivers which comply with existing or emerging industry standards must be developed to meet these requirements. However, as the LEDs are evolving rapidly themselves, and there are numerous factors which can affect their luminous and lifetime performances, some of which are not even fully understood, the design and optimization of LED drivers are often posed with significant challenges. Systematic studies of the LED performance under various driving schemes and operating conditions are therefore critical to the selection and justification of driver topology and control methodology which will ensure a satisfactory overall system performance. In this project, the investigators will take up the challenge of conducting long-hour tests and observations on the LED performance under various driving schemes and operating conditions, and formulation of design requirements and constraints based on the carefully collected and analyzed data, followed by the design of an optimal driver system through the adoption of appropriate driver topology and control methodology. In parallel to this, optimization and implementation works of the new bi-level current driving technique proposed recently by the investigators will also be conducted. Many technical aspects related to this new driving technique, such as luminous efficacy, color stability, control and calibration systems, and controller IC fabrication, require detailed investigations and these issues will be fully explored in the proposed project.

519310.label: Realisation of objectives
519310.value: Objective #1: To investigate the lifetime performance of LEDs for guiding a proper thermal design. The research starts with the investigation of LED colour temperature and its relationship with operating temperature. Based on the finding, a new colour control scheme is proposed to maintain colour set points at a desired value without having the risk of out of regulation [J2,C1]. Along with the proposed bilevel driving approach [J1], a full-colour large-area LED display panel system is developed [J3, C3]. The aging test is still undergoing at the time preparing this report and this objective has not been fully completed. Objective #2: To develop new methods for improving the overall performance of LED driver technology and enhance their competitiveness for adoption in solid-state lighting. Since LEDs operate at low DC voltage and lighting systems are generally powered by AC mains, power converters are often required to transform the AC power into a low-voltage current source. Although modern power converters can achieve high power efficiency and good power factor correction, they generally suffer premature failure due to the mal-functioning of electrolytic capacitor, which buffers the difference between the instantaneous input power and the output power in AC-DC power conversion. In order to extend the lifetime of lighting systems and make them comparable to LEDs, it is essential to reduce the dc-link capacitance so that the electrolytic capacitor can be replaced with a polyester film capacitor, which has longer lifetime and capacitance density. An effective ripple cancellation technique to reduce the output filter requirement and hence the size of output capacitor is proposed in [J4]. Also, by using switched capacitor method, it is shown that current balancing in LED strings can be achieved [J5]. This method can be further developed to replace the output filter capacitor with a switched resonant circuit. Objective #3: To develop a controller IC for bi-level current driving for use in general purpose LED drivers. The bi-level driving circuit has been developed with discrete electronic components and is used in the LED display panel. Unfortunately, the implementation of the driving into IC form is unsuccessful due to lack of suitable layout software tools and IC foundry. Objective #4: To benefit the local and Mainland manufacturing industries through the technological transfer. As mentioned in the Research Output Section, this research project leads to collaboration with industrial partners to develop: 1. An indoor LED plant factory equipped with sensors is currently under construction for facilitating both production and research. 2. In large-area video display, the research has also led to the establishment of several industrial partnerships for implementing commercial LED-based display products.

519310.label: Major findings and research outcome
519310.value: 1. A colour control method for maintain the white colour point of RGB LEDs for all aging conditions is developed. Along with the proposed bi-level driving technology, a full-colour large-scale LED video display is constructed and tested. 2. In order to extend the operating lifetime of LED lighting system, a ripple-cancellation approach to reduce the output filter requirement is proposed so that the output electrolytic capacitor can be replaced with other types of capacitors with longer lifetime. In this respect, a switch capacitor network is also proposed to balance the currents that flow in parallel LED strings in light system. This network with much smaller capacitance can be used to replace the output filter capacitor in the driver to extend the lifetime of the system. 3. A LED lighting system has been developed for indoor horticultural applications. With additional electronic sensors, a plant growth platform that are suitable for different plant species has been developed.

519310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
519310.value: LEDs have been regarded as the next generation of light source for their advantages of high luminous efficacy, long lifetime, environmental green, fast electrical-to-optical conversion, and low maintenance cost. Systems such as backlight, general lighting, automotive lighting, large-area video display, and many others are now using LEDs extensively as their light sources. However, there are still some challenges remained to be solved before these systems can live up to the promises that LEDs can offer. The main challenges and design issues include: 1. A systematic derivation procedure for driver circuits 2. Improvement of driver circuit in terms of lifetime 3. Development of lower cost drivers As simple, reliable, and cost-effective LED drivers are developed, the world can see a more rapid penetration of LEDs into the general lighting market and, subsequently, can give rise to a major global energy saving.

519310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
519310.value: High junction temperature can have significant impacts on the light output intensity, color stability, lifetime, and lumen degradation of LEDs. Other than a good thermal management system, an effective colour control scheme is required in the design of full-colour large-area video display panel. While LEDs enjoy a lifetime of 100,000 hours, the relatively short lifetime of an electrolytic capacitor in conventional LED drivers, which is about 5,000 hours, remains a limiting factor to the lifetime of the overall lighting system. Therefore, the study of replacing electrolytic capacitors with other types of capacitor in LED driver should be pursued. This project looks into these two practical issues, theoretically and experimentally, and finds solutions to them. In this project, the investigators have developed a good knowledge of the characteristics of good LED drivers. These experiences enable the investigators to confidently develop products for commercial applications.

519610.label: Project Title(Chinese)
519610.value: 網路不確定環境下用於交通監測和事故探測的行程時間估計模型

519610.label: Project Objectives
519610.value: To develop both static and dynamic journey time estimators for estimating the current travel time and predicting the short-term future travel time on each major road link of the whole network for traffic surveillance, with particular consideration of the spatial and temporal co-variances of travel times on road links with uncertainties and stochastic variations. To propose static model for estimation of origin-destination trip matrices and calibration of link performance function parameters simultaneously so as to assess the effects of various traffic management schemes on network with uncertainties due to incidents. To develop dynamic incident detection algorithm and incident duration estimation method for traffic surveillance and incident management purposes; and to calibrate the thresholds for detecting traffic incidents and estimating their durations with the use of historical traffic incident and travel time data. To assess the accuracy of the journey time estimators and proposed model with case studies in Hong Kong, and to evaluate the performance of the incident detection and duration estimation methods by using independent dataset.

519610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
519610.value: In many large Asian cities like Hong Kong, with dense development and congested road networks, the potential benefits to be gained from development of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) for surveillance of traffic congestion and improvement of network performance are substantial particularly under non-recurrent congestion due to traffic incidents. This project proposes a new modeling approach for network-wide travel time estimation with on-line and off-line traffic data. Most of the existing methods can only estimate the travel times of some site-specific links and/or path segments using the observed data from one sensor system. To overcome this limitation, the journey time estimators proposed in this project would make full use of the available data from multiple sensor systems (on-line data) and the historical data (off-line data). The first-order and second-order statistical properties of the on-line and off-line traffic data are investigated to facilitate the travel time estimation in the whole network with stochastic variations on road traffic. This project proposes to develop both static and dynamic journey time estimators for estimating the current travel times and predicting the short-term future travel times for modeling and assessing the impacts of recurrent and non-recurrent congestion on road network with uncertainties. The dynamic estimator will explicitly take into account spatial and temporal interactions between road links. The first part of the project will develop static estimator to estimate the average travel times and variances on all major road links together with their covariance relationships. The static estimator will then be extended to the dynamic dimension for prediction of the short-term future travel times with the use of historical and real-time traffic data. On the basis of these results, the second part of the project will propose static model to update the traffic demand and the network parameters for transport planning and traffic management purposes. The third part of the project will develop dynamic incident detection and duration estimation methods for traffic surveillance and incident management purposes. It follows with calibration of the thresholds for incident detection and duration estimation on the basis of historical data. Finally, all the analyses and developments will be demonstrated with case studies in Hong Kong. The proposed study has the potential to help authorities and engineers monitor the performance of the road network under recurrent and non-recurrent congestion conditions and enhance the effectiveness of traffic management strategies for improving network performance in terms of travel time and reliability. 為了模擬和評價不確定道路網路中常規和突發擁擠的影響，本項目擬構建靜態和動態行程時間估計模型，用於估計當前旅行時間和預測未來短期內的旅行時間。動態估計模型將明確地考慮道路路段之間的時空相互作用。本項目的第一部分將設計靜態估計模型來預測所有主要路段上的平均旅行時間和方差，以及他們的協方差。然後，基於歷史的和即時的交通資料，將靜態估計模型拓展到動態情形，預測未來短期內的旅行時間。基於第一部分的結果，本項目的第二部分將利用靜態模型來更新交通需求和網路參數，用於交通規劃和交通管理目的。本項目的第三部分將設計動態事故探測和時距估計方法，用於交通監測和事故管理目的；基於歷史資料對事故探測和時距估計的閾值進行校正。最後，以香港作為案例，對所有的分析和研發成果進行實證研究。本研究將有助於當局和工程師監控常規和突發擁擠條件下道路網路的性能，同時有助於從旅行時間及其可靠性方面提升交通管理策略的效率。

519610.label: Realisation of objectives
519610.value: In relation to the project objective 1, a journey time estimator (JTE) was proposed to estimate the current stochastic journey time of each path for performance assessment in road network with demand uncertainty. The spatial co-variance of the on-line data was investigated together with the data inconsistency issue to estimate network-wide travel times. The proposed models can be used as effective tools for not only network performance evaluation but also traffic surveillance in intelligent transportation systems. As far as the projective objective 2 is concerned, a generalized origin-destination (O-D) estimation model was formulated to estimate not only the mean but also the covariance matrix of stochastic multi-class O-D traffic demands under day-to-day variations. The proposed model puts focus on the statistical characteristics of stochastic O-D demands as well as their covariance between different vehicle classes. The conventional O-D estimation model, which is concentrated on the estimation of the mean O-D demand, is a special case of the proposed model. In connection to the project objective 3, several incident detection algorithms were proposed with respect to different available database in the transportation system. Firstly, using the ratio of predicted speed over estimated speed as the detection criterion, threshold-based incident detection algorithm is proposed. Secondly, four variables reflecting the traffic conditions are selected as predictor variables for the discriminant analysis to develop the incident detection algorithm. Thirdly, not only the traditional parameters such as average speed, flow and occupancy, the coefficient of variation of speed at the upstream detector and the correlation coefficient of speeds of two adjacent detectors are also considered in the proposed incident detection algorithm. Regarding project objective 4, concepts of confidence interval and root mean square error are adopted to assess the accuracy of the journey time estimators. The proposed accident detection algorithms are also evaluated or validated using the traffic data from a real-time traffic information system in Hong Kong. The empirical study indicated that the proposed incident detection algorithms outperform some existing algorithms based on the available data for journey time estimation in Hong Kong.

The estimated and predicted journey times are applied in path finding problems (see publication nos. (7), (8) and (10)) and vehicle routing problems (see publication no. (9)), particularly under the networks with travel time uncertainties. With regard to the project objective 2, a bi-level programming model was proposed to estimate the multi-class origin-destination (O-D) traffic demands from hourly classified traffic counts throughout the whole year (see publication no. (11)). Different from conventional O-D estimation models, the proposed model aimed to estimate not only the mean but also the variation (in terms of covariance matrix) of the stochastic multi-class O-D demands for the same hour periods due to day-to-day fluctuation over the whole year. In respect to the project objective 3, three methods have been proposed for incident detection on urban roads (see publication nos. (1) and (6)). These models can be classified into two types: threshold-based incident detection model and discriminant analysis. To develop a generalized algorithm for incident detection under both no-rain and rain conditions, the effects of rainfall intensity on traffic characteristics have been investigated (see publication nos. (5) and (14)). In addition, the relationships between various factors and injury severity at junction locations were examined (see publication no. (13)). The impacts of traffic incidents on congested road networks were also investigated by an effective vulnerability analysis approach (see publication no. (2)). In relation to the project objective 4, the accuracy of journey time estimators was evaluated using the concepts of confidence interval (see publication no. (15)) and root mean square error (see publication nos. (3), (11) and (12)). It was found in these studies that the accuracy of the journey time estimation can be improved if the spatial co-variance information is used. The proposed incident detection methods were evaluated using the historical road accident data in Hong Kong (see publication nos. (1) and (6)).

519610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
519610.value: In this project, various static and dynamic models were proposed to address the issues of journey time estimator (JTE) for traffic surveillance and incident detection under network uncertainties. Robust mathematical models and solution algorithms were formulated and developed to for journey time estimation, origin-destination (O-D) trip matrix estimation and incident detection problems. However, only one mode (say, private car mode) is considered in the proposed models. In reality, many travelers in densely populated cities may conduct trips using private cars, public transits, subways or combined modes. Further study is required as an extension of the proposed models and solution algorithms into multi-modal transportation networks. Journey time information is one of the most popular traffic information for travelers as well as the basic data for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). Nowadays, ITS plays an irreplaceable role in transportation networks for traffic congestion alleviation and road safety enhancement. The integration of the JTE and the newly proposed incident detection algorithm into the ITS reveals interesting and practical extensions of this project. In addition, the existing JTE only concerns the static travel time estimation. The extension of the JTE to dynamic travel time prediction warrants promising further study.

519610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
519610.value: In this project, mathematical models and solution algorithms have been developed for two purposes: (i) estimation of the journey times and (ii) detection of the traffic incidents in urban road networks. For the first purpose, to estimate accurate journey times in road networks, a model, namely journey time estimator, is formulated as a bi-level optimization problem. Conventionally, installation of more detectors in the transportation network is a widely used method for journey time estimation. However, such method is difficult for implementation due to physical limitations and budget constraints. To overcome this difficulty, not only mean but also covariance of current traffic data is adopted for network-wide journey time estimation. Numerical study based on the data in Hong Kong road network indicated that our model can efficiently estimate the journey times particularly under conditions with network uncertainties. For the second purpose, several incident detection algorithms have been developed with the availability of real-time traffic data. These traffic data are automatically collected by traffic sensors installed at selected locations in Hong Kong. Case studies were carried out to evaluate and validate the proposed incident detection algorithms for Hong Kong road network.

519910.label: Project Title(Chinese)
519910.value: 在利用统计信号处理和DSP接收机的下一代光通信网络中的光信号性能监测

519910.label: Project Objectives
519910.value: Statistical signal processing techniques for OPM: With DSP-based receivers, statistical signal processing taking into account fiber-optic specific transmission impairments are being recognized as the next major technological breakthrough in long-haul fiber-optic communications. We will analytically investigate the use of statistical signal processing for performance improvements of current OPM techniques in terms of dynamic range, sensitivity, flexibility and impacts of other impairments such as CD/PMD for different system setups. In addition, for future systems with fiber nonlinearity compensation algorithms using DSP-based receivers, nonlinearity monitoring through appropriate pilot sequence design and receiver signal processing will be investigated. The theoretical results will be verified experimentally. OPM for higher-order modulation formats: With coherent communications and DSP, higher-order modulation formats such as 16-QAM become more important. However, most of the existing OPM techniques only applies to simple formats such as DPSK or QPSK. For monitoring units at intermediate nodes along the link, we will investigate the use of low-cost OPM techniques such as asychronous amplitude histograms for 16-QAM and/or 64-QAM systems. Appropriate statistical parameters derived from the histogram will be used to monitor impairments such as OSNR, CD and PMD. The use of advanced signal processing techniques such as artificial neural network (ANN) together with asynchronous amplitude histograms will be studied if time permits. Adaptive algorithms in coherent systems with DSP-based receivers: With coherent receivers and linear impairments, adaptive algorithms are attractive alternatives to traditional OPM techniques as one does not even need to know the channel parameters for good detection performance. However, little is known about their abilities to ‘equalize’ a nonlinear channel such as the optical fiber. For QPSK systems, we will study the performance of standard adaptive algorithms such as Constant-Modulus Algorithm (CMA) and Least-Mean Square (LMS) in presence of fiber-nonlinearity, laser phase noise and/or polarization effects. Generalization to 16-QAM modulation formats will be investigated if time permits. Convergence properties including the effects of initial tap coefficients, step size and convexity of the associated cost functions will be studied analytically and through simulations and will be verified experimentally.

519910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
519910.value: The ever-growing speed demands for Internet traffic continue to motivate research in fiber-optic communication systems. Major telecommunication service providers are desperately trying to implement new systems with higher transmission rates to accommodate the growing needs from their customers. Recently, coherent communications with Digital Signal Processing(DSP)-based receivers have generally been accepted as the technology driving next generation communication networks. Reliable transmissions of data requires the knowledge of the network conditions such as individual link chromatic dispersion(CD), optical signal-to-noise ratio(OSNR), polarization mode dispersion(PMD) as well as fiber nonlinearities. However, such conditions vary with time due to temperature changes, component aging and dynamics of network traffic. Consequently, estimating various properties of the channel at the receiver and/or intermediate points along the network, or Optical Performance Monitoring (OPM), is vital to regularly diagnose and repair the network, allocate resources, redirect traffic and ensure robust and efficient data transmissions at all times. As the required quality of the estimates dramatically increase with per channel bit-rate, developing powerful OPM techniques that are cheap and flexible become unique, important and challenging issues to overcome before the full transition into coherent communications in industry. DSP-based OPM naturally evolves as an ideal solution since they are flexible, scalable and also requires no extra monitoring equipments for OPM at receivers. More generally, applying statistical signal processing can potentially provide low-cost solutions to significantly improve performance of known OPM techniques. Although the capabilities and advantages of DSP-based data communication are already well appreciated, the power of statistical signal processing and DSP in OPM is far away from being systematically investigated and fully exploited. The objectives of the proposed research are to elucidate the ultimate potentials of OPM using statistical signal processing and DSP technologies and provide concrete steps for their practical implementation. In particular, we will: 1) investigate improved OSNR monitoring techniques using statistical signal processing and fiber-nonlinearity monitoring with DSP-based receivers 2) study efficient linear and nonlinear impairments monitoring techniques for OFDM systems and 3) characterize the impacts of fiber-optic specific impairments on adaptive signal processing techniques. The successful completion of the proposed research will allow system designers to better understand the abilities and limitations of OPM using statistical signal processing and DSP technologies. Such crucial and unique insights will provide practical means to fully upgrade OPM capabilities, enable high speed transmission in dynamic environments and construct new platforms for substantial future developments in optical networking. 日益增长的网络速度需求不断激励着光纤通信系统的研究。为了适应越来越多的客户需求，主要的电信服务供应商们都在致力于推广更快的通信系统。最近，基于DSP接收机的相干通信技术将被应用于下一代通信网络的观点被广为认同。为了实现可靠的数据通信，网络的状况需要被知晓，其中包括链路的色散（CD），光信噪比（OSNR），偏振模色散（PMD），以及光纤的非线性。然而，由于温度改变，器件老化和网络流量的动态化，这些状况会随着时间改变。因此，在网络的接收端以及中间点估量信道的各种特性，或者说光信号性能监测（OPM），对于定期的网络诊断和维护、分配资源、流量分配和保证数据通信随时的突发和有效传输来说至关重要。当单信道的传输速率提高时，监测质量的需求也随之大大提高。因此在产业完全过渡到相干通信之前，研究功能强大、便宜、灵活的OPM技术成为了一个独特、重要而且富有挑战性的任务。由于在接收端，基于DSP的OPM技术具有灵活、可伸缩，并且不需要额外监测器件的优点，它自然而然的演化成为了一个最优的解决方案。一般来说，利用统计信号处理技术可以潜在的提供低成本并显著改善现有OPM技术性能的解决方案。尽管基于DSP的数据通信能力和优势已经被充分利用，统计信号处理和DSP在OPM中的功效尚未被系统研究和充分开发。 提出的研究目标是发掘利用统计信号处理和DSP技术的OPM的最终潜力，并为实际应用提供具体步骤。具体包括：1）研究改善的利用统计信号处理的OSNR监测技术和基于DSP接收机的光纤非线性监测技术，2）研究OFDM系统中有效的线性和非线性损伤监测，3）研究光纤特定的损伤对于可适应性数字信号处理技术的影响。 成功的完成提出的研究将使得系统设计者更好的理解利用统计信号处理和DSP技术的OPM的能力和局限性。这些关键和特别的见解将会为全面升级OPM性能，动态环境中的高速传输，以及为光网络的广泛前景建设新平台提供实际的解决方法。

519910.label: Major findings and research outcome
519910.value: Through the completion of this project, it is shown that a receiver with DSP capabilities have opened up a rich area for optical performance monitoring for traditional as well as new optical transmission systems with advanced modulation formats such as 16-QAM and 64-QAM. Incorporating the knowledge of the underlying physics and statistics, we derived appropriate DSP algorithms that allow the accurate estimation of various channel state parameters such as OSNR, CD, PMD as well as fiber non-linearity of a transmission link by examining the statistics of the received signal amplitude, phase as well as polarization. We also studied the effectiveness of adaptive signal processing algorithms in de-coupling the effects of different channel parameters for impairment compensation and OPM purposes In addition, machine learning algorithms such as artificial neural network (ANN) have proven to be a vital tool for OPM when different parameters are coupled together and difficult to be tracked analytically and joint OPM is desired. Using training sets generated from computer simulations or prior experimental data, we show that various ANN techniques allow accurate joint monitoring of OSNR/CD/PMD or monitoring of OSNR in presence of large amount of unknown CD. The statistical signal processing techniques and ANN are complementary techniques that adequately covers different application scenarios in which OPM plays a crucial role in ensuring the robustness of network operation and improve network efficiency. The outcome of the project provide us with a key element in future dynamic network operation with a higher level of robustness and flexibility to support ultra-high speed and dynamic emerging applications such as cloud computing and data center communications

519910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
519910.value: With the further advancement of DSP technologies for optical transmissions, it is to be expected that more complex iterative channel estimation / data detection algorithm such as Expectation Maximization (EM) algorithm will be used for OPM in coherent systems. In addition, the outcome of this project has provided the foundation for further research in DSP techniques for coherent systems with higher order modulation format such as 64-QAM and above in presence of fiber nonlinearity and WDM effects. Future studies can also incorporate mode-division multiplexed system in which channel estimation/OPM plays an even more important role in dynamic and reliable transmission with ultra-high capacities

519910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
519910.value: Current optical networks operates on the principle of worst-case scenario, leading to very conservative design with inefficient network usage. Ubiquitous and continuous monitoring of the network state, or optical performance monitoring(OPM), allow one to have up-to-date knowledge of the network state and design appropriate communication strategies to maximize transmission capacities. In this project, we investigate key technical challenges in OPM for current and future optical transmission systems and derive strategies that allow accurate monitoring of various network parameters using low-cost equipments. The outcomes of the research paved the way to realize future dynamic and efficient optical networks for emerging cloud computing and data center applications.

520310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
520310.value: As an important branch of quantum physics, quantum optics is also undergoing an explosive growth in quantum technology because it offers building blocks for constructing quantum computing and communication devices to realize the dream of quantum nanoscale technology. As sound approximations to the fundamental field theoretical models in quantum optics, linear quantum optical systems have been derived in terms of quantum stochastic differential equations (QSDEs), based on which a vast body of measurement based feedback control methods have been proposed to achieve various objectives such as entanglement preservation, state preparation, and error correction. An alternative control mechanism, called coherent feedback control, has been proposed recently where measurement is not necessarily involved; instead, quantum information may flow directionally as a (possibly non-commutative) signal (such as a quantum optical electromagnetic field or an injected laser), or directly via a bidirectional physical coupling. The benefits of coherent feedback include (i) preservation of quantum coherence, and (ii) high speed (a coherent controller would have similar time scale to the plant, and likely is much faster than classical signal processing). Notwithstanding the early recognition of the development of the general principles of quantum control theory as an essential requirement for the future applications of quantum technologies, the quest for integrated, first principles discipline of quantum control for quantum optics is rather challenging. In this project we aim to develop a set of advanced coherent feedback control methods for quantum optical systems by following two closely related directions: 1) optimal control via squeezing and direct coupling, which will reveal a general picture of how to utilize squeezing components and direct coupling to design physically realizable quantum controllers to meet prescribed control performance; 2) multi-objective control, which will provide more flexibility to manipulate quantum optical systems to meet ever demanding design performance and complexity. The outcome of this project will deliver a set of systematic, first principles control methods for quantum optical systems, which will be of benefit to the successful practice of quantum optical engineering in the near future. 作为量子物理学的一个重要分支，量子光学在量子科技界经历了一个飞速的发展，由于它在量子计算与量子通讯领域的建设性贡献，从而实现了人类量子纳米技术的梦想。作为量子光学中的基本场模型的合理近似，线性量子光学系统可以根据量子随机微分方程(quantum stochastic differential equations, QSDEs)得到。利用这类模型，涌现出了大量的基于测量的反馈控制方法以达到不同的目标，例如量子纠缠态保护、状态制奋、以及误差较正等。近年来，量子相干反馈控制作为另一种新的控制机制被提出，在这种新的控制机制中，测量不被涉及，取而代之的是量子信息(算子可能不对易)以信号(例如量子光电磁场或激光)的形式定向地流动或直接地通过一个双向物理耦合作用。相干反馈控制的优势在于：(i)保护量子相干性；(ii)高速性(量子相干控制器具有和量子系统相似的时标，从而传输速率上远远高于经典的信号处理)。尽管人们很早就已经认识到量子控制理论基本原理的发展对量子科技的应用是必不可少的，但是，基于第一原理的系统的量子光学系统的反馈控制理论的建立仍是一项极具挑战性的任务。在本项目中，我们致力于研究量子光学系统并主要沿以下两个方向提出一系列先进的相干反馈控制方法：1）通过量子挤压与直接耦合的最优控制方法，给出利用挤压器与直接耦合作用设计物理可实现性的量子控制器的普通方法，以此满足预先给定的性能指标；2）多目标控制，为量子光学系统的操控提供更加灵活的方法来满足期望的性能指标及复杂度。本项目将提供一套系统的、基于第一原理的量子光学系统控制方法；这些方法将有助于量子光学工程的顺利发展。

520310.label: Major findings and research outcome
520310.value: Supported by this grant, we have done several pieces of reswarch. 1. We systematically studied how to use squeezer, phase shifter, direct coupling and indirect coupling to design coherent quantum feedback controllers. This research generates three journal publications: (1) G. Zhang, H.W. J. Lee, B. Huang, and H. We investigated in detail how quantum linear systems respond to single-photon input states and multi-photon input states. This research generates two journal publications: (1) G. Zhang, “Analysis of quantum linear systems’response to multi-photon states”, Automatica, 50(2): 442-451, 2014 (2) G. Zhang and M.R. James, "On the response of quantum linear systems to single photon input fields", IEEE Trans. Automat. Contr., 58(5): 1221-1235, 2013. 3. 520310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
520310.value: On the basis of the research already carried out, we have been working on two pieces of research: 1. multi-photon filtering. That is, how to design filters to detect the state of a quantum system. 2. quantum signal generation. That is, how to design a quantum system to generate non-classical quantum states such as photon states and Schrodinger cat states.

520310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
520310.value: The research project investigates the problem of controller design for quantum linear systems. Quantum linear systems are mathematical models widely used in quantum technology, for example, quantum optics and opto-mechanical systems. To make a quantum linear system achieve the pre-specified performance, effective control is required. The research project propose several efficient quantum controller design methods. These methods allow one to study quantum squeezing and quantum information processing. In other words, the research carried in this project is an step toward efficient quantum control engineering.

521610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
521610.value: 最优停时问题在管理科学、工程、经济和金融投资等领域中具有重要应用，在过去的几十年中该问题在正向随机系统中已被广泛研究和发展。然而，带终时状态类的随机系统问题尚未被深入研究和发展，如金融衍生工具中的美式期权问题。此项目主要研究正倒向随机系统的最优停时问题。发展一类新方法克服当前文献之中的不足之处并将所得理论结果应用于一类具有挑战性且相当实际的重要金融决策模型。该类模型主要帮助投资者在投资过程中选择恰当的时机处理风险资产以取得最大回报。

521610.label: Realisation of objectives
521610.value: In addition to contributing to the academic literature, our study has important yet practical relevance. With the alarm bells the on-going financial crisis rings, risk hedging has drawn much more attention than ever. Among various approaches of hedging and managing risk, high-dimensional American options are preferable by institutional investors. Further developing the methods presented by prior research, our approach determines the region in which managers should exit their investee companies based on dynamic risk-sensitive models in financial investment. Moreover, our approach is easily implementable with a standard numerical technique, and therefore it provides managers with a usable way to make exit decisions. In addition, we present a motivation of mixed LQ problem from a two-stage project management in the accepted paper. Our study adds to the investment literature, since it extends the ideas for helping determining the optimal time of stopping investments in the literature. Except these, we also develop portfolio selection to consider the mixed problem on optimal stopping and optimal strategies. During the project period, we also study multi-period optimal portfolio selection model with mean-field formatulation, and extend our ideas to analyze consensus seeking in multi-agent systems, the models urban planning and the capital investment of some high-tech company in the phrase of primary research and development.

521610.label: Major findings and research outcome
521610.value: Optimal stopping (or exit) strategies are critical for investors and manageres, such as venture capitalists and business angels, to receive investment returns successfully. We find an optimization process and stopping time so as to meet certain investment criteria, such as, the maximum of an expected utility value before or at the maturity and develop an approach to help investors and managers determine an optimal stopping region. Analyzing the corresponding free boundary problem, we establish the properties of the free boundary and optimal strategy for the original problem. Except these, we also introduce forward-backward differentail equations to develop the original idea, and we further consider it in discrete-time model during this project period. We published some papers and completed some working papers.

521610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
521610.value: [1] Optimal stopping techniques proposed in this project can be further employed to study multi-period linear-quadratic portfolio selection models. [2] Our methodologies and techniques on portfolio selection can be adopted to study time-inconsistent models. [3] Our methods developed in this project can be applied to urban planning and manager's compensation with underlying assets following stochastic volatility and interest rates.

521610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
521610.value: As for the theoretical contributions, this study will contribute to the literature on various topics such as portfolio selection, investment strategies, fund management, incentive compensation, and agency theory. Specific to the literature on portfolio theory and investment, we expect the results to help shed light on the investment strategies on the basis of financial underlying assets in a continuous-time framework. In addition, the methods adopted in the current research program will also improve the techniques studied and the implementations developed in the field of investment and portfolio selection. This project is believed to be of value and of practical importance with long-term significance, and results derived from it are expected to yield highly publishable work. As one of the international financial centers in the global economy, finally, Hong Kong is currently suffering from the financial storm rooting in the United States and seeking risk-hedging solutions to stabilize the Hong Kong financial markets. Therefore, the project is particularly relevant to Hong Kong since it helps provide risk-management advice for Hong Kong policy makers and institutional investors by better understanding and controlling the risk.

522110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
522110.value: Bulk metallic glasses (BMGs), a new emerging class of metallic materials, have attracted extensive interest because of their unique mechanical and physical properties, including extremely high strength, large elastic strain limit, good corrosion resistance, and superior magnetic properties. In spite of these promising properties, their widespread applications are limited primarily due to their limited glass-forming ability (GFA) and high production cost, which are the major obstacles to the economic manufacture of these materials for industrial applications at present. For the past decade, considerable effort has been devoted to exploring the GFA of BMGs; however, most of approaches are mainly from thermodynamic and kinetic aspects in macroscopic scales. As a result, none of them are capable of predicting GFA from given alloy compositions. This proposed research aims at developing computational methodology and experimental techniques to resolve this issue from an atomic structure perspective. We intend to develop a scientific scheme to quantitatively correlate the GFA with atomic structures in the Zr-Ni-Al model system (see Fig. 1). Based on this correlation, the ultimate goal is to understand glass formation from the atomic-scale structure and alloy composition, and then to provide scientific principles to design novel BMGs with superior GFA. First-principles ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD), classical MD and reverse Monte Carlo simulations will be used to investigate the atomic-level structures and assess the glass formation and GFA. The structural features of atomic clusters and free volume, including their hierarchical orderings, energy states and percolations, will be quantitatively measured in MD simulations as a function of alloy composition. A systematic variation of alloy compositions will be used to reveal the composition dependence of GFA. Base on these results, the quantitative correlation between atomic structure and GFA will be developed by carefully analyzing their atomic-scale structural features in different alloy compositions. To verify the simulation results, the state-of-the-art techniques, including high resolution transmission electron microscopy, synchrotron extended X-ray absorption fine structure and neutron diffraction, will be conducted. Based on this systematic investigation, we will be in a position to understand how atomic clusters and short-range orders existing in the amorphous and supercooled liquid states affect glass formation and then to assess GFA from an atomic structure perspective. The implementation of this proposed research will lead to the understanding of atomic structures and glass formation of BMGs, and the development of innovative BMGs with vast industrial potentials for high-tech applicaitons in Hong Kong. 作為近年來出現的一種新型金屬材料，塊體金屬玻璃具有非常高的強度、大的彈性極限、良好的耐腐蝕性和優異的磁性等獨特的力學和物理性能，目前已經引起了人們的廣泛關注。儘管上述優異的性能可使塊體金屬玻璃具有廣泛的應用前景，然而其有限的玻璃形成能力和高的製造成本嚴重阻礙塊體金屬玻璃的工業應用。因此，如何理解玻璃形成及評價玻璃形成能力是一直是該領域內的研究熱點。儘管目前已有大量工作對此問題進行研究，然而現有工作大都是從宏觀熱力學和動力學的角度出發。因此，目前還不能夠基於合金成分對其玻璃形成能力進行預測。本項目的目的是要發展一種計算和實驗相結合的方法從原子結構的角度出發來解決此問題。我們將提出一種科學方法，以Zr-Ni-Al合金系為研究物件，建立玻璃形成能力和原子結構之間的定量關係。在此基礎上，建立原子結構-合金成分-玻璃形成能力三者之間的關係，最終為設計性能優異的塊體金屬玻璃材料提供一個科學依據。 我們將應用第一原理分子動力學，經典分子動力學和逆蒙特卡羅等類比方法研究原子結構和評價玻璃形成和玻璃形成能力。通過分子動力學類比， 我們將定量表徵原子團簇和自由體積（包括各種尺度的有序結構、能態和各種結構之間的逾滲）隨合金成分的變化；通過系統變化合金成分，我們將揭示玻璃形成能力和成分之間的關係。在此基礎上，通過仔細分析不同合金中原子結構的特徵，我們將建立原子結構和玻璃形成能力之間的定量關係。此外，我們將採用包括高分辨透射電子顯微鏡、同步輻射擴展X射線吸收精細結構譜和中子衍射在內的先進實驗技術以證實上述模擬結果。在此系統研究的基礎上，我們將對非晶態和過冷液態中的原子團簇和短程序如何影響玻璃形成有深入地理解，從而能夠從原子結構的角度對玻璃形成能力進行評估。 該項目的實施將加深我們對金屬玻璃原子結構和玻璃形成的理解，同時也將開發出有望應用於香港高科技工業社會的新型塊體金屬玻璃材料。

522110.label: Realisation of objectives
522110.value: We have mainly focused on the Zr-Cu-Al alloy systems rather than the Zr-Ni-Al alloy system in the realization of our objectives. It is because that we started our study in the binary Zr-Ni and Zr-Cu alloy systems, and found a much better glass-forming ability (GFA) and more available experimental data in the Zr-Cu and Zr-Cu-Al alloy systems than those in the Zr-Ni and Zr-Ni-Al ones. Therefore, logically we had extended our studies from the Zr-Cu binary alloys to the Zr-Cu-Al ternary alloys to investigate the properties as a function of alloy composition to achieve our objectives. Furthermore, more bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) have been prepared by us and other investigators in the Zr-Cu-Al than in the Zr-Ni-Al alloy system. For the first objective, we have revealed the intrinsic feature of various atomic clusters and free volume successfully based on the first-principles calculations, the ab-initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) and classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and the high-resolution transmission-electron-microscopy (HRTEM) analysis in the model Zr-Cu-Al ternary alloy system. After a careful investigation of the intrinsic feature of atomic structures as a function of composition in the model ternary alloy system, we have proposed a method to estimate the fraction of free volume existing in the loosely packed atomic clusters (or liquid-like zones) with defect bonds associated with the central atom. Furthermore, their value and associated energies have been calculated as a function of the composition and correlated them with GFA. For the second objective, based on our developed atomistic approach of γFP (GFA estimated from first principles calculations), the composition dependence of GFA can be readily established in the model ternary alloy system. Accordingly, the proposed γFP as a function of Al concentration in the model Zr-Cu-Al alloy system has been calculated, and a very similar trend of the dependence on the Al concentration is observed between the γFP and the experimental results. Furthermore, the best glass former has been pinpointed, which is in excellent agreement with the reported composition-dependent GFA based on experimental data. For the third objective, we have derived the fraction of the excessive atomic space (free volume) in the supercooled liquid from the atomic structure perspective to represent the kinetic effect on GFA. And by combining with the thermodynamic effect derived from formation enthalpies of various phases, an atomistic approach to γFP has been developed as a scientific principle to assess and predict the glass formation and GFA in multi-component alloy systems. This approach has been verified effectively in the model binary and ternary alloy systems.

522110.label: Major findings and research outcome
522110.value: The atomic cluster and free volume have been probed and measured quantitatively as a function of alloy composition in the model alloy systems. A unique combination of atomistic simulations and experimental techniques has been used to probe the atomic structures in details [1-7]. In particular, the global atomic packing symmetry feature has been found to be effective in some complex cases based on theoretical atomistic simulations coupled with synchrotron X-ray scattering experiments [1]. Moreover, the interconnecting-zone (I-zone) has been described quantitatively based on the atomic bonding lengths by Radial distribution function (RDF) studies and the AIMD simulations, and the nearest atom pairs in the I-zone have also been analyzed [4]. Meanwhile, the content of local crystal-like order has been characterized through the high-resolution transmission-electron-microscopy (HRTEM) analysis, and the formation of crystal-like order at the atomic scale was revealed to play an important role in enhancing the GFA of the Zr-Cu-Al base BMGs [5]. Furthermore, the intrinsic atomic structure is believed to have a close correlation with the kinetic effect. We claim that the excessive atomic space (free volume) existing in the supercooled liquid affects the crystallization process intrinsically. A lower fraction of the excessive atomic space in the supercooled liquid implies a denser atomic packing and a lower atomic mobility, all of which make the crystallization process more difficult. Accordingly, the fraction of excessive atomic space (free volume) in the supercooled liquid has been calculated based on the molecular dynamic simulations, and it has been proven playing an important role in the prediction of GFA [2,6,7]. Moreover, the driving force of glass formation and the resistance to crystallization have been calculated, respectively, based on the first-principles total energy calculations, and then the value of the glass forming parameter, γ*, proposed by Xia et al. has been calculated based on internal energies in each alloy and applied to represent the thermodynamic effects on GFA. It is noticed that the thermodynamic effect is essential but not the only factor in consideration of predicting GFA. Therefore, by considering both of the thermodynamic effects and atomic structure induced kinetic effects on GFA, an atomistic approach has been developed to predict the trend of GFA from alloy compositions alone based on the first-principles calculation and molecular dynamic simulations. The validity and power of this atomistic approach have been verified successfully by available experimental data in the model binary and ternary alloy systems.

522110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
522110.value: The effectiveness of the developed atomistic approach to predict GFA can be further investigated in other multicomponent alloy systems. With the development of the new high performance computer cluster in our college, it is possible to perform AIMD simulations in an alloy system with a maximum of five components, which does not have all the developed inter-atomic potentials for classical MD simulations. Moreover, more and more inter-atomic potentials are being developed for our use in the MD simulations to calculate the parameters involved in our atomistic approach to predict the GFA in various alloy systems. Novel BMGs with excellent GFA and low production cost for high-tech applications can be designed based on our prediction from the atomistic approach. A series of alloys close to and far away from the predicted nominal compositions can be prepared by arc melting. The copper mold suction casting will be used to prepare BMG ingots with different sizes. The X-ray diffraction (XRD) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) will be used to examine the amorphous nature of as-cast samples. By comparing their critical sizes of fully amorphous rods in different alloy systems, we can verify the GFA prediction from our scheme and design novel BMGs.

522110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
522110.value: This research project has significant impacts on science and technology of BMGs: 1) The revealing of the intrinsic feature of atomic structures contributes to a fundamental understanding of glass transition, and physical and mechanical behaviors of BMGs. 2) A solid structure-composition-GFA relationship has been established. It is of great significance to address the long-standing issue, that is, how to predict the GFA effectively in multicomponent alloy systems only from alloy compositions in terms of theoretical calculations, rather than experimental efforts with a trial-and-error method. 3) Furthermore, the physical scenario revealed from this study has extensive implications for the design of novel bulk metallic glasses with superior GFA and low production cost for high-tech applications in Hong Kong as well as in the world.

522410.label: Project Title(Chinese)
522410.value: 仅只是一个二级采购源吗？电子市场在供应链中的影响与作用

522410.label: Project Objectives
522410.value: Construct the basic modeling for the supply strategy of a manufacturer and the procurement strategy of a distributor who maximize their own utilities in a Stackelberg dual-channel environment. Identify conditions under which a unique Stackelberg equilibrium exists for the decentralized and risk-averse decisions of the two players on production, pricing and procurement for the traditional channel when they may also actively participate in the e-market. Examine the behaviors of the manufacturer and the distributor under the impact of e-market volatility. Analyze how risks and risk attitudes may be exploited strategically to strengthen a supply chain member's market position. Provide answers and explanations to questions on: whether an e-market serves only as a secondary channel to the supply chain members or plays a more fundamental role in reshaping the supply chain members' strategies; Whether the supply chain will be more efficient; and Whether the traditional retail channel will still play an active role when the supply chain members actively participate in a flourishing e-market. Explore different supply contracts in the retail channel so that we can analyze how the e-market may change the way one conducts business transactions in the traditional channel.

522410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
522410.value: The emergence of B2B e-markets has changed supply chain structures and how commercial transactions take place between firms in many industries. This new business landscape posts questions on how the manufacturer and distributor should reshape their supply and procurement strategies to take advantage of the flexibility offered by the second trade channel. There have been many studies of e-markets from different perspectives. However, the modeling assumptions in these works may have been based on certain types of e-markets or from some specific angles so that some fundamental questions regarding the impacts and roles of e-markets remain unanswered. For example, with limited numbers of participants in the e-markets studied, e-market prices are assumed endogenous through participants’ actions to balance their demands and supplies. For more mature e-markets, especially some more recent ones in China, there are usually many participants and they are all price takers, and thus the e-market price is exogenous. Because of sufficient liquidity, many participants also use the e-market as a venue for speculation. This makes the e-market rather volatile and exposes the participants to considerable price risks. The behaviors of the supply chain members are likely affected differently depending on their respective risk tolerances, and the roles of e-markets may also be different to different supply chain members. This important risk issue is not considered in other existing works in which the e-market price are assumed exogenous. Obviously, a different modeling framework is needed to study these more mature e-markets. The proposed project will study the supply strategy of a manufacturer and the procurement strategy of a distributor with decentralized price and quantity decisions. Both supply chain members may participate as price takers in a liquid e-market with an exogenous price. The members may be risk-averse and maximize their own utilities in a Stackelberg dual-channel environment. We address the fundamental open questions: how are the equilibrium production and pricing strategies of the manufacturer affected by its own risk tolerance, by that of distributor’s, and by the volatility of the e-market? Will the e-market simply be a second trade channel or can provide a strategic tool to improve the manufacturer’s market position? How should the distributor respond to the manufacturer’s decisions? Will the supply chain be more efficient? The successful completion of this project will answer these important questions and contribute to the understanding of a new market structure in theory as well as for business practice. B2B电子市场的出现已改变了很多工业中供应链的结构以及公司间的商业交易模式。这个新的商业环境促使制造商和分销商如何重塑其供应和采购战略以获利于由第二交易渠道所提供的灵活性。虽然已有一些从不同角度对电子市场的研究，但这些工作中的模型往往是基于某些特定的电子市场，而有关电子市场的影响与作用的基本问题则尚待回答。比如说，部分现有的研究基于电子市场交易商数量有限而假设交易价格为内生。这对于如中国目前的较成熟的电子市场而言是不贴切的。在这些电子市场中，交易商的数量以及交易量庞大，使交易价格成为外生而不可能被少数交易商控制。较高的流动性促使一些交易商把电子市场作为投机平台，从而使电子市场波动性较强，交易商面临较大的价格风险。取决于各自的风险偏好，供应链成员的行为也不尽相同。但是现有的研究并没有考虑这个十分重要的风险问题。很显然，我们需要一个新的模型框架来研究成熟的电子市场。 本项目将研究分布式定价与定量供应链中制造商的供应策略以及分销商的采购策略。两个供应链成员都是流动的电子市场的外生价格的接收者。他们也可能是Stackelberg双渠道环境中风险规避的价值最大化者。我们将讨论一些根本性的问题：制造商的均衡生产与定价策略将如何受到他自己的风险偏好，分销商的风险偏好，以及电子市场的波动性的影响。电子市场将只是作为第二个交易渠道仰或一个可以帮助制造商巩固其市场地位的战略工具？对于制造商的决策，分销商又将如何应对？供应链将更加高效吗？本项目的成功完成将回答以上重要问题并有助于我们冲理论和商业实践上认识这个新的市场结构。

522410.label: Major findings and research outcome
522410.value: We studied the decentralized decisions of risk-averse supplier and manufacturer in the presence of a fully liquid B2B spot market with Stackelberg game models [C1]. From the analytical Stakelberg equilibrium, we gain insights into how the supply chain members risk attitudes affect their strategies under various market environments in demand uncertainty and price volatility of the spot market. We find that when the manufacturer is relatively more risk-averse, relational contract is always needed in the supply chain. As the spot price increases, the supplier changes from contract sales only to dual channel (use spot market), and then alters from high-price strategy to low-price strategy. If the manufacturer is less risk-averse, spot trading is always adopted by both supply chain members. We also find that supply chain members adjust their strategy in anticipation of the spot price movement, If the expected spot price is high, dual channel and low-price strategy is optimal. By adjusting pricing, quantity, and channel strategies, supply chain members can effectively reap the benefit of spot trading and control their risk exposure. Our findings lead to the conclusion that rather than serving simply as a secondary channel, as shown by many in the literature, spot market also serves as a strategic tool for supply chain members. Strategic behaviors are taken by supply chain members in pricing, contract quantity, and channel choices with respect to the spot price volatility and risk-averse attitudes of the other member. When supplier is more risk-averse, the equilibrium contract price first decreases and then increases in manufacturer's risk attitude and spot price volatility. This phenomenon reveals an unintuitive managerial insight that decreasing spot price volatility may not necessarily be a good news to a risk-averse supplier, and such a supplier has a strong incentive to improve its risk management capability. This is not true for the downstream manufacturer. Finally, the manufacturer's risk attitude and the retail channel demand uncertainty exert a strong downward pressure on the retail selling price. We also studied the effect of demand and spot price information updating on the trading behaviors/strategies of supply chain members [C2]. We found that better demand information induces the supplier to more contract sales whereas the supplier becomes more reluctant to use contract sales when spot price information becomes superior. When the manufacturer's spot price knowledge improves, its contract price negotiation power increases. Contract order quantity is affected only by better demand information.

522410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
522410.value: In the current project, we have obtained many interesting findings on the trading behaviors and strategies of supply chain members with a spot market. These findings have significant practical implications and should be tested/verified by empirical evidences. However, trading data are private information and are difficult to obtain, making a rigorous empirical study hard to achieve. We may consider using control experiments to test the various trading behaviors and strategies. With experiment, it is also possible to calibrate our model parameter assumptions and limitations. Such experiment will likely be complex requiring significant resource and time inputs. A follow up project is warranted.

522410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
522410.value: (Online) Spot market has become very common for commodity and commodity like products. In a supply chain context, spot market obviously provides a second trading channel. By modeling behaviors of a supplier and a manufacturer in a game model, we found in this project that to the trading members of a supply chain, the spot market is not just a second channel. The risk attitude and spot price volatility greatly affect members' trading behaviors, including pricing and quantity decision in contract sales, trading channel choices, retail channel pricing. These correlations between the inherent risk attitude/spot volatility and trading behavior have significant practical implications and provide the supply chain members with a tool to adjust their trading strategies so that they could position themselves advantageously. For example, when the manufacturer is relatively more risk-averse, contract trading is always needed. When the manufacturer is less risk-averse, spot trading is always adopted. The expected spot price affects supplier's channel and pricing strategy significantly. When the expected spot price is low, the supplier uses contract sales only. As spot price gets higher, the supplier first change to dual channel strategy and then alter pricing strategy from high to low.
