523110.label: Project Objectives
523110.value: The overall goal of the proposed work is to develop a novel and cost-effective technology for treating C(VI) in the industrial wastewater by an adsorbent developed from an industrial fermentation waste. The first specific objective for this project period is to evaluate the effects of various parameters on Cr(VI) adsorption and desorption by the fungal fermentation waste; To elucidate the mechanisms that govern Cr(VI) removal by the fungal fermentation waste; To immobilize the waste biomaterial and to develop a continuous reactor system for removing Cr(VI) from industrial wastewater; To develop a mathematical model capable of predicting the performance of the continuous adsorption reactor for Cr(VI) removal under different experimental conditions.
rows: The overall goal of the proposed work is to develop a novel and cost-effective technology for treating C(VI) in the industrial wastewater by an adsorbent developed from an industrial fermentation waste. The first specific objective for this project period is to evaluate the effects of various parameters on Cr(VI) adsorption and desorption by the fungal fermentation waste;
To elucidate the mechanisms that govern Cr(VI) removal by the fungal fermentation waste;
To immobilize the waste biomaterial and to develop a continuous reactor system for removing Cr(VI) from industrial wastewater;
To develop a mathematical model capable of predicting the performance of the continuous adsorption reactor for Cr(VI) removal under different experimental conditions.

523110.label: Realisation of objectives
523110.value: Four objectives have been addressed and successfully achieved in this research project. In regard to the first objective, the effects of various operating parameters, e.g., pH, time, temperature, on Cr(VI) adsorption by the fungal waste and Cr(III) by the fruit waste were determined. The equilibrium and kinetic data were simulated using different models. Batch contact Cr(VI) and Cr(III) desorption experiments were carried out using different desorption media. The study establishes the critical optimal operating conditions for the batch adsorption and desorption of Cr(VI) by the fungal waste and Cr(III) by the fruit waste. Concerning the second objective, a combination of spectroscopic methods, chemical methods, and high-resolution potentiometric titration was fruitfully used to identify the Cr(VI)-binding sites and to elucidate the mechanisms that govern the Cr(VI) removal by the fungal waste. Results reveal that the amine, carboxylate and phosphodiester groups were involved in the Cr(VI) removal process at pH 2. It was discovered that the Cr(VI) removal process consisted of three phases. The anionic Cr(VI) was first rapidly adsorbed onto the protonated fungal biomass surface through electrostatic attraction. In the second phase, the adsorbed Cr(VI) was then reduced to Cr(III) by the electron donating groups on the biomass surface. Finally, the bioreduced Cr(III) cations were either adsorbed on the carboxylate groups through ion exchange with protons on the biomass surface from the carboxyl groups or released into the aqueous solution by electrostatic repulsion between the Cr(III) cations and the positively-charged biomass surface. Regarding the third objective, a novel method was developed to immobilize the biomass waste. We have successfully coated Ca-alginate immobilized biomass waste with ethylenediamine functionalized silica (Silica-Alg-IM) and evaluated its mechanical, chemical and Cr(VI) removal properties under different operating conditions. Results demonstrate that the Silica-Alg-IM exhibited significantly enhanced mechanical, chemical and Cr(VI) removal properties. Nitric acid was discovered as an effective desorbing media. The key optimal operating conditions for the batch adsorption and desorption of Cr(VI) by Silica-Alg-IM were determined. A continuous fixed-bed reactor system packed with the Silica-Alg-IM was developed and optimized with different operating conditions for removing and recovering Cr(VI) from wastewater with efficient and stable performance. As for the fourth objective, a theoretical general rate model was developed to simulate the Cr(VI) removal performance of the continuous adsorption reactor packed with Silica-Alg-IM. The model satisfactorily predicted the breakthrough curve of Cr(VI) on the adsorption reactor under different experimental conditions.

523110.label: Major findings and research outcome
523110.value: A low-cost fungal biomass (Mucor rouxii) and a fruit waste (pomelo peel) exhibit excellent metal removal ability. The performance and mechanisms of Cr(VI) removal by this biomass waste and Cr(III) by the fruit waste were investigated. The study establishes the key optimal operating conditions for the batch adsorption of Cr(VI) by the fungal waste and Cr(III) by the fruit waste. The optimum pH value for Cr(VI) removal was found to be 2.0. The equilibrium data were simulated very well by the Redlich-Peterson model, while the kinetic data were simulated very well by the intraparticle diffusion and fractional power equations. The Cr(VI) and Cr(III) biosorption processes were endothermic, thermodynamically feasible and spontaneous under the examined conditions. Desorption of Cr(VI) and Cr(III) was most effective with 2 M nitric acid. The Cr(VI)-binding sites on the biomass surface and the governing Cr(VI) removal mechanisms were successfully elucidated by using a combination of spectroscopic methods including FTIR, XPS and SEM-EDX, chemical methods, and high-resolution potentiometric titration. Results show that at pH 2 the amine, carboxylate and phosphodiester groups on the biomass surface were involved in the Cr(VI) removal process. The Cr(VI) removal process is composed of three steps: (i) Electrostatic attraction of anionic Cr(VI) onto the protonated biomass surface; (ii) Reduction of Cr(VI) to Cr(III) by the electron donating groups on the biomass surface; and (iii) Complexation between the bioreduced Cr(III) and function groups on the biomass surface, or release of Cr(III) into the aqueous solution. Biomass was successfully immobilized in Ca-alginate coated with ethylenediamine functionalized silica (Silica-Alg-IM). The Silica-Alg-IM displayed significantly enhanced mechanical, chemical and Cr(VI) removal properties. Nitric acid (2 M) was identified as an efficient desorbing media. The important optimal operating conditions for the batch adsorption and desorption of Cr(VI) by Silica-Alg-IM were established. The kinetic and equilibrium data were well simulated by the Elovich equation and the Sips model, respectively. A continuous fixed-bed reactor system packed with the Silica-Alg-IM was developed and was capable of efficient and stable Cr(VI) removal and recovery from wastewater. The Cr(VI) removal performance of the fixed-bed reactor system was satisfactorily simulated by a theoretical general rate model, solved numerically using the finite element method for the discretization of z and the orthogonal collocation method for r. The present work results in eight conference papers and presentations. Three manuscripts have been submitted to three SCI peer-reviewed journals and are currently under review.

523110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
523110.value: Our study has demonstrated that the fungal biomass waste shows great potential to be applied in developing low-cost and effective adsorbents for removing Cr(VI) ions from contaminated water and wastewater. Thus, further research and development work is definitely warranted to evaluate the performance of the fungal biomass in a real environment. The fixed-bed immobilized biomass reactor should be scaled up and evaluated for treating industrial wastewaters produced by various industries. The long-term performance of the immobilized biomass reactor should be investigated and assessed. The theoretical general rate model should be evaluated for its ability to simulate the performance of the scale-up fixed-bed immobilized biomass reactor. In addition, the modeling work should be expanded to address the performance of the reactor system in the presence of competing ions in order to simulate and predict its performance for treating industrial effluents laden with multiple components. The fungal biomass can be used to remove other types of toxic heavy metals such as lead. The fungal biomass can also be used to remove organic pollutants such as dyes and chlorophenols. Further work should be carried out to assess its performance for removal of other types of toxic heavy metals and organic pollutants.

523110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
523110.value: Toxic heavy metals are among the most prevalent and problematic pollutants found in industrial wastewater. Toxic heavy metals are daily discharged in huge quantity into the environment from various industries. Of particular concern is chromium(VI) ions, which are discharged in large quantity from industries of electroplating, leather tanning, and dye. Chromium(VI) is one of the notoriously known toxic substances since it has carcinogenic and mutagenic effects in animals and humans. There is therefore a great need to develop highly efficient and low-cost processes for removing chromium(VI) from the industrial wastewater. This project successfully shows that a fungal biomass material can efficiently remove chromium(VI) from wastewater. The biomass material can be converted into useful, highly efficient, low-cost and green adsorbent for treatment of metal-contaminated industrial effluents. A column system packed with the biomass particles has been successfully developed for treating industrial effluent laden with chromium(VI). A reliable simulation model has also been developed for predicting the chromium removal performance of the column system. This model is an exceptionally useful tool for the better design, optimization and scale-up of adsorption processes for treating wastewater laden with chromium(VI).

523510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
523510.value: This proposal addresses the research question on how to make the retrieval for relevance feedback (RF) and blind feedback (BF) fast enough for widespread adoption. RF is an iterative process that feeds back the relevance judgments of a few top ranked documents of the current iteration of retrieval. These relevance judgments may be used to formulate new queries or for training retrieval models (e.g., support vector machines). BF is the same as RF except it is usually applied once and it assumes that the top few ranked documents are relevant rather than asking the user for relevance judgment. RF and BF currently carry out another search that builds a new retrieval list, or re-rank documents in the original (or initial) retrieval list. RF and BF are known to be good ways to improve retrieval effectiveness. However, BF or RF is slow for many search applications because its retrieval time is linearly dependent on the number of distinct terms in the query, and effective queries typically have a sizeable number of query terms. As part of a general approach to reducing retrieval times, we propose to (a) investigate five different re-retrieval and/or re-ranking retrieval schemes that are expected to affect retrieval effectiveness/efficiency and (b) design specialized index (e.g., burst tries, suffix tree and directed acyclic word graph) for subsequent retrieval. These specialized indices are for storing document vectors, vectors that represent the vocabulary of terms which occur in the context of query terms, and data structures for representing all suffixes or infixes (also called factors) of a document which is regarded as a string of terms. The index design is also concerned with storing and retrieving related information (e.g., term occurrences) for N-token-grams. The trade-off between retrieval effectiveness and retrieval time-space efficiency will be investigated using benchmark data (e.g., using TREC or NTCIR data). 這提案的研究問題是如何使到盲式或相應式的回饋搜查夠快. 相應式的回饋搜查是重覆的進程,而它回饋現時搜查的幾個排在最頂的文件的相應判定. 這相應判定可以制訂新的問題或用來訓練檢索模型. 盲式回饋搜查是和回饋搜查一樣除了它只用一次同時當最頂的文件是相應的. 利用新的問題 , 盲式或相應式的回饋搜查在次搜查,從而製作檢索列表, 又或者從新排序文件. 盲式或相應式的回饋搜查是出名能夠改良檢索效用.但是跟從的檢索是緩慢, 因為檢索的時間同有多小獨特的詞是成正比, 同時問題有不小獨特的詞. 要減小檢索時間, 我們提導(a) 探討五行從新搜查檢索或從新排序的檢索策劃 (b) 設計特殊的索引來幫肋以後的檢索. 這特殊的索引是設計到來儲藏文件的向量, 代表問題詞的上文下理的向量, 同時代表所有詞尾或詞中詞的數據結構. 索引的設計也和儲藏同檢索N詞串有關. 因為有許多可能性, 檢索時間和檢索效用的權衡會被探討.

523810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
523810.value: 身体支持介面承受過多不必要的壓力可導致組織崩潰，俗稱壓瘡。涉及的可包括骨突處周圍深層組織的受傷和表面皮膚的磨損。 最近的細胞培養，組織塊，動物實驗的研究結果顯示，表皮應力可直接造成細胞損傷和組織壞死，較缺血缺氧果效發生預期時間之前。在卸荷下, 血液的復灌可以導致進一步傷害，可能是由於隨復灌而來的氧化應激和炎症反應。這種加減表皮載荷帶來的反應，如果沒有適當的紓緩，可能會加劇壓瘡的形成。除了以傳統的壓力忍受時間的二維曲線來確定組織容忍一集加載的能力，承受不同方式加減載荷的能力對研究組織的可持續性也是非常重要。我們已建立了一個壓力性潰瘍的大鼠研究模式。我們將利用這個模式來研究在不同負荷後皮下肌肉在卸荷血液復灌時所引發的損壞和修復過程。並根據組織學和生物標誌物的研究，確定組織損壞後充分癒合所需的時間, 以促進組織可持續活力。利用這些信息，我們會把傳統壓力忍受時間的二維曲線擴大為壓力忍受時間及所須紓緩修復時間的三維可持續性表面。這研究項目將指導日後承介身體各種載荷表面的不同設計和對有壓瘡危險的病人引用的臨床洩壓方法。

523810.label: Realisation of objectives
523810.value: Among the four objectives of this project, objective one: to compare the trauma in the deep tissues caused by epidermal mechanical insults of high pressure for short duration and moderate pressure for long duration was successfully conducted. Tissue responses to three difference loading magnitudes (100, 200 and 300 mmHg) and 2 loading durations (6 hours of duration for 1 or 2 days) has been examined. In the second objective: to document the biological repair process and the concomitant reperfusion complications during the unloading phase of different loading-unloading episodes, we have examined tissue damages using H&E examination. Besides, to quantify tissue damage, we have developed a software tool to quantify the area of damage at tissues underneath the loading site. The third objective: to extend the conventional 2-dimensional pressure-duration tolerance curve to a 3-dimensional pressure-duration-relief sustainability surface to determine the sustainability of different loading-unloading patterns in terms of pressure ulcer prevention was completed. During our experiments, we found that with the use of H&E examination, tissue damages was not manifested shortly after the loading experiment. Tissue damages seems to reach a sever state at 6 days after injury. These findings affected our interpretation of the effect of short durations of loading at different pressure magnitudes. For the last objective: compare the differences in the results due to the introduction of relief/reperfusion periods into the total loading regime, we found that there is no significant between damages caused by having a reperfusion period between 2 episodes of loading. One drawback of this work is that when we submit our results for publication, we received feedback from reviewers that using H&E evaluation to examine/quantify tissue damage is inadequate. Other biochemical techniques are required to substantiate our findings. This affected our publication in this work.

523810.label: Major findings and research outcome
523810.value: In this study, we investigated the effect of tissue damage resulting from different magnitudes of loading, during of compression and the effect of repetitive loading. Besides, we also examined the effect of recovery over a period of 21 days. Based on our experimental results, we found that higher loading magnitude caused larger tissue deformation and hence more sever muscle damages. However, the cellular damages as viewed from H&E studies showed little difference immediately after loading. The damages were peaked at day 6 of post-injury. The higher the loading magnitude, the sever the damages are. From our experiment, no tissue damages were found to be irreversible. All animals recovered after 21 days after the experiment. H&E studies at 21 days showed full recovery of muscle structure. When repetitive loadings were applied (i.e. 6 hours/day for one or two days), no significant difference of tissue damages were found. Based on our experimental outcomes, we found that: (1) larger deformation of tissue compression caused more sever damages to muscle but such damages can only be revealed 2 days after the loading episode. (2) Despite of the severity of muscle damage, muscle tissues can recover from damages with 21 days. (3) The introduction of reperfusion between two loading episodes does not seem to cause aggregation in tissue damages. (4) The fixed period of tissue recovery time (21 days) after insult and the inability to generate a irreversible tissue breakdown lead us to question whether our current experimental model can truly mimic the situation leading to pressure ulcers.

523810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
523810.value: During the project, we identified a number of limitations and possible research directions which helps to proceed towards a clearer understanding of the etiology of pressure ulcers. The limitations in our current experimental model cannot allow us to monitor the deformation of tissues due to different loading magnitude. Also our hypothesis of tissue ischemia during loading may not be totally correct. We need to assess and quantify tissue blood perfusion under different loading conditions. Besides, if deformation if tissue is a key factor to tissue breakdown, we need so better way to control our experiment. In addition, the damages of tissue after loading were extremely sever. Instead of triggering a "pressure ulcer", these tissues fully recovered after 21 days. More works need to be done to answer this question before we can understand the causation of pressure ulcer.

523810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
523810.value: Pressure ulcers (PU) affect many individuals who have diminished sensation or dependent mobility. The prevention of the onset of PU is extremely important as PU can lead to amputation or death. Over the past, prevention of PU has always been focused on the magnitude and duration of loading. Little work has been done towards the effect of tissue damages of repetitive loading and recovery. This study revealed the changes of tissue under different loading conditions and examined tissue recovery after external load has been removed. The results of this work directed us to look into the triggering mechanism other than previous hypotheses of ischemia and deformation, where irreversible damages of tissue occurs.

524210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
524210.value: Certain properties of titanium alloys such as high strength to weight ratio, excellent corrosion resistance, biocompatibility and good formability make them advantageous for the fabrication of components used in the aerospace, marine, medical and leisure industries. However, their applications in tribological conditions are limited because of their relatively low hardness and poor wear resistance. To improve the hardness and wear resistance, many surface engineering techniques have been explored but because of various limitations, their industrial applications are limited. To enhance both the strength and wear properties simultaneously, researchers have developed titanium-metal-matrix-composites (Ti-MMC). Ti-MMCs with ceramic reinforcement phases have significant improvement in the mechanical and wear properties over the monolithic alloys. Some Ti-MMCs have found applications in some specific and demanding components. However, the major factors that hinder the wide applications of Ti-MMC are the high cost of production and non-uniform distribution of the ceramic reinforcement phases that brings about quality and reliability uncertainty. Researchers are still looking for ways to improve synergistically the strength and wear properties of Ti alloys. This project will investigate a new method to produce a novel type of Ti-MMC in which a reinforcement network grid of Titanium Nitride (TiN) will be fabricated on the alloy surface by laser surface modification technique. The TiN network grid is metallurgically integrated into the Ti alloy matrix at the surface. TiN has significantly higher hardness, better wear resistance and strength than the monolithic Ti alloy. It is postulated that by varying the TiN grid density and the dimensions of the TiN track, the strength and wear resistance can be tailor-made and enhanced synergistically. This surface grid reinforced MMC would have lower production cost and enhanced wear properties than the conventional MMC. Also, the grid approach is preferable than laser nitriding the entire surface because of less production time required, lower thermal stress resulted and better frictional property. In tribological applications that flat parallel surfaces are sliding on each other in lubricated conditions, such as seals and bearings, the surface structure of a hard TiN grid with soft Ti alloy matrix in between may facilitate the surfaces with reduced friction which is attributed by the formation of hydrostatic bearing film. The results of this project will make possible applications of Ti alloy into potential area of lighter combustion engines, disk brake rotors, seals and bearings and can contribute to energy saving and increase the service life of tribological components. 鈦合金的若干特性，如高強度/重量比，優良的耐腐蝕性，生物相容性和良好的成形性使鈦合金元件在航空航天，航海，醫療和運動等領域中有獨特的地位。然而，由於其硬度較低和耐磨性較差, 鈦合金的應用有其局限性。為了提高 其硬度和耐磨性，研究人員探討了多種表面工程技術，但由於種種限制，這些技術在工業上的應用是有限的。為了同時加強硬度和耐磨性能，研究人員已經開發出鈦金屬基複合材料（Ti – MMC），顯著地改善了鈦合金的力學性能和耐磨性。有些鈦金屬基複合材料己被應用於高要求的組件。然而，由於Ti - MMC的生產成本高，加上陶瓷強化相的分佈往往因不均勻而影響其性能，Ti – MMC還沒有被廣泛地應用。 研究人員仍然在尋找各種方法來協同地提高鈦合金的強度和耐磨性能。本項目將探討一種新類型的表層Ti - MMC，其中氮化鈦（TiN）強化相網格由激光表面改性技術組裝於鈦合金表，使氮化鈦網格融入鈦基合金的表面。相對於鈦合金, 氮化鈦有極高的硬度，更好的耐磨性和強度。據推測，通過不同的氮化鈦網格密度和TiN軌道的尺寸，可量身定制Ti – MMC的硬度和耐磨性，以及使兩者協同地增強。與傳統的MMC比較, 這種新型的表層Ti – MMC可降低生產成本和提高磨損性能。此外，與激光氮化整個表面比較, 網格氮化鈦還有操作時間短，熱應力較低和摩擦性能更好等優點。在平面互相摩擦的應用中，如密封件和軸承，硬的氮化鈦網格和軟的合金基體有利於形成油膜, 是一對很好的配合。這個項目的成果，可將鈦合金應用輕形的燃燒發動機，盤式制動器轉子，密封件和軸承，並有助於節約能源，提高摩擦學組件的壽命。

524210.label: Realisation of objectives
524210.value: 1. Objectives 1 and 2 Parametric design approach was applied to optimize the processing parameters in order to achieve laser gas nitriding (LGN) without melting. After LGN, a uniform TiN surface track of about 1.76 μm could be formed without melting. X-ray diffraction spectra confirmed the formation of titanium nitride (TiN). The formation of the nitrided layer on titanium alloy is more complicated than on pure Ti. Nitrogen (N) absorbed at the surface under laser irradiation diffuses inward into NiTi at elevated temperatures. Rapid diffusion of N into the surface of NiTi during laser treatment will first form an interstitial solution in NiTi. Upon saturation of this interstitial solution, TiN will eventually be formed due to the great affinity of Ti for N. When TiN is formed on the surface NiTi by consuming Ti from the substrate, a Ni-rich phase will be formed somewhere, due to conservation of matter. The results of indicate depletion of Ni in the surface layer after nitriding of NiTi. 2. Objectives 3 and 4 Grids of TiN tracks were fabricated on the NiTi surface with different spacing. NiTi samples with longitudinal TiN surface tracks of 3 to 1 mm spacing have achieved 60-90% increase in yield stress respectively. Samples with traverse tracks of TiN have yield stresses worse than those of the untreated samples. This is because of the stress concentration at the traverse TiN tracks. The wear test results demonstrate that NiTi with TiN surface grids exhibits better wear performance and lower friction coefficient than that of untreated NiTi in the same wear pair with UHMWPE. The wear rates for both NiTi and UHMWPE were significantly reduced in the nitrided-grid-NiTi/UHMWPE pair. The wear factor ratio of the nitrided-grid-NiTi/UHMWPE pair indicates that as the TiN area coverage increases, the wear volume losses of TiN and UHMWPE both decrease. However, when the TiN area coverage increases from 35% to 55%, the wear factor ratios of TiN and UHMWPE are nearly the same. Going beyond 55% TiN area coverage, the wear factor ratio drops again in both of TiN and UHMWPE. TiN is much harder than NiTi and has a higher wear resistance. Thus, increasing TiN area favors enhancing wear performance. The soft area in the network traps the wear debris to prevent them stay on the surface and become detrimental to friction and wear as a third body.

524210.label: Major findings and research outcome
524210.value: Laser gas nitriding (LGN) on NiTi has been endeavored with an aim of obtaining a hard TiN surface without melting. Friction and wear performance of nitrided and untreated NiTi in Hanks’ solution were studied using reciprocating test. The following concluding remarks could be made. 1. With the laser power and nitrogen gas flow rate fixed at 90 W and 40 L/min, the optimal laser scanning speed and laser spot diameter are respectively 60 mm/min and 2.2 mm for achieving solid-state nitriding without surface melting. The thickness of nitride layer is about 1.76 μm. (published in ICALEO 2012 , paperP171) 2. Nitriding of NiTi improves the wear performance of the NiTi/UHMWPE wear pair in Hanks’ solution, as evidenced by the significant reduction in wear rates for both contact materials in the pair. This could be attributed to a higher HN/Er ratio of the nitride layer, and to a lower coefficient of friction. In addition, the wear factors decrease with increasing area of nitride coverage. ( published in ICALEO 2014 paper P128) 3. Nitriding of NiTi increases its hydrophilicity in Hanks’ solution. A hydrophilic (nitrided NiTi)/hydrophobic (UHMWPE) friction couple promotes the efficiency of lubrication and further reduces the wear rate. The results of the present investigation indicate that laser grid-nitriding of NiTi via solid-state diffusion is an effective process for improving the tribological performance of the NiTi/UHMWPE wear pair in Hanks’ solution. The project results show that it is feasible to improve the yield stress of Titanium alloys by laser gas nitrided TiN surface network reinforcement. It is not necessary to harden the entire surface by overlapping TiN tracks. An increase of 60 to 90% in yield stress was observed at suitable track spacing of longitudinal laser gas nitrided TiN tracks. This novel surface reinforcement network grid does not alter the surface roughness of the component and can enhance the strength and wear resistance of the Ti alloy and reduce its friction coefficient. ( submitted to Journal of Materials science and Technology, being reviewed)

524210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
524210.value: The experiments and results of the current project were all based on samples of flat surface geometry. In practice, Titanium alloy femoral head is of complex spherical shape and it is a challenge to fabricate the TiN surface grid network on the polished femoral head. Using the process parameters optimized in this project and employing robotic laser beam delivery method, it is possible to fabricate the TiN surface grid on a polished femoral head without surface melting and damage the polished surface. Collaboration is being sough with overseas group who have robotic beam delivery facilities.

524210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
524210.value: Titanium alloys used as medical implant have attracted a lot of interests. However, the wear resistance of these alloys is poor and causes concerned.Various surface coating methods can be applied to enhance the wear resistance. Techniques such as physical vapor deposition and chemical vapor deposition have been studied but they have limitations such as poor interfacial adhesion and high temperature distortion, respectively. Laser gas nitriding (LGN) of Titanium alloy to produce a hard Titanium Nitride surface phase has been widely studied but its application is still not adopted widely. The major problem of LGN is that it involves surface melting which would destroy the roughness of the polished components. By using the laser-solid-state-diffusion process developed in this project, it is possible to produce a hard TiN phase on Ti alloy surface without involving surface melting. The results also show that by fabricating longitudinal TiN tracks on surface, the yield stress of Ti alloys can be enhanced. By fabricating a net-work grid of TiN tracks with different spacing on the Ti alloy surface, significant increase in wear resistance and decrease in friction coefficient can be achieved. This process can be applied to fabricate Titanium components for wear resistant applications.

524710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
524710.value: Thermal and moisture comfort, function and eco impact of diapers are very important for consumers in both healthcare and domestic usages. The comfort, functional performance and eco impact are determined by the dynamic heat and moisture transfer and interactions between the human body and diapers, which are related to the heat and moisture properties of textile materials, design and fitness and materials of the diapers. To design diapers for optimized comfort and functional performance and minimized eco impact, sound scientific understanding of the dynamic thermal interactions between the body and diapers need to be developed. This project is proposed to carry out a systematical study on this problem by modeling and simulating the dynamic heat and moisture transfers and conducting psychophysical experiments to obtain experimental data on the sensory comfort and functional requirements from human subjects. The research output of this project will advance our knowledge in engineering design of diapers for achieving optimized comfort and functional performance, which will improve the quality of life for human beings. Meanwhile, the eco impact of various designs and use of materials will be evaluated for ensuring the sustainability of our living environment. 在醫學及家居用途上，溫暖度和吸濕舒適度、功能和環保各方面對消費者來說都非常重要。舒適、效能和環保方面是由人體與尿片之間的熱能動力、濕度轉移，以及互相影響所訂定。這是全取決於尿片之紡織料的熱能和濕度特性，設計、合身裁剪及生產物料等因素。要設計出具最理想舒適度和高效能，以及對環境影響最低的尿片，首先必需發展出一套科學知識以理解人體與尿片之間的熱能動力相互影響。本研究計劃會對這問題作出一系列的研究以定立熱能動力和濕度轉移之模式及其促進作用，並且進行心理物理學上之實驗來得出因應人體舒適感覺和切合功能的測試數據。本研究計劃所得出之結論可促進尿片工程學設計以製作出具最理想舒適度和高效能，以及能改善人類生活質素之尿片。與此同時，亦可以各種不同的環保設計及生產物料，並對其能維持生活環境不變以作出評估。

524710.label: Major findings and research outcome
524710.value: This study has successfully established the psychophysical relationship between the temperature and moisture distribution using the computational simulations and objective measurements. The mathematical models were developed to simulate dynamic fabric-skin mechanical interactions when wearing diapers and the 2D and 3D visualizations could be established to picture directly the dynamic heat and moisture transfer processes in wet condition, including the changes of fabric temperature and humidity gradient, capacity of absorbing moisture, water vapour concentration and evaporation condensation rate in each layer of diaper. Meanwhile, we have developed the effective method of measuring subjective comfort sensation when diapers are used (See item 1 and 2 of Part C9). The results found that the superior fabric’s heat/moisture transporting properties, when incorporated into diapers, is the main mechanism for reducing heat and wetness of the diaper area. In addition, the S-smart system is developed as a computer aided design tool and it has been proved to be effective in predicting the thermal functional performance of diapers by good agreement between the temperatures and humidity derived from the wear trials and the predictions (See item 2 of Part C8). In this study, we also conduct a critical review of disposable and reusable diapers in terms of which one poses more threat to the environment (See item 1 of Part C8). From the modeling and simulation results, it found that the reusable diapers provided lowest carbon and eco-footprints compared to its counterparts. According to Life Cycle assessment on disposable and reusable diapers, it addressed that if diaper used all reusable materials without disposable inserts, it can bring carbon and eco-footprints significantly down (See item 3 of Part C8).

524710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
524710.value: In the future development of the research, it is necessary for creation of databank to store the moisture, thermal and comfort sensation performance of various disposable and reusable diaper's materials. Using computational simulation, an appropriate and effective eco-friendly diaper's design would be worked out to provide better environmental protection.

524710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
524710.value: The study is a mid-stream research and the study outcomes provide guidance for the optimal design of Eco-friendly diapers with reusable, breathable and biodegradable materials. For example, new eco-friendly diapers can be designed in which the briefs are reusable and breathable, and the inner pads are disposable. Thus less landfill is required as the inner layer of pads is bio-degradable and degrades well. We have also conducted life cycle assessment on disposable and reusable materials in diapers and the findings are very useful for environmental protection. Such innovative clothing design incorporating above elements would offer both environmental and health benefits.

525310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
525310.value: There is great concern about air quality and visibility in Hong Kong and the Pearl River Delta region, especially the adverse health effects of fine particulates, and the economic impacts of poor visibility. In July 2009 the Hong Kong government announced adoption of WHO standards for fine particulates, of 25μg/m³ over 24 hours, and current levels are far in excess of this. Estimation of atmospheric aerosols from satellite images is becoming more reliable as sensors with improved spectral, spatial and temporal resolution become available. Accuracies for Aerosol Optical Thickness (AOT) within 20% are generally observed for global models. The PI’s team at PolyU have obtained AOT accuracies within 10% using an improved Minimum Reflectance Technique (MRT) with 500m resolution MODIS images, giving high spatial resolution aerosol data over the urbanized region of Hong Kong and the Pearl River Delta. However the relationship between satellite AOT, which represents the whole atmospheric column between the satellite and ground, and ground pollution levels is more difficult to establish. Highly variable results are generally obtained for pollutants which have recently been associated with increased sickness and morbidity, including ozone and fine particulates (PM2.5). In view of the promising results by the PI’s team for AOT estimation in the Hong Kong region, their recent establishment of an urban and a rural AERONET station at the Hong Kong PolyU and the imminent set-up of a micro-pulse lidar under MPLNET, the research team has a strong capability to improve satellite-based modeling of ground concentrations of fine particulates. Research will include (i) improved aerosol modeling from a new suite of state-of-the-art satellite sensors including the National Polar Orbiting Operational Environmental Satellite System (NPOESS) and AVHRR-3 programmes and (ii) the establishment of a logical and consistent relationship between fine resolution AOT from these sensors, and ground level PM2.5 concentrations, using additional environmental data including relative humidity, wind speed, and fractional column AOT from Lidar. This project will provide (i) models for mapping fine particulates over Hong Kong and the Pearl River Delta at high spatial and temporal resolution from satellite images, which can be used to monitor and verify newly announced air quality standards in Hong Kong (ii) a satellite-based method for prediction and forecasting of ground level pollution concentrations, and (iii) evaluation of a composite temporal and spatial observation system based on multiple state-of-the-art platform/sensor combinations, for continuous air quality monitoring over the Pearl River Delta region. 隨著光譜、空間及時間解析度之進步，利用衛星影像作大氣氣溶膠之推算變得更為可靠。一般而言，全球模型所計算出來的氣溶膠光學厚度(AOT)之準確度在20%內。然而，當有充夠的地區性氣溶膠及地面資料作比對，全球模型在地區層面應用的準確度也得以改進。而香港理工大學的科硏隊伍利用經改良的最小反射率技術(MRT)及覆蓋香港市區及珠江三角洲的500米高解析度MODIS影像, 將測量氣溶膠光學厚度(AOT)的準確度提升至10%以內。雖然如此，由於從衛星推算的氣溶膠光學厚度代表衛星跟地面之間的整個大氣氣柱, 因此經推算的氣溶膠光學厚度與地面污染的關係仍然難以建立。而較為不穩定的結果一般發生在與臭氧及2.5微米的粒子(PM2.5)等致病污染物上。理大科硏隊伍的研究將包括(i)利用一套包括(美國)國家作業氣象衛星系統(NPOESS)及先進特高解輻射計(AVHRR-3)在內的最先進遙感衛星系統,以改善氣溶膠建模技術，及(ii)利用附加的環境數據，包括相對濕度、風速及從鐳射雷達(LIDAR)所量度的部份氣溶膠光學厚度(AOT)柱，建立一個具邏輯性及一致性的衛星推算氣溶膠光學厚度與地面微粒(PM2.5)濃度的關係。 這項計劃將提供(i)數個香港及珠江三角洲的高空間及時間解析度微粒圖模型，並用於監控以及驗證最近發表的香港空氣質素指標、(ii)一個基於遙感衛星所建立的地面氣溶膠濃度及可見度的預報及預測方法，及(iii)對一個基於多個最先進的遙感衛星載台/感測器結合的時間和空間觀察系統的評估，為珠江三角洲地區的全天候空氣質素監控。

526310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
526310.value: In nanometer-scale VLSI physical design, clock network becomes a major concern on determining total performance of digital circuit. Compared to conventional clock network synthesis (CNS), variations and power consumption are two important issues today. PVT (Process, Voltage and Temperature) variations contribute a lot to the timing behavior. Some system level design techniques for saving power also affect the methodology of clock network synthesis. Previous works on CNS include delay balancing and geometric matching. However, traditional methods mainly focused on skew and wirelength minimization, it may lead to negative influence towards these process variation factors. In addition, some components such as integrated clock gating (ICG) cells for clock gating and level converters for dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) should also be considered. According to our preliminary study, a balanced clock tree will be a good starting point. We already implemented a new clock network synthesizer (CNS) with an approach of dual-MST for clock tree generation (based on the specification in the ISPD09 CNS contest). This clock tree is closed to a fully-balanced tree and the experimental result is also very promising. In this project, some techniques including link insertion, buffer sizing, balanced tree with type matching of ICG cells and routing of clock nets are implemented to address the variations and power issues. An integrated clock network synthesizer will be provided so that we can give a complete solution for a power-efficient and variation-tolerant clock network. Intensive testing will be done under a more practical platform to ensure that our solution can be adopted in the integrated sign-off flow of the semiconductor foundries. 在納米級超大規模集成電路物理設計，時鐘網絡合成（CNS）為數字電路中一個主要問題。相對於傳統的時鐘網絡合成，工藝變化和電力功耗是兩個重要的議題。工藝，電壓和溫度的變化對集成電路的效能有很大影響，一些系統設計技術為省電也影響了網絡的時鐘合成方法。傳統的時鐘網路合成方法主要是平衡延誤和幾何匹配。但是，傳統的方法主要集中在盡量減少偏差和線長，對過程變化可能導致負面影響。此外，時鐘網路合成也應考慮一些新組件，如用於時鐘門控的集成時鐘門控（ICG）和用於動態電壓和頻率調整的電平轉換器（DVFS）。根據我們的初步研究，均衡的時鐘樹將是一個很好的起點。我們已經研究出用雙MST的結構去組成時鐘網絡合成器（CNS），初步的實驗結果也很理想。在這個項目中，會致力研究一些技術包括鏈接插入緩衝區大小，平衡樹同類型匹配ICG的組件和時鐘路由器等，期望可以提供一個完整及節能的時鐘網絡解決方案。將在一個實際的平台進行密集測試，以確保我們的解決方案可用於半導體代工廠的製作流程。

526310.label: Realisation of objectives
526310.value: The objective of this project is to study and develop a clock network synthesis technique which is aimed to (a) achieve power saving in physical design, and (b) reduce the clock skew with considering process variations and multi-voltage designs with DVFS. To achieve this objective, we have studied the spanning tree problems, buffer modeling clock gating routing of clock nets and slew estimation in clock network synthesis. Finally, an integrated framework is implemented for testing. Details of the clock network system are described as follows: First, A novel clock tree synthesizer is proposed for performance improvement. Several algorithms are introduced to tackle the issues accordingly. A dual-MST geometric approach of perfect matching is developed for symmetric clock tree construction. In addition, a special technique of buffer sizing is also introduced. These two techniques can help balancing the tree structure in order to reduce the variation effect. An iterative buffer insertion technique and the dual-MZ blockage handling technique are also presented. They are developed for proper distribution of buffers and connection of wires, so the dynamic power consumption can be reduced. Additionally, slew table construction and internal nodes relocation are involved to satisfy the slew rate constraint and further reduce the clock skew. In addition, a power- and slew-aware clock tree synthesizer (PSACTS), is proposed with zero skew achieved based on Elmore RC model. In this work, the clock tree is constructed simultaneously with the insertions of clock gates. This ensures the limitation of the clock slew can be strictly satisfied while the limitation of the clock slew is always applied in the real design. The experimental results show that the power cost of our work is smaller and the run-time is reduced. The slew rate constraint is satisfied with a small clock skew from SPICE estimation. Generally, our work has better performance, improved efficiency and is more practical to be applied in the industry. Our clock synthesizer can reduce the overall capacitance and minimize the switching activity with small numbers ICG cells and clock buffers. In addition, it can balance the clock tree with appropriate insertion of clock buffers, buffer sizing, clock grid and link insertions.

526310.label: Major findings and research outcome
526310.value: In this project, two clock tree synthesizers, PACTS and PSACTS are proposed and implemented. Comparing with previous clock gating works, several novel methods are introduced. They include the power aware topology generation, the concurrent gate insertion and the fast information updating. From the experimental results, it is shown that PACTS has good performance (smaller switched capacitance) and high efficiency (shorter run-time). In addition, PSACTS is also developed to satisfy the concrete slew constraint. The experimental results show that it can reduce the switched capacitance with satisfying the slew constraint. In conclusion, our proposed clock tree synthesizers have better performance and improved efficiency, and it can be applied more practically in the industry. While we investigate the routing of clock nets, we also developed a few techniques which are also useful for general global routing. Those three techniques included low memory global routing, dynamic RSMT topology updating and bending-aware optimum path searching. We implement all the three techniques and integrate them into a new global router (LMgr). Our innovations are validated by designing experiments and measuring the routing performance of LMgr. The experiments results show that LMgr outperforms the other four routers on both the solution quality (13 out of 16 benchmarks) and the memory cost (15 out of 16 benchmarks with up to 77% reduction on the average memory cost over all the benchmarks). The results show that our proposed methods not only can tackle the problem of clock nets routing but also the routing problems with similar characteristics. We obtained best paper award in ISQED 2013 with this work which verified the impact of this work. Finally, our buffers handling and placement techniques can also be applied in handling the mixed placement constraints in the analog circuits and mixed-signal circuits. The constraint-driven floorplan problem was successfully tackled with less area cost and run-time. Experimental results demonstrated the feasibility of this approach. Our approach not only dealt with symmetry constraints in slicing floorplan comprehensively, but also improved routability significantly by containing a large number of regular structures in the final packing. The details of used methods and the experimental results have already been presented in the published papers.

526310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
526310.value: Clock skew is a major concern in the clock network synthesis. It would affect the maximum attainable frequency of operation in the circuits. Due to the high frequency of the clock nets, the signal strength of the surrounding nets may be deteriorated. Thus, clock nets have created a lot of constraints in routing which also creates challenges for placement in the analog circuits and mixed-signal circuits. The next stage of this project should investigate how to integrate the clock network synthesizer into the placement system in the analog circuits and mixed-signal circuits. The effectiveness of slicing and non-slicing representations should also be investigated for this problem. Additionally, the technique of congestion-based virtual sizing is also proposed which can allow more freedom for routing. In addition, the regularity concern should also be studied in order to improve the routability with higher efficiency.

526310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
526310.value: Clock signals are employed in VLSI digital systems to synchronize the active components. A clock tree is constructed to deliver the synchronous signal to every sequential cell of the digital circuits. The clock skew represents the timing difference of all terminals in the clock tree. In order to synchronize one circuit, each terminal must be reached within a specified small time range or a bounded skew. Additionally, the clock signal is also the single largest source of dynamic power usage in the system. Based on the concept of the low power design, especially for the mobile equipments, the improvement on the clock power consumption is crucial. In this project, we have developed clock network synthesizer. The experimental results show that our method consumes less power compared to all the published research works in the literature. The runtime of our program is also the smallest because of reduced complexity. The experimental results also show that the slew rate limitation can be satisfied with a small clock skew from SPICE estimation. It shows that our work has better performance, improved efficiency and becomes more practical to be applied in the industry.

526710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
526710.value: More than a quarter of Hong Kong's electricity comes from nuclear power plants near Hong Kong. The Chinese government has recently decided that 24 new nuclear power units will be built in the next 15 years; more than one third of them will be near Hong Kong. The proposed research project will investigate the formation and fracture of hydride blisters in zirconium which threatens the safe operation of nuclear power plants. A hydride blister is a volume of 100% or very high density of solid hydrides formed in zirconium alloys due to a local temperature gradient (see Figure 1(b) in Background of Research). In service, these alloys are susceptible to a slow corrosion process that leads to a gradual pickup of hydrogen from coolant water. If there is a temperature gradient, then hydride blisters may form near the cooler part of the metals, such as on their surfaces. Because of the brittleness of these hydrides, the original strength of the alloys can be reduced by orders of magnitude and fracture through these hydrides may occur. Such incidents had resulted in catastrophic failure of the structures and costed billions of dollars for repair work. To the best knowledge of the author, despite previous effort no theoretical model realistically predicts the formation and fracture of hydride blisters with the appropriate consideration of plastic deformation, chemical diffusion, stress gradient, heat transfer (temperature gradient) and fracture processes in one scheme. The proposed project will be built upon our successful experience in recent years to develop a theoretical framework and methodologies that include all of these processes in predicting the realistic 3-D morphological evolution of hydride blister formation and fracture initiation at the blisters. This project will not only help to establish a knowledge base for the development of materials programmes for the safe and efficient operation of nuclear power plants, but will also to provide a good opportunity for training young scientists and engineers in computational materials design - a technologically important area for Hong Kong. The analytic tools and methodologies developed in this project may find wide application in the advanced materials technologies used in the micro-electronics, photonics, and transportation industries, in which plasticity, temperature, chemical concentration, and stress gradients are commonly present. 超过25%的香港电力是从香港周边的核电厂来的。中国政府最近决定今后15年再建24个新核电机组，其中多过三分之一会在香港附近。本项目将研究影响核电厂安全的“锆合金中氢化物泡的形成与开裂”的问题。此项研究不仅会有助于建立一个核材料安全评估的知识体系，还会有助于为香港培养电脑材料设计方面的科学与工程人才。此项研究的成果还会在高级材料技术，电子，光学， 和运输等工业领域得到广泛的应用。

526710.label: Realisation of objectives
526710.value: Objective 1: We are the first team to incorporate the plasticity analysis into phase field modeling scheme to model blister formation. We treated plastic deformation strains as a set of new long rang order parameters, which fulfils a kinetic equation of Ginsburg-Landau type. In this analysis, von Mises yield criterion was applied and system distortional energy is used as the yield potential. The analysis was tested against results obtained by finite element calculations with high accuracy. In recent years, our elastoplastic method was applied by other researchers in the world to different materials systems using phase field method. Objectives 2 & 3: In order to pursuit the objectives 2 and 3, a very fundamental task to be finished is to develop the free energy functional of the system that is quantitative and temperature dependent. Phase field models in literature can seldom simulate microstructure evolutions quantitatively. This is due to the fact that the free energy functional of the system and many parameters of the system must be accurately known. This is especially difficult because by definition, the system is not at the equilibrium state at the beginning of the simulation and most part of the free energy functional is for non-equilibrium state. We started from the phase diagram of Zr-H system, and developed a double-well free energy functional that has two minima, one at terminal solid solubility of H in Zr and the other at the equilibrium concentration of H in Zr hydride. This new functional is a function of temperature. This functional was tested at dilute solution limit and was found reproducing the correct and quantitative formulation from thermodynamic theory. The newly developed free energy functional was applied to study the effect of temperature transient (temperature gradient is absent) and the effect of temperature gradient. In both studies, delta-hydride (formed at reactor operating conditions), instead of gamma-hydride was studied. The phenomenological parameters were calibrated against experimental data first. Then an 3D phase field model that couples diffusion, phase transformation, elastic and plastic deformation, and interface energies as well as thermal diffusion was formulated and applied to 1D and 2D modeling of hydride/blister formation in zirconium. The results were compared to some literature data with reasonable agreement.

526710.label: Major findings and research outcome
526710.value: In order to study hydride blister formation, the first step is to develop a temperature dependent, quantitative free energy functional for zirconium alloys within a phase field scheme. This was done for the first time in literature. The model takes into account crystallographic variants of hydrides, interfacial energy between hydride and matrix, interfacial energy between hydrides, elastoplastic hydride precipitation and interaction with externally applied stress. The model is fully quantitative in real time and real length scale, and simulation results on gamma-hydrides were compared with limited experimental data available in the literature with a reasonable agreement. The work calls for experimental and/or theoretical investigations of some of the key material properties that are not yet available in the literature. A paper summarizing the above work with the incorporation of our elastoplastic phase field model was accepted for publication by Journal of Nuclear Materials. In recent years, our elastoplastic method was applied by other researchers in the world to different materials systems using phase field method. The above theoretical model was applied to study temperature dependent delta-hydride precipitation in zirconium in real time and real length scale. Delta hydrides have not been modeled by phase field method in the literature. Our work provides the first theoretical effort. At first, the effect of external tensile load on reorientation of delta-hydrides was calibrated against experimental observations, which provides a quantitative magnification parameter (Mag) for the strain energy in free energy formulation. Then, two types of problems were investigated. In the first type, the effect of temperature transient (temperature gradient was absent) was studied by cooling the Zr-H system at different cooling rates from high temperature while an external tensile stress was maintained. At the end of temperature transients, the average hydride size as a function of cooling rate was compared to experimental data. In the second type, the effect of temperature gradients was studied in one and two dimensional temperature fields. Different boundary conditions were applied. The results show that the hydride precipitation concentrated at low temperature regimes and that this will eventually lead to the formation of hydride blisters in zirconium. A manuscript is mostly done (see a draft manuscript) and will be submitted to Journal of Nuclear Materials for review shortly.

526710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
526710.value: This project aimed to develop a 3D quantitative material microstructure modeling scheme that couples diffusion, phase transformation, elastic and plastic deformation, temperature field, interface effect, etc. into one model. Such a comprehensive scheme has not been achieved in the literature. This project delivered such a scheme using phase field method for the first time. The scheme is in real time and real length scale. It was applied to hydride formation in zirconium – a safety concern in nuclear power plants, and compared to experimental data available in the literature with reasonable agreement. The analytic tools and methodologies developed in this project will find wide applications in advanced materials technologies used in energy industry, micro-electronics, photonics, and transportation industries, in which plasticity, temperature, chemical concentration, and stress gradients are commonly present.

526910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
526910.value: This study proposes to design and produce custom external breast prostheses and bras for Hong Kong breast cancer survivors who have had one or both breasts surgically removed. The challenge of designing a well-fitting, yet affordable, custom prostheses and bra, requires understanding of a number of different disciplinary areas. For example, consideration must be given to the breast cancer patients’ psychological needs, the support provided by attending healthcare providers and professionals including nurses, doctors, the training available for these healthcare professionals, the nature of the prosthesis and bras currently available, and the technology which will allow the customisation of prostheses and bras at an affordable price. Therefore, this research will involve a multidisciplinary team of seven researchers whose expertise ranges from bra design and patternmaking to psychology and cancer care. This combination will assist in achieving a holistic and multiple perspective approach to this important but often neglected area. Consequently, not only is the focus of this study unique, but the multidisciplinary will significantly benefit breast cancer survivors and their families. 是次研究主要為香港乳癌病患者設計及製造個人化的義乳及義乳罩，研究對象包括單乳及雙乳房切除的患者。 製造合身且價格合理的義乳及義乳罩是極具挑戰性的，當中涉及對不同學科領域的了解；其中內容包括：考慮乳腺癌患者的心理需求、醫療保健機構和專業人員的支援、醫護人員的培訓、目前市面供應銷售的義乳產品以及利用現今科技製造實惠價格的個人化義乳及義乳罩等。 因此，這項研究計劃共有七位研究人員參予，共同探討四個主要學術範疇，包括: 內衣設計、紙樣繪畫、心理學和腫瘤學。相信通過是次研究有助於全面且多角度地透視以往被忽視的領域；更重要是，同時使乳腺癌倖存者和他們的家人受益於本研究的成果。

526910.label: Realisation of objectives
526910.value: Objective 1: We used 3D body scanner, 3D design software, 3D printing technology to create the customized prosthesis whilst using smart functional textiles including ‘2Dry’ for dryness and ‘Microsense’ for soft hand feel by SITIP for comfortable bra production. Findings from the scientific wear test experiments measuring temperature, humidity and core body temperature demonstrate that our mastectomy bra and prosthesis provide cooler, and drier microenvironments (See item 6.1). Objective 2: An optimum breast shape for prosthesis was created by combining three scanned breast images achieved by wearing three different types of bras. The 3D body scanner and 3D design software were employed for this. Once the optimum shape is confirmed, a mold was created by using the 3D printer. This was used as a mass-customisation process/protocol for Hong Kong mastectomy bra and prosthesis production. Objective 3: We have done the psychological analysis of 200 Hong Kong mastectomy patients and its findings are written and being reviewed. Once we created our new mastectomy bra and prosthesis, a smaller-scale wear test with 20 mastectomy patients was conducted. Because of the some delays (see Objective 4), we slightly altered the experiment design by combining the experimental group and control group. The psychological and physical benefits of our products are mainly used to support and complement our scientific wear test experiments. Objective 4: Our goal to increase awareness of breast cancer is still in progress. PhD student recruitment dragged the process quite behind. The first PhD student’s withdrew from the study after accepting the offer then the second PhD student got pregnant then withdrew from the study due to the postnatal depression. Our current Mphil student is finishing her study. The scientific wear test also took a long time to complete due to the mechanical malfunction and repair of sensors. Despite everything, we invented and applied Chinese patents of three post mastectomy products with a fantastic scientific wear test results. These three inventions were awarded a gold medal and a diploma for the best invention by the First Institute Inventors and Researchers in I.R.Iran from the Seoul International Invention Fair 2015. A paper is under review with minor revision from two rounds of reviews. Another paper out of the scientific wear test is being written. However, we are waiting for our patents to be granted and commercialisation for further active writing up of our result from the scientific wear tests. We anticipate to write more papers.

526910.label: Major findings and research outcome
526910.value: According to our survey with 200 Hong Kong mastectomy ladies revealed that better humidity and temperature control as the mastectomy bra and prosthesis design requirements. Therefore, we designed and patented three products by utilizing cutting edge technologies including 3D body scanner, 3D design software and 3D printer. The design framework used for the prototype production could be used for a mass customization of the prosthesis and bra production. Three inventions from this project include 1) prosthesis, 2) bra and 3) clip with a pouch (for prosthesis). Prosthesis design features include an air chamber/pump and ventilation holes on the bottom of the prosthesis and bra design features ventilation holes on the bottom of the cup. These design features promote the air circulation and sweat ventilation thus lead the subsequent lower and cooler environment inside the bra. We also implemented smart textiles including ‘2Dry ’ and ‘Microsense’ by SITIP in order to promote the clothing comfort. Our new prosthesis and bra have gone through rigorous scientific tests against the conventional prosthesis and bra in a controlled lab (Temperature 25C+1C, Humidity 75%+5%). A total of 9 male subjects participated in this experiment. All samples were made of the same materials in order to minimize the experiment errors. Four combination of prostheses and bras were used: CC = Commercial bra + Commercial prosthesis CN = Commercial bra + New prosthesis NC = New bra + Commercial prosthesis NN = New bra + New prosthesis Three things were measured – 1) the temperature and 2) humidity and 3) the core body temperature. Simply, the results of CC and NN demonstrate that our two products provide a cooler (0.25-1.14 Celsius degree cooler) and drier (3.7 % to 12.02 % drier) microenvironment inside the bra than the conventional bra and prosthesis. Also, the core body temperature measured by an ingestible thermometer pill demonstrates that our bra lowers the core body temperature 0.1-0.2 Celsius degrees than the conventional bra. A thorough statistical analysis with consistent p-values of 0.000 demonstrated that the probability of providing a significantly cooler and drier clothing environment by our product would be given or extremely high. These new prosthesis and bra design features could be also applied for any types of breast enhancing silicon pads, sports bras, and everyday bras. With this functional excellence, our new prosthesis, bra and clip got awarded a gold medal at the Seoul International Invention Fair 2015 in Nov 2015.

526910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
526910.value: We have been actively searching for the industry partners who can commercialise our inventions. There are two mastectomy prosthesis and bra brands sold in Hong Kong – Amoena from Germany and Trulife from Ireland. We had discussed with a R&D department manager at Trulife about possible commercialization but it didn’t get materialized due to their conservative business model. Currently, we are talking to the head office of Amoena in Munich but it is at the early stage. Whilst we are checking out the possibilities with Amoena, we are preparing for a large-scale wear test with mastectomy patients. We are thinking of engaging the Hong Kong Breast Cancer Foundation in order to raise the awareness of Hong Kong made mastectomy prosthesis and bra. In addition, based on the outcome of this research, a GRF proposal for a health promotion bra design is being drafted for GRF 2016/17.

526910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
526910.value: The problem of currently available mastectomy bras and prostheses is that they do not transfer the body heat and sweat from inside the bra to outside. In fact, the silicon or rubber base prosthesis blocks the airflow and traps the heat inside the bra. Thus it makes the wearer extremely uncomfortable. The goal of the project was to design a mastectomy bra and prosthesis that would provide comfort to Hong Kong mastectomy patients. It is confirmed by scientific experiments that our newly designed mastectomy bra and prosthesis significantly lower the humidity and temperature by promoting air circulation inside the bra compared to the conventional mastectomy bra and prosthesis. Also, our mastectomy bra lowers the body core temperature significantly than the conventional mastectomy bra. Our mastectomy bra and prosthesis is timely as the global incident rates of breast cancer increases every year. They will provide the mastectomy patients comfort they need physically and psychologically.

527910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
527910.value: Competitive cities require quality urban environment of which open space constitutes an indispensable part. This research explores why the land supply of public open space has been so inadequate in the hyper-dense city of Hong Kong. It aims at achieving three objectives: (1)establish a comprehensive, disaggregate land-use planning database about public open space in Hong Kong for the period between 1965 and 2009; (2)based upon quantitative analyses of these time-series data, evaluate the extent and the ways in which the land supply of public open space has been prejudiced vis-à-vis other ‘income-generating’ land-uses in the government planning and land allocation process; and (3)provide appropriate policy recommendations towards improving land-use planning and development of public open space in Hong Kong. Land is a precious resource in this city which comprises about 1,100 sq. km. of land and a population of about 7 million. The land policy of the Hong Kong government is to achieve the highest and best use of every piece of land. Under a leasehold system, serviced land is sold by the government to the highest bidders through competitive auctions and tenders for private development. There are two main types of open space: (a) public open space, and (b) private open space. Public open space includes parks, recreation grounds and amenity space designated by the Hong Kong planners. It is non-revenue generating to the government and is costly to be provided and maintained by the public authority. Private open space is provided within private development projects at the discretion of the developers and/or is subject to the requirement of the relevant government regulations. As part of the government planning and land lease conditions, privately developed/managed open space in some projects must be capable of access and use by the general public. It thus forms part of the public open space. This research evaluates the performance of land supply and land-use planning of public open space. Previous research has generally concluded that the public open space provision in Hong Kong was unsatisfactory in both quantity and quality. While most of these studies have already addressed the quality problems, this research focuses on the issues concerning quantity (or lack) of supply and land-use control of the open space designated for public enjoyment. This study is expected to contribute to the research literature about privatization, shrinking and vanishing of public space in international cities. 公眾休憩空間是優質城市環境的重要構成部分。本研究探討在超密集的香港城市裡，為何公眾休憩空間的土地供應會嚴重不足。它旨在實現三個目標： （1）建立涵蓋香港在1965年至2009年期間公眾休憩用地的土地利用規劃數據庫; （2）基於這些時間序列數據的定量分析，探討公眾休憩用地在政府規劃和土地分配進程中，相對於其他有土地收益的用途如何受到損害; 及 （3）基於定量研究結果，提供如何提高香港公眾休憩空間的土地利用規劃和發展的政策建議。 土地是這個包括約 1100平方公里土地和約 700萬人口城市的一種寶貴的資源。香港政府的土地政策，是以每一塊土地達到最高效益和最好利用為原則。根據香港土地租賃制度，由政府通過競爭拍賣和招標，將土地出售給出價最高者發展私人發展項目。公共空間主要有兩種類型：（一）公眾休憩用地，及（二）私人開放空間。公眾休憩用地是指由香港規劃師指定的包括公園，遊樂場和休憩空間，這是都是不給政府創收，需要昂貴費用提供和維護的公共地方。私人開放空間是由發展商決定，及/或受到有關政府規章要求提供在私人發展項目內的地方。在一些規劃及土地契約條件內，私人發展 /管理的地方需要開放給公眾使用，這些也變成公眾休憩空間的一部分。 本研究評估公眾休憩空間的土地供應和土地利用規劃的績效。以往的研究普遍認為，香港公眾休憩用地提供不能令人滿意的數量和質量。其中大多數研究針對質量問題，本研究著重休憩用地於土地供應數量方面（或缺乏）和土地用途管制的問題。這項研究預期將有助於研究關於國際城市裡公共空間私有化，縮小和消失等課題。

527910.label: Major findings and research outcome
527910.value: First, there has been a huge discrepancy in the planning and implementation of urban open space. A substantial amount of planned open space only appears on the town plans without actual development. There is no consistent statutory land-use zoning for the actual open space currently provided and managed by the government. Development pressure makes it easier for the government to convert the existing public parks and garden into a more “productive” use in this land-scarce city. Second, increasing open space supply has been closely linked with the process of gradual democratization and the expansion of representative politics of Hong Kong from the 1970s to the 1990s. Findings of this study confirm the decrease of open space land, after the dissolution of two elected municipal councils and the takeover by government bureaucrats of open space management since the 2000s. Third, open space serves different social and political functions at varying historical junctures, ranging from enhancing public hygiene, promoting racial harmony, controlling social dissent and encouraging public recreation. Irrespective of these underlying purposes, however, open space has been provided and developed in a fragmented form, especially in the urban built-up areas and in the high-density housing districts. The quality of most urban open space is far from satisfactory. Fragmentation of open space has been supported by a pragmatic, pro-development urban planning discourse that tends to define open space as a local neighbourhood facility. Cluster analysis also shows that the luxurious, low-density housing areas tend to have a disproportionate share of urban open space in their neighbourhoods. Although some of them are bathing beaches in the countryside and they are also open to the general public, long travel distance away from the heavily populated housing areas may discourage frequent visits to this open space. Finally, this planning approach of providing neighbouring open space zones in proximity to housing development has changed when Hong Kong has to compete with other cities in providing urban environment of world-class quality. The emphasis of recent urban planning strategy is to create new open space networks such as harbour waterfront promenade and interconnected green space at strategic locations. While this networked open space exhibits better urban design for the purposes of place marketing and city promotion, it is highly doubtful that such space can serve the genuine needs of the public at large, as it is subject to the risk of privatization and expropriation by commercial capital.

527910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
527910.value: Further research: - to examine how the spatial morphology of open space affects usage of and access to different social classes. - to examine how open space affects public health and local climate. - to explore whether privatization of open space affects community building

527910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
527910.value: This study examines the role and rationale of urban planning in the supply and distribution of open space in Hong Kong. Quantitative analyses of 1,177 “Open Space” zones in the statutory town plans have identified three clusters of open space around high-rise residential, low-density housing and mixed commercial-business areas, respectively. Huge inconsistency exists in the planning and implementation of open space projects. Evaluation of 1,737 public pleasure grounds and recreation facilities reveals that less than half of them were actually zoned as “Open Space” on statutory town plans. Through a historical review of urban development of this city, the study elucidates how open space planning has been influenced by factors related to colonial politics, racial harmony, public hygiene and democratization. Recreation has not been the sole purpose of the authority in providing public open space. The recent trend of expanding new open space network in strategic waterfront locations and near commercial zones, for place marketing and urban competitiveness, may aggravate the disproportionate distribution of open space, encourage its commodification and deprive the right of access to the underprivileged community.

528510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
528510.value: Corrosion of steel reinforcement in concrete structures is largely responsible for the infrastructure deterioration problem which leads to massive rehabilitation/maintenance costs worldwide. Hong Kong and the rest of China are no exceptions. To overcome the deterioration problem, extensive recent research has explored the use of fibre-reinforced polymer (FRP) composites in new construction, where the hybrid and optimal use of FRP with other materials (e.g. concrete and steel) to create economical, corrosion-resistant structures is a very promising direction. Against this background, this project is proposed to further develop a novel form of hybrid flexural members incorporating FRP which is cost-effective, durable, ductile and easy to construct. The new beam form thus has several advantages over existing beam forms and is attractive for use as bridge girders or in other structures in a harsh environment. This novel form of flexural members, proposed by the PI, consists of an inner steel tube, an outer FRP tube and a concrete infill between the two (i.e. hybrid double-skin tubular beams or hybrid DSTBs). In hybrid DSTBs, the FRP outer tube offers mechanical resistance primarily in the hoop direction in order to confine the concrete and to enhance the shear resistance of the beam, while the steel tube is typically shifted towards the tension side to serve as ductile longitudinal reinforcement. Shear connectors, provided between the steel tube and the concrete to ensure their composite action, also act as positioning spacers between the FRP tube and the steel tube. Hybrid DSTBs may be constructed in-situ or precast, with the two tubes acting as the stay-in-place form. The applicants and their collaborators have recently completed preliminary tests on the flexural behaviour of simply-supported hybrid DSTBs, which confirmed some of their advantages, but these tests were limited to a small number of small-scale circular beams without shear connectors subjected to monotonic loading. The present project is proposed to extend this existing work to gain a much fuller understanding of the flexural behaviour of simply-supported hybrid DSTBs subjected to both monotonic and fatigue loading, with particular emphasis on the behaviour of shear connectors in the beams, and to develop theoretical/design models to enable the wide practical application of this new form of flexural members. 由于混凝土结构中钢筋锈蚀而引起的结构性能劣化问题每年都给世界各国带来巨额的结构修复/加固费用。中国包括香港地区也不例外。为解决这一问题，近年来各国学者对耐腐蚀性能优越的纤维增强复合材料(FRP)在新建结构中的应用进行了大量的研究，其中一个极具潜力的方向为将FRP材料和传统的建筑材料（如混凝土和钢）优化组合，以组成经济、耐腐蚀的组合结构。基于上述背景，本项目的研究针对一种新型的FRP组合受弯构件；该组合构件具有许多优于现有构件的特点，如经济、耐久性好、延性好、施工方便等，因此非常适合用于桥梁及其它腐蚀环境中的结构。 该新型受弯构件由本项目主持人(PI)发明，由钢内管、FRP外管和两管之间填充的混凝土组成（即FRP-混凝土-钢组合双壁空心梁或简称组合双壁空心梁）。在组合双壁空心梁中，FRP外管主要具有环向的刚度，其主要作用为约束混凝土以及提高构件的抗剪承载力；钢内管通常靠近受拉区放置，作为构件的主要纵向受拉材料。钢管和混凝土之间布置有剪力连接件以确保钢管和混凝土的共同作用，在浇筑混凝土时还可作为FRP外管和钢内管之间的间隔件以固定两管的相对位置。组合双壁空心梁可以现浇或预制，内外两管可作为浇筑混凝土的永久模具。申请者和他们的合作者最近进行了简支组合双壁空心梁的初步试验；试验结果验证了该组合梁的部分优越性能。但是，这些初步试验仅限于小尺寸圆形构件的静力性能，且构件中未布置剪力连接件。本项目旨在进一步扩展现有工作，以更全面地认识简支组合双壁空心梁在静力和疲劳荷载作用下的性能，特别是梁中剪力连接件的性能；本项目还将发展可靠的理论/设计模型以方便该新型受弯构件在实际工程中的应用。

528510.label: Realisation of objectives
528510.value: OVERALL ACHIEVEMENT: We have fully addressed Objectives 1 (except for fatigue loading) and 2. We are now addressing Objective 3 (preparation of tests is under way) as a follow-on study, and hope to address Objective 4 in the future. The requested amount of funding for the project was over HK$1.70 million (excluding the on-cost), but the amount awarded was around 1.12 million. We should have revised the project scope by focusing our work on the first two objectives as a result of funding reduction, but we inadvertently missed the opportunity to do so at the beginning of the project. Nevertheless, we decided to give priority to the first two objectives in our work given the limited resources and the fact that work for Objective 3 and 4 should follow work for Objectives 1 and 2. We hope that the assessor will agree with our decision to focus on the first two objectives and will bear this situation in mind in assessing the achievement of the project. REALIZATION OF OBJECTIVE 1: A modified push-out test set-up was proposed and refined based on trial testing. A series of push-out tests was then conducted using the novel test set-up. REALIZATION OF OBJECTIVE 2: (1) A series of large-scale hybrid double-skin tubular beams (DSTBs) with shear stud connectors were designed and tested under static loading. Due to the small space between the two tubes in DSTBs, self-compacting concrete was used to cast the specimens. (2) In relation to the use of self-compacting concrete in DSTBs, a study on the behavior of FRP-confined self-compacting concrete was undertaken. (3) To investigate the behavior of concrete in hybrid DSTB sections with a circular steel tube and a rectangular FRP tube, a series of axial compression tests was conducted. (4) A 3D finite element model for FRP-confined concrete columns was developed. Based on this work, a 3D finite element model was developed for DSTBs. (5) A force-based beam element with interfacial slips was proposed for hybrid DSTBs with/without shear studs. A simple theoretical model was also established for DSTBs with negligible interfacial slips. OTHER RELATED ACHIEVEMENTS It was realized that DSTBs offer a good opportunity for the use of recycled concrete lumps. A study on FRP-confined compound concrete containing recycled concrete lumps was undertaken. In addition, cyclic axial compression tests were conducted on concrete-filled FRP tubes with particular attention to the ultimate state of the FRP tube.
