550910.label: Major findings and research outcome
550910.value: Objective 1: Are qualified audit opinions predictive of firms’ future financial performance? Audit opinions are highly predictive of firms’ future financial performance. Using a factor score aggregating various aspects of financial performance, we find that GAAP/DISC and GC underperform other firms in t+1 (t is the year when firms receive MAOs) by about 0.86 and 1.54, respectively, standard deviation of the financial performance score. Objective 2: How do the investors employ the information contained in audit qualifications to predict firms’ future financial performance? We find no evidence suggesting that investors react negatively to audit qualifications when such information is first released to the market. However, audit modifications are followed by significantly negative abnormal stock returns. The evidence is consistent with the mispricing explanation: investors overlook value-relevant audit opinion information and gradually correct mispricing in the subsequent periods. Objective 3: Is the usefulness of audit opinions as perceived by the investors consistent with the actual predictive ability of audit qualifications for firms’ future financial performance? We find that actual predictive ability of audit qualifications is significantly different from the model used by the investors in pricing stocks, i.e., the investors do not completely understand the value implications of audit qualifications. Our further analysis suggests that investors may have incorrectly extrapolated the mean reversion mode of non-MAO firms to MAO firms. Objective 4: Will the going-concern modifications differ from those caused by GAAP violation in the above aspects? Although these two types of audit modifications differ in their nature, they have similar effects on firms’ future performance and the finding of investors’ mispricing behavior holds for both types of modifications. Moreover, as stated in Item 5.3 above, we have included a new Objective, i.e., whether the difference in performance mean reversion between MAO and non-MAO firms explains the mispricing phenomenon. Our answer is positive. We have finished writing up the paper. Attached please find the Executive Summary of Major Findings of the paper. Since the paper is about the use of audit information in financial statement analysis and valuation, the topic fits the theme of Review of Accounting Studies very well. We have initially submitted it to this journal.

550910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
550910.value: There are two potential avenues for further development of this research. In one direction, the external validity of this study can be assessed by data from other economies. We argue that mispricing of auditor opinions occurs because the investors naively apply the performance mean reversion pattern of non-MAO firms to MAO firms, leading to forecast errors and mispricing. Whether this represents a general human information processing bias or is specific to Chinese investors can be investigated by using data from other markets. In the other direction, future research can explore more Chinese institutional features. For example, in China, government owners routinely bail out financially distressed listed firms. Since auditors are more likely to issue MAOs to such firms, the possible bailouts by the governments may lead the investors to form an expectation that firms’ financial difficulties are temporary (but on average such an expectation is not realized according to our empirical finding). This explanation can be empirically tested (if data are available), e.g., among MAO recipients, the mean reversion in performance could be different if firms are closely connected to the governments through ownership, management team, or other ties.

550910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
550910.value: Although auditing has evolved into an important institution for protecting the integrity of corporate financial reports since the 1800s, there is limited evidence on how auditor opinions influence investors’ assessment of the quality of financial reporting. In particular, the extant literature only shows that investors may underuse auditors’ assessment of firms’ going-concern (GC) ability in pricing securities. However, it remains unclear why investors overlook such important information. Moreover, research on the capital market effect of audit modifications due to “bad accounting” (i.e., violations of accounting/disclosure rules) remains scarce, largely because such audit opinions cannot be observed in the U.S. To help bridge this gap, we examine the Chinese capital market, where audit modifications for both GC and “bad accounting” can be observed. We find that audit modifications are not effectively used by the investors in pricing stocks. More importantly, we show that this likely reflects investors’ errors in predicting future performance of firms that receive audit modifications. Our findings hold for both types of audit modifications. The evidence enhances our understanding of why investors may not use audit-related information in valuation. It also shows the consequences of “bad accounting” practices that are pointed out by auditors.

551310.label: Realisation of objectives
551310.value: Most of the objectives have been achieved, albeit to varying degrees across languages. We have collected and transcribed data and constructed open-access online databases for Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese and Korean (http://myweb.polyu.edu.hk/~egwts/StanceCorpus/). A concordancer is currently being added to the Corpus, which continues to expand. Due to unexpected political instability in parts of the Tibeto-Burman-speaking region, fieldwork for Tani (a Tibeto-Burman language) was discontinued; instead we added data collection and transcription for Hindi (an Indo-Aryan language). With the absence of a parallel database for tonal Tibeto-Burman languages such as Tani, we downplayed Objective 2, where we originally intended to compare the use of tonal properties and intonational contours as a stance-marking strategy across languages. Instead we focused on phonological changes in the grammaticalization of evidential, epistemic and attitudinal markers in Cantonese, Korean and Japanese. (Because the orientation of Objective 2 had to be changed, we indicate 50% achievement, even though our research outputs are quite substantial.) With a parallel database now also being constructed for Indo-Aryan languages (e.g. Hindi and Bajjika), we are now further looking at phonological changes in constructions where tense markers interact with person-agreement markers to do epistemic and politeness work, in particular to signal the speaker's sensitivity to the social status of various discourse referents, which accounts for the greater complexity of the politeness system in these Indo-Aryan languages. (This is a new and exciting area of research not anticipated in the original objectives.) We have successfully traced the diachronic developments of hearsay evidential markers in Cantonese, Korean and Japanese, and of epistemic and politeness markers in Mandarin and Malay. Using discourse-pragmatic and typological analyses, we have also traced how WH-expressions (e.g. Cantonese matje~meje~me and Indonesian anu) are used as placeholders for unutterable expressions, sometimes for socio-pragmatic reasons such as avoiding taboo topics (closely related to politeness). We have also identified robust morphosyntactic mechanisms that are frequently associated with the development of grammaticalized stance markers. These include clause fusion, reanalysis of complement-taking verbs as adverbial adjuncts with epistemic, evidential and/or attitudinal functions, and reanalysis of subordinate structures as finite ones via main-clause ellipsis (and sometimes via complement-clause ellipsis as well). This project has also paved the way for additional in-depth studies of stance-marking and stance-taking phenomena (see 6.2). While we have identified many types of stance-marking strategies and their pragmatic functions, we still have not exhausted all the possibilities in this broad field, hence we humbly indicate 90% achievement.

551310.label: Major findings and research outcome
551310.value: This project has successfully identified a number of different strategies whereby some Asian languages encode the stance of their speakers. The findings of this study has important implications for the desired outcome of a given discourse interaction, both among speakers sharing the same language and between speakers from different native language backgrounds. One of the stance-marking strategies examined in this project is evidentiality marking, whereby speakers indicate the strength of their epistemic claims by indicating the source and reliability of their information. Our analysis traces how 'say' constructions in some languages develop into hearsay evidential markers with pragmatic functions (e.g. expressing counterexpectation, disagreement, and even self-mockery). By comparing conversational data in different languages, our study identifies cross-cultural differences in the way speakers deploy evidential markers to establish, maintain and negotiate their footing and hence their interpersonal relationships with other interlocutors. From typological and diachronic perspectives, we find robust similarities in the direction of grammaticalization of these hearsay evidential markers: reportative verb > evidential marker > pragmatic marker. Yet at the same time, we also identify language-specific variations. For example, unlike verb-final languages such as Korean and Japanese, a verb-medial language such as Cantonese needs to resort to right-dislocation to form sentence final evidential markers (Yap & Ahn, in press). On the other hand, although Korean and Japanese hearsay evidential markers rely on many similar morphosyntactic mechanisms in their development, including 'say' verb elision and main-clause ellipsis, Korean disallows complement-clause ellipsis, which then prevents this language from developing stand-alone 'say' constructions that could otherwise be used as disagreement markers. Thus, whereas Japanese speakers can say 'To ifute(!)' to mean 'Though (you) say (so)' to indirectly mean 'I don't agree with you', this type of stand-alone 'say' construction is not possible for Korean speakers (Ahn & Yap 2014; Tamaji & Yap, forthcoming). Our study, which focuses not only on evidential markers but also on epistemic and attitudinal markers, helps to shed light on how stance markers evolve and acquire their robustly-shared crosslinguistic features as well as their language-specific peculiarities, and consequently how speakers’ choice of stance markers affect interpersonal negotiations in discourse. Given that languages vary in terms of linguistic constraints as well as socio-cultural preferences, stance markers with otherwise similar functions will still vary in subtle ways across languages. Knowing how the stance markers of each language evolve can greatly help us to better understand the subtle pragmatic differences of each culture.

551310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
551310.value: Through this project, we have identified the sources and grammaticalization trajectories of evidential, epistemic and attitudinal markers in a number of Asian languages (Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Korean, Japanese, Malay/Indonesian). In the process, we have also come across some stance-marking strategies that deserve further investigation. We have seen how Korean hearsay evidentials that emerge from different morphosyntactic environments (e.g. connective tamye, attributive tanun, conclusive tanta) yield different pragmatic nuances. We will further examine this relationship between morphosyntactic and discourse-pragmatic differences in Japanese and possibly Mongolian and Manchu-Tungusic languages. We have also seen how Mandarin and Malay epistemic markers derived from 'fear' verbs have developed into pragmatic hedges that serve politeness functions. In subsequent work, we will further examine how Indo-Aryan languages recruit future tense and person-agreement markers to do epistemic and politeness work that is sensitive to the social status of various referents in the discourse. We hope to also compare the honorificity-oriented politeness system in Indo-Aryan with those in other languages (e.g. Japanese). PolyU seed project grants (HKPU 1-ZVAY; HKPU G-UA2N) have been obtained for the above two projects; we will further apply for GRF funding to investigate the relationship between copulas and deictic elements and stance-marking phenomena across languages.

551310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
551310.value: Each time we speak, we leave traces of our thoughts and feelings in what we say. This phenomenon, known as stance-taking and stance-marking, is both inevitable and vital to any communicative act, and each culture has developed numerous linguistic markers to convey different shades of speakers’ mood, attitude, and degree of commitment to what they say and what they think others say. Our study identifies a number of these stance markers within and across languages—in particular, Cantonese, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Malay/Indonesian. Using diachronic texts and parallel contemporary conversational data, we identify the sources of these stance markers, and trace how these markers develop within the phonological and morphosyntactic (i.e. structural) constraints of each language. We further compare equivalent markers across different languages to identify subtle differences that can have important consequences for intercultural communication. Our findings show that these stance markers often still bear traces of their origin but essentially their meanings have come to be strongly associated with their frequent (and often special) contexts of use. Since contexts of use vary across different cultures, this crosslinguistic study helps us to better understand not just when but also how and why stance markers retain their language-specific peculiarities.

551310.label: Other impact (e.g. award of patents or prizes, collaboration with other research institutions, technology transfer, etc.)
551310.value: This project has contributed greatly to the expansion and visibility of language typology research focusing on Asian languages (e.g. Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Austronesian and Indo-Aryan). 3 international workshops related to this Stance project have since launched a series of publications, among them a special issue on "Stance-marking and Stance-taking in Discourse" in the Journal of Pragmatics (July 2015 issue), guest-edited by Co-I Shoichi Iwasaki and PI Foong Ha Yap. This project also served as a super-seed project for several subsequent research projects: "Epistemicity, Evidentiality and Politeness Strategies in Discourse: A Crosslinguistic Perspective" (HKPU G-UB76), "Valence-Reducing Phenomena and the Emergence of Markers of Speaker Affectedness" (RGC GRF PolyU 154055/14H), among others. Crucially, this project facilitated extensive and long-term collaboration between language researchers in Hong Kong and a number of international universities with expertise in cross-linguistic and cross-cultural studies (e.g. UCLA, University of Hawaii, Hankuk University of Foreign Studies in Seoul, Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, University of Cologne in Germany, etc.). This project also contributes to a growing interest in a research area that Martin Haspelmath has referred to as “continent-wide typology” within the framework of “diversity linguistics” (http://dlc.hypotheses.org/340). Through this Stance project we have succeeded in strengthening Hong Kong's credentials as a major research center for language research from a triangulated typological, diachronic and discourse perspective. This project has also provided mentorship to young researchers/scholars, among them: (1) Dr Winnie Oi-wan Chor (now a lecturer at The Open University of Hong Kong); (2) Dr Weirong Chen (now at the University of International Business and Economics, Beijing); (3) Ms Vivien Ying Yang (now a PhD student at UCLA); (4) Mr Sam Tak-sum Wong (now a PhD student at The City University of Hong Kong); (5) Mr Steven Ming-chiu Wong (accepted for the PhD program at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University); (6) Ms Ariel Shuk-ling Chan (accepted for the MA/pre-PhD qualifying program at McGill University in Toronto, Canada); (7) Ms Saira Qamar (GRF undergraduate mentee for South Asian languages such as Urdu, now completing a postgraduate diploma in Education at The University of Hong Kong).

551410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
551410.value: The extant operations management literature has extensively investigated the association among quality, customer satisfaction, and firm profitability. However, the soft side of operations management, that is the influences of leader-member relationship or employee attributes on these performance dimensions, have rarely been examined. In this study we investigate the impact of leader-member exchange (LMX) between managers and employees on operational performance and firm profitability in high-contact service industries. We further investigate the contextual factors influencing this relationship. We plan to conduct a large-scale empirical study with a wide range of high-contact, small service firms in Hong Kong. To capture the constructs the best, we will collect triadic data from service employees, customers and managers. We will adopt structural equations modeling for data analysis. Our study offers important academic and managerial implications. This study is a pioneering, rigorous empirical-based work on linking LMX to operational and firm performance using triadic data from three different parties. Unlike the traditional research in operations management, LMX represents alternative means of improving service quality and customer satisfaction. This study suggests an important alternative means for service firms to enhance operational performance through strengthening the management of LMX. 現今營運管理的文獻已深入研究品質、顧客滿意度和公司利潤的關係。但是，營運管理的另一面，如領導者與下屬或員工的特質對成績指標的影響，卻被忽略。這研究一方面探討領導者與下屬關係對營運成績和公司業績的影響；另一方面，它會研究一些環境因素對這關係的影響。 我們計劃在服務業進行一項大型研究。我們會收集員工、顧客和管理層三方面的資料，並利用結構方程模式分析所收集的資料。 這研究有重要的學術和應用價值。它能嚴謹地用三方面的資料（即員工、顧客和管理層）探討領導者與下屬關係對營運成績和公司業績的關係。它亦提供另一個能提升服務品質和顧客滿意度的方向。這研究也建議強化領導者與下屬關係，以提升營運系統的成績。

551410.label: Realisation of objectives
551410.value: Based on the conceptual model of the proposal, conceptual models were explored with the reference to the related literature and the real practice of the service industry. Regarding Objective 1, out of these models, some conceptual models were confirmed for further investigation by empirical data. Using multiple informant approach, data were collected from three different parties, which are managers, customer-contact employees and customers, of high-contact service shops in Hong Kong. Structural equation modelling was employed to analyze the collected data. The results confirmed most of the hypotheses included in the conceptual models. Thus, Objective 1 has been achieved totally. Concerning Objective 2, contextual factors, including employee-customer contact and market competiveness were explored their moderating effects on the relationships depicted in one conceptual model using the collected data. Structural equation modelling was employed to analyze the moderating effects. The findings demonstrate that there is no moderating effect on the associations of the conceptual model. Hence, Objective 2 has been achieved totally. For this entire research, two papers were published in international journals and two papers were presented in international conferences. These outputs provide strong evidence that the objectives of this research has been achieved.

551410.label: Major findings and research outcome
551410.value: Major findings This research reveals that contrary to traditional wisdom, job satisfaction does not impact service quality, once leader-member exchange (LMX) is included. In service firms with a high level of customer contact, a close relationship among the manager and the employee, rather than relying on the traditional practice of making customer-contact employees happy, is important to yield superior service quality. Moreover, the results of this research show that the employee-customer contact time does not have moderating effect on the association between LMX and service quality or between job satisfaction and service quality. This clearly demonstrates that the impact of LMX in the high-contact service domain is rather robust. In other words, the importance of LMX in the pursuit of superior service quality can be taken to be universal. Research outcomes A research student has been trained to conduct empirical research of operations management. Two papers are published in high-impact international journals of operations management. One is published in International Journal of Production Economics and the other is published in Industrial Management and Data Systems. One conference paper was presented in an international conference and is published. The research student attended and presented the research work in an international conference.

551410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
551410.value: The aim of this research is to explore the soft side of operations management, which is an under-researched issue in the field of operations management, an important issue regarding the management of service operations. Specifically, this study investigates the manager-employee relationship in the service setting with the nature of a high-level customer contact. The findings demonstrate that the importance of LMX in the pursuit of superior service quality can be considered to be universal. In line with these findings and in view of further developing the research, it is recommended to examine the impact of managers’ styles on employees' work attitudes and performance in the high-contact service setting. This proposed work indeed has been examined in another research project.

551410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
551410.value: Nature This is an empirical study concerning the relationships among leader-member exchange (LMX), quality, customer satisfaction, and firm profitability in high-contact service industries. Data were collected from multiple parties, including managers, employees and customers, in high-contact service firms. Significance This research reveals that contrary to traditional wisdom, job satisfaction does not impact service quality, once LMX is included. Moreover, the results of this research show that the employee-customer contact time does not moderate the association between LMX and service quality or between job satisfaction and service quality. This demonstrates that the importance of LMX in the pursuit of superior service quality can be taken to be universal. Value From the academic viewpoint, this research is an interdisciplinary study. It integrates concepts of organizational behavior and operations management. Interdisciplinary research is emerging and highly encouraged in various fields, like operations management. Further, examining “soft” issues, such as human relationship and work attitude issues, is a timely topic in the field of service operations management. This study provides practical guidelines for practitioners to manage their firms. Specifically, this study suggests that rather than simply making employees happier with their jobs, nurturing a close supervisor-employee relationship has a more persisting positive impact on improving service quality.

551510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
551510.value: Environmental Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) indicates DEA models involving environmental management concerns. In recent years, “environmental performance” and “sustainable development” are frequently presented in public. It is thus critical to include environmental concerns in the production efficiency. Undesirable outputs, such as the industrial pollution associated with the normal output, have drawn the attention from both the academic researcher and the policy maker. Various DEA models are developed to deal with undesirable outputs. However, it is observed that originality of efficiency, the economic background of DEA method, and mathematical foundation of the environmental DEA model are yet seriously investigated. The theoretical foundation of the DEA method is often violated by improper treatment of the undesirable output. The economic impact could not be correctly interpreted in some models. The efficiency improvement of decision making unit could not be determined in some other models. Furthermore, some non-linear programming DEA models could only solved approximately. It is thus clear that without a thorough understanding of DEA model, these proposed “methods” or “techniques” often cause different types of mistake in practical applications. This project is to establish the theoretical foundation of the environmental DEA model. We start from the economic originality of efficiency concept. We go back to the initial definition of DEA efficiency involving undesirable outputs. The production possibility set and the related postulate system are investigated. All proposed undesirable output measurements in current literature are reviewed and investigated. New measurements of undesirable outputs are proposed. In addition, assuming that an undesirable output is intimately associated with a particular desirable output, we can re-quantify the desirable output by embedding the undesirable output in. Furthermore, we propose a Ratio Model considering the ratio of desirable output to undesirable output. Yet another direction is to have non-linear programming based DEA model satisfying a newly developed postulate system. The theoretical background is studied and solution algorithms are designed. At the practical application side, several industry clusters in the Chinese mainland are to be investigated, including fabric factories in the Pearl Delta Area, paper mills along the Huihe river, chemical product manufactures in Sichuan area and sea ports along the south eastern coast line. The newly proposed environmental DEA efficiency evaluation method should provide more green insight of the sustainable business performance for operations managers and policy decision makers.

551510.label: Realisation of objectives
551510.value: Thanks for the support from the university and my department, I have fully completed the project and achieved those objectives more than planned. Through the project, we have had a better insight and overall understanding about the relationship between the environmental concern and production efficiency. We have included our new understanding in my book "Grean Supply Chain Managment" published in Chinese. Another unexpected result is that we identified the "internal waste" and explained the internal in the network DEA models.

551510.label: Major findings and research outcome
551510.value: As proposed, the research started from the economic originality of efficiency concept. The research considered all published DEA models involving undesirable outputs. The production possibility set and the related postulate system have been investigated. We reviewed and investigated different undesirable output measurements and proposed new measurements of undesirable outputs. Assuming that an undesirable output is intimately associated with a particular desirable output, we further quantified the desirable output by embedding the undesirable output in. We then proposed a Ratio Model considering the ratio of desirable output to undesirable output. In short, different existing environmentally related DEA models have different theoretical shortages and thus give different results. The ratio model we provided gives the most reasonable explanation in the environemental factor involved efficiency evaluation. Further more, we brought the environmental factors in the network DEA models and exhibited the internal waste issue in the network DEA model. We constructed network DEA models for different network structures, including parallel and series structures and consider the centralized or decentralized management schemes on the sub-DMUs in the network DMU. We investigated intermediate product wastes in different situations. We theoretically showed that the resource waste reduction could be obtained without hurting the final output level. Practical experiments are conducted based on the data to be collected from textile industry and logistics industry. We examined a DEA system with a two-stage structure. In the two-stage system, we considered centralized, decentralized and mixed organizational modes. We proposed two-stage DEA models considering a degree of centralization that makes it possible to measure internal resource waste in different system modes. Important managerial insights were tested and verified from the perspective of efficiency analysis. It has been found that 1) when there is only one intermediate measure in a centralized two-stage system, internal resource waste can be eliminated completely, and 2) a higher degree of centralization in a two-stage system can lead to less internal resource waste and more expected outputs. The practical numerical computations are conducted to illustrate the approach and shows that different point views in the industrial practice. Futhermore, several industry clusters were investigated, including fabric factories in the Pearl Delta Area, paper mills along the Huihe river, two chemical product manufactures in Sichuan, Shanghai port, Shenzhen port and Humen port. The proposed environmental DEA efficiency evaluation method provided green insight of the sustainable business performance for operations managers and policy decision makers.

551510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
551510.value: The project has led a book "green supply chain" published in Chinese. We are editing a book to summarize the theoretical system and practical issues related to environmental DEA models. This would give a new picture of DEA research involving enviromental concerns.

551510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
551510.value: The concepts of “environmental performance” and “sustainable development” are frequently presented around. Undesirable outputs have drawn the attention from both academic researchers and policy makers. In most previous discussions, the originality of efficiency, the economic background of DEA method, and mathematical foundation of DEA model are yet seriously investigated. The return to scale of a decision making unit which says the marginal gain for further investment could not be correctly identified in some models. The improvement of a DMU could not be determined. This project establishes the theoretical foundation of the environmental DEA model. We redefine the environmental DEA efficiency. The production possibility set and the production frontier are constructed and studied. We suggest new treatment of the undesirable output by embedding it into some desirable outputs. We investigate characteristics of nonlinear but convex production possibility set. We also propose a ratio model which considers the ratio of desirable output to undesirable output. This research is a pioneering work to give attention to the misunderstanding on the applying the DEA to evaluate the efficiency with environmental concerns. The study generated a research branch parallel to the conventional DEA model and can be called environmental DEA model.

551810.label: Project Title(Chinese)
551810.value: 探讨运营管理的矛盾：中国制造业的质量管理标准、制度化及对组织的影响

551810.label: Project Objectives
551810.value: To assess the impact of QM standards on operational efficiency, sales performance and senior executive compensation in the Chinese manufacturing industry based on longitudinal financial data. To study the contingent (moderating) factor of institutionalization by testing if institutionalization of QM standards weakens their positive impact on technical efficiency, while strengthening their impact on sales performance and senior executive compensation. Such paradoxical relationships could help explain the possible ineffectiveness of QM standards following their widespread diffusion in different sectors of the Chinese manufacturing industry.
rows: To assess the impact of QM standards on operational efficiency, sales performance and senior executive compensation in the Chinese manufacturing industry based on longitudinal financial data.

To study the contingent (moderating) factor of institutionalization by testing if institutionalization of QM standards weakens their positive impact on technical efficiency, while strengthening their impact on sales performance and senior executive compensation. Such paradoxical relationships could help explain the possible ineffectiveness of QM standards following their widespread diffusion in different sectors of the Chinese manufacturing industry.

551810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
551810.value: 在过去二十年里，质量管理标准广泛应用于世界各地的制作业。这些标准都被视为新的管理技术，对运营管理产生了深远影响。在中国，质量管理标准应用尤其广泛，一些质量管理认证，比如ISO 9000和ISO/TS 16949（之前是QS-9000），是全世界最多的；而像TL- 9000和ISO 13485之类的质量认证也在以最快的速度增长。然而在这些研究领域里，严谨的实证研究却十分有限。以往的研究仅采用传统的运营指标来验证质量管理标准的影响，没有考虑到制度化的作用—指在社会构建过程中，质量管理标准逐步演变为一种价值，并最终成为理所当然的一种合适和规范的要素。 在本研究中我们将探讨质量管理标准对相应企业销售业绩，运营效率和高级管理人员薪酬的影响。我们将检验这种影响是否受制于制度化的水平。我们假设，质量管理标准对销售业绩，运营效率和企业高级管理人员的薪酬产生积极作用。然而，当这些标准逐渐高度制度化后，它对运营效率的促进效果将大大减少。不过，质量管理标准的制度化，在某些特定的行业里可能会加强销售业绩及提高高级管理人员的薪酬。质量管理标准，制度化和组织绩效之间的复杂关系导致运营管理面临困境。 基于客观的档案数据，我们将进行大规模的纵向研究。我们将跟踪中国制作业过去18年里（1991-2008）获得质量认证的公司以及它们的业绩变化。通过研究制度化是否在扭曲了企业运营效率的同时又提高了销售业绩及高层管理人员的薪酬，本研究有着重要的理论意义，并为管理提供建议。需要特别指出的是，我们将尝试回答下列重要问题：质量管理标准是否有效？它们会在什么情况下变为无效（例如，制度化）？我们还尝试去解决一个长期存在的矛盾问题 - 为什么质量管理标准在其效果存在高度争议的情况下还会持续蔓延？是不是因为采用质量管理标准的公司和高级管理人员从市场中得到了回报，即使这种制度化过程对运营效率产生了巨大的阻碍作用？

551810.label: Realisation of objectives
551810.value: In this research we show that despite ISO 9000’s deteriorating technical efficiency, the standard is increasingly valued by customers and boards of directors. The institutionalization process might actually increase the value of ISO 9000 certification, despite growing evidence of its inefficaciousness. However, the value of ISO 9000 certification is gradually discounted by investors. We argue that the infusion of institutional value by stakeholders might depend on their network locations whereby central organizational actors such as customers and boards of directors are likely to increasingly value the institutionalized standard, while peripheral organizational actors such as investors are likely to gradually discount it. The endorsement of some central stakeholders to the deteriorating technical efficiency of ISO 9000 might in turn lead to the widespread diffusion of the standard. As a result, our research has achieved the objectives of our proposal.

To study the contingent (moderating) factor of institutionalization by testing if institutionalization of QM standards weakens their positive impact on technical efficiency, while strengthening their impact on sales performance and senior executive compensation. 551810.label: Major findings and research outcome
551810.value: In this research we examine how some key stakeholders respond to the adoption of ISO 9000, a highly institutionalized system for quality management, when the standard is increasingly decoupled from its technical objective of improving internal efficiency. Research has shown that despite the requirement for external certification, the adoption of ISO 9000 leads to a ceremonial behavior intended to superficially conform to the standard. We focus on the responses of a few key external constituents that are likely to be the beholders of the effective implementation of the standard, including customers, board of directors, and investors. We conduct this research using longitudinal data of manufacturing firms in the U.S. from 1990 to 2006, the period over which ISO 9000 was increasingly institutionalized in the U.S. manufacturing industry. We find that, over the past two decades, the adoption of ISO 9000 is increasingly decoupled from its technical objective of improving operational performance as measured by return-on-assets (ROA) and labor productivity. Nevertheless, despite deteriorating technical efficiency, ISO 9000 is increasingly valued by customers and boards of directors. The institutionalization process might actually increase the value of ISO 9000 certification, despite the significantly worsening technical performance. On the other hand, the value of ISO 9000 adoption is gradually discounted by investors. We argue that the infusion of institutional value into an institutionalized rule by stakeholders might depend on their network locations whereby central organizational actors like customers and boards of directors are likely to increasingly value ISO 9000, while peripheral organizational actors like investors are likely to increasingly discount it. The endorsement of central organizational stakeholders to the deteriorating technical function might in turn facilitate the widespread diffusion of an institutionalized rule.

551810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
551810.value: We make two suggestions for future research. First, we believe that it would be interesting to investigate the responses of different stakeholders to the possible deteriorating technical realities in the adoption of other institutionalized management practices, such as strategic alliances and ISO 14000. Second, we suggest that researchers explore directly other potential factors that lead to different responses of various constituents to deteriorating technical function of an institutionalized rule.

551810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
551810.value: Based on hierarchical linear modeling of panel data of manufacturing firms in the U.S. from 1990 to 2006, we examine how various stakeholders respond to ISO 9000 certification when the technical value of the standard significantly dropped. We find different responses. The standard is increasingly valued by customers and board of directors, while gradually devalued by investors. We argue that the infusion of institutional value by stakeholders might depend on their network locations (i.e., central versus peripheral) and the endorsement of some central stakeholders to the deteriorating technical function of the standard might in turn facilitate its widespread diffusion.

552210.value: 網上影響力：怎樣的產品評價最具説服力？

552210.label: Project Objectives

To develop and test a set of content-based, objective measures for argument quality; and
To develop and test a set of content-based, objective measures for source credibility.

552210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
552210.value: 口碑指的是不同消費者之間針對某一個品牌、產品、服務或者公司而進行的非正式和無廣告目的評論。互聯網產生后，空間距離不再是人與人之間交流的障礙。網絡給人們提供了廣大的交流平臺。在衆多平臺中，消費者自發的產品評論越來越常見。在網上人們很容易找到關於汽車、電影、電子產品及個人興趣的各式各樣的免費評論。網上產品評論已經成爲消費者重要的信息來源。 像其他面對面進行的交流一樣，網上產品評論也會對消費者的偏好產生重大影響。產品評論的閲讀者會受到評論者觀點的影響，在不同程度上改變自己對某個產品的態度。這種態度的轉變，是營銷人士非常關心的一個問題。但是，由於無法在網絡上測量消費者的態度，我們也無法了解閲讀者的態度到底發生了多大的轉變。有鑒于此，很多網站開始讓閲讀者評價產品評論是否有幫助。以往的研究表明，認爲產品評價是否有幫助，很大程度上能夠預測閲讀者是否會接受評論者的觀點。 本研究將提出和測試一個關於產品評論的信息特徵和評論是否有幫助之間關係的模型。這個研究將填補一項口碑研究的空白，那就是口碑信息的語言風格、組織結構，和内容特徵如何影響口碑接收者的態度轉變。以往研究表明產品評論是否有幫助主要取決於兩個因素：信息質量和信息來源的可信度。現有文獻中關於這兩個因素的衡量都是基於信息接收者的主觀評判，然而這種評判是無法在網上取得的，因爲閲讀者不可能一邊看評論，一邊對信息質量和信息來源的可信度作出評價。在本研究中，我們將提出一系列新的、基於信息本身内容特性的衡量指標（如字數、段落長度、評論者是否流露出強烈個人感情，等等），以期給信息質量和信息來源可信度提供客觀的、能夠在現實生活中直接使用的測量方法。 我們的數據包含關於亞馬遜公司新推出的電子書閲讀器（Kindle）的6325個產品評論。我們將基於有關文獻，識別相關的内容特徵，並用數學模型去考察這些内容特徵與產品評論是否有幫助之間的關係。我們已利用一個小樣本（400個產品評論）作了初步的測試，其結果對我們的模型提供了基本支持。

552510.label: Project Title(Chinese)
552510.value: 转换成本对香港酒店业顾客满意度和顾客忠诚度的影响

552510.label: Project Objectives
552510.value: To develop a measurement scale for the constructs of switching costs appropriate for assessing their impact on the customer satisfaction-loyalty link in the hotel industry To examine the moderating effect of switching costs between customer satisfaction and loyalty To assess the simultaneous impact of service quality, customer satisfaction, and switching costs on customer loyalty. To provide managerial recommendations to Hong Kong hoteliers on the effective use of switching costs in order to increase customer loyalty.
rows: To develop a measurement scale for the constructs of switching costs appropriate for assessing their impact on the customer satisfaction-loyalty link in the hotel industry
To examine the moderating effect of switching costs between customer satisfaction and loyalty
To assess the simultaneous impact of service quality, customer satisfaction, and switching costs on customer loyalty.
To provide managerial recommendations to Hong Kong hoteliers on the effective use of switching costs in order to increase customer loyalty.

552510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
552510.value: Traditional studies have greatly focused on the direct impact of customer satisfaction on loyalty. The widely accepted belief is that customer satisfaction has direct and positive effect on customer loyalty. A satisfied customer will become a loyal one in the future. However, the reality is that in many situations, customers are not happy with what they receive or how they are treated but they still keep coming back and demonstrate behavioral loyalty to the firm. On the other hand, while the firm is doing what they can to make the customer happy, he/she will not return but purchases products from the firm’s competitors. Current theories fail to explain why customers behave the way they do. A new theory is in dire need to enlighten the link between customer satisfaction and loyalty. Inclusion of the construct of switching costs in the customer satisfaction-loyalty link will discover insights to better understand the complex phenomenon of customer loyalty in the hotel industry in particular. Switching costs have been studied in many contexts mostly in the general business area. Given that hotels are different from other products, we cannot simply borrow the idea and concepts and apply them to the hotel business. Developing a measurement scale of switching costs should be on top of the research agenda in customer behavior research in the hotel industry. What has been seen as switching costs in one situation may not be deemed as such in another. The process of building a measurement scale appropriate for the hotel industry will be the first of its kind. A well-developed measurement scale for switching costs will be revolutionary for the hotel business. The Hong Kong hotel industry is experiencing fierce competition, with almost all major hotel groups running hotel businesses in Hong Kong. Hoteliers need a different mindset to increase room occupancy, room rates, and profitability. The optimal use of switching costs including procedural, financial, and relational costs will help Hong Kong hoteliers develop a strategic focus to win over hotel guests and achieve organization goals. Both qualitative and quantitative data will be collected from hotel guests in Hong Kong. Managerial implications derived from this study on the effective use of switching costs to influence customer loyalty will be recommended to Hong Kong hoteliers. 以往的研究主要致力於消費者滿意度對消費者忠誠度的直接影響。消費者滿意度對消費者忠誠度有直接、積極作用的看法已被廣泛接受。一個需求得到滿足的顧客在日後將會成為忠誠消費者。然而，在很多的情況下，現實卻不盡相同。一個需求未得到滿足，消費經歷並不愉快的消費者，日後仍會再次光顧相同的公司並顯示出極大的品牌忠誠度。當公司竭盡全力滿足消費者需求時，消費者仍會光顧競爭對手的公司。迄今為止，已建立的理論無法解釋消費者的這一行為。現在急需一個新的理論來證明消費者的滿意度和忠誠度的關係。將轉換成本理念融入到消費者滿意度與忠誠度的關係中將會有助於解释酒店業中顧客滿意度與忠誠度的複雜現象。 轉換成本已經在眾多領域，尤其是商業領域得到廣泛的研究。鑑於酒店業與其他行業不同，我們不可以簡單地將轉換成本的概念以及理論應用於酒店業中。研发轉換成本的测量標準是酒店業消費者行為研究中重要的待解之題。轉換成本在不同的情況下有不同的解釋。建立一個適合酒店業的轉換成本衡量標準將是一個首創之舉。一個完善的轉換成本測量標準將會對酒店業的研究具有深远的影響。 如今，幾乎所有的大型酒店集團都在香港發展業務，香港酒店業正經歷著激烈的競爭。酒店經營者需要一個與眾不同的理念來增加客房入住率、房間價格和利潤。優化使用轉換成本，包括程序、財務以及情感相關的轉換成本將會有助於酒店經營者建立一個戰略性的策略，從而贏得顧客。研究中的定性和定量的數據來源於香港的酒店消費者。從此項研究中得到的關於有效使用轉換成本從而影響顧客忠誠度的管理措施將會有助于給香港的酒店經營者。

552510.label: Realisation of objectives
552510.value: All four research objectives have been achieved. For obejective 1, By using rigorous measurement scale development procedures proposed by Churchill (1979), a measurement scale for antecedents of switching behaviour in the hotel industry was developed.By using this scale, the influence of the antecedents on the switching intentions of hotel customers was examined. For objective 2 to 4, the simultaneous impact of customer satisfaction and switching costs on customer loyalty was investigated and the moderating effect of switching costs between customer satisfaction and loyalty was also examined. Practicalimplications regarding the optimal use of switching costs in the hotel industry were suggested. Two first tier journal papers A+)were subimtted and currently under review. Positive comments were received for one of them and it is now in the process of revising and resubmission. It is estimated that this paper can be accepted within six months. When submitting the revised version of the two papers, the following note of Acknowledgement will be added to the papers: "The work described in this paper was fully supported by a grant from the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (Project No. PolyU 5525/10H)”.

552510.value: The major findings of the study include (1)a measurement scale for antecedents of switching behaviour in the hotel industry was developed. By using rigorous measurement scale development procedures proposed by Churchill (1979), a eliable and valid scale can be used for further study. By using this scale, the influence of the antecedents on the switching intentions of hotel customers was examined, (2)the simultaneous impact of customer satisfaction and switching costs on customer loyalty was investigated and the moderating effect of switching costs between customer satisfaction and loyalty was also examined, and (3)Practicalimplications regarding the optimal use of switching costs in the hotel industry were suggested.

552510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
552510.value: The results suggested that the moderating role of switching costs on the luxury hotels and budget hotels can be different.For the luxury hotels, the moderating role of switching costs was found whereas for budget hotels, the moderating role was not so obvious to customers's decision of switching from one brand to another. The research team plans to collect more data to further test the role of switiching cost in affecting cutomers switching from one brand to another within the budget hotel sectors. With rapid development of budget hotels as a result of mass travel inside and outside China, the development of budget hotels will change the landscape of hotel industry in Asia. It is essential to have a good understanding on how consumers make their hotel choices with the budget hotel sector which has not been well reserached.

552510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
552510.value: The role of switching costs in generating hotel customers’ loyalty received little scholarly attention. The current study investigated the simultaneous impact of customer satisfaction and switching costs on customer loyalty and examine the moderating effect of switching costs between customer satisfaction and loyalty. The results suggested that the moderating role of switching costs on the luxury hotels and budget hotels can be different. 552610.label: Project Title(Chinese)
552610.value: 管理者的社会资本何时作用于企业绩效：来自中国IT产业的证据

552610.label: Co - Investigator(s)
552610.value: Prof Li, Jiatao Prof TANG, Yi

552610.label: Project Objectives
552610.value: To establish the boundary conditions of the relationship between managerial social capital and firm performance by revealing the conditions under which top managers are more willing to contribute their personal social capital to their firms. To investigate the interactive effects of firm corporate governance factors and managerial social capital on firm performance. To investigate the interactive effects of firm corporate governance factors and managerial social capital on firm performance.

552610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
552610.value: Social capital is the social relations and resource advantages bestowed upon social actors by the presence of a set of relationships among members embedded in a network (Portes, 2000). Managerial social capital, stemming from top managers’ social connections, has been suggested to influence firm decisions and outcomes (Geletkanycz & Hambrick, 1997; Park & Luo, 2003; Pennings et al., 1998). However, this stream of research has tended to assume that managerial social capital will be contributed automatically in the best interests of the firms, without considering executives’ willingness to contribute personal social capital to benefit the firm. This research aims to contribute to the literature by examining the conditions under which top managers are more willing to contribute their social capital to firms. Specifically, this study examines how particular sets of corporate governance factors may encourage top managers to contribute personal social capital for better firm performance. Drawing upon existing literature on corporate governance, we expect that two sets of corporate governance factors will strengthen the relationship between managerial social capital and firm performance. The first set of corporate governance factors is the interest alignment mechanism, meaning that the incentive function of a firm’s corporate governance will encourage its top managers to contribute their social capital to benefit the firm. The second set of corporate governance factors is named the monitoring mechanism, meaning that the monitoring function of a firm’s corporate governance will “push” its top managers to contribute their social connections to benefits the firm. In addition, the moderating role played by corporate governance factors will be further contingent on the attributes of managerial ties: the stronger and/or the higher the quality of the managerial ties are, the stronger the moderating effect of the incentive and monitoring factors will be. We intend to test our propositions on a sample of publicly listed firms in the Chinese information technology (IT) industries from 2000 to 2008. Both the archival data collection (from credible Chinese financial databases such as RESSET and WANFANG Databases) and the supplementary surveys will be conducted in our research context. Based on a pilot study focusing on managerial political ties, preliminary evidence suggests that managerial political ties have greater positive effects on firm performance when the firms’ largest owner is not the state. It is hoped that this study will foster a better understanding of the boundary conditions of the relationship between managerial social capital and firm performance. 本研究旨在通过研究在什么条件下高层管理者更愿意贡献自己的社会资本给公司。 具体来说，本研究探讨哪些公司治理因素可能鼓励管理人员更好地为企业贡献个人的社会资本。基于现有的关于公司治理的文献，我们提出，有两套公司治理因素将加强管理者社会资本和企业绩效之间的正相关关系。公司治理的第一组因素是利益机制，也就是说，企业的激励机制将鼓励其高层管理者对他们的社会资本贡献于公司。第二组因素被命名为监管机制，这意味着公司的监管手段将“推动”高层管理人员贡献个人的社会关系而造福于公司。 我们打算对中国的信息技术（IT）行业（2000年至2008）进行抽样调查。我们希望这项研究将帮助更好地理解管理者社会资本与企业绩效之间的关系。

552610.label: Realisation of objectives
552610.value: We have realized our research objective successfully. Our empirical results reveal interesting findings regarding the moderating role of corporate governance on firms' managerial social capital. Through these findings, we suggest that there are conditions under which firm executives are more or less willing to use their personal social capital for their firms. Incentives and monitoring mechanisms are demonstrated to have different moderating effect, suggesting that executives respond to different corporate governance mechanisms selectively. The data we collected also allow us to explore the heterogeneity of social capital in the interactive effects of corporate governance factors and managerial social capital in firm performance. Part of the above ideas have been developed into a complete paper, which was presented in a first-tier international strategy conference. This paper is now under preparation to be submitted to Strategic Management Journal. The remaining findings will be developed into another paper.

552610.label: Major findings and research outcome
552610.value: This research project found that (1) managerial social capital have varied impact on different performance dimensions. While social capital positively influence firms' sales growth, it does not affect firms' profitability such as ROA or ROS. (2) corporate governance mechanisms in the firm moderate the effect of managerial social capital. Managerial social capital is more likely to positively influence firm performance when there is greater incentive mechanisms(e.g. CEO ownership and pay), and less likely to enhance firm performance when there is greater monitoring mechanisms (e.g. independent director). The above findings have lead to an international conference paper, a paper under preparation to submit to Strategic Management Journal. Part of the data collected for this project is also employed in another Strategic Management Journal paper studying related but different phenomenon.

552610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
552610.value: Our concept of heterogeneity of social capital and idea that how corporate governance interact with them is not yet fully exploited in our current conference and journal papers. We explored the effect of two types of managerial social capital, executives' board interlocks with other firms and executives positional interlocks with political agencies. We found different impacts of these two types of social capital. Conceptually, they may mean very different things to firms and carry different benefits and costs. There is possibility to develop the concept and related ideas into another independent paper.

552610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
552610.value: We examine two research questions in this study: first, whether executives social ties enhance firm performance; and second, if so, under what conditions are executives more likely to contribute personal social ties for firm performance. This research project found that (1) managerial social capital have varied impact on different performance dimensions (stronger impact on sales growth but insignificant impact on profitability); and that (2) corporate governance mechanisms in the firm moderate the effect of managerial social capital: managerial social capital is more likely to positively influence firm performance when there is greater incentive mechanisms (higher CEO ownership, for example), and less likely to enhance firm performance when there is greater monitoring mechanisms (more independent directors, for example). Our study offers important theoretical implications to the growing political strategy literature. By linking managerial social capital to corporate governance mechanisms. This study represents one of the very first initiatives that incorporates and empirically tests an agency-based perspective that complements the political strategy research.

560110.label: Project Objectives
560110.value: We hypothesize that generalization (trained contrasted with novel task conditions) would be manifest in the access to working memory, visualization and manipulation of task images. 560110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
560110.value: Aims and Objectives: Generalization of previously learnt skills for application in novel situations is the marker of successful learning. Such ability is crucial in patients who have brain damage so that through rehabilitation they can reintegrate into normal daily life. This area has so far received very little attention. Previous studies conducted by our research team indicated that self-regulatory learning together with mental rehearsal of daily living tasks before their execution was effective for improving post-stroke patients’ performance in novel situations (both tasks and environment). The proposed study is intended to explain the neural processes underlying generalization learning. In particular, we are interested in knowing how the working memory mediates such learning. Method: Subjects: The subjects are 20 post-stroke patients who are in the sub-acute stage and receiving conventional rehabilitation services. All of them need to have lesions in the motor imagery working memory network resulting in mild to moderate impairments. The control group is composed of 20 age-, gender- and education-matched individuals who do not have a history of neurological diseases. Data Collection: A motor imagery task involving sequential processing of learnt or novel tasks will be used. Each trial requires the subjects to generate, visualize, and manipulate (sequencing) random-ordered snapshots capturing the sub-tasks of a daily task. There are 20 daily tasks - ten are trained and ten are new to the subjects. The subjects will learn the purpose and content of the trained tasks before the experiment. The control task requires the subject to attend to object details rather than sequencing of the snapshots. Event-related potential will be captured when subjects complete the tasks. Data Analysis: Two-way repeated measure ANOVA will be used to test the Group (lesion vs normal) x Task (Trained vs Novel) effects. We will hypothesize differences in the amplitude and possibly the latency of the N250 and N400 over the fronto-temporo-parietal regions which mediate motor and visuo-spatial processing and working memory. Dipole sources will be identified. Significance: The results will help us to understand the role of working memory and neural processes underpinning generalization learning. The findings will explain how novel combinations of representation units occur in the learning of daily task performance. The application of the findings would augment the capacity of post-stroke patients to transfer what they learn within a controlled clinical environment to where they live and what they do for the rest of their lives. 目標和宗旨： 將先前習得的技能泛化應用於新境的能力是成功學會的標誌。 這種能力對腦損傷患者很重要，通過康復他們可以重新歸入正常的日常生活。 到目前為止很少有人關注這個研究領域。 我們研究小組的早先研究表明以下2項可以有效提高腦卒中患者在新境（包括實驗任務和生活環境）中的表現：執行日常生活任務前先自己心理預演一遍以及自主學習。 本項研究意欲解釋泛化學習的神經機制, 特別是工作記憶對泛化學習的仲介作用。 方法： 被試： 被試是20名正在接受常規康復治療的腦卒中亞急性期患者， 他們的病變造成輕到重度的損傷, 並都定位在運動表像工作記憶網路。 控制組由20名無神經病史的被試組成,他們的年齡,性別和教育水準與實驗組的被試相匹配。 資料收集： 我們將採用一個包括序列處理已習得任務或新穎任務的運動想像測試。 每次實驗要求被試產生，（視覺）形象化，並且操作(程式化)包含在隨機的日常生活任務的子任務的簡單印象。 總共有20項日常任務 - 被試接受其中10項任務的訓練，但另外10項任務對於被試是新穎的。 實驗進行之前，我們告知被試他們即將接受的訓練任務的目的和內容。 控制任務要求被試關注物體細節而非程式化的生活印象。 當被試執行任務時，事件相關電位（ERP）將被記錄。 資料分析： 雙向重複測量的方差分析（ANOVA）將用於測試被試分組(損害對正常) x實驗任務(被訓練對新穎)的效應。 大腦的額葉-頂葉-顳葉對運動和視空資訊的處理都有仲介（調節）作用，於是我們假設這些腦區的N250和N400的波幅有區別，其潛伏期可能也有區別。偶極子來源將用CURRY軟體識別。 意義： 這項研究的結果將幫助我們理解工作記憶和神經加工在泛化學習過程中的角色。 研究結果將解釋在學習日常生活任務的過程中新穎的每個小的代表單位（模組）是如何組合在一起的。 研究結果將論證腦卒中患者將臨床環境控制下的習得內容應用於他們日常生活中的能力。

560110.value: All the objectives have been achieved. The tasks required for conducting the clinical study and the brain imaging were completed. The tasks were used effectively in generating the data required for the analyses. The content and designed of the randomized controlled trial had been changed. The reason is that the interleaved training protocol had been found to not reaching a significant effect size threshold. As a result, the randomized controlled trial was changed to the self-regulation group (generalization learning) versus the observation-and-practice group. 560110.label: Major findings and research outcome
560110.value: Below are the major findings of this study. 1. Stringent criteria should be set for calibrating tasks for testing improvements in activities of daily living. This is an important step before conducting task training and investigation into mechanism of the training process. The results (unpublished data) suggested that multi-dimensional scaling is useful for using patients/users as the informants in the calibration process. 2. Self-regulatory training was found to improve performance of post-stroke patients on daily living tasks among post-stroke patients (Liu, Chan et al., 2014, APMR). The results also indicated that self-regulatory training failed to improve general cognitive and motor functions of post-stroke patients. These finding suggest that self-regulatory training in contributing to generalization learning would be in the form of mental strategy rather than augmenting regain of cognitive or physical ability. 3. Self-regulatory process contributes to generalization learning. This was previously substantiated in another empirical study on post-stroke patients. Review of the literature concludes that the connectionist model provides the theoretical basis for explaining why self-regulation and mental rehearsal can contribute to generalization learning among post-stroke patients (Liu, Chan et al., 2014, JNN). 4. Self-regulatory processes involve intense visuo-motor imagery (right cunues) and retrieval of kinesthetic experiences (middle temporal gyrus and supplementary motor areas). The results of the functional MRI of the post-stroke patients who completed the self-regulatory training showed significant differences than those from the control group (Chan et al., 2014, Abstract of OHBM conference). These support the results obtained from the clinical study mentioned in #2. Visuo-motor imagery and retrieval from memory are important components in mental rehearsal. 5. The results of resting state of post-stroke patients who underwent self-regulatory training showed changes in the low frequency fluctuations (ALFF) and the regional homogeneity (ReHo) (unpublished data, under preparation). The ALFF were found in the angular gyrus, inferior parietal lobule, superior parietal lobule and middle occipital gyrus. While enhanced ReHo was found in the inferior parietal lobule and precuneus. The results are consistent with those revealed in other studies on post-stroke treatment effects on promoting inter-regional connectivity and normalization of functions.

560110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560110.value: Findings of this study can be further developed into two full papers with one on neural processes associated with generalization learning and another on neural changes after self-regulation training. Analyses on the resting state and functional imaging data set of the full data set is on its way. The whole process will take another six to nine months. This study can be extended by investigating how the generalization process manifested in real clinical settings. The method used for capturing brain activities can be functional near infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). With the results of brain imaging, important regions of interest associated with self-regulation process can be identified for locating the NIRS. Real-time signal capture can be implemented at the time when post-stroke patients undergoing self-regulation training. Changes in the NIRS patterns suggest active use of self-regulatory strategies and hence achieving generalization learning. This study can be conducted at clinical settings which are equipped with NIRS machine.

560110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560110.value: Post-stroke rehabilitation aims to enable patients to relearn the functions lost due to the lesion acquired from the stroke. In this study, our team demonstrated that the self-regulatory training when compared with the convention training (observe demonstration by therapist) significantly improved post-stroke patients' performance on daily living tasks. Self-regulatory training when coupled with mental imagery would equip post-stroke patients with mental strategies for addressing new problems in daily activity. Through brain imaging, our team revealed that self-regulation and mental imagery is likely to be dominated by retrieval of kinesthetic experience from the memory system. The images would subsequently undergo visuo-motor imagery before the actual execution of the actions. These processes are believed to be helpful to post-stroke patients when dealing with challenging daily activities.

560910.value: 利甚曼病是六個主要人類寄生蟲疾病的一種，在世界各地影響超過3.5億人。 它是由原生動物寄生蟲利甚曼原蟲引致。 目前尚沒有疫苗可用。 利甚曼病的化療主要是用銻。 但這種化療有很多的副作用，它需要4個星期的時間才完成治療，耐藥性的產生同时也進一步削弱了銻的效用。 較新的药如兩性黴素B（amphotericin B），米替福新 (miltefosine) 及 巴龍黴素 (paromomycin) 都有其缺點，包括高毒性，低效率，高價格或不方便的治療方法。 故此有迫切需要發展更多的新药。 本項目主要目的是發展黃酮二聚體作為一種新的，有效，和易於合成的利甚曼原蟲新药。 蔬菜和水果含有大量的黃酮。 文献中已有證明，如類黃酮木犀草素（luteolin），槲皮素 （quercetin）和 黃芩 （baicalein）均包含有抗利甚曼原蟲的活性。 我們的初步數據表明，合成類黃酮二聚體 1 含有非常有效的抗利甚曼原蟲的活性。 半数抑制浓度（IC50）對利甚曼原蟲（promastigote）約為0.2µM。 我們發現1 對于一系列的耐藥性利甚曼原蟲 (原蟲細胞能夠抵抗銻，噴他脒（pentamidine），兩性黴素B或米替福新) 可以保持高活性（IC50約0.2µM）。1 同时能够有效殺死在巨噬細胞系RAM264.7或腹腔引起巨噬細胞中的無鞭毛體（amastigotes）。 1的高治療指數 (therapeutic index > 500) 僅次於兩性黴素B。 在本項目中，我們將（1）進一步優化黃酮二聚體 1，（2）研究優化后的1在囓齒類動物的毒性和藥代動力學和（3）研究優化后的1在利甚曼病鼠模型中的活性。 總结，本項目將專注於開發一種新的，有效，安全，和易於合成的黃酮類二聚體作为新一代的利甚曼原蟲新药。

560910.label: Realisation of objectives
560910.value: We have designed, synthesized and characterized a library of new flavonoid dimer that showed selective anti-promastigote and anti-amastigote activities relative to macrophage hosts. One of the most potent flavonoid dimer (compound 39) was tested using a mouse model of cutaneous leishmaniasis and found that it was effective in reducing parasite load in the lesion by more than 95%.

560910.label: Major findings and research outcome
560910.value: We have developed a new class of anti-leishmanial agent based on novel synthetic flavonoid dimers. After synthesizing more than 100 flavonoid dimers and screen for their anti-promastigote and anti-amastigote activities in vitro, compound 39 was found to be the most potent. In the first publication (Wong, ILK, Chan, K-F, TH Chan* and Chow LMC*; Flavonoid Dimers as Novel, Potent Antileishmanial Agents J. Med Chem (2012) 55 (20), pp 8891–8902), we reported that compound 39 is one of the most potent anti-promastigote (IC50 = 0.13 - 0.21 µM) and anti-amastigote (IC50 = 0.63 µM) compounds when tested using Leishmania donovani. Compound 39 is effective against both stibogluconate-sensitive and resistant strains of L. donovani, suggesting that it can be used in the future to treat sodium stibogluconate-resistant visceral leishmaniasis cases. Most importantly, compound 39 is very safe (IC50 against macrophages > 88-100 µM), giving its therapeutic index (119) even better than amphotericin B. The second publication (Wong ILK, Chan KF, Chen Y-F, Chan T-H and Chow LMC (2014) In vitro and in vivo efficacy of novel flavonoid dimers against cutaneous leishmaniasis Antimicrob Agents Chemother) has been accepted for publication in Antimicrob Agents Chemother (AAC). Compound 39 has a marked anti-promastigote (IC50 = 0.19 – 0.69 µM) and anti-amastigote (0.17 – 2.2 µM) activities towards different species of Leishmania that cause cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL), including L. amazonensis, L. braziliensis, L. tropica and L. major. In the mouse model of cutaneous leishmaniasis induced by subcutaneous inoculation of L. amazonensis in mouse foot pad, intralesional administration of 2.5 mg/kg of 39.HCl can reduce foot pad thickness by 36% compared to control. Amastigotes load in lesion was reduced by 20-fold. The present study suggests that flavonoid dimer 39 represents a new class of safe and effective leishmanicidal agent against both visceral and cutaneous leishmaniasis.

560910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560910.value: This project discovers a new class of safe and potent anti-leishmanial compound that are safe and effective against both cutaneous and visceral leishmaniasis in both in vitro and in vivo animal model. Since it is also covered by a patent application, it is potentially transferable to industry for further pre-clinical trial and developments.

560910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560910.value: We have developed a new class of safe and effective drug candidate to treat a major parasitic disease (leishmaniasis) in the world. This drug candidate is based on a new class of chemical called flavonoid dimer that is developed in our research group. Not only it is safe and effective, it can also be used to treat drug-resistant parasites, making it particularly useful in the future when current anti-leishmanial drugs failed to cure the patients. We have tested this compound both in cellular and animal model and is now ready for pre-clincial trial study.

561410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
561410.value: The long-term goal is to understand the interaction between the thalamus and the cerebral cortex. The thalamus is reciprocally connected with the cerebral cortex. Both thalamocortical and corticothalamic projections send collaterals to the thalamic reticular nucleus (TRN) of the ventral thalamus. The TRN consists of only GABAergic inhibitory neurons which only projects back to the dorsal thalamus. Recently we found that TRN neurons showed great adaptation and the adaptation was stimulus specific, preferring deviant stimulus[1,2]. The deviant stimulus detection of TRN neurons either enhanced or suppressed the medial geniculate (MGB) neuronal responses to the following auditory stimulus[2]. The deviance detection feature of the TRN has been proposed to induce attention shift to fresh stimulus at the dorsal thalamus, echoing the old “searchlight’ hypothesis[3]. Deviance stimulus detection or stimulus-specific adaptation (SSA) happens in the AC[4,5]. The corticofugal fibers have greater control over the excitability of TRN neurons than the thalamocortical collateral fibers[6,7] and could change the firing pattern of TRN neurons[8]. Questions arise here. 1) Does the AC have a modulation of the deviance-detection of TRN neurons? 2) Is there a tonotopic organization in the corticofugal modulation of the deviance-detection in TRN neurons? 3) Does the corticofugal modulation of the deviance-detection in the TRN neuron depend on the deviance-detection of AC neurons? 4) Does the cortical modulation of the deviance-detection of TRN neurons depend on the selection of the frequency of the paired tones in the oddball paradigm? The questions will be addressed with both the extracellular and intracellular recordings from TRN neurons while the auditory cortex is activated with electrical stimulation. With intracellular recording, we would be able to add new understanding about the deviance-detection of TRN neurons at the subthreshold level. After mapping the AC in terms of frequency organization and deviance-detection, we would implant stimulation electrodes into the AC to activate a small area of the AC to investigate the corticofugal modulation of the deviance detection of TRN neurons. We would also investigate the corticofugal modulation on behavioral animals by comparing the deviance-detections of TRN neurons before and after the inactivation of AC with drug injection. The results of the proposed study would advance our understanding on corticofugal modulation of the deviance-detection in the TRN and thus the dorsal thalamus. The results would also add an important piece of knowledge on potential functional implications of the highly integrative brain processes of attention. 我們這項研究的長遠目標，是了解丘腦和大腦皮層的相互作用。丘腦和大腦皮層是相互連結在一起的。丘腦皮層投射和皮層丘腦投射都會將絡脈傳送到腹側丘腦的丘腦網狀核（TRN）。丘腦網狀核僅包含只能投射回背側丘腦的 GABA抑制性中間神經元。 最近，我們發現丘腦網狀核神經元顯示高度的適應力而此適應力針對特定的刺激，並對異常刺激具選擇性。丘腦網狀核神經元偵測到異常刺激，會增強或抑制內側膝狀體（MGB）神經元對其後聽覺刺激的反應。有建議認為，丘腦網狀核偵測異常刺激的特質，可促使將注意力轉移至背側丘腦的新刺激，因而與原來的“探照燈假設”相脗合。 異常刺激的偵測或特定刺激的適應是在聽覺皮層作出。皮層神經纖維較丘腦皮層並列纖維，更能控制丘腦網狀核神經元的興奮性，並可改變丘腦網狀核神經元的放電模式。 這裡引出一些問題: 1）聽覺皮層能否調制丘腦網狀核神經元對異常的偵測？ 2）丘腦網狀核神經元對異常偵測的皮層調制是否具有頻率組織架構？ 3）丘腦網狀核神經元對異常偵測的皮層調制是否要依賴聽覺皮層神經元的異常偵測? 4）丘腦網狀核神經元對異常偵測的皮層調制是否取決於特異刺激方式中雙音的頻率選擇? 上述問題，將會在利用電力刺激聽覺皮層時，藉着在丘腦網狀核神經元進行細胞外和細胞內的記錄而加以探討。透過進行細胞內的記錄，我們將更能了解丘腦網狀核神經元在閾下水平 對異常刺激的偵測。將聽覺皮層就頻率組織和異常偵測進行配對後，我們會在聽覺皮層植入電流刺激電極，使一小部份的聽覺皮層活躍起來，以探究丘腦網狀核神經元對異常偵測的皮層調制。我們還會研究具有行為的動物的皮層調制，做法是利用藥物注射使聽覺皮層不活躍，再比較使不活躍之前和之後丘腦網狀核神經元對異常刺激的偵測。

561410.label: Major findings and research outcome
561410.value: Neurons along the auditory pathway from the inferior colliculus, the medial geniculate body (MGB), and the thalamic reticular nucleus (TRN), to the auditory cortex showed stimulus-specific adaptation (SSA) to commonly occurring stimuli. In the present study, we investigated the influence of the TRN on the SSA of MGB neuronsin anesthetized guinea pigs.Intracellular recording in subthreshold level showed SSA of MGB neurons in both excitatory postsynaptic potential (EPSP) and inhibitory postsynaptic potential(IPSP) forms (Objective 1). The majority of MGB neurons responded to acoustic stimuli with an onset EPSP that followed by long-lasting IPSP components or with only IPSP components (Objective 2). These IPSP components were synchronized with neuronal activities in the TRN that can be triggered by the cortex (Objectives 2 and 3, Gao et al. submitted).The TRN neurons have a large receptive field in terms of corticofugal projection (Yu et al. 2011). We investigated the objectives in the following two ways. While the recording electrode in the TRN was fixed, the stimulation electrode was moved around the auditory cortex. The stimulation electrode was fixed, while the recording electrode was changed location. A single TRN neuron received inputs from a larger cortical area (Yu et al. 2011). In the auditory cortex, neurons from the midbrain to cortex adapt quickly to repeated stimuli but this adaptation does not fully generalize to otherrare stimuli, a phenomenon called SSA. We tested SSA in the auditory cortex to the ear of stimulationusing broadband noise. We show that cortical neurons adapt specifically to the ear of stimulation, and that the contrast between the responses to stimulation of the same ear when rare and when common depends on the binaural interaction class of the neurons (Xu et al. 2014).Inactivation of the TRN resulted in a changed neuronal response with minimized IPSP components and thus changed SSA of MGB neurons. Our results suggest that SSA in the MGB was strongly modulated by the inhibition from the TRN, which also received corticothalamic feedback, indicating SSA was a network product (Objectives 4 and 5, Gao et al. submitted). We further investigated the SSA in single neuron level. TheSSA was conducted in the cultured cortical neuron with whole cell patch clamp recording. The spatially separated electrical or chemical stimuli were used in the oddball stimulation protocol. The synapse-driven spikes was used to match those extracellular spikes recorded in the anesthetized or awaking animals, then synaptic components including excitatory and inhibitory were evaluated in the process of SSA, and the imbalance between excitation and inhibition would help to produce the obvious SSA of synapse-driven spikes. Finally glutamate-puff was used as chemical stimulation to assess the contribution of postsynaptic fatigue (Objectives 1-3; Wang et al. revised). On the extension of the current line of investigation, we have studied the functional connectivity between the auditory cortex and visual cortex and found that the auditory and visual cortex are functionally connected (Chen et al. 2013). The establishment of the new link needs the involvement of the cholecystokinin (CCK) neurons in the entorhinal cortex (Li et al. 2014).

561410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
561410.value: We have demonstrated SSA could occur at the synapse level in the present proposal, but there are some interesting questionsstill waiting for our answers. Firstly, we only evaluated the contribution of postsynaptic components to the SSA in vitro, but whether other mechanisms such as inhibition mediated by GABAb or mGlu receptor remain unexplored. Secondly, the neurons from different anatomical region have distinct intrinsic membraneproperties, and its role in SSA could be clarified by comparisonbetween corticalneurons (auditory cortex)and subcortical neurons (thalamus and cochlear nuclei). Thirdly, the imbalance of excitation and inhibition was suggested to enhance SSA, but further confirmation needs to be done usingspecific blockers applied in the external or internal solutions. Fourthly, to build the link of SSA in vitro with sensory SSA in vivo, whole cell recording in acute brain slice with preserve well the neural circuitry would provide us more valuable information.

561410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
561410.value: The deviant stimulus detection feature of thalamic reticular nucleus (TRN) has been proposed to induce attention shift to fresh stimulus at the dorsal thalamus. And deviant stimulus detection or stimulus-specific adaptation happens in the auditory cortex (AC). The fibers sending away from the cortex (corticofugal) have greater control over the excitability of TRN neurons than the collateral fibers of the projection from thalamus to cortex and could change the firing pattern of TRN neurons. Questions of the corticofugal modulation of the deviance-detection in TRN neurons arise on many levels, and all these questions will be addressed with both the extracellular and intracellular recordings from TRN neurons. With intracellular recording, we would be able to add new understanding about the deviance-detection of TRN neurons at the subthreshold level. We would also implant stimulation electrodes to activate a small area of the AC to investigate the corticofugal modulation of the deviance detection of TRN neurons. The results of the proposed study would advance our understanding on corticofugal modulation of the deviance-detection in the TRN and the dorsal thalamus. The results would also add an important piece of knowledge on potential functional implications of the highly integrative brain processes of attention.

562710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
562710.value: People with traumatic brain injury (TBI) often experience cognitive deficits in attention, memory, executive functioning and problem-solving. The present research study successfully examined the effectiveness of an artificial intelligent virtual reality (VR)-based vocational problem-solving skill training programme designed to enhance employment opportunities for people with TBI. Improvement in selective memory processes and perception of memory function were found. Across-group comparison showed that the VR group performed more favourably than the therapist-led one in terms of objective and subjective outcome measures and better vocational outcomes. Improvement in selective memory processes and perception of memory function were found. These results support the potential use of a VR-based approach in memory training.

563210.label: Project Objectives
