622110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
622110.value: In this project, we propose to study a model where two stations, each of which is a many-server queue, are arranged in series, the arrivals are allowed to vary with time and the service times at both stations follow general probability distributions. Further more, we will extend this model in two directions. One is to allow customers to abandon the system while waiting; the other is to limit the size of the waiting buffer. This type of models pervades in complex systems of many economic and public sectors. Examples of these systems include hospitals and customer call centers in various businesses. Since multiple servers are employed to handle the demand, the many-server queue has become a good model to study these systems. The motivation for considering two queues in tandem is that in many systems, it may take a few steps to fulfill the service of a customer. For example, most patients arrive to hospitals through the emergency room. After receiving treatment, some may be discharged and some may need to be transferred to another unit for further care. Most of such systems demand efficient solutions for their design and operations. A common issue is how to accommodate the time-varying demand with relatively fixed capacity. For example, call volume may change significantly every half hour in a call center, but the number of agents to be hired has to be determined in advance and fixed within a working shift, normally a few hours long. Despite the importance, this type of problems remains largely open in the literature. The major challenge comes from the study of many-server queues with general service time distributions, which still have not been fully understood. Though a system may be more complicated in reality, study of this fundamental two-station model is already a big leap and the stepping stone to take on more complicated network structures. This research will not only lead to mathematical characterizations of the underlying stochastic processes, but also insights and practical staffing rules that can make the design or operations of such systems the most efficient in a random and time-varying environment. Part of the research methodology will be based on our previous work on a single station many-server queue with general service times and constant arrival rate. The novelty of the research arises from concepts of the two-station structure, time-varying environment and staffing. 在这个项目中，我们将研究如下的排队论模型，它由两个串联的工作站组成，其中每个工作站拥有多个服务器，每个工作站的服务器的服务时间服从一般的概率分布，并且顾客到达的快慢可随时间变化而变化。我们将进一步沿两个不同方向推广这个模型。一种允许顾客在等待过程中选择离去；另一种则限制缓冲区的大小，缓冲区满时不接受新顾客。这样的模型被广泛应用于经济和公共部门的各种复杂系统中，例如，商业领域的客户电话服务中心以及医院服务系统。之所以考虑多个服务器的串联型工作站的排队论模型，是因为实际通常要求多个服务器同时工作以满足需求，并且有些顾客要求的服务需要分步完成。常见的医院服务系统中，病人到达急诊室就诊。就诊之后，有些病人可以立刻出院，但是有些则需要转移到其他部门接受进一步的治疗。 这样的系统需要一种有效的方法来设计和运作。常见的问题之一就是如何寻找相对固定的系统服务能力来应对随时间变化的客户需求。例如电话服务系统中，考虑一个工作时间段（通常几个小时），我们知道来电数目每半小时会显著变化，但是接线员数目必须在这个工作段开始前就设定好。如何设定接线员的数目才能使此系统高效的运行，这是一个相当重要的问题。尽管这个问题有实际重要性，但在学术界仍然是一个悬而未决的开放性问题。其最大的挑战在，对于服从一般分布的多服务器的排队论模型，我们还没有一个彻底的解决。尽管实际中的系统可能更加复杂，比如网状结构系统，但是基本的两串联工作站模型是研究更一般复杂系统的基石。 这项研究计划不仅从理论上研究实际模型背后的随机过程的数学性质，同时我们也将决策出实用的人事安排以及操作规则使得随机环境下的系统能够高效的运作。之前工作我们已经对于单工作站多服务器，并且服务时间服从一般概率分布，固定顾客到达率的模型进行了研究。本项目的部分研究方法将基于此继续展开。串联工作站、根据时间变化的随机环境、相应的人事安排政策是此次研究的创新之处。

622210.value: 山坡松散滑坡堆积体降雨诱发失稳机理及快速识别方法研究

622210.label: Project Objectives
622210.value: To characterize the microstructure and shear strength of saturated/unsaturated loose coarse soil deposits. Variations in the microstructure of soils with coarse contents will be studied to provide basis for identifying the most hazardous conditions. The shear strength of loose soils with varying percentages of coarse contents and degrees of saturation will be investigated and its relation with the microstructure established. The shear strength at the interface between the loose soil deposit and the native soils will also be investigated. To investigate the soil-water characteristic curves and permeability functions for loose, coarse-grained soils. These functions are required for the analysis of rainfall infiltration. Emphasis will be paid to the behaviour of these soils under small suctions. Coarse granular soils typically have an air-entry value less than 1 kPa (Li et al. 2009; Zhang et al. 2009) and the behaviour of soils at such small suctions has received very little attention in the research literature. To analyze rainfall infiltration into landslide deposits on hilly terrains during severe storms. Comprehensive 2-D/3-D rainfall infiltration analyses will be performed to investigate the processes of water infiltration, changes in pore-water pressures and hence changes in shear strength of these soils. The effects of coarse soil content, density, boulders, slope inclination, precedent rainfall, rain intensity and pattern, and the relative permeability of the native soils will be investigated. Fundamental issues related to (a) the representative element volume (REV) for coarse soils with boulders and (b) solutions to partial differential equations involving highly nonlinear SWCCs and permeability functions will be studied. To develop methods for the rapid identification of hazardous landslide deposits on hilly terrains subject to severe storms. Based on experiments and numerical analyses performed as part of Objectives (1)-(3), methods for rapid identification of hazardous landslide deposits on hilly terrains subject to severe storms will be developed. Possible methods to improve the stability conditions of such soil deposits will be explored.

622210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
622210.value: There are over 25000 visible natural terrain landslides in Hong Kong. A large number of natural terrain landslides can also occur during a single earthquake event. The May 2008 Wenchuan earthquake alone triggered approximately 30,000 landslides. Many of the landslide soil deposits are densely populated on steep terrains and are marginally stable under normal climate conditions. During wet seasons, numerous loose deposits may lose stability due to rainfall infiltration and unfavorable perched groundwater conditions. Hence the Wenchuan earthquake zone enters a period of high occurrence of geo-hazards. The soil deposits that pose hazards to the human safety and economic development must be identified and their associated risks minimized. Considering the great number of hazardous soil deposits, there is a need for a general methodology which can capture the main mechanisms associated with failures under rainfall infiltration. Such a methodology can be used to rapidly identify hazardous soil deposits. The primary objectives of the proposed research are to investigate the mechanisms of rain-induced failures of loose, coarse-grained soil deposits in the Wenchuan earthquake zone and to develop a strategy to rapidly identify numerous hazardous soil deposits on the hilly terrains. Preliminary field investigations indicate that the soil deposits are generally loose, coarse granular materials containing various coarse contents. Boulders larger than 200 mm are also frequently observed in the soil deposits. It is not fully understood how rainwater infiltrates into such coarse soils and how the shear strength of these soils decreases during rainfall infiltration. Also it is not clear how boulders affect water infiltration and groundwater flows into the soil deposits. To answer these questions, several challenging scientific issues need to be addressed on the soil-water characteristic curves, hydraulic conductivity, and shear strength of these coarse soils. These issues need to be addressed through extensive laboratory tests and numerical analyses. Based on the results obtained, a practical tool will be developed to rapidly identify hazardous soil deposits. Possible methods to improve the stability of such soil deposits will be explored. The outcome of the research will advance our engineering understanding of the fundamental behaviour of loose coarse soils. The results will also facilitate landslide hazards mitigation in Hong Kong, mainland China, and other places facing similar problems. 香港已查明25000多个天然滑坡体。一次强烈地震也可诱发大量的滑坡。例如2008年的汶川地震诱发了30000多个滑坡， 这些滑坡体密布于陡峭的山谷, 并处于亚稳定状态。在降雨条件下，由于降雨入渗和地下水位上升，这些松散堆积体则可能失稳或转化为泥石流。 因此汶川地震区已进入一个地质灾害高发期。松散堆积体的失稳可对公众安全和经济发展带来极大影响。为了有效减少松散堆积体造成的损失，必须尽早辨别这类危险堆积体，为此需要开发一种能够捕捉降雨诱发滑坡机制和迅速辨别危险堆积体的方法。 本课题的主要目标是研究降雨诱发松散粗粒堆积土体的失稳机理和建立一套可以迅速辨别危险堆积体的方法。现场调查发现滑坡堆积体通常是含不同粗粒含量的松散碎石土，有时含直径大于200mm的漂石。雨水在这种粗粒土的入渗机理和粗粒土抗剪强度如何随降雨入渗降低还尚不清楚。漂石对降雨和地下水的入渗影响也尚不明确。为解决这些问题，需要对与之相关的粗粒土的水土特征曲线，渗透系数和抗剪强度等科学问题进行深入研究。本课题将通过大量的室内试验和数值模拟分析，开发一套可以迅速辨别危险堆积体的实用工具，并探讨提高这类松散堆积体稳定性的方法。本研究结果将加深我们对松散粗粒土的基本工程特性认识，并可应用到中国香港，中国大陆和其他一些面临滑坡灾害的国家，以降低由滑坡带来的损失。

622210.label: Realisation of objectives
622210.value: The research objectives have been fully realised. Objective 1. An extensive experimental programme was implemented to characterize the microstructure and shear strength of saturated/unsaturated loose coarse soil deposits. This formed the main part of Dr Hongfen Zhao’s PhD work and Mr Zhi Zheng’s master thesis research work. Objective 2. This was also one of the primary objectives of Dr Hongfen Zhao’s PhD research. Based on a large number of laboratory tests, new constitutive models have been developed to describe the soil-water characteristic curves and permeability functions for loose, coarse-grained soils. Five papers on the research work related to Objectives 1 and 2 have been published in Canadian Geotechnical Journal, ASCE Journal of Geotechnical Engineering, and Engineering Geology. Objective 3. Dr Shuai Zhang’s PhD work is dedicated to Objectives 3 and 4. Most of the 12 FYP students also worked in this area. Extensive numerical analyses have been conducted to understand rainfall infiltration into landslide deposits on hilly terrains during severe storms. A cell based methodology has been developed to analyse rainfall infiltration and slope stability at regional scale. Numerous trips have been made to conduct field studies on triggering of landslides and debris flows in the Wenchuan earthquake zone. Good understanding on rain-induced slope failures and debris flows has been obtained through the field studies and numerical analyses. About 10 journal papers have been published on this objective. Objective 4. A methodology has been developed for the rapid identification of hazardous landslide deposits on hilly terrains subject to severe storms. In essence, our methodologies are risk based and consider the uncertainties in rainfall, material properties, boundary and initial conditions, and analysis models. In addition, the stability status of hazardous landslide deposits is presented in a GIS platform so that a large number of deposits in a catchment can be analysed. A real-time landslide warning methodology has also been developed in association with the reconstruction of a highway near the epicentre of the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake. The core of this warning methodology is a five-phase multi-risk assessment framework developed in Dr Zhang Shuai’ PhD thesis. The outcome has been reflected in six keynote/invited lectures delivered by the PI (Please refer to Part C, 11, Other impact).

622210.label: Major findings and research outcome
622210.value: This RGC research project was one of the most fruitful and exciting projects the PI ever conducted. First, 16 students at various levels were trained. Three PhD students and one MSc student on this project received their degrees and research awards. Twelve final-year undergraduate students were trained and many of them are now actively involving in landslide risk reduction in the industry. Second, this project generated 22 international journal papers and 7 international conference papers. Most of the journal papers were published in the top journals in the field: Engineering Geology, Journal of Geotechnical and Geoenvironmental Engineering, Canadian Geotechnical Journal, etc. Third, the outcome of this research project has been applied to the reconstruction of a major highway (PR303) near the epicentre of the Wenchuan earthquake. The reconstruction of PR303 was the largest project financed by the Hong Kong Government. Lastly, the outcome from this research has received several awards including Natural Science Award (First class) from Ministry of Education of China. The major findings are as follows: (1) Through extensive laboratory tests, a unified framework has been proposed to charaterterise the microstructure, soil-water characteristics, compressibility and shear strength of saturated/unsaturated loose coarse soil deposits in an integrated manner. (2) New SWCC constitutive models and shear strength models have been proposed to describe the bimodal soil-water characteristics and shear strength of unsaturated coarse granular soils. The instability of unsaturated soil along a wetting path is described based on the state parameter using an equivalent mean effective stress concept. (3) A methodology has been developed for the rapid identification of hazardous landslide deposits on hilly terrains subject to severe storms. In essence, the methodology is risk based. The stability of hazardous landslide deposits is presented in a GIS platform so that a large number of deposits in a catchment can be analysed. (4) The project team conducted extensive field studies of large-scale rain-induced slope failures and debris flows during the wet seasons of 2010, 2011 and 2013 in the Wenchuan earthquake zone. The outcome of our laboratory experimental studies has been applied to interpret the field observations and to assist the numerical simulation of several failure cases. (5) A cell-based, real-time landslide warning methodology is developed in association with the reconstruction of a highway near the epicentre of the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake. This sets a good example of applying the outcome of a RGC-funded project to an important engineering project.

622210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
622210.value: Hong Kong faces slope safety problems upon extreme storms. How to rapidly identify hazardous deposits on hilly terrains on which many landslides occurred previously is a concern. Upon a severe storm, multiple hazards, e.g. flooding, slides, debris flow can occur simultaneously. How to evaluate the impact of such multi-hazard events needs to be worked out.

622410.value: 未来无线市场中服务提供商的新的策略

622410.label: Project Objectives
622410.value: To exploit a new research direction for WSPs to improve utilities and resources efficiency by promoting resource exchange. Since WSPs are competitors while individual BS needs to perform resource exchange to improve the aggregated revenue, a group bargaining solution will be investigated. Two distributed resource exchange methods will be studied in this project. Specifically, a local bargaining method will target at improving computational and communication efficiency, where no performance-gap guarantee can be achieved. The Lagrangian decomposition method will also be investigated, which can guarantee zero performance-gap with more communication cost. To develop new business model and market strategies for WSPs under a dynamic spectrum market. To propose a brand new three-layer model to properly describe the future dynamic spectrum market and jointly to consider bandwidth competition to obtain spectrum and price competition to attract end-users for non-cooperative WSPs. Under the three-layer model, to investigate 1) with complete information of other providers’ profit functions, how WSPs perform bandwidth purchasing and price setting; 2) when profit related information is limited, how WSPs interact with each other to approach a stable point.

622410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
622410.value: Wireless service providers (WSPs) play a very important role in the wireless communication industry. Today's wireless communication is regulated by the command-and-control policy, under which fixed-spectrum slices are assigned to WSPs. To provide service to end-users, a WSP needs to take part in long-term spectrum acquisition competition controlled by the government. With spectrum purchased, of which the license duration usually lasts for years or even decades, and infrastructure deployed, WSPs can offer subscriptions for end-users and, in most cases, compete with each other for market share. It is well known that users’ demand varies spatially and temporally, which imposes great challenges for WSPs. Such long-term spectrum purchasing cannot match short-term demand variation, which causes severe inefficiency for WSPs. This project aims to tackle this inefficiency issue and investigate new strategies for WSPs in future wireless market from different aspects. A very interesting observation obtained from our recent spectrum-usage measurement is that there are many channels from different WSPs that behave contrarily with a high ratio. This motivates us to explore a new research direction to improve WSPs’ utilities and resources efficiency by promoting cooperation through resource exchange. One unique challenge is that WSPs are competitors in spectrum purchasing and service provision. Thus, in this project, we will maintain a moderate-level of cooperation among WSPs, which means that a WSP does not compromise with others by giving up its customer ownership or control power over its base stations. Two distributed resource exchange methods will be proposed in this project. To fundamentally solve the mismatch between long-term spectrum purchasing and short-term demand variation, a spectrum market with dynamic spectrum access (DSA) enabled is needed, where the spectrum bandwidth itself becomes frequently transacted goods. For WSPs, the emergence of DSA brings new opportunities and challenges. Flexible spectrum acquisition gives WSP the chance to easily adapt its system capacity to fit end-users’ demands. However, the competition among several WSPs for both spectrum and end-users complicates the situation. In this project, we will propose a three-layer spectrum market model, in which the interaction among spectrum holder, WSPs and end-users are considered. In this market, spectrum bandwidth competition and price competition will be jointly considered to maximize profits for each WSP. Spectrum management in Hong Kong is moving from the command-and-control model to market-based model. Efficient strategies that proposed in this project will help speed up this reforming procedure, which has tremendous academic and social significance. 无线服务供应商(WSP)在无线通讯产业中发挥着非常重要的作用。无线频谱的分配利用通常是由无线电法规部门确定的。目前世界各国采用的是基于静态（固定）频带分配的原则与方案。一个频段一般仅供一个无线通信系统独立使用，不同的无线通信系统使用不同的频段，互不干扰。为了给最终用户提供服务，一个WSP需要获取相应频谱的长期使用权限。随着频谱的购买和在固定位置基础设施的部署，WSP能够为最终用户提供服务，并与竞争者竞争市场的占有率。众所周知，用户的需求会随着空间和时间的不同而变化，这对WSP提出了很大的挑战。这种长期的频谱购买机制将无法适应短期的服务需求的变化，从而导致WSP和无线市场的严重的效率低下。该项目旨在解决这种低效率的问题，探讨在未来无线市场中WSP在短期和长期各应采取的新的战略。 我们从最近的频谱使用情况测量数据中发现了一个非常有趣的观察，有许多来自不同WSP的信道的行为正好相反。这促使我们探索出一条新的研究方向，也就是通过增进合作，通过WSP的资源交换，来提高各个WSP的资源效率。在这样一个问题空间中一个独特的挑战是，不同的WSP从资源/用户占用以及服务的提供上是天然的竞争关系。因此，在这个项目中，我们将保持在适度的WSP合作，也就是说，任何WSP不会放弃其客户的拥有权以及所属基站的控制权。这个项目将提出两个分布式资源交换的方法。 为了从根本上解决长期频谱采购和短期需求变化之间的矛盾，需要提出一种具有动态频谱接入（DSA）能力的频谱市场，在这种市场里频谱带宽本身将成为一种能频繁交易的商品。对于WSP来说，DSA的出现为他们带来了新的机遇和挑战。灵活的频谱收购使WSP有机会更灵活地调整其系统的能力以适应最终用户的需求。然而，在多个WSP之间为频谱和最终用户的获取而形成的竞争关系将变得更复杂了。在这个项目中，我们将提出一个三层的频谱市场模式，在这个市场中将考虑频谱的持有者、WSP、以及最终用户的交互。在这个市场中，需要联合考虑频谱带宽的竞争和价格竞争以最大化每个WSP的利润。 香港的频谱管理政策正在由指挥和控制模式向着以市场为基础的模式转变。在这个项目提出的频谱管理的高效战略，将有助于加快这一改革过程，它具有巨大的学术和社会意义。

622410.label: Realisation of objectives
622410.value: The objectives of this project have been well achieved. The interaction among wireless service providers in cognitive radio networks and future wireless networks have been studied from different aspects. More specifically, the following pieces of work have been conducted. 1. We considered the scenario that a femtocell service provider expects to rent spectrum from the co-existing marcocell service provider to serve its end users. In addition to the spectrum leasing payment, the FSP may allow hybrid access into consideration. Our study shown that both MSP and FSP can benefit from spectrum leasing and hybrid access of femtocell can further improve their utilities. 2. We focused on the scenario that macro and femto base-stations are deployed by the same Wireless Service Provider (WSP). We proposed an economic framework, where users choose either macrocell or femtocell service to optimize their own utility and the monopolistic WSP tries to maximize its revenue via pricing and spectrum allocation strategy. Our results have indicated that the revenue of the WSP is significantly improved by combining the pricing strategy and the spectrum allocation strategy. 3. Market based spectrum trading has been extensively studied to realize efficient spectrum utilization in cognitive radio networks (CRNs). We utilized the concept of insurance in spectrum trading so as to improve spectrum efficiency in CRNs. We show that by additionally purchasing a specifically designed insurance contract from a PU, an SU can improve its utility since it will be insured against the potential accident. 4. Spectrum auction is widely applied in spectrum re-distribution, especially under the dynamic spectrum management context. Motivated by the recent group-buying behaviors in the Internet based service, we advocated that SUs can be grouped together to take part in the spectrum auction as a whole to increase their chances to win the channel. We proposed TASG, a Three-stage Auction framework for Spectrum Group-buying to address the above challenges and enable group-buying behaviors among SUs. 5. In spectrum trading markets, auctions are organized by spectrum holders (SHs) to distribute channels. As buyers, wireless service providers (WSPs) acquire channels to deploy services to end users. We jointly studied the strategy of the SH in the auction design and the WSPs' strategies in the service provisions and biddings. We proven theoretically that Flexauc not only maximizes the social welfare but also preserves other nice properties: truthfulness and computational tractability.

622510.value: 當銷售者對大宗交易提供數量折扣時，對此感興趣的買家們可能會自發性地或者依賴於第三方統合他們的需求來獲得一個較低的價格，這種行為被稱作「團購」。當銷售者提供了一種具體的折扣方案後，一個顧客團體需要就每人最終購買的數量及其支付的價格達成一系列的共識，稱為「團購機制」（參見www.teambuy.com.cn）。 否則，顧客們也可能大量地聚集起來向商家索要折扣價格（參見storemob.com），稱為「主動團購」。在兩種情況中，顧客團體都可能是通過線上論壇或者第三方網站（參見www.eWinWin.com，www.LetsBuyIt.com）組織起來的一群陌生人。 團購行為被廣泛認為是對顧客和商家雙方都有利的——顧客可以獲得較低的價格，而商家的銷售量會上升。 然而，一名顧客所計劃購買的商品數量取決於他的效用函數以及商品的最終價格，而這個價格只有在團體中的所有顧客都決定了購買的數量之後才能確定下來。因此，顧客們通常可以靈活地根據決策過程中價格的變化來向上或向下調整他們的購買量。我們初步的研究發現，顧客們組成團體後反而有可能減少購買量，從而使商家受到損失。故進一步的關於顧客的購買行為以及所造成的顧客與商家的獲利/損失的深入研究是必需的。假定顧客們將會組團購買，商家是否應該提前公佈折扣方案？商家是否應該在主動團購出現時提供折扣？即使對於給定的商家的一種折扣方案，不同的團購機制也會導致各方的獲利/損失的情況及交易數量產生變化。 儘管團購行為在B2C 乃至B2B 平台上都日趨流行，現有的研究文獻極少涉及團購行為的可持續性以及對其成本/利益的分析。在本項目中，我們將針對多種不同的團購機制（統一價格或非統一價格）研究上述課題。我們的初步研究表明團購機制直接影響到顧客們的消費行為以及他們的支出，進而商家的收入。並且，團購行為並非總有利於商家或全體顧客。 本項目的成果將大大地加深及拓廣已有的關於團購行為的研究，並且隨著團購這種現象在世界上（特別是中國）越來越普遍，這項研究將顯著地提升顧客和商家的利益並對現實產生深遠的影響。

622510.label: Realisation of objectives
622510.value: We have successfully achieved the proposed objectives. We consider a seller who offers a quantity discount schedule for a homogeneous product. We first study buyers' purchasing quantities if they buy alone, called individual purchasing, and if a centralized decision maker decides the purchasing quantities for all the buyers, called centralized purchasing. We then compare the quantities and buyer surplus with those under both the uniform price mechanism and the proportional mechanism, analytically and numerically. We also study the seller's best strategy analytically under the uniform price mechanism and numerically under the proportional mechanism. Our findings provide insights on buyers' cooperation in purchase as well as the quantity discount schedule design when facing potential group purchase. We show that buyers achieve a higher surplus under these quantity-based group buying mechanisms compared with individual purchasing. However, the seller is not necessarily better off under the uniform price mechanism, as the total sales quantities may be lower under group buying. The proportional mechanism credits each buyer with a saving proportional to his purchasing quantity. This gives some buyers, especially larger ones, an incentive to make larger purchases, and sometimes results in a total quantity even higher than centralized purchasing. When buyers are homogeneous, the proportional mechanism is guaranteed to lead to a higher purchasing quantity than the uniform price mechanism, benefiting the seller. This higher quantity is usually accompanied by a higher buyer surplus, especially when the quantity does not exceed the centralized solution. Thus, the competition introduced by the proportional mechanism can help mitigate the inefficiency caused by decentralized decision-making under the uniform price mechanism. Given that group buying often occurs among buyers of similar sizes and interests, the proportional mechanism has great potential in practice. When group buying fails under either mechanism, we propose a VCG type, valuation based group buying mechanism initiated by a buyer, referred to as the initiator, who invites potential buyers, called the followers, to make a purchase with him in order to obtain a deeper quantity discount. Under this mechanism, referred to as the IF-VCG mechanism, the followers are promised with a VCG type payment and thus, will reveal their true valuations. We also investigate the current practice of group buying in China and Hong Kong, including personally making purchases through group buying. While lower prices are guaranteed for most goods and services, regular prices are maintained for hard to obtain items.

622510.label: Major findings and research outcome
622510.value: 1. Establishment of the existence and uniqueness of a Nash Equilibrium: By focusing on commonly used quadratic buyer valuation functions and a family of general quantity discount functions supported by empirical findings, we establish the existence of a Nash Equilibrium for both the uniform and proportional mechanisms. 2. Group buying (centralized purchasing, group buying under the uniform and proportional mechanisms) vs. individual purchasing: (1) It is obvious that, while centralized purchasing achieves the highest group surplus, it does not lead to higher surplus to all buyers in general. However, group buying under both mechanisms always results in higher buyer surplus and thus both mechanisms are stable. (2) Buyers may not necessarily benefit with more buyers joining the group under both mechanisms. (3) Group buying may result in lower purchasing quantities under the uniform mechanism, which happens when buyers have to purchase a large quantity to qualify for a low discount under individual purchasing and group buying allows them to scale back yet still enjoy the discounts. However, group buying will always lead to higher quantities under the proportional mechanism. 3. Comparisons among centralized purchasing, the uniform and proportional mechanism: The uniform mechanism always leads to lower purchasing quantities than centralized purchasing, resulting efficiency loss due to decentralized decision-making under the uniform mechanism. The proportional mechanism promotes competition and may lead to higher purchasing quantities than the uniform price mechanism, even higher than centralized purchasing when buyers are more homogeneous. In general, smaller buyers prefer the uniform mechanism and large buyers prefer the proportional mechanism. 4. Sellers' optimal discount schedule: It turns out that the seller does not necessarily prefer higher purchase quantities. When steepness is a decision variable, the seller will adjust the discount curve so that each buyer purchases less quantities when they form a group. Thus, quantity reduction is more likely to exist. 5. When quantity based mechanisms fail to result in group buying or attract enough buyers to fully take advantage of quantity discounts due to low buyer valuations, the IF-VCG group buying mechanism induces truthful revelation of the followers' valuation functions. With good information about others' valuations, the initiator can choose the right followers and claim a valuation function to ensure a positive expected surplus for himself. 6. To better understand how it works in these markets, the PI made several purchases on goods and services. Sometimes the sellers are able to maintain the same prices for hard to get items. While the quality for goods is in general guaranteed, the quality for services provided at the low prices varies tremendously.

622510.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
622510.value: The IF-VCG group buying mechanism is not very straightforward and requires more thoughts into a practicality and feasibility study. The initiate requires good information about other buyers' valuations which are not easy to obtain. Thus, we need to ask who should initiate such a group buying activity and how the initiators should be compensated. Furthermore, does the seller have an incentive to encourage such a group buying activity? We plan to look into these issues in the future.

622510.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
622510.value: When a seller offers quantity discounts, interested buyers may either self-organize or rely on a third party to aggregate their purchasing quantities to obtain lower prices, referred to as group buying. A group buying mechanism is a set of rules that determine the amount each buyer will purchase and the price each buyer will pay. In this project, we analyze and compare the outcomes of group buying given a seller's quantity discount schedule under both the uniform price (where buyers pay at the same unit price obtained by the group) and the proportional group buying mechanism (where buyers share group savings proportional to their purchasing quantities). Outcomes when buyers buy alone and under centralized purchasing are also presented. Finally, we study a seller's optimal discount schedule when buyers form groups. We believe that this is the first work that examines how buyer quantities are endogenously determined under various group buying mechanisms and compares the outcomes under individual, centralized, and group buying mechanisms.The results obtained are insightful and provide guidelines for sellers and buyers involved in group buying. There are several potential avenues for future research, including the seller's optimal pricing decision and buyers' strategic behavior when sub-coalition is possible.

622610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
622610.value: Piezoelectric ceramics have become preferred materials for a wide variety of electronic and mechatronic devices due to their pronounced piezoelectric, dielectric, and pyroelectric properties. However, piezoelectric ceramics are brittle and susceptible to cracking in all scales ranging from electric domains to devices. Due to the importance of the reliability of piezoelectric ceramic devices, piezoelectric fracture mechanics is being quickly developed. However, the role of Maxwell stresses and tractions in the fracture behaviors of piezoelectric materials is still unclear, which becomes a bottleneck problem and must be solved for the further development of piezoelectric fracture mechanics. Supported by RGC grants, we have been comprehensively investigating the fracture behaviors of piezoelectric ceramics and achieved great progress in both theoretical and experimental approaches. In the proposed research, we shall extend the developed theoretical and experimental approaches to study the role of Maxwell stresses and tractions in the fracture behaviors of piezoelectric materials. The proposed project aims at the development of piezoelectric fracture mechanics and at the establishment of failure criterions for electrically insulating cracks in piezoelectric materials under electrical and/or mechanical loading. We shall 1) theoretically analyze the role of Maxwell stresses and tractions in the fracture behaviors of piezoelectric materials; 2) experimentally conduct fracture tests on pre-notched (pre-cracked) piezoelectric ceramic and polymeric samples under mechanical and/or electrical loading with different Maxwell tractions; and 3) numerically simulate the fracture behaviors of piezoelectric materials with the consideration of Maxwell stresses and tractions. The outcomes of the project will advance the state-of-the-art of fracture mechanics and benefit the sensor, transducer, actuator, micromachine, and microelectronic industries. 由于压电陶瓷具有出色的压电、介电和热电性能，它们成了制备各种电子器件和机电设备的优选材料。然而，压电陶瓷极脆并易断裂，从微观电畴到宏观设备的各种尺度下都对断裂十分敏感。为了提高压电陶瓷材料、器件和设备的使用可靠性，压电断裂力学近年来有了很快的发展。但是，麦克斯韦尔牵引力在压电材料断裂行为中的作用仍然不太清楚，而它已成为了压电断裂力学进一步发展必须解决的瓶颈问题。在香港研究资助局的支持下，我们全面地研究了压电陶瓷的断裂行为,并且在理论和实验上都取得了巨大的进展。在这个研究相目中，我们将会扩展现有的理论和实验方法,来进一步研究麦克斯韦尔牵引力在压电材料断裂行为中的作用。本项目的宗旨在于进一步发展压电断裂力学，并且建立压电材料电绝缘裂纹在电力加载情况下的失效准则和判据。我们将：1）在理论上分析麦克斯韦尔牵引力在压电材料断裂行为中的作用；2）在实验上对有预裂纹样品在不同的麦克斯韦尔牵引力下进行断裂测试；和3）进行计算机模拟来计算麦克斯韦尔牵引力对压电材料的断裂行为的影响。 本研究项目的结果将会促进断裂力学和压电断裂力学的极大发展，并对传感器、转换器、促动器、微机器和微电子产业带来长远的利益。

622610.label: Major findings and research outcome
622610.value: With the financial support, we have conducted comprehensive research on the proposed project. 11 papers have been published including 9 journal papers and 2 book chapters. Two PG students have been trained including a MPhil student, who graduated, and a PhD student. The PI has been invited to deliver 6 times of invited, keynote and/or plenary lectures at national and international conferences on this research topic. We gave comprehensive comments on the self-consistent, energetically consistent, and electrostatic traction approaches. In the self-consistent approach, crack will not open if no mechanical load is applied. The energetically consistent approach under a given electric field yields a threshold stress for crack opening and a bifurcation stress, which is higher than the threshold stress. Between the bifurcation and threshold points there are two solutions for crack opening. Energy release rate is also comprehensively analyzed in each of the three approaches. (paper 1) Fracture under combined mechanical and electric loading is currently a hot research area in the global fracture community, while electric sticking is a major concern in the design and fabrication of micro/nanoelectromechanical systems. Our research proves that the two problems are switchable, depending on the loading conditions, sample geometries and material properties. A novel pre-cracked parallel-plate capacitor model was developed to analytically investigate the role of electrostatic tractions in fracture and electric sticking behaviors. A new fracture criterion was proposed based on the energy release rate and crack opening. A novel finite element method was also developed to calculate the electrostatic tractions. (papers 7, 10, 11) We developed phase field models to simulate the influence of dislocation walls on the domain configuration and polarization switching behavior of a ferroelectric single crystal. The coercive field can be reduced with enhanced remanent polarization if an appropriate density of dislocations is introduced at high temperature. We investigated also the domain pinning and depinning phenomena and the temperature induced unusual switching behavior in a ferroelectric single crystal with dislocation arrays. (papers 4, 5, 6) We provided overviews on the fracture of piezoelectric materials, the strip dielectric breakdown model, and the charge-free zone model for electrically conductive cracks in dielectric and piezoelectric ceramics. (papers 3, 8, 9) With Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy we measured surface electric potential distributions on the (001) surface in an indentation-pre-cracked BaTiO3 single crystal. The cracks are higher potential regions in comparison to other regions. (paper 2)

622610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
622610.value: Piezoelectric ceramics, which are important materials for a wide variety of applications in electronic, microelectronic, and mechatronic devices and micro/nanoelectromechanical systems, are brittle and susceptible to cracking. Because of the importance of the reliability of these devices, there has been tremendous interest in studying the fracture and failure behaviors of such materials. The traction-free (i.e., zero mechanical surface force) boundary condition has been commonly adopted in analyzing the fracture of piezoelectric ceramics, which ignores completely electrostatic tractions. However, induced charges appear along crack faces of an electrically insulating crack when the dielectric constant of the crack interior differs from that of the material, thereby producing electrostatic tractions along the crack faces. We have successfully solved the challenging coupling problem between mechanical and electrical fields. Our research proves that the two problems of fracture under combined mechanical and electric loading and electric sticking are switchable, depending on the loading conditions, sample geometries and material properties. The outputs from this project have significantly academic impact in the international fracture community and will find wide applications in the cut-edge technology industries.

622910.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
622910.value: The study of granular materials has been a subject of continuous interest across many disciplines of engineering and science, due to the ubiquitousness of these materials in our daily life and their importance. Collectively, under external loads, granular materials such as sands exhibit complex behavior involving anisotropy, dilatancy, pressure and density dependence, combined isotropic and kinematic hardening, and transitional solid-liquid state such as liquefaction. Meanwhile, it is recognized that the various macroscopic behaviors have their microscopic origins on the grain scale. Properties at the particle level, such as mean coordination number, the grain shape characteristics (i.e., grain form, roundness, sphericity and irregularity) and grain size distribution, inter-particle friction and rotation resistance, the granular fabric and its evolution with deformation, and the patterns of contact force transmission, all contribute to the overall complexity of granular materials. A comprehensive modeling framework based on full consideration of the micromechanical information of granular materials is desirable but is currently missing. This project aims to develop a novel theory based on statistical information at the grain level to describe the complex elasto-plastic behavior in granular materials. Particular emphasis is put on identifying the behavior of fabric anisotropy and its evolution in relation to the internal structure in a granular soil during complex loading conditions. Statistical laws useful for quantifying macroscopic state variables and model parameters will be extracted from a three-dimensional discrete element method that considers both inter-particle friction and rotation resistance, and will be verified and calibrated by experiments. A thermodynamically consistent elasto-plasticity framework will be formulated to accommodate the new granular theory with the above features. Finally, the proposed theory will be implemented in a displacement finite element and will then be used to simulate boundary value problems of practical importance. The theory so obtained will not only help to advance our understanding on granular materials, but also serve useful purposes in many industries and engineering areas, such as powder handling in pharmaceutical and chemical industries and hazard mitigation in civil engineering. Of particular importance to Hong Kong is the use of this new theory for the prediction and prevention of flow liquefaction and the associated instability and failure of earth structures, such as retaining walls, loose fill slopes, and soil embankments, which are commonly used in Hong Kong. 颗粒材料普遍存在且与我们的日常生活密切相关，其力学特性在各学科和工程领域一直是一个热门研究课题。颗粒材料（如砂土）在受到外荷载作用时会表现出各向异性、剪胀性、压力和密度依存性以及各向同性和移动硬化。在某些特殊情况下，甚至会发生从固相到液相的性态转化，如液化现象。研究表明，颗粒材料表现出的各种宏观力学特性有其在颗粒层面的微观根源。在颗粒层面的各种属性诸如平均接触点数、颗粒的形状特点（如颗粒的形状、圆度、球度和不规则性）、颗粒级配、颗粒间的摩擦和旋转阻力、组构及其随变形的演化和接触力的传播都影响到颗粒材料的复杂力学特性。因此，一个基于颗粒材料微观力学特性的本构模型框架非常必要，但迄今为止这方面尚缺乏令人满意的成果。 本项目试图建立一个新的基于颗粒接触信息的统计力学理论以描述颗粒材料的弹塑性变形特性。我们将重点研究如何识别与材料内部结构有关的组构各向异性及其随复杂加载过程的演化。使用可以考虑颗粒间摩擦和旋转阻力的三维离散元程序，我们将模拟和提取有用的统计信息以确定相关的宏观状态变量和模型参数，并最终建立一个基于热力学的弹塑性理论框架。本研究所提出的本构模型将被应用到有限元程序中去模拟一些实际的边界值问题。该新理论不仅能够促进我们对颗粒材料力学特性的理解，而且可以应用到很多工业和工程领域，如化工及制药业中药品与粉末处理以及土木工程的防灾减灾。鉴于土工结构、挡土墙、松散边坡和土石方堤坝在香港的大量使用，该理论可有效预测和防治与这些结构的失稳破坏及流动液化等相关重大灾害。

622910.label: Realisation of objectives
622910.value: The project has been successfully finished and all four objectives have been fully achieved. We have developed novel anisotropic critical state theory for granular media based on micromechanically-identified information on fabric and its evolution and implemented it into finite element method. Extensive micromechanical studies have been conducted to derive the signature of anisotropy and its relation with various characteristic states in sand. In particular, the unique nature of fabric anisotropy in critical state of sand has been for the first time identified. We further employed the FEM implementation of the elastoplastic model to simulate strain localisation in boundary value problems to see the interplay between fabric evolution and strain localisation. The research funding has further been applied to the design of reinforced soil structures and cemented sand structures wherein the role of fabric anisotropy is emphasised.

622910.label: Major findings and research outcome
622910.value: The major research findings from the study are summarised below: (1) The signature properties of shear-induced anisotropy in granular sand have been successfully identified based on extensive micromechanical studies and statistical granular mechanics. (2) Unique critical state characteristics in sand with full consideration of fabric anisotropy has been found baed on Discrete element method simulation. (3) The influence of pore fluid and particle shape have been carefully considered in micromechanics studies of granular sand towards full understanding of its behaviour. (4) Novel constitutive models have been developed in consideration of the unique anisotropic critical state property. (5) The developed model has been implemented in FEM (ABAQUS) for simulations of boundary value problems, wherein fabric and its evolution have been found playing a key role in dictating many interesting macro observations in sand. (6) The model has further been applied to engineering problems such as reinforced soil slope, cemented sand structure and hopper flow with the influence of fabric anisotropy being stressed. These research findings have been reported in a total of 9 papers published in top journals such as Geotechnique, Int. J. Numer. Analy. Meth. Geomech, Physical Review E, 3 book chapters and 7 papers published in prestigious international conferences. A full list can be found in Part C. A number of them have drawn good attentions in the community. For example, the paper published in Computers and Geotechnics in 2013 has received a total of 25 citations in Web of Science and 32 citations in Google scholar as of 20 Jan 2015.

622910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
622910.value: Potential further developments of the research may cover the following aspects: (1) A direct incorporation of DEM simulations into the calibration and verification of the proposed elastoplastic model. (2) An extensive comparison of the model performance with the results obtained by hierarchical mulitscale modelling based on coupled DEM and FEM simulations (3) A complete statistical granular mechanics theory that can explain both the quasi-static and dynamic behaviour of granular media. The above three future developments are indeed promising. Any of them is well deserved to be tackled with a future RGC/GRF project.

622910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
622910.value: This project has led to a novel plasticity theory based on statistical information at the grain level derived from advanced micromechanics approaches to describe the complex elasto-plastic behavior in granular materials. The unique role of fabric anisotropy and its evolution in relation to the internal structure in a granular soil during complex loading conditions and approaching the critical state have been identified. Statistical laws have been extracted to quantify the macroscopic state variables and model parameters from a micromechanics studies. A thermodynamically consistent elasto-plasticity framework has been formulated to accommodate the new granular theory and has been implemented in a displacement finite element to simulate boundary value problems in geotechnical engineering. The project yields not only important fundamental discoveries that help us to advance our understanding on granular materials, but also leads to a practical predictive tool for simulation of key industries and engineering processes, such as powder handling in pharmaceutical and chemical industries and hazard mitigation in civil engineering. The new theory will be helpful for the prediction and prevention of flow liquefaction and the associated instability and failure of earth structures, such as retaining walls, loose fill slopes, and soil embankments, which are commonly used in Hong Kong.

623010.label: Project Title(Chinese)
623010.value: 适用于纯甲醇运行直接甲醇燃料电池的集成微流体系统

623010.label: Project Objectives
623010.value: Develop a unique microfluidic-structured flow field for managing the delivery of neat methanol. This flow field will consist of plural nanosized circular flow pores. Taking advantage of the liquid methanol and gas CO2 two-phase counter flow, the unique fluidic structure will enable the formation of a liquid-gas meniscus in each pore. Driven by the chemical potential difference between the liquid methanol and gas, the liquid methanol can evaporate from the meniscus. The evaporation from the extremely small meniscus in each pore will lead to an extremely large interfacial mass-transfer resistance, creating a bottleneck of methanol delivery to the anode CL. Develop a membrane electrode assembly (MEA) for neat-methanol operation. The new MEA design will not only allow the MOR kinetics to be enhanced by synthesizing tri-metallic sub-nano catalysts, but it will also enable enhanced water recovery from the cathode by: i) increasing the hydrophilicity of the anode diffusion layer and CL; ii) forming a crack-free highly-hydrophobic cathode microporous layer with multi-wall carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs); and iii) forming a highly-hydrophobic cathode backing layer by decorating MWCNTs onto carbon foams. With the key components developed in the above tasks, we will devise an in-situ measurement system that will allow us to quantitatively characterize the concentration distributions of reactants, products, and possible intermediates formed during the MOR. Develop an advanced model that simulates methanol and water transport in the microfluidic DMFC with neat-methanol operation. The integrated model will consist of two sub-models: a pore-scale model to simulate methanol evaporation in the microfluidic flow field and a macro-homogeneous model to simulate the mass transport of the reactants and products in the MEA. With the results obtained by completing the foregoing tasks, we will optimize the integrated microfluidic passive DMFC so that both the specific energy and cell performance can be maximized under the conditions of a simple system design and compact size. This project is important not only because it addresses the fundamental mass transport phenomena in DMFCs operating with neat methanol that are different from those with diluted-methanol operations, but also because it represents a big step forward toward the commercialization of DMFC technology with applications in powering consumer electronic devices.

623010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
623010.value: 直接甲醇燃料电池（DMFC）的一个显著优点是储藏于液体燃料中的高能量密度（能量含量）。这个优势使得它特别适合作为便携和移动设备的电源。尽管如此，传统的DMFC必须使用极度稀释的甲醇溶液来限制甲醇渗透及其有害的后果。使用这样稀释的甲醇溶液不但导致了电源组能量密度的锐减从而限制了这类燃料电池的运行时间，而且还会降低它的性能和运行稳定性。这些劣势使得DMFC难以跟高级电池竞争。克服这些缺点的最终方法是让DMFC运行在纯甲醇工况。但是，直接供给纯甲醇而不提供水会从根本上改变燃料电池中反应物和产物的传质特性。也就是说，之前我们对传统DMFC在低甲醇浓度运行情况下获得的关于传质的理解变得不适用。对于给定的催化剂和电解质材料，第一个涉及纯甲醇运行的关键问题就是在给定电流密度的工况下，如何管理纯甲醇从流场板到催化层的传输使得由甲醇渗透和传质引起的电压损失最小。此外，由于在纯甲醇运行工况下水不提供在燃料盒里，第二关键问题是如何回收阴极反应产生的水来补充阳极甲醇氧化反应（MOR）所需的水。解决这两个关键问题不仅需要深化对燃料电池系统中传质的理解而且还需要一种新型的流体结构设计使得甲醇和水的传输得到妥善的管理。由于微流体技术能实现对流体在小尺度范围内的进行精确控制和操作，集成微流体技术的燃料电池系统是针对在纯甲醇运行工况下的甲醇供给和水回收问题的一种理想解决方案。因此，本项目的首要目标是了解在纯甲醇运行工况下反应物和产物的传质特性。这个目标将会通过本项目主张的创新设计实验和高级数值模拟技术来完成。同时，我们也会设计，加工，测试一个可以实现对进入阳极催化层的甲醇供给量进行管理的独创微流体结构流场板。并且我们还会优化膜电极组件（MEA）结构来强化水从阴极的回收以便于满足阳极MOR的需要。这个项目的重要性不仅体现在它是一个向崭新研究方向的转向和解决一些在DMFC中涉及基本物质传输现象的问题，而且它还代表着应用于便携和移动电子设备的DMFC商业化进程中的一个向前大迈步。完成本项目中提出的任务将会有助于在燃料电池尖端技术方面建立起本土专门知识和科学实践技术的储备。

623010.label: Realisation of objectives
623010.value: During the undertaking of this project, we have achieved much more than what was listed in the objectives. We have developed a unique microfluidic-structured flow field for managing the delivery of neat methanol. This flow field consists of plural nanosized circular flow pores. Taking advantage of the liquid methanol and gas CO2 two-phase counter flow, the unique fluidic structure enables the formation of a liquid-gas meniscus in each pore. Driven by the chemical potential difference between the liquid methanol and gas, the liquid methanol can evaporate from the meniscus. The evaporation from the extremely small meniscus in each pore will lead to an extremely large interfacial mass-transfer resistance, creating a bottleneck for methanol delivery to the anode CL. We have also developed a MEA for neat-methanol operation. The new MEA design not only allows the MOR kinetics to be enhanced by synthesizing tri-metallic sub-nano catalysts, but it also enables enhanced water recovery from the cathode by: i) increasing the hydrophilicity of the anode diffusion layer and CL; ii) forming a crack-free highly-hydrophobic cathode microporous layer with MWCNTs; and iii) forming a highly-hydrophobic cathode backing layer by decorating MWCNTs onto carbon foams. With the developed MEA, we have devised an in-situ measurement system that allows us to quantitatively characterize the concentration distributions of reactants, products, and possible intermediates formed during the MOR. In addition, we have developed an advanced model that simulates methanol and water transport in the microfluidic DMFC with neat-methanol operation. Based on the understandings of the foregoing tasks, we have optimized the integrated microfluidic passive DMFC so that both the specific energy and cell performance can be maximized under the conditions of a simple system design and compact size.

623010.label: Major findings and research outcome
623010.value: With the support of the present RGC grant, we have made significant contributions to the development of integrated microfluidic systems for direct methanol fuel cells operating with neat methanol. The results obtained in this project have been presented in 9 top-rated journal papers, as listed in Sections 8. The major findings are summarized as follows: We have developed a unique microfluidic-structured flow field for managing the delivery of neat methanol which consists of plural nanosized circular flow pores. We have developed a MEA for neat-methanol operation. The new MEA design not only allows the MOR kinetics to be enhanced by synthesizing tri-metallic sub-nano catalysts, but it also enables enhanced water recovery from the cathode. With the developed MEA, we have devised an in-situ measurement system that allows us to quantitatively characterize the concentration distributions of reactants, products, and possible intermediates formed during the MOR. We have developed an advanced model that simulates methanol and water transport in the microfluidic DMFC with neat-methanol operation. We have optimized the integrated microfluidic passive DMFC so that both the specific energy and cell performance can be maximized under the conditions of a simple system design and compact size.

623010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
623010.value: The present project has primarily focused on the development of integrated microfluidic systems for direct methanol fuel cells operating with neat methanol, with which the water and methanol transport in the microfluidic DMFC were experimentally and numerically studied. The outcome of this project have deepened our fundamental understanding of the water and methanol transport in the microfluidic DMFC and provided the needed information for the design of the microfluidic DMFC with applications in portable electronic devices.

623010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
623010.value: A growing number of portable consumer electronics demand small, lightweight power sources with high power density and energy capacity. Current battery technologies, even the most advanced Li-ion batteries, are unlikely to be able to meet the growing energy demands of a mobile workforce due to their low energy densities, creating a power-hungry problem. In this project, we developed integrated microfluidic systems for direct methanol fuel cells operating with neat methanol, with which the water and methanol transport in the microfluidic DMFC were experimentally and numerically studied. We have optimized the integrated microfluidic passive DMFC so that both the specific energy and cell performance can be maximized under the conditions of a simple system design and compact size. To provide a simple but robust tool for the design and optimization of the integrated microfluidic passive DMFC, we have also developed advanced theoretical models that simulates methanol and water transport in the microfluidic DMFC with neat-methanol operation. The air-breathing fuel cells with the developed integrated microfluidic systems in this project have shown promising applications in portable electronic devices.

640210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
640210.value: In the Chinese stock markets, many companies issue A shares, B shares and H shares targeted at different types of investors. In theory, since these different types of shares enjoy the same voting rights and dividend streams, their prices should be close to each others. However, what we have observed is that A shares are usually traded at higher prices than B and H shares. Before February 2001, B-shares were only available to foreign investors. After that, Chinese citizens were allowed to trade B-shares if they have the foreign currency required It is therefore interesting to observe the persistence of the A-share premium after the partial liberalization. Unlike previous studies that analyze either the cross-sectional or time-series variation of the A-share premium, this project takes a different approach in investigating the persistence of the A-share premium. We focus on a group of Chinese investors and examine their trading behavior after the B-share market was partially liberalized. We obtain information on their trading history, including the purchases and sales of individual companies (both A and B shares). We are therefore able to identify the investors who traded B shares in a given period as well as those who did not. The objective of our analysis is to examine why investors purchase A shares instead of B shares of the same firm, or vice versa. While we identify a number of explanatory variables, such as the A-share premium, portfolio composition of A and B shares, the availability of foreign currency, the risk and turnover measures in both markets, the key explanatory variables in our analysis are the prior investment experience of investors in the two markets. We conjecture that if investors hold or have traded A shares previously, they would be less inclined to purchase B shares even though B shares are cheaper than A shares. Furthermore, if investors have enjoyed good return performance from the A share portfolio, it is unlikely for them to switch to the B-share market. Our project will have implications for the importance of prior investment experience in affecting the decision to buy one type of securities over another. 一批中國企業在A股、B股和H股等不同的市場發行了股票。不同類型的投資者可以購買的股票類型是不同的。2001年之前，只有外資投資者可以買賣B股股票，此後，持有外匯的國內居民也可以參與到B股市場的交易中。相對於B股而言，A股市場存在溢價，為什麼會出現這種現象，並且市場自由化之後該溢價依然存在？為了更好的理解這個問題，我們搜集了一批A股和B股市場上的個人投資者的歷史交易資訊，基於此我們可以識別那些曾經購買過B股的投資者。我們試圖探究影響投資者購買同一家公司的A股還是B股的因素是什麼。我們的主要解釋變數是投資者在兩個市場上的投資經驗。我們猜想：如果某個投資者持有該公司的A股，或者至少之前交易過該公司的A股，那麼他購買同一家公司B股的概率就會變小。另外，如果投資者從A股市場上獲得了可觀的收益，那麼他們轉而投資B股的可能性也要下降。

640210.label: Major findings and research outcome
640210.value: The opening of the B-share market in mainland China in 2001 gives us a natural experiment to investigate the effect of experience on trading A versus B shares. In China, A- and B shares are issued by the same firms and share the same cash flow rights and control rights. The trading arrangement for them is also very similar. However, there has been greater demand for A-shares from domestic investors than from foreign investors, which has caused the A-shares to trade at a premium relative to B shares. Before 2001, domestic investors could only trade in the A-share market, and foreign investors could only trade in the B-share market. In February 2001, the Chinese government allowed domestic residents to invest in B shares, provided that they have the foreign currencies needed (either United States dollars for B shares traded on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, or Hong Kong dollars for B shares traded on Shenzhen Stock Exchange). Given that A- and B shares are very similar, the learning cost in switching from A-shares to B-shares should be minimal. Therefore, we can examine under the almost non-existence of learning cost, whether personal experience leads to portfolio inertia and if so, how it affects their trading performance. We do find that investors are reluctant to switch to the B-share market. Based on the brokerage account data from the 2001-2005 period, we find that among more than 20,000 investors who traded stocks before February 2001, only less than 4% purchased B-shares and B-shares continued to trade at a huge discount relative to A-shares. This is consistent with the view that investors exhibit portfolio inertia and they are not responsive enough to the change of the investment opportunity. Consistent with portfolio inertia behavior, we find strong evidence that investors’ market-specific experiences affect their future purchase decision, with more A (B) share market experience leading to more future purchases in A (B) shares. Furthermore, investors respond to variables related to the expected return and trading costs, such as A/B share premium (the price gap between A- and B-shares) and liquidity. An increase in the A/B premium increases the propensity of investors to purchase B-shares over A-shares. In addition, an improvement in A-share (B-share) liquidity increases the propensity to purchase A (B) shares. This finding is consistent with investor rationality, as investors will take advantage of price differentials between the two markets and they care about liquidity.

640210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
640210.value: It is widely documented that investors have limited attention. As a result, overweighting of personal experience may lead investors to allocate too much attention on the assets that they traded before, and too little to the other assets. During the opening of the B-share market in mainland China in 2001, we do find that investors are reluctant to switch to the B-share market. We find that investors exhibit portfolio inertia and they are not responsive enough to the change of the investment opportunity. Basically, they are more likely to buy A-shares if they have more prior experience in the A-share market, and more likely to buy B-shares if they have more prior experience in the B-share market. While portfolio inertia might be irrational, we do find investors respond to variables related to the expected return and trading costs, such as A/B share premium (the price gap between A- and B-shares) and liquidity. These findings are consistent with investor rationality, as investors will take advantage of price differentials between the two markets and they care about liquidity.

640310.label: Project Title(Chinese)
640310.value: 旅居者的生活適應研究：既有信念理論的應用與驗證

640310.label: Project Objectives
640310.value: To introduce a well-established theoretical framework, lay theory perspective, in understanding sojourner adjustment. To introduce diverse methodology and research designs to the study of sojourner adjustment. To build on the lay theory approach to examine how to improve sojourners’ cultural adjustment.
rows: To introduce a well-established theoretical framework, lay theory perspective, in understanding sojourner adjustment.
To introduce diverse methodology and research designs to the study of sojourner adjustment.
To build on the lay theory approach to examine how to improve sojourners’ cultural adjustment.

640310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
640310.value: As globalization accelerates, the number of people leaving their country of origin and residing in a foreign country for educational or work purposes has increased drastically. Research examining the cultural adjustment of these sojourners has flourished in the last few decades. Most of the existing studies have contributed significantly to our understanding of cultural adjustment by investigating how individual characteristics, environmental factors, and the combination of both influence sojourner adjustment outcomes. These studies generally reveal that individuals’ subjective perception of their cultural environment significantly impacts their adjustment; however, little is known about why sojourners perceive and experience the same culture in different ways-—so different that it could lead to varying adjustment outcomes given the same culture. Furthermore, the question of whether sojourners’ subjective perception of cultural differences can be altered to enhance cultural adjustment has also remained relatively unexplored. The current research aims to bridge this knowledge gap by examining cultural adjustment from an established theoretical framework—-the lay theory perspective to culture. The lay theory perspective posits that, like scientists, lay people formulate theories (beliefs) about people and about their social world to structure their experiences. These theories set up a mindset through which individuals interpret their environment. Although individuals are often not consciously aware of how their theories influence their thoughts, feelings, and behaviors, our research on lay theories of culture has consistently shown that these theories color individuals’ interpretation of their social environment. As a result, people often perceive and experience the same culture very differently. Past research has demonstrated that when navigating a culturally diverse environment, individuals’ theories about culture can have profound impact on their personal and interpersonal outcomes. The current proposal aims to expand this theoretical perspective to bridge the knowledge gap in cultural adjustment research. Aside from contributing to the cultural adjustment literature theoretically, this proposal also contributes methodologically by introducing diverse methodological approaches and research designs to understand cultural adjustment, and by investigating the generalizability of the proposed research framework to different sojourner populations across intercultural contexts. More importantly, the proposed research also has important practical implications for understanding how to prepare sojourners for their cross-cultural experiences and how to enhance their cultural adjustment outcomes. 全球化的社會環境下，愈來愈多人離開自己的家鄉到異地讀書或工作。過去幾十年來也有很多關於旅居者如何適應異地文化的研究，目前大多數的研究是關於旅居者的個人特質、環境，及個人與環境等因素影響他們對異地生活的適應。這些研究結果發現他們對新環境及文化的主觀看法影響著他們對環境的適應，然而，很少研究探索為何不同的旅居者對同一環境有不同的看法，和為何持不同看法的旅居者在同一地方有不同的適應結果。此外，對於能否改變旅居者的主觀看法去幫助他們適應新環境的問題也未有研究探討，所以本研究是填補這方面知識上的空白。本研究將會採用一個已經建立的理論框架──既有信念理論，去了解旅居者對異地生活的適應。 既有信念理論指出，每個人都如科學家一樣，有自己的一套理論，事實上這套理論就是個人的價值信念，這些信念影響他們如何理解世界所發生的事。雖然人們不易發覺這些信念如何影響自己的思想、情感及行為，然而，很多研究指出這些信念會影響他們對外在事物的理解，所以人們常對同一環境有不同的看法。曾有研究指出當人們於新的文化及社會環境中生活，既有的信念對自己的行為和人際互動有很大的影響，所以本研究將以既有信念理論作為框架，伸延到旅居者對生活環境的適應。 本研究除了對文化適應有理論性的貢獻外，也將在方法論方面有所貢獻。本研究將會用不同的方法和研究設計去了解文化適應，和研究個人信念的差異對旅居者在不同文化環境下的不同的影響。更重要的是本研究的實用價值，本研究可作為旅居者適應異地生活的參考依據，助他們作好適應異地文化的準備。

640310.label: Realisation of objectives
640310.value: We have achieved the three objectives stated above by demonstrating the relationship between lay theories about social group (e.g., racial group, ethnic group) and individuals’ adjustment experiences in the face of diversity. Essentialist theory is the lay beliefs that each social group possesses immutable essences that are indicative of the group members’ ability and traits. Through a series of lab experiments and field survey studies, we have shown that essentialist theory influence individuals’ categorization tendency, cognitive flexibility, judgment biases, subjective adjustment experiences, and cultural intelligence development in intercultural contexts. Across five lab experiments, we first established how essentialist theory increases individuals’ tendency to engage in racial categorization process (Chao, Hong, & Chiu, 2013). Such categorization mindset had important implications to individuals’ cognitive style and social judgment. Specifically, the results from a survey study and three lab experiments revealed that endorsement of essentialist theory could result in cognitive rigidity, leading individuals to become more closed-minded. Closed-mindedness in turn incased individuals’ reliance on existing cultural stereotypes and hinders their out-of-the-box thinking ability (Tadmor, Chao, Hong, & Polzer, 2013). Cognitive rigidity resulted from essentialist thinking has important implications to individuals’ cultural experiences. In a longitudinal study among exchange students and a cross-section survey among Western expatriates living in Beijing, we have demonstrated that endorsement of essentialist beliefs lowered individuals’ adjustment to foreign cultures and hindered their cultural intelligence development (Chao, Takeuchi, Farh, Zhang, & Hong, under review). All these papers together introduce the lay theory perspective to advance our understanding of individuals’ adjustment experiences in a culturally diverse environment (Objective 1). They introduce diverse methodologies and research designs to understand individuals’ intercultural experiences (Objective 2). By unveiling the psychological mechanisms through which essentialist theory influence individuals’ cultural experiences, it also enables us to understand how to improve sojourners’ adjustment experiences (Objective 3). This program of research has received recognitions from the academic community and has also drawn media attention. Findings of some of the studies are not only published in academic journals, but are also disseminated through news reports, presentations, and invited talks in international conferences (see Part C).

640310.value: As stated in the previous section, we first established the impacts of essentialist theory on racial categorization process (Chao, Hong, & Chiu, 2013). Such categorization mindset had important implications to individuals’ cognitive style and social judgment in the face of diversity. Specifically, we found that endorsement of essentialist theory could result in cognitive rigidity, leading individuals to become more closed-minded. In a longitudinal study among exchange students and a cross-section survey among Western expatriates living in Beijing, we have demonstrated that endorsement of essentialist beliefs lowered individuals’ adjustment to foreign cultures and hindered their cultural intelligence development (Chao, Takeuchi, Farh, Zhang, & Hong, under review). Findings of this program of research has been published or under review in academic journals, such as Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, Psychological Science, Journal of Applied Psychology, and Asian Journal of Social Psychology. They have also been presented at international conferences, such as the Society of Personality and Social Psychology and Academy of Management. The PI has also been invited to present the research work at conferences, including International Academy of Intercultural Research and Asian Association of Social Psychology. In addition, the PI disseminated the research findings to the general public and business community through the HKUST Business Insights Presentation Series. Findings of some of the studies have also received media attention in the US, UK, as well as Israel, such as Boston Globe, Science Daily, Psychology Today, Huffington Post, and No Camels. Israeli Innovation News. The project also provided training opportunities to two undergraduate students, Chengdong Pi and Jiong Ye, who are both finalists of the Mr. Armin and Mrs. Lillian Kitchell Undergraduate Research Awards. Another undergraduate student, Ning Shi is involved in conducting studies to extend the idea of the project to understand the cultural experiences of rural migrants living in urban cities in Mainland China. As an offshoot of this project, the PI has also presented a paper in a symposium at the Academy of Management that investigates the implications of essentialist theory on cross-cultural negotiation. The project is conducted in collaboration with a graduate student, Jingdan (Donna) Yao. We are in the process of writing this paper for submission to Journal of Applied Psychology.

640310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
640310.value: Our research has demonstrated that the beliefs and assumptions held by lay people (e.g., essentialist theory) can shape their social psychological experiences in a culturally diverse environment. This research focuses on intergroup contacts across racial and ethnic boundaries, and has important implications to individuals navigating in the increasingly globalized world. As mentioned above, besides the published papers, we also have a paper under review and another one in preparation. We aim to publish the remaining papers to further disseminate the results. In terms of future research directions, recent reports have suggested that approximately 230 million rural migrant workers currently reside in urban cities in Mainland China (China Daily, 2012), with an additional 10 million workers moving from countryside into the urban cities every year. The movement of rural migrant workers within this one country is no less extensive than the movement of the 215 million people who live in different countries all over the world (Migration Policy Institute, 2010). An important extension of this research would be to investigate how lay theory about social class boundary (e.g., rural vs. urban; rich vs. poor) influence individuals’ psychosocial functioning. Findings of this study could have important implications to social policy and practices.

640310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
640310.value: As our society is becoming increasingly diverse, it is not uncommon for us to be exposed to people from diverse ethnocultural background in our daily life. The current research investigates how individuals might construe and experience their multicultural world differently from an essentialist theory perspective. Essentialist theory refers to the beliefs that social categories, such as racial or cultural groups, possess immutable qualities that determine the abilities and traits of its group members. These beliefs are unspoken assumptions that are fundamental to the sense-making process. This project unveils the effects of essentialist beliefs on individuals’ ability in functioning effectively in culturally diverse contexts. Specifically, we found that endorsement of essentialist theory could result in cognitive rigidity, leading individuals to become more closed-minded, lowering individuals’ adjustment to foreign cultures and hindering the development of their cultural intelligence.

640410.label: Project Title(Chinese)
640410.value: 家族企業的透明度和融資選擇

640410.label: Project Objectives
640410.value: To examine how corporate transparency is different between family and non-family firms, and how that is related to their financing choices. We will also present a theoretical model to show how family and non-family firms’ choices regarding disclosure trade off private benefits of control and costs of external finance.
rows: To examine how corporate transparency is different between family and non-family firms, and how that is related to their financing choices.
We will also present a theoretical model to show how family and non-family firms’ choices regarding disclosure trade off private benefits of control and costs of external finance.

640410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
640410.value: Family firms are ubiquitous almost in every industrial economy. In the U.S., family firms represent 35.4% of companies in the S&P 500 and around 45% of the largest two thousand industrial firms(Anderson and Reeb, 2003a; Anderson et al., 2009). A growing literature is addressing how family-controlled firms differ from non-family publicly traded firms in terms of performance, governance and disclosure, and to a more limited extent, on financing policies (see Anderson et al, 2003a, 2003b; Villalonga and Amit, 2006 for example). In this study, we will examine how corporate transparency and financing choices differ for family and non-family firms in the S&P 1500 Index. We first predict that corporate transparency is higher for both family and non-family firms when they belong to the S&P 500 index as opposed to the S&P Midcap and S&P Smallcap indices, but the difference is expected to be larger for family firms. In other words, we expect that family firms are more transparent than non-family firms when they are listed in the S&P 500, while they are more opaque when they are outside S&P 500. We argue that this phenomenon can be explained by control benefits and financing decisions. We will develop a theoretical model to capture the idea that family firms trade off the benefits of control over corporate resources (private benefits or benefits of control) and the costs of external finance when they choose their disclosure policy and transparency. Family firms in the S&P 500 are expected to have many projects for which external finance is needed. Thus, these firms are likely to lower the cost of external finance by becoming more transparent and giving up the benefits of control. On the other hand, smaller family firms may value the benefits of control more as their funding needs are more limited, and therefore may remain more opaque. Non-family firms, on the other hand, have less potential to enjoy private benefits and thus do not trade off transparency for financing, whether they belong to the S&P 500 or not. We will examine how disclosure policies relate to different financing choices for large and small family firms as compared to non-family firms. Specifically, we will consider how debt ratio and debt maturity vary across family and non-family firms. We expect that family firms that remain opaque rely more on debt financing, and especially short-term debt, than family firms that are transparent, and non-family firms. 家族企業是無處不在，幾乎每一個工業經濟。在美國，家族企業代表 35.4%的標準普爾 500指數和45％左右的最大2000餘家工業企業（Anderson and Reeb，2003，Anderson et al，2009）。許多研究討論如何解決家族控制的公司不同於非家族公開 在計算上市公司的業績，治理和信息披露，但家族企業融資政策研究非常罕見（見Anderson et al. 2003年a，2003b; Villalonga and Amit, 2006年）。 在這項研究中，我們會研究家族企業在標準普爾1500指數如何選擇融資和公司的透明度。首先，我們預測，當家庭和非家族企業都屬於標準普爾500指數,他們的企業透明度相對於標準普爾中型股和標準普爾小型股指數較高的。 但不同的是家族企業企業透明度更高。換言之，我們預期家庭公司在標準普爾500指數比非家族企業透明度更高。而他們在標準普爾 500指數之外卻更不透明。 我們認為這現象可以使用控制權收益與融資決策解釋。我們會發展理論模型來獲得解釋。家族企業的利益權衡企業資源的控制權（私人利益或利益的控制)和外部融資費用後，他們選擇披露政策和透明度。家庭公司在S＆P 500指數預計需要許多外部資金。此，這些公司很可能為了降低對外部資金的成本增加透明度和放棄控制竊取的好處。另一方面，較小的家族企業可能會保持更加不透明增加控制的好處更因為他們的資金需要 有限。非家族企業無論他們屬於標準普爾 500或不是，一方面，較少有可能享受私人利益，權衡籌集經費後選擇不透明。 我們會研究披露政策如何涉及到不同的融資選擇。具體來說，家族企業保持不透明將會更多依賴於債務融資，特別是短期債務。

640410.label: Realisation of objectives
640410.value: We consider our final study has successfully addressed the objectives stated in the original proposal. Specifically, our study first investigates how different agency problems across family and non-family firms affect their choices of corporate transparency. Next, we examine how family firms' choice of corporate transparency affect their capital structure and debt maturity. In particular, we consider whether corporate transparency have stronger impacts on capital structure for family firms than for non-family firms due to higher expropriation risks associated with family owners. With respect to the second objective as per original proposal, we also developed a theoretical model to demonstrate how different corporate transparency across family and non-family firms affect their capital structure. However, when we submitted our study to Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, the referee requires us to significantly shorten the theoretical component and focus on the empirical parts as stated in the first objective. As such, our final study simply state propositions from the theoretical model in the hypothesis development and do not present the complete derivation of the model. Nonetheless, even without the mathematical illustration of the model, we are able to describe the theoretical predictions as two detailed hypotheses, so it would not compromise the significance of our study. Moreover, as required by the referee, our final study has incorporated some new scopes that is not included in the original proposal. For example, we attribute a significant portion of our study to deal with the potential endogeneity associated with corporate transparency and family firm status. Specifically, we employ an array of econometric methodologies such as propensity-score-matching, fixed- or random-effect model to solve endogeneity concerns. We consider this as an important contribution of our study in that both the editor and the referee commend our contribution in terms of econometric solidity. To conclude, we conduct our study to closely follow the original objectives and revise it whenever necessary in order to accommodate the issues raised during the journal reviewing process. Finally, we also introduce new angles beyond the original proposal to enrich the contribution of this paper.
