661610.label: Major findings and research outcome
661610.value: 1) Results of field observation in the Port Shelter showed that the initiation of Noctiluca bloom was due to suitable water temperature and a rich supply of phytoplankton, especially diatoms. Growth rates of Noctiluca in microcosm without disturbance of physical processes, i.e. current, wind and tide, explained ~44% of its in situ population density change, indicating that rich food supply is necessary for Noctiluca to reproduce rapidly, but hydrographical and meteorological controls play a more important part for the spatial and temporal variability of Noctiluca abundance in Port Shelter. ( Spatial and temporal dynamics of Noctiluca scintillans in Port Shelter, in preparation) 2) Prey selection by N. scintillans using mono algal preys of different size and taxonomy showed that taxon-based prey differences greatly outweighed sized-based differences in determining the clearance rate and growth rate of N. scintillans. Size limit for prey capture was not apparent. Among 10 phytoplankton species, diatoms, especially centric diatoms supported higher growth rate than dinoflagellates and chlorophytes. 3) Noctiluca did not ingest more heterotrophic prey to meet its high N requirement, nor did it grow better on mixed diets. Noctiluca did not grow better on mixed diets, but addition of diatoms - its favorite prey - would increase the food quality of mono-dinoflagellate diets and hence growth rate. This study reflects the differences in the suitability of various phytoplankton species as food for N. scintillans and further confirms that diatoms are highly preferred by Noctiluca. (Differential grazing by Noctiluca scintillans in mixed diets, in preparation) 4) N. scintillans generally exhibited higher maximal ingestion rate on suboptimal food concentration, presumably to maximize its nutrient pool and meet growth requirement. However, no compensatory feeding occurred at low food concentration, indicating that meeting metabolic requirement is more important when carbon content is in shortage. P-limitation exhibited stronger negative effect than N-limitation on Noctiluca. Regarding the nutrient requirement of N. scintillans, polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), e.g. ALA (18:3ω3) and EPA (20:5ω3) are of primary importance in determining its feeding habit, while bulk P content is the major constraint affecting its survival under suboptimal conditions. Secondary metabolites, such as resource-driven toxicity, would interact with the effects of EFA and P in determining overall food quality. (Diet nutritional quality on the growth and grazing of Noctiluca scintillans, in revision) Manuscripts based on the results of this study are still being prepared, and at least three more papers will be published.

661610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
661610.value: We are already conducting research further developed from this project. For example, we used peptidomics approach in a first attempt to investigate the peptides regenerated by N.scintillans for food digestion by using our modified methods for peptides extraction and identification. Approximate 200 unique peptides are identified, even when there are not much gene and protein information for Noctiluca and other dinoflagellate species in the public database. The functional annotation of precursor proteins and the size distribution of peptides from two bloom phases indicated that the community structure and the nutrient conditions of preys might have possible effect on the development of N.scintillans bloom. This is the first step in our endeavor to explore the relationship among N.scintillans protein/peptides size, food protein resources and reproduction. To discover more peptides related to food digestion and regulation on grazing in N.scintillans, we plan to develop transcriptomic or genomic studies in future.

661610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
661610.value: Noctiluca scintillans, a large heterotrophic dinoflagellate, is the most frequently occurring red tide species in Hong Kong, particularly in the eastern and northeastern waters during winter. Voracious feeding activity on a wide range of food types is suggested to be an important ecological advantage for Noctiluca. The goal of this study is to find the answer why it blooms every year during late fall to early spring in the eastern waters of Hong Kong. Based on field investigation and laboratory experiments, we conclude that both biological and physical factors contributed to this phenomenon. Relatively high nutrient supply during the period of northeast monsoon results in high density of diatoms - the favorite food for Noctiluca. Our results show that Noctiluca can grow faster in diatom diet and addition of heterotrophic prey does not enhance its growth. Further more, we found that Noctiluca increase its ingestion rate on suboptimal food concentration to maximize its nutrient pool and meet growth requirement, and P-limitation exhibited stronger negative effect than N-limitation on Noctiluca. Our study also reveals that Noctiluca is a major nutrient regenerator, especially in ammonia through excretion and cell death because its high ammonium content in its vacuoles. In addition to biological factors, hydrographical and meteorological processes, such as current, wind and tide, play important roles for the spatial and temporal variability of Noctiluca abundance in the eastern waters of Hong Kong. Findings from this study help us to better understand the mechanisms of the formation of Noctiluca red tides in the Hong Kong coastal waters, which will help the government to better manage Hong Kong's coastal environment.

662610.label: Project Title(Chinese)
662610.value: 天然饵料和人工饲料金属对海水鱼类毒性的比较

662610.label: Project Objectives
662610.value: To contrast the metal toxicity to marine fish from naturally contaminated diets and artificial diets, and from aqueous and dietary sources. To understand the subcellular/biochemical mechanisms underlying the dietary toxicity of metals to marine fish. To understand the chronic toxicity of low levels of methylmercury to fish diets on marine fish using fish farms as the experimental system. To perform environmental risk assessments of metals in farmed marine fish.

To understand the subcellular/biochemical mechanisms underlying the dietary toxicity of metals to marine fish.
To understand the chronic toxicity of low levels of methylmercury to fish diets on marine fish using fish farms as the experimental system.
To perform environmental risk assessments of metals in farmed marine fish.

662610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
662610.value: Over the last decade, many studies have shown that trophic transfer is the predominant route for metal accumulation in many marine animals, including fish. The dietary toxicity of metals therefore needs to be seriously addressed. There is, however, a lack of comprehensive studies to this end, mainly due to the many challenges facing the defensible designs of realistic experiments, including the selection of appropriate prey. Dietary toxicity is an even more pressing issue in the farming of marine fish which may feed contaminated diets. China is now the world's biggest fish farming country, and commercial fish diets supplemented with flavor additives often contain very high toxic metal concentrations. However, the accumulation and toxicity of metals associated with these fish feeds remain essentially unknown. In this proposal, we intend to understand the dietary toxicity of metals in marine fish by taking advantage of both fish farming and contaminated marine ecosystems, with specific objectives to 1) contrast metal toxicity to marine fish between naturally contaminated diets and artificial diets, and from aqueous and dietary sources; 2) understand the subcellular/biochemical mechanisms underlying the dietary toxicity of metals to marine fish; 3) understand the chronic toxicity of low levels of methylmercury in fish diets to marine fish using fish farms as experimental systems; and 4) perform environmental risk assessments of metals in farmed marine fish to human consumers. The simultaneous investigation of a combination of both naturally metal-contaminated prey (collected from two of the most contaminated estuaries/coastal systems of modern times) and artificial feeds is one of the strengths of this proposed research. We expect that this project will lead to major conclusions with wide general application and significance about the dietary toxicity of metals in marine fish. The data will be instrumental for our further understanding of toxic metal effects on coastal ecosystems as well as for the delivery of safe seafood. 过去十年的研究表明,在许多海洋动物如海水鱼类中，食物链传递为金属在生物体内累积的主要途径。因此，人们必须充分重视食物相金属的毒性。但是，以此为目的设计具有现实意义的实验常常面临着重重困难（例如选择合适的生物饵料），从而导致了系统性综合研究的缺乏。作为全球最大的渔业国家，中国的海水鱼养殖常常存在着饲料金属污染的问题。例如，商业饲料常常混有富含高浓度金属的香味添加剂以改善产品的口感。然而，人们对饵料中金属在鱼体内累积过程及其毒性的认识少之又少。因此，在该项目中我们计划研究鱼类养殖过程和污染海洋生态系统中食物相金属对海水鱼的毒性，具体的目标包括1）比较天然污染饵料/人工饲料以及水相/食物相金属毒性的差异；2）发掘食物相金属对海水鱼产生毒性的亚细胞及生化水平机制；3）探讨饵料中低浓度甲基汞对海水鱼的长期毒性。我们期望该项研究能够就食物相金属对海水鱼的毒性问题得出普适性的重要结论。这些数据可以帮助我们了解金属在海岸生态系统的毒性效应以及保护海食品安全。

662610.label: Realisation of objectives
662610.value: Overall, we have succeeded all the research objectives in this project, specifically: Objective 1. To contrast differences in metal toxicity from naturally metal-contaminated diets and artificial diets, and from aqueous and dietary sources. We compared the bioaccumulation and toxicity of metals associated with different fish feeds (naturally metal-contaminated and artificial contaminated) in marine fish. The fish were exposed to waterborne metals with well-controlled daily dosages, and the accumulation as well as the tissue distribution of these metals were quantified. Toxicity of dietborne metals were assessed based on several biochemical and physiological biomarkers in the fish. One unique aspect of this project was that we worked on natural contaminated prey from an UK estuary and identified the metals responsible for metal toxicity in fish. We also compared the toxicities of aqueous and dietary metals to the marine fish. Objective 2: To understand the subcellular/biochemical mechanisms underlying the dietary toxicity of metals. In this project, we took the advantages of collecting the naturally available metal-contaminated prey to test whether a specific subcellular pool of accumulated metal in the prey was correlated directly to trophic bioavailability and subsequent toxicity to the fish. The naturally metal-contaminated prey were collected from the contaminated systems, and then subjected to differential centrifugation methodology to isolate the different subcellular pools (cellular debris, metal-rich granules, organelles, metallothionein-like proteins, heat denatured proteins). Purified fractions were then either fed to the fish individually, or combined (for example, TAM) and the subcellular controls were tested for these fractions. Objective 3: To understand the chronic toxicity of low levels of methylmercury in fish diets to marine fish. In this study, we specifically worked on one important metal, namely, methylmercury. We examined the long-term accumulation and toxicity of low levels of methylmercury in marine fish from dietary sources. The fish were exposed to methylmercury for different periods and its accumulation, transport, and subcellular distribution as well as toxicity were quantified. Objective 4: To perform environmental risk assessments of metals in farmed fish We further studied the ecotoxicological implications of metal contamination in marine fish to human consumers by using the in vitro gastrointestinal extraction method to quantify the bioaccessible toxic metals (or oral bioavailability) from fish tissues after metal dietary exposure. We examined both whole soft tissues of fish or different subcellular fractions (and with different metal concentrations) using the in vitro gastrointestinal method. This method quantifies the maximum bioaccessibility of toxic metals taken up.

662610.label: Major findings and research outcome
662610.value: Overall, a large body of work is involved in this project, as shown by many publications in esteemed international journals (a total of 21), Main results are summarized below: Incorporating exposure will allow aquatic toxicology to be placed in a context of environmental relevance (Wang 2011, Pan and Wang 2012, Wang 2013a). We found that difference in metal doses rather than subcellular metal distributions was the cause of fish mortality difference. This study provides a step towards exploring the underlying mechanism of dietary toxicity (Dang et al. 2012 AT, Wang 2013b). We demonstrated that the two exposure pathways may be merged into a common framework by expressing the results in terms of influx rate (Dang et al. 2012 ES&T). Dietary uptake was the primary route for As bioaccumulation in fish and As(V) has a low bioavailability to marine fish (Zhang et al. 2012a, Lu et al. 2012). We investigated how the subcellular distribution and metal burden in prey affected the transfer of metals to marine fish. All the subcellular fractions were bioavailable to the fish (Guo et al. 2013). Inorganic As(III) and As(V) were rapidly biotransformed to the less toxic arsenobetaine and As(V) had little toxicity on marine fish (Zhang et al. 2012b). We also showed the differential roles of MTLPs in Cd uptake and elimination in the bivalves (Liu and Wang 2011, Pan and Wang 2012), as well as in Zn toxicity (Liu et al. 2013). We investigated the concentration and distribution of total mercury and methylmercury in different subcellular fractions in the marine fish. Hg bound with metal-sensitive fraction was small, thus Hg may have little toxicity to the fish. We showed that MTLP fraction had the highest % of total Hg as MeHg (88-91%) among all the subcellular fractions (Onsanit and Wang 2011, Wang 2012). We demonstrated that the bivalves displayed different patterns of Hg accumulation (Pan and Wang 2011). We also showed that metal contamination in commercial fish diet was probably underestimated in fish aquaculture (Wang et al. 2012). We conducted the bioaccessibility of methylmercury (MeHg) in marine fish. MeHg bioaccessibility in marine fish ranged from 16.0% to 67.7%. The bioaccessibilities of both MeHg and inorganic mercury were independent of the total Hg concentration and the exposure route, but was negatively correlated with MeHg in metal-rich granule fraction and the trophically available fraction. We demonstrated the important control of subcellular distribution in MeHg bioaccessibility (He and Wang 2011).

662610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
662610.value: Our study has significant implication for further research. Over the last decade, many studies have shown that trophic transfer is the predominant route for metal accumulation in many marine animals, including fish. The dietary toxicity of metals therefore needs to be seriously addressed. This is an even more pressing issue in the farming of marine fish which may use contaminated diets. China is now the biggest fishery agriculture country in the world, and commercial fish diets supplemented with flavor additives often contain very high toxic metal concentrations. In addition, many estuaries and coastal waters are now contaminated with metals due to industrial development. The contamination of preys with metals may present potential dietary toxicity to marine fish. There is thus a great need to study the toxicity of both naturally metal-contaminated prey and artificial feeds. This is especially a challenge for field environment since multiple metal contamination is common. Therefore, metal mixture should be further studied in the future. A large scale screening testing of different artificial feeds is required. Finally, much more mechanistic studies are required, such as the development of ‘flux’ as an indicator of metal toxicity, and the physiological and biochemical mechanisms underlying metal toxicity.

662610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
662610.value: Increasing evidence indicates that trophic transfer is the predominant route for metal accumulation in marine fish. Traditional toxicity testing based on dissolved metals may fail to protect marine ecosystems if trophic transfer is the major source for metal accumulation. Metal toxicity may be far more reaching than typically predicted based on dissolved metal exposure. Environmental regulators need to re-address the issue of water quality criteria for metals by incorporating the toxicity of metals associated with diet. An understanding of the metal toxicity associated with trophic transfer is thus imperative. Dietary toxicity is an even more pressing issue in the fish farming which may use contaminated diets. Currently, there is an increasing concern for seafood safety due to contamination from chemicals such as metals. Thus, there is an urgent need to understand the processes leading to toxic metal accumulation in important marine cultured species of fish. Without a complete understanding of metal accumulation and toxicity from dietborne sources, it goes without saying that is impossible to conduct realistic environmental risk assessments for the human consumption of farmed fish. Such study has significant implications for environmental risk assessments of metals in marine food chains and seafood safety assessment for human consumers.

662710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
662710.value: Liprin-α functions as a master scaffold protein for proper presynaptic functions, such as presynaptic maturation and neurotransmitter releases, by recruiting various synaptic proteins to the active zones at the presynaptic termini. The presynaptic functions of liprin-α are primarily mediated by its three sterile-alpha-motif (SAM) domains, which are responsible for linking liprin-α to the essential MALS/CASK/Mint-1 ternary complex by interacting with the CaM kinase domain of CASK and to a receptor phosphatase, LAR. Numerous CASK mutations were found to cause mental retardation. The specific liprin-α/CASK interaction implicates a functional linkage between liprin-α and CASK in brain development. In addition to its presynaptic functions, liprin-α is also important for postsynaptic development partly by its binding to a suit of proteins including GRIP1 and LAR. Despite of the critical roles of liprin-α in synapses, the molecular basis of the liprin-α-mediated protein network in synapse are still unclear due to the lack of knowledge of the interaction mechanism of liprin-α with its targets. To understand the molecular basis underlying liprin-α’s functions in synapses, we plan to perform systematic biochemical and structural characterizations of the interactions between liprin-α and its diverse targets. The proposal here is built on our unpublished crystal structure of the liprin-α2/CASK complex, which reveals a number of exciting features of the interaction mode of the two proteins and implicates potential regulatory roles of the liprin-α2/CASK interaction. In this proposal, we will perform a series of experiments to elucidate the potential regulatory mechanism of the liprin-α2/CASK interaction. We will also investigate whether calmodulin will play additional roles in modulating the liprin-α2/CASK interaction as well as the kinase activity of CASK. We have successfully crystallized the complex of liprin-α/β heterodimer, which is mediated by two SAM repeats from each protein. Solving the structure of the liprin-α/β complex will provide valuable insight into the potential assembly mechanism of this heterodimer in synapse. Finally, we plan to solve the liprin-α/LAR complex structure for the molecular mechanism underlying the liprin-α/LAR interaction. The outcome of the proposed research is expected to provide fundamental knowledge in the understanding of the roles of liprins in synaptic functions. Additionally, successful implementations of the proposed research will also be valuable for understanding the disease mechanism of CASK mutations-induced mental retardation in human patients. 作为支架蛋白，Liprin-α通过“征募”多个突触蛋白到神经突触前末端的活动区（active zone），在神经突触前功能（如神经突触的发育和神经递质的释放）中扮演重要角色。Liprin-α的神经突触前功能主要是由它的三个SAM结构域所介导。这些SAM结构域与CASK的CaM激酶结构域结合，将liprin-α连接到至关重要的MALS/CASK/Mint-1三联体复合物上。许多CASK的突变可以导致智力发育迟钝。而liprin-α和CASK之间的特异性相互作用表明这两个蛋白质的功能在脑部发育中有联系。除了具有神经突触前功能，liprin-α还可以与一些突触后蛋白质（包括GRIP1和LAR）结合，显示其在突触后发育中也发挥重要作用。尽管liprin-α对神经突触的功能发挥必不可少，对于liprin-α所介导的突触蛋白质网络的分子间作用机制的了解却很匮乏。 为了进一步了解liprin-α在神经突触中功能的分子基础，我们计划对liprin-α与它靶蛋白之间的相互作用关系进行生物化学和结构生物学研究。本研究计划书是基于我们所解析的尚未发表的liprin-α2/CASK 复合物晶体结构。该结构揭示了这两个蛋白质之间的一系列重要而独特的相互作用模式，并且提示了liprin-α2和CASK之间相互作用的潜在的调控机制。在计划书中，我们提出了一系列后续实验来解释这种潜在的调控机制。同时，我们计划研究钙调蛋白是否也会调节liprin-α2和CASK之间的相互作用以及CASK的酶活性。此外，我们成功结晶了liprin-α/β异源二聚体复合物。解析该复合物结构可以对该异源二聚体在神经突触中潜在的聚合机制提供有价值的信息。最后，我们计划解析liprin-α/LAR复合物结构来揭示这两个蛋白质间相互作用的分子机制。我们希望本研究计划的成果能够为阐释liprin家族蛋白质在神经突触功能中所扮演的角色提供基础信息。而且该研究计划的成功执行将有助于人们进一步了解CASK突变所引起的智力迟钝的致病机理。

662710.label: Realisation of objectives
662710.value: For the first objective, we characterized the molecular basis of the liprin-alpha/CASK complex by mutagenesis. Combining with sequence analysis and cellular studies in neurons, we demonstrated that the liprin-alpha2/CASK interaction is specific for vertebrates. We also showed that the liprin-alpha2/CASK interaction mode is specific for CASK but not for other CaM kinases by sequence analysis and biochemical characterization. To test the potential regulatory role of CaM for CASK's activities, we confirmed the Ca2+-dependent CaM/CASK_CaMK interaction by analytic gel filtration. Together, we have fully addressed the first objective. Additionally, we showed that three recently identified X-linked mental retardation mutants of CASK are defective in binding to liprin-alpha. For the second objective, we solved the crystal structure of the liprin-alpha/beta SAM repeats heterodimer. The structural analysis indicates that the liprin-beta SAM repeats adopt a similar fold with liprin-alpha and the heterodimer is formed via the canonical SAM domain-mediated, head-to-tail assembly mode. The liprin-alpha/beta interaction was further verified by mutagenesis studies. As the interface residues are highly conserved across liprin family members, we proposed that such SAM1/SAM3 interaction is a general mechanism for liprin assembly. In addition, the structure analysis of the liprin-alpha2/CASK and liprin-alpha/beta complexes showed that liprin-alpha2 can bind to CASK and liprin-beta simultaneously. Consistently, our analytic gel filtration chromatography analysis demonstrated that CASK, liprin-alpha2, and liprin-beta interact with each other to form a stable ternary complex in solution. Therefore, we have successfully completed the second objective. For the third objective, we have confirmed that the SAM repeats of liprin-alpha interact with the membrane-distal phosphatase domain of LAR by various biochemical assays. However, we failed to crystallize the liprin-alpha/LAR complex due to the high heterogeneity of the LAR protein. We have tried several methods to solve this problem. We tested various expression tags and different boundary of LAR to improve protein quality. We also tried to purify the other two LAR family members, PTP-sigma and PTP-delta, which may have better protein behavior for crystallization. Till now, we are still trying different strategies to determine the complex structure. Although we did not obtain the structure, we discovered that the binding of LAR to liprin-alpha does not interfere with its interactions with CASK or liprin-beta biochemically. In addition, we mapped the minimal binding region on liprin-alpha, which further enrich our understanding of liprin-alpha as a scaffold.

662710.label: Major findings and research outcome
662710.value: We determined the crystal structure of the liprin-alpha/CASK complex. Our structural analysis revealed that the three SAM domains of liprin-alpha forms an integrated supramodule binds to CASK kinase-like domain specifically. The structure of the liprin-alpha/CASK complex, together with biochemical and cellular studies, demonstrates that the interaction between liprin-alpha and CASK is an evolutionary gain in vertebrates. Next, We solved the liprin-alpha/liprin-beta SAM domain complex structure, which further uncovers the molecular basis governing the liprin hetero-dimer formation. Our structural and biochemical data indicates that liprin-alpha acts as a molecular platform to recruit LAR, CASK, and liprin-beta to form a supra-scaffold for integrating other target proteins into very large assemblies capable of regulating diverse cellular activities. Our studies also provide the potential mechanistic explanation of how the CASK/liprin-alpha interaction is involved in a severe neuronal disease, named X-linked mental retardation. The research output above has been published as a research article in 'Molecular Cell' in 2011 (Paper No. 1 in Part C). In addition to the studies of liprin-alpha, we also extend our studies to other major players in synapse functions, such as myosins and ankyrins. In these related studies, we discovered the unique targeting mechanisms for myosin-X (No. 2&3 in Part C) and myosin-V (No. 5) as well as the structural and functional supramodule formation of ankyrins' spectrin binding domain (No.4).

662710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
662710.value: In future, we are going to fill the other part of the association mechanism of liprin-alpha, based on the N-terminal coiled-coil region of liprin-alpha. This large coiled-coil region (~700 residues) was showed to be involved in diverse association with several synaptic proteins, such as RIM, CAST, GIT1, etc., as well as homo- and hetero-dimerization between liprins. Several loss-of-function or gain-of-function mutations were found in the region, indicating the region is critical for liprin-alpha's function. Thus, our mechanistic studies of this region can provide deep understanding of molecular basis of how liprin-alpha acts as a master scaffold by recruiting various targets in synaptogenesis. Due to the nature of non-specific aggregation and high flexibility of coiled-coils, the difficulty of this research plan is to find the suitable boundaries for preparing stable and homogeneous protein samples. As the start point, we will try to solve the coiled-coil structures alone by employing X-ray crystallography. The structure of this coiled-coil region will help us for understanding the dimerization mechanism of liprins, and more importantly, guide us for further studying the binding of its diverse targets. We will also try to determine the complex structures to uncover the detailed binding mechanisms of this coiled-coil region.

662710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
662710.value: Brain, full of neurons, is the control center of our human body. For thinking, learning, and memory, neuronal signals are transducted among various neurons in brain. Thus, it is critical for brain functions to form correct connections between neurons through neuronal development. Once neurons were misconnected, people would have very sever neuronal diseases, such as autism, schizophrenia, and mental retardation. My research is to understand the molecular basis of how functional proteins, such as liprin-alpha, help neurons to form proper connections during brain development by using structural biology and biochemistry. In the past three years, with the funding support from Research Grant Council, our research group has published some important results in international journals. These studies can provide knowledge basis for treatment of the neuronal disease in future.

663110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
663110.value: Many aspects of human physiology are regulated by neurotransmitters and hormones that operate via the guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins). Although G proteins are not typically considered as essential components for cell growth and proliferation, there is substantial evidence to indicate that G protein-dependent signaling pathways are intricately involved in the regulation of these cellular processes. Recent studies by the PI have revealed that several G proteins and their associated signaling partners are implicated in the control of cell survival. Interestingly, stable expression of the Gα-interacting protein (GAIP), a regulator of G protein signaling (RGS) protein, can allow mammalian cells to survive and grow in serum-free conditions. Conditioned medium collected from GAIP-expressing cells can support the growth of untransfected cells in the absence of serum, suggesting that a secreted factor is responsible for enhancing cell survival. Preliminary proteomic studies have identified the presence of Nm23 metastasis suppressor proteins in the conditioned media of GAIP-expressing cells. Nm23 proteins have been shown to inhibit the metastatic potentials of many cancer cell lines in vivo but little is known with regard to their mechanism of action. Nevertheless, Nm23 has been shown to act as a nucleoside diphosphate kinase and possesses the ability to bind to G proteins and guanine nucleotide exchange factors (GEFs). The demonstrated ability of Nm23 to interfere with the signaling of small GTPases is in good agreement with the observed loss of small GTPase activity in GAIP-expressing cells, suggesting that there is a causal relationship between GAIP and Nm23 expression. The present proposal aims to test the hypothesis that serum-independent growth and survival of GAIP-expressing cells are attributed to the increased expression and secretion of Nm23. Attempts will also be made to elucidate the mechanism by which Nm23 regulates cell survival and growth. Special attention will be directed at exploring possible linkages between the signaling pathways operated by GTPases and Nm23. Detailed knowledge on how Nm23 proteins regulate cell survival and growth will contribute to a better understanding of the actions of metastasis suppressor proteins. Furthermore, information on the interactive signals for cell growth may have important clinical applications such as molecular diagnosis and therapy for cancer. 人體機能主要是由神經傳導物質和激素調控，其作用機制往往涉及鳥苷酸結合蛋白(簡稱G蛋白)。雖然在細胞生長或增殖過程中G蛋白並非主角，但有證據顯示這些過程受G蛋白信號傳導途徑影響。本課題負責人最近便發現有G蛋白和相關信號轉導夥伴具有調節細胞存活的作用。哺乳動物細胞經過基因轉染後，穩定表達Gα相互作用蛋白(簡稱GAIP，是一種G蛋白信號調節因子(RGS)) ，置於無血清的培養基中，細胞依然可以存活和生長。之後將培養基收集及適當處理，再用於培育未經基因轉染的細胞，這些細胞也能夠在無血清的情況下生長。由此可以証明，轉染後的細胞可以分泌一種增強存活能力的物質。研究人員利用蛋白組技術，初步確定了培養基中含有Nm23轉移抑制因子。體外細胞實驗顯示，Nm23具有抑制多種癌細胞擴散的能力，但其作用機制仍有待探索。Nm23 是一種核苷二磷酸激酶，可以和G蛋白及鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子(GEFs) 結合。在上述實驗中，GAIP-表達細胞失去小分子GTP酶能力，而Nm23恰好可以干擾小GTP酶的信號功能。按此推論，GAIP和Nm23的表達，兩者之間可能存有因果關係。我們假設GAIP-表達細胞可以在無血清的情況下存活和生長，原因在於加強表達和分泌Nm23。本研究將繼續求證，探索Nm23調控細胞存活和生長的作用機理，並澄清GTP酶和Nm23的信號傳導途徑之間是否互有聯繫，結果將有助瞭解轉移抑制蛋白的作用機理。長遠而言，有關細胞生長的信號研究可能具有重大臨床意義，應用於分子診斷和治療癌症等方面。

663110.label: Realisation of objectives
663110.value: Objective 1: We have confirmed that transient expression of RGS19 in several mammalian cell types can lead to an increase in both Nm23 transcript and protein levels. The simultaneous knockdown of Nm23-H1 and H2 was able to blunt the growth enhancing effect of RGS19 in transfected HEK293 cells, suggesting that Nm23-H1/2 may be involved in mediating the growth advantage of 293/RGS19 cells. Conditioned media from 293/RGS19 cells (serum-free, 7-day cultures) effectively supported the survival and growth of HEK293 cells and the presence of Nm23 in the conditioned media was confirmed by Western blot analysis. However, NIH-3T3 cells stably expressing Nm23-H1/2 did not exhibit any growth advantage and similar results were obtained with HeLa and H1299 cells. NIH-3T3 cells overexpressing Nm23-H1/2 survived better than parental cells under serum-free condition but the effect was not as pronounced as that seen with HEK293 cells. Objective 2: Nm23-H1/2 and DJ-1 were found to be upregulated in the conditioned media from 293/RGS19 cells. Specific antisera against Nm23-H1/2 were used to confirm that both Nm23-H1/2 are secreted by the 293/RGS19 cells. Attempts to inhibit the survival promoting activity of the conditioned media from 293/RGS19 cells by depletion of Nm23-H1/2 were, however, inconclusive. In order to unequivocally demonstrate that extracellular Nm23 proteins can serve as survival signals, recombinant Nm23-H1/2 proteins (rNm23) were prepared by a baculovirus expression system. The integrity of rNm23-H1/2 was confirmed by NDP kinase assays. However, rNm23 proteins (up to 1 ug/ml) did not support the survival and growth of HEK293 or HeLa cells. This indicates that rNm23 proteins alone may be insufficient and they may need to work in conjunction with other secreted proteins (e.g., DJ-1). Objective 3: The effect of Nm23 on the Ras small GTPase was examined in detail. NIH3T3 cells stably expressing Nm23-H1 with or without Ras or RasGV (an oncogenic mutant) were established. In cell proliferation assays, Nm23-H1 cells did not show any effect on cell growth as compared to parental cells. However, when Nm23-H1 was co-expressed with RasGV, it suppressed RasGV-induced cell proliferation and neoplastic transformation. More importantly, Nm23-H1 inhibited RasGV-induced tumorigenesis in nude mice. This inhibitory effect was abolished in NDP kinase-deficient mutant of Nm23-H1, indicating reliance on its enzymatic function. In contrast, Nm23-H2 did not exhibit any tumor suppressive effect. Similar results were obtained with HeLa cells but Nm23-H1 did not inhibit tumorigenesis in H1299 cells.

663110.label: Major findings and research outcome
663110.value: The overall project goal was to examine the effect of Nm23-H1/2 metastasis suppressors on the survival and growth of mammalian cells. Initial clues of Nm23-H1/2 playing a regulatory role in cell proliferation were derived from examining the phenotype of over-expressing RGS19. Our study showed that RGS19 can up-regulate Nm23-H1/2 in several types of mammalian cells (Publication 3 and Abstract 1 in Part C) and stimulate cell proliferation by deregulating cell cycle control and enhancing Akt signaling (Publication 1 and Abstract 1 in Part C). In line with the reported disruption of GTPase signaling by Nm23-H1/2, the responsiveness of stress-activated protein kinases is impaired in RGS19 over-expressing cells that have elevated Nm23-H1/2 levels (Publication 2 and Abstracts 3 and 4 in Part C). Most interestingly, we have demonstrated that Nm23H1/2 mediates RGS19-induced suppression of Ras signaling via phosphorylation of KSR (Publication 3 and Abstract 2 in Part C). This mechanism presumably allows RGS19 to suppress oncogenic-Ras induced neoplastic transformation and tumorigenesis (Publication 4 and Abstract 1 in Part C). The observed inhibitory response was apparently due to the up-regulation of Nm23 protein expression. Further investigations revealed that Nm23-H1 but not H2 can inhibit tumorigenesis induced by oncogenic Ras or loss of the p53 tumor suppressor (Publication 6 and Abstract 1 in Part C). In H1299 lung carcinoma, expression of Nm23-H2 was found to facilitate rather than suppress tumorigenesis (Publication 6 in Part C). This effect of Nm23-H2 was associated with an elevated level of the c-Myc oncoprotein. The differential ability of Nm23-H1 and H2 to regulate tumorigenesis suggests that they can signal through distinct pathways. This aspect formed the basis of an invited review on the regulatory role of Nm23 in tumorigenesis (Publication 5 in Part C). Despite the detection of extracellular Nm23-H1/2 in the conditioned media of 293/RGS19 cells, we were unable to demonstrate any growth or survival effect of recombinant Nm23 proteins on various cell types. The recombinant proteins were fully functional as NDP kinases but they lack growth promoting effect on the several cell types tested. Further studies are needed to elucidate the functional significance of high serum levels of Nm23-H1/2 in cancer patients.

663110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
663110.value: This project has provided convincing biochemical and cellular evidence on Nm23-H1/2 playing a role in tumorigenesis. The in vivo validation of the suppressive effect of Nm23-H1 on oncogenic Ras or p53 deficiency-induced tumorigenesis may have therapeutic implications. A key issue is whether it is feasible to increase the expression level of Nm23-H1 by extracellular signals. To date, several compounds have been reported to elevate Nm23-H1 expression in vitro. For example, acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) was able to up-regulate Nm23 and exhibited anti-proliferative and anti-invasive effects in human colon carcinoma cell line SW480. Other compounds that can stimulate Nm23-H1 expression include indomethacin, gamma linolenic acid, all-trans retinoic acid, 1-alpha-hydroxyvitamin D-5, trichostatin A and 5-azadeoxycytidine. More importantly, medroxyprogesterone acetate, which was reported to elevate Nm23-H1 expression of human breast cancer cell lines and subsequently inhibit their anchorage-independent colonization, is being tested in a phase II trial. Hence, it is pertinent to establish whether Nm23-H1/2 possess stimulatory or inhibitory effect on tumorigenesis, and if so, under what conditions and genetic backgrounds. Given that Nm23-H1 and H2 appeared to exert differential effects on tumor growth, future studies should also address the molecular basis of their functional specificity.

663110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
663110.value: Nm23-H1 and H2 are prototypical metastasis suppressors that are often down-regulated in cancer cells. It has become increasingly apparent that Nm23-H1 and H2 are capable of regulating a diverse spectrum of cellular activities including cell growth and survival. Through a combination of molecular biology, biochemical, and in vivo approaches, the present study has revealed that Nm23-H1 and H2 can be up-regulated by other proteins and thereby modulate tumorigenesis. The ability of Nm23-H1 to inhibit tumorigenesis depends on the genetic background of the cancer cells and requires intact NDP kinase activity. In contrast to Nm23-H1, the H2 isoform enhances tumor growth in certain cellular backgrounds. The present study has highlighted the functional difference between the two major isoforms of Nm23 proteins in relation to their ability to modulate tumorigenesis. A thorough understanding on how Nm23 isoforms regulate tumorigenesis may enable the future utilization of these metastasis suppressors in cancer treatment.

663210.label: Realisation of objectives
663210.value: All four objectives have been successfully realized so far. For Objective 1, we divided the Dusp27 gene into three fragments (i.e., N-terminal, central, and C-terminal) and fused them in-frame with the GST gene. We prepared the recombinant GST fusion proteins from E. Coli, and injected them into rabbits to generate three antibodies, one of them was found to be good for both Western blot and immunoprecipitation. For Objective 2, by both RT-PCR and Western blotting, we examined the expression of Dusp27 mRNA and protein in various mouse tissues and myoblast cell culture both before and after differentiation. We found that both Dusp27 mRNA and protein are specifically expressed in the heart and skeletal muscles but undetectable in other mouse tissues. In myoblast cell culture, Dusp27 was already expressed at low levels, but its expression is further enhanced after myogenic differentiation. For Objective 3, using siRNA-based knockdown approach, we found that knockdown of Dusp27 reduced the expression levels of Six1 and Six4, and inhibited the transcriptional activity of MyoD and MEF2, all of these being key transcription factors involved in myogenin gene induction during early myogenic differentiation. In addition, knockdown Dusp27 also led to increased expression of Cyclin D1, which in turn may interfere with cell cycle exit during early differentiation. For Objective 4, by blast search, we found that zebrafish has a single Dusp27 ortholog (i.e., zDusp27) in its genome. In collaboration with Dr. Zilong Wen’s laboratory, we designed a Dusp27-specific morpholino oligonucleotide that blocks the translation initiation and injected it or a control morpholino oligo into the 1-cell zebrafish embryos. Twenty-four hours post-fertilization, we fixed the embryos and subjected them to immunostaining using various antibodies against sarcomeric proteins. We found that knockdown of the zDusp27 gene severely disrupted the highly-ordered sarcomeric structure. Both slow and fast muscles were disrupted by the Dusp27-specific morpholino oligo. Our work demonstrate that Dusp27 is indispensable for myogenesis in vivo.

663210.label: Major findings and research outcome
663210.value: In our previous RGC-funded project, we demonstrated that the JAK1/STAT1 pathway plays an important role in myogenic differentiation. To uncover the genome-wide target genes of the JAK1/STAT1 that are involved in myogenic differentiation, we performed microarray experiments to compare transcriptome profiles of the control myoblasts (i.e., C2C12 cells transfected with a GFP-siRNA) and myoblasts transfected with a JAK1-siRNA or STAT1-siRNA. Dusp27 is one of the target genes that were up-regulated by the JAK1-siRNA and STAT1-siRNA. As Dusp27 is a novel gene encoding a pseudophosphaatase and its function in myoblasts is poorly characterized, we functionally characterized this gene in this project. The following is a summary of what we have done: 1. We generated in-house a polyclonal antibody against Dusp27 and the antibody was proved to be good for Western blotting and immunoprecipitation. By RT-PCR and Western blotting, we found that both Dusp27 mRNA and protein are preferentially expressed in skeletal muscles and the heart. 2. Using C2C12 myoblasts as a model, we showed that Dusp27 is already present in myoblasts before differentiation. Its expression levels further increase during myogenic differentiation. Knockdown of Dusp27 by siRNA inhibited myogenin gene induction and myogenic differentiation. We also performed microarray experiments to compare the transcriptome profiles of C2C12 cells with or without Dusp27 (i.e., by knocking down Dusp27 with a Dusp27-specific siRNA). Such experiments allowed us to identify Dusp27 target genes involved in myogenic differentiation. 3. We also designed a morpholino oligo to suppress Dusp27 expression in zebrafish by blocking the translation initiation. When we injected this morpholino oligo into one-cell embryoes of zebrafish and examined skeletal muscle structure 24 hours post-fertilization (hpf) by immunostaining, we found that the sarcomeres in muscle cells were severely disrupted in morpholino-treated fishes, suggesting a role of Dusp27 in myofibril assembly. Our results showed that Dusp27 is not only involved in myogenic differentiation in cell culture models but also regulates myofibril assembly in differentiated muscle cells.

663210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
663210.value: As Dusp27 is a poorly characterized protein, we carried out initial functional characterization of this protein during myogenic differentiation. Based on its role in myogenic differentiation and myofibril assembly, it would be highly desirable to confirm these findings in a mouse model. We have already generated a Dusp27 floxed strain. We can cross this strain with inducible muscle satellite cell-specific Cre line (e.g., Pax7-CreER mice) or myofiber-specific Cre line (e.g., HSA-CreER mice) to study the role of Dusp27 in muscle stem cells and differentiated myofibers. Such analysis will reveal the in vivo functions of Dsp27 in mouse muscles. Moreover, it will be informative to look for Dusp27-interacting proteins (e.g., by yeast two-hybrid screening using Dusp27 as bait or Dusp27 immunoprecipitation coupled with Mass Spectrometry) in order to reveal the molecular mechanisms by which Dusp27 exerts its function.

663210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
663210.value: In this project, we functionally characterized Dusp27, a poorly characterized pseudophosphatase, in muscle differentiation and sarcomere assembly. We found that Dusp27 is preferentially expressed in the skeletal muscles and the heart in both zebrafish and mouse but not in invertebrates like flies or nematodes. In myoblast cell culture model, Dusp27 was found to be required for myoblast differentiation. Furthermore, when we reduced its expression in zebrafish, it potently disrupted sarcomere assembly in muscle cells. Our work suggested that Dusp27 represents a novel regulator involved in controlling muscle differentiation and sarcomere assembly in muscle cells of vertebrates like zebrafish or mouse.

663310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
663310.value: In the brain, neurons communicate with each other via specialized structures termed synapses. Synapses are made of presynaptic terminals containing neurotransmitters and postsynaptic terminals with neurotransmitter receptors. Proper synaptic transmission requires the precise alignment of presynaptic terminals with corresponding postsynaptic structures. Synapse abnormalities have been implicated in neuropsychiatry diseases such as autism. How synapses form, or the process of synaptogenesis, is not well understood in the central nervous system. Recently, synaptic adhesion molecular neurexin and neuroligin were found to induce formation of both excitatory glutamatergic and inhibitory GABAergic synapses in neurons from the central nervous system. Mutation of neurexins and neuroligins were found in patients with brain disorders such as autism and mental retardation. There are four mammalian neuroligins. While neuroligin 1 promotes formation of glutamatergic excitatory synapses, neuroligin 2 induces formation of GABAergic inhibitory synapses. How this specificity is achieved, or more broadly, what’s the molecular mechanism underlying neuroligin-mediated synaptogenesis, is not fully understood. Here we propose to investigate the molecular mechanism of neuroligin-mediated synaptogenesis by identifying the proteins associated with different neuroligins and investigating their roles in neuroligin-mediated synaptogenesis. This will be achieved by conducting coimmunoprecipitation experiments using antibodies against different neuroligins, identifying their specific associated proteins by mass spectrometry analysis and investigating their functions in neuroligin-mediated synaptogenesis by perturbing their expressions on neurons. 神经元在大脑中通过突触互相联系。突触由含有神经递质的突触前末梢及含有神经递质受体的突触后末梢组成。突触前末梢要与后末梢对准才能保证正确的突触传递。突触形成及功能的异常可以导致自闭症等神经精神疾病，但是我们对于突触在中枢神经系统中是如何形成的所知有限。最近的研究发现突触黏附分子neurexin和neuroligin可以诱导兴奋性和抑制性突触的形成。Neurexin和neuroligin的突变可以导致自闭症及智力障碍等精神疾病。哺乳动物有4个neuroligin基因。其中neuroligin 1 诱导形成谷氨酸能的兴奋性突触，而neuroligin 2 诱导形成GABA能的抑制性突触。这一特异性是如何实现的尚不清楚，而且我们对于neuroligin诱导突触形成的分子机制也不是很了解。这里我们提议通过寻找与不同的neuroligin相结合的蛋白质并研究它们的功能来研究neuroligin诱导突触形成的分子机制。我们计划用针对不同neuroligin的特异性抗体来免疫共沉淀，并结合质谱的方法来寻找与不同neuroligin特异结合的蛋白质。我们然后将进一步通过干扰这些蛋白质的表达来研究这些结合蛋白质在neuroligin诱导突触形成中的作用。

663310.label: Major findings and research outcome
663310.value: In this project, we sought to identified proteins associated the neuroligins, proteins that are critical for synaptogenesis and mutations of which led to autism in human. We generated antibodies that recognize different neuroligin isoforms, including antibody specific for neuroligin 2, and antibody recognize both neuroligin 1/3. To avoid non-specific proteins that come down with immunoprecipitation, we also obtain the knockout mice of neuroligin 1, 2 and 3 and use them as negative control. Albeit time consuming, these strategies proved to be successful and we were able to overcome the obstacles and identify a number of neuroligin associated proteins. In addition to co-immunoprecipitation and mass-spec analysis, we also used yeast-two hybrid screening to identify neuroligin-associated proteins. We subsequently verified these interactions by in vitro co-immunoprecipitation with different tag antibodies. We then went on to determine whether their interactions with neuroligins are direct or indirect. After that, we focused on two proteins, one is PICK1 and one is Itch, to study their functional significance. In the case of PICK1, which we previously showed to cluster and regulate the synaptic localization of AMPA receptors, we found that PICK1 played an important role in recruiting AMPA receptor to immature synapses that induced by neurexin and neuroligin. The synapses induced by neurexin-neuroligin in cultured neurons were normally without AMPA receptors, and as a result, these synapses were not functional (silent synapses). Upon expression of PICK1, PICK1 could recruit AMPA receptors to these immature postsynaptic sites. This synaptic recruitment of AMPA receptors depended on the interaction between GluA2 and PICK1 and on PICK1’s lipid-binding ability, but not the interaction between PICK1 and neuroligin. Furthermore, we demonstrated that the recruitment of GluA2 to synapses could be prevented by ICA69, a key binding partner of PICK1. Our data showed that PICK1, being negatively regulated by ICA69, could facilitate synapse maturation. This work provided an important molecular mechanism to understand the maturation of synapses, whose abnormality is believed to contribute to the pathogenesis of autism. The work on Itch is still ongoing and it opened a new direction to study the downstream signaling mechanism of neuroligin. With the support of this project, we have one paper published in PLoS Biology, one paper in Scientific Report, and another paper accepted by Journal of Neuroscience.

663310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
663310.value: The findings from this project opened more directions to our study. For example, the work on Itch, which was never studied for function at synapses, will provide important insight to understand how the signals transmitted from neuroligins. We are seeking additional funding to continue this line of work.

663310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
663310.value: Synapses are central to neuronal communication in the brain. Abnormalities in synapses are believed to be the underlying causes of many brain disorders, including autism and mental retardation. Elucidating how synapses form will not only help us understand how brain function, but also uncover the pathological basis of mental disorders. The pair of cell adhesion molecules neurexin-neuroligin has emerged as important players in synapse formation and their mutations lead to autism and mental retardation. However, how neuroligins drive the formation of synapses is not clear. In this study, we identify proteins that are important for the downstream signaling of neurexin-neuroligin induced synaptogenesis. We also studied the mechanisms of their actions to understand how neurexin-neuroligin induces the formation and maturation of synapses. These studies will eventually help us understand the molecular and cellular bases of mental disorders.

663610.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
663610.value: Myosins are mini protein-based motors existing in living cells that walk along actin filaments. These protein motors, by functioning as mechanical force providers as well as cellular transporters, play vital roles in diverse cellular processes ranging from muscle contraction to tissue formations. Among the unconventional myosin family members (with respect to the conventional myosin for muscle contractions), there is a sub-family, called MyTH4-FERM myosins, which includes myosin VII, X, and XV. These three myosins are so named as the tail of each motor protein contains one or a pair of MyTH4-FERM domains. The MyTH4-FERM domains in the tail regions of myosin VII, X, and XV function as cargo binding domains of these actin-based motors, and may function to link the motors with both cytoskeletal structures as well as membranes. These three MyTH4-FERM myosins are vital for neuronal network formation in brains, blood vessel patterning in animals, proper development of ear and visual cells. Mutations of these actin motors are known to cause various diseases in humans including deaf blindness, mental retardations, and cancers. However, the molecular basis underlying the critical cellular functions of these motors is essentially unknown, largely due to the lack of detailed biochemical and structural studies of these motors and their interactions with cargoes. In this proposal, we plan to perform systematic biochemical, structural, and functional studies of the MyTH4-FERM tandems from myosins VII and X. The structure of the myosin X MyTH4-FERM in complex with DCC (a myosin X cargo playing essential roles in axonal migration and blood vessel formation) in the PI’s lab provides foundations to pursue a series of experiments to dissect mechanistic basis of myosin X’s functions in filopodia formation and blood vessel patterning. 663610.label: Major findings and research outcome
663610.value: We solved the structure of the MyoX MyTH4-FERM tandem in complex with the cytoplasmic tail P3 domain of the netrin receptor DCC. The structure, together with biochemical studies, reveals that the MyoX MyTH4 and FERM domains interact with each other forming a structural and functional supramodule. Instead of forming an extended beta-strand structure in other FERM binding targets, DCC_P3 forms a single alpha-helix and binds to the target binding groove formed by beta5 and alpha1 of the MyoX FERM F3 lobe. Structure-based amino acid sequence analysis reveals that the key polar residues forming the inter-MyTH4/FERM interface are absolutely conserved in all MyTH4-FERM tandem-containing proteins, suggesting that the supramodular nature of the MyTH4-FERM tandem is likely a general property for all MyTH4-FERM proteins.We have also uncovered a highly unexpected, anti-parallel coiled coil-mediated dimerization mode of MyoX, which enables the motor to take straddled walking steps on bundled actin filaments. These results were published in two separate articles in PNAS. The unconventional myosin VIIa (MYO7A) is one of the five proteins that form a network of complexes involved in formation of stereocilia. Defects in these proteins cause syndromic deaf-blindness in humans (Usher Syndrome I). Many disease causing mutations occur in MyTH4-FERM domains in the myosin tail that binds to another USH1 protein Sans. We report the crystal structure of MYO7A MyTH4-FERM domains in complex with the central domain (CEN) of Sans at 2.8-Å resolution. The MyTH4 and FERM domains form an integral structural and functional supramodule binding to two highly conserved segments (CEN1&2) of Sans. The MyTH4-FERM/CEN complex structure provides mechanistic explanations for known deafness-causing mutations in MYO7A MyTH4-FERM. The structure also facilitates mechanistic and functional studies of MyTH4-FERM domains in other myosins.This work was published in Science.

663610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
663610.value: Our systematic characterizations of the MyTH4-FERM tandems in Myo-X and Myo-VIIa have established the general operation mode for MyTH4-FERM tandem. The work will be valuable for understanding other MyTH4-FERM containing proteins in the future, and to understanding a number of human diseases that are caused by mutations of these proteins.

663610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
663610.value: Mutations of myosin VIIa are known to be responsible for ~50% of human patients with impaired hearings and/or blindness called Usher syndrome. More than 160 different myosin VIIa human deafness-causing mutations are known through genetic screenings. Additionally, mutations of several myosin VIIa interacting proteins also cause human deaf and blindness. However, why mutations in myosin VIIa and its binding proteins cause human deaf and blindness is poorly understood. In this research, we determined the structure myosin VIIa in complex with Sans, a component of the Usher complex. Our work explains how myosin VIIa transports various cargo proteins in various human cells as well as maintains stereocilia structures in hair cells of human ears. Importantly, the structure of the myosin VIIa/Sans complex, together with a series of our related work, provides clear mechanistic explanations to many dozens of disease-causing mutations in the myosin cargo binding tail. The myosin VIIa/Sans complex structure is expected to be highly valuable for interpreting previously unknown mutations of myosin VIIa and myosin XV identified in patients with hearing impairments in the future. Our discoveries might provide a scientific foundation for future gene therapy of hereditary deafness caused by mutations in myosin VIIa, XV and Sans.

700110.label: Project Objectives
700110.value: Log key sections to establish the basic geology. From the logs and published maps, we aim also to produce facies architectures of the volcanic successions and generate isopach data that will assist us in deducing the original extents of the various suites. Field investigations of the sedimentary formations bracketing the volcanic series will allow us to work out how the northern India margin developed. It should thus be possible to establish the rift-basin geometry to see if there was pre-volcanic uplift related to a mantle plume, and if this is the case where the plume’s axis was centred. Conversely, if the magmatism was due to simple rifting, did it involve broadly synchronous detachment or diachronous unzipping? Establish the age and duration of volcanism using radiometric dating techniques, biostratigraphy (of the enveloping sedimentary formations and any intercalated layers) and magnetostratigraphy. Using paleomagnetism, establish where the volcanism took place. Existing tectonic models for the region (see below “Background of Research”) make robust predictions and these can be tested quantitatively using this approach. Also, data from thick exposures can be used to construct magnetostratigraphies. The Middle Permian (~266 Ma) saw the geomagnetic field flip from the ~50 m.y.-long Kiaman Reverse Polarity Superchron to the mixed-polarity Illawara interval. Thus, determining whether the rock sequences date from the Kiaman or Illawara should be achieved in this study. Using igneous petrology and geochemistry, we aim to constrain the mantle and crustal source regions, and petrogenetic processes that produced the volcanic and associated intrusive rocks.

700110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
700110.value: The Permian period (296–251 million years ago, Ma) is notable for (i) its mass extinctions and (ii) the large-scale mafic volcanism which took place at various sites on eastern Pangea and the nearby South China Block. In addition to the well-known large igneous province-forming events in SW China (263 Ma) and Siberia (251 Ma), one continental area most affected by volcanism was “northern” India. Remnants of several Early to Middle Permian mafic suites are preserved in the Himalaya along a 2500 km-long belt between northern Pakistan and NE India (via NW India, Nepal, and southern Tibet). Considering the widespread interest in Himalayan-Tibetan geology, surprisingly little is known about these volcanic series; the proposed multi-disciplinary research project aims to rectify this. Specifically, we plan to investigate (i) the volcanism’s trigger, (ii) whether the suites are genetically linked, and (iii) what are their temporal relations? (iv) If the volcanism was in response to mantle plume activity, where was the axis centred? (v) If this explanation seems likely, could the volcanism be related to a postulated super-plume episode? (vi) Conversely, the volcanism may have been due to simple continental rupture; the Cimmerian terrane, portions of which are preserved in Indochina, Yunnan Province, central Tibet and areas much further to the west in Turkey, peeled-off Gondwana at this time. The block was unusual for it formed a very long (~4,500 km) sliver, perhaps no more than 200–300 km wide. Why was this so? The proposed study should not only provide fundamental information on the geodynamic processes associated with plumes and/or rifting, but key insights on important rock packages now forming part of Asia. The investigation should also inform understanding of similar systems elsewhere, for instance the ocean basins and intervening crustal ribbons east of Australia (80–55 Ma), as well as those and nearer to home which developed as the South China Sea formed (31–16 Ma). 二疊紀時期(296-251百萬年前， Ma) 以(i) 生態大滅絕和(ii) 在東盤古大陸和附近的中國南方地塊發生的大規模基性岩漿火山作用而著名。 除了中國西南和(263 Ma)和西伯利亞(251 Ma)的知名大型火成岩區形成事件之外， ”北印度” 是另一個最受火山作用影響的大陸地區。 因此在沿著喜馬拉雅山和北巴基斯坦及印度西北(通過印度西北、尼泊爾和南西藏) 之間的2500公里長山岳帶還保存了一些早期及中期二疊紀的岩套殘餘。 相對於西藏喜馬拉雅地質的廣泛研究而言， 上述一帶二疊紀基岩套所知甚少﹔我們計劃以多重學科的研究方案來加深此方面的了解。為此我們將主要研究: (i)火山作用的成因， (ii)有關岩套的相關性， 和 (iii) 岩套的時序關係。 (iv) 火山作用是否由地幔熱柱活動所引致及軸心的位置。 (v)如果地幔熱柱活動設定成立，火山作用會否與超級地幔熱柱的假設相關？(vi)相反地，火山作用也許歸結於簡單的大陸破裂， 如當時與岡瓦那大陸分離的史前大陸基墨里 (Cimmerian terrane) 。基墨里大陸 (Cimmerian terrane) 為一塊非常長 (~4,500公里) 的裂片，或許有200-300公里寬， 如分佈於印度北部，土耳的西部，中國的雲南省和西藏內。對這方面的進一步研究不僅提供地 ”北印度” 基性岩漿岩套與幔熱柱活動或是斷裂作用的地球動力信息，也會加深對亞洲大陸形成過程的了解。 這項研究也會對其它有相似爭論的地方起參考作用， 例如澳洲(80-55 Ma)東邊的地殼段帶和它附近的海洋盆地，還有南中國海的形成(31-16 Ma)等等。

700110.label: Realisation of objectives
700110.value: The multi-disciplinary study has resulted in a deep and comprehensive understanding of the various mafic magmatic provinces that were erupted onto northern Greater India in the Early Permian. Acquisition of a wealth of basic field data combined with the generation of information associated with the laboratory studies means that we now have a detailed understanding of the suites at Panjal (NW India), southern Tibet, Abor (NE India) and eastern Tibet (in total ~2000 km along-strike length). We have used this information to develop a new regional-scale geotectonic model. Critically, it has enabled us to evaluate thoroughly various influential models proposed for eastern Gondwana in the Carboniferous-Jurassic (Ali et al., 2013, Geophys. J. Int.). We note that the three journal outputs are receiving citations, indicating that our insights are gaining traction with the community. In terms of under-achievements, there are four. 1. With some of the sections in southern Tibet, which are close to the tectonic suture between India-Asia suture, the magnetizations are secondary. The overprintings were likely acquired during the mountain building phase associated with India's collision and indentation into Asia. Therefore, we cannot use develop a magnetostratigraphy for these sections to refine age-date assignments. That said, the alternative age data now exist for many of the terrains, so this is not such a problem. 2. The mafic magmatic province that Zhu et al. (2010, Geol. Soc. Am. Bull.) identified at Selong, southern Tibet, and that was to form an important area of investigation for this study, turned out to be an intrusive body (this observation underpins the reason for carrying out detailed fieldwork). Hence we cannot use the rocks there for geotectonic modelling - the overall structure is ambiguous and the age is uncertain. 3. Access to the Panjal Traps area of NW India was delayed, thus we are behind on writing up some of the basic data for submission. It is hoped that this work can be submitted before the autumn 92015). Obviously, RGC's support will be acknowledged. 4. Unfortunately, mid-way through the study relations between Dr Bryan and the PI turned frosty, and communication between the two of us has been limited. However, materials from our collections at Abor and southern Tibet were passed on to him for petrological and geochemical studies, and I hope at some time to see publication.

700110.label: Major findings and research outcome
700110.value: Through investigating the various mafic magmatic suites that developed on northern Greater India in the Early Permian, we now have a thorough understanding of a how a vast ribbon of continental blocks (Cimmerian terranes) that are today present in west, south and SE Asia rifted off eastern Gondwana. The various journal outputs have already received citations and it possible that the 2013 one in Geophysical Journal International (now 13 hits) could emerge as the key work for guiding regional scale geological interpretations. Critically, that work outlines a comprehensive geotectonic model and also provides a detailed review of around several influential scenarios that have been published since 2008. The study on the Abor suite (Journal of Asian Earth Sciences; 12 citations) settles two key issues. First, it refutes the idea proposed by some India-based workers that the unit dates from the Early Eocene – this has caused much confusion. Second, it appears likely that the extension was not related directly to the rifting of the Cimmerian terranes, but more likely reflects plate adjustments between India and SW Australia and eastern Antarctica. At that time, large parts of eastern Gondwana appear to have been trying to separate. Very recently, a manuscript related to the Panjal Traps work has been re-submitted to the Journal of Asian Earth Sciences. Furthermore, I anticipate writing up with an MPhil student a study related to some work on a suite in easternmost Tibet, although the sections there unfortunately carry mid-Cenozoic overprints related to the India-Asia collision and thus cannot be used to inform debates on the region’s Permian development.

700110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
700110.value: Having immersed myself in the geotectonic development of eastern Gondwana in the Late Paleozoic, an obvious avenue for follow up work concerns the Sibumasu block. Stretching from western Yunnan in SW China to western Indonesia, via Myanmar, Thailand, the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra, the literature indicates that it is devoid of Permian-age rift volcanics. Why is this so? Based on the reconstruction presented in the Ali et al. (2013) paper, Sibumasu was in a more easterly location its present-day northern tip close to NW Australia, its southern extremity out by New Guinea. One possibility is that the terrane detached along a strike-slip fault. If this is the case, then very likely there are associated structures (pull-apart basins, pop-ups) that developed in response.

700110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
700110.value: Unraveling the geological history of Asia is often difficult. Base-level knowledge, often limited exposure (particularly in the tropical areas), inaccessibility of the terrain, political considerations etc are some of the problems that need to be overcome. These issues aside, the outputs from this RGC-funded study provide fundamental insights into one of the most significant events the region is associated with, that is the major rifting episode that affected the eastern Gondwana supercontinent ~280 million years ago (in the Early Permian). At a direct level, our work on the various magmatic provinces (Panjal, Abor, a several others in southern and eastern Tibet), that are associated with the break-up has provided high-quality new data. Critically, by taking the data and combining it with other types of geological and geophysical information, we have been able to propose a comprehensive new geotectonic model. Critically we are able to propose where each of the crustal slivers (Sibumasu, Qiangtang and Lhasa blocks) were located in Gondwana prior to their break-off. Furthermore, we have been to review a variety of scenarios that have been proposed over the last 6-7 years, highlighting their strengths and their weaknesses. It is anticipated that the work will spur further investigations.

700210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
700210.value: An experimental program is proposed to explore and optimize alternative ionic interfaces for a recently invented dual-electrolyte alkaline-acid technology for various power sources including fuel cells, batteries, and super-capacitors. The alkaline-acid electrochemical cell has an alkaline negative electrode and an acidic positive electrode and can therefore operate at a higher voltage than a conventional mono-electrolyte cell. A bipolar membrane provides the ionic barrier, ionic balance and ionic contact of the two electrolytes. The electrode reactions occur separately in different pH environment leading to the higher operating voltage. Potential profiles from the negative, across the ionic interface of bipolar membrane, to the positive will be investigated under different current densities, electrolyte concentrations, and configurations of the ionic interfaces. The bipolar membrane dual electrolyte has a different water transport due to its possible generation both at the anode and cathode as well as at the membrane interface. Catering to the difference of protons and hydroxide ions transport, asymmetric ionic interface with a thicker cationic exchange layer will be investigated for optimum ion transport and better water balance. Alternative bipolar membranes and configurations of interfaces will be explored to develop a higher power and energy in fuel cells, batteries, or super-capacitors. 本研究項目考察和優化離子介面在新近發明的一項酸堿雙電解質電化學電源技術中的應用, 包括燃料電池、電池和超級電容器等。通過將鹼性的負極和酸性的正極相結合,操作電壓比傳統的單一電解質電源高。技術中雙極膜將酸堿電解質進行隔離,同時維繫電極反應過程中的離子平衡。正負電極反應分別在不同pH環境進行,從而帶來較高的工作電壓。本專案將會考察電流密度、電解質濃度及不同離子介面的配置等因素對酸堿電化學電源中正、負電極之間電勢曲線的影響。由於電極反應過程中正負極上及膜介面上有水的生成和解離,因此酸堿電解質電化學電源系統中的水傳遞行為具有重要的研究意義。考慮到質子和氫氧根離子在電解液中傳遞行為的差異,本專案提出一個新型具有較厚陽離子交換層的不對稱離子介面體系來實現最佳的離子傳遞和水準衡。為獲得較高的功率和能量密度, 本專案也將嘗試考察不同類型的雙極膜和不同的離子介面在酸堿電解質電化學電源中的應用。

700210.label: Realisation of objectives
700210.value: The objectives have been fully realized and achieved. The concept of alkaline-acid dual electrolyte electrochemical power source has been investigated fully and demonstrated with a number of electrochemical cells. The power sources include fuel cells, flow batteries, rechargeable batteries, and electrochemical capacitors. The pH differential between negative and positive electrodes is achieved by 2 electrolytes, 3 electroltyes, and gel electrolytes. Different ionic interfaces are studied and include monopolar and bipolar membranes. The I-V curves, charge-discharge cycles, and other electrochemical characteristics have been obtained and analysed. Using a hydrogen pump with identical positive and negative electrodes, the ion transport across pH differential interface are studied with hydrogen reference electrodes placed at various locations. The ion transport across the ionic interfaces and the potential profiles in various components are determined and hence transport and kinetics mechanism revealed. A new ion exchange materials of polymer threaded in metal organic framework has been discovered with promise to be applied in a membrane form. The advantages of acid-alkaline hybrid devices have been demonstrated with high voltage, high energy density, and separate scalability of power and energy in flow batteries.

700210.label: Major findings and research outcome
700210.value: A Vanadium-MH rechargeable semi-flow battery has been develoepd with an experimental OCV of 1.93 V and operating voltage of 1.70 V, very high values among rechargeable flow batteries with aqueous electrolytes. The two electrolytes of different pH are separated by a bipolar membrane. The system demonstrated good reversibility and high efficiencies in coulomb (95%), energy (84%), and voltage (88%). The work was reported in JES 160 (2013) A1384. A hybrid battery system with gel electrolytes is developed to alleviate some limitations on conventional batteries, such as maintenance cost and acid stratification for the lead-acid battery, high self-discharge and short life cycles for high current discharge for nickel-metal hydride battery. This hybrid battery consists of a lead-acid positive electrode and a nickel-metal hydride negative electrode, operating in H2SO4-silica gel and KOH-potassium salt poly(acrylic acid) gel electrolytes via monopolar ion exchange membranes, respectively. The hybrid battery using gel electrolyte maintained stable discharge plateau at 2.27 V and longer discharge capacity than wet electrolyte system. This improved performance may be due to the gel electrolyte which can prevent acid stratification, reduce the corrosion rate of electrodes, and resolve the problem of salting-out in the central chamber for aqueous electrolyte system. This work was reported in ECS Transacations 41(13)(2012) 133. A three-electrolyte hybrid battery system has a stable operating voltage with repeated charge/discharge cycles. The operating voltage and power of the system can be increased by as much as 50% and found to have higher voltage and higher capacity than that of individual lead acid or nickel metal hydride cells. This work was reported in Electrochimica Acta 56 (2011) 9420. A porous metal−organic framework composite with flexible anion-exchange polymers threaded within the host cavity demonstrates very fast and reversible ion-exchange activity. Polyvinyl benzyl trimethylammonium hydroxide (PVBTAH) caged in ZIF-8 is synthesized in steps of chloro-monomer impregnation, in situ polymerization, amination, and alkaline ion exchange. The synthesized non-cross-linked PVBTAH∼ZIF-8 material exhibits superior ion-exchange kinetics compared to conventional ion-exchange resins. The work was published in JACS (2014) 136 (2014) 7209.

700210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
700210.value: The research is being further developed in an ITF industry-university collaborative project "Hybridized Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries for Flexible and Scalable Electricity Storage". The results are sufficiently promising to merit commercialization development. The fundamental results of measurements across interface with a pH gradient reveal mechanism of ion transport and suggest ways to control and influence the ion selectivity for optimum operation at high voltage and high current. Another promising development is the discovery of a new material, viz. ion-exchange polymer encapsulated in a metal-organic-framework. This can be further developed into a membrane of high ionic selectivity and fast transport.

700210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
700210.value: Fuel cells, batteries, and super-capacitors are energy conversion devices critical to renewable energy technologies for alleviation of climatic changes. These devices are electrochemical in nature with different energy and power densities. The development of our novel dual-electrolyte power source can increase power and energy by as much as 50% due to the increased voltage of an alkaline-acid dual electrolyte configuration. This project has further advanced this type of power cell for various configurations and combinations of negative and positive electrodes. In addition, there were investigations on various ionic interfaces between the chambers containing separately the negative electrode and positive electrode. The findings of ionic interfaces and transport will also be useful to electro-dialysis, desalination, and other electrochemical technologies for energy and environment.

700310.label: Project Title(Chinese)
700310.value: 由旋進力驅動的液態行星的流動

700310.label: Project Objectives
700310.value: To derive an asymptotic solution for asymptotically small Ekman number that describes weakly precessionally driven flows in the spheroidal planetary core of arbitrary eccentricity in the mantle frame of reference satisfying all the required boundary condition but making no prior assumption about the spatial-temporal structure of the flows. To construct a fully 3D numerical model on modern massively parallel computers, using an efficient EBE (Element-By-Element) finite element method, for the precessionally driven flows taking place in the spheroidal planetary core of arbitrary eccentricity without the existence of an inner sphere and to compare the numerical model directly with the analytical model and with the existing result of laboratory experiments. To simulate strongly nonlinear precessing flows in the spheroidal planetary core of arbitrary eccentricity with the presence of a sizeable inner sphere using the EBE finite element method for understanding both the effect of the inner sphere and the transition from the simple laminar to complex turbulent precessing flows.
