706010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
706010.value: The project lies in the interphase of geometry, analysis, topology, and mathematical physics. It is about a generalisation of a classical invariant called analytic/combinatorial torsion in te context of having a higher flux in space. Therefore the results in this area are interesting to researchers in many areas.

706110.label: Project Objectives
706110.value: Achieving successful epitaxial growth of Bi2Se3 by MBE: To successfully grow high quality Bi2Se3 thin films by MBE, a suitable substrate will firstly be identified. The growth mode and surface characteristics will then be studied, based on which, the MBE conditions may be optimized for better films and surfaces. High quality epitaxial Bi2Se3 films will be fabricated with varying thickness and doping. Fabrication of layered structures and surface capping by magnetic metal: To investigate the size dependence of the TI state and novel properties, layered structures incorporating Bi2Se3 and normal insulators or metals will be fabricated. Capping of Bi2Se3 by magnetic metal will be experimented. The growth characteristics of the heterogeneous films, including the growth mode and strain relaxation, will be studied. Characterizations of the surface and electronic properties: The MBE samples will finally be characterized by scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), photoelectron spectroscopy (PES), photoluminescence (PL), Hall and Kerr effect measurements, etc., for their structural, optical and electronic properties. Attention will be paid to new phenomena and novel properties, which can be expected from the structured films grown by MBE.

706110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
706110.value: Very recently, topological insulator (TI) is attracting intensive attention in physics community. It represents a new state of matter where the surface states residing in the bulk energy bandgap are topologically protected against scattering due to, e.g., disorder, and so it offers great promises in spintronics and fault-tolerant quantum computing applications. Lately, the compound of Bi2Se3, a known thermoelectric material, has been identified to be a superior three-dimensional TI material. It has a relatively large bulk energy bandgap (~ 0.3 eV), which makes it attractive for room temperature study and applications. So far, a limited number of experimental measurements of the TI materials have been made on bulk crystals, where high background carrier densities are usually found. To access the TI states, one has to dope the crystals with some impurity atoms (such as Sn and Ca), which introduces complications to the electronic characteristics of the materials. Using bulk samples, it is also difficult to probe the size-dependent effects. Therefore in this project, we shall grow thin films and layered structures of Bi2Se3 using molecular-beam epitaxy (MBE), a known technique offering good controls over film thickness, doping and interface properties. Not only thin films of Bi2Se3 with varying thickness and doping levels will be grown, but also that layered structures incorporating Bi2Se3 and normal insulators or metals will be fabricated. Capping of Bi2Se3 films with magnetic metals will be attempted for studies of novel properties. Characterizations of the surfaces will be carried out using techniques of reflection high-energy electron diffraction, scanning tunneling microscopy and photoelectron spectroscopy, while transport and spin properties of the samples will be investigated by Hall and Kerr rotation measurements. 近来，拓扑绝缘体材料吸引了物理学界的很大的注意力。该材料代表了物质材料的一种新的状态，在其体电子能带禁带中具有受拓扑保护的表面态，而该表面电子不受由于无序缺陷所导致的散射等影响，所以它在自旋电子学和量子计算等方面具有潜在的应用前景。最近，一种熟知的热电材料，硒化铋化合物，被人们发现是一种优质的三维拓扑绝缘体材料，它具有较大的体禁带宽度(~0.3 eV)，使其在室温下的应用具有吸引力。 到目前为止，少量的试验工作已经在一些体材、块材上进行。人们发现这些体块材料中具有较高的背景载流子浓度。为了能探测表面电子，往往需要在该材料中引入外来杂质(如锡或钙)，但外搀杂质无疑给材料的电子特性研究带来复杂性。同时，利用体块材料也很难对尺寸效应进行探讨。所以本课题提出利用一种对材料的搀杂、界面和膜厚等参数具有很好可控性的分子束外延技术对硒化铋薄膜和层状材料进行生长研究。项目除了将对不同膜厚和搀杂浓度的薄膜材料进行外延生长外，也将探讨将该材料与其他材料，如普通绝缘体或金属等，进行结合以形成不同的层状结构。又计划在该材料表面上进行磁性材料的覆盖进行试验和特性测试。我们将利用高能电子衍射、扫描隧道显微镜和光电子能谱等手段对材料的表面进行表征，利用霍尔和柯尔效应对电子的输运和自旋性质等进行测量。

706110.label: Realisation of objectives
706110.value: Epitaxial growth of topological insulator Bi2Se3 films on various substrates by the technique of molecular-beam epitaxy have been extensively experimented. We started by using Si(111), the most widely available semiconductor, as the substrate and found that Bi2Se3 did not readily grow on clean Si(111). Subsequently, a two-step growth strategy was developed for high quality epitaxial films. A few more substrate materials were then examined, including H-terminated Si(111), GaN(0001), graphene, GaSe(111), InP(111) and InP(100) and In2Se3 and ZnSe buffered Si(111), InP(111), revealing the growth characteristics of Bi2Se3 on these different substrates. Based on these studied, we identified the best substrates for high quality epitaxial Bi2Se3(111) films to be roughened InP(111)A. In addition, vicinal substrates were also tested demonstrating their advantageous over the flat ones. Our films have been requested by a number of groups worldwide for transport and optical measurements, revealing new properties and physics. For heteroepitaxy of Bi2Se3, the growth mode and strain profile were follow. Multiple quantum well or superlattice heterostructures were realized also. Another important aspect of experimental work is the realization of high-index films, on which anisotropic Dirac cone was unveiled. Ca and Cr doping in epitaxial Bi2Se3 were attempted. We identified the tendency of Ca clustering in Bi2Se3, which explained the under-doping effect of Ca in Bi2Se3. Finally, transport and optical studies of Bi2Se3 films were carried out in collaborations with groups locally in Hong Kong and outside (i.e., in mainland China, USA and France). Except for magnetic capping, which was under experimented due to our unforeseen extension of the growth experiments and studies to high-index Bi2Se3(221) films and our concern of contamination of the UHV by magnetic elements (which would be detrimental to high quality intrinsic films for transport and optical studies), we have achieved fully or more of the objectives laid out in the original proposal.

706110.label: Major findings and research outcome
706110.value: The main findings of project include: - the revelation of the variation of growth characteristics of Bi2Se3 depending on the substrates used [4, 12] (the number in the bracket refers to the sequential No. of the listed journal publication in Part C). On Si(111), we adopted the two-step growth method and used a vicinal substrate to achieve improved quality of epitaxial Bi2Se3 films, which showed reduced background doping and enhanced electron mobility [1, 12]; - single domain Bi2Se3 was achieved on InP(111)A substrate. It suggested the selection of superior substrates for epitaxy of layered materials in general, such as Bi2Se3 and others [11, 12] - hetero-structures incorporating Bi2Se3 in the matrix of ordinary insulators, such as In2Se3, ZnSe, were successfully grown. We revealed the growth mode and strain relaxation processes in such heteroepitaxial systems [2, 3]; - high-index Bi2Se3(221) films were successfully achieved using InP(100) substrate, in which anisotropic topological states on surface were revealed [9, 12]; - Ca and Cr-doping in Bi2Se3 were experimented. We identified the effect of Ca clustering, which could be the potential cause of under-doping by Ca in Bi2Se3 [7 and item 5 in the conference list in Pt. C]; - high-field linear magnetoresistance in both Bi2Se3(111) and (221) were uncovered by transport measurement [6, 10]. An anomalous anisotropic magnetoresistance in Bi2Se3 as well as an interplay between topological insulator and superconductor were discovered [5, 8].

706110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
706110.value: The strain effect on the surface states in topological insulators is an area of great fundamental interest and demands for extensive future explorations. Recently, there have already been reports of local strain effect, such as in the vicinity of a dislocation, as well as some theoretical studies of such strain effect. Experimentally, it is very challenging but critical to achieve uniformly strained films. Our success in achieving high index film on InP(100) may suggest a potentially viable route that is worthy of experimental attention. Another front is the MBE growth and surface characterizations of other types of quantum materials such as topological crystalline insulators. Indeed, MBE is a viable method to realize different faces of a crystalline film, for example, which makes the study of electronic properties of such quantum materials as a function of crystalline orientation possible.

706110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
706110.value: Bi2Se3 belongs to a newly discovered family of quantum materials, i.e., the topological insulator (TI), that promises for future electronic applications with high information processing speed but low energy consumption. Realization of such TI thin films is of primary importance for physical property explorations and for device applications. This study aimed to grow Bi2Se3 films in a more controlled environment using the method of molecular-beam epitaxy so as to obtain high quality samples. In this project, we identified the superior substrate and developed unconventional growth strategies to realize high quality epitaxial Bi2Se3 films. For the first time, we also achieved the high-index Bi2Se3(221) film, on which anisotropic surface states were discovered. We further realized heterostructures by stacking Bi2Se3 with ordinary insulators such as In2Se3 and ZnSe, which would show interesting properties. Our transport studies of the samples unveiled an array of new phenomena and properties, which are of fundamental interests as well as application potentials. All of these marked great contributions to the development of topological insulator research.

706310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
706310.value: Amphiphilic molecules represent an interesting and important class of compounds. They self-assemble in solvents because of the differential solvation of the hydrophilic and hydrophobic functionalities to yield various tertiary structures and assemblies. Inspired by the supramolecular structures found in nature, the design and construction of synthetic amphiphiles is challenging and may lead to an understanding of the different factors that are involved in directing their formation and give new insights in the development of materials with unique and previously unattainable properties. Despite numerous studies on amphiphilic organic chromophoric dyes and polymers, amphiphilic metal-containing chromophoric molecules and polymers are relatively much less explored. With our recent discovery of a robust class of luminescent Au(III) complexes that shows strong room-temperature phosphorescence and capability of displaying excimeric emission, it is envisaged that Au(III), with its preference for square-planar geometry, would serve as ideal chromophoric units for the construction of amphiphilic phosphorescent metal complexes. Thus an exploration of the spectroscopic and luminescence properties of amphiphilic Au(III) complexes and their supramolecular assemblies would represent a challenging area of research. In this project, novel classes of amphiphilic Au(III) complexes will be designed and synthesized. With the fine-tuning of the amphiphilicity at various length scales, supramolecular assemblies with different morphologies and superstructures could be obtained. The spectroscopic, electronic absorption and luminescence properties of amphiphilic Au(III) complexes in various media will be explored. It is envisaged that introduction of amphiphilic character into the metal complexes would lead to interesting spectroscopic features both in the UV-vis and emission spectra that are sensitive to changes in the microenvironment. Attempts will also be made to explore the possibility of these amphiphilic complexes in displaying liquid crystalline and organogelating properties. Attempts will also be made to correlate the spectroscopic, electronic absorption and luminescence properties of the metal complexes with the intermolecular interactions, structural and electronic aspects of the ligands, as well as their supramolecular assemblies, nanostructures and morphologies. Extension of the work to other isoelectronic metal complex system will also be made for systematic comparison studies. The proposed project should contribute not only to the design and synthesis of amphiphilic Au(III) complexes and the basic understanding of their spectroscopic properties, but also would serve to provide model studies for the understanding of the different factors that govern the interplay of various intermolecular forces involved, which may provide insights into the utilization of these interactions for supramolecular assembly and construction of functional materials. 兩親性分子代表了一類有趣並且重要的化合物。由於親水性基團和疏水性基團不同的溶劑化效應，兩親性分子能夠在溶劑中進行自組裝，並且形成多種三維結構和組裝形式。受到自然界超分子結構的啟發，設計並構建人工合成的兩親性分子具有很大的挑戰性。它能夠讓我們理解導致自組裝形成的不同因素，並且在發展以往做不到和具有獨特性質的材料方面提供了新的視角。雖然兩親性有機染料分子以及聚合物得到了大量的研究，但是兩親性的含有金屬的生色團分子和聚合物的研究則相對較少。最近，我們研究發現了一類很穩定的金（III）金屬發光配合物。這類分子在室溫下具有很強的磷光，並且能夠產生受激二聚物的發光。由於金（III）偏好平面四方形配位元結構，我們可以預見，金（III）配合物為構築兩親性磷光金屬配合物提供了一個很理想的生色單元。因此，關於兩親性金（III）配合物的波譜和發射光譜的探討，及其超分子組裝性能研究是一個具有挑戰性的研究領域。在本項目中，我們將設計合成一系列新穎的兩親性金（III）金屬配合物。通過對兩親性單元長度的精細調控，我們可以得到具有不同形貌和超結構的超分子組裝體。我們還將研究兩親性金（III）配合物在不同介質中的波譜，電子吸收光譜和發射光譜。可以預見，兩親性單元的引入將會導致有趣的紫外-可見光吸收光譜和發射光譜性質，使他們能夠感應微環境的改變。此外，我們還將探索此類兩親性金屬配合物在液晶和有機凝膠中應用的可能性。研究金屬配合物的電子吸收光譜和發射光譜同分子間相互作用，配體的結構和電子特性，以及超分子自組裝，納米結構和形貌之間的相關性。我們還將拓展到其他等電子金屬配合物體系來作系統性的對比研究。本專案的主旨不僅在於兩親性金（III）金屬配合物的設計和合成，以及對光譜性質的基本理解；它還為控制各種分子間相互作用的不同因素提供了模型研究，對利用這些相互作用進行超分子組裝和功能材料的構建提供更為深刻的見解。

706310.label: Realisation of objectives
706310.value: Various functionalized organic donor ligands, polymers/block copolymers, and gold precursor complexes have been synthesized, and the ligands and polymers/block copolymers have been incorporated into the gold precursor complexes to give amphiphilic gold(III) complexes and polymers. Other related amphiphilic platinum(II) complexes of the functionalized organic donor ligands and polymers/block copolymers have also been synthesized and characterized. All the gold(III) and platinum(II) complexes have been well characterized and shown to exhibit rich luminescence behaviour. The spectroscopic, electronic absorption and luminescence properties of the newly synthesized metal complexes and polymers have been studied, and their supramolecular assembly properties and their possibility of displaying liquid crystalline and organogelating properties have also been explored. The effects of solvents and microenvironments on the spectroscopic, electronic absorption and luminescence properties of the metal complexes and polymers have been studied in detail. Attempts have been made to correlate the spectroscopic, electronic absorption, luminescence and other functional properties of the metal complexes and polymers with the intermolecular interactions, structural and electronic aspects of the ligands, as well as their supramolecular assemblies, and the possibility of employing them for the construction of nanostructured materials has also been explored. Other related polynuclear gold(I) complexes have also been explored, designed and synthesized. Specifically, new classes of amphiphilic gold(III) complexes of mono-anionic 6-phenyl-2,2'-bipyridine (C^N^N) ligands, di-anionic bis-cyclometalated diarylpyridine (C^N^C) ligands, and di-anionic 2,6-bis(benzimidazol-2’-yl)pyridine (N^N^N) ligands and have been successfully synthesized and some of them have been shown to exhibit supramolecular assembly properties and organogelating behaviour as well as luminescence behaviour that could be perturbed by modulation of their self-assembly properties. The gelation and self-assembly properties have been investigated in detail through variable-temperature UV-vis absorption and emission studies, and the morphologies of the gels and nano-assemblies have also been characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Extension of the work to the study of other related isoelectronic systems, such as the amphiphilic platinum(II) system, and the related gold(I) system has been made and their supramolecular assembly properties have also been explored for comparison studies. Some of them have been shown to display rich luminescence properties as well as electrostatic assembly and supramolecular interactions that could be exploited for the sensing and detection of biological substrates or for the construction of ordered Langmuir-Blodgett films. The outcome of the project has led to a number of publications in international SCI journals, invitations to contribute review articles, cover pages, book chapters, plenary and invited lectures at international conferences, and training of a Ph.D. student. Realization of these important findings should give rise to important information and insights to the understanding of the fine balance and the interplay of amphiphilicity of the metal complexes, the nature of the metal centres (Pt(II) versus Au(III) versus Au(I)), intermolecular interactions, structural and electronic aspects of the ligands, solvents and microenvironments, for the rational design of their supramolecular assemblies and nanostructures.

706310.label: Major findings and research outcome
706310.value: Various target amphiphilic gold(III) complexes, polymers and block copolymers with hydrophobic and hydrophilic groups as well as various solubilizing groups have been successfully synthesized. Some of them have been demonstrated to undergo self-assembly and to exhibit organogelation behaviour. Their electronic absorption and luminescence behaviour have also been studied. Specifically, a new class of amphiphilic luminescent bis-cyclometalated alkynylgold(III) complexes of di-anionic bis-cyclometalated diarylpyridine (C^N^C) ligands has been synthesized and characterized; some of them are demonstrated to exhibit gelation properties driven by π-π stacking and hydrophobic-hydrophobic interactions. The gelation properties have been investigated in detail through variable-temperature UV-vis absorption and emission studies, and the morphology of the gels has been characterized by SEM and TEM. The fine balance and the interplay of the non-covalent interactions in these gelators could be readily modified by the judicious choice and rational design of the coordinating ligands in the organometallic system (Inorg. Chem. 2013, 52, 558-567 (highlighted as Front Cover)). Some of them also exhibit rich electroluminescence behaviour (Inorg. Chem. 2013, 52, 12713-12725). In addition, a new class of luminescent gold(III) complexes of mono-anionic 6-phenyl-2,2'-bipyridine (C^N^N) ligands has been successfully synthesized and studied (Inorg. Chem. 2012, 51, 7537-7545). Another highly novel class of amphiphilic gold(III) complexes of di-anionic 2,6-bis(benzimidazol-2’-yl)pyridine (N^N^N) ligands has been successfully synthesized, and shown to exhibit supramolecular assembly properties and organogelating behaviour that could be perturbed by modulation of their self-assembly properties (Chem. Eur. J. 2014, accepted for publication (highlighted as Back Cover)). The gelation and self-assembly properties have been investigated through variable-temperature UV-vis absorption and emission studies, and their morphologies characterized by SEM and TEM. Extension of the work to the study of other related isoelectronic systems, such as the amphiphilic platinum(II) system, and the related gold(I) system (Chem. Eur. J. 2014, 20, 304-310; Inorg. Chem. 2014, 53, 3854-3863) has been made and their supramolecular assembly properties have also been explored for comparison studies. Some of them have been shown to display rich luminescence properties as well as electrostatic assembly and supramolecular interactions that could be exploited for the sensing and detection of biological substrates such as enzymes (Chem. Commun. 2011, 47, 2000-2002 (Selected as Hot Article)) and proteins (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2011, 133, 18775-18784). A new class of amphiphilic platinum(II) 2,6-bis(benzimidazol-2'-yl)pyridine complexes has been demonstrated to show interesting assembly-disassembly process and morphological transformation of the nanostructures (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2011, 133, 12136-12143). These changes can be systematically controlled by the variation of solvent composition and could readily be probed by UV-vis absorption, emission, NMR, TEM and even with naked eyes. Luminescent amphiphilic platinum(II) complexes of 2,6-bis(1,2,3-triazol-4-yl)pyridine (N^N^N) have been synthesized and shown to be capable of forming ordered Langmuir-Blodgett films (Chem. Eur. J. 2013, 19, 14496-14505). Dissolution of the various Au(III) and Pt(II) complexes in solvents of different polarity or in good or poor solvents has been made to strongly perturb the microenvironment around the complexes, giving rise to supramolecular assemblies and superstructures that led to interesting electronic absorption, luminescence and morphological behaviour. Correlation of the spectroscopic, electronic absorption, luminescence and other functional properties of the metal complexes with the amphiphilicity of the metal complexes, the nature of the metal centres (Pt(II) versus Au(III) versus Au(I)), intermolecular interactions, structural and electronic aspects of the ligands, solvents and microenvironments, as well as their supramolecular assemblies and nanostructures have been made (Acc. Chem. Res. 2011, 44, 424-434 (invited article; highlighted as Cover Page); Chem. Commun. 2011, 47, 11579-11592 (invited Highlight article in celebration of International Year of Chemistry); RSC Polym. Chem. Ser. No. 2, Mol. Des. Appln. Photofunct. Polym. Mater., 2012, 245-286; Comprehensive Inorg. Chem. II, 2013, 8, 59-130 (invited article)).

706310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
706310.value: At least several areas may be identified. First, the work forms the basis for the study of new classes of amphiphilic gold(III) and transition metal-ligand chromophoric complexes, polymers and block copolymers that will give rise to desirable supramolecular assemblies and nanostructures. The utilization of luminescent metal complexes that can undergo induced assembly via various non-covalent interactions, especially solvophilic and solvophobic interactions, is particularly interesting and novel in that it may serve as the basis for the design of novel classes of supramolecular assemblies, metallogels and nanostructures. Second, the controlled assembly brought about by a change in the solvent and microenvironment is particularly attractive. These may generate changes in the spectroscopic and luminescence properties and their morphologies. Thus one can envisioned the future development of these classes of compounds for applications in ordered assemblies, responsive probes and materials with tunable optical and excited state properties.

706310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
706310.value: Novel classes of metallogels, supramolecular assemblies and nanostructures based on amphiphilic gold(III) and other transition metal-ligand complexes, polymers and block copolymers have been synthesized and characterized. Unique spectroscopic and luminescence changes based on various non-covalent interactions including solvophilic and solvophobic interactions have been observed in these systems. Correlations on the spectroscopic, electronic absorption, luminescence and other functional properties of the metal complexes with the amphiphilicity of the metal complexes, the nature of the metal centres (Pt(II) versus Au(III) versus Au(I)), intermolecular interactions, structural and electronic aspects of the ligands, solvents and microenvironments, as well as their supramolecular assemblies and nanostructures have been made, which should give insight into their property-structure relationship important for the future design of novel classes of metallogels and supramolecular assemblies. The outcome of the project has led to a number of publications in international refereed SCI journals and plenary and invited lectures at international conferences. The works of one Ph.D. student was associated with the project. The student has already successfully completed her Ph.D. study and graduated. Realization of these important findings should give rise to important information and insights to the future design of novel types of metallogels, ordered assemblies and nanostructures, as well as responsive probes and materials with tunable optical and excited state properties.

706410.label: Realisation of objectives
706410.value: We have developed a a rhodol-based probe named HKYellow and its cell-permeable form HKYellow-AM with fluorescence excitation and emission wavelengths at 547 nm and 570 nm, respectively, for sensitive and selective detection of peroxynitrite in multiple cell lines and primary cells. An impressive 93-fold fluorescence turn-on response of HKYellow was observed toward 1 equiv peroxynitrite treatment, much higher response than that toward potentially interfering hydroxyl radical or hypochlorous acid. Moreover, a ratiometric fluorescent probe, FRET-1, comprising a coumarin and rhodol as the fluorescence donor and acceptor, respectively, has been found to exhibit dual fluorescence responses at both 470 nm and 535 nm upon peroxynitrite addition, and therefore can be exploited for ratiometric detection and imaging of peroxynitrite. Based on this design principle, we then generated three new FRET probes (HJ-2-118, HJ-2-124, HJ-3-163) which attempt to address FRET-1’s limitations in cellular retention, photo-transfer efficiency, and quenching of donor fluorophore (coumarin). To our delight, in chemical characterization, the probes showed improved sensitivity over FRET-1, and ratiometric properties that can be further validated in cellular systems. To overcome the drawbacks of our previously published BODIPY probe HKOCl-1, we have developed new-generation green fluorescent probes, HKOCl-2 series. HKOCl-2 shows excellent sensitivity and selectivity for detecting HOCl, and more importantly, the fluorescent product of HKOCl-2 is much more stable than that of HKOCl-1. Green fluorescent probe HKOCl-2b has been reliably exploited in detection of endogenous hypochlorous acid produced in human and mouse macrophages stimulated with PMA or yeast zymosan. More recently, we have discovered a new switch motif for HOCl detection and developed ultrasensitive green fluorescent probe HKOCl-3 and yellow fluorescent probe HKOCl-yellow. Those new probes are being validated in cellular systems. We used HKGreen-4A, our fourth-generation peroxynitrite probe, to establish methodologies for peroxynitrite detection and imaging in live cells and tissues. The roles of peroxynitrite in host-pathogen interactions in immune defense and free radical-mediated tissue injury in metabolic dysfunction were scrutinized in the contexts of bacterial infection and atherosclerosis, respectively. So far, in sensors literature, the kinetics of peroxynitrite induction following bacterial infection remains unknown. We address this by using a mouse macrophage cellular model (RAW264.7 cells) of Gram-negative bacterial infection to characterize the time course of peroxynitrite formation in the immune cells challenged with different pharmacological and bacterial stimulants.

706410.label: Major findings and research outcome
706410.value: HKGreen-4A, our fourth-generation green peroxynitrite probe, has recently been successfully concluded as a manuscript submitted to J. Am. Chem. Soc. It is currently under minor revisions and the revised version will be submitted before July 5, 2014. The current manuscript reports on our findings on the probe’s high selectivity and sensitivity in chemical characterization, the kinetics of endogenous peroxynitrite formation induced by bacterial infection (E. coli), and the enzymatic pathways involved. In addition, we report the newly established methodology of live tissue staining with HKGreen-4A in an ApoE-KO mouse model of atherosclerosis. Using HKGreen-4 as the probe, we have established a cell based assay system for the detection of peroxynitrite with flow cytometry and 96-well plates. Several manuscripts on HKGreen-4 and its derivatives for improved performance in cell imaging are in preparation. HKOCl-2, a series of second-generation BODIPY hypochlorous acid probes designed to address the limitations of a previous probe HKOCl-1, has been published Organic Letters (June 2014). In this report, we demonstrated that HKOCl-2 probes are superior to HKOCl-1 in three aspects of comparison: selectivity, sensitivity and chemo-stability. More recently, we have discovered a new switch motif for HOCl detection and developed ultrasensitive green fluorescent probe HKOCl-3 and yellow fluorescent probe HKOCl-yellow. Manuscripts summarizing those two new probes are in preparation. We have collaborated with Prof. Hidehiko Nakagawa (Graduate School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Nagoya City University, Japan) on the use of our fluorescent probe HKGreen-3 in development of two peroxynitrite donors. The results have been published in Chem. Commun. (2011) and J. Am. Chem. Soc. (2012). We have collaborated with Prof. Massimo Delledonne (Dipartimento di Biotecnologie, Università degli Studi di Verona, Italy) on the use of our fluorescent probe HKGreen-2 in the first detection of peroxynitrite in plants. The result has been published in Nitric Oxide (2011). We have been collaborating with Dr. Jian-Gang Shen (School of Chinese Medicine, The University of Hong Kong) on the use of our probes HKYellow-AM in detection of peroxynitrite in neuronal cells under hypoxia condition. A manuscript on this work is in preparation.

706410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
706410.value: Based on our success of developing green and red fluorescent probes for detection of peroxynitrite and hypochlorous acid in cells and tissues, we plan to focus on the design and synthesis of fluorescent probes that can be used for in vivo detection of peroxynitrite and hypochlorous acid in living animals. In addition, we will also explore further applications of our probes in elucidating the biological roles of peroxynitrite and hypochlorous acid in development using zebrafish models.

706410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
706410.value: Peroxynitrite (ONOO–) is a potent oxidizing and nitrating species implicated in numerous diseases including diabetes, stroke, cancer, and neurodegenerative disorders. Another important ROS (reactive oxygen species), hypochlorous acid (HOCl), figures prominently in innate immune response against microbial infections, but potentially contributes to pathological conditions such as atherosclerosis and Alzheimer's disease. Rapid and accurate detection of ONOO– and HOCl has been challenging due to their transient nature and difficulty of achieving high selectivity and sensitivity for single ROS in probe design. Thus far, many existing probes for these species are either employing green-emission fluorophores or possessing insufficient selectivity and/or sensitivity for single ROS detection in live cell or tissues. We have developed the highly selective and sensitive HKRed-1 and HKYellow as red and yellow probes for cellular ONOO– detection, respectively. The ratiometric probe FRET-1 and analogs have been successfully developed for exploration in quantitative ONOO– detection. A HKOCl-2 series of green HOCl probes has been designed to address practical limitations of our previously published HKOCl-1. In biological applications, we used a green ONOO– probe HKGreen-4A to define the kinetics of ONOO– formation in mouse macrophages during bacterial infection, and establish a method for live tissue ONOO– staining in atherosclerotic mice

706710.label: Project Title(Chinese)
706710.value: 雙線性因子二維數據模型及其應用

706710.label: Project Objectives
706710.value: In this project, we will develop novel statistical models to perform bilinear factor analysis (BFA) for 2D data. The models will exhibit the following advantages over conventional FA: (1) BFA explicitly involves column and row covariance matrices for 2D data; (2) BFA can overcome the curse of dimensionality problem. Practically efficient estimation methods for fitting bilinear factor models for 2D data will be developed. Both likelihood approach based on Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithms and Bayesian approach have been considered for FA for 1D data in the literature and they are worthy of consideration for FA for 2D data. In addition to the EM algorithms, the fast conditional maximization (CM) algorithm proposed by Zhao, Yu and Jiang (2008), which always outperforms the EM in all their simulation studies, will also be considered. Theoretical properties of maximum likelihood estimators of model parameters will be studied. Model selection to determine the numbers of factors via constructing likelihood ratio test and Bayesian information Criterion (BIC) will be examined. To provide a better interpretation of row and column factor loadings matrices, factor rotation methods similar to the varimax method used for 1D data will be considered. To handle more sophisticated data structures, several promising extensions of the proposed bilinear factor models including sparse extensions, mixtures extensions, robust extensions and high-order extensions will be investigated. The proposed bilinear factor models will be applied to several real world data sets to address problems related to dimension reduction, statistical classification and clustering.

706710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
706710.value: Factor analysis is a powerful tool to uncover the latent common characteristics (or factors) among a set of variables. However, factor analysis is simply designed for one-dimensional (1D) data, where each datum is represented as a vector, and few research works have been devoted to the factor analysis for two-dimensional (2D) data, where each datum is represented as a matrix. Nowadays, massive applications naturally yield 2D data. The following lists two real examples of 2D data: Data 1. In the water research study by Ouyang (2005), observations consist of water quality variables such as water temperature, water PH value, oxygen concentration, nitrogen concentration, etc., measured at 22 water quality monitoring stations in a river annually from 1999 to 2001. Such data can naturally be represented in the form of a matrix with columns being water quality variables and rows being monitoring stations, each matrix for one year. Data 2. In image processing or computer vision (Xie et al., 2008), images or image patches, where columns and rows are lists of pixels, are collected for various reasons such as image compression, pattern recognition, etc. Conventional treatments to perform factor analysis for 2D data include, for instance, stacking up the columns of each 2D data matrix and then applying standard factor analysis to the resulting 1D data. However, this will abandon the dependency pattern in the 2D data and hence more compact and useful representation of the original 2D data in matrix form may be lost. In this project, novel statistical models named bilinear factor models for 2D data using the original matrix form will be proposed to provide flexible factor dependency structures for row and column variables and to allow for a wider range of applications. Model estimation via Bayesian and maximum likelihood methods will be developed. Properties of maximum likelihood estimators of model parameters and the problem of model selection will be studied. Several promising extensions of the proposed models will be considered. Applications of the proposed methodologies to analyse several real-world datasets in air pollution, pattern recognition, disease inflection and image clustering will be investigated. 因子分析是一個功能強大的工具來發掘在一組變量中潛在的共同特點（或因素）。然而，因子分析只是為一維（1D）數據而設計，其中每個數據都表示為一個向量。很少研究工作致力發展於二維（2D）數據的因子分析，其中每個數據被表示為一個矩陣。如今，大量的應用自然地產生出二維數據。下面列出了兩個二維數據的真實例子： 數據 1：在Ouyang(2005) 的水研究中，觀測數據包括在1999至2001年期間每年在河流中22個水質監測站所量度出水質變量，如水溫，水的PH值，氧濃度，氮濃度等。這些數據可以很自然地形成一個矩陣，其中每列代表一水質變量而每行代表一監測站，與及每個矩陣為一年。 數據 2：在處理圖像或電腦視覺(Xie等, 2008)中，由於各種原因如圖像壓縮，模式識別等，所收集的圖像或圖像貼片裏，每張圖像數據的列和行是代表像素。 傳統用於二維數據來進行因子分析的方法包括疊起每個二維數據矩陣的所有列，然後利用傳統因子分析應用在所產生的一維數據中。然而，這將放棄依賴二維數據中的相關性，從而可能會損失對原本的二維矩陣數據的一些更簡潔和有用的表達形式。 在這個項目中，將建議一些用於以矩陣形式表示的二維數據的新穎統計模型，命名為雙線性因子模型，以提供對行和列變量靈活的相關性結構，並允許更廣泛的應用。通過發展貝葉斯和最大似然方法，可得出模型參數的估計。模型參數的最大似然估計的性質的和模型選擇的問題將加以研究。幾個關於所提出的模型的可行擴展將被考慮。本項目所提出的方法將應用來分析一些真實的數據集，包括空氣污染，模式識別，疾病感染和圖像聚類。

706710.label: Realisation of objectives
706710.value: 1. In Zhao, Yu, and Kwok (2012), we have (i) developed a novel statistical model called bilinear principal component analysis (BPPCA) to perform bilinear factor analysis (BFA) for 2D data; (ii) developed two efﬁcient parameter estimation algorithms for ﬁtting BPPCA；(iii) established the properties of maximum likelihood estimator of BPPCA; (iv) applied the proposed BPPCA model to several real world data sets for dimension reduction and statistical classification. (Objective 1) 2. We believe that it is better to study the model selection issue in BFA and the interpretation of row and column factor loadings in several separate papers. We have proposed a novel model selection criterion for classical Gaussian mixture models in Zhao, Jin and Shi (2014) and mixtures of factor analyzers in Zhao, Yu and Shi (2014). We plan to extend the idea of these two works to the model selection issue in BFA and the mixture extension of BFA. (Objectives 1 and 2) 3. We have extended the idea of BFA to discriminant analysis (Zhao, Yu, Shi and Li, 2012) and (Zhao, Shi and Zhu, 2014); to high frequency financial data analysis (Wang, Zhao and Yu, 2013). The other possible extensions including sparse extensions, mixtures extensions, robust extensions and high-order extensions are being investigated. (Objectives 2 and 3)

(ii) developed two efﬁcient parameter estimation algorithms for ﬁtting BPPCA, namely conditional maximization (CM) and alternating expectation conditional maximization (AECM) algorithms. (iii) established the properties of maximum likelihood estimator of BPPCA. Objective 2: (i) In Zhao, Yu, Shi and Li (2012), we have using the idea of bilinear factor analysis to discriminant analysis for 2D data, leading to a new framework called separable linear discriminant analysis. (ii) In Zhao, Shi and Zhu (2014), we have further extended the work of Zhao, Yu, and Kwok (2012) and Zhao, Yu, Shi and Li (2012), leading to a new and effective discriminant analysis method called two-stage regularized linear discriminant analysis. (iii) In Zhao, Jin and Shi (2014) and Zhao, Yu and Shi (2014), we have proposed a novel criterion called hierarchical BIC for the model selection in classical Gaussian mixture models. It is shown that hierarchical BIC is more accurate than the commonly used BIC. Extensions of these two works to BFA and mixtures of BFA will be investigated in the near future. (iv) In Yu and Zhao (2014), we have obtained a more efficient implementation of the CM algorithm for ML estimation of factor Analysis, which is a by-product of this project. Objective 3: (i) In Zhao, Yu, and Kwok (2012), we have applied the proposed BPPCA model to several real world data sets such as XM2VTS, AR, Iris to address problems related to dimension reduction and statistical classification. (ii) In Wang, Zhao and Yu (2013), we have extended the idea of BFA to high frequency financial data analysis.

706710.value: Factor analysis is a powerful tool to uncover the latent common characteristics among a vector of response variables (i.e., 1D data). However, few research works have been devoted to the factor analysis for two-dimensional (2D) data, where each datum is represented as a matrix. Nowadays, massive applications naturally yield 2D data such as images, realized covariance matrices and spatial-temporal data. In this project, we have developed novel statistical models named bilinear factor models for 2D data. Efficient parameter estimation and model selection algorithms have been developed. The methods have been successfully applied to several real world data sets to address problems related to dimension reduction and classification. The proposed methods have been further extended to develop new and effective discriminant analysis method and factor models for realized covariance matrices.

707010.value: To study the interplay between antiferromagnetism and superconductivity in the underdoped copper oxides by using renormalized mean field theory and phenomenological theory. To analyze and understand the local rotational symmetry breaking observed in STM experiments in copper oxides. The approach will be along the line of resonating valence bond theory, but will incorporate possible spontaneous or external symmetry breaking effects. To study the weight distribution in the underdoped copper oxides, in comparison with the recent ARPES data. To develop and apply the phenomenological theory for underdoped copper oxides to study other types of experiments.

707010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
707010.value: Since the first discovery of high temperature superconductors (HTSC) in 1986, these materials have attracted great interest. It is generally believed that the physics in this class of compounds is primarily in the CuO2 planes. In the undoped case such as La2CuO4, the system is an anti-ferromagnetic Mott insulator because of strong correlation effect induced by the dominant Coulomb interaction. By chemical doping, the static anti-ferromagnetic (AFM) order is destroyed. However, many experiments have shown that there is still strong short range AFM fluctuation and dynamical correlation in the system. The interplay between the AFM correlations and Cooper pair correlation is one of the most important and challenging issue in condensed matter physics. One of the best ways to study the correlation effect in the cuprates is to probe the electronic structure in the underdoped compounds. Angle resolved photo-emission spectroscopy (ARPES) and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) experiments are two very powerful techniques to investigate the electronic structure in the cuprates. The most recent experimental results have revealed a number of important new results in the pseudogap phase of the cuprates. In this proposal, we plan to apply our renormalized mean field theory and phenomenological Green's function theory I co-developed with my collaborators to study the recent experimental result. We would like to explain the unidirectional pattern in STM experiments, and the weight distribution in the ARPES experiments in particular. 高溫超導體(HTSC)自1986年首次被發現以來便引來極大關注。科學家普遍認為這類化合物中的物理性質主要集中在CuO2 的平面上。在無摻雜的情況下(如La2CuO4)，系統會由於受到有主導地位的庫倫相關作用影響而成為一個反鐵磁性莫特絶緣體系統。雖然透過化學摻雜，這種系統的靜態反鐵磁性(AFM)順序可被瓦解，但很多實驗證明系統中的强短距AFM波動及動態關聯仍然存在。反鐵磁性相關作用與庫柏對相關作用之間的相互作用是凝聚態物理學中最重要及最具挑戰性的問題之一。其中一個研究這種銅氧化物中的關聯效應的最佳方法是探討無摻雜化合物的電子結構，而角分辨光電子發射能譜(ARPES)和掃描穿隧顯微鏡(STM)則是兩項對研究銅氧化物的電子結構的非常有用的技術。最近的實驗結果已揭示了銅氧化物贋能隙中的一些重要的訊息。 在此計劃，我們將把我和我的合作伙伴共同研發的重整化平均場理論和唯象格林函數理論應用於這些近期的實驗結果上，並希望可以以上理論合理解釋掃描穿隧顯微鏡實驗結果中的單向排列性和角分辨光電子發射能譜實驗結果中的比重分布。

707010.label: Realisation of objectives
707010.value: In this project, the PI and his Ph. D. student, Kun Huang and research associate studied underdoped copper oxides, especially the pseudogap phase in that region. Part of the project was in close collaboration with Prof. T. M. Rice at ETH-Zurich. In particular, we studied Andreev reflection, Josephsosn tunnling, and a number of other experiments including photoemssion and scaning tunneling spectroscopy in underdoped cuprates by using a phenomenological theory in combining with renormalized mean field theory. Our results have been published in a Physical Review Letters (on Andreev reflection eperiment), and an EPL (Josephson tunneling), and a comprehansive long artilce published in Rep. Prog. Phys. The objectives are realized.

707010.label: Major findings and research outcome
707010.value: * We studied the Andreev and single-particle tunneling spectra of underdoped cuprate superconductors by a phenomenological theory in which the pseudogap is a precursor to the undoped Mott insulator. In the low barrier tunneling limit, the spectra are enhanced by Andreev reflection only within a voltage region of the small superconducting energy gap. In the high barrier tunneling limit, the spectra show a large energy pseudogap associated with single particle tunneling. Our theory semiquantitatively describes the two gap behavior observed in tunneling experiments. (PRL 105, 167004, 2010) * We reviewed the motivation underlying the phenomenological ansatz, based on analogies to the approach to Mott localization at weak coupling in lower dimensional systems, has been proposed by Yang et al (2006 Phys. Rev. B 73 174501) and had successfully describing a range of experiments. The implications for a more microscopic theory are studied together with the relation to theories that start directly from microscopic strongly coupled Hamiltonians. (Rep. Prog. Phys. 75, 016502, 2012) * We examined the Josephson coupling between optimally cuprate superconductors separated by a spacer with a finite-energy cooperon excitation. We found that for an underdoped-cuprate barrier in its normal state, the YRZ model gives a good description of the temperature-dependent enhanced Josephson coupling and a detailed examination of the origin of the enhancement shows a significant contribution from the cooperon excitation which is comparable to that from nodal quasiparticles. (EPL, 99, 24002, 2012)

707010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
707010.value: Physics of underdoped copper oxides is very rich. The phenomenological theory for pseudogap phase of the underdoepd copper oxides has provided a framework to study the physics. Further development and comparision with experiments are needed to advance our understanding of this topic.

707010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
707010.value: Superconductivity is a macroscopic phenomenon, in which electric resistance vanishes suddenly below a critical transition temperature. The transition temperature is usually very low, which has greatly limited the application of superconductivity. Copper oxides have the highest superconducting transition temeprature. This has stimulated many scientists to search for higher transition temperature materials. One of the important questions is why copper oxdies are so special. Superconducting cuprate is at the boundary of antiferromagnetic Mott insulator, a type of insulator due to electorn repulsive interaction. Underdoped cuprate is near the insulating phase, and is most interesting and important to reveal the underlying physics of high temperature superconductivity. In this project, we studied a phenomenological theory to describe underdoped pseudogap phase and applied the theory to study transport and spectroscopic experiments and the theoretical calculations are in good comparison with many experiments.

707210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
707210.value: The Paleoproterozoic crustal evolution of the western Yangtze Block, South China is important for the reconstruction of the supercontinent Columbia but is poorly known. We have recently confirmed that the lower Kunyang Group, originally thought to be ~1.0 Ga old, has ages as old as 1.7Ga. These strata, now called the Dongchuan Group, provide a rare opportunity to investigate the Paleoproterozoic crustal evolution of South China. Currently, the precise ages and provenance of the group are not well understood and its temporal and spatial distributions are unknown. We will conduct detailed field and laboratory work on the rocks of the Dongchuan Group, including whole-rock major and trace element analyses, and zircon U-Pb, Hf and O isotopic analyses. The aims of this study are: 1) to determine the precise ages of the strata; 2) to provide geochemical constraints on their provenance; 3) to understand their geodynamic setting, 4) to compare strata of the same age from South China and other continents and 5) ultimately to yield information about the possible role of the Yangtze Block in the re-construction of the Columbia supercontinent. This work will assist in establishing an integrated model for the tectonic evolution of the western Yangtze Block and shed light on the relationship of the Yangtze Block and its equivalents elsewhere. 华南扬子西缘古元古地壳演化的研究对于哥伦比亚超大陆的重建有着非常重要的意义，但是其演化过程还不清楚。我们最近的年代学研究表明原来普遍认为形成于10亿年的下昆阳群（现被解体为东川群）的年龄应该是17亿年。因此，东川群是华南少有的研究古元古地壳的对象。但是其精确沉积年龄、成因及时空分布仍不清楚。在这项研究中，我们将会进行详细的野外调查和室内研究（包括主量、微量元素，锆石U-Pb同位素定年及Hf，O同位素示踪），以期解决下列问题：1）确定地层的沉积时间；2）东川群成因的地球化学制约；3）形成的构造背景；4）对比华南和其他大陆相同时代地层；5）利用取得的数据重建扬子板块在哥伦比亚大陆中的位置。这项研究将帮助建立扬子板块西缘的构造演化模型，并更好的认识扬子板块和其他地区等同地体之间的关系。

707210.label: Realisation of objectives
707210.value: This project involved three post-graduate students, Wei Chen, Baiqiu Wang and Wei Wang. These students were essential for obtaining the datasets and field excursions as they received training. Two major field seasons were included during the investigation. In August 2010, group members spent three weeks in the Dongchuan area, southwestern Yangtze Block to examine typical outcrop of Paleoproterozoic to Mesoproterozoic strata and associated Fe-Cu mineral deposits. In the summer of 2011, two students together with postdoctor Dr Xin-Fu Zhao went to investigate some major Fe-Cu deposits and strata succesions. Zhou joined their field trip for two weeks, in order to provide guidance. Key outcrops are examined and some samples were collected. We have also obtained sufficient analyses necessary for the research. Then the students and postdoctor attended the 34th international geology conference held in Brisbane 2012. Dr Zhao presented talk and two students presented posters related to this project to the conference. Although insufficient funds, the work has been progressing with a lot of new ideas and new analytical data. This is evidenced by a large number of publications in the highly ranked international journals. Specifically both the Paleoproterozoic to Mesoproterozoic strata, e.g., the Dongchuan and Hekou groups and their relationship to the breakup of the supercontinent Columbia are now much better known and provide examples for comparison of contemporary successions around the world. There are many major findings in this projects that are linked with the original objectives. We did not have major problems during the study.

707210.label: Major findings and research outcome
707210.value: The project was very productive, despite the limited funds were available. The major findings include the following aspects: 1. Field correlation of the Paleoproterozoic to Mesoproterozoic rifting successions in the southwestern Yangtze Block The sedimentary basement in the southwestern (SW) Yangtze Block was poorly mapped in the past due to sparse outcrops in the area. Our work established the order of sedimentary successions in the SW Yangtze Block for the first time. Traditionally thought Archean to early Paleoproterozoic sedimentary basement, the Dahongshan Group, is actually Paleoproterozoic to early Mesoproterozoic in age (~1.7-1.5 Ga), and is comparable to the Hekou and Dongchuan groups in terms of age, lithology and sedimentology (Chen et al., 2013; Wang et al., 2014; Zhao et al., 2010). These contemporary sedimentary strata were interpreted to be rifting successions related to the breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, confirming the linkage between the Yangtze Block and the Columbia supercontinent. 2 . Reconstruction of the Yangtze Block in the supercontinent Columbia Although the Yangtze Block has been thought to be possibly linked to the assembly and breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, yet the paleogeography reconstruction of the Yangtze Block was loosely constrained. Based on comprehensive comparison of coeval rifting-related sedimentation and magmatism among continents that were involved in the assembly and breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, the Yangtze Block was placed in a triangle framework and was connected to north Australia and northwestern Laurentia in the reconstruction of the Columbia supercontinent (Chen et al., 2013; Wang et al., 2014). 3. Petrogenesis and tectonic implications of late Mesoproterozoic mafic volcanic rocks in the southwestern Yangtze Block, SW China. In order to understand the evolution of the Yangtze Block after the breakup of the supercontinent Columbia, we examine Mesoproterozoic mafic voclanic rocks in the area. We documented that the ~1050 Ma metabasalts in the Julin Group, SW China have tholeiitic compositions, and were derived from a depleted asthenospheric mantle source followed by significant fractional crystallization and crustal contaminations. They have geochemical affinity of within-plate basalts, and were suggested to have formed in a continental rift (Chen et al., 2013). Both the metabasalts and associated sedimentary rocks in the Julin Group indicate a shallow marine environment likely on a passive continental margin. Our work does not support the existence of a Grenvillian orogenic belt in the southwestern Yangtze Block, and thus there is no evidence that the Yangtze Block was located in the interior of the Rodinia supercontinent (Chen et al., 2014). 4.Studies of associated Fe-Cu deposit, Associated with the evolution of the Yangtze Block are a number of Fe-Cu deposits. The Lala Fe-Cu deposit, one of the largest deposits in the Kangdian IOCG metallogenic province, contains abundant magnetite and chalcopyrite with economic amounts of Au, Mo, REE, Co and P.We documented that Iron-copper ores formed in five stages, comparable to IOCG deposits elsewhere in the world. The main Fe-Cu mineralization stages (II and III) were formed at 1086 ± 8 Ma by a high temperature (385-430ºC) fluid of dominantly magmatic-hydrothermal origin, coeval with an igneous activity in an intra-plate environment. The sulfide-vein stage (IV) formed via remobilization of earlier mineral assemblages of Stages II and III at ~850 Ma by widespread Neoproterozoic tectonothermal activities in the region (Chen and Zhou, 2013.

707210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
707210.value: Our studies about these rifting successions and associated sulfide deposits were essentially carried out by the PhD students, Wei Chen and Wei Wang. The work concerns sedimentology and geochemistry of sedimentary rocks and their relationship to the formation of Fe-Cu mineral deposits. In addition to the work on the sedimentary strata, Chen also worked on the Paleoproterozoic to Mesoproterozoic igneous plutons with abundant geochemical data and new findings about the petrogenesis and tectonic affinity of these igneous rocks. The research results are to be submitted for publications. Moreover, we will carried out the studies regarding the late Mesoproterozoic sedimentary successions that are uncomfortably above the Paleoproterozoic to early Mesoproterozoic strata, in an order to reconstruct the Yangtze Block in the supercontinent cycle from Columbia to Rodinia.

707210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
707210.value: The Paleoproterozoic to Mesoproterozoic rifting successions in the southwestern Yangtze Block were investigated. The project was successful and has many achievements. Our work established the order of sedimentary successions in the SW Yangtze Block for the first time. The Dahongshan, Hekou and Dongchuan groups are contemporary sedimentary strata interpreted to be rifting successions related to the breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, confirming the linkage between the Yangtze Block and the Columbia supercontinent. Based on comprehensive comparison of coeval rifting-related sedimentation and magmatism among continents that were involved in the assembly and breakup of the Columbia supercontinent, the Yangtze Block was placed in a triangle framework and was connected to north Australia and northwestern Laurentia in the reconstruction of the Columbia supercontinent. In combination with our regional studies, we have also investigated some related Fe-Cu deposit, SW China and petrogenesis and tectonic implications of late Mesoproterozoic mafic volcanic rocks in the southwestern Yangtze Block, SW China. The study has resulted in numerous publications in top-ranked international journals. Two PhD students and one PDF were trained during the project.

710210.value: 加權流程時間最小化問題的具競爭性在線調度算法

710210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710210.value: Scheduling jobs that arrive on-line is a fundamental problem for many computer systems. It has been the focus of research for different communities, including the operating systems, database, networking and theory communities. Different scheduling algorithms lead to different quality and efficiency of the systems. For example, a web server using the first-come-first-served algorithm may process a request for a large web page while letting many requests for small web pages to wait. It results in slow response for all requests, which can actually be avoided by scheduling the small ones first. As another example, an operating system using round-robin may preempt interactive user tasks for background operations like virus scanning. It results in serious interruptions for the user tasks, which is undesirable and can be avoided by scheduling the user tasks first. The main objective of this theoretical research is to design new on-line scheduling algorithms with performance that can be mathematically proved to be good. The average weighted flow time is one of the most general measurements for the quality of a schedule. The flow time (also known as response time) of a job is the amount of time since its arrival until its completion. The weight of a job is a value allowing the users to indicate the importance of that job. For many years, the theoretical community has been searching for an algorithm which for any job sequence, produces a schedule with average weighted flow time close to that of the optimal schedule. An algorithm achieving this guarantee is said to be competitive. Some algorithms have been proposed, but their performance deteriorates, i.e., becomes further away from the optimal, when the variation in sizes or weights of the jobs increases. In 2009, we proved a surprising result that such deterioration is inherent for any deterministic algorithm. Nevertheless, the intuition built from the result suggests that randomized algorithms may be competitive by balancing the processing between jobs with large weights and jobs with large weight-to-size ratios. This research aims at formalizing this intuition and obtaining a competitive randomized on-line algorithm. It answers a classical problem in on-line scheduling and provides new insights and guarantees to practical applications. Then we extend the study to the on-line non-clairvoyant model, where the size of a job is unknown until it is completed, and the off-line model, where the complete input is known in advance. Finally, we evaluate our algorithms by experiments. 在線工作調度是電腦系統的一個基本問題。它一直是不同領域，例如操作系統，數據庫，網絡和理論界，的主要研究問題之一。調度算法的選擇是系統質量和效率的一個關鍵因素。例如，如果一個操作系統把背景病毒掃描調度於用戶互動程式之前，用戶將會受到嚴重的延誤和中斷, 而這是不可取的。又例如, 如果一個互聯網服務器始終把短小的網頁服務調度於較大的網頁之前，較大的網頁將會受到不公平的服務停滯。本研究的主要目標就是設計新而且可通過數學證明效率良好的調度算法。 加權流程時間是其中一種最常用的調度質量測量標準。流程時間是一件工作從到達到完成之間的所花時間。加權量是用戶對每件工作重要性的估計。多年來, 理論界一真在尋找一個算法，對於任何工作列，其調度結果的平均加權流程時間皆接近於最優調度。有些算法被提出了，但當工作的大小或加權量的變化增加時, 它們的效率則會惡化，即離最優調度越來越遠。在 2009 年，我們證明了一個令人意外的結果，發現這種惡化是所有確定性算法皆固有的。然而，從證明中所得的感覺，提議一個平衡較大工作和較重要工作 (即加權量和大小之比率較大的工作) 的隨機算法。本研究的目標是把這感覺具體化，並得到一個隨機算法，使得對於任何工作列，其預計平均加權流程時間皆接近於最優調度。然後我們會考慮線下問題，即工作列是預先知道的。線下算法有助於估計最優調度，讓我們可以對新的隨機算法的實際表現進行實驗。最後，我們會考慮系統的公平性。我們會研究平均平方加權流程時間，或更具一般性的加權流程時間的多次方的平均值。這些測量標準懲罰過長的流程時間，從而防止不公平的服務停滯。

710710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710710.value: With ever increasing concern on our environment, energy conservation and renewable energy are two key issues. Concerning energy conservation, it has been globally agreed that the use of electric vehicles for road transportation can significantly conserve our fossil fuels. Concerning renewable energy, the Council for Sustainable Development, Hong Kong has made a vision that wind power is the most attractive renewable energy source for Hong Kong. A common core to enhance energy conservation and renewable energy is the development of high-performance electric machines for electric vehicle (EV) propulsion and wind power (WP) generation. Actually, both applications desire the electric machines operating with a very wide speed range. Because of inherently high efficiency and high power density, permanent magnet (PM) machines have been widely adopted for industrial application. However, since the air-gap flux can hardly be controlled, they cannot provide the desired wide-speed operation for EV propulsion or WP generation. Recently, the concept of flux-mnemonic PM or "memory" motors has been proposed to control the air-gap flux. However, the PMs are prone to accidental demagnetization by armature reaction, and the process of its PM magnetization involves complex coordinate transformation of armature currents. Also, its complicated PM rotor is not mechanically robust enough to withstand high-speed or intermittent operation. In order to fully utilize the merits of flux-mnemonic PM motors while fundamentally solve the aforementioned problems, the proposed machine incorporates the idea of dual magnets, the concept of hybrid excitations and the use of solid rotor with no PMs or windings. The purpose of this proposal is to develop a novel flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine, and to explore its applications. The corresponding objectives are: (1) develop a novel flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine topology, which incorporates two kinds of PMs - one tunable and one nonerasable, hence offering high efficiency, high power density, high robustness, and immunity from accidental demagnetization; (2) develop a new electromagnetic field approach to analyze the proposed machine, which takes into account the hysteresis and eddy-current characteristics of PMs; (3) develop new control strategies for the proposed machine, hence achieving effective online magnetization and wide-speed operation for both motoring and generation; and (4) explore promising applications of the proposed machine that desire high efficiency, high power density, high robustness, high controllability and wide-speed operation, such as electric vehicles and wind generators. 隨著社會對環境問題的關注日益增強，節能和可再生能源成為兩大關鍵課題。在節能方面，採用電動汽車進行公路運輸節約化石能源已經成為全球共識。而在可再生能源方面，香港可持續發展委員會則明確提出風能是香港最具潛力的新能源。這兩者共同的技術核心在於設計高性能的電機來獲得高效率的電動汽車驅動以及風電能量轉換。與傳統電機不同，這兩種應用所需要的電機都要求滿足非常寬的調速範圍。 由於本身俱備高效率和高功率密度的優點，永磁電機已被廣泛應用於多個工業領域。但是永磁電機的氣隙磁通難於被控制，致使其不能滿足電動汽車驅動和風電能量轉換所需的寬調速範圍。近年來提出的磁通記憶永磁電機，也稱為記憶電機，可以實現對氣隙磁通的控制。不過記憶電機的永磁體容易因為電機的電樞反應而意外退磁，而且在充磁時也需要對電樞電流進行複雜的坐標變換，難以控制。不僅如此，其複雜的永磁轉子在高速或者斷續運行時不能提供足夠的機械強度。為了充分利用記憶電機的優點並從根本上解決上述不足，本項目提出一種新型磁通記憶雙永磁體電機，並探究其應用場合。具體的研究目標包括：（1）開發新型磁通記憶雙永磁體電機的結構，利用一種可調節和一種不可調節的兩種永磁體的相互配合來實現電機高效率、高功率密度、高機械強度，並可免於意外的退磁問題；（2）設計新的電磁場分析方法，在考慮磁滯和渦流特性的情況下對該電機進行分析；（3）針對該電機設計及控制策略，從而滿足電機在電動和發電兩種工作模式下均能有效的在線充磁、退磁和寬速度範圍調節；（4）探討該電機其他的應用場合，類似電動汽車和風力發電應用時需要高效率、高功率密度、高機械強度、高可控性和寬速度調節範圍運行要求的場合，使該電機得到更充分的利用，發揮更大的價值。

710710.label: Realisation of objectives
710710.value: The 1st objective has been fully achieved. By incorporating both the neodymium-iron-boron (Nd-Fe-B) and aluminum-nickel-cobalt (Al-Ni-Co) permanent magnet (PM) materials into the hybrid-field doubly-salient PM (DSPM) machine structure, a novel flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine topology is developed. With the use of a temporary current pulse to online tune the magnetization of Al-Ni-Co PMs, the machine can provide flexible air-gap flux control. Because of the use of Nd-Fe-B PMs to provide strong air-gap flux, it can maintain high efficiency and high power density. Due to the DSPM structure, the rotor is made of simple iron core which offers high robustness. Moreover, the Al-Ni-Co PMs are artfully located in such a way that they can readily be magnetized or demagnetized by the magnetizing winding while immune to accidental demagnetization by the armature reaction field. The 2nd objective has been fully achieved. A new finite-element electromagnetic field approach has been developed to analyze the flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine, which takes into account the hysteresis and eddy-current characteristics of PMs. Specifically, a new hysteresis model of the Al-Ni-Co PMs is proposed which can be incorporated into the time-stepping finite element method to perform both the steady-state and transient analyses of the proposed machine. The 3rd objective has been fully achieved. By applying a positive or negative temporary DC current pulse to properly magnetize or demagnetize the Al-Ni-Co PMs, the air-gap flux density of the proposed machine can be effectively online controlled for both motoring and generation. Additionally, the overall PM poles can be flexibly altered to realize the pole-changing control, hence achieving very wide speed operation. The 4th objective has been fully achieved. Because of the merits of high efficiency, high power density, high robustness, high controllability and wide-speed operation, the proposed machine is identified to be promising for application to in-wheel motors of electric vehicles, integrated-starter-generators for hybrid vehicles and wind generators for wind turbines.

710710.label: Major findings and research outcome
710710.value: The research outcome is very fruitful, namely 9 international journal papers [J1]-[J9] and 2 international conference papers [C1]-[C2]. Concerning the machine design, we have developed two new topologies of flux-mnemonic machines and their design methods. By incorporating the aluminum-nickel-cobalt (Al-Ni-Co) permanent magnets (PMs) into the doubly-salient PM (DSPM) machine structure, a new flux-mnemonic machine is proposed [J1], dubbed as the flux-mnemonic DSPM machine or DC-excited memory machine. Consequently, by further incorporating both the neodymium-iron-boron (Nd-Fe-B) and Al-Ni-Co PMs into the DSPM machine structure, a new flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine is proposed [C1], [J4], which is also dubbed as the dual-memory machine. The corresponding magnet proportioning criteria are analytically derived [J5]. Also, the design principles, including how to select the numbers of salient poles, how to size the PM areas and thicknesses and how to determine the rotor dimensions, are formulated [C2], [J6]. Concerning the machine analysis, we have developed a new approach to assess the proposed flux-mnemonic machines. Based on the hysteresis properties of the Al-Ni-Co PM material, a piecewise-linear hysteresis model is proposed [J2]. By incorporating this hysteresis model into the time-stepping finite element method, both the steady-state and transient performances of the flux-mnemonic DSPM machine can be analyzed. Then, it is extended to form the parallelogram hysteresis model for the analysis of the flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine [C1], [J4]. With the use of this hysteresis model, the forward and backward magnetization processes can be evaluated quantitatively [J5]. Concerning the machine control, we have developed two new control strategies of the flux-mnemonic machines. First, by applying a positive or negative temporary DC current pulse to magnetize or demagnetize the Al-Ni-Co PMs, the dual-mode control of the flux-mnemonic DSPM machine is proposed [J3]. Hence, it can be flexibly operated as a DSPM machine or as a switched reluctance (SR) machine. Moreover, a new pole-changing control approach is proposed for the flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine [J9]. Hence, the machine can realize the pole-changing control by properly dropping some poles. Concerning the machine application, we have successfully applied the proposed flux-mnemonic machines to electric and hybrid vehicles. The proposed flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine can achieve the features of high starting torque and fast acceleration rate as well as constant power output over a wide speed range, which are highly desirable for electric vehicles [J7]. Furthermore, the outer-rotor topology of flux-mnemonic machines is identified to be very promising for electric and hybrid vehicle applications [J8].

710710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
710710.value: Fault tolerance is highly desired by modern electric machines for some essential applications such as vehicular operation and medical operation. While the proposed flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine is very promising for application to electric and hybrid vehicles, more fault-tolerant control schemes of the proposed machine need to be explored. For example, during some open-circuit faults such as the phase-winding open-circuit fault and power device open-circuit fault, the machine should be able to operate at the remedial mode so that it can maintain the same torque or power level with acceptable system efficiency. Meanwhile, during some short-circuit faults such as the turn-to-turn fault, phase-to-phase fault and phase-to-ground fault, the machine should be able to isolate the faulty parts and operate at the remedial mode to maintain the performance for a reasonable period.

710710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
710710.value: With ever increasing concern on our environment, the development of high-performance electric machines becomes a key issue. Because of inherently high efficiency and high power density, permanent magnet (PM) machines have been widely adopted for industrial application. However, since the air-gap flux can hardly be controlled, they cannot provide the desired wide-speed operation. Recently, the concept of flux-mnemonic PM motors has been proposed to control the air-gap flux. However, the PMs are prone to accidental demagnetization by armature reaction, and the process of its PM magnetization involves complex coordinate transformation of armature currents. Also, its complicated PM rotor is not mechanically robust enough to withstand high-speed or intermittent operation. This project has successfully developed a novel flux-mnemonic dual-magnet machine, and also explored its applications. The key is to incorporate the idea of dual magnets into the concept of hybrid excitations and the use of solid rotor with no PMs or windings. Hence, the proposed machine can offer high efficiency, high power density, high robustness, high controllability and wide-speed operation for both motoring and generation. It is very promising for application to electric vehicles and wind turbines.

710810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
710810.value: This study investigates whether there is disposition effect in the housing market. Disposition effect refers to the phenomenon that asset owners tend to sell assets with nominal gains and keep those with nominal losses. This phenomenon is predominantly explained by the prospect theory, which postulates asymmetric preferences towards gains and losses. There are far more tests of disposition effect in the financial markets than in the housing markets and most of these studies rely on experiments or surveys. This project proposes to use market transaction data to study the disposition effect in Hong Kong’s housing market. The use of housing market data to test disposition effect is possible since it is relatively easy to identify transactions that resulted in seller’s gain or lost. The result does not only contribute to our understanding of the buyer’s and seller’s behavior in the real estate market but also the factors that affect homeowners’ decision to sell their housing units and also help to explain the correlation between price and volume. The existence of disposition effect also contributes to a wider literature on the test of the Prospect Theory. As a side product, this project also examines whether certain housing attributes affect the holding period of housing units, which have practical and policy implications. 本研究探討住房市場是否存在處置效應。所謂"處置效應"，也就是所謂的"出贏保虧效應"，意指資產所有者往往傾向出售出賺錢的資產、並繼續持有賠錢的資產。這種現象主要以"前景理論"解釋，前景理論假設人們對收益和損失有非對稱的偏好。現存處置效應的實證研究，以金融市場為主，並依賴實驗或調查，很少以實際交易數據作為論證基礎。房地產市場在這方面實證研究更為罕有。本研究項目擬利用香港住房市場的交易數據，作為處置效應的實證研究。使用住房市場數據的優勢在於交易數據容易識別每項交易導致賣方的收益或損失。其結果不僅有助於我們了解買方和賣方在房地產市場的行為，也有助於解釋價格和成交量的關係。作為附帶產品，本研究項目還為對影響住房持有期的因素提供實證數據。除學術貢獻外，研究結果對政策制定者、投資者及房地產從業人員都具一定的啟示作用。

710810.label: Realisation of objectives
710810.value: For the first objective, a thorough review of relevant literature has been conducted. A list of relevant studies can be found in the list of reference in Dr Wong Kwan To's PhD thesis (see student trained) and the journal paper accepted for publication in Surveying and Built Environment. For the second objective, we have identified other factors that affects the housing unit owner’s decision to sell their units. We have logically deduced that, in addition to price, the size, age and sea view of a housing unit would have impact on the housing owner’s decision to sell their units. For the third objective, we have collected all transaction records in Tai Koo Shing since July 1991 as stated in the proposal and estimated the parameters using convention regression approach for testing disposition effect. We went further by collecting all transaction records in Mei Foo Sun Chuen from since 1969 and used a much more sophisticated approach (based on the survival analysis and partial identification approach) to test the disposition effect. The details of the data, model and results are in Wong Kwan To's PhD thesis. Since we have collected more data and applied two very different testing procedures, we consider that we have over-achieved the third objective. For the fourth objective, we obtained the empirical results from both data sets using two different approaches. We found that the results from both sets of data and modelling approached are broadly similar. In both cases, there is strong evidence that support the existence of disposition effect in the housing market. This results are robust across data sample and testing procedures. Since the results are derived from more than one data sets and based on two different testing procedures, we consider that the fourth objective is also over-achieved.
