710810.label: Major findings and research outcome
710810.value: The results of this study suggest that house owners’ decision to sell or hold their housing units are affected by the purchase price of their units. After controlling the factors that may affect housing owner’s decision to sell their housing unit, there is strong evidence that housing unit owners are less willing to sell if they the selling price is lower than their original purchase price but the opposite is true if the selling price is higher than their original purchase price. This is seemingly irrational behavior is in line with the prediction of prospect theory. This result has important practical implication for buyers in the housing market when formulating negotiation strategies in a property deal since disposition effect implies that sellers who brought at a low price in the past are more willing to cut price during the negotiation process. In addition, we found that smaller households are more mobile; older units are more difficult to sell due information asymmetry problem and likewise units with less information asymmetry problems such as those with a sea views are transacted more frequently. The details of the results from transaction in Tai Koo Shing over the period 1991-2011 can be found in the journal paper accepted for publication in Surveying and Built Environment. We further tested disposition effect using data from Mei Foo Sun Chuen, which extended over a longer time horizon (1969-2011). We adopted a survival analysis approach to overcome the potential problems of censored data. In addition we deal the problems of missing variable using the partial identification approach, which estimates the bounds of the parameters rather than the conventions point estimates. The standard errors are found by bootstrapping. With this new approach and data set, we also found similar evidence of disposition effect. In addition, we also found that disposition effect existed both in the pre-1997 and post-1997 periods, which suggest that it is a general phenomenon, not affect the by the perceived risk premium of holding properties. We found that only nominal (but not real) expected loss matters. Finally, we found that disposition effect is more significant for relatively short holding periods (< 3 years). The details of the data, results and testing approaches using the Mei Foo Sun Chuen data set can be found in Wong Kwan To’s PhD thesis.

710810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
710810.value: There are five potential areas of research that stem from this project. First, it would be interesting to extend the study to non-residential properties. Since buyers and sellers of commercial properties are investors. They are likely to be more experienced and rational and therefore less affected by the deposition effect. Second, the characteristics, such as gender, age, education level etc., of the housing owners may affect the disposition effect. Data on housing owner attributes can be collected to test their impact on disposition effect. Third, disposition effect may not be linear in the magnitude of nominal gain or loss, for example, a small gain or loss may not have any impact on disposition effect due to high transaction cost and information cost. The modelling approach can modified to explicitly model the impact of transaction and information costs. Finally, a large scale empirical studies with data from different housing market in different economies can be used to test the impact of market maturity, size, liquidity, land tenure systems, tax rates, and institutional setting on the disposition effects.

710810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
710810.value: This study shows that when housing owners makes decision on selling their home, they will take into consideration the price they paid for purchasing their housing unit. If the selling price is lower than their purchase price (before adjusted for inflation), they are less willing to sell. Conversely, when the selling price is higher than the price that they paid for the property, they are more willing to sell. This backward looking behavior appears to be irrational as rational buy /sell decisions should be based on expected further prices rather than historical prices. This phenomenon cannot be explained by orthodox economics but consistent with prospect theory which suggest that people tend to avoid realizing nominal loss and too eager to realize nominal gain. This behavior of the property seller is not affected by the perceive market risk but appeared to be stronger for units that have been held for a relative short duration. Disposition effect started to fade away when the property has been held for more than 3 years. One practical implication of the results of this study is that it is worth knowing what the prospective sellers had paid for their property when negotiating a deal with them.

710910.label: Project Objectives
710910.value: Investigation of the salient features of climate change and urbanization in the past several decades over HK and the PRD, through analysis of three hydroclimatic datasets from: (a) the Hong Kong Observatory, (b) the China National Meteorological Information Center, and(c) the USA NCEP/NCAR (National Center for Environmental Prediction/National Center for Atmospheric Research); Exploration of the relationships among different weather variables (e.g., precipitation, relative humidity, wind pattern, and daily maximum, minimum and mean temperatures) influenced by climate change and urbanization over HK and the PRD, through dynamic downscaling of the NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis data; Examination of the important characteristics of future climate change, through study of the regional details of climate projections for the 21st century with different IPCC SRES (Special Report on Emissions Scenarios) for HK and the PRD by downscaling the global change projections from Global Climate Models; Evaluation of the relative impacts of future climate change and urbanization on hydrologic processes over HK and the PRD; and Assessment of the trends of floods and droughts in the PRD for the 21st century based on the outcomes from Objectives (3) and (4).

710910.label: Realisation of objectives
710910.value: Objective 1: We studied the climate change and urbanization influence on weather variables over HK and South China (including the Pearl River Delta (PRD)) by using the past weather data for the period of 1960-2005. From the study, we obtained a general picture of regional climate change, which shows a significant temperature increase since the middle 1980s, and the urbanization influence is mainly on daily minimum temperature. Further, we used the weather data recorded at Hong Kong to analyze the climate change and related urbanization influence. We found that the urbanization influence on Hong Kong’s temperature is different from what we obtained from the region of South China. Objective 2: We used one regional climate to study the impacts of land use change on temperature and precipitation over the PRD. Further, we explored the impacts of CO2 increase on hydrological processes over the Pearl River basin. Objective 3: The future climate projections over South China (including the Pearl River basin and Hong Kong) based on different IPCC SRES (Special Report on Emissions Scenarios) were obtained. Then, the related features of climate projections were analyzed. Objective 4: Using the variable infiltration capacity (VIC) hydrologic model, we obtained the hydrologic processes under different future climate projections. The general features of future hydrologic processes in different time periods in different SRES scenarios were obtained. Objective 5: Further, using the VIC simulations, the data for analyzing future floods and droughts were prepared. Then, the related future possible natural hazards were under exploration. For under-achievements and outline attempts to overcome problems For objective 4, some analyses for analyzing the impact of future urbanization were under-achievement. However, the study undertaken in this project provided a basis for further exploration of future urbanization influence. For objective 5, the analysis of future floods and droughts was under-achievement. However, we have prepared the data and will have an understanding of the features of those floods and droughts under different emission scenarios.

710910.label: Major findings and research outcome
710910.value: Major findings: 1. To enhance the simulation capacity of hydrological models, a new hydrologic model was developed. The study was published in an international journal (Chen and Wu, 2012). 2. The factors that influence soil erosion in hydrological models were investigated, and it was found that the soil erodibility and surface slope are dominant in soil erosion. The results were reported in a research journal paper (Wu and Chen, 2012). 3. The optimized reservoir operating rules for the Xinfengjiang reservoir in the East River Basin in southern China were developed. A research paper was published in a top research journal (Wu and Chen, 2012). 4. The hydrologic response to the elevated CO2 levels for the West River basin in South China was investigated. The result was published in a research journal paper (Niu et al., 2013). 5. The terrestrial hydrological processes during a dry climate period in the Pearl River basin were investigated. Two headwater sub-basins of the West River were studied to compare and contrast the terrestrial responses. The result was published in a journal paper (Niu and Chen, 2014). 6. The teleconnection of two climatic patterns, namely the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) and the Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), with hydrological processes over the Pearl River basin in southern China, were explored. The result was published in a journal paper (Niu et al., 2014). 7. The features of teleconnection between ENSO and weather variables (i.e., precipitation, and temperature) over South China, including the East River basin, were obtained. The research result was published a research journal paper (Li and Chen, 2014). 8. A new method for detecting daily anomaly runoff was developed, and a case study was conducted over a headwater catchment in the East River. A research paper was published on a top international journal (Chen et al., 2014). Major research outcome 1. We have published 12 peer-reviewed top journal research papers arising directly from this research project. Further, we have submitted four other journal papers for review. 2. In addition, about 22 conference papers and presentations were given in several international conferences. 3. Two PhD graduates and one MPhil graduate have been trained, and one PhD student is under taining.

710910.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
710910.value: From this project, the future precipitation, soil moisture, and streamflow simulations from different emission scenarios can be used to analyze future water resource variation. Specifically, over the East River basin, those simulation results can be used to detect the future water resources reliability over Hong Kong. The teleconnection features of ENSO and IOD over the Pearl River and Hong Kong can be useful for developing regional seasonal forecasting skill for those natural hazards (mainly droughts), and then such a skill will be vital for mitigating potential drought damages and enhance the regional water resources management capability. Nevertheless, to develop seasonal regional climate forecasting skill needs several fundamental investigations. Mainly, how to improve the understanding of teleconnection features needs further research; how to make use of the teleconnection features for reliable seasonal climate forecast needs a comprehensive study. Especially, how to develop a reliable seasonal climate forecasting skill needs more endeavors.

710910.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
710910.value: This study aims to improve our understanding of the impacts of climate change and urbanization on hydrologic processes in Hong Kong (HK) and the Pearl River Delta (PRD) in South China. A larger goal is to advance our knowledge on the assessment of extreme hydrologic events (e.g. floods and droughts), with particular reference to climate change and urbanization impacts. In HK and the PRD, the annual mean temperature has increased consistently over the years; since the early 1980s, the PRD has also experienced rapid urban development. These have already had some negative impacts on the region’s water resources. This study conducted the impact assessment for the past of climate change and urbanization influence using the weather-station observations from the Hong Kong Observatory, weather-station observations from the China National Meteorological Information Center, and the USA NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis global weather data. Then, this study further investigated future hydrologic impacts based on future climate scenarios from Global Climate Models. This project will significantly contribute to research on the hydrologic impacts of climate change and urbanization in HK and the PRD, and for the world at large.

711110.label: Project Objectives
711110.value: [Develop the UV-index] According to our previous studies, a UV-diagram can be expensive to be constructed and stored. We plan to develop an index of the UV-diagram (called the UV-index), which supports efficient execution of probabilistic NN queries. The UV-index should be efficient and easy to be constructed. Moreover, it should have a small size. We will also examine how the index can be quickly updated upon insertion and deletion of objects. [Develop efficient query algorithms] Our second objective is to study algorithms for evaluating probabilistic queries, including k-NN, reverse-NN, continuous NN, and uncertain NN queries. We will investigate how to use the UV-index to facilitate the computation of these queries. Complexity analysis and experimental evaluations will be carried out to validate the effectiveness of these algorithms. [Develop data mining applications] Next, we will study how the UV-diagram can be used in data mining. We will examine how the patterns shown on a UV-diagram can be displayed effectively for data visualization applications. We will also study how the UV-diagram facilitates efficient pattern analysis and uncertain data clustering. [Prototype development] We will integrate the UV-index and its query algorithms into an open-source uncertain database system previously developed by the PI. On top of the database, we will design a querying service for geographical objects. We will also develop data clustering and visualization applications on this database.

711110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
711110.value: In various important and emerging applications, the data used in their systems is inherently uncertain. Consider a location-based application that provides querying facilities on geographical objects (e.g., airports, vehicles, and people) extracted from satellite images. Due to the errors incurred during satellite image transmission, the locations of the geographical objects can be inaccurate. In biological applications, the extent of the area of a retina cell extracted from microscopy images can also be inexact, due to limited image resolution and measurement accuracy. To manage data impreciseness, researchers have recently designed uncertain databases, which provide tools for storing and querying imprecise data. Our goal is to develop new techniques for managing uncertain spatial databases. In particular, we study the probabilistic nearest-neighbor (NN) query, which allows questions like: “Which restaurant in Hong Kong is the closest to me?” to be answered. To evaluate this query, we propose the Uncertain Voronoi diagram (or UV-diagram in short). The UV-diagram is a generalization of the Voronoi diagram, which facilitates NN query evaluation, for uncertain data. Since the UV-diagram is expensive to be constructed and stored, we propose a new data structure, called the UV-index, which resembles the UV-diagram. We will investigate how the UV-index can be efficiently constructed and updated. The UV-index will be used to handle other important queries, including top-k NN, reverse NN, and continuous NN queries. We will further investigate the use of the UV-diagram in data analysis and mining algorithms. An extensive experimental evaluation will be performed on our methods. We will also implement the UV-diagram in an open-source uncertain database engine, based on which a location-based application will be developed. 在多種新領域中， 很多時候數據是不準確的。在一個大型位置處理系統，如果一些地理物件（如機場、車輛、人類）是從衛星圖片抽取的話， 它們的位置便不準確。類似的問題也發生在生物科技應用上。因此，近年來， 有很多硏究投放在開發不確定數據庫。我們要硏發怎樣在不確定數據作出高效的查選， 例如：「那家餐廰最接近我？」我們提出一種名為UV-圖的工具。UV-圖其實是一種Voronoi 圖，它可以處理在不確定數據的相鄰查選（Nearest Neighbor Query)。我們會硏究怎樣將它高速地建構造和更新，也會看看怎樣運用它在其他查選 （如 Reverse-Nearest Neighbor Query)。我們也會將UV-圖應用在數據挖掘的領域。這些結果會建構在一個開源數據庫。我們會在這數據庫開發一個位置處理系統。

711110.label: Realisation of objectives
711110.value: We have generally achieved the project objectives. We have developed an efficient UV-index for the UV-diagram, through novel techniques (e.g., batch construction and space decomposition). We have also investigated efficient data structure support for insertion and deletion of objects. We have also investigated how to use the UV-index to support probabilistic nearest neighbor queries and other variants (e.g., continuous NN queries and trajectory queries). We have also investigated how to perform uncertain data clustering with the use of nearest neighbor queries and Voronoi diagram built on the spatial objects. We have further developed a database prototype to support queries and visualization of the UV-diagram. There are other interesting works to follow. It is interesting to investigate how to the UV-index can inspire the development of advanced data structures for other kinds of probabilistic queries (e.g., reverse-NN and skyline queries). It is also interesting to examine how kind of distance measures (e.g., Earth Mover Distance). Another direction is to perform a detailed user study on how the UV-diagram can best support visualization and data mining.

711110.label: Major findings and research outcome
711110.value: 1. We have developed new construction methods for the UV-index. We have studied in more depth about the theoretical size of the UV-cell. We develop a model-based UV-cell construction method, which is experimentally faster than the method in our previous paper (ICDE10). We have further improved the UV-index construction performance, by developing a batch construction method. 2. We have extended our solutions to support multi-dimensional uncertain data, whose uncertainty regions are in the form of a rectangle, for Euclidean distances. We study efficient algorithms for computing multi-dimensional rectangles that tightly bound the UV-cell of the object. Furthermore, we study the problem of updating a UV-cell, when there is insertion or deletion of objects to the underlying database. We have recently studied k-NN search on other kinds of distance measures (e.g., Earth Mover Distance). 3. We have recently investigated a new technique of constructing UV-cells. Rather than finding the rectangle that bounds the UV-cell, we have developed the use of many small rectangles to represent a UV-cell. This “spatial decomposition” technique, with the use of a suitable index, is able to support probabilistic nearest neighbor queries better than our previous solution. 4. We have studied how the UV-index can support another kind of nearest neighbor queries, namely, the continuous nearest neighbor (NN) queries. As our experiments show, this solution shows a high performance. 5.We also address the issue of evaluating a trajectory NN query on uncertain spatial data. Our new solution, which borrows concepts from the UV-diagram construction, eliminates the need of evaluating probabilistic query at every point of the trajectory. Many objects that cannot contribute to the answer are removed by our new pruning techniques. The experimental results on real datasets show that our algorithm is very efficient. 6. We develop an efficient algorithm to support the clustering of uncertain data. The main idea is to employ the Voronoi diagram to compute the clusters based on the expected distance between two uncertain objects. 7. We have implemented a system, which allows a UV-diagram to be displayed and visualized. The system also provides zoom-in/zoom-out facilities, which allow the details of the shapes of the UV-cells to be displayed to be adjusted. Such a feature is useful for users to investigate the NN patterns of a large number of objects.

711110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
711110.value: 1) Development of new pre-computation techniques, which also build data structures such as the UV-index, to support other kinds of probabilistic queries such as reverse NN, top-k, and skyline queries. 2) Perform a detailed case study of the UV-diagram for supporting visualization. 3) Study extension to other kinds of distance measures (e.g., the Earth Mover Distance).

711110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
711110.value: In various important applications, the data used in their systems is inherently uncertain. Consider a location-based application that provides querying facilities on geographical objects (e.g., airports, vehicles, and people) extracted from satellite images. Due to the errors incurred during satellite image transmission, the locations of the geographical objects can be inaccurate. To manage data impreciseness, researchers have recently designed uncertain databases, which provide tools for storing and querying imprecise data. Our goal is to develop new techniques for managing uncertain spatial databases. In particular, we study the probabilistic nearest-neighbor (NN) query, which allows questions like: “Which restaurant in Hong Kong is the closest to me?” to be answered. To evaluate this query, we propose the Uncertain Voronoi diagram (or UV-diagram in short). The UV-diagram is a generalization of the Voronoi diagram, which facilitates NN query evaluation, for uncertain data. Since the UV-diagram is expensive to be constructed and stored, we propose a new data structure, called the UV-index, which resembles the UV-diagram. We investigate how the UV-index can be efficiently constructed and updated, and how it can be used to support other queries. An extensive experimental evaluation will be performed on our methods.

712010.label: Project Title(Chinese)
712010.value: 等離子共振增強聚合物薄膜太陽能電池的理論與實驗研究

712010.label: Co - Investigator(s)
712010.value: Prof Chew, Weng Cho Prof Yang, Yang

712010.label: Project Objectives
712010.value: Determining the important optical properties of materials. Generally, the optical properties including the absorption coefficient and refractive index of active polymer-blends are highly dispersive. They may cause significant changes in PR properties. The true value of the optical properties of the polymer-blends plus other materials used in devices will be determined experimentally. Studying the physics of PRs in polymer SCs Rigorous and efficient models will be developed through electromagnetic theory for studying surface and localized PRs in multilayered polymer SCs with metal nanostructures. With the true-valued optical properties, we will investigate the PRs modes, their field and energy distributions, and their effects on the absorption of the active polymer-blend layers and photocurrent generation. Experimentally investigating and understanding surface and localized PRs Since localized and surface PRs have different properties which may result in different contributions in SCs, this project will investigate both surface and localized PRs. We will start with the metal layers with periodic 2D-nanogroove patterns for theoretically and experimentally studying the surface PRs. After gaining the knowledge and experience of the surface PRs, we will investigate more complicated structures of the ordered 3D-nanoclusters and 3D-patterned metal layers for the localized and surface PRs respectively. Optimizing the PR field and energy distribution Since the energy of the surface and localized PRs will decay in the active polymer-blend layer, the enhanced absorption in the polymer-blend will change along with the depth of the polymer-blend layer, which is critical for the use of the PRs in polymer SCs. The field and energy distribution of the PRs will be experimentally studied and optimized with the geometric dimensions of the ordered nanostructures and the thickness of the active polymer-blends. Optimizing the PR resonance wavelength and bandwidth By changing the dimensions of the ordered nanostructures and the thickness of the active polymer-blend layers, we can tailor the resonance wavelength and bandwidth of the surface and localized PRs for enhancing the absorption at the weak-absorption wavelength region of an active polymer-blend for photovoltaic applications. Exploring the strong PR enhancement in polymer SCs with newly-active polymer-blends We will start with some active polymer-blends with known polymer physics such as P3HT:PCBM so that we may accurately investigate the effects of the PRs. Then, we will study new polymers with Prof. Yang in UCLA for achieving practical PR-enhanced polymer SCs. Achieving academic and research merits Besides the better understanding of the physics of the surface and localized PRs plus the enhanced absorption of the active polymer-blends for achieving the better SC performance, we will publish our results in international journals, explore intellectual-property possibilities and train research students and professionals. *** Note: To show our capability to manage the project, we have already started to work on objectives (1) and (2) and obtained some preliminary results. Moreover, Dr. Choy visited Prof. Yang in this past summer and developed a spacing layer in polymer SCs which is useful for studying the PR decay feature in objective (4). Details will be discussed in “Research Plan and Methodology”. (A supporting letter from industry is attached in Section 14).

712010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
712010.value: 聚合物/有機薄膜太陽能電池，由于其獨特的優點，比如制造工藝簡單，低耗，重量輕，比矽太陽能電池的機械柔韌性好得多，等等，已引起人們廣泛的關注，是光伏應用方面最有潛力的器件之一。基元聚合物太陽能電池的轉換效率已達到6.77%（仍比矽太陽能電池略低）。科研工作者們目前正積極探尋各種可用于實際生産的改進聚合物太陽能電池的方法。 最近，金屬納米結構的等離子共振效應成爲光伏學科的熱點。等離子共振效應可以加強太陽能電池中與金屬納米結構毗鄰的半導體對光的吸收，從而促進電子-空穴對的産生。已有報道證明，在半導體層深度約幾百納米處，等離子共振效應很強。有趣的是，典型的聚合物共混太陽能電池，比起目前的無機薄膜太陽能電池（厚度1-10微米）,其厚度要薄得多（<300納米）。除此之外，大多數的共混聚合物，比如3-烷基噻吩：[6,6]-苯甲基-C61-丁酸 -甲 酯（記作P3HT:PCBM），在太陽能電池中用來吸收光以及産生電子空穴對，其實比矽的吸收系數高。因此共混聚合物被稱爲“活化”共混聚合物。 因此，我們的研究爲一種全新的基于等離子共振加強效應以及活化共混聚合物的太陽能電池探明了道路。雖然，等離子共振的增強效應在理論及實驗上尚未有確切的定論，我們將會爲促進光電流的産生繼續深入探討和試驗活化層中等離子共振效應如何加強光吸收。等離子共振的研究基于多種有序排布的金屬納米結構，比如金屬納米凹槽，金屬納米團簇。 對于理論研究，我們將會建立起基于經典電磁理論的嚴格有效的模型，研究多層器件與金屬納米結構的等離子共振效應，使得我們能夠更好的了解等離子共振的原理。 更具體而言，由于活化共混聚合物與矽不同，它有典型的高度色散和吸收性質，必將對等離子共振性質有很大影響。活化共混聚合物的折射率和吸收系數可以通過實驗精確測量，我們的研究中會細致考慮這些參數。 等離子共振特性，比如活化共混聚合物中的能量衰減性質，共振波長與帶寬對多層器件的光學設計有重要影響。通過對各種不同成份的活化共混聚合物以及有序排列金屬納米結構的實驗研究，我們將得到最優化的結果並使之能夠投放到光伏聚合物太陽能電池的應用中。

712010.label: Major findings and research outcome
712010.value: World-leading work in multiphysical study of plasmonic photovoltaics. Notable among the achievements are the pioneer research work the multi-physical (optical and electrical) study and understanding of plasmonic effects on photovoltaics. We first conceive a novel plasmonic-electrical concept that the abnormal light distribution by plasmonic structures could manipulate carrier transport and collection of OSCs which can be introduced to break the space charge limit for photocurrent of organic solar cells, which is the fundamental electrostatic limit and universal phenomenon of organic semiconductors. We first experimentally demonstrated the plasmonically induced carrier generation and enhanced carrier extraction in enhancing SC performances and also first clarified the electron accumulation effects induced by metal nanoparticles for improving SC carrier extraction and made OSC power conversion efficiency (PCE) reach 8.8% [Adv. Function. Mat. 23: 4255-4261, 2013, Energy & Environmental Science 6: 3372-3379, 2013.]. Comprehensive and high-impact research in the optical design of organic photovoltaics. In optical design of SCs, we corrected some misunderstandings [Plasmonics, 4, 107, 2009] of organic SCs (which can also be adopted in other planar SCs) when “small” particles are embedded at the spacer layer [Appl. Phys. Lett., 99: 113304, 2011 (theoretical); J. Mater. Chem., 21, 16349, 2011 (experimental)]. We also explained and clarified the first time the optical enhancement phenomena in solar cell designs from longitudinal and transverse modes in nanoparticle arrays [Appl. Phys. Lett., 99(15), 153304. 2011] and plasmonic band edge effect in nano-gratings [J. Phys. Chem. C, 116: 7200-7206, 2012]. The first kind of dual plasmonic metal nanostructures for photovoltaic devices. We first proposed, demonstrated and explained different dual plasmonic nanostructures for high performance OSCs with PCE reaching 9.2% (best) which is among the best performed OSCs [Adv. Funct. Mat., 23, 2728–2735, 2013; Adv. Mater. 24, 3046-3052, 2012.]. We proposed two schemes. Scheme 1: Metallic nanograting offering strong surface plasmon resonances hybridizes with metallic nanoparticles offering strong localized plasmon resonances. Scheme 2: Metallic nanoparticles hybridizes with metallic nanoprisms to achieve broadband enhancement. The work published in Adv. Mat. has been cited about 262 times since May 2012, including by the Nobel Laureate Alan Heeger (inventor of conductive polymer) and Prof. Sajeev John (inventor of photonic crystals). Since then, different methods of double light-trapping structures have been studied such as Nano Lett., 2013, 13, 59; Adv. Function. Mat., 2013, 23, 20; Adv. Energy Mat., 2013, 3, 5. They have cited our work.

712010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
712010.value: 1. Novel metal nanostructures for wideband absorption enhancement with low cost. 2. Incorporate Au or Ag nanostructures in all the layers in the multiple layered OSC device structures.

712210.label: Project Objectives
712210.value: To evaluate the bioactivities of indigenous autotrophic denitrifiers (AD) in contaminated marine sediment in denitrifying remediation: During denitrifying treatment of an aged marine sediment, AD may compete with heterotrophic denitrifiers (HD) for electron acceptor nitrate. The competition depends on many significant parameters, including pH, concentration of nitrate, and ratios of nitrate/sulfide and nitrate/humic-residues, in the sediment. The effects of these parameters on both AD and HD in different sediment samples will be investigated. To investigate the speciation change of heavy metals in the sediment as a result of autotrophic denitrification: A series of experiments will be carried out to investigate the speciation of heavy metals, including those commonly found in Hong Kong such as Zn, Cu, Pb, Cd and Ni, before and after autotrophic denitrification under various conditions. To identify and characterize the predominant autotrophic denitrifying bacteria in the sediment and their interactions with other bacteria in the sediment: The key denitrifying bacteria responsible for the autotrophic denitrification will be identified using the DNA-based techniques. Their interactions, with the other bacteria populations, such as heterotrophic denitrification bacteria and sulfate reducing bacteria, in the sediment will be examined. To evaluate the increase of sediment toxicity resulting from speciation change of heavy metals after autotrophic denitrification: The increased sediment toxicity resulting from autotrophic denitrification on selected bacteria, microalgae, invertebrates, and fish will be evaluated in series of statistically designed experiments.

Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
712210.value: Sediment is the ultimate sink for recalcitrant pollutants, many of which are highly toxic. Denitrification-based remediation has been proven as a cost effective approach for organic removal in sediment. However, little attention has been drawn on the concomitant autotrophic denitrification process and its impacts during such treatment. In this study, experiments have conducted to evaluate the activities of autotrophic denitrifiers in contaminated marine sediment in remediation, and their competition with heterotrophic denitrifiers on nitrate. It was found that the competition depended on many significant parameters, including pH, concentration of nitrate, and ratios of nitrate/sulfide and nitrate/humic-residues, in the sediment. Additionally, the speciation change of heavy metals in the sediment as a result of autotrophic denitrification was investigated. The results show the different behaviors of the metals in Hong Kong sediment, such as Zn, Cu, etc., before and after autotrophic denitrification. The predominant autotrophic denitrifying bacteria in the sediment and their interactions with other bacteria in the sediment were examined using advanced DNA techniques, and the results showed the significant role of these autotrophic denitrifying bacteria in remediation of Hong Kong's sediment.

712310.label: Realisation of objectives
712310.value: Objective 1: The scheme of using external confinement has been verified to improve the interface bonding, strength and ductility of CFST columns containing the same volume of steel and concrete. The results have been published in some journal papers listed in Part C Research Outcome/Output. Objectives 2 and 3: A uni-axial stress-strain curve model for confined concrete in CFST columns taken into account the interaction between steel and concrete has been developed. Its applicability has been verified by comparing with the test results obtained in this project and the results obtained by other researchers on uni-axial test and combined axial and flexure tests. The results have been published in some journal papers listed in Part C Research Outcome/Output. Objectives 4 and 5: An extensive parametric study has been carried out for various concrete strength, steel yield strength, diameter-to-thickness ratio and forms of external confinement. From the results of the parametric study, some simplified design rules for CFST columns with external confinement to achieve different levels of ductility have been proposed. The results of the parametric study and details of the design proposal have been published in some journal papers listed in Part C Research Outcome/Output.

712310.label: Major findings and research outcome
712310.value: - Verified the proposed scheme of using external confinement to improve the steel concrete interface bonding, strength and ductility of CFST columns [Ho and Luo 2012; Dong and Ho 2012; Ho and Lai 2013, Ho and Luo 2013 and Dong and Ho 2013]. - Proposed a uni-axial stress-strain curve for predicting the axial-stress-strain curve of CFST columns with or without external confinement. Its applicability has been verified by comparing with the obtained test results in this project and those obtained by other researchers. The proposed model can be used to predict accurately the axial-stress-strain curve of confined concrete in CFST columns with or without external confinement [Ho et al. 2014; Lai and Ho 2014; Ho and Dong 2014; Lai and Ho 2014a, 2014b]. - Results of the parametric study are very useful and have been used to develop some useful design guidelines for CFST columns with and without confinement. The design guidelines are simple and can be readily adopted by structural designers to design the content of steel tube for achieving two different levels of ductility depending on the external demand. The details of the parametric study, proposed levels of ductility capacities and the details of the design equations for required steel volume can be referred to the following publication (some of them has been submitted only and is undergoing review process) [Lai and Ho 2015a, 2015b, 2015c, 2015d, 2015e, 2015f].

712310.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
712310.value: The results obtained in the study is very useful, particularly for the constitutive model of the confined concrete in CFST columns, to be applied in other concrete-filled metal structures, such as cold-formed steel, stainless steel and aluminum structures. Preliminary study will be carried out and research proposal in this field of study will be submitted in the future.

712310.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
712310.value: To advance our construction technology and respond to global warming, this project has proposed and verified a new design concept using external confinement to improve the strength and durability performance of concrete-filled-steel-tube columns. The obtained test results, developed constitutive model and proposed design aids will not only advance our column design technologies, but also greener the infrastructures by trimming the embodied carbon content that offers Hong Kong a more sustainable living environment.

712410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
712410.value: Tomorrow’s electric infrastructure promises a clean, efficient, reliable, resilient, and responsive electric system – a smart grid. A self-healing transmission and distribution system, which automatically anticipates and responds to disturbances, is a critical function of a smart grid. Effective system restoration is the major component of self-healing electric systems. Unfortunately, even for the current power system, few decision support tools are available to dispatchers and restoration planners. These plans typically developed off line and then used as guidelines for dispatchers in an on-line environment. Dispatchers need to adapt to the actual outage scenario and be able to develop the strategy based on their experience. Due to the integration of renewable generation and liberalization of electricity market, the added complexity associated with uncertainties has made system restoration an even more serous challenge both technically and financially. The development of the self-healing electric system requires: (1) the ability to estimate risks of ongoing or potential outages for an electric system. (2) the development of a systematic system restoration methodology under the flexible system operating conditions. (3) an effective evaluation methodology of strategies for a self-heal restoration system. Our goal addresses the systematic system restoration methodology for future power systems in which there is a significant amount of renewable resources and demand response. Probabilistic methodologies must be adopted in such an environment with uncertain generation and volatile load. This research covers three major aspects for the establishment of the self-healing electric system: coherent system reliability measures, a comprehensive restoration methodology associated with high-efficient algorithms, and a sophisticated restoration strategy evaluation methodology. For the first task, novel system reliability measures will be built on a set of coherence indexes, which have been developed recently in financial engineering and hold promise for a wide application in the system that uncertainties have been subject to criticism. For the second task, a comprehensive system restoration methodology will be established to meet the new energy environment. A new system restoration philosophy, called target-oriented, is proposed. This systematic methodology provides a uniform framework to establish system restoration strategies for systems with different characteristics. For the third task, a sophisticated algorithm based on point estimation method will be proposed to assess a restoration strategy under the stochastic system operating conditions. In the long run, the accomplishment of this project would represent a major step toward modernization of power system restoration and, ultimately, implement the functions of a self-healing smart grid. 未来的智能电网将是一个清洁、高效、可靠并且响应迅速的电力系统。在遭受冲击后，实现电网的自愈是智能电网的核心问题之一。高效的系统重启动策略是实现自愈的核心功能。然而，迄今为止，几乎没有系统化和全局化的电力系统重启动决策工具。现行的方法是系统运行人员首先根据经验确定若干场景，再借助分析工具离线生成重启动方案。 随着电力系统的发展，可再生能源利用的增加以及电力市场化改革的深入导致更多的随机因素被引入了电力系统。这些随机因素导致自愈电力系统不论在技术研发上还是在经济分析上都更加复杂。实现自愈电网至少需要有以下几个方面的技术作为支撑：（1）对系统已经发生或潜在的故障风险进行估计；（2）可以灵活适应不同运行条件的自愈方案生成系统；（3）高效的系统自愈方案评估系统。 本项目将研究自愈电力系统的基础理论问题，提出一种系统化的电力系统自愈方案的生成策略。这种策略可以适应电力系统新技术的发展，包括随机的新能源出力以及负荷响应。主要包括以下三个方面的内容：（1）一致性的系统可靠性测度；（2）全面的系统自愈方案生成策略及相关算法；（3）系统自愈方案的评价机制。在第一个方面，一组满足一致性要求的可靠性指标将被提出。这些指标将借鉴现代金融学的最新成果，能够很好的满足包含大量随机事件的系统测度要求。在第二个方面，一种系统化的全面自愈方法将被提出。一种新的概念，即目标驱动的自愈方案生成概念将被提出。基于这种概念，一种统一的自愈方案建立框架及与之相适应的算法将被建立。在最后一个方面，基于点估计的随机系统评价算法将被引入，以实现对随机系统自愈方案的评估。 从长远的角度看，本研究的成果将为构建自愈电网提供理论支撑和方法论的指导

712410.label: Realisation of objectives
712410.value: As the first project of a series of inter-related RGC-supported research projects on the construction of a self-healing smart grid, the objective of this project is to establish a generic and systematic system restoration methodology, which is a essential component for self-healing smart grids. For implementing a reliable, resilient, and responsive electric system, some novel information acquisition and measurement methods for constructing restoration strategy have been proposed; a comprehensive, generic and adaptive system restoration methodology has been developed and widely tested; contributions for system restoration of new components for the future smart grid have been identified; a piece of software that implements the proposed methodology has been developed and used in realistic power systems. Based on the scope of the proposal, four coherent tasks have been completely accomplished. The first objective focuses on establishing information acquisition methods for construction restoration strategy. Phasor measurement unit (PMU) has been introduced to ensure complete observability under normal operating conditions and during system restoration process. Some sophisticated algorithms were proposed. New applications of PMU-based measurements for system restoration have been proposed as well. For the future smart grid, challenges of system restoration with renewables have been identified and potential solutions have been studied. The second objective is to develop a comprehensive, generic and adaptive system restoration methodology. After carefully reviewing theoretical accomplishments and industrial practices of system restoration, we identified that power system restoration is a complex, multi-stage and multi-objective problem and, furthermore, all constraints of power system operation have to be involved. For this critical problem, a comprehensive methodology entitled ‘Generic Restoration Milestone’ (GRM) has been successfully developed. A series of algorithms with realistic considerations have been proposed for implementation of each milestone. The third objective is to develop restoration strategy evaluation methods. The proposed GRM based method has been employed to evaluate restoration strategies for transmission systems. A multi-agent based restoration framework was proposed to evaluate restoration strategies of distribution systems. The contributions of renewables and responsive loads for system restoration were also proposed. Some highly efficient algorithms have been proposed to assess steady-state and transient constraints. The proposed methods were implemented by the PI’s team with a piece of software entitled ‘System Restoration Navigator’. It has been used in some US and Chinese realistic power systems. The accomplishment has been highlighted by IEEE Smart Grid Newsletter as the first attempt for ‘putting the dream into practice: a self-healing smart grid’.

712410.label: Major findings and research outcome
712410.value: The findings are systematic and comprehensive system restoration methodology. It provides essential components for self-healing smart grids. 1. Risk assessment methods for constructing restoration strategy with emerging system components (1) Risk of renewable energy integration New challenges of future energy paradigm were identified [Journal 5]. Renewables will be widely used [Conference 3]. Risks will mainly come from electricity prices, renewables, and responsive loads [Journal 6]. Risks can be quantified with a uniform framework [Conference 8]. (2) Information acquisition method A restoration-originated PMU placement method was proposed to ensure complete observability with a binary optimization algorithm [Conference 2]. PMU can also enhance operation actions[Conference 1]. 2. A comprehensive system restoration methodology (1) Generic and adaptive transmission system restoration methodology A comprehensive methodology entitled ‘Generic Restoration Milestone’ has been proposed. This methodology decoupled the multi-stage and multi-objective restoration into 6 sub-problems (milestones). Based on the characteristics of the system and outage, some milestones can be selected to construct the restoration strategy. Algorithms have been proposed to implement each milestone. It was successfully used in some realistic power systems [Journal 1]. (2) Multi-agent based distribution system self-healing framework Based on the multi-agent system theory, a method for self-healing urban power grid is proposed. The operating states for a self-healing system were classified and strategies to implement self-healing were developed. It was used in some realistic distribution systems [Journal 2]. (3) Sophisticated algorithms to the implemented proposed methodology A robust, non-divergent model for large-scale AC-DC power system analysis was proposed to construct self-healing strategy. It was proved mathematically that the proposed methods reduce the size of the correction equations significantly and it is a symmetrical positive-definite system. The proposed methods were integrated into the SRN and used in realistic power grids [Conference 4]. 3. Evaluation of system restoration strategies Power flow constraints and transient stability constraints during system restoration can be evaluated with the proposed methods [Journal 1, 2]. Especially, the critical sequential constraints were assessed with a direct solution method [Journal 4]. Novel hybrid GPU-CPU architecture was used to assess transient stability and the fluctuation of renewables during system restoration [Journal 3]. Fluctuation of frequency due to renewables and responsive loads can also be assessed [Journal 6]. 4. Software based on the proposed methodology A piece of software for constructing system restoration strategy entitled SRN was developed. The first version and the second version have been used by some US and Chinese power grids [Conference 5].

712410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
712410.value: Based on the GRM methodology, a framework of system restoration has been established. Based on the accomplishments of the current project, the load restoration with realistic models needs to be developed. The discrete characteristic of loads should be modeled carefully. The cold loads need to be integrated into load restoration scheme. It is believed that the sophisticated branch-and-cut method with nonlinear optimization algorithms will be the useful. Furthermore, proactive load response strategies can also be considered during system restoration. Criteria for renewables integration during system restoration, especially for wind power and PV solar, should be carefully identified. Due to variable and uncertain characteristics of renewables, impacts on system during restoration will be significant, especially at the beginning stage of a system restoration. It is believed that the assessment of frequency response for the system during restoration can provide criteria of timing of renewables integration. The prediction based strategies may be helpful. Realistic and operable restoration strategies should consider controllable components of a power system, i.e., the breaker-based model should be established. The restoration strategy established in this project is based on the branch-bus model. Mapping between branch-bus model and breaker based model should be established in the future.

712410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
712410.value: It is well known that a reliable supply of electricity is essential to sound economic development and societal vitality. Recent catastrophic blackouts in North America, Europe, and India serve as powerful reminders of the need for a reliable, resilient, and responsive power grid. The US Electric Power Research Institute estimated that “across all business sectors, the U.S. economy is losing between $104 billion and $164 billion a year to outages”. By minimizing or eliminating interruptions, the self-healing grid could dramatically reduce this cost. Power system restoration is a essential component to implement a self-healing smart grid. Very few effective decision support tools are currently available to dispatchers. The objective of this project is to study how to restore a power system after an outage. The restoration process is decoupled into several sub-problems (milestones). Based on the characteristics of the system and outage, a set of milestones can be selected to construct the restoration strategy. Algorithms and software modules are developed. The impacts of renewables on system restoration are also studied. The accomplishment of this project would represent a major step toward modernization of power system restoration and, ultimately, fully implement the functions of a self-healing smart grid.

713510.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
713510.value: Hydrogen is a very useful gas because it has many industrial applications such as metal smelting, cooling in power station, electronic fabrication process, medical installation and corrosion prevention in nuclear reactors. Also, as an environment-friendly green energy source in fuel cell to lower carbon emissions and create less pollution, hydrogen can power electric and hybrid vehicles, as well as emergency/backup power systems. However, hydrogen is a very dangerous gas because it is highly flammable with a high rate of flame propagation. In order to avoid the leakage of hydrogen that can cause serious explosion, sensors that can detect hydrogen quickly and accurately are important and essential in practical applications. Silicon carbide (SiC) is an ideal material to produce these sensors. Its wide bandgap permits its use at temperatures up to 1000 oC. Also, SiC is very hard and chemically inert, which permit its use in aggressive atmospheres. To date, devices based on catalytic metal (Pt, Pd, etc.)-insulator-SiC (MISiC) structure, e.g. MISiC Schottky diodes and MISiC capacitors have been extensively investigated in these capacities. However, before they can be put into practical applications, it is of utmost importance to develop a suitable dielectric material to act as the insulator inside the devices, having high-quality interfaces with the gate metal and SiC substrate, thus raising the interfacial diffusion barriers to effectively resist intermixing of layers. Therefore, the main aim of this project is to investigate the preparation methods, and optimize physical, geometrical and process parameters for such dielectrics, with a view to improving the long-term high-temperature stability as well as sensitivity of the MISiC hydrogen sensors. 氫氣是非常有用的氣體，因為它有許多工業應用，例如：金屬熔煉、電站冷卻、電子製備工藝、醫療裝置以及核反應堆的防腐等等。而且，爲了降低碳排放，減少污染，作為燃料電池的一種環境友好的綠色能源，氫氣能驅動電動和混合動力汽車,以及作為緊急/備用動力系統。然而，氫氣是一種非常危險的氣體，因為它具有高度易燃性以及高的火焰傳播速率。爲了避免能夠引起嚴重爆炸的氫氣的洩露，能夠快速準確探測氫氣的傳感器是重要的，在實際應用中也是必不可少的。碳化硅（SiC）是生產這種傳感器的理想材料。它的寬帶隙允許它在直到1000 0C的溫度下使用。而且，SiC非常堅硬、化學上惰性，使它能在惡劣環境下使用。迄今為此，基於催化金屬(Pt, Pd等)-絕緣體-SiC(MISiC)結構的器件,如: MISiC肖特基二極管和MISiC電容器已經在這些應用方面廣泛被研究。然而，在它們能投入實際應用之前，最重要的是研製一種合適的介質材料作為器件的絕緣層，使之與柵金屬和SiC襯底有高質量的界面，以提高界面擴散勢壘，有效阻止層間互混合。因此，本項目的主要目標是研究製備這種介質的方法，并對介質的物理、幾何和工藝參數最佳化，從而改進MISiC氫氣傳感器的長期高溫穩定性以及靈敏度。

713510.label: Major findings and research outcome
713510.value: 1. MISiC Schottky-diode hydrogen sensor with HfON gate insulator fabricated by NO nitridation is investigated. Experimental results show that this novel sensor can rapidly respond to hydrogen variation and can give a significant response even at a low ???? concentration of 48-ppm, e.g., a sensitivity of 81% is achieved at 450 C and 2.5 V, which is two times higher than its ???? counterpart. The enhanced sensitivity of the device should be attributed to a remarkable reduction of the current of the sensor before hydrogen exposure by the NO nitridation because the NO nitridation can passivate the O vacancies in the insulator and facilitate the formation of a ?? interlayer to suppress the leakage current associated with high- materials. 2. A novel metal–insulator–silicon carbide Schottkydiode hydrogen sensor with HfTiO2 gate insulator annealed in three different gases (N2, O2, or NO) is fabricated. The hydrogen-sensing characteristics of the devices are studied with the help of ellipsometry, transmission electron microscopy, scanning electronmicroscope, energy-dispersive spectroscopy, and atomic force microscopy. Experimental results show that these sensors have high sensor output and can give significant response even at low hydrogen concentration. This work also finds that the NO-annealed sensor has the highest sensor output. When 800-ppm H2 in N2 gas is introduced, the NO-annealed sensor exhibits a high sensor output of 782% at 450 ?C, which is about three and six times higher than those of the O2- and N2-annealed sensors, respectively. As compared to another sensor with HfO2 gate insulator annealed in NO, the proposed NO-annealed sensor shows higher sensor output, which should be mainly attributed to the larger barrier height at the metal–insulator interface. The excellent hydrogen-sensing characteristics of this novel sensor make it very suitable for detecting hydrogen leakage, particularly in high-temperature environments.

713710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
713710.value: Building on the previous successful pilot investigations, this research project aims at developing an integrated air conditioning system comprising a geothermal heat pump system and a liquid desiccant dehumidification system for year-round comfort air conditioning applications in sub-tropical regions. The integration will not only enhance the overall energy efficiency of the system as compared to conventional air conditioning systems but will also contribute to the reduction of heat dumped from such systems to the ambient air. The higher efficiencies of a heat pump and a liquid desiccant dehumidifier in handling the separate treatment of dry air and moisture in the air are the underlying reasons for the enhanced performance. The geothermal heat pump will make use of the ground as a reservoir for heat storage when operating in the cooling mode, thus avoiding the “heat island” effect or a temperature rise in the microclimate due to dumping of heat from air-cooled air conditioning systems. Despite all these advantages, published work on this kind of integrated system was scarce, probably due to the relative lower air humidity in the current major markets of geothermal heat pumps. A detailed three-dimensional modelling methodology for geothermal ground heat exchanger design will be developed to enable more accurate determination of the requirement for provision of ground boreholes. A novel design of liquid desiccant dehumidifier will be investigated in order to solve the carry-over problem of conventional systems in which minute droplets of the liquid desiccant are blown into the supply air stream, causing health hazard concerns. The superiority of the proposed integrated system will be demonstrated by using computer simulation based on the models developed and experimental testing of the prototype built. A case study on the application of the integrated system will be made in respect of a typical low-rise housing development in Hong Kong in which central cooling and heating will be provided throughout the year so that the energy saving potential can be identified. The successful outcome of this research project will be beneficial not only to academics and building services engineering professionals but also to all walks of life in Hong Kong and other sub-tropical regions. It will make significant contribution to energy conservation and the consequent reduction of carbon dioxide generation and promotion of environmental protection since building air conditioning systems consume a major proportion of the total energy supply on a worldwide basis. 在過往初部研究探討的成功基礎上，這個研究項目旨在制定一套包括地熱熱泵系統和液態化學抽濕系統的綜合空調系統，能在亞熱帶地區提供全年室內舒適空調服務。這種結合，不僅能提升傳統空調系統的整體系統能源效率，並且亦有助於減少從這些系統排放到周圍空氣的熱量。其基本原因，實有賴於獨立處理乾燥空氣及其中的水分時，熱泵和液態化學抽濕機能發揮較高的效率。當在制冷操作模式時，地熱熱泵會利用土壤作為熱儲藏庫，從而避免了“熱島”效應，亦即是由於從風冷式空調系統排放的熱量而引致微氣象的溫度上升。儘管擁有上述這些優點，關於這種結合式系統的文獻還是稀少，原因可能是由於在目前主要地熱熱泵的市場，當地空氣濕度還是相對的低。 為求能夠更準確測定地面鑽孔數量的需要，將發展一個詳細的三維建模方法，以作地熱熱交換器設計之用，。並將會探討一套設計新穎的液態化學抽濕機，用以解決傳統系統的液滴流轉問題，就是由於其液態乾燥劑的液滴被吹入供應氣流，因而產生對危害健康的關注。將利用基於研發所得的數學模型作計算機模擬運算及初型實驗測試結果，證明所提出的結合式系統的優越性。為確定這結合式系統，在全年運作式中央冷氣及取暖系統中，所具備的節能潛力，亦將進行一個以香港典型低層住宅物業發展為題的個案研究。 若成功完成，這研究項目將不僅有利於對學術界及屋宇裝備工程專業人士，也能惠及所有在香港及其他亞熱帶地區的各行各業。這將可以為能源保護和隨之而來的二氧化碳減排與環保推廣，作出重大貢獻，概因建築空調系統所消耗的能源佔全球總能源供應的主要部份。

713710.label: Major findings and research outcome
713710.value: A methodology was devised to determine the groundwater direction from a thermal response test analysis using three boreholes. The corresponding findings were published in HVAC&R Research. A new TRNSYS component was also developed based on the previously built borehole model, which was used to perform dynamic system simulations of a typical office building in Hong Kong. The related results were presented in the conference Building Simulation 2011. An experimental setup was erected to study the results of a thermal response test which utilised three boreholes with various groundwater flow directions. However, it was found that the predicted groundwater conditions departed substantially from the actual values. This was mainly due to the limitations of the available experimental facility which made it difficult to keep the far-field groundwater temperature constant. The previously developed numerical model for the borehole ground heat exchangers was modified to handle an inhomogeneous groundwater flow. The formulation of the new model was published in Energy. Additionally, the new model was employed to investigate the effect of groundwater table on a thermal response test analysis, and the results were presented in the International Conference on Applied Energy. It was found that if the groundwater table in the thermal response test analysis was ignored, it could lead to erroneous results in the subsequent dynamic system simulation, particularly for long-term study of a large borefield. A simplified numerical model for a cylindrical energy pile was developed, which did not make use of very fine grids. The formulation of the model was published in Energy. Furthermore, the capability of determining the thermal properties inside and outside the energy pile through a thermal response test analysis was investigated, showing that the predicted results were sufficiently accurate. The results were presented in the International Conference on Sustainable Energy Technologies. An experimental setup was built to investigate the performance of a novel liquid desiccant dehumidifier tower. However, the test results departed significant from the simulated values, primarily due to the liquid desiccant not being sufficiently regenerated and cooled before entering the dehumidifier tower. Nevertheless, the benefit of employing speed control to a ground-coupled liquid desiccant air-conditioner was investigated. Dynamic simulations were performed for an application to an office in Hong Kong. It was found that the annual borefield load unbalance was reduced which was beneficial to situations involving multi-storey buildings. The results were published in the Journal of Clean Energy Technologies.

713710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
713710.value: The experimental thermal response test can be improved by increasing the scale of the test rig. Instead of using an electric heater inserted inside each borehole to generate the heat load, a U-tube can be adopted with hot water circulating through it in order to achieve heat rejection in a way similar to the actual installation. The performance of the liquid desiccant dehumidifier tower can be further studied by modifying the test rig. Chilled water can be employed to cool the regenerated liquid desiccant before entering the dehumidifier tower. Provision should be made for proper positioning of the temperature sensor for measuring the desiccant temperature entering the dehumidifier tower. Measures should also be made to enhance the regeneration effectiveness.

713710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
713710.value: The research project aims at investigating different important aspects of ground-source heat pump systems intended for use in a sub-tropical city like Hong Kong. These include the more precise modelling of the ground heat exchanger performance with an inhomogeneous groundwater flow as well as the development of a new hybrid system through the coupling with a liquid desiccant dehumidification cycle for reducing the annual heat injection into the ground. In both considerations, the required borehole length may be reduced which implies that the initial cost can be lowered and the payback period of the system shortened. This is crucial when economic feasibility of the system is taken into consideration. With the development of a modified model for the ground heat exchanger in the research project, it becomes possible to investigate more complex groundwater flow conditions that may be encountered in actual situations. The application of the proposed variable-speed ground-coupled liquid desiccant air-conditioner allows more floors to be served by the ground-source heat pump systems subject to the constraint of a limited borefield area. This will enhance the applicability of the system to multi-storey buildings which are commonly found in Hong Kong.

713810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
713810.value: Many systems in the physical world have dynamics that change abruptly in some random fashion. There are abundant examples of these systems in various engineering applications, for instance, failures and recovery processes in manufacturing systems, change of operation modes in power systems, and varying of control surfaces in flight control systems. Traditional mathematical models with deterministic descriptions are far from sufficient to represent the complex dynamic behavior of these systems. The theories developed for jump systems often require precise statistical information of the jumping processes, which renders them difficult to be applied in practice. Recent years have seen some preliminary developments in theory of systems with random jumps governed by partially known, or completely unknown jumping processes under the frameworks of Markov jump and switched systems. On the other hand, many practical models describing the evolution of the population of species in a competitive environment, the concentrations of biopolymers in cells, or the transport and accumulation phenomena in compartments, have positive characteristics. These ‘positive’ system models require special and more involved mathematical treatments as they are defined on cones rather than on linear spaces. While the development of theories related to control synthesis and approximation techniques for systems with jumps has received great attention in the past decade, very little effort has been devoted to practical systems with positive characteristics. The control synthesis and approximation of jump systems with imprecise transition descriptions have not been actively pursued in the past due to difficulties and the lack of effective tools in preserving the natural constraints of positivity of the systems in the feedback control and simplification processes. By exploiting the system characteristics and employing the latest theoretical tools, this project aims to develop new and enhanced control system design and system simplification results for jump systems with uncertain transitions and positive characteristics. Several features on the description of the switching characteristics using non-homogeneous Markov chains and the concept of fixed and average dwell time will be explored. Various commonly used control performances will be characterized to facilitate the simplification and controller design under the structural constraints of positivity. The expected performance improvements will reduce undesirable conservatism and considerably narrow the gaps between existing theories and applications. 現實世界中許多系統的動力學特徵會以某種隨機的方式劇烈變化。在不同的工程應用中存在大量這類系統的例子，比如，製造系統中的出錯與恢復的過程，電力系統中的操作模式的切換，以及飛行控制系統中的控制面的轉變。 具有確定性描述的傳統的數學模型遠不夠描述這些系統的複雜的動態行為。已有的跳變系統理論往往需要跳躍過程的精確的統計信息，這使得其很難在實際中應用。近年來，在馬爾可夫跳躍和切換系統的框架下，具有部分已知或完全未知的跳躍過程的隨機跳躍系統理論有了一些初步進展。另一方面，許多實際的模型，比如描述在一個競爭環境中的物種種群的變化，細胞中的大分子的濃度，或在隔室中的轉移及聚集的現象，這些模型都具有正性特點。因為這些正系統模型是定義在錐面上而不是線性空間上，所以需要特殊和更複雜的數學處理方法。雖然在過去十年裡，與跳躍系統的控制綜合與近似有關的控制理論的發展得到了廣泛的關注，但是對於具有正性特徵的實際系統方面的研究還很少。過去由於困難以及缺乏有效的工具使得在回饋控制和簡化的過程中保持系統的正性約束，使得具有不精確跳躍描述的跳躍系統的控制綜合與近似理論沒有得到積極的研究。 這項目的目的就是通過利用系統特性和應用最新的理論工具，針對具有不確定切換和正特性的跳躍系統，發展新的改進型的控制系統設計和簡化方法。我們將利用非齊次馬爾可夫鏈和固定或平均滯留時間的概念研究描述切換特性的幾種特點。在正性結構約束下，各種常用的控制性能將被刻畫，從而使得系統簡化和控制器設計變得容易。同時，預期的系統性能改善將減小不希望出現的保守性，並大大縮小現有理論和應用之間的差距。

713810.label: Realisation of objectives
713810.value: All the objectives have been achieved. The details are listed below. Objective 1 A new stability condition for continuous-time Markovian jump time delay systems with incomplete transition rate descriptions is provided. Several synchronization conditions are obtained for coupled genetic oscillators by means of Lyapunov functional theory and matrix inequality approach. A class of random jump systems represented by transition operators, which includes switched linear systems with strictly stationary switching signals in infinite modes space as its special case is considered and a series of necessary and sufficient conditions are established for almost sure stability of this class of random jump systems under different scenarios. The relations between asymptotic stability and exponential stability of continuous-time and discrete-time positive systems with delay are also investigated. In terms of control performances, ℓ1-induced and L1-induced performances for positive systems are developed using linear Lyapunov function. Analytical computational expressions of these performances is provided. For positive linear systems with distributed delays, the L∞-gain performance is developed. The equivalence of several dynamic characteristics between mutually dual switched linear systems, both discrete- and continuous-time cases are considered. Objective 2 A new design technique based on a projection inequality has been applied to design both state feedback and static output feedback controllers for continuous-time Markovian jump time delay systems with incomplete transition rate descriptions. Iterative solutions of Lyapunov matrix equations associated with Ito stochastic systems having Markovian jump parameters are given. The problem of positive observer synthesis for positive systems with both interval parameter uncertainties and time delay is tackled and a pair of positive observers with state-bounding feature is proposed. The idea is also extended to the case of continuous-time filtering under the L1-induced performance. The synthesis of the state-feedback controller for single-input multiple-output positive systems is investigated under ℓ1-induced performance with analytical solution established. Certain applications of simultaneous and decentralized stabilization techniques to multi-agent consensus control and building vibration control are also studied. Moreover, an approach to synthesizing asynchronous switching control laws for discrete-time Markovian jump linear systems is developed. Objective 3 The construction of a reduced-order model for a stable positive system is developed such that the positivity of the original system is preserved and the error system is stable with a prescribed H∞ performance. The problem of mixed additive/multiplicative model reduction for stable linear continuous-time systems is also studied. The solution procedure can be implemented by the well-known cone complementary linearization method.

713810.label: Major findings and research outcome
713810.value: For Markov jump systems with delay and uncertain transition descriptions, a stability criterion is formulated with state- and input delay for fully known transition rates. On the basis of it, an equivalent condition is given under the assumption of partly known/unknown transition rates which is then used for synthesizing controllers [J9]. Several synchronization conditions are obtained for coupled a class of systems with positive characteristic---genetic oscillators [J3]. Random jump systems represented by transition operators are studied with equivalent almost sure stability established [J6]. For systems with positive characteristics, the relations between asymptotic stability and exponential stability of positive systems with delay are obtained [J8]. For switched systems, the equivalence of several dynamic characteristics between mutually dual switched linear systems is exposed [J17]. Moreover, stochastic stability of switched systems with dwell time consisting of a fixed and a random part is analyzed [J14]. An approach to synthesizing asynchronous switching control laws for Markovian jump linear systems is provided by utilizing a separation technique [C2]. Performance-based synthesis problems for various systems with positive characteristics are investigated. Characterizations of ℓ1-induced, L1-induced, and L-inf-induced (systems with distributed delay) performances and their analytical expressions are obtained. Corresponding controllers and filters can be constructed using linear programs [J10,J15,C1]. Bounding positive observers and filters are obtained [J4,J18]. Linear Lyapunov function to prove the asymptotic stability of positive fractional-order nonlinear systems has been revisited [J16]. Two system approximation problems are considered. Positivity and stability preserving model reduction is considered under a prescribed H-inf performance using the system augmentation approach [J2]. A necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of a desired reduced-order model is derived. Iterative linear matrix inequality approaches with primal and dual forms are proposed for solution. The problem of mixed additive/multiplicative model reduction for stable linear continuous-time systems is studied. By virtue of the bounded real lemma and the projection lemma, a linear matrix inequality approach is proposed for mixed additive/multiplicative H-infinity model reduction [J12]. Semi-definite or linear programs are used to check the developed stability analysis conditions and for synthesizing controllers and filters. Iterative solutions of Lyapunov matrix equations associated with Ito stochastic systems having Markovian jump parameters are also provided [J1]. The results of this project have been applied to the decentralized H-inf control problem [J7], consensus control for multi-agent control [J5,J11,J19] and building vibration control [J13].

713810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
713810.value: Amongst the many potential applications and extensions of the results developed in the project, there are two areas where the results can be further developed (a) The reachable set estimation of stochastic systems is an important property which has not been studied. It is especially interesting to consider the case with uncertain transition descriptions for Markov jump linear systems. The analysis can be further extended to systems with various delays (discrete, distributed, or neutral). (b) Positive systems with Markov jump characteristics form a class of systems that have special importance to genetic regulatory network modelling. The signal transmission involves time-varying delays which may be bounded or unbounded under some rate constraints. For positive linear systems with delays, it is well known that their stability is insensitive to the magnitudes of the delays. While this is still valid for stochastic systems is particular interesting and important from a synthesis point of view.

713810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
713810.value: Dynamic systems in the physical world may change abruptly in some random fashion. Traditional mathematical models with deterministic descriptions are far from sufficient to represent their complex dynamic behavior. The theories developed for jump systems often require precise statistical information of the jumping processes, which renders them difficult to be applied in practice. On the other hand, many practical models describing the evolution of the population of species in a competitive environment, or the concentrations of biopolymers in cells, have positive characteristics. In this project, analysis and synthesis methods for Markov jump systems with delay under uncertain Markov transitions have been developed. Equivalent almost sure stability conditions for general random jump systems represented by transition operators have been established, and stochastic stability for Markov jump systems with dwell time consisting of a fixed and a random part has been characterized. New control-related performances and analytical expressions for computation have been established for positive systems. Bounding observers and filters are constructed for such systems. Model approximation approaches have been developed for both positive and general systems under certain error measures. The results have been applied to a variety of control problems ranging from multi-agent control and building vibration control.

714310.label: Project Title(Chinese)
714310.value: 服務於普適通信的基於QoS的自適應排程機制

714310.label: Project Objectives
714310.value: Design a QoS-based scheduler for ubiquitous communication: We would like to propose a novel scheduler, known as adaptive QoS-based scheduler (AQS) to support ubiquitous applications with very different QoS requirements. AQS can support various communication paradigms, such as unicast communication, anycast communication, multicast communication, and broadcast communication. Propose novel scheduling algorithms for AQS: AQS consists of two levels, namely, the node level and the flow level. At the node level, AQS aims to construct a transmission schedule for a node so as to yield the best network bandwidth usage based on the current bandwidth demands of neighbouring nodes. It adapts to changes in network topology to improve its performance. When the network topology is stable, AQS performs like a topology-dependent scheduler. Otherwise, it does topology-transparent scheduling. We will also devise the adaptation conditions to optimize network performance. At the flow level, we propose a novel flow-based fair packet scheduling algorithm which makes use of the assigned transmission schedule from the node level to construct a transmission schedule for each flow so that the issues of flow-based QoS guarantees, mobility, and channel error handling can be jointly addressed. Implement a prototype ubiquitous system utilizing AQS: We will implement a prototype ubiquitous system utilizing the aforementioned AQS in a wireless ad hoc network testbed. We will then evaluate the scheduling performance of AQS on the ubiquitous system in terms of the realized flow-based and network throughputs, computational and storage overheads, power consumption, and so on. We have experience implementing P2P applications in an ad hoc network testbed, and we believe it is feasible to translate our experience in deploying these P2P applications into an AQS prototype.

714310.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
714310.value: The growing demands of anywhere, anytime communication dictate that part of the communication infrastructure be wireless; and many advances have been made in wireless communications, such as the developments in wireless ad hoc networks. However, the provision of quality-of-service (QoS) guarantees in such networks remains a challenging research issue due to node mobility, and the limited availability and variability of wireless bandwidth. Existing research is inadequate because 1) it is not adaptive to changes in network topology or it fails to offer flow-based QoS guarantees with high network utilization, and 2) it does not address implementation issues. In this project, we propose a novel scheduler, known as adaptive QoS-based scheduler (AQS), to support ubiquitous applications with different QoS requirements in wireless ad hoc networks. To address the dynamic topology of ad hoc networks due to mobility, and to cater to different QoS requirements of different applications, we propose a two-level AQS design, consisting of the node level and the flow level. At the node level, we devise an adaptive distributed scheduling algorithm to construct a transmission schedule for a node so as to yield the best network bandwidth usage based on the current bandwidth demands of neighbouring nodes and the network topology information. At the flow level, we propose a novel flow-based fair packet scheduling algorithm which employs the assigned transmission schedule from the node level to construct a transmission schedule for each flow so that the issues of flow-based QoS guarantees, mobility, and channel error handling can be jointly addressed. To demonstrate the feasibility of AQS, we shall implement and evaluate the performance of AQS in a wireless ad hoc network testbed. With these efforts, we expect that this project will impact the development of QoS provisioning in the next-generation wireless ad hoc networks for ubiquitous communication. The basic science developed in this project will be important contributions to the research community, while the knowledge and experience gained in the testbed deployment will prove valuable to industry. 大眾對於普適（隨時，隨地）通信服務的需求日益增長。這使得無線網絡成為通信網絡中不可或缺的壹部分。當前，無線通信已取得了多方面的進展，無線隨意網絡即為其中之壹。然而，由於通信節點的流動性及無線帶寬的有限和不固定，在無線隨意網絡上服務質量 (QoS)的保證仍為研究難題。現有的相關研究尚存較大不足， 具體而言：1）對於網絡拓撲結構的變化的適應性，和在保證充分利用網絡資源前提下的以數據流為單位的QoS， 兩者未能兼得 2）缺乏具體的實現機制 本課題將提出壹個新的排程機制，來滿足無線隨意網絡上各種普適應用程序的QoS要求。這壹機制被命名為基於QoS的自適應排程機制(AQS)。 我們提出壹個雙層（即節點層和數據流層）的AQS 設計，來應對由節點運動帶來的網絡拓撲結構變化和各種應用程序不同的QoS要求。在節點層，我們將設計壹個自適應的分布式排程算法來設定每個節點的傳輸時間安排。這壹算法旨在於考慮鄰近節點帶寬需求和網絡拓撲結構的前提下實現對網絡帶寬的最佳利用。在數據流層，我們將提出壹個全新的以數據流為單位的公平數據包排程算法。這壹算法將利用節點層設定的節點傳輸時間安排來設定每個數據流的時間安排。這樣， 對每個數據流的QoS要求的保證，節點流動性，及對傳輸信道中發生錯誤的應對，可以得到統壹的解決。 我們將在壹套無線隨意網絡上實現AQS並對其表現作出評估，以此來說明AQS的可行性。 我們認為，本課題的成果將對在下壹代無線隨意網絡上為普適應用提供QoS保證的發展產生積極的影響。其理論部分對於科研群體將是重要貢獻。另壹方面，在試驗床上進行開發和試驗過程中所獲取的經驗對業界不無脾益。
