784710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
784710.value: 从胚胎干细胞中制备神经细胞是一种对神经损伤进行修复的有效方法。 我们研究了一个钙释放的内源因子，环腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADRP）, 对小鼠胚胎幹細胞的神經分化过程的调控。 cADPR广泛存在于从植物到动物的多种细胞中。 cADRP在许多细胞活动中起着重要的作用。cADPR是由烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD）在ADP核糖基环化酶的作用下形成的。合成cADPR的最主要ADP-核糖环化酶是CD38。CD38是一种膜结合蛋白和新颖的多功能酶。我们发现在小鼠胚胎幹細胞的神經分化的过程中，CD38的表达降低了。CD38的敲除或8-生物素-cADPR拮抗剂的处理都能加快胚胎幹細胞的神經分化。 我们推测CD38/cADPR/Ca2+ 信号传递通路对胚胎幹細胞的神經分化过程有抑制作用。因此我们设计：（1）进一步证明cADPR在胚胎幹細胞的神經分化中的作用；（2）解析cADPR在胚胎幹細胞的神經分化过程中的分子机理。这个项目的成功不仅能够增加我们对胚胎幹細胞的分化和神經系统的发育的了解，并且能够促进对神經和心理疾病进行相应的胚胎幹細胞的细胞治疗。

784710.label: Realisation of objectives
784710.value: Objective 1. To establish the role of cADPR in neural differentiation of ES cells. To explore the role of CD38/cADPR signaling in the neural differentiation of ES cells, we demonstrated that the cADPR signaling is functioning endogenously not only in undifferentiated ES cells but also in neurons derived from ES cells. Subsequently, we established both CD38 knockdown and CD38 overexpressing ES cell lines and found that the CD38 knockdown or overexprssing ES cells are undifferentiated and proliferate normally when maintained in regular ES medium. We then successfully adopted a method to efficiently drive ES cell entry neural lineage. We found that CD38 knockdown or treatment of cells with a cADPR antagonist or a CD38 inhibitor markedly inhibited neural differentiation of ES cells, whereas CD38 overexpressing promoted it. Taken together, we demonstrate that the CD38/cADPR signaling is required for the neural differentiation of mouse ES cells (Wei and Yue, submitted). Thus, we have successfully completed the objective 1. In addition, we explored the role of CD38 signaling in the cardiomyogenesis of ES cells. Interestingly, we found that overexpression of CD38 in ES cells significantly inhibited CM differentiation, whereas CD38 knockdown promoted it. Moreover, CD38 knockdown ES cell derived CMs possess the functional properties as normal ES cell derived CMs. Last, we showed that the CD38 pathway negatively modulated FGF4 cascade to suppress CM differentiation of ES cells. Taken together, our data indicate that CD38 signaling pathway inhibits CM differentiation of ES cells (Wei et al., 2012, J. Biol. Chem. 287). Objective 2. Mechanism of CD38/cADPR signaling in neural differentiation of ES cells. Neural induction in vivo is regulated by an interplay between FGF, BMP, Wnts, and other unidentified signaling events. Yet, our data indicate that the CD38 signaling is involved in neural differentiation of ES cells independent of the known regulatory circuits. On the other hand, we found that CD38 knockdown markedly inhibited reactive oxygen species (ROS) production as compared to control cells, whereas CD38 overexpression increased it. Moreover, application of hydrogen peroxide mitigated the inhibitory effects of CD38 knockdown on neural differentiation of ES cells. Interestingly, CD38 does not affect mitochondrial function to regulate ROS production. Instead, we found that CD38 is required for NADPH oxidase activity. In summary, we demonstrate that the CD38 signaling pathway is required for neural differentiation of ES cells by modulating ROS production (Wei and Yue, submitted). In summary, we have successfully completed the objective 2 as well.

784710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
784710.value: We found that treatment of ES cell derived neurons with cADPR antagonists, markedly inhibited Ach-induced intracellular Ca2+ signaling. Unexpectedly, Ach, ATP, bradykinin, or dopamine all induced similar Ca2+ changes in neurons derived from CD38 knockdown ES cells as compared to control cells, suggesting that the Ca2+ handling in CD38 knockdown neurons is actually normal. This seemingly contradictory result may be explained by the possibility that CD38-independent ADP-ribosyl cyclase can compensate the loss of CD38 to produce normal levels of cADPR, thereby contributing to the normal Ca2+ handling properties of these neurons. Thus, one of future plan in the lab is to molecularly identify CD38 independent ADP-ribosyl cyclase in the neural tissues or cells. We found that CD38 does not affect mitochondrial function to regulate ROS production. Another importance source for cellular ROS production is NOX of NADPH oxidase. We indeed found that CD38 knockdown markedly inhibited NOX activity and CD38 overexpression increased it. However, C38 knockdown did not inhibit the expression of some NOX subunits during neural differentiation. Instead, CD38 appears to be colocalized with p22phox in the cell membrane. Whether CD38 regulates NOX activity by directly interacting with the NOX family members is currently under investigation in the lab.

784710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
784710.value: CD38 is a multi-functional membrane enzyme and the main mammalian ADP-ribosyl cyclase, which catalyzes the synthesis and hydrolysis of cADPR, a potent endogenous Ca2+ messengers. Here we explored the role of CD38 in the neural differentiation of mouse embryonic stem (ES) cells. We found that the expression of CD38 is decreased during the neural differentiation of mouse ES cells in vitro. Perturbing the CD38/cADPR signaling by either CD38 knockdown or treatment of cADPR antagonists inhibited the neural commitment of mouse ES cells, whereas overexpression of CD38 promoted it. Moreover, CD38 knockdown dampened reactive oxygen species (ROS) production during neural differentiation of ES cells by inhibiting NADPH oxidase (NOX) activity, while CD38 overexpression enhanced it. Likewise, application of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) mitigated the inhibitory effects of CD38 knockdown on neural differentiation of ES cells. Taken together, our data indicate that the CD38 signaling pathway is required for neural differentiation of mouse ES cells by modulating ROS production. The success of this project not only increased our understanding of ES cell differentiation and embryonic neural development, but also encourage the application of therapies based on ES cells in the treatment of neurological and psychiatric disease.

785010.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
785010.value: 根管治療是牙科常用方法之一。然而，根管治療後的牙齒失去營養和變得脆弱。理想的方法是去除感染或壞死牙髓後，能夠再生牙髓組織，保持牙齒的活力。 我們的研究表明，通過保守的治療方法－根管消毒，形成血塊和嚴密封閉根管，牙髓壞死的年輕恆牙能夠繼續形成牙根和獲得正常的牙髓功能。理論上認為，血塊的形成能夠吸引根尖周的干細胞進入根管再生牙髓組織。在初步的狗牙實驗中，我們並沒有發現新生的牙髓組織。可能因為進入根管的根尖周干細胞不足。體外培養和植入干細胞進入根管可能促進牙髓再生。此外，根尖周干細胞植入根管，需要支架組織和血液營養。血管內皮前體細胞於根尖周干細胞共同培養有可能夠促進組織的再生和血管化，血管內皮生長因子能夠促進血管內皮細胞的增值和血管再生。但是，有關血管內皮細胞對牙髓再生尚無研究。 本研究主要對共同植入根尖周干細胞和血管內皮前體細胞牙髓再生進行實驗。將研究不同比例的細胞混合培養，獲得最佳牙髓再生的細胞比例；體內研究將一定比例的兩種干細胞混合後植入牙根片斷中，再埋入實驗鼠皮下，6周後取出，進行組織學和免疫組織化學研究，牙髓再生組織的結構， 細胞和血管的結構， 再生牙本質和造牙本質細胞層。如果牙髓再生能夠實現， 有可能成為新的牙髓疾病的治療方法， 具有重要的臨床和公共健康意義。

785010.label: Realisation of objectives
785010.value: 1. To investigate the effects of EPCs on the dentinogenic differentiation of SCAPs at different SCAPs/EPCs ratios, and to determine the optimal ratio of SCAPs/EPCs for co-transplantation: Different ratios of SCAPs and EPCs were cultured in direct contact using optimized medium for coculture. The 70% confluent cocultures were incubated in the osteo-/odontogenic differentiation medium for up to 3 weeks. Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity, the expression levels of ALP, bone sialoprotein (BSP), dentin sialophosphoprotein (DSPP) genes, and alizarin red staining for mineralization at different time points were analyzed. The quantification of ALP in co-cultures revealed a greater ALP activity compared with DPSC-alone cultures. At all the time points, 1:1 cultures showed a significantly greater ALP activity than that of DPSC-alone cultures. Alizarin red staining and quantification revealed a much greater amount of calcification in the 1:1 and 1:5 cocultures compared with other cultures (P < .01). The expression levels of ALP, BSP, and DSPP genes further confirmed the greater osteo-/odontogenic differentiation in cocultures compared with those of DPSC-alone cultures. 2. To investigate the ability of EPCs with or without VEGF in enhancing of pulp tissue regeneration and vascularization of SCAPs in immunodeficient mice transplantation; & 3. To explore the fate of SCAPs and EPCs in the newly formed pulp tissue and its vascular networks, and to analyze the mechanisms of interactions between SCAPs, EPCs and host endothelial cells. EPCs and SCAPs were encapsulated within a peptide hydrogel scaffold. Cell-scaffold constructs were injected into the canal space of tooth-root fragments and implanted into the subcutaneous space on the back of 6- 8-week-old female severe combined immunodeficient mice. Three months after the transplantation, the mice were euthanized and the tooth fragments were removed for histological (Haematoxylin and eosin) and immunohistochemical (human mitochondria and CD31) analysis. The histological examination of the tissue sections is still ongoing. The available data showed that co-cultured group formed higher amount of vascular pulp-like tissue compared to mono-cultured group. 4. With the collaboration with my previous students in Peking University, large animal study with canine teeth simulated clinical pulp regeneration has been performed. Canine premolars were infected for apical lesion formation, disinfected, and then transplanted with autologous dental pulp stem cells with platelet-rich plasma (containing high concentration of growth factors) for 3 months. Radiographic, histological and immunohistological examination were conducted. The results showed that with PRP and stem cells transplantation, more vital tissues formed inside the root canals.

785010.label: Major findings and research outcome
785010.value: This study, for the first time, unveiled the synergistic effects of dental stem cells (DSCs) and endothelial cells (ECs) in vasculogenesis and odontogenic differentiation in-vitro (Dissanayaka et al., 2012) and pulp-like tissue regeneration in-vivo (Zhu et al., 2012; Zhu et al., 2013). It further examined the interactions between SCAPs and EPCs in a 3D co-culture model, focusing on the survival, proliferation, angiogenesis and differentiation capacities to reflect the cells’ complex and multi-component in-vivo milieu more accurately. The results of this study found that ECs regulate DPSC activity and their differentiation capacity in 3D, which may facilitate the maintenance of DPSC quiescence and osteo/odontogenic differentiation when exposed to induction stimuli. The in-vivo mouse study, in which the DPSC-EC encapsulated peptide hydrogel was transplanted to investigate the vascularized dental pulp regeneration, unveiled that Peptide Hydrogel Scaffold can promote long-lasting vessel formation when endothelial cells were co-encapsulated with dental pulp stem cells and showed that in-vitro prevascularized stem cell constructs can successfully be used for dental pulp regeneration. (Manuscript is under preparation). In the canine model study, vital tissues were regenerated inside the root canals with transplantation of dental stem cells with PRP in canine premolars. The results further showed the closure of open apex and healing of apical lesion radiographically. Histologically, the new regenerated tissue contained bone-like, cementum-like and connective tissue with newly-formed vasculatures (Zhu et al 2012; Zhu et al 2013).

785010.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
785010.value: The promising results of this study can be further examined in a large animal model such as dog or guinea pig before developing into a clinical trial. From this study, we found the newly formed tissue inside the root canals were mainly bone-like, cementum-like tissue, which is different from normal pulp tissue, which we originally expected to be regenerated. Further study using immunohistochemical (human mitochondria and CD31) analysis to decipher the roles of transplanted cells and host cells will be performed. The histological and immunohistological examination of the tissue sections is still ongoing. The available data showed that co-cultured group formed higher amount of vascular pulp-like tissue compared to mono-cultured group. However, we observed that in majority of root canals, the new tissue does not grow to fill the whole root canal. This indicates that multiple-step transplantation should be investigated to replace the single-step transplantation.

785010.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
785010.value: Each year, millions of teeth with infected and dead pulp are treated by root canal therapy. This makes teeth generally weaker and susceptible to undesirable outcomes. Therefore, there is a need to combine the recent progress in stem cell and tissue engineering research to establish a better clinical treatment modality to regenerate the lost dentin-pulp tissues. It was shown that dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs) are a promising group of stem cells which has the potential of producing dentin-pulp like tissues in vivo. When implanting cells/scaffolds into root canals which have a blood supply only from the apical end, measures for enhancing blood supply is particularly important. However, this aspect was not studied adequately in relation to dentin-pulp regeneration and most of the studies have overlooked it. The present study investigated the potential of dentin-pulp regeneration by DPSCs when co-implanted with endothelial cells (ECs). The results showed that there is an enhancing effect in blood vessel formation and pulp differentiation. Animal study showed the potential of regeneration of pulp-like tissue with a good blood supply by this method. The success of this study may lead to develop an entirely new treatment protocol in clinical endodontics based on stem cell therapy.

785110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
785110.value: 人源CD38是一個多功能蛋白， 參與多種不同的功能。作為一種酶，它催化產生兩種鈣信使，即cADPR和NAADP；作為一種抗原，它參與調控細胞的粘附，分化和增殖。而且，CD38是1型人類免疫缺陷病毒（HIV-1）感染進程的一個分子標記，也是B細胞慢性淋巴癌（B-CLL）惡化的一個標記。最近的研究顯示，CD38能夠與T細胞表面抗原CD4結合， 而CD4是人類免疫缺陷病毒感染的基本受體。在HIV感染過程中，HIV表面的蛋白gp120結合CD4從而引發病毒和細胞的融合。這樣，HIV就進入了細胞內。通過與CD4的結合， CD38抑制了gp120和CD4之間的結合，因此抑制了HIV感染。CD38也參與了B細胞慢性淋巴癌，不僅僅作為一個診斷標記分子，也是一個治療的靶點。因此，抗CD38的抗體已經被廣泛地研究和發展用以治療B細胞慢性淋巴癌。CD38的抗體分為兩類，一類是激活性的，一類是非激活性的。CD38的激活性抗體是配體擬合的，它與CD38結合後引發的應答與配體結合CD38引發的應答是相似的。而非激活性抗體結合CD38後，不能夠引發CD38的信號傳導。此次申請，我們計劃研究CD38與CD4以及CD38與抗CD38的抗體（包括激活性和非激活性抗體）之間相互作用的分子基礎。這些研究將揭示CD38對HIV融合的抑制效應以及CD38與配體之間的結合方式，為治療HIV感染和B細胞慢性淋巴癌的藥物設計提供原子水平的精確信息。

785110.label: Realisation of objectives
785110.value: We have tried to express CD4 in E.coli, yeast and insect cells. However, CD4 was expressed as inclusion body in E.coli and the expression levels in yeast and insect cells were extremely low. We can not get enough protein to detect the binding between CD4 and CD38. We have expressed and purified HB7 and OKT10. They were co-crystallized with CD38. The diffraction data were colleced and the structures were solved. Furtheremore, we identified more than 20 nanobodies against CD38, with 8 of them successfully crystallized with CD38 and the structures were all solved.

785110.value: We have got the complex structures of CD38 with a serial antibodies against CD38. The specific binding epitopes of all these antibodies have been identified. The structural comparison among them revealed how these antibodies can affect the function of CD38 and indicated potential therapeutic application. The results have been summarized in 3 published papers, 1 submitted paper and 1 in-preparing manuscript.

785110.value: We have solved 8 nanobodies in complex with CD38, with each of them bound to different epitope on CD38. These nanobodies are small, one-domain protein, which have been indicated very useful in therapeutic development.Further development of these nanobodies may be used in CD38 related diseases.

785110.value: We have determined a serial structures of CD38 in complex with its antibodies. These antibodies bind different positions of CD38. These structures may be useful in medicine development in CD38 related diseases.

785210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
785210.value: Over two decades after the discovery of Human Immunodeficiency Virus type I (HIV-1) in 1981, an effective HIV-1 vaccine remains elusive. Broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) are likely to be a key component of protective immunity conferred by an effective HIV-1 vaccine. Elicitation of potent bnAbs has not been achieved by any vaccine candidate so far. Potent bnAbs do exist in a small percentage of infected individuals over a period of years of infection, which may contribute to the long-term no disease progression. The few potent broadly neutralizing human monoclonal antibodies (bnmAbs) identified to date from such individuals revealed unusual characteristics. This includes autoantibody properties and high sequence diversification from their germline predecessors, and the inability of immunogens designed to include the conserved epitopes of some of the bnmAbs to generate the same or similar bnAbs. These observations raised a fundamental question to HIV-1 vaccine development – whether the human immune system in most individuals lacks B cells harbouring sequences that are appropriate for rapid and efficient maturation to bnAbs (“holes” in the human immune system), or whether the human immune system does have such B cells, but ignore HIV-1 infection (regulated by tolerance mechanism). To address this question, we propose to identify bnmAbs from B-cell genomic DNA antibody gene repertoire. This proposal is based on the fact that the methods described to date for isolating bnmAbs rely on activation of the B cells using either messenger RNA (mRNA) or secreted antibodies of activated B cells from infected individuals. No B-cell genomic DNA antibody library has been reported. Our preliminary study demonstrated the feasibility of constructing large and diverse genomic DNA antibody libraries. Compared to mRNA-based antibody library, genomic DNA antibody library is more diverse and not biased to one or two VH-families, suggesting potential higher possibility for isolating potent bnmAbs. In this proposed study, we will construct B-cell genomic DNA antibody libraries from regional dominant non-subtype B infected individuals, and identify bnmAbs from the genomic DNA and the corresponding mRNA-based antibody libraries. The results from this study may help develop our understanding in human immune system and its response to HIV-1 infection. Furthermore, the bnmAbs per se (to be isolated in this study) may have potential for prevention and treatment of HIV-1 infection. Their epitopes may provide new leads for HIV-1 vaccine immunogen immunogen designers. HIV/AIDS发现已近30年，但研制出一种能够诱导出高滴度、高效价广谱中和抗体(Broadly neutralizing antibodies，bnAbs)有效的HIV-1疫苗仍然是一个巨大的挑战。高效价广谱中和抗体在HIV-1感染者体内非常稀有，通常需要经过长时间（多达几年）的抗原抗体相互作用才能产生。然而部分HIV-1感染， 但病程长期不进展者拥有高效价广谱中和抗体，这可能与他们的病程不进展有关。一些单克隆广谱中和抗体已经从病程不进展者中分离得到， 但这些中和抗体彰显出非比寻常的特性，包括自身免疫抗体的特性（b12, 2F5和4E10），与原始的抗体基因序列相比有很多的体细胞突变，同时设计的免疫原很难在体内诱导出相同的或相似的抗体。这些研究结果让我们重新思索HIV-1疫苗很难研制的原因──是大部分人的免疫系统缺乏能够成熟成为对HIV-1有中和活性的抗体基因；还是人类免疫系统中存在这一类抗体基因，但HIV-1的感染不能刺激免疫系统， 使这一类抗体基因成熟成为广谱中和抗体。鉴于以往所发现的广谱中和抗体都是以HIV-1感染者的B细胞的信使RNA或活化的B细胞为基础筛选出的，为回答上面的问题，我们准备从B细胞的基因组DNA抗体库中寻找可能的广谱中和抗体。我们的前期工作已经证明了构建一个有足够容量和多样性的基因组DNA抗体库的可行性。相对于信使RNA抗体库而言，基因组DNA抗体库更加多样，所以从基因组DNA抗体库里可能有更大的机会找到高效广谱中和抗体。在这项研究中，我们将从中国的非B亚型感染者的外周血B细胞基因组DNA抗体库中来筛选高效广谱中和抗体，并同以mRNA构建的抗体库来做比较。这项研究将有助于我们了解人类免疫系统的抗体产生机制以及免疫系统对HIV-1感染后所做出的反应。同时，筛选出的抗体对HIV-1感染的预防、治疗和疫苗研制也将有积极意义。

785210.label: Realisation of objectives
785210.value: The project objectives have been fully achieved. We constructed two B-cell genomic DNA antibody libraries and two corresponding mRNA-based antibody libraries. All four antibody libraries were deep sequenced and the results revealed new obstacles to development of an effective HIV-1 vaccine that can elicit broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs). We found that the germline antibodies of known HIV-1 bnAbs are rare in human antibody gene repertoire and that the usage of each antigen gene lineage is imbalanced, which pose challenges to development of bnAbs upon HIV-1 infection. We did not isolate HIV-1 monoclonal bnAbs from these four antibody libraries, but isolated a panel of engineered envelope RSC3-specific monoclonal antibodies that have very low levels of somatic maturation, but have the potential to mature to bnAbs in vitro, suggesting the existence of possible obstacles to the somatic maturation of these antibodies in vivo. The results from this project have revealed a new research direction of HIV-1 vaccine development that we are currently pursuing further.

785210.label: Major findings and research outcome
785210.value: All four antibody libraries were deep sequenced and the results revealed new obstacles to development of an effective HIV-1 vaccine that can elicit broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs). We found that the germline antibodies of known HIV-1 bnAbs are rare in human antibody gene repertoire and that the usage of each antigen gene lineage is imbalanced, which pose challenges to development of bnAbs upon HIV-1 infection. We did not isolate HIV-1 monoclonal bnAbs from these four antibody libraries, but isolated a panel of engineered envelope RSC3-specific monoclonal antibodies that have very low levels of somatic maturation, but have the potential to mature to bnAbs in vitro, suggesting the existence of possible obstacles to the somatic maturation of these antibodies in vivo. The results from this project have revealed a new research direction of HIV-1 vaccine development that we are currently pursuing further. This study has resulted three journal publications and three conference poster presentations. One more manuscript is in preparation. Two RPG students have been working on this project, one has graduated in 2013 and the other will graduate this August.

785210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
785210.value: The results of this study suggest the existence of possible obstacles to eliciting HIV-1 bnAbs in humans. Identification of these obstacles may greatly help develop an effective HIV-1 vaccine that can elicit bnAbs. These obstacles may be intrisic and / or environmental factors. Further studies are needed to identify them and possible solutions to overcome them.

785210.value: 1. The results of this project shed light on new research directions for HIV-1 vaccine immunogen design.

840210.label: Project Title(Chinese)
840210.value: 追尋抒情精神：中國文學的現代學術研究中的「中國抒情傳統」的概念

840210.label: Project Objectives
840210.value: To scrutinize the formation and the significance of the conception of “Chinese lyrical tradition” in modern studies of Chinese literature. To expose the socio-historical contexts of the vivacity and eclipse of these discourses in various cultural and political environments at different periods of time. 840210.label: Realisation of objectives
840210.value: 「中國抒情傳統」肇始自旅美學者陳世驤與高友工，先後吸引多位學者如柯慶明、蔡英俊、呂正惠、張淑香等作延伸與反思。計劃執行人就此學術譜系，爬疏當代學者之間的學術淵源，分析各種論著。 陳世驤論述的方法及其學術背景，可溯源自三四十年代學者的學術洞見，然而此中種種，多因歷史政治因素而埋沒。本計劃透過翻查報刊、借閱海外善本，重組陳世驤的詩學、思想，以及當時的歷史語境。 抒情傳統之傳播固得力於譯介，但在翻譯的過程中難免遺失不少訊息，不少值得參考的研究材料在傳播過程中遭到遮蔽。本計劃由四五十年代陳世驤在國內外兩度英譯《文賦》起始，討論其各項論著。計劃執行人就此處理繁瑣的版本比對，並追查半世紀前陳氏的發表軌跡，並進行重譯。 中國抒情傳統論述統合了海外漢學的研究成果。本計劃除了重新提述普實克等遭埋沒的學者的貢獻，亦探索抒情傳統與中國文學現代性之關係。執行人數度拜訪中外學府，與王德威教授等交流和合作，擴展了研究成果。

840210.label: Major findings and research outcome
840210.value: 一、 專著 本研究成果結集成兩部專著。《抒情中國論》為計劃執行人的個人論著。《抒情之現代性》為計劃執行人與美國哈佛大學王德威教授合作編著。 二、 演講及研討會 2011年1月至2014年5月間，計劃執行人訪問美國、台灣、上海、蘇州、江蘇等地，進行十場相關的演講：其中2012年11月「『抒情傳統』論與中國文學研究」，為台灣政治大學「王夢鷗教授學術講座」系列其中一講；此外在2014年3月「中國抒情傳統論」，為美國耶魯大學東亞研究中心的系列座談會。 計劃執行人亦就「抒情傳統」的課題，參加過五次研討會。詳情可參考本報告Part C的第9部分。 三、 學術期刊 本計劃執行人先後發表五篇學術論文，詳情可參考本報告Part C的第8部分。其中〈抒情在彌敦道上：香港文學的地方感〉收入香港公共圖書編：《情繫筆墨間：第九屆香港文學節研討會論稿匯編》。 四、 翻譯 本研究計劃關注陳世驤的論述的翻譯問題，曾將重要文章重譯並發表，詳情可參考本報告Part C的第8部分。

840210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
840210.value: 抒情傳統研究與論述介入中國現代文學領域，重新審視多位現代文學家的美學貢獻，具備重寫現代文學史的可能； 抒情傳統可視為1949年以後海外學界延續三四十年代文學研究成果的論述，大陸當代文學則是該論述可試圖接續的領域； 文學地域性亦能與抒情傳統對話，本計劃執行人曾援引人文地理學討論香港新詩。香港文學與作家是抒情傳統進而探討的對象； 現代語境底下的抒情傳統研究，衍生各種中西文學理論的對話，對古典文學研究甚有參考價值。

840210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
840210.value: 本研究計劃以陳世驤提出「中國抒情傳統」的論述為中心，上溯此傳統論述之文化、歷史與思想之源流，下探此傳統在海外引起的影響與後續發展，梳理及討論抒情傳統論在現代批評語境下對中國文學的影響。除了讓讀者及學界重新認識抒情傳統，亦能豐富中國文學批評的現代內涵，整合與考掘海外中國文學研究的成果，並提供另一角度有利重新書寫中國現代文學史及中國文學現代批評史。

840410.label: Project Title(Chinese)
840410.value: 內戰時期香港少年兒童副刊研究

840410.label: Co - Investigator(s)
840410.value: Dr Chan, Chi Tak Dr Fan, Sin Piu

840410.label: Project Objectives
840410.value: 探索副刊主編的編輯主張與取向，比較當中異同，勾勒內戰時期少兒副刊的發展面貌。 探討作品的內容及表現特色，描繪當年原始生態，以至香港早期兒童文學的生成。 藉著文本分析，發掘讀者在少兒副刊的培養下，文學發展的走向，以至香港文化與閱讀品味的生成狀況。 追踪副刊的編者、作者與讀者間的互動與回饋，展示內戰時期南來左翼文人在港的活動，以及對少兒讀者的影響。

追踪副刊的編者、作者與讀者間的互動與回饋，展示內戰時期南來左翼文人在港的活動，以及對少兒讀者的影響。

840410.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
840410.value: 內戰期間，南來左翼文人與思想進步份子在港創辦園地，像《華僑日報》的「兒童周刊」和「學生周刊」，《星島日報》的「兒童樂園」和「學生園地」，為戰後在學與失學在職的讀者提供不同層次的「教育」與「養份」。本計劃以上述四份少年兒童副刊為研究對象，從戰後香港社會形勢、報社辦報宗旨與經營策略、編者主張與取向、政府管治等角度切入，藉著文本細讀與分析，一方面探討它們的創設目標、編輯取向，另一方面考察當中的教養內容、文學成份，期以勾勒香港早期少兒副刊、兒童文學，以至兒童教育的發展方向與特色。此外，研究團隊借用人際與大眾傳播為分析架構，再藉口述史的深入訪談，讓歷史的參與者發聲，口述六十多年前不為人識的歷史，追跡編者作者如何構築園地，與讀者，以及讀者間的生活群組（groups），通過積極的互動（interaction）所產生的回饋（feedback），從而探索這些副刊對少兒讀者的教養與影響，為早期的香港副刊史、香港兒童文學史、兒童教育補白，並進一步探討香港研究的新方向。 內戰期間，南來左翼文人與思想進步份子在港創辦園地，像《華僑日報》的「兒童周刊」和「學生周刊」，《星島日報》的「兒童樂園」和「學生園地」，為戰後在學與失學在職的讀者提供不同層次的「教育」與「養份」。本計劃以上述四份少年兒童副刊為研究對象，從戰後香港社會形勢、報社辦報宗旨與經營策略、編者主張與取向、政府管治等角度切入，藉著文本細讀與分析，一方面探討它們的創設目標、編輯取向，另一方面考察當中的教養內容、文學成份，期以勾勒香港早期少兒副刊、兒童文學，以至兒童教育的發展方向與特色。此外，研究團隊借用人際與大眾傳播為分析架構，再藉口述史的深入訪談，讓歷史的參與者發聲，口述六十多年前不為人識的歷史，追跡編者作者如何構築園地，與讀者，以及讀者間的生活群組（groups），通過積極的互動（interaction）所產生的回饋（feedback），從而探索這些副刊對少兒讀者的教養與影響，為早期的香港副刊史、香港兒童文學史、兒童教育補白，並進一步探討香港研究的新方向。

840410.label: Realisation of objectives
840410.value: 就研究目標所列，研究團隊中三位成員各有分工，霍玉英負責《兒童周刊》及《兒童樂園》兩個版面，樊善標及陳智德各負責一個版面，分別為《學生園地》和《學生周刊》。三位成員除細讀四份少兒副刊的原始資料，分類建檔外，還探索了四者的編輯主張與取向，勾勒出內戰時期上述四份少兒副刊發展面貌，並比較異同。此外，研究團隊通過文本細讀，從內容及表達兩者，深入探討了四份副刊中的作品特色，尤為著重教養內涵和文學元素，用以描繪當年原始生態，以至香港早期兒童文學的生成。在四份少兒副刊中，《兒童周刊》的政治意味雖濃，但仍有不少優秀的兒童文學。當然，最切中兒童文學的遊戲情味，誠是發表在《兒童樂園》的作品。因此，藉著文本分析，研究團隊發掘了讀者在少兒副刊的培養下，文學發展的走向，以至香港文化與閱讀品味的生成狀況。 在第四項的研究目標中，研究團隊借助口述歷史的研究方法，藉著與歷史參與者的深入訪談，補足文獻中無法提供的史料，追踪副刊的編者、作者與讀者間的互動與回饋，展示內戰時期南來左翼文人在港的活動，以及對少兒讀者的影響。不過，上述四份少兒副刊到底是上世紀四十年代的產物，以《學生周刊》為例，版面負責人陳君葆（1898-1982），以導師身份在該刊文的林煥平（1911-2000）、鄧初民（1898-1981）及樓棲（1912-1997）等都無從訪談。此外，《學生周刊》不同於組織嚴明的《兒童周刊》，難以追踪當年曾在該刊發表文章的青年作者。《學生園地》雖有讀者會的設立，但不如《兒童週刊》般，在逾大半世紀後，當年的小讀者仍彼此互有聯繫，並於1998年合力編製《崢嶸歲月：原香港華僑日報兒童週刊創刊曁讀者會成立五十周年紀念》，讓久己湮沒的歷史再現紙上。不過，首席研究員過去曾訪問《兒童週刊》的讀者，像阿濃（朱溥生）、吳錦勳、伍捷（伍志強）、何天樵及馮飛鳳等，從他們的訪談中，真實反映了編者、作者與讀者間的互動與回饋，重現當年鮮為人知的歷史。再者，首席研究員其後與這些歷史參與者的交流中，他們都樂意提供照片及自資出版的回憶錄（李潔真的《又見維港――我的回憶錄》），有助本計劃的進行。此外，在細讀《兒童樂園》的原始資料當中，首席研究員發掘了當年遠從上海投稿的年輕作者，即今著名兒童雜誌編輯兼作家施雁冰、兒童文學作家與翻譯家任溶溶，以及豐子愷幼女豐一吟。從他們的訪談與書信往還，都能說明在國共內戰時期，上海與香港兒童文學交流的一道因緣。 本計畫所列的四個研究目標，前三項的目標已達成，第四項則受客觀的限制，只能完成《兒童周刊》和《兒童樂園》的訪談。不過，研究團隊已就蒐集資料撰寫了五篇論文，其中三篇在國際研討會及工作坊宣讀，兩篇刊於《中國文學學報》第二及第三期，一篇刊於《中國兒童文化》；此外，有兩篇投稿至《政大中文學報》及專書《香港：都市想像與文化記憶》，兩者已獲接納，並將出版。

840410.label: Major findings and research outcome
840410.value: 本計劃以四份少兒副刊為探討對象，並在香港少兒刊物、兒童文學的發展、兒童教育與香港研究的相關研究課題上，有以下成果： 1. 研究團隊探討了四份少兒副刊（1947-1949）的編輯取向，特別是左翼文人的政治宣傳需要，其對作品與讀者的影響，為早期香港少兒副刊的發展提供參照。四十年代末的左翼文化共見於其陣營內部刊物，以及其所滲透的中性媒體，藉著共同術語，傳播一致的意識形態，建構左翼共名。以《華僑日報》的《兒童周刊》與《學生周刊》為例，前者藉與兒童讀者的互動，培養中共的建國份子；後者借助導師的指引，以及學生的回應，強化左翼共名的傳播力量。《星島日報》的《學生園地》在湯建勛任內，因客觀環境的限制，園地採迴避政治，側重實用技能和知識、適應青年學生趣味和日常生活需要的編寫方針；曾莫休接任後，則積極刊登引導讀者接納「政治」的文章。四份少兒副刊中，《兒童樂園》最為獨異，能從兒童為本位的編寫方向出發，無所謂政治目的，表現了編者與作者的兒童觀。 2. 戰後的香港，以她獨特的政治環境與地理位置，成為中共的宣傳陣地，少年兒童副刊也在這種特殊的政治環境下，成為左翼文人滲透的對象，並開闢了一座政治意味濃厚的教養場所。《兒童周刊》作為少兒副刊與它的愆生物讀者會，為在學、或失學、或在職童工，提供了在正規學校以外的學習機遇。1947至1948年間的《學生週刊》，作品較多圍繞在一般的教育與學習問題，沒有很明顯的左翼言論。至1949年初，隨者國共內戰形勢的轉變，《學生週刊》開始出現較明顯的左翼言論，並倡導香港青年學生的思想覺醒與自我改造，並在憧憬解放或革命前夕的暗喻描述外，再以描寫青年回新中國升學或「建設祖國」的詩文，強化「返回中國」是文藝青年的出路。 《學生園地》的青年文化教養內容經歷了極端的變化，從1947創刊的一年間，編者雖由受中國共產黨指派，但版面較集中於實用知識和益智活動，以滿足青年的求學、工作需要和閒暇興趣。其後一年，新任編者引入了直接討論政治的理論文章，鼓勵讀者參與共產革命運動，但並非一面倒地宣傳。最後的一年，政治內容變得非常隱晦，卻不是回到第一期多元的實用、趣味取向，而是以指導寫作一枝獨秀。不同於上述三份少兒副刊，《兒童樂園》不單沒有政治意味，也無所謂工具性、社會性的教育目的，編者與作者從兒童本位為編寫目標出發，強調作品中的兒童性與遊戲性，為兒童提供非功利性、政治性的審美培養。 本計劃藉著細讀文本，探尋了內戰時期少兒副刊所呈現的教育取向與內容，並在檢視作品的文學元素中，為香港早期少兒文學的發展與特色提供參照。 3. 研究團隊雖探尋了四份少兒副刊的主編誰屬，但主事者均已去世，而當年的年輕作者或小讀者亦已屆古稀。因此，訪談較集中於《兒童周刊》的小讀者，以及關係《兒童樂園》的上海兒童文學作家。訪談人物雖然不多，但本計劃仍能讓歷史的參與者敘述、詮釋當日境況，尋繹國共內戰時期香港少兒刊物的發展，重現這一段消音已久的歷史，並予少兒副刊及其作品應有的意義和地位。 4. 兒童以至兒童文學向為研究者忽略，但本計劃嘗試以國共內戰時間的四份少兒副刊為研究對象，並有所發現，不單開展了香港大專院校以少年兒童為讀者對象的研究，還拓濶了更為多元的研究課題，像少兒發展與成長（讀者在副刊影響下的成長歷程）、少兒雜誌副刊（香港少兒副刊的發展軌跡）與少兒文學（強調少兒文學在文學的應有地位與價值）等。

840410.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
840410.value: 戰後的香港，以她獨特的政治環境與地理位置，成為中共的宣傳陣地，南來的左翼文人在此間創辦報刊、書店、出版社與學校，並滲透到不同的傳播機構，宣傳中共的主張與建國方略。於是，以兒童及學生為對象的副刊也在這種特殊的政治環境下，成為左翼文人滲透的對象，並開闢了一座政治意味濃厚的教養場所，像由兩大報業系統《華僑日報》與《星島日報》分別創辦的四份副刊《兒童月周刊》、《學生周刊》、《兒童樂園》及《學生園地》，可謂築構了上世紀四十年代香港少兒副刊的一道奇瑰的風景。不過，如能結合在1941年創刊，1946年在港復刊的《新兒童》，以至在兩大左翼報章《大公報》及《文滙報》的兒童副刊《兒童園地》和《新少年》，則更能呈現國共內戰時期，香港少兒副刊、兒童文學、少兒發展與成長等的整體面貌。 此外，中共建國後，左右兩翼文人南北對流，香港兒童文學在這種特殊的政治、地理及歷史環境下得以日趨繁榮――1950年，《世界兒童》從上海轉至香港出版，並運銷南洋；1953年，《小朋友》除上海的少年兒童出版社新貌外，再以中華書原貌在香港「復刊」，惠及香港與南洋的小讀者；再有1953年，友聯社以全彩印刷，領導香港兒童雜誌出版潮流的《兒童樂園》，更影響華文地區幾代兒童。本計劃如能結合上述研究領域，在在重整並構築香港兒童文學、副刊雜誌的發展面貌。首席研究員在《新兒童》、《兒童樂園》的原始資料蒐集及研究早有涉獵，當下更延及《小朋友》的探討，日後即以整合上述資料為研究範疇，期為香港兒童文學的發展提供參照。

840410.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
840410.value: 本計劃以內戰期間，在香港創辦的四份少年兒童副刊為研究對象：《華僑日報》的「兒童周刊」和「學生周刊」、《星島日報》的「兒童樂園」和「學生園地」。透過戰後香港社會形勢、報社辦報宗旨、教養內容、文學成份等角度切入，勾勒香港早期少兒副刊及兒童教育的發展與特色。此外，藉口述史的訪談，追跡編者作者如何與讀者進行互動和回饋，探索少兒副刊對讀者的教養與影響，為早期的香港副刊史、香港兒童文學史、兒童教育補白。

840810.label: Project Title(Chinese)
840810.value: 有效的教師領導在幼兒教育課程革新之探討

840810.label: Project Objectives
840810.value: To investigate how teacher leadership is understood in relation to curriculum change in kindergartens in Hong Kong; To identify the roles and responsibilities of teacher leaders for curriculum change; To understand the process and practice of teacher leadership in coordinating and leading curriculum change; To identify the conditions that support and challenge the development of teacher leadership at school level; and To explore the links between teacher leadership and curriculum change.
rows: To investigate how teacher leadership is understood in relation to curriculum change in kindergartens in Hong Kong;
To identify the roles and responsibilities of teacher leaders for curriculum change;
To understand the process and practice of teacher leadership in coordinating and leading curriculum change;
To identify the conditions that support and challenge the development of teacher leadership at school level; and
To explore the links between teacher leadership and curriculum change.

840810.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
840810.value: This research project aims to develop new conceptions and possible reinterpretations of the distributed models of teacher leadership promoted in the West as the key to school improvement by investigating the phenomenon of teacher leadership in a Chinese, policy-driven early education context. In Hong Kong, the Education Bureau issued a Guide to the Pre-primary Curriculum in 2006, which stated that pre-primary institutions must establish internal mechanisms for curriculum improvement. In response to the new curriculum policy, many kindergarten principals have set up functional groups of teachers to coordinate and manage curriculum change. A practice of teacher leadership is emerging in the field of early childhood education in Hong Kong that follows the trend in many Western developed countries, including the UK, US and Canada. As the project is the first of its kind to investigate effective teacher leadership for curriculum change in the local field of early childhood education, an inductive research approach will be adopted using a combination of qualitative and quantitative methods. Adopting a grounded theory approach, the research will have two phases: exploratory and confirmatory. The first phase of the study will explore the phenomenon of teacher leadership in a sample of kindergartens that have been rated as “excellent” in quality assurance inspection by the Education Bureau. The qualitative case study methodology will be used to investigate the views of teacher leadership held by various stakeholders, including school principals, key stage coordinators and teaching staff. The findings of the case studies will then be used as the hypothetical basis for a territory-wide quantitative questionnaire. The ultimate goal of the project is to capture a fuller picture of teacher leadership in the local field of early childhood education, and critique the way in which Western models of teacher leadership are being put forward as solutions in a Chinese, policy-driven context. The findings of the project will enable the reframing of the dominant Western perspective that decentralized forms of teacher leadership are the key to school improvement. In this way the project will make a significant contribution to the construction of a theory of school leadership. In addition, the project will develop contextually relevant models of effective teacher leadership for curriculum change. These models will be of value to policymakers, teacher educators and frontline practitioners in their efforts to support the development of teacher leadership in the local field of early childhood education.

840810.label: Realisation of objectives
840810.value: The research project consists of two phases, using qualitative case study and quantitative questionnaire survey respectively. The qualitative case studies started in September 2010. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with school coordinators (if the school is operated by an organization), school principals, key stage coordinators and teaching staff of six preschools. The themes of the interview mainly covered: conceptualization of teacher leadership, teacher collaboration, teacher involvement in decision making, roles and responsibilities of teacher leadership, conditions that support and challenge teacher leadership development, and professional growth of teacher leaders. The interviews were carried out three times within the school year respectively at the beginning (September- October 2010), middle (February- March 2011) and end of the school year (June-September 2011). The case studies in the first phase have made possible the identification of the characteristics and patterns of effective teacher leadership for curriculum change and provided a basis for generating testable hypotheses for the questionnaire survey in the second phase. The second phase was to develop a quantitative questionnaire about teacher leadership for curriculum change and to test some hypotheses with the questionnaire. The design of the questionnaire was based on the important issues and key concepts generated from the qualitative case studies. The territory-wide questionnaire survey was conducted between late February and April, 2012. A disproportionate stratified random sampling method was used to survey 300 kindergartens from the whole population. 189 kindergartens agreed to participate and 2,042 completed questionnaires were returned, resulting in a response rate of 63%. Descriptive statistics and preliminary analysis including mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, skewness, kurtosis and correlation were obtained using SPSS. Confirmatory factor analysis and latent mean analysis were then performed to test several hypotheses regarding the relationships between the characteristics of teacher leadership and demographic variables.

840810.label: Major findings and research outcome
840810.value: The major findings of the case studies: 1. The majority of interviewees expressed the view that teacher leaders acted as change agents in various aspects of school development. Specifically, they stated that teachers played an active role in coordinating and leading curriculum change, facilitating parent-child relationships, contributing to teacher development within school and in the professional community of local ECE sector, and developing school-community partnership. 2. Teachers were given opportunities to participate in decision making, showing that the practice of traditional top-down leadership was no longer applied in the case study schools. Loosely coupled within hierarchical structures, the shared governance for increasing teacher’s influence on decision making in the area of curriculum and pedagogy was adopted in the case study schools. 3. The majority of interviewees reported that there was a collegial atmosphere in school where formal and informal discussions could be carried out whenever necessary. The collaboration among teachers in schools mainly covered four aspects: i) exchanging practical information; ii) providing aid and support; iii) sharing materials, methods, and ideas; and iv) engaging in joint work. The first three types were most common among the participating schools, but the last one, a typical indicator of collegiality which is frequently documented in the Western literature, was emerging but not yet frequently reported. 4. As a supporting condition for teacher leadership, autonomy was given to teachers so that they could pursue a high quality of work. All case study schools provided multiple channels and opportunities for continuing professional development. The findings indicate that the support and encouragement of principals played a crucial role in building capacity and empowering teacher leadership. The major findings of the questionnaire survey: 1. Overall there was a significant relationship between school-level teacher qualifications and the school-based professional learning communities (PLC). Associated with the notion of teacher leadership, PLC is a sustainable form of school-based professional development, which includes components such as shared responsibility, de-privatized practices, reflective dialogue, and organizational learning. 2. There were significant group differences in all dimensions of school performance as perceived by groups of teachers from different functional positions in school, namely middle management staff, teachers within the curriculum development team, and teachers not in the curriculum development team. The dimensions of school performance included school management, teaching and learning, teacher collaboration, and de-centralization of leadership. The results showed that the higher the participant’s position in school, the better they perceived the performance of their school to be. 3. Teachers working at medium- and large-sized preschools showed significantly lower perceptions of organizational support for teacher leadership than their counterparts in small schools. Specifically, they perceived less support on decision-making in curriculum change from the school management, and felt that the school management did not encourage professional autonomy and teacher leadership.

840810.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
840810.value: The project offers new insights into the specific nature of teacher leadership in Hong Kong early childhood education and enables the development of new conceptions and possible reinterpretations of Western notions of teacher leadership. However, although teacher leadership has been promoted as an internal mechanism for curriculum change, little is known about the effectiveness of the new tier of middle management for student outcomes. Future research could investigate the current and potential roles of teacher leaders that can contribute to school effectiveness by focusing on the links between the actions of teacher leaders and student outcomes, and identifying the role played by teacher leadership in creating the conditions (i.e. trust, networking, school culture, etc.) which enable those outcomes. In the recent years, the value of the home-school partnership has been universally accepted in early childhood education. Future research could investigate how teacher leaders can maintain and promote teacher-parent partnership and facilitate home-school liaison activities where the impact on children’s learning and development can be established.

840810.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
840810.value: This research project developed a new understanding of how models of teacher leadership for school improvement that have been developed in the West can be implemented in Hong Kong kindergartens, by investigating the phenomenon of teacher leadership in the context of Chinese, policy-driven kindergartens. Using Hong Kong early childhood education as a research site, the project employed mixed methods of research. The major findings of the case studies indicate that teacher leaders acted as change agents in various aspects of school development. Loosely coupled within hierarchical structures, the model of shared governance increased teacher participation in decision making in the area of curriculum and pedagogy. The major findings of the questionnaire survey indicate that there was a significant relationship between school-level teacher qualifications and the school-based professional learning communities (i.e. part of the practice of teacher leadership). There were significant group differences in all dimensions of school performance including school management support, teaching and learning, teacher collaboration, and de-centralization of leadership as perceived by groups of teachers from different functional positions in school. Teachers working at medium- and large-sized preschools showed significantly lower perceptions of organizational support for teacher leadership than their counterparts in small schools.

841610.label: Project Title(Chinese)
841610.value: 促進青少年的社會心理幸福及學業表現--為香港學生發展覺知訓練課程

841610.label: Co - Investigator(s)
841610.value: Miss Lau, Ngar-Sze Elsa Dr Lo, Chuen-Yee Barbara

841610.label: Project Objectives
841610.value: To examine the nature of the inter-relationships between mindfulness training, psychosocial factors and learning variables, and how they are related to academic outcomes. To understand the pattern of change (or stability) of students’ psychosocial factors before and after mindfulness training, and the resulting implications for curriculum design, policy making and teaching approaches. 841610.label: Realisation of objectives
841610.value: The study was carried out as planned. Based on a comprehensive review of related literatures and mindfulness programs implemented in other societies, the intervention program was developed. Instruments which have not been validated in the local context were pilot tested to ensure their validity and reliability. For the International Affective Picture System (IAPS), an emotional stimulus set of static images and new sets of photos were chosen and tested to tailor for the secondary school students in Hong Kong. The number of student participants was smaller than our expectation; however, it was still large enough for this study. The three schools that participated in this study were helpful in identifying the experimental group as well as the reference group. They also provided the necessary logistic support including assigning a teaching staff as the resource person in helping with data collection and administrative support. With the staunch support of the schools, the intervention program was delivered as planned. The collection of quantitative data before and after the intervention was carried out as planned. The major difficulty encountered was lack of motivation and interest of some student participants in the intervention activities. After the program started, the instructors identified this problem. Some measures, such as strengthening rapport with the students, were taken. However, some students requested to quit the program. After the 6th session, the research team discussed with the schools and decided to allow those who were not interested in the program to leave. On one hand, this affected the size of the experimental group. On the other hand, it gave the research team a chance to explore why mindfulness activities were not attractive to these less academically able students in mainstream schools. To answer this question, the research team interviewed 41 of the students in the experimental groups, including those who had quitted in the middle of the program. The interview facilitated deeper understanding of the views and feelings of the school students, and how the program should be adapted if it is to be tried out again. With the completion of the intervention and quantitative and qualitative data collected, the present study has successfully shed light on the problems and effectiveness of introducing mindfulness program to improve emotional regulation, learning motivation, mindfulness, attention control and academic performance of less academically able students.

841610.label: Major findings and research outcome
841610.value: The present study is an attempt to develop a mindfulness program based on MBSR principles for less academically able students. It was postulated that the program would improve their attention and emotional control, learning motivation and academic self-concept, which will finally lead to a positive impact on their academic performance. From the quantitative data on students’ learning outcomes (including learning motivation, attention and emotional control, academic self-concept and academic result,) there are no significant differences between the experimental and reference groups. Several possibilities could be considered in explaining such null findings. First, these outcomes might not be surprising at all as changing less academically able students in Hong Kong is full of challenges. Many previous attempts to improve the academic performance of this group of students have not achieved the desirable results as they are characterized by low learning motivation and short attention span. Teachers very often find it difficult to manage this group of students in class. If the learning activities failed to attract the participating students in the first few sessions, they would fall into the trap of losing interest and motivation, and started to have disruptive behavior in the sessions. The post-course interviews with the students reveal that many of these young less academically able adolescents might not be able to understand mindfulness from the designed program as the quiet and subtle activities were not their usual way of practice. Not all student participants disliked the mindfulness activities. Some of the students interviewed reported that they found the course useful and helpful in improving their emotional and attention control. Alternatively, it is also possible that the program is not ineffective at all, but the outcome measures used were not sensitive enough in capturing the nominated beneficial effects. In the present project, most of the measures used involved questionnaire format (including picture viewing emotion regulation measure) and therefore they were all susceptible to self-report bias effects. In particular, our present sample of participants consisted of Band 3 students who identified themselves as falling in the lower end of mainstream academic race. Latent factors such as poor self-esteem may possibly cause a mark-down or floor effect when they rate themselves in all self-report measures. In other words, the mindfulness training program may possibly exert some beneficial effects when applied to this special population, but these effects could not be readily captured when using standard self-report measures.

841610.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
841610.value: The qualitative research findings suggest that mindfulness activities might have positive impact on less academically able students in mainstream schools. In order to make this kind of activities widely applied to this special group of population, it would be advisable to refine the quasi-experimental design in the following ways: 1. Ensuring that all student participants thoroughly understand what mindfulness activities are before joining the intervention program; 2. Adapting the mindfulness activities to suit the developmental characteristics of student participants; 3. Including cognitive understanding in the theoretical aspects of mindfulness activities; 4. Training up practicing teachers in schools to deliver the course; 5. Strengthening rapport building between the instructor and student participants. As the learning process of less academically able students may be slow and subtle, future research studies on the impact of mindfulness activities may need to incorporate more objective measures, such as behavioral or psychophysiological measures, in capturing the subtle effects of mindfulness and the individual changes brought about throughout the training processes. Interviews should also be included to provide timely and in-depth data on the views and changes in students’ motivation and emotional wellbeing.

841610.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
841610.value: Mindfulness activities, such as meditation and mindfulness walking, have been found to be effective in helping patients with learning and emotional difficulties. It is postulated that teaching mindfulness activities to less academically able students might be able to help them enhance their emotional wellbeing, attention control, motivation, and finally academic performance. With this in view, a 12-week mindfulness intervention course, which includes activities like body scan and mindful walking, was developed. A total of 51 less academically able Secondary 3 and 4 students from three mainstream schools participated in the intervention. A quasi-experimental design using a variety of instruments was adopted to gauge the impact of the mindfulness course on the students. Statistical analysis show that there were no significant differences between the experimental and reference groups with respect to learning motivation, mindfulness, academic self-concept, and academic performance. However, some student participants revealed that the program had positive impact on their emotional control and well-being The quantitative and qualitative data collected show that the outcomes of the intervention program could be enhanced if the design and logistics arrangements are modified to better cater for the developmental characteristics

842210.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
842210.value: Narrating an event is a common linguistic and communicative act in children’s daily life and it reflects children’s discourse competence. Two research questions in narrating motion events have attracted much discussion in the literature: (a) How does a child encode a motion event? (Developmental issue) (b) How much of this is affected by the specific properties of the native language? (Typological effect on acquisition) In terms of typology of languages, three types of lexicalization patterns of manner and path in motion events have been proposed: verb-framed, satellite-framed and equipollent-framed languages. In general, scholars have reached general agreement on the classification of languages such as English and Spanish, However, the classification of serial-verb languages, (e.g. Chinese) has generated a debate. A large number of studies on how children encode motion events in English, Spanish and other western languages provide evidence on the relationship between language typology and language development. On the contrary, research on Chinese children’s expression of motion events is relatively scarce and more research needs to be done. The purpose of this study is to examine how children of ages three, four,five and seven encode motion events in Cantonese narratives, and explores how such findings shed light on the issue of Chinese in the debate of lexicalization typology and language development. The proposed project has theoretical significance. Since most of the theories on motion event development are based on European languages and research on the acquisition of Chinese motion events is rather limited, findings from this study can add to the growing body of work on Chinese (e.g., Guo and Chen 2009) and provide data for cross-linguistic comparison and verification or modification of the theories of motion event development put forth in the literature regarding typological influence. Using verbs to express motion events has been one of the important milestones in children’s early language development. Specific information on such development will be useful for language teachers and educators in understanding the oral language development of children. In addition, such information will be useful and important for speech and language pathologists as normative data in assessing children with language problems. 敘述事件是兒童日常生活中普遍的語言及溝通行為，並能反映兒童的話語(discourse) 能力。在眾多的文獻當中，下列兩個研究課題備受關注﹕ 甲. 兒童如何把動態事件編碼(encode)？(語言發展的議題) 乙. 母語的特定屬性怎樣影響動態事件的編碼？(類型學對語言獲得的影響) 在類型學上，學者按方式(manner)與路徑(path)在動態事件的詞彙化模式中(lexicalization pattern)把語言分為三種類型，分別為: 動詞框架型(verb-framed)、衛星框架型(satellite-framed)以及等位框架型(equipollent-framed)。 一般而言，學者大都認同英語及西班牙語在類型學的分類。但是，連動句的語言(如漢語)的分類，則引起了不少爭論。 很多動態事件的研究，都利用了英語、西班牙語及其他西方語言來引證類型學與語言發展的關係。可是，研究中國兒童表達動態事件的研究很少，不言而喻，這方面需要更多和更深入的研究。 是項研究目的在於了解三、四、五以及七歲的粵語兒童，如何敘述動態事件，並希望利用研究所得的資料，為漢語詞彙化在類型學上的爭議，提供一些數據，促進更多的探討。 此外，是項研究計劃在理論上冀能作出貢獻。首先，動態事件的理論研究大部份都是建基於歐洲語系，在漢語語言獲得方面則十分少。所以是項研究不單可以豐富過去在動態事件上的漢語研究(如 Guo and Chen, 2009)，更可提供一些漢語數據，作為跨文化的比對和引證，從而推動、修改及整合動態事件在類型學上的的理論與發展。 利用動詞來表達動態事件乃早期兒童語言發展的一個重要里程碑。是次研究所獲得的具體資料，相信對語文教師以及教育家了解兒童的口語發展，有莫大的幫助。再者，語言病理學家更可利用這些資料，作為常模(normative) 數據，協助他們測試語言有障礙的兒童。

842210.label: Realisation of objectives
842210.value: The project was carried out successfully without major difficulties despite some delay because of the drop-outs in the second wave of data collection and additional analysis. In this project, a full-time research assistant had been recruited to help with data collection and analysis. With permission from parents and schools, we had collected enough data to answer the project objectives listed above, despite a major reduction of funding (from proposed HK$1,08,000 to HK$466,310) and the period of investigation (from 3 years to 2 years, with an extension of 6 months). As mentioned in our proposal, we intend to disseminate our findings in conferences and in journal papers. To date, we had presented three conference papers at major international child language conferences (e.g., 12th International Congress for the Study of Child Language; Child Language Seminar 2013) within the grant period (Jan 2011- June 2013). Another conference paper has also been accepted recently for presentation at the upcoming 13th International Congress for the Study of Child Language, a premier conference on child language acquisition, in Amsterdam in July 2014. The conference attendances kept us well-aware of the latest development in the field of language acquisition and motion events. We received very useful feedback on our presentations from colleagues at the conferences, especially regarding some of the analyses and the interpretation of the data. Originally we planned to write up the papers by June 2013. As we need to re-code and re-analyze some of the data, we are very sorry that we have to postpone our journal paper submission plan. We intend to submit two papers to journals, one in March 2014 (Journal of Child Language) and the other in June 2014 (Journal of Pragmatics). We will send a copy to RGC for record once we have submitted them. For the sharing of our data with colleagues in the field of child language acquisition, we plan to do it via the Child languages Exchange System (CHILDES) later after the publication of the papers.

842210.label: Major findings and research outcome
842210.value: The main aim of the project is to investigate how motion events were expressed by Cantonese children and adults. Major findings are as follows: 1. The linguistic devices used by Cantonese children to encode motion events a. Cantonese-speaking children mainly used manner verbs (e.g.跳 tiu ‘jump’ , path verbs (e.g. 落lok ‘down’), and deictic verbs (嚟lai‘come’，去heoi ‘go’) to encode motion events. The dominant pattern was: Verb 1-Manner verb + Verb 2-Path verb + (Verb 3-Deictic verb). b. No error was found in the word order of the verbs by children. 2. The developmental trend of encoding motion-events in Cantonese-speaking children a. Use of manner verbs by children increased with age, with higher frequency count and more types of manner verbs in older children (ages 5-7). b. The most dominant types of expressions were “Manner + Path + Deictic” and “Manner +Path”, followed by “Manner only”. Use of “Path only” expressions was rare. c. In general, children used less “ground element” than adults. No significant difference was found in the use of “ground element” among children. 3. The comparison between children and adults in encoding motion events a. Adults had more types and variety of manner verbs than younger children. b. Adults used relatively more “Manner + Path + (Deictic)” expressions than children. c. Adults used significantly more “ground element” than children, especially in “Manner + Path + Deictic (去heoi ‘go’ )” expressions. 4. The variation of encoding motion events in different elicitation contexts a. No task effect was found in the use of motion event types among adults and children, with “Manner + Path + ( Deictic)” the dominant pattern. b. More use of Manner verbs by children and adults was found in the video-clips context. 5. Typological influence on the expression of motion events in children and crosslinguistic differences between Cantonese and other languages a. The dominant use of Manner + Path + (Deictic) and the less use of ground element by children and adults indicate that Cantonese contains features of both satellite-framed and verb-framed languages, similar to Mandarin Chinese but not English or French. b. The dominant use of “Manner + Path (+ Deictic)” expressions (traditionally called “directional verb compounds”) by children and adults, and the rare occurrence of errors in word order of verbs suggest strongly that Cantonese children were sensitive to the characteristics and constraints (e.g. iconicity principle and temporal order) of verb compounding, a very productive process found in Cantonese morphology and syntax but not in English or French.

842210.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
842210.value: The data collected for the project provided an interesting and rich source for the study of narrative ability of Cantonese children. Further explorations on how Cantonese children use connectives in narratives and how verbs combine with aspectual marking can be carried out using the data collected. As verb learning is central to language development in children, the current data and findings could be used as baseline to examine the language development of children with language delay and disorders in expressing motion events. What will be the major differences between typically-developed children and atypically-developed children? Will the lack of ability to use motion events early and appropriately a “clinical marker”? Such information will be very important to local speech and language therapists for assessing atypical children. In addition, the data and findings can also be adopted to assess the narrative development of children learning Cantonese as a second language in kindergartens and in primary schools.

842210.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
842210.value: This study examines the use of motion events by Cantonese-speaking children and adults. Our findings show that children’s use of motion event constructions was similar to adults even at a very young age (Age 3). They used a combination of verbs (known traditionally as ‘directional verb compounds’) to express the manner of the motion, the direction of the path and the perspective of the speaker. No word order problem was found in children’s use of the verbs together. In addition, children at age 3 were found to have a relatively large vocabulary of manner verbs. As age increased, children developed more manner verb vocabulary. The findings show that Cantonese is very different from French and English in encoding motion events, and strongly suggest that Cantonese children are sensitive at an early age to the grammatical characteristics and constraints of Cantonese in expressing motion events.

844110.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
844110.value: Tests (including inventories, questionnaires, and observations) are used everyday and everywhere. Ensuring fairness and equity is crucial. Take an ability test as an example. Two test-takers with the same proficiency level should have equal probability of answering any item correctly, irrespective of their group membership (e.g., gender or ethnicity). If different probabilities occur, this item is biased against certain groups. In other words, the item exhibits differential item functioning (DIF) because it functions differently for different groups of test-takers. There are three possible outcomes when a study is affected by DIF: (a) when a test contains DIF items, its scores are no longer comparable across different groups; (b) if DIF items exist but are not detected, subsequent decisions (e.g., college entrance or medical diagnosis) that are based on the test scores will be misinformed; (c) if a DIF-free item is mistakenly classified as having DIF and thus is revised or removed, a big waste of time and money will result. Many methods for DIF assessment have been developed. A prerequisite of any DIF assessment method is to place different groups of test-takers on a common metric, so that items can be assessed for evidence of DIF. A common metric is established using a matching variable. Only when a matching variable contains exclusively DIF-free items will subsequent DIF analyses be correct. Unfortunately, existing DIF assessment methods fail to establish such a clean matching variable, and thus often generate misleading DIF assessment, which in turn leads to unfair tests or waste of time and money in test development. This project aims at (a) resolving the fundamental problem in establishment of a clean matching variable, (b) building a new methodology of DIF assessment, via proposing an innovative strategy, called the DIF-free-then-DIF strategy, and (c) evaluating the performance of the new strategy under a variety of conditions. In the new strategy, a small set of items that are the least likely to exhibit DIF are selected to serve as a matching variable, and then other items are assessed for DIF using this matching variable. It is expected that this strategy will generate more reliable DIF assessment than conventional methods. This project links theory and practice to a valuable measurement validation process that ensures test fairness and score comparability across groups. A new era of DIF assessment will begin - one that will enable Hong Kong to play its continued leading role in DIF assessment. 我們無時無刻都在使用測驗(包括問卷與觀察資料)，因此確保公平、公正是必須的。以能力測驗為例，兩位具有相同能力的考生對試題答對的機率應要相同，而此答對機率應與他們的組別身分無關(如：性別或種族)。如果具有不同的機率，則表示試題會應不同組別而有偏誤。換句話說，因為試題對於不同組別有不同作用，因此我們稱試題具有差異試題功能(DIF)。如果這個情形發生，會造成三種結果：(a)當測驗具有DIF試題時，不同組別的分數就無法進行比較；(b)如DIF試題存在但卻未能被偵測到，後續的決策(如大學入學資格與醫療診斷)則會受到錯誤的測驗分數所影響；(c)如果乾淨的題目卻被錯誤判斷為具有DIF的試題而被更改或棄置，則會浪費極大的時間與金錢。 許多DIF的評估方法已經被發展出來，任何DIF評估方法的前提是將不同組別考生置於共同的量尺上，以檢測DIF試題。共同量尺是採用配對變項所建立出來，只有配變項為乾淨的試題時，DIF分析的結果才會正確無誤。然而既存的DIF評估方法無法建立乾淨的配對變項，這使得DIF評估的結果有誤，進而導致測驗不公，或者在測驗發展上的時間和金錢的浪費。 本計畫旨在(a)解決建立配對變項上的基礎性問題；(b)透過創新的策略”DIF-free-then-DIF“來建立新的DIF評估方法；以及(c)評定新策略在各種情境中的表現。相對於傳統的方法，策略的應用將可產生更具可信的DIF分析。本計畫連結了理論與實務，以增進測驗的公平與不同組別間的比較。我們期盼在DIF評估新紀元開啟的同時，香港在DIF評估中可持續扮演領導的角色。

Propose the DFTD strategy, implement this strategy while using various DIF assessment methods, and demonstrate its advantages over those alternative methods.
Exemplify implications and applications of the DFTD strategy through systematic and secondary real data analyses.
Build a new methodology and start a new era of DIF assessment.

844110.label: Major findings and research outcome
844110.value: The DFTD strategy has been successfully developed. In a published paper, we described the key ideas of this strategy, demonstrated its procedures step by step, and conducted simulations to evaluate its performance. The paper has been published in Educational and Psychological Measurement. In another manuscript, entitled “A purification procedure for choosing reference indicators in multiple group factor analysis,” we adopted the DFTD strategy to select clean indicators in multiple-group confirmatory factor analysis. The manuscript was submitted to Multivariate Behavioral Research for publication. Studies on incorporating the DFTD strategy to the MIMIC method and examining the effects of the number of anchored items on DIF assessment have been presented at the annual meeting of the International Meeting of Psychological Society. We also sought the potentials of expanding the application of the DFTD strategy with multiple grouping variables and cognitive diagnostic models. Manuscripts are under preparation and will be submitted to international journals for publication soon. All of these research outcomes demonstrate a great success in this project.

844110.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
844110.value: This project creates a new research line for future studies. The following are important research topics. First, the DFTD strategy can be applied to different measurement models (e.g., linear models and cognitive diagnostic models). Second, there may be multiple grouping variables and they may have interactions. Third, grouping variables may be latent rather than observed. Our team members will keep researching these topics.

844110.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
844110.value: Test fairness is essential. To ensure that no item favors or disfavors any group of test-takers, many detection methods for differential item functioning (DIF) have been developed. All methods require a clean matching variable to place different groups of test-takers on the same scale. When a matching variable consists of DIF items, it will be contaminated. The more DIF items in a matching variable, the worse the method will perform. Several scale purification procedures have been developed in the literature to purify the contamination. Unfortunately, they fail when there are many DIF items in a matching variable. In this project, we have successfully developed the so called DIF-free-then-DIF strategy to resolve this fundamental problem in searching a clean matching variable. Simulation results demonstrate its superiorly over traditional methods on the detection of DIF items. Test fairness is better secured with this new strategy. This project also opens a new research line because the new strategy is very general and can be applied to other conditions, such as measurement invariance in factor analysis. We will continuously devote ourselves to transferring the knowledge generated from this project and relevant research issues.

844710.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
844710.value: 這是一項由兩岸三地學者共同設計主持的人文學科基礎性研究課題，內容包括建設一個漢譯佛經漢、印語言對比分析語料庫，和在此基礎之上的譯經詞匯、語義和語法專題研究，最終目的在於深入瞭解古代印度佛教及文化對漢語的發展演變究竟起到了什麼樣的作用，並推動三地佛教漢語研究的開展。 對於古代印度佛教文化與中國文化的關係，學術界在以下兩個方面已經形成高度的共識：一是印度佛教文化對中國文化有巨大的影響；二是不瞭解、不研究這種影響，就不可能對東漢以來的中國文化的歷史發展面貌及其動因有全面的認識（季羨林1988：16-21）。 不過，在漢語方面，這一影響尚未得到充分的揭示（向熹1993，朱慶之2007a）。主要原因是：在1990年代之前，理論語言學還沒有充分認識到語言接觸會對語言的發展演變有全面的影響；研究者大都不具備跨文化跨語言研究的能力，除了有明顯特徵的宗教和哲學借詞，其他外來成分大都難以辨認。 漢譯佛經是印度語言和文化影響漢語和漢文化最重要的媒介，亦可視為是這種影響的第一步，因而也是研究印度佛教文化影響漢語和漢文化的基本材料。本研究將用「梵漢對勘」，即漢譯佛經和與其平行的古代印度語文本對比分析的方法，對《維摩詰經》《法華經》和《阿毗達磨俱舍論》三部有代表性的佛經進行窮盡式的專書研究，建立漢印對勘語料庫，找出漢譯文中與古印度平行文本所有有對應關係的詞彙、語義和語法成分，發掘譯文中因原典影響而出現的特殊語言現象，並且進一步追蹤這些已獲得漢語外殼的外來成分對漢語發展演變有什麽樣的影響。 語言是思想和文化的基本載體。本研究的成果不僅會對漢語歷史研究有所貢獻，也會對中國哲學史、思想史、翻譯史和中印文化交流史的研究有重要的參考價值，最終將提升我們對中國文化歷史發展變化過程和原因的認識。 This is a cooperative project to be conducted by scholars from Hong Kong, Taiwan and Mainland China, which includes the construction of a comparative database of Chinese Buddhist translations and their Indian parallels, as well as lexical, semantic and grammatical research based on this database. The objective of this project is to examine the impacts of Indian Buddhism upon the Chinese language and to boost the study of Buddhist Chinese in China. Two points have been generally acknowledged concerning the relationship between the Indian and Chinese cultures. One is that Indian Buddhism has exerted a profound influence on Chinese culture in many ways. The other is that without appreciating this influence, one can never attain a full-scale understanding of the history of Chinese culture and even the history of China (Ji Xianlin 季羨林 1988:16-21). However, this influence has not yet been substantiated with respect to the Chinese language(Xiang Xi 向熹 1993, Zhu Qingzhi 朱慶之 2007a). This can be attributed to two factors: first, before the 1990s, it was assumed that the Chinese language as a self-sufficient system basically resisted any deeper change other than obtaining a few loanwords during language contacts; second, due to the lack of interdisciplinary knowledge, most Chinese linguists fail to recognize other foreign elements except for explicit transliterations or translations of Buddhist terminologies. As the major medium and direct testimony to the influence of Indian Buddhism on Chinese culture and language, Chinese Buddhist translations comprise the fundamental database of our research in this regard. The present project will focus on three influential Buddhist texts including the Weimojie jing 維摩詰經 (“The Teaching of Vimalakīrti,” Skt. Vimalakīrtinirdeśa-sūtra), the Fahua jing 法華經 (“The Lotus Sutra,” Skt. Saddharmapuarīka-sūtra) and The Apidamojushelun 阿毗達磨俱舍論 (“The Commentary on the Treasury of Abhidharma”, Skt. Abhidharmakośabhā ya).Through comparing their Chinese and Sanskrit versions, we will identify the Indian origin of each Chinese lexical, grammatical and semantic item, if applicable. Further analyses will be undertaken with particular regard to those elements that emerged as a result of the interference of Indian originals, so as to discern if and how these elements found their way into the common Chinese language. In view of the significance of language as the essential vehicle for expressing thoughts and concepts, this project will also benefit other relevant studies such as the history of Chinese philosophy, the history of translation in China and the history of communication between ancient India and China.

844710.label: Realisation of objectives
844710.value: 本項目2011年1月1日正式開始進行，到2014年6月30日結束，歷時三年半，終告完成。項目的5項目標基本達成。總結如下： 1.完成了“漢譯佛經梵漢對比分析語料庫”的開發，並建成網上檢索系統，可供研究者利用互聯網進行檢索。 2.對譯文和平行梵文本作了逐詞逐句的語言學對比分析，對其句法地位和語義進行了詳細的描寫，對譯文中與原典有關的絕大多數語言現象的產生原因作了文本層面的解釋，全部資料約15000頁。 3.對漢譯文在詞彙、語義、語法和語篇中受到原典語言（梵文）影響的具體表現正在逐一分析討論，在梵語音節、名詞的格、名詞代詞複數、被動式的時間表達以及篇章結構等方面已有文章發表，其他的研究正在進行。 4.在釐清翻譯佛經語文中來自原典的影響的同時，關注這些影響對於漢語發展演變的作用。 5.項目吸收了九位來自兩岸三地的年輕學者參加，包括北京外國語大學的王繼紅，中國社會科學院梵文研究中心的姜南，上海交通大學人文學院的范慕尤，台灣中央大學的趙淑華（博士研究生），香港教育學院的李博寒（博士研究生），中國人民大學文學院的朱冠明、上海復旦大學國學研究院的劉震、北京语言大学的邱冰和北京科技大學計算機學院的皇甫偉。通過項目的工作，這些年輕學者得到了從事佛教漢語研究的學術訓練。 本項目要通過對佛經的漢譯文本與平行梵語文本的“一個虛詞都不放過”式的語言分析比較，試圖從源頭上了解印度佛教如何通過翻譯佛經來影響漢語，影響中國人的思維和表達方式，進而影響到中國文化的方方面面。這在中外學術界尚屬首次，沒有參照，這是一難；研究者需要受過漢學與印度學（佛教學）跨學科的學術訓練，這樣的人材很少，這是二難；對兩種古代語言進行精細語言分析和描寫，需要花大量的時間，這是三難。但經過項目組成員的共同努力，以及UGC惠允延期，這些困難大都得以克服。

844710.label: Major findings and research outcome
844710.value: 1. 建立了國內外學術界第一個“漢譯佛典漢梵語言對比分析語料庫”，為佛教與中國文化關係之研究提供了一個最基礎同時是最新的研究平台。主要的工作包括：A）對三部佛經作了精細的漢梵語言對比分析。B）已將對比分析的結果數字化，並開發出網上檢索系統，可供研究者利用互聯網進行檢索。試用版（http://ckc.ied.edu.hk:8080）已經上網，在同行之間交流，聽取意見，即時修訂。項目結項報告評審通過後可提供給學界正式使用。 2. 在進行語料對比分析、建立語料庫的同時，計劃中的研究工作已經展開。業已撰寫將近30篇文章，其中10篇已經在中國語言學的權威或有影響的學術期刊發表或即將發表。文章內容涵蓋了計劃中的所有方面：通過系統的專書漢梵對比分析，使譯文中與梵文有關係之處得以系統揭示，將項目主持人早先提出之佛教漢語兩個混合的基本特徵中之“目的語與源頭語之混合”的觀點提供了更為堅實的證據。通過利用語料庫的資料，不但討論了譯文中與原典有關的特殊語言現象（Ref 8.1, 8.3-6,8.7,8.9-10/9.7,9.12-14），還努力尋找佛經翻譯對漢語詞彙和語法的影響，並取得了一項突破性的成果，這就是論證了漢語人稱代詞和名詞複數形式（如北方話的“們”和粵語的“哋”）來源於佛經翻譯，是因佛經翻譯導致的目的語（漢語）與源頭語（如梵語）的語言接觸的產物（Ref 8.2,8.8/9.10-12）。 3.開發出計算機“漢譯佛經漢梵對比分析”製作系統和閱讀檢索系統，為今後的擴大研究奠定了基礎。

844710.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
844710.value: 本研究計劃建立的“漢譯佛典漢梵語言對比分析語料庫”及在此基礎上展開的研究實踐，在佛教漢語研究的理論和方法上，都是一次有益的嘗試與示範。語料庫可以為相關的研究者，尤其是那些需要利用梵語資料而又沒有能力利用的研究者，提供一個全新的研究平台；課題組利用這個平台所取得和正在取得的研究成果，亦可為今後佛教漢語研究提供一種可供選擇的研究視角和範式。語料庫的開放性，使得它可以吸引相關領域的研究者或研究團隊在利用之餘參與它的發展，不但指出其不足甚至錯誤，還可以擴充它，使之在不遠的將來成為一個完全開放、資料豐富、實用性強的高品質的研究平臺，嘉惠學界。就本項目的參與者來說，利用語料庫的資料對三部譯經的語言作精細的分析（參看成果9.14），寫出更多高水平的學術論文，應是完全可以期待之事。

844710.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
844710.value: 印度佛教對中國古代文化的發展有十分重要的影響，這種影響首先表現在語言方面，通過佛經翻譯，大量印度語言和文化成分首先進入譯文（漢譯佛經），形成了“佛教漢語”，這種語言因為中國人對佛經的誦習而得到認同，其中一部分進入日常漢語，不僅豐富了漢語的表達方式、提高了漢語的表達能力，在某些方面還影響到漢語後來的發展演變。但在已往，以上的認識僅僅是模糊的，得不到第一手材料支持的。本項目利用印度學的最新成果，將翻譯佛經與印度原典進行語言學的對比分析，真正了解到譯經語文與原典語文的具體關係，不但將過往的“推測”落到實處，還有大量新的發現。在方法和內容上改善了漢語史和相關範疇的研究廣度和深度，具有重要的學術價值。

844710.label: Other impact (e.g. award of patents or prizes, collaboration with other research institutions, technology transfer, etc.)
844710.value: “漢譯佛經梵漢對比分析語料庫”(A Database of Chinese Buddhist translation and their Sanskrit parallels for the Buddhist Chinese Studies)（試用版）介紹（使用說明請看附件，網址: http://ckc.ied.edu.hk:8080） 這是專門為佛教漢語研究者設計的研究工具，包括兩個方面的內容：第一、漢譯佛經與現存平行梵語佛典的文本（段落）對照，第二、漢譯詞語之平行梵語成分的語法和語義描寫和分析。建立語料庫的目的在於方便佛教漢語的研究者了解譯文與平行梵語之間可能存在的對應關係。語料庫目前收入的資料有《法華經》、《維摩詰經》和《俱舍論》（試用版中各兩品）。 2010年，香港教育學院朱慶之教授與台灣中央大學萬金川教授、北京大學段晴教授合作設計了題為“漢譯佛經梵漢對比分析語料庫建設及其漢語歷史語言學研究”（Assessing the impact of Sanskrit on the Chinese language: Creating a database of Chinese Buddhist translations and their Sanskrit parallels to facilitate research in historical Chinese linguistics through contrastive analysis）的研究計劃，並得到香港特別行政區政府研資局（RGC）GRF的支持（項目編號為HKIEd844710）。 這項研究計劃具體參與語料庫的設計和製作工作的主要有王繼紅博士（北京外國語大學）、姜南博士（中國社會科學院梵語研究中心）、劉震博士（復旦大學）、范慕尤博士（上海交通大學）、趙淑華（臺灣中央大學博士研究生）、皇甫偉博士（北京科技大學）和邱冰博士（北京語言大學）。其中，王繼紅、姜南和范慕尤分別負責《俱舍論》、《法華經》和《維摩詰經》的梵漢對比；趙淑華和劉震負責對初稿進行校訂，其中趙淑華重點校訂了《法華經》第一、第四品和《維摩詰經》第一、第二品，劉震校訂了《法華經》的其餘部分；語料庫的軟件開發則由皇甫偉和邱冰負責。
